actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Radiant damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Overwhelming Presence (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, each enemy in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the angel can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Prone and Stunned conditions until the end of the angel's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Warding Bond (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The angel can choose one creature it can see within 30 feet to become its ward. The target becomes the angel's ward until it dies or until the angel uses this Bonus Action to choose a different ward. While the angel is within 10 feet of this ward, the ward gains a +4 bonus to saving throws.

fluffInfo.value: Also known as myrmeriks, angels of slaughter serve gods of death (such as Myrkul in the Forgotten Realms setting or Nerull in the Greyhawk setting). Only three angels of slaughter exist at a time. Divine entities must bargain with angels of slaughter for their service.

These angels slaughter hundreds at a time in epic acts of carnage. Holy texts record these events as warnings against whole cities or nations earning the wrath of a god. In rare cases, certain individuals might earn the bitter enmity of a god, causing that deity to request the services of an angel of slaughter to destroy their quarry. Angels of slaughter often employ other creatures to assist in their slaughter, and they sometimes use weather events or plagues as cover for their atrocities.

Each angel of slaughter dwells in a fortress in the Shadowfell. In return for its services, an angel of slaughter is gifted some of the souls and corpses that it harvests during its catastrophic endeavors. The angel either consumes these souls to power its abilities, or the angel employs the souls to maintain its Shadowfell demesne.

In its true form, an angel of slaughter is a whirlwind of blood, bones, corpses, and blades. The angel often takes the illusionary form of a giant, a massive beast, or another spectral entity to survey the area the angel is about to decimate. Many mortals recognize sightings of an angel of slaughter as portents for coming disasters.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, radiant; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.value: If the angel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The angel makes two Engulfing Slam attacks and uses Fling.

actions.name: Engulfing Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**2d10 + 9**) Slashing damage plus 13 (**2d12**) Radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pulled into the angel's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. When the angel moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The angel can have up to three creatures Grappled by this action at a time.

actions.name: Fling
actions.value: The angel throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space the angel can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: Angels of vengeance, also known as umulti, begin their existences as planetars, sent by greater divine powers to seek justice and retribution for those wronged. If a planetar performs evil, immoral, or unsavory acts while delivering justice, it can become corrupted. Its evil acts cause it to waste away physically and spiritually, transforming into an angel of vengeance.

Angels of vengeance target those who commit transgressions against divine entities, often regardless of the transgression's severity. These angels aim to kill, not to parley, and an angel of vengeance speaks only to let a victim know that they are about to die.

An angel of vengeance's true form is large fiery eye within the center of five concentric rings. The rings are often made of a material that befits the divine power that it originally worked for; for example, angels created by fire deities evoke rings of fire, while those created by wealth deities often bear rings of precious metals. Angels of vengeance often disguise themselves as silent, purposeful humanoids clad in armor and wielding swords.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The angel makes three Ring attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Unblinking Eye.

actions.name: Ring
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of five rings, and while Grappled, it has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Cone of Retribution (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each enemy in a 90-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Unblinking Eye
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature Grappled by the angel. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: *As patient as a fisherman, the angler worm lights a beacon in the darkness and waits for its next meal.*

fluffInfo.name: Silk Snares
fluffInfo.value: The angler worm burrows into the ceilings of caves and tunnels, where it creates snares from strong silk threads coated with sticky mucus. It then lures prey into its snares while remaining safely hidden, emerging only to feed. With dozens of snares, food always comes to the angler worm eventually.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Keen Touch
traits.value: The angler worm has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on vibrations.

traits.name: Snare Walker
traits.value: The angler worm ignores movement restrictions caused by its snares or the snares of other angler worms.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The angler worm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Transparent Trap
traits.value: With 10 minutes of work, the angler worm can create a web of nearly transparent snares in a 20-foot cube. The web must be anchored between two solid masses or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling. A web of snares layered over a flat surface has a depth of 5 feet. The web is difficult terrain, and the snares forming it are nearly transparent, requiring a successful DC 15 Wisdom (*Perception*) check to notice them.

A creature that starts its turn in the web of snares or enters the web during its turn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky snares. A creature restrained by the snares can use its action to free itself by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The angler worm makes two Bite attacks or one Bite attack and one Coils attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Coils
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained by the angler worm, it can't breathe, it takes 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the angler worm's turns, and the angler worm can't use its Coils on another target.

actions.name: Ethereal Lure (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: The angler worm creates an orb of faint, blue light on a point it can see within 20 feet of it. The light glows until the start of the worm's next turn. When a creature that isn't an angler worm starts its turn within 60 feet of the orb and can see the light, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of its next turn. While charmed, the creature must take the Dash action and move toward the light by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the light. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the charmed creature enters the worm's snares, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to avoid being restrained.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The blade can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.value: Opportunity attacks against the blade are made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the blade with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the blade, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Machete
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Wild Hop
bonusActions.value: The blade jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed. If the blade uses this bonus action to jump at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, the next Machete attack the blade makes against that creature on the same turn is made with advantage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The needler can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sniper
traits.value: If the needler misses with a ranged weapon attack while they are hidden, they remain hidden. Additionally, if the needler makes a ranged weapon attack with advantage and hits, the attack deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the needler with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the needler, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Blowgun
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While poisoned in this way, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) poison damage at the start of each of their turns.

bonusActions.name: Hop and Hide
bonusActions.value: The needler jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The seer can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Third Eye
traits.value: Creatures within 30 feet of the seer can't hide from the seer. Creatures who can't be targeted by divination magic are immune to this effect.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the seer with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the seer, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Acid Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage. If the target is a creature and they attack the seer before the start of the seer's next turn, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Refulgent Beam
actions.value: The seer fires two magical beams of radiant energy, each beam targeting a creature the seer can see within 120 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While shedding light in this way, attack rolls against the target have advantage, the target can't benefit from being invisible, and they can't take the Hide action.

actions.name: Noxious Bubble (1/Day)
actions.value: The seer creates a 5-foot-radius sphere filled with toxic gas in an unoccupied space they can see within 60 feet of them. If undisturbed, this bubble lasts for 1 minute then dissipates harmlessly. If a creature attacks the bubble, touches it, enters its space, or otherwise disturbs it, the bubble bursts, and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (**6d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Psychedelic Drone (1/Day)
actions.value: Each enemy within 60 feet of the seer who can hear them must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage and be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.name: Hop
bonusActions.value: The seer jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The slink can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The slink can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the slink with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the slink, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The slink makes one Poison Dagger attack and one Tongue Nab attack.

actions.name: Poison Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Tongue Nab
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. *Hit:* The slink grabs one Small or Tiny object the slink can see that the target is holding or carrying. The slink can catch the object if they have a free hand, otherwise it lands at the slink's feet.

bonusActions.name: Hop and Hide
bonusActions.value: The slink jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Acid Burst
traits.value: When the tadpole is reduced to 0 hit points, their body pops, spraying acid around them. Each creature within 5 feet of the tadpole takes 1 acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The tadpole can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the tadpole takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tadpole takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Noxious Skin
traits.value: When a creature starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more tadpoles, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 feet of the creature.

actions.name: Bite (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: acrobatics +3 plus PB, athletics +0 plus PB, stealth +3 plus PB, survival +2 plus PB

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The angulotl yegg can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Poison Knife)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d4 plus PB** piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage. Beginning at 7th level, the yegg can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Death from Above! (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the yegg jumps up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they leap over an enemy during this jump, the yegg can make a signature attack with advantage against that enemy. On a hit, this attack deals an extra **PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Lay Low (3/Day)
actions.value: When the yegg hits a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use their reaction to remain hidden.

actions.name: 7th Level: Excoriating Acid (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the yegg throws a flask of acid at a point they can see within 20 feet of them. The flask shatters, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd10** acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Promising Threat
traits.value: The bestial spirit has advantage on Charisma (*Intimidation*) checks if the target has seen it hit a creature with its Chomp attack in the past minute.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Elementals can be found all over Drakkenheim, often in areas where the eldritch magics are especially concentrated. Many who have encountered these elementals have spoken of the city itself coming to life to attack them. Reports of ruins reaching out and crushing adventurers, burning flames moving and hunting with minds of their own, or contaminated pools lurching to engulf passersby have been heard. Even the blowing air itself has mustered parts of the Haze into shifting clouds that stalk adventurers through the streets. These magical creatures are a constant reminder that nothing in the city can be trusted, and that nowhere is truly safe.

entries: **Resistances**: acid; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Sludge Form
traits.value: The animated sludge can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. In addition, a target hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: Each creature in the animated sludge's space must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes grappled by the sludge if it is Large or smaller (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the sludge's space.

The sludge can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the sludge's turns, each target grappled by it takes 28 (**8d6**) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).
A creature within 5 feet of the sludge can attempt to pull a creature or object out of it. This takes an action and requires a successful DC 14 Strength check.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study an Animated Delerium Sludge, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Malleable and Resilient
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Contamination by Contact
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Contaminated Touch and Engulf actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Easy to Outwit
fluffInfo.value: You know the elemental's mental ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Animated Delerium Sludge often lies dormant in bodies of water before attempting to Engulf an unsuspecting creature. If reduced to less than 20 Hit Points, it attempts to slip back into the nearby sludge and Hide, hoping to be left alone.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Invisible in Sludge
traits.value: The elemental has the Invisible condition while fully submerged in delerium sludge.

traits.name: Sludge Form
traits.value: The elemental can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each Large or smaller creature in the elemental's space. *Success* The target is pushed out of the elemental's space. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

At the start of each of the elemental's turns, the target takes 28 (**8d6**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.
A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can take an action to pull a creature or object out of it with a successful DC 15 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: If the spirit is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spirit move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the spirit isn't an object.

traits.name: New Form (1/Day)
traits.value: When the spirit is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it can choose a different object it can see within 10 feet of it and send its consciousness into that object. After it does so, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Reach
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Mage Hand__ cantrip. When it does so, the spectral hand created by the spell is invisible.

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Animated Slimes
fluffInfo.value: Animated slimes can morph into common objects for various uses: tables, benches, etc. Some have used them to help furnish the homes of the poor. Some animated slimes have gone rogue, acting as mundane pieces of furniture to lure prey into their clutches.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The animated slime can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.value: While the animated slime remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The animated slime has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Occasionally Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.value: The animated slime can use a bonus action to become sticky and adhere to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the animated slime is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The animated slime can become non-adhesive at any time.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the slime is in object form, the target is subjected to its Occasionally Adhesive trait (if it is currently active).

traits.name: Disoriented Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: When the ankheg fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead, and they can't use bonus actions until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.value: Difficult terrain composed of earth and stone doesn't cost the ankheg extra movement.

traits.name: Soft Underbelly
traits.value: When a prone creature within 5 feet of the ankheg attacks the ahkheg, the attack is made with advantage instead of disadvantage.

traits.name: Unstable Tunneler
traits.value: While burrowing, the ankheg leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake. Each section of tunnel collapses 1 minute after the ahkheg leaves that space.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the ankheg can't make a Bite attack against another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ankheg spits acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) acid damage and is bathed in acid. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

A creature who is bathed in acid takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature can use their action to wipe the acid off themself or another creature within their reach, ending the effect early.

bonusActions.name: Earth Eruption
bonusActions.value: While burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, the ankheg erupts (without spending movement) into a 10-foot square on the ground directly above them. This area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature on the ground in this area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the ankheg's choice and is restrained by rubble. A creature can use their action to free themself or another creature within their reach. On a successful save, a creature is moved 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the creature's choice and is not restrained.

fluffInfo.value: *The massive worm erupted from the earth, crushing all near it and scooping up the remains.*

An annelidast is a gigantic worm that slumbers for decades at a time in the bowels of the earth, where the rock itself radiates primordial magic. Over millennia, they have grown lead-plated carapaces to shield themselves from the magic.

fluffInfo.name: Unique Predation
fluffInfo.value: Each century, an annelidast wakes and travels to the surface to feed. The worm eats through baleen-like teeth that help it filter feed through the earth as it travels underground, but this method of eating requires it to pulverize larger surface prey before consumption.

fluffInfo.name: Sleeping Plague
fluffInfo.value: The annelidast's exterior is saturated with the primordial magic of its deep-earth home. When an annelidast nears waking, it burrows toward the surface in a dreamlike state, following vibrations in the earth made by living creatures. As it lies just beneath the surface rousing from its slumber, the primordial magic infusing it radiates outward and sickens creatures living there, making them easier prey when it fully wakes.

entries: **Immunities**: bludgeoning, poison from nonmagical attacks; poisoned

traits.name: Deep Earth Dweller
traits.value: The annelidast doesn't require air.

traits.name: Primordial Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) poison damage. A creature that finishes a long rest within 1,000 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or develop tumors across its body and become poisoned until the tumors are removed by the __greater restoration__ spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The annelidast can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The annelidast makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**2d12 + 8**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the annelidast. A creature restrained by the annelidast automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

actions.name: Crush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The annelidast launches most of its massive bulk into the air and crashes down on the ground in a 20-foot line that is 10 feet wide. It then retracts itself into a space along that line and can occupy the space of one or more Large or smaller creatures. Each creature in the line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (**7d12**) bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone, and is restrained while it shares a space with the annelidast, as it is pinned beneath the annelidast's body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed out of the annelidast's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice within 5 feet of the annelidast. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 17 Strength check. If the annelidast burrows along the surface of the earth at least 20 feet before using this action, creatures in the line have disadvantage on the saving throw.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: Annominc has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.value: If Annominc moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Annominc can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study an Anomollusk, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Powerfully Protected
fluffInfo.value: You learn its Resistances as well as its Shell Reflection Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dangerous Slime
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Snail Trail and Creep abilities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Slow and Simple Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Drawn to magic, Anomollusk's view spellcasters and those equipped with magic items as delicious morsels. It attacks by first using its Creep action before it tries to Slobber on them. If threatened, it tries to cover the enemy and its territory in acidic slime. If reduced to less than half Hit Points, it attempts to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Acidic Bile, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Shell, Skin.

entries: **Resistances**: Damage from Spells; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Magical Attacks

traits.name: Snail Trail
traits.value: When the anomollusk moves through a space, it fills the space with contaminated mucus that remains for 10 minutes. A creature that ends its turn in the mucus is covered in goop and subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Slowed condition. Each time the creature ends its turn with the Slowed condition, it gains a Contamination level. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to clean away the goop, ending the Slowed condition.

actions.name: Slobber
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Creep
actions.value: The anomollusk moves up to its Speed, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Anthracia has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Anthracia makes three attacks using Stone Touch, Missile Thorn, or both. She can also use Tree Teleport, if available.

actions.name: Stone Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be restrained (save ends at end of turn) as their limbs become heavy. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they become stable and are petrified into a withered stone tree featuring their tortured likeness. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Missile Thorn
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Tree Teleport (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Anthracia touches a living tree. She instantly teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another living tree within 500 feet of the first.
Both trees must be Medium or larger.

actions.name: Wall of Poison (1/Day)
actions.value: Anthracia conjures an opaque wall of poisonous gas centered on a point she can see within 150 feet of her. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall lingers in the air for 1 minute and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature who is in that area when the wall appears or who enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (**4d12**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who don't need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the wall after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

fluffInfo.value: *Swirling sand comes together to form a snarling, canine-faced humanoid whose eyes shine with an eerie, blue glow.*
Anubians are elementals summoned to guard tombs or protect treasures.

fluffInfo.name: Piles of Dust
fluffInfo.value: An anubian at rest resembles a pile of sand or dust, often strewn about an already dusty location. When active, it rises up to form a muscular humanoid with the head of a jackal. A destroyed anubian collapses into an inert pile of sand.

fluffInfo.name: Death to the Unarmored
fluffInfo.value: In combat, anubians prefer to fight unarmored foes rather than creatures wearing armor. They associate unarmored creatures with spellcasters, and their latent resentment over centuries of being summoned as servants drives them to attack such figures when they aren't shackled by magical bondage.

fluffInfo.name: Sandstorm Tag Teams
fluffInfo.value: Anubians fight effectively as teams, using their haboob attacks to corner and isolate the most vulnerable targets.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.value: The anubian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Sand Camouflage
traits.value: The anubian has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

traits.name: Sand Form
traits.value: The anubian can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Vulnerability to Water
traits.value: For every 5 feet the anubian moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 (**1d4**) cold damage. An anubian completely immersed in water takes 10 (**4d4**) cold damage at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The anubian makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Haboob (1/Day)
actions.value: A 30-foot-tall cylinder of sand forms in the anubian's space and moves with it for 10 minutes, until the anubian ends the storm as a bonus action, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). The area within 5 feet of the anubian is heavily obscured. A creature that starts its turn in that area or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the storm. While restrained, the creature takes 3 (**1d6**) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns, and moves with the anubian when the anubian moves. A creature, including the restrained creature, can use its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

bonusActions.name: Sand Step
bonusActions.value: The anubian collapses into loose sand and teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, reforming in that space. If the destination space contains sand, the anubian can immediately Hide. The anubian can't use Sand Step while Haboob is active.

fluffInfo.value: *Sharp teeth fill this large, demonic ape's mouth. Its long, muscular arms stretch to the ground, ending in wickedly curved claws.*

fluffInfo.name: Servants of Fire
fluffInfo.value: These black-furred gorilla demons serve only Mechuiti, the demon lord of fire and apes. Their final loyalty is unshakable, though sometimes they serve others for a time. They have no fear of fire, gleefully setting villages and crops aflame if their master is snubbed or insulted.

fluffInfo.name: Fearless Attackers
fluffInfo.value: The apau perape are fearless and savage, living for battle. Once in combat, their morale never breaks. Like their master, they have an insatiable hunger and leave no dead behind, consuming even the bones.

fluffInfo.name: Eyes of Fire
fluffInfo.value: When this demon is angered, its eyes glow a deep, disturbing red, unlike any natural ape.

entries: **Resistances**: fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Diseased Ichor
traits.value: When the apau perape takes piercing damage or slashing damage, a spray of caustic blood spurts from the wound. Each creature within 5 feet of the apau perape must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the Mechuiti's ichor disease and be poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hp maximum by 5 (2d4) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The apau perape has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The apau perape makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fiery Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The apau perape releases a terrifying, flame-coated roar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (**9d6**) fire damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened.

fluffInfo.name: Perfect Transmogrification
fluffInfo.value: Amongst __Mutagenists__, the quest for genetic perfection can become an all-consuming obsession. Those who seek to achieve this so-called superior state refer to it as the "Apex" and describe the transformation as creating the ultimate humanoid specimen.

Through years of study and trials, Mutagenists have perfected their Transmogrifying Elixir to harness the ultimate power of mortal potential. This formula allows them to amplify their natural capabilities to the peak physical form while maintaining their unbound intellect. There is no telling how many long years a Mutagenist has spent in their lab, and how many unwilling test subjects had to suffer the fates of their imperfect formulae before they arrived at the ultimate conclusion of their research. This is the pinnacle of their scientific study, the perfected Transmogrifying Elixir: the Apex Formula.

fluffInfo.name: Permanent Transformation
fluffInfo.value: The process renders the Mutagenist permanently altered. Energy courses through their veins, their strength and agility extended to the very limits of human capabilities. Their form is able to shift and adapt to incoming threats, and they are able to perceive events around them with great precision. Their mind, although it remains intellectually intact by the process, is inherently and irrevocably shattered. No Mutagenist who takes the Apex Formula could ever perceive or admit to the fracturing of their mind. Regardless of their vast intelligence, a sickening madness takes hold of their psyche; one that plunges the apothecary-turned-Apex creature into a hostile, madness-filled rage. They still hold onto the threads of their vast scientific mind, using that as a justification for their actions, unaware of the deranged mental state they now reside within.

fluffInfo.name: The Folly of Perfection
fluffInfo.value: Even Mutagenists who achieve the Apex state have a gnawing question in the back of their minds: is it truly enough? Could they become even more? Their seemingly perfect form is not without subtle flaws, broken psyche, and weaknesses. Many Mutagenists can never truly be satisfied with their results, and even the Apex Formula can never fulfill the unattainable desire for absolute perfection. It is this obsession that has led many Mutagenists to lunacy in the face of their achievements. For even an Apex may spend eternity bound to their workshop, kidnapping unwilling subjects to continue to test and experiment, seeking a perfection that will never truly be achieved.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying the Cacophonous Chimera:

entries: **Personality Trait:** I am humanity perfected! All beings are beneath me, for I am the apex of physical existence. All should cower in my glory
**Bond:** Science has granted us this gift! This research is the most valuable scientific discovery in the world and must be protected!
**Ideal:** Do not try and stop me, for I am offering perfection to all of humanity. Can't you see? The Apex Form will cure the world of all sickness, all flaws, all weakness!
**Flaw:** There cannot be a weakness in my design. If there is, I will solve it — I just need more time!

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine*, *Survival*, or *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Apex. , learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Adapts to Threats
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Apex's Rapid Adaptation Reaction and Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Harness the Elements
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Bonus Action attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Perfect Form but Fragile Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the Apex's weakness to Necrotic and Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Apex will often be accompanied by several abominations of its own creation. Lab assistants, failed experiments, and __Wretched Patients__ are often by its side.

An Apex begins combat by unleashing one of its Bonus Action attacks. It quickly analyzes the battlefield, looking for the most optimal use of its energy. It observes the arrangement of its enemies and decides if it is best to use its lightning, fire, or cold attack based on what will deliver the most damage to the most targets.
It then uses its speed to move close to a target to smash it with its Slam attacks. The Apex prefers to target Frozen enemies with its Slams.

The Apex is unwilling to see its own flaws, but it is not stupid. If reduced below 60 Hit Points, it unleashes a final attack and attempts to distance itself from its enemies, hoping to escape and recuperate.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +10, athletics +10, intimidation +10, medicine +10, nature +10, perception +10

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Apex regains 20 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the Apex takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Apex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Apex's Long Jump is up to 50 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Apex makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Lightning Bolt
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Fire Blast
bonusActions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Fire damage, and the target and each creature within 10 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target has the Burning condition (4d8 Fire).

bonusActions.name: Cold Snap
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature the Apex can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The witch makes two attacks, using Dagger or Eldritch Burst in any combination.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Force damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The aqualisk can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The aqualisk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The aqualisk's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The aqualisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. If it is grappling a creature, it can also use its Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 7**) piercing damage plus 11 (**2d10**) force damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (**2d10**) force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, that creature is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the aqualisk can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Ethereal Strike (1/Turn)
actions.value: While on the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk momentarily shifts to the Material Plane and makes a bite attack against a creature before returning to the Ethereal Plane. Unless the target can see into the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.value: The aqualisk magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane. If a creature is grappled by the aqualisk when it uses this action, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane with it. The aqualisk and target remain there as long as the aqualisk maintains *concentration* (as if *concentrating* on a spell). If its *concentration* is broken or it chooses to end its *concentration*, the aqualisk and the target both return to the Material Plane.

actions.name: Fling
actions.value: One object held or creature grappled by the aqualisk is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction it chooses and knocked prone. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Bite, Pinch, or Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bubble Lift (1/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Bubble Lift__ spell, using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability

fluffInfo.value: *A portly gentleman with slender arms and legs keeps his face and hands carefully concealed.*
Arachnocrats are spider-like fiends who enjoy masquerading as members of high society. They eat haute cuisine and drink fine wine in the company of humans.

fluffInfo.name: Finer Tastes
fluffInfo.value: Viewing the wealth and standing of their victims as the greatest measure of taste, these devils delight in aristocratic prey, though they most often feed on the liquefied innards of servants of the aristocracy to avoid detection. They use local spiders as spies and informants to get closer to their quarries or discover dark secrets their quarries would rather keep hidden. Ever patient in their schemes of corruption, arachnocrats often court their quarries over months of theatre, dinner parties, and elaborate balls.

fluffInfo.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
fluffInfo.value: Arachnocrats are adept at disguising themselves as aristocrats. Their most noticeable features are their clawed hands and their spider-like faces, which they cover with gloves, masks, scarves, voluminous robes, and similar attire. The eccentricities of the well-to-do help to cast off any suspicion over their odd coverings.

fluffInfo.name: As Good As Gold
fluffInfo.value: The arachnocrat's preferred prey comes at a high price. Blessed by the Arch-Devil of Greed, Mammon (*Tome of Beasts*), arachnocrats have a second stomach that can turn common rocks into faux gemstones. The fiends vomit up the gemstones after digesting the rocks for a few months, and they use the gemstones to fund their endeavors. The counterfeit nature of the gems is detectable by only true craftsmen.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Aristocratic Disguise
traits.value: An arachnocrat in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) checks made to pass as a humanoid aristocrat.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the arachnocrat's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The arachnocrat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Spiders
traits.value: The arachnocrat can communicate with spiders and other arachnids as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The arachnocrat can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arachnocrat makes two claw attacks. If both claws hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is restrained in gilded webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 13 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 8; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way. The skin of a creature that dies while poisoned takes on a golden hue.

fluffInfo.value: *Long, simian arms snake through the trees like furred serpents, dangling from a shaggy, striped ape in the leafy canopy above and trying to snare those below.*
An arboreal grappler is a malformed creation of the gods, a primate whose limbs warped into long, muscular tentacles covered in shaggy, red fur.

fluffInfo.name: Carry Prey to the Heights
fluffInfo.value: Arboreal grapplers use their long limbs to snatch and drag prey behind them as they use their powerful forelimbs to ascend to the highest canopy. Victims are constricted until their struggles cease and then are devoured. The grapplers' flexible tentacles are ill-suited for terrestrial movement; they must drag themselves clumsily across open ground too wide to swing across.

fluffInfo.name: Clans in the Canopy
fluffInfo.value: Arboreal grappler tribes build family nests decorated with bones and prized relics of past hunts. These nests are built high in the jungle canopy, typically 80 feet or more above the ground. Clans of 40 or more spread across crude villages atop the trees; in such large settlements, a third of the population are juveniles. These nests are difficult to spot from the ground; a DC 20 Wisdom (*Perception*) check is required. A creature observing an arboreal grappler as it climbs into or out of a nest has advantage on the check.

fluffInfo.name: Carnivorous Elf Hunters
fluffInfo.value: Grapplers are carnivorous and prefer humanoid flesh, elves in particular. Scholars suggest this arises from hatred as much as from hunger, citing records of various humanoids hunting arboreal grapplers millennia ago.

traits.name: Boscage Brachiation
traits.value: The arboreal grappler doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it climbs out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Mobile Grappler
traits.value: The arboreal grappler can move at its full speed when dragging a Medium or smaller creature it has grappled.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The arboreal grappler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arboreal grappler makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The arboreal grappler has two tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, exhaustion, flanked, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Antimagic Lethargy
traits.value: While in the area of an __antimagic field__ spell, the amalgam's speed is halved and they can't use reactions. Additionally, if targeted by the __dispel magic__ spell, the amalgam must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be unable to use reactions for 1 minute.

traits.name: Arcane Tracker
traits.value: If the amalgam comes within 30 feet of a creature or object affected by magic, the amalgam can unerringly track that target for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Explosive Enhancement
traits.value: After the amalgam is hit with an attack using a mundane melee weapon, that weapon becomes charged with vibrating energy. For the next minute, the weapon gains a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls. If this bonus increases to +3, the weapon explodes and is destroyed, and the creature wielding it takes 10 (**3d6**) force damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the amalgam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a puddle of muck.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The amalgam can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the amalgam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The amalgam can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane amalgam makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage, or 7 (**2d6**) acid damage if the amalgam has half their hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Wild Surge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The unstable compounds that form the amalgam react violently to each other. Each creature within 10 feet of the amalgam must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (**4d10**) damage of a random type (roll a d6 for each creature): 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, necrotic; 6, poison. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

fluffInfo.value: *A luminous green mist swirls into the form of an ancient warrior. Dented armor and a ragged cloak enshroud the warrior's skeletal body, and its grinning skull leers out from an open helm.*
Some spectral guardians were not warriors in life, but powerful spellcasters.

fluffInfo.name: Worn Finery
fluffInfo.value: Composed of faintly glowing green vapor, the arcane guardian is a skeletal being encased in ancient armor or noble's finery. The cloth is worn and tattered, spiraling away into mist at the edges, and the creature glides with the faintest whisper of sound.

fluffInfo.name: Eternal Disgrace
fluffInfo.value: The arcane guardian is the spirit of an ancient warrior or noble, bound to serve in death as it failed to do in life. A broken oath, an act of cowardice, or a curse laid down by the gods for a terrible betrayal leaves an indelible mark on a soul. After the cursed creature's death, its spirit rises in a place closely related to its disgrace. Compelled by the crushing weight of its deeds, the arcane guardian knows no rest or peace.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Disgrace Bound
traits.value: The arcane guardian is bound to a tomb, castle ruins, or other place related to the disgrace in life that caused it to rise as a arcane guardian in death. If the guardian starts its turn more than 1 mile from its bound location, it loses its Spectral Blade action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to its bound location after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The arcane guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The arcane guardian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane guardian makes three Spectral Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Spectral Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) force damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.value: Many spellcasters who died in Drakkenheim have become disembodied and corrupt undead spirits, still flowing with arcane power but twisted into evil, shadowy forms. They drift through the ruins, hungering for magical essence as much as living life force.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.value: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a __specter__ in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The __specter__ is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study an Arcane Wraith, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Contaminated Undead
fluffInfo.value: You know the Arcane Wraith's Immunities and Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Spellcaster's Spirit
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Comet Shards and Nightmare Pattern actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Unstable Intellect
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the monster's strongest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Arcane Wraiths take advantage of their Incorporeal Movement, gliding through walls and small openings, before blasting targets with Comet Shards from above. They use Nightmare Pattern to control foes and focus attacks on those unaffected by the illusion. Occasionally, they collaborate with other undead, such as Haze Husks and Haze Wights, commanding them like apprentices or minions.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Ectoplasm.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

fluffInfo.name: Items:
fluffInfo.value: Arcane Wraiths often have 1d3 uncommon potions or spell scrolls collected nearby and may occasionally have a spellbook with 2d6 wizard spells of 3rd level and lower scribbled inside.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The arcane wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane wraith makes three Comet Shard attacks.

actions.name: Comet Shard
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the arcane wraith.

actions.name: Nightmare Pattern (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cube centered on a point the arcane wraith can see. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition (save ends). While Blinded, the target has the Immobilized condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.value: *A dark, droning cloud containing thousands of gray, thumb-sized wasps, shifts and swarms around the black silhouette of a tall human with glowing red eyes. The wasps, too, glow with the heat of a low-burning coal and are wreathed in foul-smelling smoke.*

fluffInfo.name: Faithless Servant
fluffInfo.value: Ia'Affrat the Insatiable is the inverted reflection of his unkempt, overly-unyielding creator, Arbeyach, Hell's Prince of Swarms. Ia'Affrat acts as Arbeyach's emissary to the courts of his rivals and to the mortal world as diplomat, spy, assassin, and scourge. Though he serves the rigid and resolute Prince of Hell, Ia'Affrat shows little loyalty to his maker. The eloquent and sophisticated creature has betrayed his master in thousands of small ways over the centuries, and eventually may betray him utterly. Until then, Ia'Affrat's shifting hive mind pursues an unquenchable lust for arcane mysteries, human interaction, and the material pursuit of unwholesome flavors and dark delights.

fluffInfo.name: Joker and Devourer
fluffInfo.value: Ia'Affrat delights in comedy, wine, song, dance, food, and inflicting torture and public humiliation on his foes—he is a rapacious devourer, greedy for all transient pleasures.

entries: **Immunities**: bludgeoning, fire, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.value: Ia'Affrat's individual Fiends are connected via a hive mind. He can telepathically communicate with any of his individual Fiends within 50 miles of him, and he can't be surprised. If he is reduced to half his hp or lower, his Intelligence score is reduced to 10, he immediately changes into his shapeless form, and he can't take on a Humanoid form again until he regains hp to be above half his hp or he finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede Ia'Affrat's darkvision.

traits.name: Grasping Limbs (Humanoid Form Only)
traits.value: Ia'Affrat can wield weapons and hold, grasp, push, pull, or interact with objects that might otherwise require a more Humanoid form to accomplish.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Ia'Affrat fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Ia'Affrat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Smoke Shroud
traits.value: Ia'Affrat emits a cloud of dark smoke within 5 feet of himself. The area is lightly obscured to all except Ia'Affrat, and each non-devil creature that starts its turn in the smoke must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its turn. At the start of each of his turns, Ia'Affrat chooses whether this shroud is active.

traits.name: Swarm (Shapeless Form Only)
traits.value: Ia'Affrat can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect, but he can't grapple or be grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ia'Affrat makes three Bite or Burning Claw attacks, or he makes four Flaming Insect Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Shapeless Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 21 (**6d6**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage, or 10 (**3d6**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage if Ia'Affrat has half of its hp or fewer. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Burning Claw (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Insect Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) fire damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Inhabit (Shapeless Form Only)
actions.value: Ia'Affrat crawls into the body of a Humanoid, or a Humanoid corpse that has been dead no more than 7 days, that he can see within 5 feet of him. If the target is unwilling, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or the target loses control of its body, and Ia'Affrat takes control of the body. Ia'Affrat controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ia'Affrat can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and he retains his alignment, his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, his Hurl Flame action and Teleport and Consume Host legendary actions, and his condition immunities. He otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. If the target was a Humanoid corpse, he uses the statistics it had before it died.

Ia'Affrat inhabits the target until the target's body is reduced to 0 hp, Ia'Affrat ends it as a bonus action, or Ia'Affrat is forced out by the dispel evil and good or __greater restoration__ spell. When the inhabit ends, Ia'Affrat reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. The target is immune to Ia'Affrat's Inhabit for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the inhabit ends.

bonusActions.name: Shape Swarm
bonusActions.value: Ia'Affrat can shape himself into a Large or smaller Humanoid or back into a shapeless mass of Tiny insectoid Fiends. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form, and he can't regain hp or gain temporary hp, except for the Consume Host legendary action. He can't take on a Humanoid form if he is occupying the space of another creature.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the flower remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

traits.name: Rooted
traits.value: The flower is unaffected by forced movement and can't be detached while it lives. If the flower is rooted to a wall or ceiling, it doesn't need to make ability checks to maintain its grip.

actions.name: Flytrap
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.value: One creature within 60 feet of the flower that the flower can see must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails its save takes 4 (**1d8**) acid damage and is knocked prone. If the creature is climbing, it instead loses its grip and falls. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much acid damage and suffers no other effects.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Ardwyn can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Ardwyn can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward a distance equal to half her movement speed. She can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Seedspeech
traits.value: Ardwyn can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.value: As a bonus action, Ardwyn can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (**3d6**) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Ardwyn expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 1st.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Argan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pervasive Magic
traits.value: Damage from Argan's spell attacks ignore the target's damage resistances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Argan makes three Arcane Lance attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Lance (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**5d6**) force damage, and Argan moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Lightning Volley (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Argan calls down lightning on up to three creatures he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (**6d6**) lightning damage and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed is not halved.

actions.name: Fireball (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Argan sculpts a fiery explosion centered on a point within 90 feet of him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (**12d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: Argan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

fluffInfo.value: *The gray, moth-winged fey flies out from the trees in a hail of tiny arrows.*
Both more rugged and more ruthless than normal pixies, the aridni are an especially greedy breed of fey bandits and kidnappers.

*When the elves abandoned the mortal world and returned to the elflands, not all of their fey servants went with them. Some stayed by choice; some were abandoned as tainted, feral broods; and some remained to become servants of local gods or human mages. Most of them are angry at humans for their corruption of, and rebellions against, the elven courts and empires in Midgard. They seek to regain some of their fallen fey wealth and glory from humans and dwarves by stealing from, corrupting, and killing their ancient enemies. Among these abandoned fey are the aridni ("slaver pixies"), evil pixies suborned by the Slavers of Reth-Saal.*

fluffInfo.name: Pale Archers
fluffInfo.value: These ashen-faced fey with gray moth wings fire green-glowing arrows with a sneer and a curse. Aridni prefer ranged combat whenever possible, and they are quite difficult to lure into melee. They sometimes accept a personal challenge or respond to accusations of cowardice.

fluffInfo.name: Caravan Raiders
fluffInfo.value: Aridni have developed different magical abilities that aid them well when they raid caravans for captives, such as charming foes or putting them to sleep.

fluffInfo.name: Wealth for Status
fluffInfo.value: They delight in taking plunder from humans and dwarves as a sign of their power over mortals and of their contempt for those who lack fey blood.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The aridni doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The aridni has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The aridni makes three Shortsword or Pixie Bow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pixie Bow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Enchanted Arrows
bonusActions.value: The aridni enchants one arrow with minor magic. The next time it hits a creature with a Pixie Bow attack before the start of its next turn, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

entries: **Confusion**: The target can't take reactions and acts randomly until the end of its next turn, as if it had failed the saving throw against the __confusion__ spell.
**Fear**: The target is frightened until the end of its next turn and must spend its next turn moving away from the aridni by the safest available route.
**Laughter**: The target falls prone and is incapacitated with laughter until the end of its next turn.
**Sleep**: The target falls unconscious for 1 minute. It wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
