fluffInfo.value: Unlike most Rangers of the North, Arin and Beinion do not often wander across Eriador. Instead, they remain close to Lake Evendim and its surroundings, where they maintain a close watch. A wife and her husband, their self-appointed tasks include warding off all evil creatures threatening to defile the ruins of Annúminas, and guiding wayward travellers back to safer lands. Beinion is a grim and short-spoken man, and Arin is equally silent, unless she's singing—when she does, her voice is clear and can be mistaken for that of a fair Elf-maiden. The two see themselves as the appointed keepers of these lands, and they feel honour-bound by this duty.

Arin and Beinion live together in a small stone house that was once little more than a hovel on the edge of Annúminas. Over time, they have made this ruin into a warm and cosy home, in spite of all the desolation around them. Recently, Beinion has grown concerned with his wife's well being, as she is now with child, making her life as a Ranger an even more dangerous business. Beinion secretly wishes Arin would agree to abandon their obligation as guardians, and retire to live the simple life of the Bree-folk. For the moment, she refuses to be left home. Maybe, they might agree to leave their post if someone took their place.

entries: **Skills**: athletics +5, intimidation +1, perception +6, stealth +4, explore|tlotrr +6, hunting|tlotrr +6, travel|tlotrr +6

traits.name: Strength of Will
traits.value: Arin has advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and she gains a bonus to these saving throws equal to her Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Occupation
traits.value: Ranger

traits.name: Distinctive Features
traits.value: Faithful, Fair-spoken

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Arin makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

fluffInfo.value: Arlowene is a middle-aged hedge who lives in Seawatch Tower, the large lighthouse within Saltar's Port. Arlowene is a trained healer and spellcaster, who has learned how to specialize in both wizardly abjuration and clerical healing magic. She abhors violence.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Celestial, Hedge, Sylvan, can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d6 - 1**) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (**1d8 - 1**) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: Arlowene curls up into a spiny ball. When curled up in this way, she can't move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and her base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Arlowene with an attack while she is curled up takes 5 2d4 points of piercing damage from her sharp quills. If a creature hits Arlowene while she is curled up, however, Arlowene is knocked prone in her space. Arlowene may uncurl herself at any point during her turn.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Aronar has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself.

traits.name: Delusions of Grandeur
traits.value: Whenever Aronar is affected by an effect (such as the __hold person__ spell) that allows him to make a saving throw at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that saving throw at the start of his turn. Additionally, whenever Aronar succeeds on a saving throw against an effect, he ends that effect on himself and any ally within 30 feet of him under the same effect.

traits.name: Sun Eater's Grace (3/Day)
traits.value: When Aronar is within 30 feet of Athmia and casts a spell that restores hit points to another creature, Athmia regains the same number of hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aronar makes three Divine Mace attacks, or he makes one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.

actions.name: Divine Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d6 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: God Complex (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Aronar's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Cure Wounds (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Aronar touches a creature and the target regains 21 (3d8 + 8) hit points.

bonusActions.name: Vainglory (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: A creature of Aronar's choice within 60 feet of him regains 15 (3d4 + 8) hit points.

fluffInfo.value: Named "The Seahawk" by __Arlowene Lum__, Arrevis is a raptor who wields his blade with a prowess forged through years of experience. He can join the fight at the end of this adventure, but he has just emerged from a coma and is weakened. Arrevis has the following character traits, which you can use to help roleplay him:

fluffInfo.name: Ideal:
fluffInfo.value: "Whatever I need to do to survive, I'll do it."

fluffInfo.name: Bonds:
fluffInfo.value: "Without a friend beside me, I'm lost. With someone, I can do anything."

fluffInfo.name: Flaws:
fluffInfo.value: "I can't resist the allure of power. I just can't get enough."

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Vulpin, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Arrevis wields a gold-hilted longsword of life-stealing. Attacks made with this weapon are magical. Arrevis also wears a periapt of wound closure.

traits.name: Pain Threshold
traits.value: If Arrevis takes 20 damage or more at once, he is stunned until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Arrevis can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Arrevis lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Arrevis cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Arrevis has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Patient
traits.value: When Arrevis reacts with a readied action, he has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check he makes as part of that action.

traits.name: Woodland Hunter
traits.value: Arrevis treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Arrevis makes two attacks with his longsword of life stealing. If Arrevis leaves one hand free, he can also make an attack with his talons.

actions.name: Longsword of Life Stealing
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands. Whenever Arrevis scores a critical hit with this attack, his target takes an extra 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. Arrevis gains temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage. The longbow is not considered a heavy weapon for Arrevis.

fluffInfo.value: *This spike-covered insectoid stands at the ready with a wicked spear grasped by two limbs. It decompresses its wings impossibly to fashion a pair of walls behind it, held together and connected to the insectoid by a stretchy pink goo.*

Arxes are fiendish creatures who serve other fiends as mobile field defenses. They can detach their elytra, the hardened shells that cover their wings, to provide cover for commanders who wish to direct their armies from forward lines. They use their telepathy and excellent vision to feed accurate overviews of the battlefield to these leaders, who use this intel to direct troops and make attacks from behind the arx's wall.

fluffInfo.name: Hirable Mercenaries
fluffInfo.value: When they aren't fighting for legions of devils or demons, arxes willingly accept payment for their services. They are steadfast combatants who reliably follow orders, but they show no concern about individual allies over greater tactical advantages.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The arx is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The arx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spiky Hide
traits.value: A creature that touches the arx or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage. This trait also applies to the arx's walls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arx makes two Claw attacks and one Spear attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage, or 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Wall Smash
actions.value: If the arx has its wall set up (see Emplace Wall), it can briefly close the panels of the wall in on each other. Each creature other than the arx between the panels in a 10-foot cone from the corner where the panels meet must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (**8d6**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Emplace Wall (Recharge 3-6)
bonusActions.value: The arx extends its hardened elytra and casts them into the ground, creating a wall. The wall is 3 inches thick and is composed of two 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. The panels must connect perpendicular to each other, forming a corner behind the arx. If the wall falls in a creature's space when the arx places it, the creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage, and the arx determines to which side of the wall the creature is pushed. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and decides to which side of the wall it is pushed.

Each 10-foot panel has AC 17 and 50 hp. If a panel is destroyed, the arx can place only one panel of wall with this bonus action. If both panels are destroyed, the arx can't use this bonus action again until it finishes a long rest or until its elytra are restored with a __regenerate__ spell or similar magic.
While the arx has at least one wall emplaced, it must remain within 15 feet of at least one of its walls. The arx can retract the walls into its body, ending this effect, as a bonus action.

fluffInfo.value: *A hirsute hulk with bulging, bloodshot eyes perches high in a tree, ready to seize unwary passersby with its rusty, hook-like talons.*

fluffInfo.name: Iron Hooks and Fangs
fluffInfo.value: Asanbosam resemble hairy ogres from the waist up, but with muscular, flexible legs much longer than those of an ogre. These odd appendages end in feet with hook-like talons, and both the creature's hooks and its fangs are composed of iron rather than bone or other organic material. These iron fangs and claws mark an asanbosam's age, not just by their size but also by their color. The youngest specimens have shiny gray hooks and fangs, while those of the older asanbosams are discolored and rusty.

fluffInfo.name: Iron Eaters
fluffInfo.value: The asanbosam diet includes iron in red meat, poultry, fish, and leaf vegetables, and—in times of desperation—grinding iron filings off their own hooks to slake their cravings. The asanbosams' taste for fresh blood and humanoid flesh led to the folklore that they are vampiric (not true).

fluffInfo.name: Tree Lairs
fluffInfo.value: Asanbosams spend most of their lives in trees, where they build nestlike houses or platforms of rope and rough planks. They don't fear magic; most tribes count at least one spellcaster among its members.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The asanbosam can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The asanbosam makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (**2d10**) poison damage and contract a disease. Until the disease ends, the creature is poisoned. Every 24 hours that elapse, the infected creature must repeat the saving throw. On a success, the disease ends. On a failure, the creature's hp maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction lasts until the disease ends. The target dies if its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the asanbosam can't use its Claws on another target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract the disease described in the Bite attack.

bonusActions.name: Arboreal Escape
bonusActions.value: While in a tree, the asanbosam takes the Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.value: When he finishes a Long Rest, Vladimir von Drakken reverts to his Reborn Vladimir von Drakken form.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies, he drops to 1 Hit Point instead unless he is killed by a creature with the blood of House von Drakken within them.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**6d8 + 8**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 70 (**20d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 22 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Soul Rending (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 54 (**12d8**) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: Double damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 25 (**6d6 + 4**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success*: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken moves up to his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: Greater in stature, cruelty and cunning than ordinary Wargs, a Wolf-chieftain is called upon by its lesser kin to deal with serious threats, like bands of travelling adventurers trespassing into Warg territory. A Wolf-chieftain is never encountered alone, but always surrounded by a pack of Wild Wolves.

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.value: If a Wolf-chieftain takes fire or radiant damage, it must succeed on a Charisma (*Intimidation*) check (DC 10 + damage taken) or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The Wolf-chieftain has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The Wolf-chieftain has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wolf-chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.value: *A lean and dull-scaled drake perches on a chimney as if it just crawled out, its tail still hanging into the flue as smoke billows out.*

fluffInfo.name: Chimney Nesting
fluffInfo.value: Ash drakes clog chimney flues and delight in dusting crowds with thick, choking ash and soot, while the drakes laugh with sneering, wheezing tones. To placate the creatures, owners of smelters and smithies leave large piles of ash for the drakes to play in, with the hope they leave the shop and workers alone. Anyone hunting ash drakes finds them difficult to attack in their cramped lairs because the creatures blend in with the surroundings. Ash drakes often befriend kobolds, who have little trouble appeasing the drakes and appreciate the added security they bring.

fluffInfo.name: Hunt Strays and Pets
fluffInfo.value: Ash drakes eat rats and stray animals, although few can resist snatching an unattended pet. Contrary to popular opinion, this drake doesn't consume ash, but enjoys a pile of ash like a cat would catnip, rolling around in it and becoming wild-eyed. Anyone who disrupts such play becomes the target of the creature's intensely hot, sooty breath weapon.

fluffInfo.name: Slender Dragons
fluffInfo.value: While an ash drake is three feet long with a four-foot-long tail that seems to trail off into smoke, it weighs less than one might expect—approximately ten pounds. Every third winter, when chimneys are active, a male drake leaves his lair to find a mate. The resulting eggs are left in a suitable chimney, and one of the parents protects the young until they leave the nest at two years of age.

fluffInfo.name: Volcanic Haunts
fluffInfo.value: Ash drakes outside a city live in or near volcanic plateaus and mutter about the lack of neighbors to bully. In the wild, an ash drake may partner with a red dragon or flame dragon, since the dragon provides its lesser cousin with plenty of ash.

traits.name: Firesight
traits.value: The ash drake can see through areas obscured by fire, smoke, and fog without penalty.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Ash Cloud (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ash drake beats its wings, filling the area within 10 feet of it with ash for 1 minute. The ash spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature that isn't an ash drake and that enters the cloud for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the end of its next turn. The ash moves with the drake, remaining centered on it for the duration.

actions.name: Ash Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ash drake spews blistering hot, choking ash in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) fire damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.name: Ashari Firetamer
fluffInfo.value: Of all the Ashari tribes, the Fire Ashari of Pyrah have suffered the greatest. Their people were all but destroyed when Thordak burst through the Rift of Flame in his cataclysmic return to Exandria. Yet despite their immense hardships, the Fire Ashari have given selflessly to the people of Tal'Dorei.

Firetamers are the elite elementalists of the Pyrah, using their attunement to the primordial forces of the world to not just create fire, not just command it, but tame it to their will. A firetamer of Pyrah is nothing like the manic pyromancers of Tal'Dorei. For while the latter recklessly wields fire as a weapon, firetamers use their talent to protect others from fire's destructive power—or wield that same power to destroy those who threaten their people.

Firetamers are almost always accompanied by a __salamander__, a __fire elemental__, or a small herd of __magma__ or __smoke mephits__. While home in Pyrah, Ashari firetamers use their power to control the Rift of Flame or to control the flames of the volcanic forest known as the Cindergrove. And on the outskirts of Emon, a group of firetamers led by a half-orc Ashari named Lorkathar keeps watch over the volatile Scar of the Cinder King.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Flamecharm (Recharges after a resting)
actions.value: The firetamer can cast the __dominate monster__ spell (save DC 15) on a __fire elemental__ or other elemental fire creature. If the creature has 150 or more hit points, it has Advantage and Disadvantage on the saving throws.

bonusActions.name: Flameform (Recharges after a resting)
bonusActions.value: The firetamer can transform into a __fire elemental__. Its game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the elemental, but the firetamer retains its alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, and all of its skill and saving throws proficiencies. While in this form, the firetamer can't cast spells. When the firetamer is reduced to 0 hit points, falls unconscious, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in flameform for up to 5 hours or until it reverts to its humanoid form as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Druidic Recovery
bonusActions.value: If the firetamer is in __fire elemental__ form using Flameform, it can expend a spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

fluffInfo.name: Ashari Skydancer
fluffInfo.value: Zephrah's location in the Summit Peaks has shielded the Ashari who dwell there from countless hardships. Few infringe upon their isolated home, and this safety has bred a certain recklessness among the Air Ashari. Though they guard their elemental rift as closely as do the rest of their kin, their lack of stoicism and restraint often earns them the scorn of the Earth Ashari of Terrah, the only other Ashari tribe in Tal'Dorei.

Air Ashari children learn to fly before they learn to walk, accompanying their parents through snow-fattened clouds on Ashari skysails. But while all in Zephrah love the sensation of flight, few hone their skills as rigorously as the skydancers. These graceful masters of the wind are at once artists, performers, and warriors. They are the beloved heroes of their people, both defending them in times of danger and bringing them happiness in times of peace.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the skydancer is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throws to take only half damage, the skydancer instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throws, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The skydancer doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Skysail
traits.value: The skydancer flies with a special Ashari magic item called a skysail. While the skysail's wings are extended, the skydancer can glide through the air at a speed of 60 feet, but must descend by at least 10 feet at the end of its turn and can't gain altitude.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The skydancer makes two skysail staff attacks.

actions.name: Skysail Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the skydancer makes this attack while flying, the target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throws, taking 21 (**6d6**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Fly (1/Day)
actions.value: The skydancer uses its skysail to cast __fly__ on itself for up to 1 minute (no *concentration* required).

fluffInfo.name: Ashari Stoneguard
fluffInfo.value: The Earth Ashari of Terrah are a stoic people, slow to change and more likely to fight defensive battles and outlast enemies than wage offensive wars. The Terrah stoneguard are the perfect embodiment of this ideal, with their druidic training augmented by ancient combat techniques that allow them to hold fast against a tide of enemies. The stoneguard craft arms and armor from the granite around them, and their magical stonecraft rivals even that of the dwarves. It is said that when elemental armies poured into Exandria in mythic times, two legendary stoneguard protected all of Terrah against that onslaught for ten days and ten nights, each standing guard while the other rested.

Today, the stoneguards stand vigilant along key defensive points within the Cliffkeep Mountains, warding the Terrah tribe against the dwarves of Kraghammer. If the stoneguard were ever to falter in their vigil, they believe the dwarves would doubtlessly enter their ancestral lands and strip its natural beauty in search of wealth and fuel.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks, when using skin-to-stone

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The stoneguard makes three granite maul attacks.

actions.name: Granite Maul
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the attack hits, the stoneguard can also immediately cast __thunderwave__ as a bonus action. This casting uses a spell slot but requires no components.

fluffInfo.name: Ashari Waverider
fluffInfo.value: The waveriders of Vesrah know firsthand the dangers of the open ocean and dedicate their lives to protecting seafarers from storms, pirates, and sea monsters. They are not warriors, however, but rather accomplished healers and aquatic empaths, using their powers to seek out and rescue survivors of marine disasters. They sometimes bring critically wounded survivors to Vesrah, a practice that the isolationist Water Ashari condemn for fear that such outsiders threaten their way of life. The waveriders take their peers' scorn in stride, for they would rather be righteous than popular.

A waverider turns to violence only as a last resort, preferring to fight in their shapechanged fishform rather than with harpoon in hand. They use hit-and-run tactics as a __hunter shark__ or employ their __giant octopus__ form's natural camouflage to harry opponents. When patrolling the open seas, waveriders skim across the water on personal waveboards with folding sails, similar in function to the skysails of the Zephrah.

traits.name: Healing Tides
traits.value: Whenever the waverider casts a spell of 1st level or higher that affects a non-hostile creature, that creature regains 3 hit points (in addition to any healing the spell may provide).

traits.name: Marine Empathy
traits.value: The waverider can speak with and understand aquatic plants and animals.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the waverider or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the waverider. Attacks with this weapon made while Underwater Combat do not have Advantage and Disadvantage.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

traits.name: Corpse Carrier
traits.value: The hoarder carries 6 (1d6 + 3) corpses, which they can use with Corpse Bomb and Create Zombies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hoarder makes two Arm attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, they can use Impale on the target.

actions.name: Arm
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (hoarder's choice).

actions.name: Impale
actions.value: The hoarder attempts to impale one Larger or smaller creature they can see within 10 feet of them on their spikes. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 16 (**3d10**) piercing damage and be restrained. A creature restrained in this way takes 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns, and if this damage reduces them to 0 hit points, they die and become an additional corpse for the hoarder's Corpse Carrier. A creature can use their action to make a DC 17 Strength (*Athletics*) check, and on a success, they free themself or a creature within reach who is restrained by the hoarder. If the hoarder is destroyed, each creature restrained by them is freed.

actions.name: Corpse Bomb
actions.value: The hoarder hurls a corpse up to 60 feet, destroying it and releasing necrotic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the corpse. Each creature in this area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (**6d10**) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of the hoarder's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't prevented from regaining hit points.

bonusActions.name: Create Zombies
bonusActions.value: The hoarder drops any number of corpses from their Corpse Carrier. Each dropped corpse rises as a zombie in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hoarder and takes their turn immediately after the hoarder's.

entries: **Senses**: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), tremorsense 60 ft.

traits.name: Ash Cover
traits.value: The ashsnake has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made when it is burrowing in ash, as well as a +4 bonus to its armor class.

traits.name: Eruption
traits.value: When the ashsnake emerges from burrowing, any creature within 5 feet of it that is at least one size smaller than the ashsnake must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Ashsnake can make one bite attack and either one Constrict or Crush attack each round.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained and the ashsnake cannot constrict or crush another target. The ashsnake can release the target at any time during its turn.

actions.name: Crush
actions.value: The ashsnake crushes its grappled target, dealing 11 (**2d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ashen Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ashsnake breathes out a cloud of superheated ash in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (**2d10**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *A winged shadow eclipsed the sun, and an inferno consumed the city. An ashen corpse rose from the dirt and walked the charred streets as if its world had not just been incinerated.*

Ashwalkers are the unfortunate result of humanoids who met their end from the breath of a dragon while in a place suffused with powerful magical energy. These undead creatures often emerge in hordes after a dragon's rage has leveled a city. Though burnt almost to ashes, many ashwalkers can rasp out a few words, typically words of hate for those who were spared the ashwalker's fate.

fluffInfo.name: The Last Breath
fluffInfo.value: While the fire of a red dragon's breath is the most common source of ashwalkers, they can be created from any dragon's breath. The magical infusion of the dragon's breath that kills the individual leaves residual energy of a similar type in the remains. For example, an ashwalker killed by poison breath often exudes some of the noxious clouds as it walks the wastelands of its destroyed home.

fluffInfo.name: Unlived Dreams
fluffInfo.value: Ashwalkers have no purpose in undeath and rarely serve a master. Sometimes they carry on a sad mimicry of their former life, acting out the final hours before their demise, not fully aware of what happened. Some ashwalkers even return to the site of their homes and lay down in the dirt to sleep, although sleep never comes. Adventurers who seek the riches of lost civilizations leveled by dragon fire have reported seeing smoldering corpses milling about marketplaces or theatre spaces until a living soul snaps them from their reverie, often driving them into maddened rages.

entries: **Languages**: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breath Born
traits.value: The ashwalker has immunity to a type of damage based on the type of dragon that killed it: acid (black, copper), cold (silver, white), fire (brass, gold, red), lightning (blue, bronze), or poison (green).

traits.name: Burst of Breath
traits.value: A creature that touches the ashwalker or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (**1d6**) damage of the type noted in its Breath Born trait.

traits.name: Last Breath
traits.value: The first time the ashwalker is reduced to 0 hp, it drops to 1 hp instead and its Draconic Breath automatically recharges. The ashwalker transforms into raw energy of the type noted in its Breath Born trait. While in this energy form, it is immune to all damage and to being grappled or restrained. At the end of the ashwalker's next turn, it is destroyed.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The ashwalker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) damage of the type noted in the ashwalker's Breath Born trait.

actions.name: Draconic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ashwalker exhales elemental energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) damage of the type noted in its Breath Born trait on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Atonement (3/Day)
traits.value: If Ashyra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does, she must either end the effect of her Ancient Curse on one enemy within 120 feet of her or be dazed until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Mummy Dust
traits.value: Whenever Ashyra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of her takes 9 (**2d8**) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ashyra makes two attacks using Desiccating Slam, Soul Fire, or both, and she uses Ancient Curse.

actions.name: Desiccating Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. The target's speed is reduced to 0, and they can't regain hit points until the start of Ashyra's next turn.

actions.name: Soul Fire (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, their hit point maximum decreases by a number equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Ancient Curse
actions.value: Ashyra inflicts weakness on one creature she can see within 120 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While the target is cursed in this way, their attacks deal half damage. The curse lasts until Ashyra chooses to end it or until removed by a cure ailment power, a __remove curse__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: Ashyra teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Atonement (3/Day)
traits.value: If Ashyra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does, she must either end the effect of her Ancient Curse on one enemy within 120 feet of her or be dazed until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Mummy Dust
traits.value: Whenever Ashyra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of her takes 9 (**2d8**) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ashyra makes two attacks using Desiccating Slam, Soul Fire, or both, and she uses Ancient Curse.

actions.name: Desiccating Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. The target's speed is reduced to 0, and they can't regain hit points until the start of Ashyra's next turn.

actions.name: Soul Fire (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, their hit point maximum decreases by a number equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Ancient Curse
actions.value: Ashyra inflicts weakness on one creature she can see within 120 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While the target is cursed in this way, their attacks deal half damage. The curse lasts until Ashyra chooses to end it or until removed by a cure ailment power, a __remove curse__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: Ashyra teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
**Immunities**: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Aspect of Fire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Molten Skin
traits.value: Any creature who touches, makes a melee attack within 5 feet of, or ends their turn within 5 feet of the aspect takes 11 (**2d10**) fire damage. Flammable objects within 5 feet of the aspect burst into flames.

traits.name: Natural Light
traits.value: The aspect gives off bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet.

traits.name: Cooling
traits.value: If the aspect of fire takes 50 or more cold damage in one round, its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Fuel for the Fire
traits.value: The aspect of fire doesn't treat plant life as difficult terrain. Whenever the aspect begins its turn in a space of plant life that provides cover, it burns the plant life away from all spaces it is currently occupying, healing 1d4 hit points for each 5-foot square of such plant life it has consumed. If it heals for 17 or more damage in this way, it flares up, recharging its magma throw action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The aspect makes two molten fist attacks.

actions.name: Molten Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) fire damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 5**) fire damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Magma Throw (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The aspect hurls a ball of molten rock. Choose a location within 60 feet of the aspect. All creatures within 15 feet of the target location must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (**4d10**) fire damage. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

fluffInfo.value: Aster Amaryllis, better known as Aster the Thorn, is a ruthless hedge captain of the Bandit Coalition. One of the organization's perpetual bad actors, Aster doesn't care for Benna's vision beyond how it can be used to inspire loyalty in his lackeys, and always has some side-operation running in secret to enrich himself. He is cruel, greedy, spiteful, and uncaring of the lives he tramples over in his pursuit of wealth.

A large, middle-aged male hedge, Aster is a captain of the Bandit Coalition and runs various criminal schemes with contacts in Alderheart. He has brown eyes, grey fur, and long black quills. He is a killer and is incredibly dangerous.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, Thieves' cant, can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs

traits.name: Bandit Fighting
traits.value: When Aster hits with a melee attack, he can spend a bonus action to either take the Disengage action or attempt to trip the target of his attack. A creature he attempts to trip must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Bandit Flight
traits.value: Whenever Aster takes the Dash or Disengage actions in combat, difficult terrain doesn't cost him extra movement that turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aster makes two melee attacks with his barbed longsword. If using his longsword with one hand, he can also make an attack with either his shortsword or hand crossbow.

actions.name: Barbed Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands. When Aster scores a critical hit with this weapon, his attack deals an extra 7 piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: Aster curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way, he cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and his base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Aster with a melee attack while he is curled up takes 2d4 points of piercing damage from his sharp quills. If a creature hits Aster while he is curled up, however, Aster is knocked prone in his space at the end of the turn. Aster may uncurl himself at any point during his turn.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +13, deception +13, history +13, nature +13, perception +13, persuasion +13, religion +13

traits.name: Offer to Remembrance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Atæshia fails a saving throw, a willing creature within 60 feet of her who can see her can give their life to protect her. This creature dies instantly, and Atæshia succeeds on the saving throw.

traits.name: Reborn From War
traits.value: When Atæshia is reduced to 0 hit points, she disintegrates into ash on a solemn wind. For the next 100 years, if a Celestial, an Elemental, or a Humanoid whose challenge rating or level is 5 or higher dies within 60 feet of where Atæshia died, Atæshia returns to life where she died with 25 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Atæshia makes three Pale Flame attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Moment of Loss, if available.

actions.name: Pale Flame
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) radiant damage plus 14 (**4d6**) fire damage. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they die and all their remains burn to nothing.

actions.name: Moment of Loss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Atæshia transforms one creature she can see within 60 feet of her into the form of a living ash cloud. While transformed to ash, the target is immune to all damage, can't provide cover to other creatures, and can't take reactions. At the start of the target's next turn, they reform and must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 1 hit point. On a successful save, the target takes 44 (**8d10**) necrotic damage. This damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

actions.name: From Death, Life (1/Day)
actions.value: Atæshia uses her Kindled Sacrifice villain action, even if it is unavailable, to sacrifice herself.

bonusActions.name: Flickering Flame
bonusActions.value: Atæshia forms into a cloud of ash, teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of her, and reforms into her true form. Each creature within 5 feet of the space she left must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**1d10**) fire damage.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Athmia has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If Athmia is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

traits.name: Mental Assault (1/Turn)
traits.value: When Athmia hits a creature with her Soul Blade attack, she can assault their mind. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or expend one spell slot of the highest level available with no effect. A creature who fails this saving throw but can't expend a spell slot must instead spend 3 of their Hit Dice with no effect, or if they can't, take an extra 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Athmia makes two Soul Blade attacks.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**5d6 + 8**) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Athmia until the end of her next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Frenzy (1/Day)
actions.value: Athmia clouds the minds of her foes.
Each enemy within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed until the start of her next turn. Athmia gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature who fails this save.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: Athmia takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonusActions.name: Sun Eater's Gift (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: While within 30 feet of Aronar, Athmia swaps places with him if he is willing.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +11, athletics +12, deception +10, history +11, insight +10, perception +10, persuasion +10
**Resistances**: necrotic, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Abyssal Resistance (Costs 2 Souls)
traits.value: When Aurumvas fails a saving throw, he succeeds instead.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: When Aurumvas's soul count is 0, he has advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and his Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, Aurumvas must use his movement on each of his turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature he can sense with his soulsight, and then if he is able, he must use his action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. Aurumvas can't act with any other purpose until he adds 1 to his soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When Aurumvas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, Aurumvas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to his soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Soul Weapons
traits.value: While Aurumvas's soul count is 2 or higher, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 feet of him deal an extra 5 (**1d10**) psychic damage with weapon attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aurumvas makes three attacks using Greedy Hands, Covetous Bolt, or both.

actions.name: Greedy Hands
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. Aurumvas can burn 1 soul to gain temporary hit points equal to the psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Covetous Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**5d8**) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can burn 2 souls to force the target to expend their highest-level spell slot available with no effect.

bonusActions.name: Greed Is Good
bonusActions.value: Aurumvas chooses an object he can see within 30 feet of him that is worth at least 100 gp. He teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that object.
