fluffInfo.value: *A slim feline far larger than any house cat slips from the shadows. Its coat glistens like ink as it chirps, and its tail flicks teasingly as its golden eyes observe the doings in its temple.*

fluffInfo.name: Bred for Magic
fluffInfo.value: Temple cats of Bastet are thought by some to be celestials, but they are a terrestrial breed, created by the priesthood through generations of enchantment.

fluffInfo.name: Lazy Temple Pets
fluffInfo.value: By day, temple cats laze about their shrines and porticos, searching out attention from the faithful and occasionally granting boons when it suits then.

fluffInfo.name: Fierce Shrine Guardians
fluffInfo.value: By night, they serve as guardians in their temples, inciting would-be thieves to come close before viciously mauling them. More than one would-be rogue has met his or her fate at the claws and teeth of these slim, black-furred beasts. Bastet temple cats are fierce enemies of temple dogs.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The temple cat has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Priestly Purr
traits.value: When a cleric or paladin who worships Bastet spends an hour preparing spells while a Bastet temple cat is within 5 feet of it, that spellcaster can choose two 1st-level spells and one 2nd-level spell that it is able to cast and imbue the temple cat with the spells. The spellcaster doesn't expend spell slots to imbue the cat in this way. The cat can be imbued with no more than three spells at a time. The cat can use the Spellcasting action to cast each spell once, requiring no material components. Once the spells are expended, the temple cat must finish a long rest before it can be imbued with spells again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The temple cat makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fascinating Purr
actions.value: The temple cat purrs loudly at a Humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it and that can hear it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed. While charmed by the temple cat, the target is incapacitated and must move on its turn toward the cat by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the cat and pet or hold it. The target doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the cat, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the temple cat's Fascinating Purr for the next 24 hours. The temple cat has advantage on attack rolls against any creature petting or holding it.

fluffInfo.value: *Bloodthirsty Hunter of the Night*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Running water keeps bat hounds at bay and can destroy them, a lingering remnant from the vampiric curse that spawned them.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Barred by Water
traits.value: The bat hound can't willingly move into running water or to a space up to 20 feet above running water. If it starts its turn in running water, it takes 10 Acid damage and has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: If it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition and isn't wearing heavy armor, the bat hound can extend its membranous wings to move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends in the air.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The bat hound can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the bat hound regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

bonusActions.name: Outmaneuver
bonusActions.value: The bat hound takes the Dash and Disengage actions, and until the end of the turn, needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

fluffInfo.value: *Spirit Hex-Bound to the Swamp*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The jinxcraft seals can be washed away with alcohol, hindering and even destroying the bayou beast.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Spirits Susceptibility
traits.value: The elemental takes 9 (**2d8**) Force damage for every bottle of alcohol splashed onto it, and its Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Hexed Slam attacks.

actions.name: Hexed Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed until the start of the elemental's next turn. While cursed, the creature subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Swamp Grasp (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Swamp water and plants roil around the elemental. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature on the ground in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the elemental. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Poison damage, and the target has the Restrained condition for 1 minute, until the elemental has the Incapacitated condition, or until the elemental dies. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to make a DC 16 Strength (*Athletics*) check, ending the Restrained condition on the target on a success.

traits.name: Exceptional Smell
traits.value: The bear has a +10 bonus to Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.value: The bear has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in their native terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the bear can't use their Bite attack on another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are knocked prone.

actions.name: Powerful Swipe (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are shoved up to 10 feet away and knocked prone. If the target hits a solid surface, they take an extra 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, perception +1 plus PB

traits.name: Exceptional Smell
traits.value: The bear's proficiency bonus is doubled for Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

traits.name: Familiar Territory
traits.value: The bear has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) and Wisdom (*Survival*) checks made in their native terrain (as determined by you and the GM).

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite or Claw)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage (Bite) or slashing damage (Claw).

actions.name: 1st Level: Tenacious Strike (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage. On a miss, the bear deals PB slashing damage to the target and gains 2 ferocity.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Pummel (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). While grappled in this way, the bear's attacks (including the triggering attack) deal an extra **PB** damage, the target is restrained if they are Large or smaller, and the bear can't make a signature attack against another target.

actions.name: 5th Level: Clawing Frenzy (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature Claw attack against PB creatures of their choice within 5 feet of them. At the end of their turn, the bear gains 1 ferocity for every attack that missed.

bonusActions.name: Hunt by Scent
bonusActions.value: The bear detects the location of each living creature within 10 × PB feet of them, unless the creature is hiding their scent by supernatural means.

fluffInfo.value: *Dressed in hunting leathers with a thick bearskin cloak around his shoulders, the bearded king sits upon a throne carved from a whole tree trunk. A crown of holly leaves wreathes his head, and a blackened maul rests near his hand. An ornate clay pot filled with honey hangs at his hip*.
Mesikammen the Bear King, called "Old Honey Paws," rules the northern Kingdom of the Bear. Its forests are thick with bears, and bearfolk and werebears are common among its people.

fluffInfo.name: Abuzz with Bees
fluffInfo.value: The country's chief product and export, thanks to the Bear King's insatiable appetite for sweets, is honey. The Bear King's hive-keepers harvest rich, blossom-sweet honey from the hives of giant bees they tend. The land's brewers use the honey to create the finest mead, and the most potent brews are infused with fey glamour.

fluffInfo.name: Boisterous Revels
fluffInfo.value: The Bear King and his court of bear jarls, witches, and oracles spend most of their time hunting in the hills, feasting, brawling, and drinking mead. Old Honey Paws maintains his rulership over this court by besting all rivals in a yearly series of challenges. The challenges are open to anyone, but the Bear King has defeated all comers since he rose to the throne.

entries: **Immunities**: bludgeoning, slashing, piercing, poison from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons; poisoned

traits.name: Honeyed Weapons
traits.value: Radiant, magical honey drips from the Bear King's paws and coats his weapons, making his weapon attacks magical. When the Bear King hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d8** radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The Bear King has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Bear King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration (Bear or Hybrid Form only)
traits.value: The Bear King regains 10 hp at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Bear King makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or he makes three Maul or Honey Bolt attacks. If two Maul attacks hit one Large or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Bite (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage at the start of each of its turns, as radiant honey sticks to the wound. Any creature can take an action to remove the honey from the wound with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. The honey dissolves if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Claw (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Maul (Fey or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Honey Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The Bear King transforms into a Large brown bear, or a Large bear-Humanoid hybrid, or back into his true form, which is Fey. His statistics other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The Bear King reverts to his true form if he dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Although it has the head of a shaggy bear, this humanoid creature wears armor and carries a battleaxe in one massive, clawed hand and a warhammer in the other. It's a solid slab of muscle that towers over most humans.*

The hulking bearfolk are intimidating creatures. Brutish and powerful, they combine features of humanoid beings and bears. Their heads are ursine with heavy jaws and sharp teeth. Dark fur covers their muscular bodies. Adult bearfolk stand at least 7 feet tall and weigh more than 600 pounds.

fluffInfo.name: Sworn to the Bear King
fluffInfo.value: Bearfolk are almost universally the subjects of the Bear King. The bearfolk protect the cities of their northern kingdom and roam the wooded roads of the wilderness. The greatest number of bearfolk are concentrated around the court of the Bear King himself, with ancient bear jarls governing their unruly kin. Only a handful of renegades, exiles, and other rogue bearfolk live permanently outside this society.

fluffInfo.name: Passionate and Volatile
fluffInfo.value: Boisterous and jovial, the bearfolk are a people of extremes. They celebrate with great passion and are quick to explosive anger. Settling differences with wrestling matches that leave permanent scars is common, as is seeing two bloodied bearfolk sharing a cask of mead and a raucous song after such a scuffle.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The bearfolk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bearfolk makes one Battleaxe attack, one Warhammer attack, and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonusActions.name: Frenzy (Recharges after a Long or Short Rest)
bonusActions.value: The bearfolk triggers a berserk frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While in frenzy, it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and has advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls made against a frenzied bearfolk have advantage.

fluffInfo.value: *A golden-furred bearfolk dressed in a beaded poncho slashes the air before her with a hefty wooden scepter. As the rod cuts through the air, a curtain of darkness is burned away by the trailing blue light.*
Bearfolk druids provide frontline defense against the corrupting influence of shadow.

fluffInfo.name: Grounded Nature
fluffInfo.value: Bearfolk who pursue druidic training understand the state of balance inherent in all natural creatures. Such keen inner senses provide these druids with hyperawareness of whether or not the taint of unnatural shadow magic has influenced a creature, and their insight makes these druids more resistant to any corrupting influences.

fluffInfo.name: Moonlit Leaders
fluffInfo.value: While bearfolk druids are common throughout all bearfolk communities in the mortal world, the highest concentration is in the Shadow Realm. Each day in the Moonlit Glades they push back against the slow, insidious influences of shadow corruption. These druids are critical to the survival of such bearfolk communities.

traits.name: Glowing Heart
traits.value: The bearfolk has advantage on saving throws made to resist being frightened and to resist corruption effects, such as from shadow or the void.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The bearfolk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bearfolk makes one Bite attack and one Quarterstaff attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage or 8 (**1d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Repel Corruption (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The bearfolk can speak words of power that repel evil creatures or creatures corrupted by shadow. Each evil-aligned or shadow-corrupted creature within 30 feet of the bearfolk must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the bearfolk for 1 minute.

A creature affected in this way must spend its turns trying to move as far away from the bearfolk as it can and can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The bearfolk magically transforms into a beast (with a challenge rating of 2 or less), remaining in that form for up to 4 hours, or back into their true form. Their weapon attacks while in beast form are magical. Otherwise, other than size, their statistics are the same in each form. They can speak and cast spells while in beast form. Any equipment they are wearing or carrying in Humanoid form melds into the beast form. They can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of their equipment. They revert to their Humanoid form if they die.

bonusActions.name: Frenzy (1/Rest)
bonusActions.value: The bearfolk can trigger a berserk frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While in the frenzy, they gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks and have advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls made against the bearfolk while they are frenzied have advantage.

fluffInfo.value: *This gaudily dressed humanoid bear stomps on the ground to a pounding rhythm to accompany her singing.*
Bearfolk thunderstompers are raucous bards that help to elevate the fight against shadow.

fluffInfo.name: Jolly Big Bards
fluffInfo.value: Thunderstompers tend to be jovial, loud, and larger than life. They eagerly dive into dangerous situations, confident their dancing stomps will see them through. They typically accompany their stomping with singing or chanting, flute playing, or some form of percussion instrument.

fluffInfo.name: Way of the Stomp
fluffInfo.value: The bearfolk developed the thunderstomper style as a way of mimicking the sounds and vibrations of giant-kin. This allowed small groups of traveling bearfolk to fool their ancient enemies and avoid dangerous encounters. Later, the dancing style was honed to generate thunderous energy.

traits.name: Deceptive Steps
traits.value: While traveling, the bearfolk can perform a stomping dance that mimics the thundering footsteps of mighty giants. Any creature within a half mile that hears the sound, but that can't see the bearfolk, must succeed on a DC 15 *Perception* check or believe the sound comes from real giants (or other Huge or larger creatures).

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The bearfolk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bearfolk uses their Thunder Stomp or Warsong. They also make one Bite attack and one War Flute attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: War Flute
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (**1d8**) thunder damage.

actions.name: Thunder Stomp
actions.value: The bearfolk hammers their feet on the ground while chanting, emitting destructive energy in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Warsong
actions.value: The bearfolk sets an inspiring rhythm with their dancing. Each ally of the bearfolk within 60 feet of them has advantage on all saving throws against being charmed or frightened until the end of the bearfolk's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Frenzy (1/Rest)
bonusActions.value: The bearfolk can trigger a berserk frenzy that lasts 1 minute. They gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons and have advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls made against a frenzied bearfolk have advantage.

bonusActions.name: Taunt (2/Rest)
bonusActions.value: The bearfolk can target one creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the bearfolk, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bearfolk's next turn.

traits.name: Aquatic Memory
traits.value: The Bearracuda can move under and through heavy snow as if it weren't difficult terrain. While moving through snow, the Bearracuda has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks.

traits.name: Pacifying Light
traits.value: If the Bearracuda becomes Blinded by a light-based effect, it must also succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall Unconscious for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until a creature uses an action to shake or slap it awake.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.value: When the beast gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spine Spike
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes two attacks.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.value: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to study a Beetle Knight, revealing the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Alien and Unflinching
fluffInfo.value: You identify its condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Watch Out for that Horn!
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Fling Bonus Action, and Pincer Horn action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Slow and Unintelligent
fluffInfo.value: You know its strongest and weakest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Beetle Knight is surprisingly agile, rarely standing still in battle. They charge during the first round, flinging enemies aside or attempting to grapple. If possible, they back up to charge again but will otherwise defend with their arm blades. They attempt to flee losing battles where their Hit Points fall below half their maximum.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Blades, Mandibles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Carapace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The beetle knight makes two Scything Arm-Blade attacks.

actions.name: Scything Arm-Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pincer Horn
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage, or 26 (**4d10 + 4**) Piercing damage if the beetle knight moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the beetle knight can't use its Pincer Horn against another target.

bonusActions.name: Fling
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature Grappled by the beetle knight. *Failure:* The target is thrown up to 1d6 × 10 feet, landing with the Prone condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 3 (**1d6**) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: *This emaciated, gray husk of a creature wears rags and picks hungrily at a sliver of bone. It moves in a crouch so low that it's almost crawling, but its eyes glow like flickering coals and it exudes a desperate ferocity with each rot-fouled breath.*

*The ghoul empire maintains complex social structures and forges serious alliances, particularly among the undead princes of Morgau and Doresh. Unofficial embassies exist in Zobeck, the Ironcrag Cantons, Krakova, and Magdar. Other hidden outposts may lurk below the Seven Cities, Illyria, or beyond.*
*Their patience and willingness to convert enemies into followers makes lasting victories against the darakhul difficult. Three full legions of ghouls serve Emperor Nicoforus directly, and a dozen more legions of varying quality press the fight to other races of the Underworld.*

fluffInfo.name: Lesser Ghouls
fluffInfo.value: Most citizens of the ghoul empire are not darakhul but lesser strains of ghouls and ghasts. Beggar ghouls are by far the weakest of these. Though they make up the majority of any military action involving the legions, they are employed as fodder, and the most wretched of them are barely suitable even for that. They eke out miserable livings by scrounging for food near the surface or by begging in the ghoul cities.

fluffInfo.name: Withered and Deprived
fluffInfo.value: Thin and emaciated even for undead, beggar ghouls are shriveled versions of their standard cousins—little more than flesh-covered skeletons. While some beggar ghouls spend their entire existence in undeath as this weak strain, at least a few were once stronger ghouls who withered when they were trapped far from sources of flesh. Others were exiled from the empire without the resources to fend for themselves.

traits.name: Hungry Dead Nature
traits.value: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The beggar ghoul has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the beggar ghoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Savage Hunger
traits.value: Its Bite attack is a critical hit if the beggar ghoul bites a creature it has surprised.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *The ghostly humanoid floats through the air, its head hovering several inches above its severed neck.*

A vengeful spirit is created when a strong-willed humanoid with magical talent is killed by relatively mundane means wielded by angry or fearful people. The victim's angry spirit returns, looking for retribution against those involved in its death—whether that death was wrongful murder or justified execution. These spirits inflict punishment on the living with the rage that animates them, and they mete out their revenge in poetic fashion.

fluffInfo.name: Varied Vengeance
fluffInfo.value: A vengeful spirit is defined by its means of death. Regardless of the cause of death, each vengeful spirit seeks to have its killer or killers die in like fashion.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Angry Defiance
traits.value: The vengeful spirit adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The vengeful spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The vengeful spirit doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Essence of Rage
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be enraged until the end of its next turn. While enraged, the target has advantage on melee attack rolls and must move to and attack the nearest creature other than the spirit. In addition, attack rolls against the enraged target have advantage.

actions.name: Decapitation (1/Day)
actions.value: The vengeful spirit makes a quick, cutting gesture at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has a head and that is below half its hp maximum. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (**8d6**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target that fails the saving throw also has one of its heads cut off. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head.

fluffInfo.value: *With the face of a mandrill and the tusks of a great boar, these ferocious half-ape, half-human pygmies have demon blood flowing in their veins. Only the desperate or the suicidal travel to their volcanic temple-islands.*

Once a peaceful people, the behtu have since been corrupted by Mechuiti, the demon lord of apes, cannibalism, and torture. By feeding his blood to the behtu, he filled them with the cruelty and power of a demon, transforming them into the creatures they are today. The behtu carry his worship from island to island, subjugating, devouring, or converting all they meet.

fluffInfo.name: Temple Builders
fluffInfo.value: The behtus raise shrines to Mechuiti wherever they go. Some are kept and prosper, while others fall into decay and return to the jungle.

fluffInfo.name: Ichor Drinkers
fluffInfo.value: In his volcanic temples, Mechuiti's idols weep his ichorous demon blood. Behtus use the ichor to create infusions that give them inhuman strength and speed, and their leaders use it to perform a ritual that transforms simians and humans bathed in the ichor into more behtu. Behtus also etch demonic tattoos using the ichor, granting them infernal powers and protection.

fluffInfo.name: Scaly Mounts
fluffInfo.value: Behtus breed demonic iguanas as war mounts (use the statistics of a giant lizard). The most powerful behtu sorcerers and druids have been known to ride large crimson drakes and small flame dragons as personal mounts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The behtu makes one Bite attack and one Spear attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The behtu exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Ichorous Infusion
actions.value: The behtu ingests an infusion made from Mechuiti's blood. For 1 minute, the behtu has advantage on saving throws and ability checks that use Strength and Constitution, and its walking and climbing speeds are doubled. In addition, it has disadvantage on saving throws and ability checks that use Intelligence and Wisdom for the duration. A non-behtu that ingests the infusion must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. The behtu typically has 1d4 + 1 infusions in its possession.

fluffInfo.value: Unlike most Rangers of the North, Arin and Beinion do not often wander across Eriador. Instead, they remain close to Lake Evendim and its surroundings, where they maintain a close watch. A wife and her husband, their self-appointed tasks include warding off all evil creatures threatening to defile the ruins of Annúminas, and guiding wayward travellers back to safer lands. Beinion is a grim and short-spoken man, and Arin is equally silent, unless she's singing—when she does, her voice is clear and can be mistaken for that of a fair Elf-maiden. The two see themselves as the appointed keepers of these lands, and they feel honour-bound by this duty.

Arin and Beinion live together in a small stone house that was once little more than a hovel on the edge of Annúminas. Over time, they have made this ruin into a warm and cosy home, in spite of all the desolation around them. Recently, Beinion has grown concerned with his wife's well being, as she is now with child, making her life as a Ranger an even more dangerous business. Beinion secretly wishes Arin would agree to abandon their obligation as guardians, and retire to live the simple life of the Bree-folk. For the moment, she refuses to be left home. Maybe, they might agree to leave their post if someone took their place.

entries: **Skills**: athletics +5, intimidation +1, perception +6, stealth +4, explore|tlotrr +6, hunting|tlotrr +6, travel|tlotrr +6

traits.name: Strength of Will
traits.value: Beinion has advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and he gain a bonus to these saving throws equal to his Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Occupation
traits.value: Ranger

traits.name: Distinctive Features
traits.value: Faithful, True-hearted

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Beinion makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Belfray, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Accustomed to the Dark
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Belfray's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Flying Blood-Drinker
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Flyby and Keen Hearing features, and Enfeebling Bite attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the Belfray's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Belfray attempts to strike with a Sonic Blast from the shadows before engaging. Once a target is weakened, it swoops in with its claws. When damaged, Belfrays Bite, feeding on the blood of their victims to regain strength. It uses movement to stay away from threats, diving to attack before flying to a safe distance. If reduced below half of its maximum Hit Points, it attempts to fly away.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Heart, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Webbed Membrane.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The belfray doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack action when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.value: The belfray has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The belfray makes two Claws attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite with Sonic Blast, if available.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Enfeebled condition until the end of the belfray's next turn. The belfray regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt by its Bite.

actions.name: Sonic Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the belfray that can hear it. *Failure:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the belfray takes the Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *With their pale skin and translucent wings, these winter fairies blend perfectly into their snowy environment. Only their beady black eyes stand out against the snow and ice.*
These malevolent ice-sprites are a plague upon the people of snowy climates, ambushing unwary prey with icy arrows and freezing powers.

fluffInfo.name: Servants of the North Wind
fluffInfo.value: Known as *patzinaki* in some dialects of Dwarvish, the beli are the servants of winter gods and venerate the north wind as Boreas and other gods of darker aspects. They are frequent allies with the fraughashar.

fluffInfo.name: Feast Crashers
fluffInfo.value: Beli especially delight in disrupting feasts and making off with the holiday cakes—the least deadly of their malicious pranks.

fluffInfo.name: Fear of Druids
fluffInfo.value: They have an irrational fear of northern druids and their snow bear companions.

traits.name: Arctic Hunter
traits.value: The beli has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in snowy terrain. In addition, it has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight in snowy terrain.

traits.name: Cold Regeneration
traits.value: If it starts its turn in an area with below freezing temperature, the beli regains 3 hp. If the beli takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the beli's next turn. The beli dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and it doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The beli doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Ice Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) cold damage.

actions.name: Icy Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion from the arrow's icy chill. On a success, the target can't suffer further levels of exhaustion from any beli's Icy Shortbow for 24 hours. If a creature would suffer a sixth level of exhaustion from this attack, it is reduced to 0 hp instead and must make death saving throws as normal. A creature reduced to 0 hp in this way can't suffer further levels of exhaustion from any beli's Icy Shortbow for 24 hours.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The beli magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the beli wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Cast Iron Stomach
traits.value: Thursir have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Thurs Rune Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the giant's next turn.

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brawler makes two attacks, using Grasping Strike or Punch Down in any combination.

actions.name: Grasping Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Punch Down
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Brace Up
bonusActions.value: The brawler gains 13 (3d8) Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Combo
bonusActions.value: The brawler makes one Grasping Strike or Punch Down attack.

bonusActions.name: Enraging Insult
bonusActions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature that can see or hear the brawler within 30 feet. *Failure:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Psychic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the brawler until the start of the brawler's next turn.

traits.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: If an attack deals over half of Benna Seridan's current remaining hit points in damage (even if her hit points are reduced to 0 by the attack), she immediately regains 8 (1d12 + 2) hit points.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Benna Seridan's long jump is 30 feet, and her base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Benna Seridan makes three melee attacks, two with her scimitar and one with her dagger. Alternatively, Benna Seridan can make two ranged attack with her daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar of the Wood
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage. The sword has 2 charges. Benna Seridan can expend a charge and speak the command word to cast __spike growth__ (save DC 16) centered on herself. She can pass through this terrain unaffected. The sword regains one charge each day at dawn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *These small, winged faeries appear to be made of gray mist, and they can conceal themselves completely in the fogbanks and clouds enshrouding their mountainous lairs.*

fluffInfo.name: Mist Dancers
fluffInfo.value: These evil, cunning faeries (whose name means "mist dancers" in Old Elvish) overcome their victims by seeping into the creature's lungs to choke it on the bereginyas' foul essence.

fluffInfo.name: Mountain Spirits
fluffInfo.value: They are most commonly found in the highest mountain ranges, often above the tree line, but they can be encountered in any foggy or misty mountainous region. Shepherds and goatherds often leave bits of milk or cheese to placate them, particularly during the spring lambing season.

traits.name: Foul Form
traits.value: The bereginyas' semi-solid form emits poisonous gases. Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the bereginyas must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more is immune to the bereginyas' Foul Form for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bereginyas makes two Claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the bereginyas attaches to the target. While attached, the bereginyas can use only the Smother action, and it moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the bereginyas' movement. The bereginyas can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the bereginyas by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) poison damage.

actions.name: Smother
actions.value: While attached to a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the bereginyas extends a tendril of poisonous gas down the creature's throat. The creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 22 (**5d8**) poison damage, immediately runs out of breath, and begins suffocating. On a success, it takes half the damage, doesn't run out of breath, and isn't suffocating. Suffocation ends if the creature dies, if the bereginyas is removed from the creature, or if the bereginyas is killed. A suffocating creature that fails this saving throw reduces its remaining rounds of breath by 1.

fluffInfo.value: The militia captain of Reya's Watch, Bernice is a loud and protective bright gallus. She lost her husband, a tender named Farnham, to a forest fire, and she sees her role with the militia as a continuation of his legacy.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Bernice can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects or heavy weapons (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Bernice can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Bernice can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) slashing damage or 6 (**1d10 + 1**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Inspire
actions.value: Bernice inspires an ally that can see and hear her. The ally can roll a 1d4 and add the number rolled to its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the trollkin has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The trollkin regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The trollkin berserker makes four attacks, using Freezing Bryntroll or Freezing Handaxe in any combination.

actions.name: Freezing Bryntroll
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage. Once per round, if the berserker hits with its bryntroll, it can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first, and that is within reach. On a hit, the second creature takes 13 (**2d12**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Freezing Handaxe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Although slightly stooped, this male figure is muscular and broad‑shouldered. The creature's head is lost in a riot of moss, while a thick mustache and beard reach almost to its waist.*

The hulking, moss-haired berstuc looks sculpted out of a primordial forest—it stands over 12 feet tall and weighs 800 pounds. Despite its great stature, it seems strangely gentle, with a serene, almost soothing presence. Nothing could be further from the truth; the berstuc is a murderous demon that stalks woodlands and jungles of the Material Plane.

fluffInfo.name: Poisoned Fruit
fluffInfo.value: Berstuc prowl forests in search of travelers to torment. A berstuc demon poses as a benevolent, or at least indifferent, wood spirit to gain the trust of mortals. It allows itself to be persuaded to help lost travelers (reluctantly) or to lead them to their destinations. Once it draws its unwitting prey deep into the woods, it strikes.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: False Presence
traits.value: The berstuc detects as a Fey when sensed by spells and features, such as the __detect evil and good__ spell or a paladin's Divine Sense. However, it is still a Fiend and can be subjected to spells and features that affect Fiends, such as Divine Smite. Beasts and Plants find the berstuc's presence soothing and don't attack the berstuc unless ordered to or provoked.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.value: The berstuc has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in forest terrain.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The berstuc has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Twisted Path
traits.value: While in a nonmagical forest, the berstuc leaves no trail and can't be tracked, except by magical means. Creatures of the berstuc's choice within 30 feet of it that travel with it can't retrace their own trails, and become hopelessly lost after 1 hour of travel with the berstuc. Creatures led astray by the berstuc have disadvantage on ability checks to discern their location or to navigate for 24 hours.

traits.name: Verdant Nature
traits.value: The berstuc doesn't require food or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The berstuc makes three Slam attacks. If two Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the berstuc can use Enclose on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the berstuc doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

actions.name: Enclose
actions.value: The berstuc encloses a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it in a mossy growth on the berstuc's body, and the grapple ends. While enclosed in the berstuc's growth, the target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover from attacks and other effects outside the berstuc, and it takes 21 (**6d6**) poison damage at the start of each of the berstuc's turns. The berstuc can have only one creature enclosed at a time.

If the berstuc takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside its growth, the berstuc must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel the enclosed creature as the growth bursts. The expelled creature falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the berstuc. If the berstuc dies, an enclosed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the growth by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Bervis's base long jump is 30 feet, and his base high jump is 15 feet with or without a running start.

traits.name: Team Tactics
traits.value: Bervis can take the Help action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Shortened Spear
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage, or 3 (**1d6**) piercing damage if used with two hands.

traits.name: Promising Threat
traits.value: The bestial spirit has advantage on Charisma (*Intimidation*) checks if the target has seen it hit a creature with its chomp attack in the past minute.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.value: *Big Linda has proven well worth the lives I spent to capture her. She is the prize champion of my fighting pit, and a loyal friend. I am very much excited for you to meet her. Also, before you ask, yes she bites* - The Queen Of Thieves

Big Linda resembles a dragon without wings, and has knobbly flesh accented by shimmering scales that stretch along its back. The monstrous beast has a gaping maw of razor-sharp teeth and a tail of razor-sharp spines, but dishevelled and useless forearms. Big Linda has been permanently charmed by the Queen of Thieves and (usually) obeys her spoken commands. The creature emerges from its den in response to the Queen's whistle call.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Big Linda makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Big Linda can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Big Linda spews acid in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in that line of fire must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (**11d8**) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study Big Linda, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You know Big Linda's damage Immunities as well as its Rejuvenation and Regeneration traits.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Acidic Mucus!
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of her Acid Spew attack.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Big, Clumsy, and Dumb
fluffInfo.value: You recognize Big Linda's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Big Linda sends Acid Spew against groups of opponents. She then tries to optimize her Bite and Tail attacks by placing herself within her enemies. She is hesitant to leave the Deep Haze but is also not smart enough to resist chasing those who antagonizing her. She rarely flees unless severely wounded, wherein she will seek the safety of the Deep Haze to recover.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts, Glands, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 Hit Points. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 63 (**14d8**) Acid damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 Hit Points. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level. *Failure or Success*: 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: Bigger Linda has Immunity to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

actions.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.

**Tail**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the Prone condition.
**Stomp**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**3d10 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep
actions.value: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this Epic Action as the first Epic Action she uses this round. After using this Epic Action, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite Epic Action until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 31 (**7d8**) Necrotic damage plus 31 (**7d8**) Force damage, and the target gains a Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When *Bloodied*)
actions.value: Bigger Linda moves up to her Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Round)
actions.value: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

traits.name: Occupation
traits.value: Retired adventurer, Burglar

traits.name: Distinctive Features
traits.value: Cunning, Fair-spoken

fluffInfo.value: *An impossibly thin figure passes through the trees, its skin and clothes formed of curling silver birch bark. The autumn leaves that adorn its crown whisper strangely in the breeze.*

Birch sirens are a less common variety of treant that often live together in family units called copses. These sirens are more malicious than their larger counterparts and delight in luring travelers deeper into dangerous woodland with their haunting melodies.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Wood
fluffInfo.value: The largest population of birch sirens lives in the Shadow Realm, in the rarely traveled portions of forest that span the region. Occasionally, birch sirens are coerced to lend aid and protection to shadow fey rangers who hunt such dangerous woods.

fluffInfo.name: Elven Origins
fluffInfo.value: Birch sirens are rumored to have been created by the magic of the elves. These tree-folk were once guardians of vast orchards and beautiful gardens, contributing to the wonder of such places with their alluring songs. When the elves began to fade from the world, so too did the purpose of the birch sirens, and now they exist as cruel shadows of their former selves.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the birch siren remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

traits.name: Rustling Copse
traits.value: If two or more birch sirens use their Haunting Tune ability while within 300 feet of one another, saving throws to resist the effect are rolled with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The birch siren makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Psychic Shriek.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Haunting Tune
actions.value: The birch siren rustles its leaves, creating a haunting chorus. Each humanoid within 300 feet of the birch siren that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed. The birch siren must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue the chorus. It can stop the chorus at any time. The tune ends if the birch siren is incapacitated.

While charmed by the birch siren, a creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature cannot take actions while charmed in this way. Whenever a target takes damage or begins a turn unable to hear the chorus, it can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this birch siren's tune for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Psychic Shriek
actions.value: The birch siren emits a soundless scream that tears at the minds of its victims. All non-plant creatures within 30 feet of the birch siren must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (**4d8 + 3**) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Exceptional Vision

traits.name: Flyby

traits.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a Tiny creature, they are grappled (escape DC 12). If the target is a Small or larger creature, the bird attaches to them. While attached, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can attempt to detach the bird as an action by making a DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a failed check, the attached target takes 2 (**1d4**) slashing damage. On a successful check, the attached target takes 2 (**1d4**) slashing damage and is no longer attached. The bird can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

bonusActions.name: Spot

fluffInfo.value: Palest Westruun was not a king, but his new statue in the Opal Ward is often called the __Black King__, a subtle jab at the city's previous "Black King," the tyrannical dragon Umbrasyl. The high priest of the First Bastion blessed both the __Black King__ and Westruun itself when the statue was unveiled on the anniversary of Westruun's reclamation, saying, "May the __The Lawbearer__ grant us all strength of spirit when chaos next threatens our peaceful civilization. When that time comes, may the __Black King__ unsheathe his sword to rally our people and lead Westruun to victory."

When the safety of all of Westruun is threatened, the __Black King__ will animate and defend its people, becoming a __stone golem with a speed of 60 feet, Charisma and Intelligence scores of 18 (+4), and the ability to speak Common__. Its personality is dour but determined—regal and single-minded in its desire to protect its city and its people.
(See The Black King for more information on this NPC.)

actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: The black knight commander strikes an imposing figure upon its chosen mount; one that inspires bloodlust in its allies and fear in its foes. Devoted to its own twisted code, the black knight commander has a sense of honor but spares no compassion for those who stand in its way. Whether the knight fights for a dark lord or a demonic god, all its foes will be trampled into the dust and their families slaughtered so there can be no revenge. The only victory is a total victory.

traits.name: Hateful Presence
traits.value: Each friendly creature within 10 feet of the black knight commander gains a +2 bonus on weapon damage rolls but can't use the Help action.

traits.name: Locked Saddle
traits.value: The black knight commander can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

traits.name: Mounted Charge
traits.value: If the black knight commander moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits it with a Lance attack on the same turn, the commander can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

traits.name: Mounted Warrior
traits.value: The black knight commander is rarely seen without its warhorse mount. The warhorse wears custom barding that raises is Armor Class to 15, and mounting and dismounting the warhorse costs the commander only 5 feet of movement. While the commander is mounted, its mount can't be charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The black knight commander makes one Lance attack and two Mace attacks. If the commander is mounted, its mount can then make one Hooves attack. If both Mace attacks hit one creature, the target takes an extra 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Charge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: While mounted, the black knight commander lets loose a terrifying cry. It then moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) bludgeoning damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage, and the black stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the black stirge doesn't attack. Instead, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The black stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 4 points of Strength from the target, or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the black stirge. This replaces the stirge's Blood Drain action.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Blend
bonusActions.value: While not in sunlight, the black stirge can become invisible as a bonus action. It can end this effect as a bonus action.

fluffInfo.name: Always Hungry
fluffInfo.value: Blemmyes are brutes that savor humanoid flesh, and they see all humanoids as potential meals. Some even have the patience to tend groups of humans, goblins, or halflings like unruly herds, farming them for food and fattening them up for maximum succulence.

fluffInfo.name: Cannibals
fluffInfo.value: So great is their hideous hunger that blemmyes are not above eating their own kind; they cull and consume the weakest specimens of their people when other food is scarce. The most terrible habit of these monsters is that they seldom wait for their food to die, or even for a battle to conclude, before launching into a grisly feast.

traits.name: Carnivorous Compulsion
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, if the blemmyes can see an incapacitated creature, the blemmyes must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or spend its next turn moving toward and attacking that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The blemmyes makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is incapacitated and a Medium or smaller creature, the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the blemmyes, and it takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the blemmyes' turns. The blemmyes can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the blemmyes takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the blemmyes must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the blemmyes. If the blemmyes dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Toxic Demise (10th level or higher)
traits.value: When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a burst of toxic mulch or fetid viscera. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throws against your spell save DC or take necrotic damage based on the creature's challenge rating (see the table below). As an action, you can also cause a summoned creature to explode, immediately killing it.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bloated Hive is usually a solitary creature that spends its time cowering in dark corners living out its cursed life as nothing more than a conduit for its colony. In combat, they focus entirely on keeping their distance from threats and spawning swarms of insects to defend themselves. If cornered, the Bloated Hive uses its Claws and Distracting Swarm before moving back into the shadows and attempting to escape and find a new nest.

Larger packs of Bloated Hives are much braver and more violent, and actively hunt and pursue targets until their numbers are less than their prey. Places where large colonies gather are dangerous. The Bloated Hives work in unison to protect their nests. Only if they become outnumbered do they flee.
