actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Spawn Swarm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The bloated hive creates a __Swarm of Contaminated Insects__, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the bloated hive.

bonusActions.name: Distracting Swarm
bonusActions.value: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

traits.name: Cast Iron Stomach
traits.value: Thursir have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Thurs Rune Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the giant's next turn.

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This bent-backed crone has long, leathery arms and cruel, flesh-shearing talons. Her face is a misshapen mass of leathery flesh with a bulbous nose, like a gnarled knot on an old oak tree, and her hair falls in ringlets of wriggling worms.*

Blood hags have long skulked on the fringes of society. The hags prey on mankind, stealing seed to propagate, blood to satisfy their insatiable thirst, and faces as trophies of these short-lived and bloody trysts.

fluffInfo.name: Worm Hair
fluffInfo.value: A blood hag's hair is a morass of wriggling worms, ever-thirsty for fresh blood.

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.value: The blood hag can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of her and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The blood hag makes three Claw or Blood Bolt attacks and can use Blood-Drinking Hair or Face Peel. She can replace one attack with a use of Sanguine Curse.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The blood hag has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Blood-Drinking Hair
actions.value: The hag drains blood from one creature grappled by her. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The blood hag regains hp equal to half the necrotic damage taken.

actions.name: Face Peel
actions.value: The blood hag peels the face off one creature grappled by her. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (**4d6**) slashing damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. While its hp maximum is reduced in this way, the target has disadvantage on all Charisma checks. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Sanguine Curse
actions.value: The blood hag curses one creature she can see or sense within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for 1 minute. A creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it doesn't have blood. While cursed, the target is incapacitated and takes 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns as its internal blood vessels rupture. The cursed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on itself on a success.
The blood hag can have only one target cursed at a time. If it curses another, the effect on the previous target ends.

entries: **HP**: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Beak)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk makes a signature attack. On a hit, the next attack made against the target before the start of the hawk's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Swooping Attack (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move, they can make a signature attack against one target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or drop one item they are holding.

actions.name: 5th Level: Storm of Talons (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then they can dive onto one creature within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd10** slashing damage and is blinded until the end of the hawk's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Blood Bags
traits.value: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Blood Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonusActions.name: Blood Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 3d6 Hit Points, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: medicine +0 plus PB, persuasion +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Blood Curse)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d4 plus PB** necrotic damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of the seneschal's next turn. Beginning at 7th level, the seneschal can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Coagulate (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal empowers the blood of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target can expend 1 Hit Die, rolling it and regaining hit points equal to twice the result plus their Constitution modifier.

actions.name: 5th Level: Blood Puppet (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or move up to their speed in a direction of the seneschal's choice. During this movement, the seneschal can force them to make one attack against a creature of the seneschal's choice (no action required).

actions.name: 7th Level: Blood Bondage (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal arrests the hearts of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **PBd6** necrotic damage and is paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't paralyzed.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the ooze remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a pool of blood.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or the ooze melds into the target's body.
While inside a creature, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside that host.

If the host creature takes 5 damage or more on a single turn from a source other than the ooze, the ooze must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or exit the host, entering the nearest unoccupied space of the ooze's choice. A cure ailment power, __protection from poison__ spell, or __lesser restoration__ spell cast on the host also forces the ooze out. By spending 5 feet of their movement, the ooze can voluntarily leave the host's body.

actions.name: Crimson Feast (Inside Host Only)

actions.name: 3rd Level: Clever Goop (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The ooze takes the Hide action and makes a signature attack (in either order). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the target is knocked prone. While the ooze is hidden in this way, they can approach a creature or move where they're clearly visible without automatically giving away their position.

actions.name: 5th Level: Crimson Feast (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The ooze attempts to enter the body of a creature they can see within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the ooze melds into the target, who takes **PBd6** necrotic damage, becomes the ooze's host, and is poisoned until the ooze exits the host.
While melded, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the host, and they can't take any action except to exit the host as a bonus action.

At the start of each of the ooze's turns, the host must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes **PBd6** necrotic damage and remains melded. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and the ooze exits the host. If the host dies or is subject to a cure ailment power, a protection from poison or __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ooze exits the host.
When the ooze exits the host, they enter an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the host.

bonusActions.name: Parasitic Symbiosis
bonusActions.value: If the ooze's caregiver is within 5 feet of them, the ooze moves inside their caregiver. While inside their caregiver, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the caregiver. The ooze can exit the caregiver by using another bonus action, entering an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the caregiver.

bonusActions.name: Quick Cure (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: While inside their caregiver (see Parasitic Symbiosis), the ooze cleanses their caregiver's blood, ending the paralyzed and poisoned conditions on the caregiver.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the vampire takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the vampire takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Radiant Weakening
traits.value: The vampire has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 piercing damage plus 3 necrotic damage. If two or more vampires joined the attack, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage dealt. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a cure ailment power, a __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 30 Ft. (or 10 Ft. If Missing A Leg)

traits.name: Bloody Inspiration
traits.value: As a bonus action, the bloodbonded can inspire an ally within 30 feet to an enraged state of bloodlust for one minute. These followers gain 5 temporary hp, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and vulnerability to psychic damage. All attacks made by the bloodbonded followers are reckless, gaining advantage to hit enemies but granting enemies advantage on attacks against them.

traits.name: Resolute Followers
traits.value: Allies of the bloodbonded within 60 feet of it have advantage on Charisma and Wisdom saving throws.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rage Bomb (2/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the bloodbonded can infuse one of its bloodbonded followers who is under the effects of Bloody Inspiration with a fatal fury. This magic causes the follower to foam bloodily at the mouth. If the follower is not slain before the start of the bloodbonded's next turn, the follower dies and explodes in a shower of superheated blood. Creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 (**2d8 + 3**) fire damage on a failure and taking half damage on a success.

actions.name: Blood Boil
actions.value: The bloodbonded targets a creature it can see within 60 feet and utters words of madness. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) fire damage as its blood superheats. The bloodbonded must be able to speak to use this ability.

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.value: The treant is immune to the diseases described in the [Bloodmire Diseases](https://5e.tools/tables.html#bloodmire%20diseases_griffonssaddlebag2) table.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal Bloodmire tree.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The treant makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mudball
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the treant's next turn.

actions.name: Animate Blood (2/Day)
actions.value: The treant magically animates a pool of blood it can see within 60 feet of it. The blood congeals into a viscous form and has the statistics of a __gelatinous cube__, except its Ooze Cube, Pseudopod, and Engulf trait and action options deal necrotic damage instead of acid damage, and its Transparent trait doesn't function unless it's in blood or bloodwater.

The animated blood acts as an ally of the treant. The blood remains animate for 8 hours or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the blood; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate pool of blood.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the blowbelly pufferfish dies, it bursts. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The blowbelly pufferfish makes two Chomp attacks.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage. Puff Up (Recharge 5-6). The blowbelly pufferfish inflates its size, becoming Huge and filling its space. Each creature in its space is pushed to an unoccupied space outside the area and must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (**2d8**) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute as the barbs of the pufferfish poke and prod them. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't Poisoned. If the creature is pushed into a wall or similar solid surface, it takes an extra 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled (escape DC 13); until this Grapple ends, the creature is also Restrained.
The blowbelly pufferfish stays puffed up until the start of its next turn, after which it returns to its normal size. While puffed up, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Electric Invigoration
traits.value: Whenever a Body Snatcher would take Lightning damage, it absorbs the energy and instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage, rounded down. The Body Snatcher also immediately recharges its Electric Torrent ability.

traits.name: Skin Sack
traits.value: The Body Snatcher is physically indistinguishable from its host and cannot be detected by nonmagical means. If the Body Snatcher is reduced to 0 Hit Points, and it has been inside its current host for less than 24 hours, the host regurgitates it then has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Body Snatcher makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Invade
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15; one Humanoid creature Grappled by the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* The Body Snatcher departs its current host and moves into the Grappled creature. It then regains all Hit Points and recharges Electric Torrent. If it had been inside its previous host for less than 24 hours, that creature has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point. Otherwise, the previous host body becomes a lifeless skin sack.

actions.name: Electric Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Body Snatcher unleashes a large electric pulse. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each other creature within 20 feet of the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Lightning damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Body Snatcher, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Emotionless Undead
fluffInfo.value: You know the Body Snatcher's condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Shadowy Energy
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Clinging Shadows trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) In the Dark of Night
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Body Snatcher's Sunlight Weakness trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Body Snatcher sticks to dimly lit areas or places of complete darkness. It teleports up to a creature and attempts to grapple it, teleporting away as soon as it has one or two targets in its hands. Often the Body Snatcher will emerge from tunnels or secret entrances to its lair. They do not travel far from the labs they were created in and often have easy points of escape to disappear once they have a victim in hand.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches, Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Clinging Shadows
traits.value: A creature in Dim Light or Darkness has Disadvantage on ability checks to escape the body snatcher's grapple. Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in Dim Light or Darkness, the creature takes 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: The body snatcher takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage if it ends its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The body snatcher makes four Grabbing Hands attacks.

actions.name: Grabbing Hands
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the body snatcher can't use this hand against another target. The body snatcher has four hands, each of which can grapple one target.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Teleport
bonusActions.value: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in Dim Light or Darkness. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. An unwilling creature can make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher __Teleport__.

traits.name: Acidic Blood
traits.value: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

actions.name: Sling Mud
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.value: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, restrained, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 (**1d8**) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have grappled also resurfaces.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Parasitic Mutation
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Bojack's Immunities and senses.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Acidic Ambusher
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the creature's Corrosive Mucus and Impaling Limbs attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fast and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You know the Bojack's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bojack is an ambush skirmisher. It waits for the opportune moment to strike, attempting to surprise as many targets as possible. After it surprises its prey, it attacks with its Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus and uses its Predatory Cunning to move out of melee range.

The Bojack can climb walls and will try and skitter up buildings or behind walls, springing back out to attack before escaping again. If brought below 20 Hit Points, the Bojack attempts to Dash away and Hide.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Heart, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Blades.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur, Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The bojack can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the bojack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal animal corpse.

traits.name: Sudden Death
traits.value: Creatures that haven't yet taken a turn in combat are Helpless against attacks made by the bojack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bojack makes two attacks, using Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus in any combination.

actions.name: Impaling Limbs
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Piercing damage and the target is Bleeding (2d6). While Bleeding in this way, the target is also Slowed.

actions.name: Corrosive Mucus
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d4 + 4**) Acid damage and the target is Burning (2d4 Acid). While Burning in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonusActions.name: Predatory Cunning
bonusActions.value: The bojack takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Retribution of Ragnarok
traits.value: When Bolgrim dies, runes engraved on his chest explode. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12 Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from Bolgrim. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Bolgrim makes three attacks, using Longsword, Handaxe, or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Slashing damage if the target is marked.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Slashing damage if the target is marked.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d12 +2**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is spiritually marked with a necrotic rune until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This small, leering water spirit resembles a cross between a gray frog and a damp scarecrow, with small tendrils sprouting from all its extremities. It has water wings seemingly made out of jellyfish flesh.*

fluffInfo.name: Swamp Robbers
fluffInfo.value: Known as uriska in Draconic, the bolotis are small, swamp-dwelling water spirits which delight in drowning unsuspecting victims in shallow pools and springs, then robbing the corpses of whatever shiny objects they find. Bolotis use their magical vortex abilities to immobilize their victims and drag them to a watery death. They delight in storing up larders of victims under winter ice or under logs.

fluffInfo.name: Fond of Allies
fluffInfo.value: Bolotis sometimes team up with miremals and will-o'-wisps to create cunning ambushes. They are happy with a single kill at a time.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 20 Ft., *swim* 40 Ft. (0 Ft. Swim 60 Ft. In Vortex Form)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The boloti can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Water Camouflage
traits.value: The boloti has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide while at least half of its body is submerged in water.

traits.name: Water Mastery
traits.value: A boloti has advantage on attack rolls if both it and its target are touching the same body of water. If the target and the boloti are both on dry ground, the boloti has disadvantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Watery Body (Vortex Form Only)
traits.value: The boloti can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that starts its turn in the boloti's space must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 4 (**1d8**) bludgeoning damage as it is buffeted by the swirl of water.

actions.name: Dagger (True Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirlpool (Vortex Form Only)
actions.value: One creature in the boloti's space must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 9 (**2d8**) bludgeoning damage, and if it is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the damage and is pushed out of the boloti's space.

bonusActions.name: Vortex Form
bonusActions.value: The boloti magically transforms into a Small vortex of swirling, churning water or back into its true form, which is Fey. The boloti can transform into its vortex form only while at least half of its body is submerged in water, and any creature it is grappling with Whirlpool is freed if the boloti transforms back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Thousands of tiny bones coalesce into a humanoid form, then disperse in a clattering swarm the next moment. The bones rustle as the creature moves, a sound like sand sliding down a dune.*

fluffInfo.name: Spies and Sneaks
fluffInfo.value: Bone collectives are not primarily fighters, preferring to spy and skulk. However, when cornered, they fight fearlessly, seeking to strip the flesh from their foes. They wear robes or cloaks to pass as humanoid, as they know that most creatures find them disturbing.

fluffInfo.name: Commanders and Servants of Undeath
fluffInfo.value: Bone collectives' long finger bones and hooked claws help them ascend and control zombie mounts, and their magic allows them to control small groups of undead. This undead affinity occasionally leads them to serve as spies or spymasters for necromancers, darakhul, vampires, or liches.

fluffInfo.name: Feed on Society
fluffInfo.value: Bone collectives join societies around them, whether human, goblin, or ghoul. They prey on the living and the dead, to replenish lost bones. They produce a reddish venom that drains the luster of life from victims. Those who survive can describe the horrifying red smile of the collective's venom‑coated fangs.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned
**Languages**: Common, Darakhul (can't speak in shapeless form)

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.value: The collective's individual bones are connected via a hive mind. It can telepathically communicate with any of its individual bones within 50 miles of it, and it can't be surprised. If the collective is reduced to half its hp or fewer, its Intelligence score is reduced to 1, it can't cast spells, it immediately changes to its shapeless form, and it can't take on a Humanoid form.

traits.name: Grasping Limbs (Humanoid Form Only)
traits.value: The bone collective can wield weapons and hold, grasp, push, pull, or interact with objects that might otherwise require a Humanoid form to accomplish.

traits.name: Swarm (Shapeless Form Only)
traits.value: The bone collective can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bone.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The bone collective doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Wyrmblood Venom
traits.value: When the bone collective hits a poisoned creature with a Bite or Piercing Bones attack, the target's Charisma score is reduced by 1d4. The target is incapacitated if this reduces its Charisma to 0. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bone collective makes two Claw attacks, or one Claw attack and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**4d12 + 5**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Piercing Bones (Shapeless Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the collective's space. *Hit:* 52 (**8d12**) piercing damage, or 26 (**4d12**) piercing damage if the collective has half its hp or fewer.

bonusActions.name: Shape Swarm
bonusActions.value: The bone collective can shape itself into a Small Humanoid or back into a shapeless form of Tiny bones. Its statistics are the same in each form, and it can't regain hp or gain temporary hp. It can't take on a Humanoid form if it is occupying the space of another creature.

fluffInfo.value: *The cracked skull scurries forward on bone-white legs, crab claws raised.*

fluffInfo.name: Skull Shells
fluffInfo.value: Much like an enormous hermit crab, bone crabs inhabit the remains of large fish, humanoids, and other creatures. A bone crab's spiny, ivory-white legs blend in perfectly with bones and pale driftwood. When lacking bones, these crabs gnaw cavities into chunks of driftwood or coral to make a shelter, cementing bits of shell and debris to their portable homes. They drag aquatic prey above the high tide line and leave it to fester in the hot sun. The crabs can pick corpses clean in a few hours, and their hunting grounds are littered with cracked and sun-bleached bones—the perfect hiding place for these littoral predators.

fluffInfo.name: Scavengers of Memory
fluffInfo.value: Bone crabs are voracious scavengers. They live in seaside crags and coves, where they use their specialized chelae to crack open skulls and feast on the brains. Some crabs retain fragments of memory from those they devour, and these crabs recognize friends or attack the foes of those whose skulls they wear.

fluffInfo.name: Pack Hunters
fluffInfo.value: Bone crabs hunt in packs, preying on seabirds and creatures stranded in tidal pools. Centuries of feeding on brains has left the crabs with a rudimentary intelligence and a psychic connection with fellow packmates. They use this to alert each other to danger, potential prey, or a threat to their territory. Although bone crabs cannot be domesticated, they can be convinced to nest in particular areas, attacking intruders while ignoring the area's regulars.

fluffInfo.name: White Ghost Shivers
fluffInfo.value: Because they eat carrion, bone crabs carry a dangerous disease known as white ghost shivers. This disease wracks victims with fever and delirium. Sailors and others who eat a bone crab's unwholesome, diseased flesh rarely survive it.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The bone crab can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Bone Camouflage
traits.value: The bone crab has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide among bones.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The bone crab can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with other bone crabs in its pack within 100 feet of it. While within 30 feet of another bone crab, the bone crab can't be surprised and has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The bone crab has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the crab's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The bone crab's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: White Ghost Shivers
traits.value: A creature that eats the meat of the bone crab or that is bitten by a creature infected with the white ghost shivers disease must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the disease. An infected creature develops the first symptoms after 24 hours. Symptoms include a mild chill that escalates to a fever and frightful hallucinations that give the disease its name. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. The exhaustion lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws against the disease recovers from it. Alternatively, the disease can be removed by the __lesser restoration__ spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Dank winds sweep up skeletons, both humanoid and animal. They blow forward, reaching out for living creatures like a clawed hand of bone. A scattering of bones rolls across the ground, then rises into the air, billowing like a sheet*.

fluffInfo.name: Swarms of Fallen
fluffInfo.value: On rare occasions, the pugnacious spirits of fallen undead join together, bonded by a common craving: to feel alive again. They gather up their bones from life, as well as any other bones they come across, and form bone swarms.

fluffInfo.name: Nomadic Undead
fluffInfo.value: These swarms ravage the countryside wresting life from living creatures, grabbing livestock, humanoids, and even dragons, digging in their claws in an attempt to cling to life. Bone swarms with one or more sets of jaws wail constantly in their sorrow, interrupting their cries with snippets of rational, but scattered speech declaiming their woes and despair.

fluffInfo.name: Cliff and Pit Dwellers
fluffInfo.value: Bone swarms gather near cliffs, crevasses, and pits in the hope of forcing a victim or an entire herd of animals to fall to its death, creating more shattered bones to add to their mass.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The bone swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bone swarm makes two Swirling Bones attacks. It can replace one Swirling Bones attack with one Death's Embrace attack, if available.

actions.name: Swirling Bones
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 36 (**8d8**) bludgeoning, 36 (**8d8**) piercing, or 36 (**8d8**) slashing damage (the bone swarm's choice), or 18 (**4d8**) bludgeoning, 8 (**4d8**) piercing, or 8 (**4d8**) slashing damage (the bone swarm's choice) if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

actions.name: Death's Embrace (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. *Hit:* The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained and any attack against the bone swarm has a 50 percent chance of hitting the grappled creature instead. The bone swarm can have only one creature grappled at a time. The grappled creature has advantage on ability checks made to escape the grapple when the bone swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

fluffInfo.value: "Do you really need all of your bones? Are you sure I couldn't just snack on a few? I'll gladly pay you for them."

traits.name: Bone Armor (1/Day)
traits.value: A bone trader in its lair can use a bonus action to summon a temporary suit of bone armor that lasts for ten minutes or until dismissed by the bone trader. While wearing its bone armor, a bone trader has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Charisma (*Intimidation*) checks.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.value: The bone trader can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Bone Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Skelesuck
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have one of its bones sucked out, resulting in the piercing damage becoming a reduction in maximum hit points until magical healing is applied.

actions.name: Fey Charm
actions.value: The bone trader targets one humanoid, goblinoid, fey, or beast it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards the bone trader as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the bone trader's control, it takes the bone trader's requests or actions in the most favorable way . Each time the bone trader or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the bone trader dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the bone trader's fey charm for the next 24 hours.
The bone trader can have no more than one humanoid charmed at a time, along with up to three beasts.

fluffInfo.value: *Voracious Carrion Eater*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: A lingering result of the fey bargain that created them, boneflayers are disoriented and diminished by loud, thunderous noises.

entries: **Languages**: Sylvan; understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The boneflayer doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Thunderous Ward
traits.value: When the boneflayer hears a drum or gong, or takes Thunder damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The boneflayer makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both talons. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

bonusActions.name: Swoop (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: If the boneflayer has a creature Grappled, the boneflayer flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

entries: **Senses**: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense throughout bonemonger's lair
**Languages**: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Go for the Throat
traits.value: The bonemonger deals an extra 21 (**6d6**) damage when it hits a target with a bite attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Insightful Telepathy
traits.value: The bonemonger is constantly under the effects of the __detect thoughts__ spell (save DC 20). As a bonus action, it can probe deeper into the mind of any creature it can detect in its lair. If the creature fails its saving throw, the bonemonger has advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the start of the bonemonger's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the bonemonger fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Osteomancer (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the bonemonger would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 246 hit points, it gains 100 temporary hit points as bones coalesce around it, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the bonemonger can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 41,000 XP (63,000 XP total) for defeating the bonemonger after its Osteomancer activates.

actions.name: Mi

The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (**3d8**) thunder damage and 13 (**3d8**) psychic damage, and become frightened of the bonemonger until the end of the bonemonger's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Distilled to nothing but dry, whispering sand and a full set of teeth, this ghoulish creature still hungers for flesh and blood.*

*Spread mainly through bite wounds, this disease makes itself known within 24 hours by swiftly debilitating the infected. An infected creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw after every long rest. On a failed save, the victim takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the victim finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The victim recovers from the disease by making two consecutive successful saving throws. Greater restoration cures the disease, while lesser restoration gives the victim advantage on the next saving throw. Primarily spread among Humanoids, the disease can affect ogres, and therefore other Giants may be susceptible. If a creature dies while infected with darakhul fever, roll a d20, add the character's Constitution modifier, and find the result on the Adjustment Table below to determine what Undead form the victim's body rises in.*

fluffInfo.name: Starved Into Dust
fluffInfo.value: The bonepowder ghoul is a small and unassuming pile of dust and bone fragments. Ghouls can achieve this powdery form through long starvation, a process that invariably takes decades. Rarely purposefully created, a bonepowder ghoul typically rises from the remnants of a ghoul trapped away from food, becoming animate hunger and hatred.

fluffInfo.name: Whispering Voices
fluffInfo.value: Though bonepowder ghouls speak, their voices are faint. When they drain life force from living creatures, their dusty forms gain some substance, strengthening their voices enough to cast spells and command allies.
