fluffInfo.value: *Covered in black spikes, the dragon's eyeless head swings from side to side. Darkness creeps from its strange, eel-like hide, spreading like ink in water.*

Apex predators of the underworld, cave dragons are the stuff of nightmare for creatures with little else to fear. They can speak, but they value silence, speaking rarely except when bargaining for food.

fluffInfo.name: Born to Darkness
fluffInfo.value: Eyeless, these dragons have long, thin spikes that help them navigate tunnels or seal passages around them, preventing foes from outflanking them. Their stunted wings are little more than feelers, useful in rushing down tunnels. Their narrow snouts poke into tight passages, which their tongues scour free of bats and vermin. Young cave dragons and wyrmlings can fly, poorly, but older specimens lose the gift of flight. Cave dragon hide is more like eel skin than reptilian scales, and it grows mottled with brown and black as it ages.

fluffInfo.name: Ravenous Marauders
fluffInfo.value: Cave dragons are always hungry and ready to eat everything. They devour undead, plant creatures, or anything organic. When feeding, they treat all nearby creatures as both a threat and the next course. Alliances they make only last so long as their allies make themselves scarce when the dragon feeds. They can be bribed with food as easily as with gold, but other attempts at diplomacy typically fail. Cave dragons do form alliances with peoples of the underworld, joining them in battle against enemies, but there is always a price to be paid in flesh, bone, and marrow. Wise allies keep a cave dragon well fed.

fluffInfo.name: A Hard Life
fluffInfo.value: Limited food underground makes truly ancient cave dragons almost unheard of. The eldest tend to die of starvation after stripping their territory bare of prey. Their nigh-endless hunger leaves the ancients the most likely of cave dragons to form alliances, especially with allies that promise—and deliver—food. On occasion, cave dragons climb to the surface to feed, but their earthbound, plodding pace leaves them outcompeted by other predators or unable to keep up with swift or flying prey. They prefer tight tunnels where they can ambush and outmaneuver prey.

fluffInfo.name: Edible Hoards and Vertical Lairs
fluffInfo.value: Due to the scarcity of food in their subterranean world, a cave dragon's hoard may consist largely of food sources: bat colonies, enormous beetles, carcasses in states of decay, a cavern infested with shriekers, and whatever else the dragon doesn't immediately devour. Cave dragons are fond of bones and items with strong taste or smell. Vast collections of bones, teeth, ivory, and the shells of huge insects litter their lairs, arranged like artful ossuaries. Large vertical chimneys serve as nesting sites for eggs and are popular resting places when a cave dragon sleeps within its lair. Chimneys just wide enough to hold young cave dragons make preferred ambush sites, as the dragons' tough spikes help hold them in position until prey passes beneath. The oldest cave dragons also retreat to vertical chimneys near nesting sites or within their lairs to die in peace. Stories claim that enormous treasures are heaped up in these ledges, abysses, and other inaccessible locations.

traits.name: Darkness Shroud
traits.value: The cave dragon naturally suppresses light near it. Bright light within 15 feet of the dragon becomes dim light, and dim light within 15 feet becomes nonmagical darkness.

traits.name: Magical Tunneler
traits.value: The cave dragon can burrow through nonmagical unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dragon can choose whether to leave the material it moves through undisturbed or leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

fluffInfo.value: *These patches of tangled, lacy moss cling to the ceiling, slowly pulsing with an eerie glow. Their stems gently writhe among the soft, feathery mass, dusting the ground below with a twinkling of phosphorescent spores.*

fluffInfo.name: Plant Carnivore
fluffInfo.value: Cavelight moss glows with a pale, yellow light, but when agitated, its light changes to an icy blue. Cavelight moss is frequently mistaken for a benign organism, but it hunts living flesh and renders its meals immobile before starting the long process of digestion. A cavelight moss is a collective of smaller life forms patched together and sharing sensations. Barely cognitive, a cavelight moss spends its time positioning itself above well‑traveled sections of cavern, feeding on rats, bats, and crawling insects. When it senses larger prey, it slowly and quietly moves toward the creature.

fluffInfo.name: Long-Lived Spores
fluffInfo.value: A cavelight moss can survive for 200 years, shedding luminous spores and consuming vermin. Its spores germinate in the carcasses of its victims, and in lean times, these spores can grow slowly on guano or other areas rich in moisture and organic nutrients.

fluffInfo.name: Rare Colonies
fluffInfo.value: If a cave system has no true protectors and food is plentiful, these creatures congregate—most commonly, in bat colonies of millions of individuals. When they gather this way, cavelight mosses function as a large colony, covering strategic locations where prey roams. When a source of food moves on, the entire colony slowly disperses as well.

Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and at the start of each of the target's turns, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. The cavelight moss then gains 5 temporary hp. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw can't suffer further levels of exhaustion from the cavelight moss's grapple for the next 24 hours. The cavelight moss can have only one creature grappled at a time.

fluffInfo.value: The Alabaster Sierras are bordered by hazardously treacherous shore-side cliffs and bleak mountains swarming with starving monstrosities. But beneath those peaks is a dense, beautiful, and eerie forest called the Parchwood. During the six-year nightmare that was the Briarwood's reign, refugees made their home here—but so did Lady Delilah and Lord Sylas's experiments. The centaur skeletons of the Parchwood are not centaurs at all; rather, they are the remnants of the Briarwoods' fleeting attempts to entertain themselves by refashioning the remains of different species into unique forms.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Hag of Pestilence and Flesh-Shaping*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Centipede hags draw more than strength from the filth that covers them; it is the essence of their being. Scrubbing it away dissolves the hag.

traits.name: Scoured Filth
traits.value: The hag is burned by soapy water. Treat a bucket or flask of it splashed on the hag as a vial of Acid. If the hag is fully immersed in soapy water at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Acid damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The hag can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Bite attacks or uses Spellcasting to cast __Contagion__. It can also use Warping Caress.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the hag's next turn.

actions.name: Warping Caress
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. Until the target's Exhaustion level is reduced to 0, its body is warped and twisted, and it has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength or Dexterity. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If a Humanoid dies from this action, the hag can spend 2 days of work to shape its corpse into a __Deepdreck__, or it can combine it with the corpse of a horse to create a __Fleshdobbin__.

entries: **Resistances**: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.value: The cerberus pup has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, deafened, and stunned.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: When one of the cerberus pup's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cerberus pup makes three attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The cerberus pup exhales debilitating fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 (**1d6**) fire damage and 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: The Cerebrograft is a horrific attempt to combine two creatures into a singular form, a nightmarish combination of brains and brawn. Through surgical implantation and flesh-melding, an apothecary creates a forced symbiosis, fusing their nervous systems and unlocking potent psionic abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Improved Lackeys
fluffInfo.value: A Cerebrograft is often the "reward" granted to a pair of loyal lab assistants, a means of "removing deficiencies" by combining their bodies and minds, frequently named a portmanteau of its constituent beings.

fluffInfo.name: Dominant Personality
fluffInfo.value: Although intended to be a symbiosis of two minds, typically, the implanted creature subsumes the psyche of its host, fully controling the new form. However, sometimes, the two beings form a constituent mind combining elements of the originals, or even a bicameral mind where the original two debate internally over what action to take.

fluffInfo.name: Delicate Work
fluffInfo.value: Thanks to their psionic abilities, Cerebrografts are well suited to controlling other test subjects. Apothecaries find their precise telekinetic powers especially useful in surgical procedures and laboratory experiments.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Cerebrograft, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Occult Fleshmending
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Cerebrograft's Dual Minds trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Powerful Psionics
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Telekinetic Grip and Psychic Crush.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Powerful, Clumsy, and Slow
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Cerebrograft's ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Despite its physical and psionic might, Cerebrografts prefers fighting alongside allies of its apothecary master. When confronted with multiple foes, it tries to overwhelm their minds using Psychic Crush to escape and find reinforcements.

A Cerebrograft uses its Telekinetic Grip to hold its enemies, unruly test subjects, and wild experiments at bay. It typically focuses on one target, allowing allies to pummel the Restrained foe. If it can, it uses the environment to its advantage, moving foes to restrain them such as into mancles, cages, or surgery tables.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Languages**: telepathy 30 ft. The languages of its creator

traits.name: Dual Minds
traits.value: The cerebrograft has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Grip
actions.value: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the Incapacitated condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

actions.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the cerebrograft. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: If an attack deals over half of the general's current remaining hit points in damage (even if their hit points are reduced to 0 by the attack), they immediately regain 8 (1d12 + 2) hit points.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The general's long jump is 30 feet, and their base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The general makes three melee attacks, two with their scimitar and one with their dagger. Alternatively, the general can make two ranged attack with their daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: If the priest is dealt damage equal to half or more of their current remaining hit points (even if their HP is reduced to 0 by the attack), they immediately regain 8 (1d12 + 2) hit points.

traits.name: Charge
traits.value: If the priest moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards an enemy, their antler attack deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) points of piercing damage. If the target of the charge is Large or smaller, they must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the priest.

actions.name: Antlers
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (**1d8 + 1**) bludgeoning damage if being held in both hands.

fluffInfo.value: *The angel's dark halo, flayed skin, and soulless, rage-filled eyes hint at the horrors it endured to end up shackled at the feet of the demon.*

fluffInfo.name: Broken and Chained
fluffInfo.value: These angels have been captured by fiends, tortured, and turned to serve darkness. They invariably wear chains, shackles, barbed flesh hooks, or manacles to show their captive state. A pack of chained angels is considered a status symbol among the servants of evil. A chained angel fights for the forces of evil as long as it remains chained, which amuses demons and devils greatly.

fluffInfo.name: Chance at Redemption
fluffInfo.value: While their souls are tainted with the blood of innocents, in their hearts chained angels still hope to be redeemed, or at least to gain the solace of extinction. Any creature that kills a chained angel receives a gift of gratitude for the release of death. If it cannot be redeemed, a chained angel is a storm of destruction.

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.value: The chained angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The chained angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Redemption
traits.value: When a creature casts the __knock__ spell on the chained angel's chains, the chains release a blast of unholy flame. The spellcaster must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (**3d10**) fire damage and 16 (**3d10**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the spellcaster survives, the chained angel must immediately make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the angel's chains fall away. It is restored to its senses and the form it had before it was chained, typically a deva. On a failure, the chained angel remains chained for 7 days, and during that time, any further attempts to cast __knock__ on the angel's chains fail.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chained angel makes two Fiery Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Fiery Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 16 (**3d10**) fire damage.

actions.name: Fallen Glory (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Each creature the chained angel can see within 50 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 19 (**3d12**) radiant damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

fluffInfo.name: Champion of Ravens
fluffInfo.value: Death comes for all things in their time. It is the will of the __The Matron of Ravens__ that no being, no matter how heroic or how powerful, shall escape their rightful place in the hereafter. Yet when his sister __Vex'ahlia__ died in a sunken Issylran tomb, Vax'ildan demanded that the goddess of death release her claim on __Vex'ahlia's__ soul—and claim his instead.

Inscrutably, the __The Matron of Ravens__ acquiesced to Vax'ildan's demand. He donned the Deathwalker's Ward, a Vestige of Divergence imbued with the __The Matron of Ravens__ power, and the legendary armor of her previous mortal champion. In time, Vax'ildan too came to be called her champion, and returned to life from death more than once—even enduring utter annihilation by __The Whispered One__ and strangulation by an Archfey. All these deaths were permissible for the __The Matron of Ravens__ champion, since the threads of fate that bound Vax'ildan to her service had not yet run their full course. But they inevitably did.

Vax'ildan bade farewell to all the people he held most dear in the wake of __The Whispered One__ defeat, and vanished into the eternal embrace of his god. In the years since, his returns to the world he once knew have been rare and fleeting. The Champion of Ravens is not Vax'ildan, though Vax resides within him. He is a loyal arbiter of the ineffable providence of death itself. He appears at times as a wrathful angel, masked and surrounded by a storm of raven feathers, bringing an end to those who would pervert the sanctity of oblivion out of greed or fear of the unknown.

All fear the end, in their own way. Some fight it, delving into magic that delays the inevitable by making a mockery of both life and death. Others lash out, hurting people around them in smaller ways. But those whose fears are greatest are met by the Champion of Ravens, whose kind soul soothes and shepherds the fearful beyond the veil of the mortal world.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +19, intimidation +10, investigation +10, perception +16, persuasion +10, sleight of hand +12, stealth +19
**Resistances**: radiant, necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Druidic, Elvish, Thieves' cant

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.value: During his first turn, the Champion has Advantage and Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Champion scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.value: While the Champion is conscious, he and friendly creatures within 10 feet of him have a +3 bonus to saving throws (included above).

traits.name: Eternal Champion
traits.value: When the Champion is reduced to 0 hit points or dies, his body is destroyed but his spirit returns to the __The Matron of Ravens__ side, and he gains a new body after 1d4 days.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the Champion is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throws to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throws, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Fate-Touched (4/Day)
traits.value: When the Champion makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throws, he can reroll the d20 and use either roll. Alternatively, when a creature the Champion can see makes an attack roll against him, or a saving throws against one of his spells or features, he can force that creature to reroll the attack or save and use the new roll.

traits.name: Shadow Smite (1/Turn)
traits.value: The Champion deals an extra 49 (**14d6**) radiant or necrotic damage (his choice) when he hits a target with a weapon attack and he doesn't have Advantage and Disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Unerring Sight
traits.value: The Champion's ranged weapon attacks ignore cover and cover and have no range penalty.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: The Champion wears boots of haste and the Deathwalker's Ward, and wields Whisper.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Champion makes three attacks with Whisper.

actions.name: Whisper
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d4 + 8**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) psychic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throws or be frightened of the Champion for 1 minute. On a ranged attack, the Champion can teleport with Whisper, appearing within 5 feet of the target on a hit, or in a random space within 30 feet of the target on a miss.

actions.name: Touch of Life and Death (Recharges after a resting)
actions.value: The Champion touches a creature within 5 feet of him, and chooses to either heal or harm that creature, restoring 55 (10d10) hit points or dealing 55 (**10d10**) necrotic damage. If the creature is an unwilling target, it can avoid either effect with a successful DC 20 Dexterity saving throws.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The Champion takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonusActions.name: Boots of Haste (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The Champion clicks his heels together, casting __haste__ on himself. He doesn't suffer from lethargy when the spell ends.

entries: **Languages**: Common, plus up to three other languages

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Chantelle wears a dress of many pockets and has a book of instant copying and wand of gilding, which are all described in appendix A.

traits.name: Silver Tongue (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: When Chantelle makes a Charisma check or saving throw, she can choose to make the roll with advantage.

traits.name: Wand of Gilding
traits.value: The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, Chantelle can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 15) from it: __alter self__, __charm person__ (2nd-level version), __enthrall__, or __hypnotic pattern__.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magic Coin
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 bludgeoning damage plus 19 (**3d12**) thunder damage.

actions.name: Money Talks (4/Day)
actions.value: Chantelle enchants a coin in her hand with divination magic, which lasts for 10 minutes or until Chantelle ends the effect early (no action required). For the duration, a creature holding the coin that knows at least one language can understand the meaning of any word Chantelle speaks, and when Chantelle speaks, that creature understands what Chantelle says.

Alternatively, Chantelle can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of her next turn, using her own senses as if she were in the coin's space. During this time, Chantelle is deafened and blinded with regard to her own senses.

fluffInfo.value: Ordained with prayer beads and holy symbols, a chaplain is a faithful warrior-priest who accompanies questing knights and military regiments on campaign. During moments of peace, some will prepare continual flame, sending, speak with dead, remove curse, greater restoration, scrying, and raise dead as the need requires. Other chaplains are fiery zealots who can prepare faerie fire, burning hands, scorching ray, flaming sphere, fireball, and wall of fire.

traits.name: Devotion
traits.value: The chaplain has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage or 5 (**1d8 + 1**) damage when used in two hands to make a melee attack.

entries: **Languages**: understands one language but can't speak

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.value: The chapped brute has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing. While deafened, the brute can't use its blindsight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chapped brute makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Adaptive Hide
traits.value: After taking damage, the chapped brute abomination gains resistance to that type of damage until it takes another type of damage.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The chapped brute abomination has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell. While deafened and unable to smell, the brute can't use its blindsight.

traits.name: Unstable Life
traits.value: At the start of the chapped brute abomination's turn, roll 1d20. The abomination regains hit points equal to any even result and loses hit points equal to any odd result. The abomination can neither exceed its hit point maximum with a gain nor fall below 1 hit point with a loss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chapped brute abomination makes two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the brute can't use the tentacle against another target. The chapped brute abomination has four tentacles.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: Each creature grappled by the chapped brute abomination must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the brute's body. An engulfed target is blinded, restrained, unable to breathe, and has Cover from effects that originate outside the brute. At the start of each of the brute's turns, each engulfed creature takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage. The brute can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make its choice of a DC 18 Strength (*Athletics*) or Dexterity (*Acrobatics*) check. On a success, the creature escapes and uses 10 feet of movement to enter a space of its choice within 5 feet of the brute.
If the brute dies, an engulfed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement.

If a creature dies inside the brute, the brute doesn't roll for Unstable Life at the start of its next turn and instead regains 20 hit points. The creature's body breaks up inside the brute, and the brute expels anything the creature wore or carried.

fluffInfo.value: *The massive spider stands perched on tall, stilted legs, and the disheveled body of a robed arcanist swings from its clenched mandibles.*

fluffInfo.name: Feed on Spellcasters
fluffInfo.value: These massive arachnids are largely confined to great forests and occasional wastelands, although rumors persist of sightings in the dark alleys of magocratic cities, causing trepidation among the spellcasters there. Few creatures pose such a threat to spellcasters as chelicerae.

fluffInfo.name: Carry Their Prey
fluffInfo.value: Walking on high, stilted legs, these creatures resemble gigantic harvesters. More often than not, they are found with the grisly bodies of humanoids dangling from their clenched mandibles.

fluffInfo.name: Cocoon Arcanists
fluffInfo.value: Chelicerae stalk isolated victims, striking with a poisonous bite then pinning the victim within powerful jaws. There, the victim's helpless body can hang for days on end as the chelicerae pursues obscure and eldritch tasks. At best, victims wake up weeks later with no memory of the events, far from home, and drained of vitality and spells. Others are stored immobilized in thick cocoons in a high treetop until their body and mind recover. A few unlucky victims are slain and rise a week later as walking dead that obey and protect the chelicerae.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The chelicerae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The chelicerae can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chelicerae makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace the Bite attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the chelicerae doesn't have another creature grappled, the target is grappled (escape DC 15). A poisoned target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poisoned condition on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Magical Discharge (Recharge Special)
actions.value: The chelicerae releases some of its stored magical energy in a burst. Each creature within 15 feet of the chelicerae must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (**8d8**) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using Magical Discharge, the chelicerae can't do so again until it successfully siphons magic from a creature or until it finishes a long rest.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Moves
bonusActions.value: The chelicerae takes the Dash or Disengage action.

bonusActions.name: Siphon Magic
bonusActions.value: The chelicerae siphons magic from a spellcaster it is grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or lose one spell slot of the highest level it can cast. The chelicerae then regains an expended use of its Spellcasting.

fluffInfo.value: *The only chemists I admire are the ones who make Caspian cinnamon rolls. This is not one of them.*

Chemists indulge in the science of the alchemical, often harnessing the raw potential of elemental formulae while creating unique compounds and reagents. They have been known to dabble in the science behind the creation of elementals and oozes, and perfecting explosives and acids.

fluffInfo.name: Chemist Minions
fluffInfo.value: Although Chemists often do not dabble in creating creatures, any apothecary can make use of minions. Simple elementals and oozes can be found in a Chemist's lab. __Tankers__ work as a good lab assistant for administering large amounts of chemical formulae for the scientist, while __Living Biohazards__ are often the failed early experiments many Chemists. A __Chemystral__ is the ultimate pride and joy of many chemists.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I revel in the chaos and destruction that my concoctions cause, watching the flames and corrosion with maniacal laughter and a crazed gleam in my eyes.
**Bond:** Creativity is born from chaos; the most groundbreaking discoveries require pushing boundaries, no matter the dangers involved.
**Ideal:** I am obsessed with avenging my mentor, who was persecuted by those who feared our knowledge and power.

**Flaw:** My obsession with perfecting destructive formulae often leads me to take careless risks, sabotaging my own work and safety. I've burned down my own workshop more times than I can remember, and I'll do it again.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study a Chemist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistance from Exposure
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Chemist's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Masters of Compounds
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Chemist's Critical Condition trait and Explosive Compound action. (20+) Mental, not Physical, Prowess. You are aware of the Chemist's AC and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chemists opt to start things off with a bang, unleashing their Explosive Concoction on the first round, especially against a grouped together party. They use Acid Rain to create a dangerous zone between them and their enemies and default to unleashing their Chemical Spray on enemies stuck in the difficult area. If a creature closes the distance on the Chemist, they use their Caustic Grip. If they find themselves surrounded or outnumbered in close quarters, they attempt to escape.

traits.name: Critical Condition
traits.value: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Chemist is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

actions.name: Caustic Grip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Explosive Concoction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the Burning condition (4d6, same damage type). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
actions.value: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 30 (**12d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Emergency Dose
bonusActions.value: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

fluffInfo.value: One of a __Chemist__'s ultimate creations, the Chemystral is a perfectly balanced sentient compound capable of altering its physiology to adapt to surrounding threats. The horrific ooze has the ability to stick to any surface and even propel itself into the air and fly. It is impervious to nearly all forms of elemental attack. Much like a chameleon changing its color to blend into its surroundings, the Chemystral changes itself at a cellular level to adapt to environmental changes and elemental threats, gaining properties to better combat predators. Even with its inherent resilience, the Chemystral is unable to adapt to the cold, or deal with intense sound.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Chemystral, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Living Chemical Reaction
fluffInfo.value: You know the Chemystral's

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Elemental Adaption
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Chemystral's Elemental Reaction trait.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Weakness to Cold
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Chemystral's Cold Vulnerability trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Chemystral attempts to Engulf as many victims as it can. It cares little about taking elemental damage and only thinks to retreat if it is consistently taking Cold damage.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Glands.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.value: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cold Vulnerability
traits.value: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes Frozen (DC 15). While it has the Frozen condition, it loses its Immunities to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its Resistance to Force damage, and it gains Vulnerability to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the Frozen condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

traits.name: Elemental Reaction
traits.value: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

traits.name: Acid
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid).

traits.name: Fire
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

traits.name: Lightning
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Poison
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Necrotic
traits.value: On a hit, the chemystral regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The chemystral regains 25 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sonic Neutralization
traits.value: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental Reaction trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The chemystral moves up to its Speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

*Failure:* The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the Restrained condition, and takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has Total Cover from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 17 Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

fluffInfo.value: *These bat-winged fey sport horns, scales, and other minor draconic features.*

*Dragons of the Mharoti Empire consider chernomoi cute guardian pets and treat them roughly the way humans treat a parrot or other pet bird. In some cases, chernomoi serve elder dragons as familiars and messengers, dressed in dazzling armor made of gemstones. Chernomoi familiars and messengers are as much valued companions as they are a visible sign of their master's wealth and power.*

fluffInfo.name: Dragon Sprites
fluffInfo.value: Chernomoi (which means "lair sprite" in Draconic) often reside discreetly in a dragon lair or dragonborn household, cleaning and tidying up at night and only occasionally keeping a small trinket or shiny gemstone as compensation. They appear as tiny, winged humanoids, dressed in metallic armor made of small coins and semi-precious stones.

fluffInfo.name: Lair Alarms
fluffInfo.value: Chernomoi are terrified of wyverns and never lair anywhere near them. Otherwise, they are very protective of their draconic masters and raise an alarm if an intruder is undetected. They fight with their tiny blades if cornered, though they always flee from danger as a first option—usually straight to a dragon, dragonborn, or drake ally.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The chernomoi emits a loud shriek that is audible out to 100 feet. Each creature within 60 feet of the chernomoi and that can hear it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The chernomoi magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Spellcasting, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the chernomoi wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.value: The chicken can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Peck
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Its eyes gleam like polished walnuts, and its sly smile seems oddly placed on the tiny body, covered in spikes and thorns. The creature's waist is no thicker than a clenched fist, and its sinuous arms are no wider than a finger but twice the length of its body.*

fluffInfo.name: Born of Magic
fluffInfo.value: Children of the briar are a frequent nuisance to fey and mortal alike. They grow in deep briar patches in forest clearings or along sunny hillsides and riverbanks. More rarely, they spawn when a sorcerer or magical creature's blood is spilled on the forest floor, or when summoned into being by obscure druidic items of power.

fluffInfo.name: Thorn Fortresses
fluffInfo.value: Despite their size, children of the briar gather in great numbers, cultivating ancient forest thickets into veritable fortresses. Wise men flee when they hear the clicking language in the underbrush, for children of the briar have the capricious wickedness of spiteful children and a taste for blood.

fluffInfo.name: Spies and Scouts
fluffInfo.value: From their lairs, children of the briar creep far and wide to spy on the forest's inhabitants, sometimes using spiders, monstrous centipedes, and giant dragonflies as mounts. They converse with travelers bearing interesting news, but their words are thorned with gleeful malice, jealous bile, and lies. They are not above murder. They trade news and gossip for trinkets, favors, and drops of spilled blood.

fluffInfo.name: Fey Blessed
fluffInfo.value: The fey have long used children of the briar as spies and informants. The power of the fey courses through their veins, allowing them to work simple magical tricks and slip between the mortal and fey realms with relative ease.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.value: The child of the briar has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The child of the briar makes two Claw attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). At the start of each of the grappled creature's turns, it takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage. The child of the briar can have only one target grappled at a time.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spitdart Tongue (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Entangle
actions.value: While within 10 feet of at least one other child of the briar, this child can cast the __entangle__ spell (spell save DC 13). Each friendly child of the briar within 30 feet of this child can use its reaction to join the casting. For each child beyond the first participating in the casting, the save DC increases by 1, to a maximum of DC 17, and the size increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of a 40-foot square. The entangled area must include at least one of the children involved in the casting. All participating children of the briar are immune to the spell's effects.

traits.name: Volant
traits.value: When the chimera reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the chimera can move up to their speed toward an enemy they can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chimera makes three Bite attacks. They can replace one attack with a Lion's Toss attack or a use of Dragon's Eruption, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lion's Toss
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 20 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Dragon's Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The chimera spits a volcanic explosion at a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (**6d8**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Roar
bonusActions.value: Each enemy who can hear the chimera and is within 60 feet of them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the chimera for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature succeeds on a saving throw against this effect or if the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the chimera's Roar for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Ram's Defense (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The chimera makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack imposes disadvantage on the target's next attack roll made before the start of the chimera's next turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Lion's Leap (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The chimera moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they end this movement on the ground, each creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: 5th Level: Volcanic Blow (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The chimera spits an explosion of fire at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: While the chimeron's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the chimeron must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The chimeron can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When the chimeron reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the chimeron consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the chimeron's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Soul Resistance
traits.value: While the chimeron's soul count is is 2 or higher, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chimeron makes up to three attacks using Powerful Bite, Scorching Bite, Booming Bite, or Chilling Bite. They can't use any attack more than once.

actions.name: Powerful Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scorching Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) fire damage, and the target is set on fire until the target or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative.

actions.name: Booming Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) thunder damage, and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Chilling Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage, the target's speed is halved until the end of their next turn, and they can only make one attack during their next turn.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Protective Plates
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Dreg's AC.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Pinning Blades
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Bone Blade attack and No Escape trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Sturdy Foe
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Chitinous Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitinous Dregs often charge into the front lines of combat. It positions itself between other Dregs and their foes almost as if it was defending its allies. Chitinous Dregs attempt to draw the combat towards itself at all times, using its Bone Blades to keep the focus on it, and its Sentinel Strike Reaction and No Escape trait to ensure creatures facing it cannot get away. The Chitinous Dreg is a warrior and rarely retreats: it is too enraged with a protective bloodlust when thrust into battle to worry about its own wellbeing.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Wall Crawling
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Climb Speed, its Running Leap trait, and its Slow Fall feature.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Madding Noise
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Chitter attack action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its mental ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitters often attack in a small group. Usually two to three that form a family will stick together. The mutated squirrels have been known to be quite territorial and hostile, even to other Chitter families who try to infringe on their territory.

Chitters are excellent climbers, capable of falling a great distance without fear of hurting themselves. It is not uncommon for Chitters to be found in tall buildings, or up on the top floor of ruined houses, or hard-to-reach rooftops or attics. Chitters charge their enemies and leap at them, attempting to disable them with their chittering, and relying on their Claws and Bite. Chitters protect their homes with determined ferocity, but if reduced to less than a third of their Hit Points, they leap and clamber away.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive

fluffInfo.value: *Small horns crown this pig-faced devil's head. It stands on shaggy goat legs and holds a flaming polearm in its clawed hands. It bears a wicked gleam in its black eyes*.

fluffInfo.name: Bad Bargains
fluffInfo.value: Quick and canny, a chort devil delights in enticing mortals to make terrible bargains. A chort wants its victim to know it is dealing with a devil. The relative straightforwardness of this approach enables the creature to better deceive victims. After all, the chort affirms, if the victims weren't so desperate, they wouldn't be bargaining with a devil. If necessary, an implied threat of immolation gives it greater bargaining power, but the devil is careful not to torture or otherwise harm its patsy, as that voids any potential contract.

fluffInfo.name: Recitation of Contracts
fluffInfo.value: Occasionally, some poor fool believes he can trick a chort and escape a legal bargain. The devil appears and recites the entirety of the contract its victim signed, replete with embarrassing details about a dispatched rival, the ensnarement of a lover, and other disclosures. A chort ensures all those entangled in its victim's affairs are present to hear the recitation, and it disappears once all the victim's dark secrets have been revealed.

fluffInfo.name: Smear Tactics
fluffInfo.value: An opponent of the chort often finds itself the victim of its own hubris, as the devil digs up or creates vile tales about the opponent. For example, it may steal a paladin's sword and use it to murder an especially pious person, leaving the sword in the victim. Thus, a chort dispatches a foe resistant to its manipulations, brings suspicion to a potential foe, and taints a weapon—at least in reputation—which might be used against it.
