traits.name: Kren's Gifts
traits.value: The Rosselbuck has advantage on all Wisdom (*Perception*) and Wisdom (*Survival*) checks. The Rosselbuck can also make a bite attack as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Rosselbuck has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The Rosselbuck's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Predatory Aura
traits.value: Any creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the Rosselbuck must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Loping Glide
traits.value: When falling or long jumping at least 30 feet, the Rosselbuck can spend a reaction to fly up to twice its speed in one direction as it descends. The Rosselbuck lands in an unoccupied space at the end of its movement and takes no falling damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Rosselbuck's long jump is up to 60 feet and its high jump is up to 40 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Rosselbuck makes one antler attack and one kick attack.

actions.name: Antler
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Kick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.value: If the Rosselbuck jumps or glides at least 30 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space occupied by one or more other creatures. Each of these creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 26 (**6d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage and 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the Rosselbuck's space into an adjacent unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the Rosselbuck's space.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The corrupted slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sickness
traits.value: Each time a creature comes in contact with the corrupted slime, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. Once a creature has been affected by a corrupted slime's Sickness, it is immune for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Spike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Drain
actions.value: The corrupted slime deals 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage to each creature affected by its sickness within 120 feet of it. It then regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt.

fluffInfo.value: *The eye sockets of the funerary figure's ornate death mask suddenly ignite with a golden radiance. With the creak of long-unused limbs, this towering figure in ancient armor raises its weapons once more.*Ushabtis are placed in tombs as servants in the afterlife for those buried there—as both a laborer in the kingdom of the dead and a guardian in the kingdom of the living. These sentinels tend to the physical work and maintenance required after death that is beyond the abilities of those of flesh and blood. Dressed in ceremonial regalia, they are sometimes mistaken for living beings by those who would intrude upon their domain, but careful examination reveals faintly glowing hieroglyphs graven into their garments and bodies.

*In Midgard, ushabtis are common in the Southlands as funerary figures. Originally gifted to his faithful by the wise god Eshu—whether this was truly as a gift or as trickery depends on the scholar telling the tale—these constructs gained near universal usage among the priests of other faiths. In Nuria Natal, they take on many more utilitarian roles for the living, not being confined to merely serving the dead, such as by protecting travelers and offerings at roadside shrines and as bodyguards and servants for the living god‑kings and other important figures.*
*Of note, a corrupted ushabti is viewed with some esteem in Nuria Natal, assuming the sacrifice was willing. These ushabti are sometimes called imy-ut ushabtis.*

fluffInfo.name: Tomb Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Ushabtis are most commonly encountered as guardians—a function they fulfill effectively, fiercely attacking anything that threatens their sworn charge. An ushabti is sometimes obvious from the blood of its victims staining its form. Some ceaselessly babble ancient scriptures or invocations to the gods of death. Tombs are often littered with bones of tomb robbers an ushabti has dispatched.

fluffInfo.name: Serene Repose
fluffInfo.value: Most ushabtis have human faces and proportions, with features resembling a death mask. When at rest, they stand or lie with arms folded across their chests, clutching their ceremonial weapons. Many variations have been found, however, including some that are animal-headed, completely monstrous, or have abstract or fanciful designs, such as a sun-sphere head or a body made of papyrus scrolls.

fluffInfo.name: Sacrificial Corruptions
fluffInfo.value: Some dark practitioners use sacrifices—willing or not—as undying servants of their godkings and god-queens. Generals, trusted advisors, and close allies have willingly accompanied their dying lords into the afterlife through this horrifying transformation. The sacrifices are tightly bound in linens and sealed within a sarcophagus among a swarm of flesh-eating scarabs that, over a period of days to weeks, fully consume their bodies. The servant's devotion to their task and the anguish of their passing transforms the scarab colony and animates the funerary wrappings to carry on with the sacred duty. Most view this as a corruption of the process for creating ushabtis, reducing the time and cost of construction with blood and resulting in a weaker, uncontrollable guardian. Though a corrupted ushabti fulfills its duties to protect its dead charges, it views living creatures as meals for the scarab colony within its wrappings, regardless of that creature's identity.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The ushabti's weapon attacks are magical. When the ushabti hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra (**2d6**) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The ushabti regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

traits.name: Swarm Body
traits.value: The corrupted ushabti is a spirit inhabiting a colony of scarabs around a Humanoid skeleton within funerary wrappings. It can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny scarab and Humanoid bones, and it can't regain hp or gain temporary hp, except for its Regeneration trait. In addition, a creature that hits the ushabti with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage as a dozen Tiny scarabs skitter out and bite the attacker.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The ushabti doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The corrupted ushabti makes two Ceremonial Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Ceremonial Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Vomit Swarm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The corrupted ushabti exhales scarabs in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 25 (**10d4**) piercing damage and is covered in scarabs. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't covered in scarabs. A creature covered in scarabs takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the covered creature, can take its action to brush the scarabs off the covered creature by succeeding on a DC 15 Dexterity check.

fluffInfo.value: *The ooze boils and bubbles with rank marsh gas and the fetid stench of the sewer. It leaves a stinking trail of acidic slime wherever it goes.*

fluffInfo.name: Swim and Walk
fluffInfo.value: A corrupting ooze is a festering slime that can slither and even swim like a gigantic sea slug, or it can assume a roughly humanoid form and shamble through the streets. Its stench and its lack of speech, however, make it unlikely that anyone might mistake it for a person. They are frequently soldiers and servants to heralds of blood and heralds of darkness.

fluffInfo.name: Dissolve Bones
fluffInfo.value: A corrupting ooze can absorb an entire large animal or small person, simply dissolving everything in a matter of minutes. This function makes them an important element of certain dark rituals.

fluffInfo.name: Strong Swimmer
fluffInfo.value: A corrupting ooze naturally floats on the surface of water. It swims with a pulsating motion that propels it.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.value: The ooze doesn't require sleep.

traits.name: Putrid Stench
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the corrupting ooze must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The corrupting ooze makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or one nonmagical leather, metal, or wooden item the creature is wearing or carrying is destroyed. This effect can't destroy armor or weapons.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Reshape Body
bonusActions.value: The corrupting ooze can reshape its mass into a vaguely Humanoid shape or back into its amorphous shape. It reverts to its amorphous shape if it dies. While in a Humanoid shape, it can take any action that requires hands, except it can't wield weapons or a shield or don armor.

Corvax lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Corvax cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons

traits.name: Skulker

actions.name: Talons

fluffInfo.value: *Demon of Hunger and Secrets*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Savvy demon hunters bar corvodaemons with warding lines of ash prepared from feathers.

traits.name: Ashen Forbiddance
traits.value: The corvodaemon can't cross a line of ashes created by burning feathers sprinkled with Holy Water.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.value: If the corvodaemon dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Devour Anima
traits.value: A creature the corvodaemon reduced to 0 Hit Points is cursed until it regains any Hit Points. When the cursed creature fails a Death Saving Throw at the start of its turn, it dies regardless of how many failures it has.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The corvodaemon can mimic the voice of any creature it has heard, or of a creature known to one of the creatures within range of its telepathy. A hearer can discern the voices are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The corvodaemon can use Feeding Frenzy if available. It then makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The corvodaemon enters a voracious feeding frenzy, driven by its insatiable hunger for souls. Until the start of its next turn, the corvodaemon's Speed doubles, and when it damages a creature, it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage taken.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Thieves' Cant, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, the assassin can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: The assassin has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.value: During their first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a *surprised* creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.value: Once per turn, the assassin deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage when they hit a target with a weapon attack and have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: The assassin has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in dim light or darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack

In their adult form, their main defense is being inedible to most creatures. Should that fail, cosmoths will defend themselves with their powerful claws.

traits.name: Resting Place
traits.value: When Rhodar drops to 0 hit points and isn't in his resting place, he teleports to his resting place. While in his resting place, Rhodar is stable. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Spear Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: Rhodar is surrounded by three floating spears of shimmering darkness, which he can summon to a free hand on his turn (no action required). When Rhodar fails an ability check or saving throw, he can choose to destroy one of these spears and succeed on the ability check or saving throw instead. Once Rhodar destroys all three spears, he can't use his Spear of the Damned attack or Spear Sacrifice until the next dusk, when he manifests any destroyed spears.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Rhodar makes two Sanguinus attacks, and he can make one Spear of the Damned attack for each Spear Sacrifice use he has remaining.

actions.name: Sanguinus
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, their hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Rhodar regains hit points equal to that number. This reduction lasts until reversed by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.
The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under Rhodar's control.

actions.name: Spear of the Damned
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) force damage, and if the target is a creature, they are knocked prone and restrained as a spear of darkness impales them. A creature can attempt to free themself or another creature within their reach by using an action or a bonus action to make a DC 20 Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a success, the creature is freed and the restrained condition ends for them. The creature is also freed if Rhodar summons that spear to attack another target or destroys it using Spear Sacrifice.

bonusActions.name: Beguile
bonusActions.value: Rhodar targets one creature he can see within 30 feet of him and who can see him. The target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by Rhodar, then either makes a melee attack against a target of Rhodar's choice or falls prone (Rhodar's choice).

bonusActions.name: Inhuman Agility
bonusActions.value: Rhodar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffInfo.value: Found only in the Crater Basin, these massive burrowing monsters have petal-like mouths lined with razor-sharp teeth. Their thick hides of midnight purple are covered in spines and octarine slime. Those who have survived an encounter with one have spoken of the earth shaking moments before the beast emerges from below, devouring helpless victims caught in its path.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Breach
actions.value: The crater wurm utilises its full movement. While doing so, it can enter large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the wurm enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed to the side of the wurm's space. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (**10d6**) bludgeoning damage, and is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone. After finishing its move, the wurm can make one bite attack against a prone target as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (**6d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Contaminated Gullet
actions.value: A creature swallowed by a crater wurm gains one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim) each time it takes acid damage while inside the wurm.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Crater Wurm, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Subterranean Threat
fluffInfo.value: You know it has Tremorsense and that it creates tunnels when digging through rock.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Earth Shaker
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the Crater Wurms' Breach and Bite attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Blunderous Brute
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Crater Wurms' strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Crater Wurms disregard other creatures, viewing them as only morsels to consume. All are as the dust of the earth to it—simply food. These wurms understand that creatures they devour often try to flee. Their favored tactic is to remain buried until their Tremorsense detects movement. They then surface with its Breach action, making Bite attacks, swallowing nearby Prone creatures. They dive beneath the ground once at least one creature is swallowed, or if reduced to half its Hit Point maximum.

fluffInfo.value: The Crimson Countess is a powerful harpy matriarch. Recognizable by her red-feathered wings and deep crimson hair, she is clad in black and gold armour and carries with her a spear that crackles with electrical energies.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I screech blood-curdling war cries and perform aerial stunts as intimidation.
**Ideal**: Any who walk the earth are prey for those who soar the sky.
**Bond**: I collect trophies from my kills to remind my flock who is the mightiest.
**Flaw**: I am aggressively territorial, envious of my rivals, and covetous of my trinkets.

traits.name: Aerial Acrobat
traits.value: On each of her turns, the Crimson Countess can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The Crimson Countess has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Crimson Countess can use her Frightful Screech. She then makes two attacks with her talons or one with her javelin.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frightful Screech
actions.value: Each creature of the Crimson Countess' choice that is within 120 feet of her and not deafened must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the effects of the Crimson Countess' Frightful Screech for the next 24 hours.

While frightened by this effect, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from the Crimson Countess by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to the Crimson Countess, the creature can repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, the effect ends for that creature.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 feet, one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage, plus 14 (**4d6**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Thunder Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Crimson Countess unleashes a thunderous cry in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in the cube must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail this saving throw are pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine Crimson Countess, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Arcane Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Dangerous Talons
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Pluck trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Bold and Nimble
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creatures highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Countess only leaves her clock tower to join in on hunts with her valkyries, but otherwise she prefers the defendable position at the towers highest floor. From here any adventurer who makes it past her soldiers and into her lair can easily be grabbed and thrown off the open balconies, falling to their death.

She is overconfident and will do anything to protect her advantageous position in the city. She only flees if all her minions are dead and she is below 25 Hit Points. If she flees, she will attempt to gather more soldiers and return to reclaim the clock tower at a later date.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Feathers.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Aura of Storms
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Crimson Countess takes 10 (**3d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Pluck
traits.value: The Crimson Countess doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

actions.name: The Crimson Countess always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On their turn, the Crimson Countess can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Crimson Countess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Grasping Talons**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).
**Lightning Javelin**: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Aerial Acrobat
actions.value: The Crimson Countess flies up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Frightful Screech (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 120 feet of the Crimson Countess that can hear them. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). While Frightened, the target must take the Dash action and move away from the Crimson Countess by the safest available route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creatures in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Crimson Countess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Crimson Countess can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Crimson drakes are easy to spot, with scales the color of dried blood, a deadly scorpion stinger, and a mischievous gleam in their eyes.*

*A crimson drake occasionally chooses to serve an evil spellcaster as a familiar. They are too mischievous to be especially loyal or trustworthy, but they are ferocious in defense of their master, feeling as possessive toward the master as other dragons might a piece of a hoard. Such crimson drakes have the following trait.*
***Familiar**: The drake can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a magic, telepathic bond with that willing companion. While the two are bonded, the companion can sense what the drake senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. While the drake is within 10 feet of its companion, the companion shares the drake's Magic Resistance trait. At any time and for any reason, the drake can end its service as a familiar, ending the telepathic bond.*

fluffInfo.name: Fiery Raiders
fluffInfo.value: Crimson drakes lair in woodlands near small settlements, making nighttime forays to set fires and hunt those who flee the flames—traits that make humanoid tribes prize them as raiding partners. Goblins gleefully adopt a crimson drake as a mascot to burn things down while they get on with slaughtering people. Red dragons and flame dragons regard a crimson drake as a pet, at best, but this rarely works out. When it is inevitably insulted by its larger cousins, a malicious crimson drake may intentionally set fires to blaze a trail for hunters to find the dragon's lair.

fluffInfo.name: Mistaken for Pseudodragons
fluffInfo.value: A crimson drake's scales and features are quite similar to those of a pseudodragon, and they can imitate a pseudodragon's hunting cry or song to trick victims into approaching. Once their prey gets close enough, they immolate it. As with pseudodragons, they resemble a red dragon in all but size and the presence of the drake's scorpion-like stinger. On average, a crimson drake weighs 12 pounds, its body measures about 18 inches long, and its tail adds another 18 inches.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crimson drake makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage at the start of each of its turns while poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The drake exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or martial melee weapons gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Crimson Knight, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Elite Spawn
fluffInfo.value: You know the Crimson Knight's damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Unholy Magic
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Crimson Knight can unleash a variety of powerful smites.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Weaknesses
fluffInfo.value: You are aware the vampire's regeneration is temporarily halted by Radiant damage, and its Vampire Weaknesses.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Crimson Knights form units with other minions and thralls of their vampire masters. Several Crimson Knights may form an elite guard, or one might be attached to lead a contingent of vampire thralls.

In battle, Crimson Knights seek out the most formidable melee combatants to meet head on, disarming them with Crackling Smite. They make use of Unholy Smite to prevent their target from healing, and terrorize them using Wrathful Smite.

A Crimson Knight will give their undead existence to defend their master and hold fast even as they are cut down. If they encounter a foe capable of dealing Radiant damage, they make them the target of their attacks to ensure they can continue to regenerate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Crimson Axe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d12 + 4**) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice. *Hit or Miss:* After being thrown, the axe returns to the vampire's hand.

actions.name: Crackling Smite
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Unholy Smite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of the vampire's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wrathful Smite
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Charge
bonusActions.value: The vampire moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, it has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that creature before the end of its turn.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a giant rat (speed 30 ft.), a blood hawk (10 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a giant centipede (30 ft., climb 30 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.value: The imp is immune to the diseases described in the [Bloodmire Diseases](https://5e.tools/tables.html#bloodmire%20diseases_griffonssaddlebag2) table.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The imp has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the imp's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Sting (Bite or Beak in Beast Form)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.

fluffInfo.value: *A beautiful figure made of water and plants steps from the lake and smiles.*
Crinaea are nymph-like water fey that inhabit small bodies of water such as wells and fountains.

fluffInfo.name: Water-bound Fey
fluffInfo.value: Similar to dryads, crinaea are bound to a body of water which becomes their home and focal point. Unlike dryads, crinaea can choose to be bound to a water source and can change which water source they call home. A crinaea must submerge itself in its bound water source every day or suffer. As long as the water source stays pure and the crinaea never travels more than a mile from it, the crinaea can live indefinitely. If its home water source is ever dried up or destroyed, the crinaea quickly fades until it finds a new home or dies.

fluffInfo.name: Friendly but Poisonous
fluffInfo.value: One of the most gregarious fey, the crinaea enjoys long conversations with intelligent creatures. The crinaea is often well-versed in the goings-on around its home and happily shares such information with friendly creatures. It offers its pure water to those in need and those who are polite, but woe be unto those who anger the fey after having tasted its water, as the crinaea can poison any water taken from its home.

traits.name: Crinaea's Curse
traits.value: The crinaea can sense water within 300 feet of it that was drawn from its bonded source within the last 24 hours. As a bonus action, the crinaea can poison up to 1 gallon of water within 300 feet of it that was drawn from its bonded source. This can even affect water that has been used to make another nonmagical substance, such as soup or tea, or water that was consumed within the last 30 minutes. The poison can affect a target through contact or ingestion. A creature subjected to this poison must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (**4d8**) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned.

Water-bound Form. The crinaea is bound to its water source. If the crinaea is separated from its water source for more than 24 hours, the crinaea gains 1 level of exhaustion. It gains an additional level of exhaustion for each day until it bonds with another water source or it dies. The crinaea can bond with a new water source and remove its levels of exhaustion by finishing a long rest while submerged in the new water source.

traits.name: Watery Form
traits.value: While fully immersed in water, the crinaea is invisible and it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Splinter of Crooked Power*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Crooked effigies are bound to the Old Ways, and they recoil from the tools of forging and tinkering—symbols of a growing civilization.

traits.name: Crooked Thorns
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the effigy deals 5 (**1d10**) Psychic damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Old Bindings
traits.value: The effigy takes an extra 10 Force damage if it's hit by an attack roll using Smith's Tools or Tinker's Tools (treat as a Club or Light Hammer).

actions.name: Impale
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two branch arms. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

fluffInfo.value: *Crooked Trickster (Anything stolen or gained by trickery)*

entries: **Skills**: deception +5, history +2, sleight of hand +5, stealth +5

traits.name: Trackless Step
traits.value: The crooked hare leaves no tracks, or it leaves the tracks of a Large or smaller creature of its choice. If it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, it can share the effects of this trait with another creature within 5 feet (no action required).

actions.name: Twisting Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 24 hours. The cursed creature's limbs sporadically twist and move in unnatural ways, giving the creature Disadvantage on attack rolls and on ability checks that rely on Charisma.

fluffInfo.value: *Broken Spirit of Betrayal*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The crooked man can't abide self-sacrifice and withers in its presence.

traits.name: Aversion to Self-Sacrifice
traits.value: The crooked man takes 20 Necrotic damage if he can see a creature willingly take damage or gain a condition in place of someone else, or to someone else's benefit.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The crooked man has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crooked man makes two Crooked Claw attacks, and he can replace one attack with a use of Snap Limb. He can also use __Confusion__ if available.

actions.name: Crooked Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Snap Limb
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, one creature the crooked man is grappling, and that has limbs that can break. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Force damage, and the bones (or equivalent) in one of the target's limbs (crooked man's choice) breaks, causing an appropriate effect below. A broken limb heals in 40 days, or when the creature regains any Hit Points from magic or Regeneration. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Broken Arm
actions.value: Disadvantage on attack rolls. Can't hold anything or manipulate objects with the limb.

actions.name: Broken Leg
actions.value: Speed halved. If the creature takes the Dash action, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Broken Wing
actions.value: Fly Speed reduced to 0.

bonusActions.name: Blinking Teleport
bonusActions.value: The crooked man has the Invisible condition for 1 minute and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. The condition ends immediately after the crooked man deals any damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Fiendish Murder*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: While they might take the form of crows or possess crow bodies, crowstorms are held at bay by drawn images or crafted effigies of crows.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: False Crows
traits.value: The swarm can't enter a space with a drawn or painted image or crafted effigy of a crow. A creature holding such an icon has Advantage on saving throws the swarm forces it to make.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny crow. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Wing Bind
traits.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, any creature (other than a Fiend) with a Fly Speed that starts its turn in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the swarm. *Failure:* The target's Fly Speed is 0 until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Peck
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Piercing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage if the swarm is *Bloodied*. If the target is a creature, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of the swarm's next turn.

actions.name: Cacophony (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the swarm. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Ablaze
traits.value: The crux sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, and they can't benefit from being invisible. A creature who starts their turn grappling or grappled by the crux takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crux makes two Flame Tongue or two Sulfurous Rake attacks.

actions.name: Sulfurous Rake
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

actions.name: Flame Tongue
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d12**) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it ignites.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Fire (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux imbues the power of fire in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Flame Bloom.** The Elemental launches a seed of flame at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. A 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point erupts with fire and burns for 1 minute. Each creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage.

**Smoke Screen.** The Elemental exudes an aura of smoke 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. The smoky area is heavily obscured for all creatures who aren't fire elementals.

bonusActions.name: Flame Jet (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux gains a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of their turn and can move up to their speed.

entries: **Languages**: Aquan, Common, plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

traits.name: Scintillating
traits.value: The crux can't benefit from being invisible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crux makes two Rimeglass Touch attacks, and they can use Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back, if available.

actions.name: Rimeglass Touch
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) cold damage, and the target can't see or hear creatures other than themself and the crux until the start of the crux's next turn.

actions.name: Frosted Reflection
actions.value: The crux reflects the appearance of a specific Medium or Small creature they've seen within the last week. This appearance is illusory and imperfect, showing a frostbitten version of the creature. The illusion lasts until the crux takes thunder damage, uses this action again, or is incapacitated. For the duration, the crux additionally knows any languages that creature knows.

actions.name: It Stares Back (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The crux imposes fragility on a creature within 60 feet of them who is reflected by the crux's Frosted Reflection. If the target can see the crux, the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the crux for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the crux stops reflecting them. While frightened in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target isn't frightened, and they are immune to the It Stares Back of all cruxes for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Ice (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux imbues the power of ice in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Frigid Sheen.** The Elemental gains a mirror sheen that reflects damage for 1 minute. When the Elemental is hit with an attack by a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, the Elemental can use a reaction to reflect the attack. The Elemental is unaffected by the attack, and the attacker must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack's damage and effects are reflected back at the attacker as if the attack originated from the Elemental, turning the attacker into the target. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage, but suffers no other effect.

**Frost Squall.** Frost swirls around the Elemental for 1 minute. For the duration, each non-Elemental creature who starts their turn within 15 feet of the Elemental has their speed reduced to 15 feet unless it is already lower until the end of their turn, and the first time they willingly move before the start of their next turn, they take 10 (**3d6**) cold damage.
**Languages**: Aquan, Common, plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.value: When Vladimir von Drakken consumes the blood of six living creatures of level or challenge rating 10 or higher, he transforms into Reborn Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change. If he is destroyed before he can feed sufficiently, he must begin the process again when he rejuvenates.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Vladimir von Drakken is destroyed in his crypt-starved form, he crumbles into ash and reforms 1d10 days later with all of his Hit Points. His new body appears within his crypt in the Brachenwald. Casting Hallow on the druidic shrine prevents his new body from returning so long as the spell remains in effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**6d6 + 5**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 40 (**10d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid killed by this effect and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Shadow Step (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *This gem-encrusted devil grins with jagged teeth and bares claws as sharp as glass.*

fluffInfo.name: Gem-Coated
fluffInfo.value: Crystalline devils resemble gem-coated humanoids with cruel, twisted faces, jagged teeth, and terrible talons like shards of broken glass. Their feet, however, are soft and bare, allowing them to pad along in silence as they seek a favorable spot to assume gem form.

fluffInfo.name: Winking Jewels
fluffInfo.value: In its treasure form, a crystalline devil resembles a sparkling jewel, glowing with a warm inner light. It seeks to catch the eye of an unwary creature whose mind it might corrupt to greed and murder. If its identity is discovered in gem form, it reassumes its normal form and attacks.

fluffInfo.name: Passed Along
fluffInfo.value: After insinuating themselves into groups, crystalline devils encourage betrayal and murder, then persuade a host to pass on their treasure as atonement for their crimes.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the crystalline devil's darkvision.

traits.name: False Appearance (Gemstone Form Only)
traits.value: While the devil remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary gemstone.

traits.name: Glittering Temptation (Gemstone Form Only)
traits.value: The devil sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, a creature is incapacitated and must move on its turn toward the devil by the safest route, trying to get within 5 feet of the devil to hold it. The charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a success, a creature is also immune to this devil's Glittering Temptation for the next 24 hours. A creature charmed by the devil has disadvantage on the saving throw against Crystalline Spray.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The crystalline devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The devil makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Shard Claw (Fiend Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Crystalline Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The crystalline devil sprays a burst of crystal shards. Each creature within 15 feet of the devil must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (**6d8**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Betraying Carbuncle
bonusActions.value: The crystalline devil magically transforms into a Small or smaller gemstone or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form, except it can't move or speak when in its gemstone form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true from if it dies.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Crystalline Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Light Absorption
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creaturea has Resistance to Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Reflecting Attacks
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Dreg's Refracted Beam attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Prone to Shattering
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Crystalline Dreg is quite literally a glass cannon. It prefers to stay behind other Dregs, blasting its foes with its beam attacks and absorbing any elemental damage to alter its attacks. If an enemy who can deal Bludgeoning damage is present, the Crystalline Dreg will flee from that creature and attempt to kill them from a distance, knowing it is their biggest threat. The Dreg tends to focus on enemies approaching with melee weapons over anyone using elemental damage. If the front line of Dregs that the Crystalline Dreg often uses as shield is gone, or if the Crystalline Dregs are outnumbered and threatened with melee combat, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dreg makes two Refracted Beam attacks.

actions.name: Refracted Beam
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the dreg's next turn. If this attack deals a different damage type due to Refract Elements, it has additional effects:

actions.name: Acid or Fire
actions.value: The target is also Burning (2d6) of the corresponding damage type.

actions.name: Cold
actions.value: The target has the Frozen Condition (DC 13).

actions.name: Lightning
actions.value: The target has the Shocked Condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Heat Consumption
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the Cuddle Bug gains 1 Freeze Point, affecting the creature as detailed below. (The effects of Freeze Points stack.)
A creature can remove all accumulated Freeze Points by taking at least 1 fire damage or finishing a short or long rest.

rows: The creature has a -2 penalty to all attack rolls.
The creature can't add its proficiency bonus to any Dexterity checks or Dexterity saving throws.
The creature suffers one level of Exhaustion. This level of Exhaustion goes away when the creature no longer has any Freeze Points.
The creature's speed is halved, and it can use either an action or a bonus action on each of its turns, not both
At the start of each of the creature's turns while it's not unconscious, it takes 5 cold damages.

actions.name: Drain Heat
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) cold damage, and the Cuddle Bug regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

entries: **Languages**: Understands Infernal but can't speak, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Maggoty Hide
traits.value: A creature attacking the garmr in melee that is adjacent to the garmr is subject to the maggots crawling over its rank fur. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots, taking 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns. An infested target can make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the maggots are burnt away if it takes at least 5 Acid or Fire damage. After the creature successfully saves or the maggots are burnt away, it has Immunity to this trait for 1 hour.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The garmr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The garmr makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Earth Rending Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature in a 20-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only. Unattended objects and structures in the area are not allowed a saving throw, they take double damage, and the howl ignores their damage threshold.

bonusActions.name: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature within 5 feet of the garmr. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots (see Maggoty Hide).

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Cursed Slime
fluffInfo.value: These fearsome looking slimes were once benign, until they became warped and cursed through Lendarick's esoteric experiments.

entries: **Immunities**: acid, poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The cursed slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Cursed
traits.value: Any creature that touches the slime or hits it with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 2 (**1d4**) psychic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The slime can climb difficult surfaces, including vertically and upside down, without making an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Cyclopean Hulk, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Phasing Wink
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Wink Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Burning Eye
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the Hulk's Eye Laser attack.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Strong and Tough
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Hulk's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: It uses its Eye Laser to disintegrate enemies into a fine delerium dust. The Cyclopean Hulk focuses its power on blasting enemies from afar or slamming them into the ground if they get close. It will then Wink out of existence, reappearing every few seconds to deliver a devastating blast from its eye before vanishing again. Cyclopean Hulks usually fight to the end, and rarely flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with its Eye Laser.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eye Laser
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Force damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into a pile of fine delerium dust.

bonusActions.name: Wink (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: The hulk vanishes from the Material Plane and is transported to the Space Between Worlds. At the start of its next turn, it returns to an unoccupied space of its choice within 10 feet of the space it vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near).

fluffInfo.name: Storm Worship
fluffInfo.value: Their fellow __cyclopes__ may assume that the might of a stormcaller is akin to godliness, but many stormcallers hunger for greater power. A cabal of stormcallers regularly gathers in the Daggerbay Mountains at an ancient elven temple called the Skyneedle (in Elvish, ira'fallai; in Giant, "Tall Zappo-Zappo"). There, they conduct strange rituals to commune with an entity they call the Eye of the Storm—and with every ritual, their power grows.

However, the Eye of the Storm is no avatar of the __The Stormlord__, but a vengeful __storm giant__ named Eyvindr, who's posing as a demigod and intent on raising an army to exact retribution on the Council of Seven Scepters. He'll have to risk revealing himself to the stormcallers eventually—but not until he believes that his control over his cyclops devotees is absolute.

entries: **AC**: 18 (Chain Mail, Cloak Of Protection And Ring Of Protection)

traits.name: One-Eyed
traits.value: The cyclops has Advantage and Disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Storm Wings
traits.value: While outdoors in stormy conditions, the cyclops has a flying speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Supernatural Focus
traits.value: The cyclops has Advantage and Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain *concentration* on spells, and cannot lose *concentration* because of turbulent weather.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cyclops makes two ice claw attacks.

actions.name: Ice Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**3d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) cold damage.

traits.name: Ooze Ancestry
traits.value: The cyglops doesn't need to breathe. The cyglops doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The cyglops has advantage on saving throws against disease.

traits.name: Poor Depth Perception
traits.value: The cyglops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cyglops makes two pseudopod attacks and uses its eye ray, if recharged. The eye ray can be replaced by its Release Skeletons action.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (**2d10**) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet from the cyglops and knocked prone.

actions.name: Eye Ray (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**6d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Release Skeletons
actions.value: The cyglops ejects 1d3 sets of skeletal remains from inside itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 10 feet of it, losing 4 (1d8) hit points for each one. The remains then animate, each becoming a skeleton loyal to the cyglops. Each skeleton remains for up to 1 hour, or until the cyglops reabsorbs it as an action. All skeletons created this way share one turn in combat, which takes place immediately following the cyglops in initiative.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: Dagon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.value: If Dagon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: One With the Sea
traits.value: When Dagon drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a swirling body of water. At the start of each of Dagon's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum Hit Points return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost Hit Points. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.

If Dagon is the target of a __Banishment__ spell cast with a 9th-level spell slot while in this cloud form, it automatically fails its saving throw and is instead sent to the deepest corner of the ocean where it slumbers for 6d10 years.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: Dagon deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Spectral Waves
traits.value: Storm-tossed waves formed of magical force swirl around Dagon in a 120-foot Emanation originating from him. Creatures without a Swim Speed treat this area as Difficult Terrain and take 10 Force damage if they end their turn in this area. Flying creatures that end their turn in this area must make DC 24 Strength saving throws, gaining the Prone condition on a failed save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Dagon makes four Slashing Claw attacks.

actions.name: Slashing Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Dagon and gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Hungry Tide (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 24, creatures of Dagon's choice within 120 ft. of it; *First Failure:* The target takes 11 (**2d10**) Force damage, and gains the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. *Second Failure:* The target takes 4d20 (22) Force damage its Speed is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased until it uses an action to make a successful DC 24 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

entries: **Languages**: understands Druidic and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Dancing Flowers
traits.value: The dancing lady has three spinning flowers resembling life-sized dancing Humanoids. Each flower has AC 16, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to psychic damage. Attack rolls against these whirling blooms have disadvantage. Destroying a flower deals no damage to the dancing lady, who regrows destroyed flowers at the end of their turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dancing lady makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blood-Red Waltz
actions.value: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw as a dancing flower sweeps toward them. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (**4d8**) psychic damage and is moved to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the dancing lady. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved.

actions.name: Disarming Quickstep
actions.value: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw as a dancing flower whirls them into a dance. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (**5d6**) bludgeoning damage and is dazed until the start of the dancing lady's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

actions.name: Ballet of Terror (1/Day)
actions.value: The dancing lady's flowers pirouette and emit acrid mist. Enemies within 120 feet of the dancing lady who can smell the mist must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened of the dancing lady for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Intelligence gleams in the eyes of the well-dressed ghoul. It smiles a greeting, barely revealing sharp teeth.*

*Spread mainly through bite wounds, this disease makes itself known within 24 hours by swiftly debilitating the infected. An infected creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw after every long rest. On a failed save, the victim takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the victim finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The victim recovers from the disease by making two consecutive successful saving throws. Greater restoration cures the disease, while lesser restoration gives the victim advantage on the next saving throw. Primarily spread among Humanoids, the disease can affect ogres, and therefore other Giants may be susceptible. If a creature dies while infected with darakhul fever, roll a d20, add the character's Constitution modifier, and find the result on the Adjustment Table below to determine what Undead form the victim's body rises in.*

fluffInfo.name: Imperial Cunning
fluffInfo.value: In the lightless depths, an empire of devouring ambition grows and plots and dreams. They call themselves the People, but the people of the surface world call them the Lords Subterranean, the Ghoul Imperium, or simply the Empire of the Ghouls. To them, if you are not a member of the People, you are food.

traits.name: Hungry Dead Nature
traits.value: The darakhul requires no air or sleep.

traits.name: Master of Disguise
traits.value: A darakhul in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) checks made to pass as a living creature. While using this ability, it loses its Stench.

traits.name: Stench
traits.value: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the darakhul must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the darakhul's Stench for the next 24 hours. A darakhul using this ability can't also benefit from Master of Disguise.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the darakhul has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The darakhul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The darakhul makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one War Pick attack. If the darakhul is using a shield, it instead makes one Bite attack and one Claw or War Pick attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage, and, if the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an Undead, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a Humanoid is paralyzed for more than 2 rounds, it contracts darakhul fever.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This proud and commanding darakhul meets every threat with a steely gaze and a blade crackling with necrotic power.*

fluffInfo.name: Imperial Authority
fluffInfo.value: All darakhul and ghouls automatically acknowledge the commanding presence of a general but may not automatically obey depending on the relationship between them.

fluffInfo.name: Hungry Dead Nature
fluffInfo.value: Darakhul generals don't require air or sleep.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.value: If the darakhul fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Master of Disguise
traits.value: A darakhul in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) checks made to pass as a living creature. While using this ability, the darakhul loses their Stench.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The darakhul's weapon attacks are magical. When the darakhul hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **5d6** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Stench
traits.value: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the darakhul must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the darakhul's Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the darakhul has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The darakhul and any ghouls within 60 feet of the darakhul have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The darakhul uses Targeting Directive and makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a humanoid, they must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a humanoid is paralyzed for more than 2 rounds, it contracts darakhul fever.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (**5d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Tactical Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The darakhul barks out an order. Up to five allied ghouls within 120 feet that can hear the darakhul can use their reactions to each make one weapon attack.

actions.name: Targeting Directive
actions.value: One of the darakhul's allies within 60 feet that can hear the directive deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage to creatures it hits with a weapon attack until the beginning of the darakhul's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Dark Confessor, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unnatural Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Dark Confessor's damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Deadly Response
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Dark Confessor's Bloody Rebuke Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weaknesses
fluffInfo.value: You are aware the vampire's Regeneration is temporarily halted by Radiant damage, and its Vampire Weaknesses.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: In the first round of combat, the Dark Confessor casts __Spirit Guardians__. It uses its Claws to attack anyone who comes within its melee reach. The Dark Confessor then proceeds to attack with its Spiritual Maul.
If there are enemies grouped close to one another, the Dark
Confessor uses Unholy Light on them.
The Dark Confessor flees if it is below 50 Hit Points or takes steady Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.
