actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Foul Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Fiendish Presence
bonusActions.value: The gargoyle activates or deactivates an aura of supernatural malevolence. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, creatures that start their turn within 15 feet of the gargoyle while the aura is active and can see it. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature has Immunity to the gargoyle's Fiendish Presence trait for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Demonglass Warriors
fluffInfo.value: The demonglass found on the Western Frontier is the solidified essence of the overlord Tol Kharash and his lesser fiends. Cults of the Horned King—notably, the denizens of Turakbar's Fist—often embed small shards of demonglass within the cult's warriors. This serves as a minor form of possession, compelling the warriors to serve the Horned King while simultaneously weakening their ability to resist his fiendish minions. The basic abilities granted by embedded demonglass are presented in the Demonglass Warrior template, while other potential powers are described in the Demonglass Champion sidebar.

Removing an embedded demonglass shard from a creature is a risky proposition, typically killing the host. Removing a shard safely requires the host to either be a willing participant, Restrained, or Unconscious. A Remove Curse or __Greater Restoration__ spell cast on the host breaks the possession and allows the shard to be removed. The actual physical removal requires a sharp tool and a Wisdom (*Medicine*) check with a DC of 15; if the check fails, the shard is still removed, but the host suffers 15 points of Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Demonglass Warrior Template
fluffInfo.value: Beasts, Humanoids, Giants, and Monstrosities can all become demonglass warriors if embedded with a demonglass shard. When a creature becomes a demonglass warrior, it retains its statistics except as described below.

fluffInfo.name: Skill Proficiency:
fluffInfo.value: *Intimidation*. The demonglass warrior can add its Proficiency Bonus to Charisma (*Intimidation*) checks.

fluffInfo.name: Senses
fluffInfo.value: The demonglass warrior gains Darkvision with a radius of 60 feet.

fluffInfo.name: Languages
fluffInfo.value: If its Intelligence score is at least 3, the demonglass warrior can speak Infernal in addition to any other languages it knows.

fluffInfo.name: New Trait:
fluffInfo.value: Tool of the Horned King. A demonglass warrior has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells and other magical effects cast by Fiends.

fluffInfo.name: New Trait:
fluffInfo.value: Witness Tyranny. The demonglass warrior gains Temporary Hit Points equal to its Proficiency Bonus when a creature within 5 feet of it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

traits.name: Tool of the Horned King
traits.value: The demonglass goblin has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells and other magical effects cast by Fiends.

traits.name: Witness Tyranny
traits.value: The demonglass goblin gains 2 Temporary Hit Points when a creature within 5 feet of it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Shortbow

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.value: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *This creature resembles a blue-skinned dwarven infant, no older than a year. Its limbs flail, its head lolls with an obvious lack of coordination, and it screams incessantly.*

Of the madness and insanity that resonates so strongly in derro society, perhaps none is as twisted as the derro fetal savant, born insane by the blessing of their eldritch masters and destined to lead their people further into madness.

fluffInfo.name: Soul Swapping
fluffInfo.value: Only the rarest of derro are born with the ability to exchange souls with other creatures, and the babbling infants are treated with maddened reverence. Oddly, this unique power causes an extreme sensitivity to bright light.

fluffInfo.name: Carried into Battle
fluffInfo.value: Placed in small, pillowed cages and borne aloft on hooked staves, the wild-eyed, magically gifted newborns are used to sow confusion among enemy ranks. Though typically carried into battle, fetal savants can make their cages float, freeing their carriers to better defend them when necessary.

traits.name: Enchanted Cage
traits.value: The savant is immune to damage and can't be the target of spells or effects as long as its cage exists. The cage has a flying speed of 30 feet while the savant is inside of it, moving at the mental command of the savant. When the cage is destroyed, the savant floats gently to the ground. The cage has AC 19, 75 hp, and is immune to piercing, poison, and psychic damage. A non-derro that touches the cage or hits it with a melee weapon attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn. The cage disintegrates if exposed to sunlight for 1 hour.

traits.name: Maddening Babble
traits.value: The savant constantly babbles eldritch nonsense while it can see any non-derro creatures and isn't incapacitated. Each non-derro creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the savant and can hear the babbling must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.value: The savant takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn outside the cage and in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The fetal savant makes two Psychic Burst attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Soul Exchange (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The savant exchanges its soul with one Humanoid it can see within 20 feet of it. Its body becomes paralyzed, the target's soul inhabits the savant's paralyzed body, and the savant inhabits the target's body, taking full control of it. The savant retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, its Psychic Burst action, and its immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The exchange lasts until the target's body or the savant's body is reduced to 0 hp, the savant ends it as a bonus action, or the savant is forced out by an effect like the __dispel evil and good__ spell. When the exchange ends, the target returns to its body, regaining control, and the savant's soul returns to its body, which is no longer paralyzed. The target is immune to this savant's Soul Exchange for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the exchange ends.

fluffInfo.value: *This blue-skinned creature resembles a stunted dwarf. Its colorless eyes are large, and its white hair is wild. The expression on its face is a terrible rictus of madness and hate*.

All derro are mad, but some devote their very souls to the service of insanity. They embrace the powers of darkness and channel shadow through their minds to break the sanity of any creatures they encounter. Derro shadow antipaladins are the elite servants of gods like Nyarlathotep and the Black Goat of the Woods.

fluffInfo.name: Herald of Madness
fluffInfo.value: The shadow antipaladin is insanity personified. Despite being called paladins, these unhinged creatures aren't swaggering warriors encased in steel or their dark reflections. A shadow antipaladin instead serves as a more subtle vector for the madness of its patron. They are masters of shadow magic and stealth who attack the faith of those who believe that goodness can survive the approaching, dark apotheosis. Death, madness, and darkness spread in the shadow antipaladin's wake.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the shadow antipaladin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the antipaladin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Insanity
traits.value: The shadow antipaladin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The shadow antipaladin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The shadow antipaladin's weapon attacks are magical. When the antipaladin hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the shadow antipaladin has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The derro makes two Scimitar or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Infectious Insanity (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The shadow antipaladin magically assaults the minds of up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute as its mind fills with thoughts of eldritch terrors and otherworldly entities. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Sand Step
actions.value: The desert cat teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that contains dirt, sand, or other fine earth.

fluffInfo.value: *The towering woman rises up from the desert sand. Her pale brown robe almost perfectly matches the gritty terrain, and her roughly textured skin is a rich walnut brown.*

fluffInfo.name: Arid Adapters
fluffInfo.value: Desert giants live in arid wastelands that were once a thriving giant empire. Their rich brown skin is rough-textured, and they dress in light robes matching the color of the sand, accented (when they aren't trying to blend in) with brightly colored head cloths and sashes. Beneath their robes, the desert giants paint or tattoo their skin with intricate designs in a riot of colors that outsiders rarely see.

fluffInfo.name: Wandering Legacy
fluffInfo.value: Desert giants subsist in the scorching wastes by moving from oasis to oasis. They follow herds of desert animals that they cultivate for milk, meat, and hides, and they shun most contact with settled people. While in ages past the desert giants lived in stationary settlements and cities, the fall of their ancient empire drove them into the dunes. The truth behind their nomadic lifestyle is a sore spot. Should any outsider learn the truth, the desert giants stop at nothing to permanently silence the inquisitive soul.

fluffInfo.name: Keepers of the Past
fluffInfo.value: Over time, wandering desert giants amass vast knowledge of ruins and relics scattered across and beneath their homeland. On rare occasions that the tribes require something of outsiders, this information is their most valuable commodity. Relics of the past, or simply the location of unplundered ruins, can purchase great advantage for the tribe. The designs the giants painstakingly inscribe on their bodies tell a tale that, if woven together correctly, reveals an entire tribe's collected discoveries. For this reason, the desert giants hold the bodies of their dead in sacred esteem. They go to extraordinary lengths to recover their dead, so they can divide the knowledge held on the deceased's skin among other tribe members.

actions.value: As a bonus action, the retainer grants an infernal blessing to an ally they can see within 60 feet of them. The next time that ally makes an attack roll before the start of the retainer's next turn, the ally adds a +PB bonus to the roll. If the attack hits, it deals an extra **PB** damage.

actions.name: 7th Level: Hellbitten Knives (1/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the retainer imbues their daggers with hellfire. For 1 minute, their signature attack deals an extra **PB** fire damage and ignores damage resistances.

entries: **HP**: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: deception +2 plus PB, persuasion +2 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* **2d4 + PB** piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the retainer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Misleading Strike (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the retainer makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target must use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a creature of the retainer's choice.

actions.name: 5th Level: Adjuration (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the retainer grants an infernal blessing to an ally they can see within 60 feet of them. The next time that ally makes an attack roll before the start of the retainer's next turn, the ally adds a +PB bonus to the roll. If the attack hits, it deals an extra **PB** damage.

actions.name: 7th Level: Hellbitten Knives (1/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the retainer imbues their daggers with hellfire. For 1 minute, their signature attack deals an extra **PB** fire damage and ignores damage resistances.

fluffInfo.value: *Five-Fingered Fungus (Rare wood chips)*

traits.name: Scent of Death
traits.value: Creatures that can smell have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made to find the devil's glove.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The devil's glove can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage, and the devil's glove attaches to the target. While attached, the devil's glove can't make Tendril attacks against other targets, and if the target is a creature, the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn if it can smell the devil's glove.
The devil's glove can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the devil's glove as an action.

actions.name: Decaying Bloom (2/Day)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the devil's glove. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of the devil's glove's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Symbiosis
bonusActions.value: The devil's glove forms a magical bond with a willing creature it touches. The bonded creature doesn't need to eat or drink, and the creature has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. The bond ends when the creature dies, the devil's glove dies, the devil's glove ends the bond (no action required), or when the devil's glove uses this Bonus Action again.

fluffInfo.value: The devilbound gnome is a gnome spellcaster that has made a magical agreement with a devil for greater power. To ensure loyalty and to further the gnome's power, the devil binds an imp to the gnome's service. This binding changes the gnome, giving it fiendish protections and minor fiendish features, such as glowing eyes, a sulfurous aroma, a forked tongue, or similar. Beyond fulfilling the occasional demand, the devil cares little for what the gnome does with the power, provided the flow of souls doesn't cease.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Infernal Blessing
traits.value: While the devilbound gnome is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above) and saving throws. In addition, magical darkness doesn't impede the gnome's darkvision.

traits.name: Infernal Bond
traits.value: The devilbound gnome is magically bound to an imp. The imp acts as an ally of the gnome's, obeying its spoken commands. The gnome can perceive through the imp's senses, speak through its mouth, and communicate with it telepathically even if the two aren't on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The devilbound gnome has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The devilbound gnome makes three Hellish Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Hellish Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) fire damage plus 9 (**2d8**) poison damage.

actions.name: Hell's Servitors (1/Day)
actions.value: The devilbound gnome magically calls 1d4 devils with a challenge rating of 4 or lower, or it calls 1 devil with a challenge rating of 6 or lower. The called Fiends arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the gnome and obeying its spoken commands. The Fiends remain for 1 hour, until the gnome dies, or until the gnome dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: To Hell and Back (1/Day)
actions.value: The devilbound gnome sends one creature it can see within 60 feet of it hurling through Hell. The target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the target takes 35 (**10d6**) fire damage as Hell pulls on the creature. On a failure, the target is incapacitated and disappears, as it takes a quick trip through the nightmarish landscapes of Hell. At the end of the gnome's next turn, the target reappears in the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space, and takes 55 (**10d10**) psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Digipede, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Charged Form
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Resistance to Lightning damage and that it has Tremorsense thanks to its large antenna.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Sharp and Shocking
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Digipede's Talons and Eye Beam actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Insectile Predator
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Despite its size, a Digipede will try to hide along rooftops, dark corners, narrow alleys, and any crevice which can accommodate it. It launches its Eye Beam from hiding to hinder its prey's escape, then rips into them with its Talons and Bite. The electric shocks from its attacks disrupt the ability of its prey to effectively fight back.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Carapace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The digipede makes one Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Lightning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Shocked condition until the end of the digipede's next turn.

actions.name: Eye Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Slowed condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the Immobilized condition. *Third Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Dimensional Attunement
traits.value: A dimensional shambler gains 1 Dimension Point at the end of its turn during combat or when it is otherwise threatened. It begins an encounter with 0 points and can have up to 4.

traits.name: Dimensional Warping
traits.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, if a creature within 30 feet of the dimensional shambler attempts to teleport. *Failure:* The creature doesn't teleport. *Success* The creature teleports as normal.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The dimensional shambler has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dimensional shambler makes up to four Dimensional Claw attacks and uses Disdainful Banishment. It can't attack the same creature more than twice with Dimensional Claw when it uses Multiattack.

actions.name: Dimensional Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, Reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 5**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). It can Grapple up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

actions.name: Disdainful Banishment
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature Grappled by the dimensional shambler. *Failure:* The target is teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dimensional shambler can see.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Flurry
bonusActions.value: A dimensional shambler can spend 3 Dimension Points to gain an extra use of Legendary Action. It must use the additional use before its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Rend
bonusActions.value: A dimensional shambler can spend 1 Dimension Point to extend its claws through space and time, increasing its Reach with Dimensional Claw to 30 feet and allowing it to ignore all cover with those attacks until the end of its turn.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Step
bonusActions.value: A dimensional shambler can spend 3 Dimension Points to teleport itself and all creatures it has Grappled to a chosen destination it has visited within the past month.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The dimensional shambler teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fluffInfo.value: *Jovial Cauldron Helper (Spices and rose quartz)*

traits.name: Boil and Bubble
traits.value: While the dingpot doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, it can provide enough heat to boil water within its vessel.

actions.name: Steam Spray
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) Fire damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the dingpot's next turn. Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

actions.name: Brew (1/Day)
actions.value: The dingpot produces a magical elixir within its vessel. The elixir remains potent for 24 hours. It can choose from the following brews:

actions.name: Healing Draught
actions.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature can drink the elixir to regain 4 (1d6 + 1) Hit Points.

actions.name: Lucky Draught
actions.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature can drink the elixir to gain startling luck for 10 minutes. When the creature fails an ability check or a saving throw, it can reroll the d20 and use the new roll. Once this causes a roll to succeed, the effects of the elixir end early.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Diorite makes 3 Eldritch Bolt attacks. Up to three of these attacks can be replaced by Stone to Flesh. She also makes one Sculptor's Claws attack.

actions.name: Sculptor's Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Restrained condition. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save. If the target fails a saving throw against this ability while it has the Restrained condition, it instead has the Petrified condition. It can continue to make saving throws at the end of each of its turns, ending the petrification on a successful save.

actions.name: Eldritch Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Force damage.

actions.name: Stone to Flesh
actions.value: Diorite ends the Petrified condition on one creature she touches. Diorite regains 16 (3d10) Hit Points and the newly un-Petrified creature has the Charmed condition for 10 minutes.

fluffInfo.value: *Except for a pair of tiny fangs, the entire body of this yellowish-green worm looks like a ropy tangle of slime-covered tubes and puddles of mucus.*

fluffInfo.name: Anesthetic Ooze
fluffInfo.value: Many jungle clans believe the dipsa is an eyeless snake, but it is a tubular ooze with a lethal, poisonous bite. The dipsa's venom has an anesthetic quality that allows the ooze to cling to creatures and slowly turn their innards to jelly without being noticed until the victim falls down dead. Once the poison's numbing property wears off, however, victims report an agonizing sense of burning from the inside out.

fluffInfo.name: Tiny Fangs
fluffInfo.value: A dipsa's undulating movement evokes that of a snake as much as its serpentine form, but close examination reveals that it has neither bones nor internal organs, only tiny fangs of the same color and substance as the rest of its body. A dipsa never exceeds 1 foot in length. Its coloration oscillates between sickly hues of yellow or green.

fluffInfo.name: Gelatinous Eggs
fluffInfo.value: Dipsas are hermaphroditic. When two dipsas breed, they leave behind a hundred gelatinous eggs in a small puddle of highly acidic milt. A dozen become fertilized and survive long enough to hatch, after which they immediately devour the others.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The dipsa can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Discreet Bite
traits.value: The bite of a dipsa is barely perceptible and the wound is quickly anesthetized. When the dipsa hits with a Bite attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (*Perception*) check to notice the dipsa and its attack. Each time the creature takes acid damage from an attached dipsa, it can repeat this check, noticing the dipsa on a success. A creature that takes acid damage from the dipsa while below half its hp maximum automatically succeeds on this check.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.value: The dipsa doesn't require sleep.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.value: The dipsa has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and the dipsa attaches to the target. While attached, the dipsa can't attack, and at the start of each of the dipsa's turns, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have its hp maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

The attached dipsa moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the dipsa's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the dipsa.

bonusActions.name: Translucent
bonusActions.value: The dipsa takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Exceptional Vision
traits.value: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bird makes two attacks using Heavy Beak, Rending Talons, or both.

actions.name: Heavy Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is dazed until the start of the bird's next turn.

actions.name: Rending Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13). While grappling a target, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. Each time the target makes a check to end the grapple, the target takes 4 (**1d8**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Crushing Grip
actions.value: The bird's powerful talons crush a grappled target. The target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, taking 17 (**5d6**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the save by 5 or more, they are also dazed until the end of their next turn.

bonusActions.name: Spot
bonusActions.value: The bird makes a Wisdom (*Perception*) check.

traits.name: Bonemonger
traits.value: Whenever the dire bunny first sees a bone, it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted until it possesses the bone or the bone is no longer in its line of sight. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get closer to the bone and sequester it. A distracted dire bunny whose owner issues a command to it repeats the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of any bone for the next hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Detect Thoughts (1/Day)
actions.value: The dire bunny learns the surface thoughts of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it for 1 minute. It can attempt to probe deeper into the creature's mind, using an action to force the target to make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, per the __detect thoughts__ spell.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, fire, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

traits.name: Anguish Unleashed
traits.value: When the mournling dies, the sadness they contain is released into the world. Each creature within 30 feet of the mournling who can hear them must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 (**4d10**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The mournling is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Puddle of Mud
traits.value: When the mournling leaves a space, the ground in that space becomes difficult terrain for their enemies for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mournling makes three attacks using Slam, Mudslide, or both, and they can use Dust Storm, if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**4d10 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Mudslide
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target and each Huge or smaller creature of the mournling's choice within 5 feet of the target are pulled up to 30 feet toward the mournling.

actions.name: Dust Storm (1/Day)
actions.value: The mournling hurls dirt, gravel, and sand. Each creature within 60 feet of them must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.name: Break and Reform
bonusActions.value: The mournling teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of them.

fluffInfo.value: In ancient times, the Mirescar was called the Heartwood. It was the domain of a wise and kindly __guardian naga__ named __Sagacitous Erusaire__, who welcomed all with good hearts to share their bounty or receive alms. However, this __naga__ has been corrupted into a cruel shadow of his former self. He and his __diseased grick__ minions have been twisted into hideous, pus-oozing spreaders of disease—and spreading it is now the only thought in their minds. The __naga__ can cast __contagion__ at will, and his __diseased grick__ minions can do so once per day. Is it possible to save the mind of this corrupted guardian?
(See A Sickness Spreads for more information on this NPC.)

The wormlike grick waits unseen, blending in with the rock of the caves and caverns it haunts. Only when prey comes near does it rear up, its four barbed tentacles unfurling to reveal its hungry, snapping beak.

fluffInfo.name: Passive Predators
fluffInfo.value: Gricks rarely hunt. Instead, they drag their rubbery bodies to places where creatures regularly pass, lurking out of sight amid rocky rubble and debris, squeezing into burrows, holes, or crevices, climbing up to ledges, or coiling around stalactites to drop on unwary prey. A grick consumes virtually anything that moves except for other gricks. It targets the nearest prey, grabbing a fallen creature with its tentacles and dragging it off to eat alone.

fluffInfo.name: Roving Ambushers
fluffInfo.value: Gricks remain in an area until the food supply dwindles, often because sentient creatures become aware of their presence and plot alternate routes around their lairs. When prey is scarce in the Underdark, gricks venture aboveground to hunt in the wilderness, lurking in trees or on cliff-side ledges. A grick pack is often led by a single well-fed, oversized alpha around which the others congregate.

fluffInfo.name: Spoils of Slaughter
fluffInfo.value: Over time, grick lairs accumulate the cast-off possessions of intelligent prey, and expert guides know to look out for these tell-tale signs. Underdark explorers sometimes seal off the routes leading to and from a grick lair to starve them, then claim the wealth of the foul creatures' victims.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.value: The grick has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the grick can make one beak attack against the same target.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: An __Alienist__ looking to permanently control the mind of their victim may opt to remove the brain altogether, killing the patient and resurrecting the mind as its own sentient entity. Somewhere within this process the brain loses its sense of self and any connection it had to the former body it held, becoming an organism made up entirely of electrical synapses and controlled thoughts. The Disembodied Psyche is then subject to several arduous experiments to heighten its fortitude and mental capabilities, giving the creature forms of telepathy and telekinesis.

The now-undead form of this controlled consciousness can be unleashed upon the foes of the alienist and even take over the bodies of other victims, putting them in a controlled and obedient state for the alienist to perform even more mental experiments on, or use as a puppet against their enemies.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Disembodied Psyche, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unnatural Immaterial Form
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Telepathic Energy
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Hypnotize and Mental Possession actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Incorporeal Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's AC, Hit Points, and Strength ability score.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Disembodied Psyche begins any combat by getting into a position where it can hit as many creatures as possible with its Hypnotize before attempting to mentally possess a target. If it is in a dangerous situation, such as being surrounded or cornered, it uses Teleport to move to a more advantageous position.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Ectoplasm.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Brain.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

entries: **Immunities**: psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The psyche can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The psyche makes two Electroshock attacks. It can also use Hypnotize, if available.

actions.name: Electroshock
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Lightning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition until the end of the psyche's next turn.

actions.name: Hypnotize (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature of the psyche's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the psyche. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). While Incapacitated, the target has the Immobilized condition.

actions.name: Mental Possession
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the psyche can see within 5 feet. *Success* The target is immune to this psyche's Mental Possession for 24 hours. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the psyche; the psyche disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The psyche now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The psyche can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The psyche's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the psyche leaves as a Bonus Action. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. When the possession ends, the psyche appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this psyche's Mental Possession for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The psyche teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Displacer Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Multiplanar Existence
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Dreg's Displacement trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Teleporting Attack

fluffInfo.value: The Displacer Dreg is a difficult creature to pin down. It uses its Talons to fend off attackers while Teleporting itself to safety if it thinks it is in a losing situation or to gain a more advantageous position.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.value: Attack rolls against the dreg have Disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack roll, this trait does not apply until the end of its next turn. This trait does not apply while the dreg has the Incapacitated condition or has a Speed of 0.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: The dreg teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This twisted humanoid has gray flesh and black claws that drip blood. A bone mask is bound to its head by strips of putrid flesh, and a third arm hangs from the right side of the creature's body, its hand clutching a large sack stained with blood.*

*The dissimortuum's mask is nigh indestructible. When the creature is destroyed, its mask usually survives and breaks free. On its own, the object emits a faint magical aura with mixed enchantment and necromantic properties. It is a tempting souvenir, but any humanoid or giant foolish enough to don the mask is immediately wracked by pain and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become dominated by the mask. The domination arrives slowly. The creature acts normally for a day or two, but then the creature notices periods of time that cannot be accounted for. During these unremembered times, the creature gathers the grisly components needed to build a new body for the dissimortuum. This process takes a week, after which the creature is freed from domination as the dissimortuum arises anew and dons its mask once more.*

fluffInfo.name: Plague Bringers
fluffInfo.value: Dissimortuum are undead monstrosities constructed by necromancers to spread the undead plague, slowly but surely. These creatures are rare but tenacious. A dissimortuum obeys orders from the necromancer whose magic created it. When a dissimortuum kills, it collects body parts from its victims and keeps them in a sack that it carries with its third arm at all times. The monster sets down its sack of trophies only when pressed in combat, to make the most of its extra limb.

fluffInfo.name: Constructing Dissimortuum
fluffInfo.value: Even when not following instructions, a dissimortuum seeks to create more of its own kind. The creature wanders graveyards, battlefields, and slums, searching for the gruesome components it needs to construct a mask and body for its undead offspring. The process is slow, taking up to a month to make a single mask, but a dissimortuum has plenty of time. The new creation is independent and not under the control of its maker or of the necromancer that might have created its maker.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The dissimortuum can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The dissimortuum doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dissimortuum makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one Claw attack with a use of Terrifying Mask.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d8 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Mask
actions.value: Each non-Undead creature within 60 feet of the dissimortuum that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target becomes immune to the dissimortuum's Terrifying Mask for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The surgeon regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Poison damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The surgeon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Veiled Ignorance
traits.value: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under the effect of a __Mind Blank__ or __Nondetection__ spell, has the Invisible condition toward the surgeon (this ignores the surgeon's Blindsight).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The surgeon makes two Bone Saw attacks.

actions.name: Bone Saw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage.
Critical *Hit:* If the target is a creature, its Intelligence score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0.

actions.name: Infested Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The surgeon unleashes a spray of worm-ridden cerebral fluid. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Psychic damage, and the target is infested with larval parasitic worms. The target takes 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns as the worms burrow toward its brain. The ongoing damage ends when the target takes Poison damage or is targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this Psychic damage, the worms reach its brain and it dies. A Humanoid slain in this way rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to four resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze uses Engulf and makes two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 13 (**2d12**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 26 (**4d12**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 17 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d12):
1. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) force damage.
2. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) fire damage.
6. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) cold damage.
7. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) radiant damage.
11. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) poison damage.
12. The target takes 6 (**1d12**) psychic damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This mole-like creature is the size of a large dog, with a thick, barrel-shaped body. A ring of tentacles sprouts above a mouth dominated by spade-like incisors, and cataracts fill its tiny eyes.*

fluffInfo.name: Domesticated by Dwarves
fluffInfo.value: Mountain dwarves have domesticated many subterranean creatures, among them a breed of giant talpidae commonly called dogmoles. Energetic and obedient, dogmoles pull ore trolleys through mines, sniff out toxic gases and polluted waters, and help excavate trapped miners.

fluffInfo.name: Sense Cave-Ins
fluffInfo.value: Dogmoles are renowned for their ability to detect imminent cave-ins and burrowing monsters, making them welcome companions in the depths. Outside the mines, dogmoles serve as pack animals, guard beasts, and bloodhounds.

fluffInfo.name: Derro Juggernauts
fluffInfo.value: Derro also use dogmoles, but such unfortunate creatures are brutalized from birth and hardened by scarification, drugs, and warping magic. This treatment forces the dogmole to grow into a large, furless mass of muscle, scar tissue, and barbed piercings with incisors the size of shortswords. Derro use dogmole juggernauts as mounts and improvised siege engines or, when not at war, as gladiatorial contestants.

traits.name: Burrowed Tunnels
traits.value: If the dogmole burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dogmole makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.value: If the dolguul is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Strength or Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, the dolguul instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

actions.value: The dolguul makes one Hook attack and one Cleaver attack.

actions.name: Hook
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet towards the dolguul.

actions.name: Cleaver
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target begins bleeding. While bleeding, a creature takes 2 (1d4) points of Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The bleeding ends after 1 minute, if the creature regains at least 1 Hit Point, if a creature within 5 feet of the bleeding creature uses a Utilize action to expend a use of a Healer's Kit, or if a creature within 5 feet of the bleeding creature makes a successful DC 12 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. While grappling in this way, the dolguul can't use its Bite attack on another target.

bonusActions.name: Into the Meat Grinder
bonusActions.value: If the dolguul hits with both a Hook attack and a Cleaver attack in the same turn, it makes a Bite attack.

fluffInfo.value: *The creature resembles a large, stony goblin, with an oversized head and leering grin. It has a mossy beard, massive shoulders, and long forearms.*

*The domovoi are ancient survivors, and they have outlived empires. They now have a certain sense of ownership of ancient places. They most commonly dwell in the ruins of Old Valera and Old Thorn, as well as the vast necropoleis of Spintarra and Siwal. The Siwalese Fey are sandier in appearance and have beards of rope and twine. These desert domovoi are known as "pa'athara" in Siwalese.*

fluffInfo.name: Abandoned Servants
fluffInfo.value: The domovoi were the portal guards and house lackeys of the elvish nobility, and when elves leave a place, the domovoi are often left behind. Some say the domovoi are left on purpose, while others say the domovoi are too attached to their homes to follow the elves to far-flung locales.

fluffInfo.name: Debt Collectors
fluffInfo.value: These smirking stragglers seek work as tireless sentinels and fey button men, collecting debts for criminal syndicates. They delight in frustrating the progress of would-be thieves and tomb robbers, and they enjoy roughing up weaker creatures with their powerful, stony fists.

traits.name: House Guardian
traits.value: When the domovoi finishes a long rest in a structure with up to 2,500 square feet of floor space, the structure becomes magically protected. This works like the __guards and wards__ spell, except the domovoi can choose only two effects from the spell to place in the warded area.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The domovoi makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The domovoi magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the domovoi wears or carries is invisible with it.

bonusActions.name: Protector's Step
bonusActions.value: The domovoi magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space within a structure protected by its House Guardian trait or within 30 feet of the exterior of that structure. Swirls of golden light, sparkles of starlight, or tendrils of inky shadow (the domovoi's choice) appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The doomcaller has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, and the target has disadvantage on their next attack roll. Additionally, all attacks against the target by allies of the doomcaller are made with advantage until the start of the doomcaller's next turn.

actions.name: Summon Fiend (1/Day)
actions.value: The doomcaller chooses what to summon and attempts a magical summoning. A doomcaller has a 60 percent chance of summoning 1d6 succubi or 1d4 barbed devils. A summoned fiend appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, does as it pleases, and can't summon other fiends. The summoned fiend remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner takes a bonus action to dismiss it.

fluffInfo.value: *Within seconds, the startled rat became four, and then the four multiplied into sixteen rats.*

The result of a clone spell gone awry, a doppelrat uses short-lived duplicates to overwhelm its adversaries. An easy battle against a single rat can quickly spiral out of control as the doppelrat clones itself into a swarm—the original rat hides while combat rages. Doppelrats settle in large city alleys and sewers after they have killed or driven off normal rats and natural predators. Doppelrats can sense others of their kind among standard rats, which helps ensure the longevity of their species.

fluffInfo.name: Stillborn Clones
fluffInfo.value: Those who survive a doppelrat's bite suffer from a frightening disease, sloughing off a stillborn clone each day as their own vitality fades.

fluffInfo.name: Clone and Run
fluffInfo.value: In combat, doppelrats spawn as many clones as they can, then flee or hide while the copied rats swarm foes. Only a keen-eyed opponent can discern the original from all the clones.

fluffInfo.name: City Bounties
fluffInfo.value: In cities with known doppelrat lairs, magistrates hire spellcasters to scour alleys and sewers and obliterate any rats they find. Shady spellcasters who capture a live doppelrat have blackmailed such magistrates by promising to rescue the town from the rats for an exorbitant fee.

traits.name: Arcane Doubling
traits.value: While in combat, at the start of each of its turns, the doppelrat rapidly creates duplicates of itself as an automatic defense mechanism. These duplicates immediately form into a swarm of rats in the doppelrat's space, acting as allies of the doppelrat and obeying its body language commands. The swarm acts on the doppelrat's turn, and the doppelrat can use its reaction to move up to its speed with the swarm, provided it is in the swarm's space when the swarm moves. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until the doppelrat dies, or until the doppelrat dismisses it as a bonus action. The doppelrat can have no more than two swarms of rats under its control at a time.

traits.name: Hidden Original
traits.value: While the doppelrat is in the space of a swarm it created with Arcane Doubling, it is indiscernible from the other rats and has Cover. A creature must take an action to visually inspect the swarm and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to find the doppelrat among its duplicates. Once a creature succeeds on this check, the doppelrat loses Cover against attacks and spells from that creature and that creature's allies until the doppelrat starts its turn in the same space as one of its swarms.

traits.name: Horrific Doppeling
traits.value: Characterized by the growing and sloughing off of tumors shaped like the infected creature, horrific doppeling is a disease that infects creatures attacked by doppelrats. Until the disease is cured, the creature is poisoned. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or shed a tumor that looks like a Tiny version of itself. Though disturbing, the tumor is merely a mass of shed skin and fat that decays as normal. The disease is cured after the creature succeeds on two saving throws.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The doppelrat has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract the horrific doppeling disease (see the Horrific Doppeling trait).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +2, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.value: *These twitching balls of tentacles surround an inhuman face dominated by a squid-like beak.*

*Mages who study the Wasted West disagree whether the dorreq are something that slipped through with the Great Old Ones during the Mage Wars, or if they are creatures twisted and warped by the alien radiations of the Walkers. Regardless, they are most commonly found swarming on and around the enormous Walkers of the Wastes, tootling strange, alien harmonies through their beaks.*

fluffInfo.name: Servants of the Void
fluffInfo.value: The dorreq are servants to ancient horrors of the Void and realms beyond human understanding. They are guardians and sentries for such creatures, and they swarm and attack any creatures approaching too close to the elder aberrations they serve.

fluffInfo.name: Death from Above
fluffInfo.value: Dorreq prefer to drop on their victims from above, pinning them with their many tentacles and biting them with their large, chitinous beaks.

traits.name: Void Warping
traits.value: The area around the dorreq is warped by its connection to the Void. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the dorreq must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dorreq makes one Bite attack and two Tentacles attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and pulled up to 5 feet closer to the dorreq. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The dorreq can grapple up to two creatures at a time.

actions.name: Void Thrum (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dorreq emits a barely audible, vibrating thrum laced with Void energy. Each creature within 20 feet of the dorreq must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage and 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Stone Step
bonusActions.value: The dorreq teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain a stone or rocky surface, such as a cliff face or rocky terrain.

fluffInfo.name: Taryon Darrington
fluffInfo.value: Gleaming, resplendent, and overflowing with indefatigable confidence, Taryon Gary Darrington is every bit the man he was when he parted ways with Vox Machina over twenty years ago. These days, though, all the bravado and good cheer he had two decades ago is real—not just an act. Tary doesn't need to fake it anymore; he's made it. Even if responsibility doesn't come easily to him, he takes it whenever he has to.

fluffInfo.name: After the Epilogue
fluffInfo.value: After many years running the Darrington Brigade—his heroic adventuring band—and publishing several absolutely true accounts of their exploits, Taryon realized his adventuring checklist was essentially complete. He left his home in Deastok, in Wildemount's Dwendalian Empire, and began a new chapter of his life. Leaving the brigade in the capable hands of his sister, Maryanne, and his confidant Lionel Gayheart, Taryon traveled around launching several smaller "satellite" brigades in Wildemount's most dangerous lands.

Then, realizing he had spent his career as a writer of nonfiction adventure books, he decided to try his hand at fiction instead. With his trusty scribe and majordomo __Doty X__ at his side ("Doty Ten," he patiently explains to anyone who mispronounces it), Taryon and his husband Lawrence moved to the Menagerie Coast, setting up in a small writing cottage in Port Damali. While Lawrence tutors local students, Taryon has been dashing off novel after novel. His most successful books are a series called "The Deastok Mysteries," which feature a young, handsome blonde boy who solves crimes around Wildemount with his brilliant intellect and trusty robot sidekick.
From time to time, Taryon charters a skyship to visit his old friends in Whitestone and enjoy the memories of their time together as full-fledged members of Vox Machina.

fluffInfo.name: The Automatic Scribe, Doty
fluffInfo.value: Doty X is much like past models of Tary's mechanical servant—vaguely humanoid but not too expressive. The new model is sleek and stylish, and not built for battle. Doty's vocabulary has grown to six words: "Tary," "Yes," "Correct," "Absolutely," "Soon," and "Handsome." The scribe also features a built-in shelf of Taryon's favorite books—that is, his favorite books that he's written himself—in case Taryon needs to make a sale while he's on holiday.

traits.name: Arcane Surge (4/Day)
traits.value: When Doty hits a target, __Tary__ can channel magical energy to deal an extra 14 (**4d6**) force damage to the target as long as __Tary__ is not incapacitated.

traits.name: Dedicated Servant
traits.value: Doty has an additional 20 hit points, and has a +2 modifier to saving throws, ability checks using skill proficiencies, and attack rolls.

traits.name: Limited Vocabulary
traits.value: Doty can say the following words in Common: "Tary," "Yes," "Correct," "Absolutely," "Soon," and "Handsome."

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.value: Doty can't be surprised.

actions.name: Empowered Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) force damage.

actions.name: Repair (3/Day)
actions.value: Doty regains 15 (2d8 + 6) hit points.

entries: **Skills**: deception +8, intimidation +8, perception +5, persuasion +8, religion +5, stealth +6

traits.name: Apostate's Weapons
traits.value: The downcast apostate's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage and 18 (**4d8**) necrotic or radiant damage (downcast apostate's choice).

traits.name: Action Surge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: The downcast mercenary takes one extra action.

traits.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
traits.value: If the downcast mercenary fails a saving throw, it can reroll the saving throw and use the new roll.

traits.name: Thaumaturge
traits.value: The downcast mercenary can cast __thaumaturgy__ at will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The downcast mercenary makes three attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The mastermind behind some of the worst things to ever find in a basement. Watch out because even your fallen allies can be enemies.*

Perhaps no apothecary is a more prolific creator of monsters than the Reanimator, and amongst them, Dr. Everett Freed is perhaps the most infamous. A gifted professor of anatomy and medicine at Altbruke University, Dr. Everett Freed served as a field medic and surgeon during the Westemär Civil War, where the brutality and chaos of war allowed him to clandestinely begin his experiments with the fallen or grievously wounded soldiers thrust into his care. The sights of the war caused him to see the frailty of the human form—the cries of pain and agony of the wounded collected in the fields disgusted him with their feeble, broken bodies. Deep within himself welled the desire to create a perfect soldier, a warrior who would not bend or break in battle.

During the war, one of Dr. Freed's duties included triaging casualties to determine who could be saved or recover. Unbeknownst to his commanders, Dr. Freed used his position to manipulate the diagnosis, choosing ideal specimens for his experiments, individuals who would then be listed amongst the slain and missing.

fluffInfo.name: Reanimator Minions
fluffInfo.value: It's possible Dr. Freed was the first to create many creatures. He is most well known as the first to create Reautomata. In the process of making his magnum opus, Freed built creatures such as the __Body Snatcher__, __Cerebrograft__, the __Ripper__, and the __Stitcher__. Freed's experiments did not stop there, and in many ways his practice ascended the body alone thanks to his collaborations with the Alienist Dr. Sina Rienks, eventually transforming himself into a __Think Tank__.

fluffInfo.name: Mind Over Body
fluffInfo.value: One of Freed's infamous gambits was to remove his brain from his own body, placing it into a body double. Eventually, Freed became a Think Tank, able to remotely control brainless bodies from his hidden sanctum.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I am always calm and composed, especially when explaining the 'necessary' cruelty of my experiments
**Ideal:** Progress demands sacrifice; the advancement of knowledge justifies all actions, no matter how gruesome.
**Bond:** I still possess the first successful reanimation I ever created: the preserved head of a beloved family member. It's both my proudest achievement and my darkest secret.

**Flaw:** I am obsessed with the perfection and infallibility of my creations, often dismissing any evidence of their defects, uncontrollable behavior, and horrific appearances. I never accept any failure as my fault.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study the Reanimator, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Protected by the Reanimated
fluffInfo.value: You know of his Resistances, Immunities, and Bodyguard Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Deadly Toxins
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of his Touch of Death.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Electrical Reinvigoration
fluffInfo.value: You learn of his Reanimate action.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Prior to combat, Freed casts __False Life__ and __Death Ward__ on himself, and perhaps any allies joining him in battle. He does not engage in combat without creations by his side. If Freed is caught alone, he doesn't fight; he flees. However, when supported by his loyal creations, he can be overconfident and brash, secure that his bodyguards will keep him safe from harm. Freed always remains within 10 feet of one or more creations so he can use his Bodyguard Reaction reliably.

On his turn, Freed uses Electric Jolt and Necrotic Blast to hammer his foes, while directing a favored creation with Creator's Command. Should one of his minions be brought down, he uses Reanimate and immediately sends it back into the action with Creator's Command.

Freed uses Touch of Death against a particularly loathsome foe, one who harries him with dangerous abilities, or who he especially wishes to slay. All the while, he threatens his enemies by telling them his plans for their body parts once he's killed them.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Dr. Everett Freed, Reanimator is immune to the Weakened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Reanimator makes two Electric Jolt or Necrotic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Electric Jolt
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

actions.name: Touch of Death (1/Day)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 200 Poison damage. This damage ignores __Resistance__ and Immunity to Poison damage and can't be reduced or prevented in any way. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it automatically fails death saving throws until it finishes a Long Rest. A Heal or __Greater Restoration__ spell ends this effect early.

actions.name: Reanimate (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Reanimator targets the corpse of one of its destroyed creations it can see within 30 feet. The target returns to life with 45 (10d8) Hit Points. The target has Resistance to all damage and Advantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Creator's Command
bonusActions.value: The Reanimator chooses a creature it can see that was reanimated or created by it. The target can use its Reaction to make an attack with Advantage or move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Resting Protections
traits.value: While the Dragon is Unconscious, it can't become affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Draconic Charm
actions.value: One Humanoid the Dragon can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be magically Charmed for 1 day. The Charmed target obeys the Dragon's spoken commands.

If the target suffers any harm from the Dragon or another creature or receives a harmful command from the Dragon, the charm ends. If a target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this Dragon's Draconic Charm for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *This slender aquatic creature sports a powerful single finned tail and wicked jaws like a matched pair of serrated blades.*

Dragon eels are wingless, slender, underwater dragons that vary widely in color from browns and blacks to brilliant iridescent hues in mottled patterns. Though not true dragons or drakes, they are no less fearsome and powerful.

fluffInfo.name: Fond of Servants
fluffInfo.value: While most dragon eels are solitary and irascible, on rare instances some form pairs or small bands—and some gather humanoid servants.

fluffInfo.name: Magnetic and Lightning
fluffInfo.value: Dragon eels make their natural homes in twisting underwater cave systems and prefer magnetically-aligned, metallic cavern formations navigable with their refined electric sight. Some dragon eels use their constant electric auras combined with acquired alchemical reagents to electroplate portions of their golden hoard onto the walls of their dwellings.

fluffInfo.name: Pirate Fleets and Dominions
fluffInfo.value: Dragon eels claim large swaths of shoreline as their demesne. Although neither particularly cruel nor righteous, a dragon eel often lords over awed tribes, allowing locals to revere it as a mighty spirit. Some dragon eels use such tribes as the core of a pirate fleet or raiding parties carried on their backs. Their ability to swim through air during storms adds to their reputation as terrible thunder spirits.

fluffInfo.name: Bribable
fluffInfo.value: Their deceptive moniker sometimes lulls foolish sailors into a false confidence when they expect to face a simple if dangerous eel beast, but instead find themselves dealing with intelligent draconic kings of the coastal shallows. Wise sailors traveling through known dragon eel territory bring tithes and offerings to placate them.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.value: The dragon eel can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 6 hours to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Shocking Hide
traits.value: A creature that touches the dragon eel or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage.

traits.name: Storm Glide
traits.value: During storms with ample rain or lightning, the dragon eel gains a flying speed equal to its swimming speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon eel makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) piercing damage plus 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 30 (**5d8 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the eel. The dragon eel can choose to not push a target.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon eel exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each target in that line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (**10d10**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common and Naku Naku but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Removal
traits.value: When a creature or object becomes enclosed within the Dragon Frog's mouth, any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Dragon Frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or with-out a running start.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pulling Tounge
actions.value: The Dragon Frog lashes out its tongue at a Medium or smaller creature or object it can see within 25 feet of it. If the target is a creature, it is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the Dragon Frog, unless it succeeds on a DC 12 Strength saving throw. If the target is an object, it falls to the ground at the Dragon Frog's feet; if the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a contested Strength check or have the object pulled away from it.

traits.name: Arcane Acumen
traits.value: The dragonet has advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks made to reveal information about supernatural effects and objects they can see. Additionally, they always know if their emotions are being sensed, their thoughts are being read, or they are being targeted or perceived by any divination spells.

traits.name: True Words
traits.value: When a creature speaks in Draconic, the dragonet has advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) checks to determine whether they are lying.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The dragonet exhales sparkling light in a 15-foot cone. Each object in that area is outlined in light for 1 minute, and each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or also be outlined in light for the duration. Outlined creatures and objects shed dim light in a 5-foot radius, and if any outlined creatures or objects bear magic, the dragonet can learn its school of magic, if any, by looking at it. Any attack roll against an outlined creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see the target, and the outlined creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

actions.name: Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.value: For 1 minute, the dragonet gains truesight out to a range of 60 feet.

fluffInfo.value: *The dragon-headed leaves of these oak trees sometimes rustle despite a lack of wind, betraying a hint that they're more than they seem.*

*The finest druidic minds in the Mharoti Empire created these trees for the draconic lords of the land. Once the druids had shown the dragons the secret of the tree's creation, they were slain so that the secret would not spread. A handful of human and kobold gardeners know how to tend them and make them thrive, but little more.*

fluffInfo.name: Gifts among Dragons
fluffInfo.value: These magnificent trees are imbued with some characteristics of their draconic masters. While most groves consist of only one type of dragonleaf tree, dragons sometimes make gifts of them to cement a pact or as a show of fealty.
