The dragon giving the tree relinquishes command of the plant as part of the deal. This accounts for mixed groves belonging to especially powerful dragon lords.

fluffInfo.name: Silent Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Dragonleaf trees use fairly simple tactics to deter potential intruders into their masters' lairs. They remain motionless or allow the breeze to jostle their leaves to appear inconspicuous. Once enough intruders enter the grove, the trees fire razor sharp leaves or rain elemental energies upon the intruders, adjusting their position to make better use of their weapons.

fluffInfo.name: Long Memories
fluffInfo.value: Dragonleaf trees live up to 1,000 years. They stand 15 feet tall and weigh 3,000 pounds, but ancient specimens can reach heights of 45 feet. Growing a new dragonleaf tree requires a cutting from an existing tree at least 50 years old, which the tree's draconic master imbues with power, sacrificing the use of its breath weapon for a month. While this time barely registers on a dragon's whole lifespan, it still carefully considers the creation of a new tree, for fear that others might discover its temporary weakness.

traits.name: Elemental Affinity
traits.value: The dragonleaf tree has immunity to a type of damage based on the type of dragon that grew it: acid (black, copper), cold (silver, white), fire (brass, gold, red), lightning (blue, bronze), or poison (green).

traits.name: Eternally Loyal
traits.value: The dragonleaf tree has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against influence or effects that would encourage it or force it to act against its draconic master. If charmed or controlled and directed to act against its master, the tree can immediately repeat the effect's saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon leaf tree makes three Slam or Throw Leaves attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

actions.name: Throw Leaves
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**4d4 + 2**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

actions.name: Elemental Leaves (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragonleaf tree's leaves rain acid, shed bolts of lightning, shake loose icicles, or similarly emit the elemental energies of the dragon that grew the tree. Each creature within 20 feet of the dragonleaf tree must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 **12d6** damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.value: Whenever the dragonling first detects treasure worth 100 gp or more that isn't being worn or carried, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to, and frolic in, the treasure. A distracted dragonling repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of that treasure for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Metallic Character
traits.value: When the dragonling's tamer finishes a long rest, the dragonling gains an affinity for the element associated with the first precious metal it touches. This affinity grants the dragonling resistance to that damage type and lasts until its tamer next finishes a long rest. Copper gives acid affinity, gold gives fire, and magnetite & silver give cold.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to study a Drakkenheim Sewer Gator, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Fearless Aquatic Predator!
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Drakkenheim Sewer Gator's condition Immunities and Swim speed.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Watch out for its bite!
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Crushing Bite and Death Roll actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Get it out of the water!
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Contaminated Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Drakkenheim Sewer Gator is primarily aquatic, haunting the sewer system or the Drann River. These monstrosities lunge from the waters to grab prey, dragging it beneath the surface. Once a target is in its jaws, the gator Death Rolls until its victim stops moving. It is a cunning hunter, knowing how to disappear below murky waters, but it can be provoked to chase its prey. Out of the water it is vulnerable and flees if reduced below half its Hit Points.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Ribs, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Contaminated Regeneration
traits.value: The sewer gator regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn as long as it is in contaminated water. The gator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Amphibious Lunge
traits.value: If the sewer gator swims 20+ feet on its turn, it can long jump or high jump up to 60 feet. If it ends this jump within 5 feet of a creature, it has Advantage on its next Crushing Bite attack against that creature, and that attack deals an additional 40 (**9d8**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Predatory Stealth
traits.value: The sewer gator has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to Hide in water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sewer gator makes two attacks. It can't make both a Crushing Bite attack and a Tail Strike attack against the same target.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the sewer gator can't use Crushing Bite against another target.

actions.name: Tail Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d6 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the sewer gator and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Death Roll
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft., one creature Grappled by the sewer gator. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 19. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed and Helpless conditions until it escapes the sewer gator's grapple.

fluffInfo.value: *Dragon Disguised as a Festival Horse*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Unable to resist revelry and merriment, drakkenhob are driven away by payment offered in gold or alcohol.

traits.name: Irresistible Payment
traits.value: As an Influence action, a creature that offers the drakkenhob alcohol or any amount of gold and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check forces the drakkenhob to accept the offer and immediately take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed to get away from the creature by the safest route possible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drakkenhob makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Piercing damage plus 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage, and the target drops whatever it is holding and has the Frightened condition. A Frightened target takes the Dash action and moves away from the drakkenhob by the safest route on each of its turns unless there's nowhere to move. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Call the Hounds
bonusActions.value: The drakkenhob lets out a wolf-like howl and magically summons three hunting hounds (use the Wolf stat block) that appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of it. The hounds take their turn immediately after the drakkenhob on the same Initiative count, and they obey the drakkenhob's mental commands. The hounds vanish when they or the drakkenhob drop to 0 Hit Points, or when the drakkenhob uses this Bonus Action again.

fluffInfo.value: *These winged snakes are coastal beasts and sometimes confused with true dragons or wyverns. They are neither, but quite deadly in their own right.*

fluffInfo.name: Searing Acid and Dissolving Gaze
fluffInfo.value: The gaze of these winged snakes can paralyze and dissolve their victims. Drakon fangs do not deliver venom; volatile acid constantly burbles up from a drakon's stomach and enhances its attacks. A caustic drool clings to creatures they bite, and drakons can also belch clouds of searing vapor. Their lairs reek with acidic vapors and droplets of searing liquid.

fluffInfo.name: Coastal Beasts
fluffInfo.value: Drakons lair along warm, largely uninhabited coasts, where they explore the shores and the coastal shelf, spending as much time above the waves as under them. Fortunately, they rarely travel far inland.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The drakon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Dissolving Gaze
traits.value: When a creature that can see the drakon's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the drakon, the drakon can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if the drakon isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage, its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the acid damage it takes, and it is paralyzed until the start of its next turn. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the drakon until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the drakon in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drakon makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 10 (**4d4**) acid damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The drakon exhales acidic vapors in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (**8d6**) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: perception +0 plus PB, survival +0 plus PB

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through this tunnel normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** slashing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Spit Breath (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin breathes fire at their foe. This attack uses the statistics for their signature attack, except the fire is a ranged weapon with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and all the damage dealt by the attack is fire damage instead of piercing damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Roll Out (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin moves up to their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. The drangolin can end this movement in a space that contains another creature. If they do, that creature takes 2 × PB bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the drangolin traveled, and they must make a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed 5 feet out of the drangolin's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

actions.name: 5th Level: Rend and Roast (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin makes two signature attacks against the same target, then breathes fire on them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Draven makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Profane Sacrifice (1/Turn)
traits.value: When Draven hits a creature with a melee attack, he can sacrifice his vitality to empower the attack. The target's speed drops to 0 until the start of his next turn, and Draven takes 5 (**1d10**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Draven makes three Gloom Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Gloom Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d4 + 8**) piercing damage plus 7 (**3d4**) necrotic damage, and Draven can move the target up to 10 feet horizontally. If the damage from this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, Draven regains a use of Blood of the Dragon.

actions.name: Blood of the Dragon (1/Day)
actions.value: Draven boils the blood of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target takes 33 (**6d10**) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn) and knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Creeping Dread
bonusActions.value: Draven chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him in an area of dim light or darkness. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or move their speed in a direction chosen by Draven. A creature with advantage on saving throws against being frightened has advantage on this saving throw, and a creature who can't be frightened automatically succeeds on it.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The dread skeljaskra deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dread skeljaskra makes two attacks, using Rend, Burning Spit, or Spiked Tail in any combination.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**6d8 + 6**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Burning Spit
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Poison damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.

actions.name: Spiked Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**5d10 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet.

actions.name: Crushing Roll (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: If the dread skeljaskra begins its turn in its Armored Ball form, it can roll up to 60 feet. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16 Each creature in a 60-foot Line that is 15 feet wide. *Failure:* 32 (**5d12**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: *Devourer of Nightmares*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Dream eaters are confused by the intricate patterns on moth wings, and it disrupts their own colorful hypnosis.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The dream eater doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Moth Ward
traits.value: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saving throws against the dream eater's Hypnotic Wings.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The dream eater can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dream eater makes two Talons attacks and can use Devour Dreams.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Devour Dreams
actions.value: The dream eater unfurls its tongue and devours the dreams from a creature's mind. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 16, a creature the dream eater is grappling, or a creature within 5 feet of it that has the Incapacitated condition (Incapacitated creatures fail automatically). *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the creature's Charisma score decreases by 1d6. A creature reduced to 0 Charisma by this effect doesn't recover lost Charisma when it finishes a Long Rest, and it has the Incapacitated condition until its mind is restored with a __Greater Restoration__, __Heal__, or __Wish__ spell. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Wings
bonusActions.value: The dream eater's wings shine with dazzling rainbow colors until the start of its next turn, emitting Bright Light in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the dream eater and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in the dream eater's Bright Light. *Failure:* Until the start of the dream eater's next turn, the target has the Incapacitated condition, and its Speed is 0.

fluffInfo.value: *This tattered skeletal humanoid resembles a monster from a nightmare with vestigial skeletal wings with a few feathers, small horns, sharp teeth, and cloven hooves.*

fluffInfo.name: Drawn to Sin
fluffInfo.value: Dream eaters are dedicated to lust, gluttony, and greed. They make their lairs in casinos, brothels, thieves' dens, and other locations where gambling, food, and other pleasures are readily available. Sometimes dream eaters work together to create such a place, especially near large towns or cities. Some band together to create traveling shows, offering all the oddities, whimsies, and flights of fantasy customary for such entertainers.

fluffInfo.name: Devouring Hopes
fluffInfo.value: Dream eaters lure people into their lairs, enticing them with promises of pleasure or wealth. Of course, they make sure the odds are stacked in their favor. Eventually, their victims are left with nothing. Worse than the loss of physical treasures, dream eaters leave their victims stripped of hopes and aspirations. Dream eaters feed on emotions, leaving helpless thralls willing to sell their souls for their vices.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Dream Eater's Caress
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the dream eater must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or take 5 (**2d4**) psychic damage. The dream eater gains temporary hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dream eater uses its Lotus Scent. It then makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained. The dream eater has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Lotus Scent
actions.value: The dream eater secretes an oily chemical that most creatures find intoxicating. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 15 feet of the dream eater must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the creature is charmed by the fiend. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dream eater's Lotus Scent for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Waking Dreams (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Each creature within 20 feet of the dream eater must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. When it moves, an incapacitated creature moves in a random direction. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The dream eater magically transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries: **Languages**: all languages known before the curse

traits.name: Aura of Confusion
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn or moves within 25 feet of a Dream Whisperer must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or be affected as if they had failed a save against the __Confusion__ spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Dream Whisperer has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Dream Whisperer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Dream Whisperer makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The Dream Whisperer gains Advantage on attack rolls against the target for 1 minute, and the target rolls on the Lost Memories table.

table.title: Lost Memories
rows: The target becomes deeply suspicious of a character or NPC of the GM's choice. They gain the following flaw: "I know they are seeking to betray me. I have to act first—it's me or them!"
The target forgets all memories of a loved one of the GM's choice. The next time the target sees them, it's as if they are meeting them for the first time.
The target becomes stricken with doubt and gains the following flaw: ""The world is out to get me, and I can't win. I may as well give up now."
The target forgets how to speak in one language known, decided by the GM.
The target forgets the location of something important to them, of the GM's choice. It may be the location of a goal, their home settlement, or a hidden treasure.
The target loses an inconsequential memory such as what they ate a few nights ago or the name of an unimportant NPC.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 0 Ft. All +5 Ft. In Dreamscape, *fly* 20 Ft. (hover)
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Phantasmal Cone
traits.value: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 120-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 16 (**3d10**) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

traits.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
traits.value: When the dreamholder takes 10 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Dreameater
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.value: The dreamholder shoots four of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to four creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries: **1. Charm Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.
**2. Confusion Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

**3. Static Ray**: The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**4. Rot Ray**: The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 17 (**5d6**) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

**5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 20 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 22 (**5d8**) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

**6. Nightmare Ray**: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 (**5d10**) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

fluffInfo.value: Drella Swoop is a cheery sera luma able to make conversation with people from all walks of life. She is a con artist who left Alderheart after burning all of her bridges there, and has decided to join the hunters of Reya's Watch in the hopes of swindling them out of some of their more lucrative trophies.

entries: **Skills**: deception +5, insight +4, investigation +5, perception +6, performance +5, persuasion +5, sleight of hand +6, stealth +6
**Languages**: Birdfolk, Mapach, Vulpin, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Drella can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Drella can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Drella can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.value: On each of her turns, Drella can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: Drella can choose to reroll any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: Drella deals an extra 14 **4d6** damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Drella's that isn't incapacitated and Drella doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Drella makes two dagger attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with a shocking grasp.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, becoming poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. Drella has three poisoned daggers on her person which she prepared ahead of time. The poison dries and becomes useless 1 hour after its application.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, they can't take reactions until the start of Drella's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *A drowned woman floating in the water, her long hair drifting around her, suddenly rises! Her hair strikes out like dozens of watery snakes.*

fluffInfo.name: Raging Romantics
fluffInfo.value: Drowned maidens are piteous, but terrifying, undead. They are created when a woman dies in water due to a doomed romance, often from unrequited love or drowned by a philandering partner. Either way, the drowned maiden awakens from death, seeking vengeance. Even as she dishes out retribution, a drowned maiden anguishes over her tragic fate.

fluffInfo.name: Beckoning for Help
fluffInfo.value: The maiden lurks in the silent depths where she died—usually deserted docks, bridges, or coastal cliffs. She waits to pull the living to the same watery grave in which she is now condemned. Using her ability to disguise herself as a living person, she silently beckons victims from afar, acting as if in danger of drowning. When a victim is within range, the maiden uses her hair to pull her victim close enough to drain its strength with a magical kiss. Victims soon weaken and drown. The victim's final vision is the drowned maiden's tearful lament over the loss of life.

fluffInfo.name: Death to Betrayers
fluffInfo.value: Desperate individuals may bargain with drowned maidens. Sometimes maidens release pleading victims who promise to return to her lair with the person who caused the maiden's death. Embracing and drowning her betrayer releases the maiden from undeath.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drowned maiden makes three Hair attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Hair
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Large or smaller creature. She can grapple up to three creatures at a time. The hair holding a creature can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; 15 hp; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.value: One creature within 5 feet of the maiden and that she is grappling must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage, and its Strength is reduced by 1d6. On a success, the target takes half the damage, and its Strength isn't reduced. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its Strength is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.value: The maiden covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the maiden takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the maiden is disguised.

bonusActions.name: Reel
bonusActions.value: The drowned maiden pulls each creature grappled by her up to 15 feet straight toward her.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Grave Goods Sense
traits.value: The drowned raider vættir can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættr's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættr can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: A destroyed drowned raider vættir gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its Hit Points and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættir is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the drowned raider vaettir has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drowned raider vaettir makes two attacks using Battleaxe or Javelin in any combination.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Water Purge
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12 Each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Druid of the Sanguine Rite, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unrelenting Unlife
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Bloody Renewal
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Bloodthorn Whip attack and Plasma Absorption trait

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Unnaturally Aware
fluffInfo.value: You know their highest and lowest ability scores

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The druid of the blood rites uses dark magic to twist the lifeforce of other creatures. The druid uses its bloodthorn whip to inflict a series of open wounds upon its foes, and then feeds on their lifeforce by pulling it through their wounds using plasma absorption.
When not directly engaged in combat, the druids attempt to charm a group of foes and convince them to partake in their blood rituals, using their life force as sacrifice to empower one of their own.
If the druids are directly confronted with greater numbers, or their health is below half, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Blood Sacrifice
traits.value: A creature with the Restrained condition also has the Helpless condition against the vampire's attacks.

traits.name: Plasma Absorption
traits.value: Each time a creature takes damage from the Bleeding condition while within 30 feet of the vampire, the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Draining Bite or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Bloodthorn Whip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

actions.name: Draining Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Bloodroots (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the vampire. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: (This Hydra lives in Mooren Lake and has gained intelligence by living for so long in the residuum-infused waters. It has an Intelligence score of 12 (+1), can speak Common, and commands a tribe of __lizardfolk__.)
(See Unfriendly Waters, a mid-level adventure hook, for more information.)

The hydra is a reptilian horror with a crocodilian body and multiple heads on long, serpentine necks. Although its heads can be severed, the hydra magically regrows them in short order. A typical specimen has five heads. At the dawn of time, Tiamat, the Queen of Evil Dragons, slew a rival dragon god named Lernaea and cast her blood across the multiverse. Each drop that fell upon a world spawned a multi-headed hydra consumed by a hunger as great as the fallen god's hatred. Great champions are known to test their mettle against these fearsome creatures.

fluffInfo.name: Everlasting Hunger
fluffInfo.value: A rapacious and gluttonous monster, a hydra snatches and tears apart its prey in a frenzy of feeding. When a hydra has cleared a territory of food and driven off any creatures smart enough to avoid it, it moves on to seek its meals elsewhere. A hydra's hunger is so great that if it can't feed, it might turn against itself, its heads attacking each other as the creature eats itself alive.

fluffInfo.name: Hardy Water Dwellers
fluffInfo.value: Hydras are natural swimmers, dwelling in rivers, along lakeshores, in ocean shallows, and in wetland bogs. A hydra rarely requires shelter from the elements, so it doesn't normally have a lair. Only in colder climes are hydras drawn to the protection of sheltered caverns and ruins. When a hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads remains awake and alert, making the creature difficult to catch by surprise.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.value: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: Du'ulora are spirits of fury that feed on anger and inspire rage in mortals. A du'ulora is a maelstrom of eyes and wings, bound together by flesh that seems like solidified shadow. It can extend up to three tentacles from this dark mass. A du'ulora can turn a victim's anger into manifested heat; in battle, it grapples its victims and burns them with their own fury.

fluffInfo.name: Manipulating Fury
fluffInfo.value: While they feed on anger and hatred, du'ulora rarely act rashly. They are cunning and calculating strategists who excel at inspiring fury in others and turning it against them. In battle this can cause their victims to lower their guard and even to strike their own allies in heedless rage. As servants of the Dreaming Dark, the du'ulora craft dreams that stir buried anger and incite hatred; they excel at igniting feuds and inspiring vendettas. So where a tsucora agent of the Dreaming Dark manipulates peoples' fears and a hashalaq employs seduction, the du'ulora excel at inciting violence.

fluffInfo.name: The Fists of Dal Quor
fluffInfo.value: The du'ulora are martial champions of the quori. They thrive on conflict and love to personally crush their enemies. While they enjoy fighting in the vanguard, the du'ulora are also skilled strategists. In Dal Quor , the du'ulora command squads of tsucora and lesser quori. In Riedra, military commanders are typically Inspired bound to du'ulora spirits.

fluffInfo.name: Rage Against The Darkness
fluffInfo.value: The du'ulora bound to the kalashtar serve the light, but they still manipulate fury. Du'ulora kalashtar learn to harness and channel their own aggression, and are often Fighters or Barbarians; others are dispassionate Monks, who provoke rage in their enemies while never allowing it to distract them from their goals.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.value: The quori can't be *surprised* while it isn't Incapacitated.

traits.name: Aura of Fury
traits.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the quori. *Failure:* The target becomes enraged. While enraged, the target has Advantage on all melee attack rolls, and all attack rolls made against the target have Advantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The quori has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Track Hatred
traits.value: When the quori deals damage to any creature, it forms a psychic link with the target for 24 hours. During that time, the quori has advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to track the target. The quori can attempt to track the target at any range, even if it is on another plane of existence. Abilities such as the __Pass Without Trace__ spell or the Ranger's Nature's Veil feature do not impede the quori's ability to track its target. The quori remains alert to danger even when it is tracking while traveling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The quori makes three Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17) from one of three tentacles. While Grappled, the target takes 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage and 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage at the start of each of the quori's turns.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 16, one Humanoid the quori can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the quori; the quori disappears and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Aberrations. The quori's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the quori leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the quori appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this quori's Possession for 24 hours. *Success* The target is immune to this quori's Possession for 24 hours.

actions.name: Recall Agony (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the quori can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 67 (**15d8**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The black horse strides out of the shadows with its nostrils huffing steam. Its rider, swathed in black leather, raises its arm to reveal not a lantern but its own severed, grinning head.*

Though it appears to be a headless rider astride a black horse, the dullahan is a single creature. The fey spirit takes the shape of a horse rider holding its own head aloft like a lantern, or (more rarely) the form of an ogre cradling its head in one arm.

fluffInfo.name: Harbingers of Death
fluffInfo.value: Hailing from the darkest of fey courts, the dullahan are macabre creatures that walk hand in hand with death. They sometimes serve powerful fey lords and ladies, riding far and wide in the capacity of a herald, bard, or ambassador. More often than not they carry doom to a wretch who roused their lord's ire.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Baleful Glare
traits.value: When a creature that can see the eyes of the dullahan's severed head starts its turn within 30 feet of the dullahan, the dullahan can force it to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw if the dullahan isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature must take the Dash action and move away from the dullahan by the safest available route. A doomed creature that fails this saving throw is restrained while frightened instead.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the dullahan until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the dullahan in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Relentless Advance
traits.value: Moving through difficult terrain doesn't cost the dullahan extra movement, and the dullahan can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground.

traits.name: Relentless Nature
traits.value: The dullahan doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dullahan makes three Spine Whip or Necrotic Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Seal the Doom.

actions.name: Spine Whip
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or fall prone as it is wracked with pain.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Seal the Doom
actions.value: The dullahan points at a creature doomed by Deathly Doom within 40 feet of it that it can see. The creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target immediately drops to 0 hp if it is below half its hp maximum. On a success, the target is immune to the dullahan's Seal the Doom for the next 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Deathly Doom
bonusActions.value: The dullahan magically dooms a creature for 1 hour. It can have only one creature doomed at a time. If it dooms another, the effect on the previous target ends. The dullahan knows the direction to the doomed creature as long as both are on the same plane of existence.

fluffInfo.value: *The sand surges and shifts, a sinkhole opens, and sandy tendrils reach out.*

fluffInfo.name: Enormous Forms
fluffInfo.value: Though most commonly seen as dunes, a dune mimic can take the form of a date palm grove, a riverbank, an enormous boulder, or other large shapes in the landscape.

fluffInfo.name: A King's Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Dune mimics were created by a forgotten king as guardians for his desert tomb. Somewhere, dozens of them guard vast wealth.

fluffInfo.name: Spread by Spores
fluffInfo.value: Although not intended to reproduce, they began producing spores spontaneously and replicating themselves. Now they are spread across the deserts. Luckily for the other inhabitants, dune mimics reproduce just once per century

traits.name: Adhesive (Object or Terrain Form Only)
traits.value: The dune mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the dune mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 15). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The dune mimic can harden its outer surface, so only the creatures it chooses are affected by this trait.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object or Terrain Form Only)
traits.value: While the dune mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary sandy object or terrain feature.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The dune mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dune mimic makes three Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the dune mimic is in object or terrain form, the target is subjected to the mimic's Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The dune mimic engulfs a Large or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mimic's turns or take 10 (**3d6**) slashing damage, as the creature is lacerated by the mimic's sand-coated form. If the mimic moves, any engulfed creatures move with it. The mimic can have no more than two creatures engulfed at a time.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The dune mimic transforms into a Huge sand- or gravel-covered object, shapes itself into a sandy or rocky terrain feature no larger than a 20-foot cube or transforms back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The guide can see up to 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the guide is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the guide instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Spirit Hand
traits.value: The guide can cast __mage hand__ at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The guide can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the guide casts the spell, it can make the hand invisible.

traits.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
traits.value: When the guide hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned until the end of the guide's next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Attacks
traits.value: The guide's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the guide is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The guide makes three attacks.

actions.name: Spirit Strike
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) force damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Spirit Hand
traits.value: The initiate can cast __mage hand__ at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The initiate can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the initiate casts the spell, it can make the hand invisible.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the initiate is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The initiate makes two attacks.

actions.name: Spirit Strike
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) force damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the leader is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the leader instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Spirit Hand
traits.value: The leader can cast __mage hand__ at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The leader can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the leader casts the spell, it can make the hand invisible.

traits.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
traits.value: When the leader hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned until the end of the leader's next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Attacks
traits.value: The leader's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the leader is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Invisibility (3/Day)
traits.value: As a bonus action, the leader can magically turn invisible until the start of its next turn, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The leader makes four attacks.

actions.name: Spirit Strike
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) force damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, force; charmed, dazed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, stunned

traits.name: Frosted Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Durixaviinox fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take the Disengage action until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Hoarfrost
traits.value: Cold damage dealt by Durixaviinox ignores damage resistance.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: Durixaviinox can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Durixaviinox makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d6 + 8**) slashing damage, and Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Numbing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Durixaviinox exhales a freezing blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (**12d6**) cold damage and is restrained until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

bonusActions.name: Icy Grip
bonusActions.value: Durixaviinox encases a creature he can see within 60 feet of him in ice. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (**4d10**) cold damage and is restrained. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. A creature can use an action to break themself or another creature they can reach out of the ice, ending the restrained condition.
