fluffInfo.value: Black-tailed squirrels called dusktails are found across Humblewood. Dusktails are swift, agile, and intelligent. Dusktails can eat just about anything, and are adept at sneaking into seed stores where they can quickly deplete food supplies if given the chance.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.value: The dusktail has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The dusktail has advantage on saving throws made to resist being poisoned.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1** piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This striking woman with obvious fey features and skin the color of slate sits in the shade of an ancient, vine-wrapped tree. Clothed in vines and leaves, she is almost indistinguishable from the tree.*

*These dryads are commonly found near the ruins of Thorn, in the Arbonesse Forest, and in the Shadow Realms. They are close friends to the darker fey and are thought by some to be created from ordinary dryads drawn into the corruption of the Shadow Realm. Certainly, their mastery of the shadowy Umbral language shows their close ties to this darker world.*

fluffInfo.name: Creeper Vine Spirits
fluffInfo.value: Duskthorn dryads are spirits tied to thorn-bearing creeper vines. They seek out dead trees as homes for their vines. They can travel through trees to escape their foes but must stay near their vines.

fluffInfo.name: Grove Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Duskthorn dryads use their vines and the plants in their glades to defend themselves. They often call on the aid of forest animals and children of the briar. Occasionally, a circle of duskthorn dryads work together to call on the aid of an enormously strong vine troll skeleton to protect their grove.

entries: **Skills**: animal handling +4, deception +9, nature +6, perception +4, persuasion +9, stealth +7

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.value: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.value: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one dead tree within her reach and emerge from a second dead tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The duskthorn dryad makes two Thorned Slam or Thorn attacks.

actions.name: Thorned Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Thorn
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Children of the Forest (1/Day)
actions.value: The dryad magically calls 1d4 boars, constrictor snakes, or wolves, or it calls 1 child of the briar. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the dryad and obeying her spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the dryad dies, or until the dryad dismisses them as a bonus action.

fluffInfo.value: *A ragged creature emerges from the sand. Its spindly frame is encased in a hodge-podge of armor scraps and rusted weapons. A long, hooked nose protrudes over a wide mouth filled with sharp teeth*.

Dust goblins vary greatly in size and appearance, although they are universally scrawny, bony, and lanky. They seem to suffer from malnutrition even when in perfect health, a perception reinforced by the way their bellies distend after they've gorged themselves on flesh. Their skin is always dry and cracked, ranging from dusky gray to dark green in color.

fluffInfo.name: Rule the Wastelands
fluffInfo.value: Dust goblins are twisted creatures, tainted by many generations of life in a blasted wasteland. After a magical war devastated the dust goblins' homeland, they rose to become the most dominant inhabitants. They inhabit ancient ruins and ambush travelers who stray too close to their borders.

fluffInfo.name: Twisted Minds
fluffInfo.value: The lingering magical energy saturating the wastes of their home, coupled with the harsh conditions in which they scratch out a living, have tainted the minds of all dust goblins. Their thinking is alien and unfathomable to most creatures. Whereas most goblins are cowardly, dust goblins don't seem to experience fear. To the contrary, they enjoy wearing skull helmets and using ghostly whistles to frighten foes. Owing to this alien mindset, dust goblins get along disturbingly well with Aberrations. The creatures often forge alliances and work together for mutual benefit, while making their unnerving mark on communal lairs.

traits.name: Twisted
traits.value: When the dust goblin attacks a creature from hiding, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Like the Wind
traits.value: The Dust Bunny's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Kick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dust Kick
actions.value: The Dust Bunny kicks up dust at a creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become Incapacitated and begin sneezing uncontrollably until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Jump
actions.value: The Dust Bunny disappears in a poof of dust, teleporting up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fluffInfo.value: Curves are seldom seen in the stacked blocks and precise geometric forms of dwarven architecture. Devoid of angles and planes with no beginning and no end, circles are a mystery and hold power. Dwarven ringmages are those dwarves who have mastered the art of tapping into that power, imbuing it into metal rings and their spellcasting. Rings and circles are sacred to them, and they read omens in the cycle of seasons, the shape of flowers, and in a storm's first rain drops.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.value: The dwarven ringmage has advantage on saving throws against poison.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dwarven ringmage can use its Ring Magic. It then makes three Ring Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Ring Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

actions.name: Ring Magic
actions.value: The dwarven ringmage draws circles of magic in the air and sends them toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, causing one of the following effects:

entries: **Rings of Binding**: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained by magical rings until the end of its next turn.
**Rings of Bravery**: The target can't be frightened and has advantage on melee weapon attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
**Rings of Protection**: The target has a +2 bonus to its Armor Class until the end of its next turn.

**Rings of Retribution**: When any creature hits the target before the start of the ringmage's next turn, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The dyra can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.value: Whenever the dyra takes damage while grappling a creature, the creature grappled by it also takes half the damage the dyra took.

traits.name: Lightning Susceptibility
traits.value: If the dyra takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn, and if it's grappling a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or the grapple ends.

traits.name: Metal Stride
traits.value: While moving on a metallic object, structure, or surface, the dyra's speed is doubled.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The dyra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dyra makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the dyra can't constrict another target, and the target takes 4 (**1d8**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Electrical Overload
traits.value: If the dyra takes 25 lightning damage or more during a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The dyra is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The dyra's weapon attacks are considered magical.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The dyra deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dyra uses its Electrostatic Discharge, if available. It then makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (**1d10**) fire damage.

actions.name: Electrostatic Discharge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dyra expels a burst of electricity in a 15-foot radius around itself. Each creature other than the dyra in the area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of the dyra's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

fluffInfo.value: *This swanlike creature's feathers are made of shining metal. When it inhales, the feathers on its chest glow red hot.*
Eala are beautiful but deadly creatures native to the Plane of Shadow. They grow feathers like their Material Plane counterparts, but their feathers are made of gleaming, razor-sharp metal.

*Eala are favorites of Sarastra, the Queen of Night and Magic and a ruler of the shadow fey. She is partial to jet black eala, and all such specimens are brought to her flock at the Winter Palace. Those who bring her such birds are rewarded with a magical dagger and the title and status of "Honored Eala Catcher," or "Lord or Lady of Black Feathers" for those who bring her several.*

fluffInfo.name: Metallic Diet
fluffInfo.value: Eala plumage displays a stunning mixture of metallic colors, which vary depending on their diet. An eala uses its fire breath to melt metals with low melting points such as gold, silver, lead, copper, and bronze. The eala consumes the molten metal, some of which migrates into the creature's deadly feathers. Eala that display primarily or entirely a single color are highly prized among some nobility.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The eala makes two Wing Blades attacks.

actions.name: Wing Blades
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The eala breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The eala's fire breath ignites flammable objects and melts soft metals, such as gold and lead, in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.value: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.value: The elemental can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material they move through. While they use Earth Glide, the elemental can't be used as a mount.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Slam)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and the elemental can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Earthshaker (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental strikes the ground, and each creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The elemental's caregiver automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

actions.name: 5th Level: Transmute Ground (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental picks a 10-foot-square area of ground they can see within 30 feet of them. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or partially sink into the ground and become restrained. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success and ending the restrained condition for the freed creature.

bonusActions.name: Toss Me
bonusActions.value: While the elemental is within 5 feet of their caregiver, they can hurl the caregiver 5 × PB feet in any direction, including up. If the caregiver would normally take damage from a fall after being thrown, they can negate the damage with a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Trampling Rampage
traits.value: If an enemy who is touching the ground starts their turn within 5 feet of two or more earth sparks, the enemy must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 feet of the enemy. On a failed save, the enemy falls prone, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Shatter Smash (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Snort Rocks (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a flying creature, they must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall prone. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Trampling Rampage
traits.value: If an enemy who is touching the ground starts their turn within 5 feet of two or more earth sparks, the enemy must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 feet of the enemy. On a failed save, the enemy falls prone, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Shatter Smash (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Snort Rocks (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a flying creature, they must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall prone. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

fluffInfo.value: *This terrible creature resembles an imposing knight wearing baroque plate armor made of calcified resin. Its helm is a blank gray oval without eye slots or mouthpiece, and one of its arms ends in a slavering, fanged mouth.*

Eaters of dust can consume just about anything with their horrible maw-arms, but they prefer the flesh and souls of mortals. This ability to sustain themselves on almost anything, even on dust and soil, earned them their current name, given by the fiends that employ them, after their original name was long forgotten. A typical eater of dust is 7 feet tall and weighs more than 350 pounds. While an eater of dust cannot speak, it can telepathically communicate.

fluffInfo.name: Mercenary Companies
fluffInfo.value: Eaters of dust—or *yakat-shi* as they are sometimes called in ancient planar texts—roam the lower planes selling their services to arch-devils, demon lords, and other fiendish rulers for the chance to sample new flavors and morsels. Eaters of dust feel only contempt for most other life forms. They attack and eat their non-eater allies at the first sign of weakness. Because of this, eaters of dust often operate in small, deadly units of eaters led by a powerful leader, styled the *yakat-norog*.

fluffInfo.name: Armor Shell
fluffInfo.value: While many sages confuse eaters of dust for some obscure variety of fiend, they are aberrations escaped from a far-flung dimension of madness and nightmares. Indeed, their armor is not armor at all, but a secreted resin that hardens into a shell as strong as steel. When cracked, it exudes a nacreous blood, and the resulting scar resembles mother-of-pearl. Some old eaters are covered in intricate networks of shimmering scars.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: telepathy 120 ft. understands Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Void Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Maw
traits.value: The eater of dust's Maw-Arm attacks are magical. When the eater hits with its Maw-Arm, the weapon deals an extra **3d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The eater of dust regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of eater's next turn. The eater dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The eater of dust makes one Maw-Arm attack and two Necrotic Blast attacks, or it makes three Necrotic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Maw-Arm
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the eater regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d8 + 3**) necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Hungry Step
bonusActions.value: The eater of dust magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead.

entries: **Skills**: deception +7, insight +7, perception +11, sleight of hand +9, stealth +13
**Languages**: Thieves' Cant, plus three other languages

traits.name: Customized Poison
traits.value: The assassin prepares and applies specialized poisons to its weapons. The first time each turn that the assassin deals weapon damage to a creature, choose one of the following:

entries: **Abduction**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. *Success* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.
**Debilitation**: The target takes 17 (**5d6**) Poison damage, and has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.
**Suffocation**: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target can't speak or breathe.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The assassin makes three attacks using its Daggers or one attack using its Heavy Crossbow.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries: **Languages**: Thieves' Cant, plus three other languages

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The enforcer makes two attacks using their Dagger and Fighting Chain in any combination.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Fighting Chain
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). The enforcer can only have one creature grappled by its fighting chain.

bonusActions.name: Strangle
bonusActions.value: The enforcer deals 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage to a target Grappled by its Fighting Chain, and the target is unable to speak until the start of the enforcer's next turn or until it is no longer Grappled.

fluffInfo.value: *An evil wind swirls out of the desert, parching those it touches and whispering evil plans.*

fluffInfo.name: Bitter Exiles
fluffInfo.value: Desert and plains tribes often exile their criminals to wander as outcasts. A banished criminal who dies of thirst sometimes rises as an edimmu, a hateful undead that blames all sentient living beings for its fate.

fluffInfo.name: Rise Again
fluffInfo.value: Unless its body is found and given a proper burial, an edimmu is nearly impossible to destroy. Edimmus rarely venture more than a mile from their remains, but they sometimes follow prey they have cursed to seal the creature's fate. Once that creature is slain, they return to the site of their demise.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The edimmu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If destroyed, an edimmu rises again in 2d4 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. When the edimmu rises, it appears within 5 feet of its remains. Only burying its mortal remains in consecrated or hallowed ground prevents this trait from functioning.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The edimmu doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Water Siphon
traits.value: The edimmu has advantage on attack rolls against creatures made of or gaining power from magical water, such as water elementals, water jinnborn, water genies, and sorcerers with water-based origins. In addition, such creatures have disadvantage on the saving throw against the edimmu's Draining Touch and Multiattack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The edimmu makes two Draining Touch attacks. If both attacks hit one creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Draining Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after drinking 1 pint of water. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

fluffInfo.value: *The grotesque beast has the muscular tail, bulbous head, and rubbery, slime-covered flesh of an eel. Its torso and webbed paws resemble those of a misshapen canine, while needle-sharp teeth fill its menacing jaws.*

fluffInfo.name: Hounds of the River Fey
fluffInfo.value: Ferocious aquatic fey, these amphibious menaces often serve lake trolls, lorelei, green hags, and other watery fey and giants. Predatory beasts as dangerous on land as they are in the water, the have a capricious cruelty. Few creatures beyond the fey appreciate eel hounds' lithe power and cruel grace, instead noting only their grotesque form and unnerving savagery.

fluffInfo.name: Slippery Ambushers
fluffInfo.value: Eel hounds are ambush predators, hiding among the muck and algae of riverbanks, bursting out as a pack. Possessed of a low cunning, they prepare ambushes by vomiting their slippery spittle where land animals come to drink or along game trails. Then they surge from the water to snatch the off-balance prey. They surround targets, latching on with their powerful jaws, and then drag non-aquatic prey into the depths to drown or force aquatic prey onto land to suffocate.

fluffInfo.name: Fey Water Hounds
fluffInfo.value: Eel hounds understand Sylvan, and those dwelling near humans or other races pick up a few words in other tongues.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The eel hound can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The eel hound has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the hound can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Slick Spittle
actions.value: The eel hound covers the ground in a 5-foot square centered on a point it can see within 10 feet of it with its slippery spittle. Each creature standing in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The spittle remains on the ground for 1 minute.

bonusActions.name: Water Step
bonusActions.value: The eel hound teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain enough water to partially submerge the hound.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study an Effulgent Cnidarian, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Aberrant Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the monster's Immunities and Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hypnotic Color Change
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the monster's Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak but Aware
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the monster's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Effulgent Cnidarians are not predatorial—they only want to bask in the glow of delerium crystals, feeding slowly on the arcane energies they emit. They are, however, protective of their food sources. If creatures venture into an area of heavy delerium crystallization, they are sure to find a few Cnidarians bobbing about. The Cnidarian prefers to use its Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence to dissuade threats from engaging, instead hoping to cause its enemies to kill one another. The Cnidarians feed on creatures under its hypnosis, absorbing their essence through its tendrils. If attacked, it uses its Reflexive Flash and attempts to move away from its threats, often floating straight up as quickly as it can and out of the reach of danger.
Cnidarians do not stay around to fight. If all targets have avoided its charm and are actively attacking it, it abandons its food source to seek other safer areas.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Altered Reality
traits.value: The cnidarian has the Invisible condition for creatures Charmed by it.

traits.name: Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cnidarian and can see it is subjected to the following effect unless the cnidarian chooses otherwise. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition (save ends). While Charmed, the target regards all other creatures as enemies except the cnidarian, whom it regards as an ally.

Whenever the target makes an attack or casts a detrimental spell, it must choose its target at random from the creatures it can see within range. If a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack action from the target, it must make the attack, if able. If the target ends its turn without taking an Attack or Magic action, it takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the cnidarian until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the cnidarian in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Neon Illumination
traits.value: The cnidarian sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cnidarian makes two Tendrils attacks.

actions.name: Tendrils
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**6d8**) Necrotic damage, or 48 Necrotic damage if the target is Charmed by the cnidarian.

entries: **Languages**: Understands Common, Dwarven, Elvish, and the Northern Tongue, but cannot speak

actions.name: Ram
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d12 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) Necrotic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, and the eikthyrnir moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Grasping Thorns
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15 A Large or smaller creature within 30 feet is pulled adjacent to the eikthyrnir and has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The trollkin regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The trollkin makes two attacks, using Spear and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3 to hit, range 150/600 feet., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Aim
bonusActions.value: The raider has Advantage on the next ranged attack roll it makes during the current turn.

fluffInfo.value: *A line of stout, bearded warriors with golden auras stand ready, adorned in chain mail and carrying battle axes and oaken shields. Their badges and symbols are all different, and no two have the same braided pattern in their beards.*

The einherjar are great warriors chosen by the valkyries. They eat and drink their fill of boar and mead each night, then spend their days preparing for Ragnarok. Some of this is combat training, and other portions are raids against the giants fighting the gods. Regardless of how often they are slain, the einherjar reappear each morning in Odin's hall, leaving them without fear of death.

fluffInfo.name: Defenders of the Mortal World
fluffInfo.value: Occasionally, ravenfolk guide a troop of einherjar against some of Loki's minions on the Material Plane. These raids are often small battles that further delay the inevitable rise of the world serpent and its many evil spawn. They fight against giants, demons, lindwurms, and other evil creatures, but the einherjar themselves are not exactly saintly. They can drink and carouse with the loudest and most boastful of humanoids. Though otherworldly and servants of Odin, einherjar are very humanlike, if somewhat larger than life.

fluffInfo.name: Fear Dragons
fluffInfo.value: The einherjar are superstitiously fearful of dragons and dragonkin, the distant progeny of the world serpent.

fluffInfo.name: Never Speak to the Living
fluffInfo.value: In theory, the einherjar are forbidden from speaking with the living: they must pass their words through a valkyrie, ratatosk, ravenfolk, or one of the other races allied with Odin. In practice, this rule is often flouted, though if Loki's servants notice it, they can dismiss any einherjar back to Valhalla for a day.

traits.name: Battle Frenzy
traits.value: The einherjar has advantage on all attack rolls it makes while it is below 30 hp.

traits.name: Fearsome Gaze
traits.value: The stare of an einherjar is especially piercing to Humanoids. It has advantage on any Charisma (*Intimidation*) check it makes against a Humanoid.

traits.name: Runic Weapons
traits.value: The einherjar's weapon attacks are magical. When the einherjar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d8** radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The einherjar makes two Battleaxe attacks, or it makes three Celestial Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with Celestial Blessing, if available.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Celestial Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d8 + 2**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Celestial Blessing (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The einherjar calls on its celestial patrons for one of the following blessings:

entries: **Odin's Strength**: The einherjar roars a battle prayer to Odin. Each friendly creature within 60 feet of the einherjar and that can hear the prayer deals an extra 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage when it hits with any weapon. In addition, when an affected creature makes an attack roll, the creature can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to the attack roll.

**Valkyries' Mercy**: The einherjar pleads for the assistance of the valkyries to save one friendly creature it can see within 60 feet of it that has been reduced to 0 hp. The creature regains 13 3d8 hp. Once the einherjar has aided a creature with Valkyries' Mercy, it can't target that creature with Valkyries' Mercy again until the creature finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bandit lord hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The bandit lord has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bandit lord's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bandit lord makes two Longsword attacks and one Dagger attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 14 (**2d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage, or 8 (**2d4 + 3**) piercing damage if used to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: For 1 minute, the bandit lord can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the bandit lord. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the bandit lord is incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The skald makes two Shortword or two Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, range 80/320 feet., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Heroic Oration (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: One creature of the skald's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear it has Advantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the skald's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Dragon Frog fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Removal
traits.value: When a creature or object becomes enclosed within the Dragon Frog's mouth, any spell of 6th level or lower on the target ends.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Dragon Frog's long jump is up to 90 feet and its high jump is up to 45 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Dragon Frog makes three attacks: one with its Chomp and two with its Claws.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Large or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Dragon Frog, and takes 11 (**2d10**) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the Dragon Frog's turns.

The Dragon Frog can hold up to three creatures in its mouth at a time. If the Dragon Frog takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Dragon Frog must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which enters an empty space within 10 feet of the Dragon Frog. If the Dragon Frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**1d10 + 8**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Dragon Frog lets out a ground-shaking croak that warps the environment in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 66 (**12d10**) thunder damage and is pushed 15 feet away from the Dragon Frog. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
If the Dragon Frog has any creatures in its mouth when it uses its Croak, they all fall Prone in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of the Dragon Frog.

entries: **Languages**: understands Draconic, Ignan, and Terran but can't speak them

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The wurm can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.value: The wurm can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

traits.name: Noxious Resilience
traits.value: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Volcanic Body
traits.value: The wurm sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 10 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The wurm makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) piercing damage plus 5 (**1d10**) fire damage.

actions.name: Molten Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 38 (**11d6**) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 15 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes restrained. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

fluffInfo.value: *A large dragon with black scales and shadowy wings emerges from the darkness. Its red eyes glare bright as coals, and it speaks in a deep monotone.*

fluffInfo.name: Solitary Lairs
fluffInfo.value: They haunt dark and lonely places, such as deep caves, dense forests, shadowy ruins, and many wild locations in the Plane of Shadow. They are long-lived for drakes, often reaching 250 years of age, and mate rarely, abandoning their eggs shortly before hatching.

fluffInfo.name: Fade Into Shadows
fluffInfo.value: An elder shadow drake naturally fades from view in areas of dim light or darkness, becoming invisible until it attacks or is bathed in sunlight.

traits.name: Shadow Sight
traits.value: The drake has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made while in dim light or darkness, and magical darkness doesn't impede the drake's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elder shadow drake makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slap attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The drake magically turns invisible until it attacks, uses Shadow Step, or starts its turn in sunlight, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the drake wears or carries is invisible with it. The drake must be in dim light or darkness to use this action.

actions.name: Stygian Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The elder shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid on a point the dragon can see within 60 feet of it. The ball bursts into a 20-foot-radius sphere of black mist centered on that point for 1 minute. Each creature in the mist when it appears must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (**12d6**) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The mist spreads around corners, and its area is magical darkness. No natural light can illuminate the mist. If any of the mist overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 1st level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Step
bonusActions.value: The drake teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must be in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The elder thing has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elder thing makes up to two Grasping Tentacle attacks and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Grasping Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: At Will:
actions.value: __Charm Person__, __Scorching Ray__, __Thunderwave__.
1/day: __Cone of Cold__, __Fear__, __Ice Storm__.

bonusActions.name: Surgical Eye
bonusActions.value: The elder thing assesses the anatomy of a creature it can see within 30 ft. and makes a DC 15 Intelligence (*Medicine*) check. If it succeeds, its attacks against the target are critical hits on die rolls of 18 or higher for the next minute or until it uses Surgical Eye against a different target. If the elder thing succeeds on this check a second time against the same creature, its attacks against the target are instead critical hits on die rolls of 16 or higher for the next minute or until it uses Surgical Eye against a different target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 2**) Slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: One of the finest professors in the Amethyst Academy, Eldrick Runeweaver has personally instructed a generation of talented arcane spellcasters. He is the foremost living expert on abjuration magic, but is also highly regarded within the Academy as a dedicated administrator and calculating leader. If Eldrick Runeweaver successfully retakes the Inscrutable Tower, he will likely take up the vacant spot in the Academy Directorate and assume the mantle of Archmage of Drakkenheim.

Eldrick Runeweaver is a towering and broad-shouldered man in his mid-sixties. His amber eyes glow softly behind his circular glasses, and he has a square-cut, greying black beard. He wears nine rings of silver, gold, and electrum: one on each finger except his left thumb. He wears flowing purple garb with golden embroidery, and carries an obsidian staff tipped with a delerium crystal.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I carefully calculate my every action, and I speak using a few well-chosen words. I'm a teacher at heart, so I often phrase my responses in the form of a pointed question.
**Ideal**: I will seek out more information whenever I encounter an unknown situation or problem. Through reason and logic, the facts always bear out the truth of the matter.
**Bond**: I hold a position of responsibility and authority within the Amethyst Academy, and it is my duty to protect the Academy's interests, carry out its agenda, and keep its many secrets.
**Flaw**: I care deeply for my students, but tend to overlook their faults and failures. I've had several wayward apprentices over the years, and I've often had to cover up their mistakes.

fluffInfo.value: Eldrick Runeweaver has a cat familiar, and travels with an iron golem bodyguard and a homunculus servant. He most often communicates via sending, telepathic bond, and project image spells, or by sending his simulacrum instead. Eldrick always has a contingency spell in place, and has a clone kept in a distant stronghold with extra equipment should the unthinkable occur.

entries: **AC**: 17 (Robe Of The Archmagi And Staff Of Power)

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Eldrick Runeweaver wears a robe of the archmagi, carries a staff of power, and wears a ring of spell storing. He carries 2d6 very rare spell scrolls and potions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Eldrick Runeweaver fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Staff of Power
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.value: Eldrick can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Eldrick has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Warding Aura
traits.value: Eldrick projects a 30-foot Emanation of warding magic. The first time on each turn that a creature within the Emanation deals damage or casts a spell on Eldrick, that creature takes 14 (**4d6**) Force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Eldrick.

actions.name: Eldrick always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Eldrick can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Eldrick takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 6**) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (Eldrick's choice).

actions.name: Teleport
actions.value: Eldrick teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.

actions.name: Chain Lightning (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Eldrick casts __Chain Lightning__, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dispel Magic (1/Round)
actions.value: Eldrick casts __Dispel Magic__, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Eldrick chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Eldrick can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study an Eldritch Cataclysm, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Amalgamation of Energies
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Immunities, as well as its Air Form trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) An Octarine Storm
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Chain Lightning, Meteor Strike, Quake, and Icy Bolt actions.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Exceedingly Resilient
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Eldritch Cataclysms rule the skies, and never willingly descend to the ground. Instead, it rains down lightning, meteors, and icy blasts from above. The temperamental nature of these elementals means they delight in attacking with a variety of elements, and seldom use the same action two rounds in a row. They enjoy using their Meteor Strike on targets they've Frozen with Icy Bolt, and delight in using their Cyclonic Storm to blow away weapons and equipment dropped by targets of their Chain Lightning.

These enraged creatures revel in destruction but have little conception that anything could actually pose a threat to them. When confronted with a foe able to withstand their onslaught, they treat it as a personal affront, and furiously focus their subsequent attacks upon them occasionally to the exclusion of all else. Despite this single-minded strategy, an Eldritch Cataclysm can recognize when a creature is resistant or immune to its elemental attacks and tries to use only the most effective powers against its chosen target.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.value: The eldritch cataclysm can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cyclonic Storm
traits.value: The eldritch cataclysm emits a 120-foot Emanation of high winds that disperse gases and vapors and extinguish unprotected flames. Ranged attacks that pass through the area have Disadvantage. Objects that are not worn or carried are blown away 1d6 x 5 feet in a random direction. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17 (flying creatures have Disadvantage). *Failure:* The target has the Slowed condition until the start of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is flung 1d6 x 5 feet in a random direction, landing with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The eldritch cataclysm uses Chain Lighting or Icy Bolt, then uses Meteor Stike or Quake.

actions.name: Chain Lightning
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**3d8 + 7**) Lightning damage, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of the cataclysm's next turn, and the lightning leaps to another creature of the cataclysm's choice within 15 feet of the first target. The cataclysm makes a separate __Chain Lightning__ attack against the target. The cataclysm can make any number of __Chain Lightning__ attacks in this way, but a creature can be targeted only once each time the cataclysm takes this action.

actions.name: Icy Bolt
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**3d8 + 7**) Cold damage. *Hit or Miss:* The target and each creature within 5 feet of it are subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 17).

actions.name: Meteor Strike
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot radius, 40-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Fire damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Quake
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the cataclysm. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Uncontainable
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Escape Reality
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Void Walker Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dull and Diffident
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Eldritch Crawlers weave together fractured timelines, and slip in and out of the Space Between Worlds with ease. They create their own Thin Places and travel through them back and forth as needed. When under attack, Eldritch Crawlers bend and alter the realities they exist in to shift to one where they are more likely to survive. They teleport around the battlefield and vanish into the Space Between Worlds as they need to, using Void Walker and their Fractured Reality Reaction, only to reemerge and attack their prey with Contaminated Venom.

traits.value: The eldritch crawler is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The eldritch crawler may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the eldritch crawler can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the eldritch crawler has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The eldritch crawler is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the eldritch crawler's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Insectoid Limbs
traits.value: The eldritch crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. It ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite

If brought to less than half its Hit Points, it attempts to flee.

If an Eldritch Troll takes Psychic damage, it immediately flees and attempts to find a safe place to recuperate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Force or Psychic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Claws

actions.name: Corrupting Blast (Recharge 5-6)

bonusActions.name: Forced Mutation
bonusActions.value: The troll is so contaminated that it changes form constantly, growing new appendages or exploding out of its old skin into a new form. The troll may manifest one of the following mutations. The mutation stays in effect until a new one is chosen.

bonusActions.name: Grotesque Wings
bonusActions.value: The troll gains a Fly Speed equal to is Speed, but it falls if it ends its turn in the air.

bonusActions.name: Cyclopean Eye
bonusActions.value: Corrupting Blast now recharges on a 4-6, and the troll gains Truesight 30 ft.

bonusActions.name: Extra Arms

bonusActions.name: Spider Legs

bonusActions.name: Reflective Flesh

bonusActions.name: Crystalized Carapace

fluffInfo.value: *The ground ripples and tears as rocks fall, jets of flame erupt, and howling winds rage around a rocky creature.*

*Among the Tamasheq, the elemental loci are cherished as minor deities, nearly as powerful as the Wind Lords themselves. The sorcerers of Kush have tried to capture and enslave loci for decades; thus far without success, but they grow bolder (and closer to their goal) with each attempt.*

fluffInfo.name: Spirit of the Land
fluffInfo.value: Elemental loci are living spirits inhabiting or embodying tracts of land and geographical features. They are the ultimate personification of nature—the land itself come to life. They vary in size from small hills to entire ridge lines, with no discernible pattern to where they take root.

fluffInfo.name: Stubborn Nature
fluffInfo.value: Elemental loci are fiercely protective of their chosen location. They tolerate no interference in the natural order and challenge all who despoil the land, be they mortal, monster, or god.

entries: **Immunities**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.value: The elemental locus doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Immortal
traits.value: If the elemental locus dies, it returns to life in 1d12 months, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a space of the locus's choice within its bound land. Only a __wish__ spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

traits.name: Land Bound
traits.value: The elemental locus is bound to an area of land or ocean no larger than 100 square miles. If it leaves this region, it loses its Spawn Elemental action. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to the center of this area after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The elemental locus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The elemental locus deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Unstoppable
traits.value: Moving through difficult terrain doesn't cost the elemental locus extra movement, and its speed can't be reduced.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental locus makes three Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spawn Elemental.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**5d8 + 9**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Spawn Elemental
actions.value: The elemental locus magically creates up to 2d6 mephits or 1 Elemental with a challenge rating of 5 or lower. The Elementals arrive at the start of the locus's next turn, acting as allies of the locus and obeying its spoken commands. The locus can create only Elementals that share an element with a terrain feature comprising at least 100,000 square feet of the locus's bound land. For example, a desert-bound locus can't create a water-based Elemental, unless its bound desert contains an oasis or other source of water around the size of a small pond. The Elementals remain for 1 hour, until the locus dies, or until the locus dismisses them as a bonus action. The locus can have any number of Elementals under its control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Elementals is no higher than 8.

actions.name: Smack
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) damage of the type associated with the spirit.

actions.name: Duplicate (1/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Duplicate__ spell (spell save DC 10), using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components
