traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 25 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vampire takes radiant damage, it regains 10 hit points from the next use of this trait instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the following flaws:

entries: *Forbiddance*. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
*Stake to the Heart*. The vampire dies if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage and 17 (**5d6**) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under this vampire's control.

actions.name: Fey Majesty
actions.value: The vampire targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be charmed. The charmed target regards the vampire as a friend to be heeded and protected. Although not under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests in the most favorable way and is a willing target for the vampire's bite.

While the target is charmed, the vampire can communicate with the target telepathically within 300 feet. The vampire can use a bonus action to force the target to repeat the saving throw. If the save fails, the vampire can render the creature full of despair (disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls) or confused (as the __confusion__ spell) for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the despair or confusion on itself on a success.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Mist Form
actions.value: The vampire polymorphs into a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. Anything it wears or carries transforms with it. While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 30 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, but it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. A vampire in mist form is immune to nonmagical damage, except damage from sunlight, and has resistance to damage other than radiant. The vampire reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.value: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: Elora Quickwit is a thin, middle-aged kindled corvum and the owner of Moss Hall, Marshview's local inn and tavern. She often overcharges her customers and involves herself in disreputable schemes to turn a profit. Though most of the locals detest her, the perch is too small to boycott her establishment, and she has close ties with Sergeant __Burlywhirl__, the head of the local Perch Guard.

entries: **Skills**: deception +7, history +4, insight +4, perception +6, persuasion +5, sleight of hand +4, stealth +4
**Languages**: Birdfolk, Jerbeen, Vulpin, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Elora can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Elora can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Elora has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Convincing
traits.value: Elora has advantage on all Charisma checks made to convince someone of her knowledge of anything pertaining to the *History* skill.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.value: Elora can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: Elora deals an extra 10 **3d6** damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Elora's that isn't incapacitated and Elora doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Elora makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: The elvish veteran archer is a stealthy hunter that quietly slips through the wood, watching for game or intruders. While capable with a sword, the elvish archer's true skill lies with the longbow. When unseen, the archer can launch a volley of arrows at its foes with deadly results.

traits.name: Beast Hunter
traits.value: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to track Beasts and on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to recall information about Beasts.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.value: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the archer to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.value: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

traits.name: Point Blank Hunter
traits.value: A longbow deals one extra die of its damage when the archer hits with it (included in the attack). In addition, when the archer makes a ranged attack with a longbow, it doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though it may still have disadvantage from other sources.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elvish veteran archer makes three Shortsword attacks or two Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the archer can pin part of the target's clothing or body to the ground or to a nearby wall or tree. If it does so, the target is restrained. A creature, including the target, can take its action to remove the arrow and free the restrained target by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check.

actions.name: Arrow Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The elvish veteran archer fires a flurry of arrows in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Central Nervous System
traits.value: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sensitive Gut
traits.value: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Warded
traits.value: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squirt
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) acid damage.

fluffInfo.name: Evolutionary Fire
fluffInfo.value: The Fire Ashari of Pyrah believe that the mythic __rocs__ that gave rise to the ember rocs maintain balance in Tal'Dorei. __Rocs__ avoid humanoid settlements and hunt the monstrous creatures that would otherwise threaten those settlements. So the Ashari lure __rocs__ to sites of elemental rifts, enticing them to devour creatures attempting to escape into the Material Plane. After years of feeding on __fire elementals__, __salamanders__, __fire giants__, and more, a __roc__ is imbued with primordial power, flames erupting from every feather to transform it into the ember roc.

fluffInfo.name: Hopeless Ends
fluffInfo.value: An ember roc patiently observes prey for hours before it strikes, snatching up __elephants__, __whales__, and even young dragons. It unleashes iron talons to grapple targets, paying no heed to counter-attacks, then soars back to its nest—often inside an active volcano. If prey proves too much trouble while in flight, an ember roc readily drops it from some great height. But those unable to escape slowly roast in the creature's fiery grip.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The roc has Advantage and Disadvantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.value: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the roc takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.value: The roc sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) piercing damage and 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d6 + 8**) slashing damage and 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Inferno (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The roc beats its wings, creating a swirling conflagration. Each creature within 30 feet of the roc must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throws or take 21 (**6d6**) fire damage.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.value: The Emberbat can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.value: The Emberbat has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Ember Flame
traits.value: The emberbat can create a flame from its nose at will. It sheds bright light in a 5-foot-radius and dim light in another 5 feet beyond this. This effect lasts until it is dismissed, which the emberbat can do at anytime. When lit, the flame also provides a small damage boost to the emberbat's bite (already included in stat block).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage plus 1 fire damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This floating, green crystal sparkles with an inviting glow above the head of a fallen figure.*

fluffInfo.name: Servants of Logic
fluffInfo.value: Arcane scholars often debate logic with specially created speaking crystals that are based on their own minds, allowing them to ponder topics from different angles. Most scholars create the crystals to work through a puzzling topic, then dispel the crystal's magic once the topic has been resolved. Long-lived speaking crystals can develop personalities and sometimes abandon or even kill their creators, desiring more than debate. The magical backlash of breaking away from their creators transforms the crystals into emerald eyes.

fluffInfo.name: Trapped Manipulators
fluffInfo.value: Upon transforming, these floating, oval-shaped, pink or purple crystals turn a dark shade of green and gain powers of manipulation. They quickly discover that, though they broke from their creators, they must be bound to a creature to survive.

fluffInfo.name: Shifting Goals
fluffInfo.value: Each emerald eye's motivations are different, though all share a desire for knowledge and varied experiences. One may be purposeful, using its power to drive its bound creature toward some specific goal. Another might be cooperative, defending its bound creature in exchange for mobility. Still another might be a manipulator, using and abandoning bound creatures as it hops up a political power chain.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +6, deception +5, history +6, perception +3, persuasion +5, religion +6
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The emerald eye doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The emerald eye is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Psychically Bound
traits.value: The emerald eye must be psychically bound to a creature to survive. It loses 5 (2d4) hp for every hour it is not bound to a creature or every hour it is more than 30 feet away from its bound creature.

actions.name: Phrenic Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Bind
actions.value: The emerald eye chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 6 or higher. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or the eye psychically binds itself to the target. If the target succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, it knows the eye attempted to bind to it. Otherwise, the target is unaware of the attempt. While bound to the emerald eye, the creature has resistance to psychic damage, but it has disadvantage on saving throws against the eye's Compulsion. The eye can be bound to only one target at a time. If it binds to another, the effect on the previous target ends.

actions.name: Compel
actions.value: The emerald eye magically compels one creature it can see within 30 feet of it to move. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the eye for 1 minute. At the start of each of the charmed target's turns, the emerald eye chooses a direction horizontal to the eye, and the target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its turn. The target can take its action before it moves. The target can't be compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: The Emerald Order cult leader has embraced the mysteries of the Emerald Tablet and has bent its worship of Thoth-Hermes to furthering the efforts of the Order. The cult leader seeks to gather arcane and alchemical knowledge wherever it is found by any means necessary. If subtle manipulations fail, the cult leader is not above using lethal methods to ensure the cult's goals are met.

traits.name: Blessed Weapons
traits.value: The cult leader's weapons are blessed by its deity, and its weapon attacks are magical. When the cult leader hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d8** radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Divine Blessing
traits.value: While the cult leader is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Wisdom modifier to its Armor Class (included above). In addition, it has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Prophetic Tactics
traits.value: The cult leader has advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, at the start of each of the cult leader's turns, one friendly creature within 30 feet of the cult leader has advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of the cult leader's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Emerald Order cult leader makes three Mace or Radiant Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) radiant damage.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Acidic Blood
traits.value: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d6 + 8**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

actions.name: Sling Mud
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d4 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.value: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, restrained, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 (**1d8**) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have grappled also resurfaces.

fluffInfo.value: *This dark cloth of black and purple, stitched with silver and golden threads, resembles a garment of elvish make. Smoke sometimes billows under the hood.*

fluffInfo.name: Silent Motion
fluffInfo.value: A billowing empty cloak glides through the air, either under its own power or on the shoulders of its master. Its movement appears odd somehow, as though it moves slightly out of step with the frame bearing it.

fluffInfo.name: Guards
fluffInfo.value: Created by the shadow fey as unobtrusive guardians, empty cloaks are often paired with animated armor or other constructs like monolith footmen, and made to look like a display piece.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Servants
fluffInfo.value: Shadow fey nobles sometimes wear an empty cloak as their own clothing, using it to cover a hasty retreat or to assist in a kidnapping.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The empty cloak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Diligent Sentinel
traits.value: The empty cloak has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks.

traits.name: Shadow Construction
traits.value: Made mostly of shadow, the empty cloak bursts into pieces then dissipates when a creature scores a critical hit against it.

traits.name: Wrapping Embrace
traits.value: The empty cloak can occupy a Medium or smaller creature's space and vice versa. It has advantage on attack rolls against any creature in the same space as it.

actions.name: Razor Cloak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadow Snare
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. *Hit:* The target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained by tendrils of shadow. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. The tendrils of shadow can be attack and destroyed (AC 12; hp 10; vulnerability to radiant damage; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

bonusActions.name: Protective Embrace
bonusActions.value: When a creature the cloak can see attacks a creature in the cloak's space, the cloak can briefly wrap itself around the creature in its space. The creature in its space takes only half the damage from the attack, and the cloak takes the other half.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: fire, necrotic, poison, radiant; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, prone, restrained

traits.name: Celestial Arsenal
traits.value: The Empyrean brazen bull's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.value: When the Empyrean brazen bull dies, it explodes, and each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 **6d6** fire and 21 (**6d6**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Soulfire Nimbus
traits.value: At the start of each of the Empyrean brazen bull's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (**3d6**) radiant damage. A creature that touches the Empyrean brazen bull or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (**3d6**) radiant damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The Empyrean brazen bull deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Unrelenting Charge
traits.value: If the Empyrean brazen bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving thrown or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the Empyrean brazen bull can make one attack with its bite or hooves against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target., *Hit:* 24 (**3d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Empyrean brazen bull can't bite another target.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**3d12 + 8**) piercing damage and 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 feet., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**3d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage and 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: The Empyrean brazen bull makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the Empyrean brazen bull, and it takes 21 (**6d6**) fire damage at the start of each of theEmpyrean brazen bull's turns. If the Empyrean brazen bull takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Empyrean brazen bull must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the empyrean brazen bull. If the Empyrean brazen bull dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The stag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The stag makes three Ram or Lightburst attacks.

actions.name: Ram
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lightburst
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) radiant damage, and the target is outlined in a golden light, giving attack rolls against them advantage until the start of the stag's next turn.

actions.name: Starcall (1/Day)
actions.value: The stag calls down a magical shower of stars on an area that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide within 120 feet of the stag. Each enemy in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (**8d6**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each other willing creature in that area regains 15 hit points.

The stars then create a 10-foot-high wall of opaque radiant light in that area. Each creature in the wall's space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the stag is incapacitated or dies. Any enemy who enters the wall of light for the first time on a turn must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Starlight Infusion
bonusActions.value: The stag infuses radiant energy into a willing creature they can see within 60 feet of them. That creature deals an extra 5 radiant damage with weapon attacks until the start of the stag's next turn.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The stag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The stag makes three Ram or Lightburst attacks.

actions.name: Ram
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lightburst
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) radiant damage, and the target is outlined in a golden light, giving attack rolls against them advantage until the start of the stag's next turn.

actions.value: The stag calls down a magical shower of stars on an area that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide within 120 feet of the stag. Each enemy in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (**8d6**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each other willing creature in that area regains 15 hit points.

The stars then create a 10-foot-high wall of opaque radiant light in that area. Each creature in the wall's space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the stag is incapacitated or dies. Any enemy who enters the wall of light for the first time on a turn must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.value: The stag infuses radiant energy into a willing creature they can see within 60 feet of them. That creature deals an extra 5 radiant damage with weapon attacks until the start of the stag's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Elementals can be found all over Drakkenheim, often in areas where the eldritch magics are especially concentrated. Many who have encountered these elementals have spoken of the city itself coming to life to attack them. Reports of ruins reaching out and crushing adventurers, burning flames moving and hunting with minds of their own, or contaminated pools lurching to engulf passersby have been heard. Even the blowing air itself has mustered parts of the Haze into shifting clouds that stalk adventurers through the streets. These magical creatures are a constant reminder that nothing in the city can be trusted, and that nowhere is truly safe.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.value: The entropic flame can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the flame or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**1d10**) fire damage. In addition, the flame can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (**1d10**) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (**1d10**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.value: The entropic flame sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The entropic flame makes three hurl flame attacks. Before or after making each attack, the entropic flame can teleport up to 10 feet to a space it can see. It may teleport into a space occupied by another creature.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Touch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (**1d10**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study an Entropic Flame, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Supernaturally Resilient
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Inextinguishable Fires
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the elemental's Dancing Flame action and Flickerjump Bonus Action, as well as its Enduring Flame trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Swift and Senseless
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: An Entropic Flame is a haughty combatant driven by a burning desire to set the world on fire. It teleports from place to place using its Flickerjump, setting alight creatures and objects using its Dancing Flames. If possible, it tries to remain close to Burning targets to keep them on fire within its Enduring Flame aura.

Within the smoking ruins of Drakkenheim, Entropic Flames love to set buildings, furniture, and other objects on fire. They quickly turn the battlefield into a roiling inferno, one which cannot be extinguished easily thanks to their presence.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine an Entropic Watcher, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Guarded Existence
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Imperiling Stare
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Withering Gaze feature.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Physically Resilient
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Entropic Watcher is a keen hunter who, by its very gaze, can cause a creature to grow weak and leave it open for annihilation. The Entropic Watcher focuses its gaze upon its prey and unleashes its eye beams towards it, knowing that if it can hold its gaze, the creature will succumb to the watcher's blasts much easier. It will use its Force Barrier and Shadow Crash to force its victims into an optimal position for it to strike, and grab them with its tendrils, holding them readily in its Withering Gaze.
If the Entropic Watcher is reduced to less than 50 Hit Points, it attempts to flee.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The entropic watcher is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The entropic watcher may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the entropic watcher can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the entropic watcher has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The entropic watcher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the entropic watcher's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Corrupting Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the entropic watcher takes 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The entropic watcher has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Withering Gaze
traits.value: The entropic watcher's eye creates a 150-foot long, 10-foot wide Line of withering magic. At the start of each of its turns, the entropic watcher decides which way the line faces and whether the line is active. Creatures in the Line have Vulnerability to Necrotic damage and can't regain Hit Points.

actions.name: The entropic watcher always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the entropic watcher can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the entropic watcher takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Tendrils**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 40 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The entropic watcher has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

**Insanity Beam (1/Round)**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**4d10**) Necrotic damage, and the beam leaps to another target. The entropic watcher makes another Insanity Beam attack against a new target within 30 feet of the first. A creature can be targeted by only one Insanity Beam per turn. For each additional creature the beam hits, its damage increases by 5 (1d10).

actions.name: Dimensional Glide
actions.value: The entropic watcher moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Shadow Crash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot radius Sphere centered on a point the entropic watcher can see within 150 feet. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: The Sphere's area is filled with magical Darkness for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher uses Shadow Crash again. A creature that ends its turn in the area takes 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Grasp
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature Grappled by the entropic watcher. *Failure:* 16 (**3d10**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Force Barrier
actions.value: The entropic watcher creates a shimmering octarine 10-foot-by-10-foot wall of force centered on a point within 150 feet. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher has the Incapacitated condition or dies. The wall appears in any orientation it chooses, and can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the entropic watcher's choice).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by __Dispel Magic__. A __Disintegrate__ spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The entropic watcher chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The entropic watcher can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: This ancient elvish hermit tends the shrine. Eoghan Ghostweaver is a priest of Morrigan, and keeps the old faith of his goddess. He has a sallow face with skin stretched thin over his cheekbones, is garbed in black feathered robes, and wields a staff of the woodlands.

fluffInfo.value: *The air crackles and lights flicker in the ruins. In a whirl of colorful robes, a gaunt human materializes from the maelstroms of time. His eyes scan the hall in panic, witnessing an event only he can see*.

fluffInfo.name: Adrift in Time
fluffInfo.value: Not much is known about the time-traveling eonic drifters other than that they were humans who left a dying civilization to look for help not available in their own age. To their misfortune, returning to their own time proved much more difficult than leaving it, and the eonic drifters found themselves adrift in the river of time. As the decades passed, their chance of returning home withered, along with much of their vitality. They have become gaunt and semi-mummified by the passing of ages.

fluffInfo.name: Crystal Belts
fluffInfo.value: A drifter carries an odd assembly of gear gathered in countless centuries. It barters with these goods when necessary. The more eclectic the collection, the more jumps it has performed on its odyssey. Belts of crystals around its body store the energy that fuels a drifter's travels. After each large jump through time, the reservoirs are exhausted for awhile, allowing only short jumps.

fluffInfo.name: Jittery and Paranoid
fluffInfo.value: Visiting countless eras in which mankind has all but forgotten their once-great civilization has robbed most eonic drifters of their hope. Their greatest fear is being robbed of their crystal belts, which are their only remaining links to the people they once were. They plead or fight to the death for the belts.

fluffInfo.name: Ruins Dwellers
fluffInfo.value: Drifters can appear at any time or place, but they often frequent the sites of their people's past (or future) cities. There they are comforted by knowing that they're at least in the right place, if not the right time.

actions.name: Time-Warping Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

actions.name: Drift Forward (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The drifter chooses one creature it can see within 5 feet of its future self. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage and is pulled forward in time. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't pulled forward in time. A target pulled forward in time disappears, along with the drifter's future self, as the future self pulls the target with it. At the end of the drifter's next turn, the target and the drifter's future self reappear in the spaces they previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied spaces. When the target reappears, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn as it recovers from the disorienting experience.

bonusActions.name: Call to the Future (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The eonic drifter calls to a future version of itself, which appears in an unoccupied space the drifter can see within 30 feet of it. The drifter's future self acts on the drifter's turn, and each turn it makes one Time-Warping Staff attack against a creature of the drifter's choice or uses the Help action to aid the drifter. The future self can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 30; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage), otherwise it remains until the drifter dismisses it as a bonus action or the drifter finishes a long rest. If the drifter's future self is destroyed, the drifter must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.value: During her first turn, Erestee has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Erestee scores against a *surprised* creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.value: Once per turn, Erestee deals an extra 7 (**2d6**) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Erestee that isn't incapacitated and Erestee doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

bonusActions.name: Unseemly Unseelie

fluffInfo.value: *This small humanoid has a slightly pointed face with bright, brown eyes and a black, snout-like nose. Its skin is covered in short, tan fur, and its head, shoulders, and back have smoothed-down quills.*
Erinas, or hedgehog folk, are a small, communal people.

fluffInfo.name: Burrowed Villages
fluffInfo.value: Natural diggers at heart, erinas live in shallow networks of tunnels and chambers they excavate themselves. Enemies who attack the peaceful erinas become confused and lost in the mazelike tunnels. On their own ground, the erinas can easily evade, outmaneuver, or surround invaders. They lure intruders into choke points where the enemy can be delayed while noncombatants and valuables are hustled to safety through other tunnels. Such choke points are often protected or held by erina defenders, the largest and hardiest of their kind.

fluffInfo.name: Scroungers and Gatherers
fluffInfo.value: Erinas are naturally curious. They tend to explore an area by tunneling beneath it and popping up at interesting points. They dislike farming and live mainly on the bounty of the land surrounding their homes. In cities, they subsist on what they can find, and they have a knack for finding whatever they need.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The erina has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.value: The erina has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Spines
traits.value: A creature that touches the erina or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage. In addition, a creature grappled by or grappling the erina takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage at the start of the erina's turn.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Breath (2/Day)
bonusActions.value: The essence imbues the power of breath in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Hide in Breath.** The Elemental tries to hide inside the body of a creature within 10 feet of them who isn't a Construct, an Elemental, an Ooze, or an Undead. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or the Elemental retreats inside the target until the start of the Elemental's next turn. While inside the target, the Elemental can't take actions and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the target.

**Toxic Breath.** The Elemental exudes a noxious aura 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. That area is lightly obscured, and each creature who needs to breathe who starts their turn in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.

fluffInfo.value: These two-foot-long beetles have shells in a range of reds, yellows, and oranges, with anywhere from eight to twelve black spots on their back. They are often kept as pets and seen as signs of good luck, as they feast on many common garden pests, including the dreaded gimlet. When threatened, they can ooze a noxious-smelling liquid from their carapace to ward off predators.

fluffInfo.name: Fine Familiars

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Excess makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, a target takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage at the start of each of Excess's turns, and Excess can't make a Bite attack against another target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: Excess makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature who they are grappling or hidden from.

If the attack hits, the target is swallowed as Excess enlarges their head and stomach. The swallowed target is no longer grappled, but they are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside Excess, and take 10 (**3d6**) acid damage at the start of each of Excess's turns. Excess can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If Excess dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by them and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: Excess takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *...and that's why we don't go to Slaughterstone Square.* - Lieutenant Petra Lang

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Executioner fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The Executioner is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Executioner has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The Executioner's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the Executioner is destroyed, it returns with all its hit points in 24 hours unless a __disintegrate__ spell is cast on its remains.

actions.name: Guillotine Blade
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 30 (**6d6 + 9**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. Immediately after making a ranged attack, this weapon flies back to the Executioner's hands.

actions.name: Necrotic Vents (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Executioner vents necrotic gas in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails this saving throw by 5 or more gains one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or artisan's tools gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Executioner, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unstoppable Machine
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Executioner's

fluffInfo.name: Immutable Form, Dimensional Anchor, and Rejuvenation
fluffInfo.value: traits, as well as its damage Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Strange Abilities
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Destroyer, Summon Grasping Shadow, and Guillotine Blade actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Powerfully Tough
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Executioner's strongest and weakest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Executioner is not a foe to be defeated, but rather an obstacle to be avoided or a danger to escape. It is a reminder of the callous and uncontrollable dangers present in Drakkenheim. The Executioner's combat tactics vary based on whether it detects low-level characters trespassing in Slaughterstone Square or high-level characters trying to defeat the machine itself. The Executioner pursues its targets within Slaughterstone Square, but never leaves the plaza.

When the Executioner detects creatures trespassing on Slaughterstone Square, it responds first by using Summon Grasping Shadows, followed up by Death Grip to try to prevent their escape. Meanwhile, it uses Lumber Forward to gain ground. You should embrace clever solutions that characters invent to escape or bypass the Executioner. As long as your players aren't trying to destroy it, the Executioner will only use Guillotine Blade against a Restrained target within its melee range, and does not make ranged attacks nor activate its Necrotic Vents aura.

However, should your players engage the Executioner directly in combat, do not pull any punches. They have made an incredibly foolish mistake by confronting a well-telegraphed deathtrap and should be served their just desserts. It activates its Necrotic Vents, and then relentlessly attacks with its Guillotine Blade. The Executioner throws the massive weapon to hit targets trying to avoid it in melee, or those that try to harm it with ranged weapons or spells. If it encounters any impediment in its way (such as a __Wall of Force__), it crushes it with Destroyer.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Fluid, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Blades.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

traits.name: Dimensional Anchor
traits.value: The Executioner can't be teleported or sent to another plane of existence unless it chooses to be.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The Executioner is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the Executioner is destroyed, it reforms with all of its Hit Points 1 minute later unless a __Wish__ spell is used to stop it. A __Wish__ spell used in this manner is always stressful, and the caster must roll to determine whether or not they can cast the __Wish__ spell ever again.

traits.name: Necrotic Vents
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Executioner takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Stoic
traits.value: The Executioner can't take Reactions.

traits.name: Bound to Slaughter
traits.value: If the Executioner begins its turn more than 100 feet away from Slaughterstone Square, it disappears into the Haze and reappears 1 minute later at the center of Slaughterstone Square.

actions.name: The Executioner always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Executioner can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Executioner takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Lumber Forward (1/Round)
actions.value: The Executioner moves up to its Speed.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.value: Spectral chains appear around one creature within 300 feet of the Executioner. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. The condition ends if the Executioner uses Death Grip against a different target

actions.name: Guillotine Blade
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +18, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 45 (**10d6 + 10**) Slashing damage which ignores any __Resistance__ or Immunity to Slashing damage. Immediately after making a ranged attack, this weapon flies back to the Executioner's hands. Critical *Hit:* The target dies unless it has the Epic Resistance action or Legendary Resistance trait.

actions.name: Destroyer (1/Round)
actions.value: The Executioner chooses a Huge or smaller object or structure within 5 feet of it. Alternatively, it can choose a spell or magical effect within 30 feet of it. The object or structure is destroyed, or the spell or effect ends.

actions.name: Summon Grasping Shadows (1/Round)
actions.value: The Executioner targets 1d4 corpses within 300 feet of it. Each target's spirit rises as a __Grasping Shadows__ in the nearest unoccupied space. The spirits act each round on Initiative count 20, and disappear if the Executioner is destroyed.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Executioner chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Executioner can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *I admire their divine focus but it's the controlling you with ghosts thing where they lose me.*

An Exorcist comes prepared to deal with evil entities, sinister spirits, and fearsome fiends. Equipped with their holy symbol, a book of prayers, and a bag of ritualistic baubles, Exorcists stand ready to face the most unnatural and otherworldly entities of the realms. Some Exorcists, however, are so familiar with the ways of the undead, they can summon spirits into hosts. In some rare cases, Exorcists allow demons to inhabit the living.

fluffInfo.name: Exorcists Minions
fluffInfo.value: Exorcists deal with all manner of entities. They can call forth Specters, Ghosts, Demons, Wraiths, and other extraplanar entities. The most horrifying creation of the Exorcist is the Soulbound Host, which occurs when an Exorcist allows themself to be a vessel for demonic, extraplanar, or fairy entities, attempting to harness the power of such beings. Most are driven mad during the process.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I speak to the dead often, sometimes when I am not even sure if they are there..
**Bond:** The understanding of life and death grants us power over the planes that few have dared to grasp.
**Ideal:** It is in control of demons and ghosts that we will transcend to our true potential.
**Flaw:** I am sure I have the strength within me to host a demon or spirit without succumbing to its will.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study an Exorcist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Demons and Undead
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Exorcist's Immunities as well as their Expel Evil action.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Master of Possession
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Exorcist's Grasping Ghost action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak of Character and Body
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Exorcist's Strength and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Exorcist relies on its divine weapons and direct combat skills. They often reside in locations that have natural hazards where they can use their Grasping Ghosts to force enemies into danger. Hazards could include burning braziers, spiked pits, or a pool of blessed acid. If any foe has a summoned creature, the Exorcist dispatches it using Expel Evil, and destroy any undead foes with Last Rites.
If the Exorcist is in a losing situation, they attempt to use Spiritual Healing on themself before fleeing.

traits.name: Blessed Weapons
traits.value: When the Exorcist hits with any weapon, the weapon unleashes holy fire, causing the target to have the Burning condition (4d6 Radiant; included in the attacks below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The exorcist makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Grasping Ghost.

actions.name: Radiant Sword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Radiant).

actions.name: Blessed Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Radiant).

actions.name: Grasping Ghost
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target is moved 30 feet in a horizontal direction of the exorcist's choice. At the end of this movement, the target has the Immobilized condition until the end of the exorcist's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Expel Evil (1/Day)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each Celestial, Fey, Fiend, and Undead that can see and hear the exorcist. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions and must move as far from the exorcist as it can on its turns. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target takes damage, the exorcist has the Incapacitated condition, or the exorcist dies.

actions.name: Last Rites (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet that isn't a Celestial or Construct (Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage). *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Radiant damage. If the target is a Fiend or Undead, it instead takes 64 Radiant damage and is turned to ash if the effect reduces it to 0 Hit Points. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Spiritual Healing
bonusActions.value: One creature the exorcist can see regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. Once a creature benefits from Spiritual Healing, it can't do so again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

fluffInfo.value: An eye crawler is an ambulatory eye that observes everything. It might be spying for something else. An eye crawler has no effective attacks. Mages theorize eye crawlers derive sustenance from light or ambient magical energy.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The eye crawler has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

fluffInfo.value: Eye crows are big corvids plentiful throughout Etharis. They mimic sounds and voices, and they're extremely clever, remembering faces, locations, and how other creatures treat them. People keep eye crows as pets and often use their iridescent black feathers, which have a deep-green sheen, to decorate.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The eye crow can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The eye crow has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the crow's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage. If the eye crow scores a critical hit on a creature, the target is blinded until the end of the crow's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Eye-like sigils dot the smooth, marble skin of this statue. One of the eye sigils opens, and a beam of brilliant light shines out.*

fluffInfo.name: Covered in Arcana
fluffInfo.value: Eye golems stand at least ten feet tall, and their magically durable hide is covered with real eyes as well as arcane sigils that resemble eyes.

fluffInfo.name: Blinds Victims
fluffInfo.value: An eye golem rarely kills its victims, choosing to steal its victims' eyes instead. The victims are left blinded, wandering, and tormented, seeing only visions of the eye golem flashing through their memories. This drives some mad, while others instead choose to serve the golem, becoming devoted to the one who still holds sight.

fluffInfo.name: All Eyes Open
fluffInfo.value: When killed, an eye golem does not simply fall down dead. All of its eyes open at once, and a blinding burst of light shines from the body. When the light stops, hundreds of perfectly preserved eyeballs remain where its body fell, still warm, fresh, and without scars or damage. Detectable only by those trained in the arcane arts, each eye emits a barely perceptible beam of light, connecting it to its owner. The creature that holds the golem's central eye after it is slain can use the eye to restore stolen eyes to their victims.

traits.name: Blinding Demise
traits.value: When the golem reduces a creature to 0 hp, it can blind the creature permanently. If it does so, the creature is reduced to 1 hp instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Gaze of Ancient Light (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The golem opens all of its eyes and emits a burst of blinding light. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (**10d6**) radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Primal Voice of Doom
actions.value: The golem intones a disturbing invocation of the sun god at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The ravenfolk scout can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Peck
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rapier

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ghost Wings
actions.value: The ravenfolk scout furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is the physical body of an apothecary who has willingly allowed an extraplanar creature to possess them, trapping the powerful outsider in a mortal form. Powerful yet vulnerable, Soulbound Hosts loathe their creators. They wander the world for the means to reverse the curse of mortality placed upon them and return to their otherworldly domains.

Exorcist and Alienist apothecaries do not primarily study the body, and rarely practice the type of magic and science which leads to mutant horrors and flesh-stitched abominations. They are instead concerned with the supernatural forces of the mind and soul. Many research and contact powerful extraplanar entities, eager to possess mortals as a means of entering the material world. These apothecaries learn how to create Soulbound Hosts as a powerful means to contain and fight back against these dangerous otherworldly foes.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Gambit
fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is usually created under truly desperate circumstances, such as when a heroic apothecary faces a dangerous otherworldly being such as a demon, fey, spirit, or inscrutable entity from the Space Between Worlds. Not only are these planar invaders pernicious foes, many are effectively immortal—often these creatures simply reform when killed outside their native planes. Thus, an apothecary who lacks the ability to defeat the demon on their own, or who wishes to defeat a powerful outsider in a more permanent fashion, may instead decide upon a heroic act of self-sacrifice by turning themselves into a Soulbound Host.

fluffInfo.name: Preparing the Trap
fluffInfo.value: Using an array of implanted metals, ingested tinctures, mental preparations, and occult incantations, a skilled apothecary may willingly prepare their body for possession. During the process, the apothecary can weave a unique spiritual trap. It then falls to the apothecary to convince the otherworldly creature to possess them, an act that many outsiders are eager to do. Thus, the canny apothecary preys on the ego of the monster itself.

fluffInfo.name: Mortal Curse
fluffInfo.value: When the outsider inhabits the body, the apothecary's soul departs, leaving the extraplanar creature to take their place spiritually. If this mortal form is killed or destroyed, the bound creature does not simply return to their plane of origin. Instead, the spirit departs to the afterworlds like any other mortal soul, losing their accumulated otherworldly power forever. Thus, the Soulbound Host becomes both a prison and a death sentence for the other wielding being tricked into the apothecary's body.

fluffInfo.name: Rogue Hosts
fluffInfo.value: Unfortunately, this act of self-sacrifice is not without its imperfections. The apothecary's body is filled with otherworldly essence, and while the creature's power is greatly diminished, they often remain extremely dangerous—allies of the departed apothecary may still find it challenging to slay the Soulbound Host. Many escape, wandering the world with stolen lives and even assuming the identity of their host while they search for the means to escape their now mortal form. All bound outsiders are painfully aware of their new mortality, frustrated that returning to their planes of origin is not a simple matter of destroying their flesh-cage or switching their essence into a different host, one which lacks the binding wards placed by the apothecary.

fluffInfo.name: Price of Freedom
fluffInfo.value: Trapped outsiders can win their freedom by calling back the soul of the apothecary who trapped them, and resurrecting them into their body. This is a thing many outsiders are loathe to do out of fiendish ego, since it puts the original soul in a bargaining position. In this way, the apothecary can force the spirit to accept a bargain which requires them to remain in their own worlds for at least the duration of the apothecary's lifetime.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion*, *Medicine*, or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Soulbound Host, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Possessed Body
fluffInfo.value: You know the Soulbound Host's type and damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Extraplanar Magic
fluffInfo.value: Depending on the type of spirit, you learn either the Hellfire Chain, Illusory Assault, or Psychic Barrage actions, as well as the Spellcasting trait of the host.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Cursed Fate
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its desperation caused by its spirit-bound mortality and its Reactions.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is a careful combatant. Though powerful, the last thing they want is to be killed in their mortal form. If they are seriously injured, they often attempt to bargain, offering power and knowledge to assailants who spare them.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The host makes two Enchanted Strike attacks.

actions.name: Enchanted Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Illusory Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the host. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the host's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Faerie Step
bonusActions.value: The host teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

fluffInfo.value: When a will-o'-wisp basks in the eternal sunset of the Plane of Fey, a change overcomes the malevolent spirit that lies at its heart. In place of a wisps' despair, a faerie develops a guileful and mischievous cunning.

These faeries often pair themselves with more powerful creatures, such as a fey queen with a penchant for collecting waifs and strays, or a territorial suneater owlbear. They act as a lure for such a creatures, coaxing unwary wanderers to follow their cheerful nimbus. If all goes according to the faerie's plan, both faerie and host will gain a meal from this symbiotic mutualism.

**Immunities**: radiant, poison; blinded, charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralysed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Bright
traits.value: When the faerie-o'-fire isn't invisible, it sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.value: The faerie-o'-fire can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The faerie-o'-fire can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Solar Flare
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage. Until the end of the creature's next turn, the creature sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet, attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature can't benefit from being invisible.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The faerie-o'-fire magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

bonusActions.name: Consume Life
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the faerie-o'-fire can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the faerie-o'-fire regains 10 (**3d6**) hit points.

traits.name: Fey Touched
traits.value: Magic can't put the faevlin to sleep. Only a creature of the fey type can cause the faevlin to become charmed, and a faevlin always knows if a non-fey creature attempted to render it charmed.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.value: The faevlin can use a bonus action to take the Hide action.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Cold damage. *Success* Half damage.
