traits.name: Flesh Bond
traits.value: As long as the fleshcrafter and its flesh golem are within 120 feet of each other, the fleshcrafter can communicate with it telepathically. In addition, whenever the fleshcrafter casts a spell with a range of touch while within 120 feet of the golem, the golem can use its reaction to deliver the spell as if it had cast the spell, using the fleshcrafter's spell attack modifier and save DC. Whenever the fleshcrafter takes lightning damage, the golem regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Frenzy Control
traits.value: While the fleshcrafter is alive and conscious, its flesh golem can't go berserk. If the fleshcrafter dies, its flesh golem immediately goes berserk.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

entries: **Languages**: Speaks and understands all languages, Telepathy 120 ft. (can communicate only with other fleshcrawlers or infected creatures)

traits.name: Infect Humanoid
traits.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 15 A creature Restrained in a fleshcrawler's fleshwebs for 1 hour. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition for 1d4 days. While a creature has the Charmed condition in this way, the fleshcrawler can issue telepathic instructions that the creature does its best to obey. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from the fleshcrawler, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the Charmed condition on a success. A creature with the Charmed condition can make a save to end the effect at the end of each day.
If a creature is still Charmed at the end of the duration, it dies, and its body transforms into a flesh cocoon gestating a new fleshcrawler that hatches in 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The fleshcrawler makes two attacks, using Fleshwarp Strike and Necrotic Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Fleshwarp Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Necrotic damage and the target has the Restrained condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the Restrained target rolls a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) to end this condition.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) Necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Fleshwebs (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15 One creature the fleshcrawler can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 15; HP 15; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).

fluffInfo.value: *Flesh-Crafted Amalgam of Knight and Horse*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Affixing a bridle to a fleshdobbin causes the instincts of the horse within the amalgam to take over, becoming a loyal steed once more.

traits.name: Bridle Binding
traits.value: If a creature puts a bridle on the fleshdobbin (treat as securing Manacles), the fleshdobbin has the Charmed condition while it wears the bridle, and it can't take the bridle off on its own.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The fleshdobbin can't shape-shift.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The fleshdobbin makes one Claw attack and one Wailing Halberd attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Wailing Halberd
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) Slashing damage plus 5 (**1d10**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Psychic damage. In addition, the target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages known by the target

actions.name: Strangle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **2d8 + summonSpellLevel** Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC) and can't speak. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and is Suffocation.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: The fleshling construct constricts a target that it is grappling, doing **2d8 + summonSpellLevel** Bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Languages**: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak them

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The flintclaw has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.value: If the flintclaw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the flintclaw can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.value: The flintclaw's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The flintclaw makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Obscuring Form
traits.value: Other creatures in the swarm's space are blinded.

traits.name: Shrink
traits.value: When the swarm is reduced to half their hit points, their size becomes Large.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.value: The swarm has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The swarm makes three Flutter Cutter attacks.

actions.name: Flutter Cutter
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 26 (**6d6 + 5**) slashing damage, or 33 (**8d6 + 5**) slashing damage if the target is a Construct made of stone or is holding or wearing an object that emits bright light.

bonusActions.name: Devour Stone
bonusActions.value: The swarm feeds on a mundane object or structure within 5 feet of them that is made mostly of stone.
If the swarm targets a Medium or smaller object, it is entirely devoured. If the swarm targets a structure or a Large or larger object, the swarm devours a 5-foot-cube portion of it.

entries: **Skills**: animal handling +4, medicine +4, nature +3, perception +4, stealth +4

traits.name: Body Bite (1/Day)
traits.value: While the spirit has at least 5 hit points, a friendly creature can use a bonus action to take a bite out of the spirit. The spirit takes **1d4** piercing damage, and the creature regains a number of hit points equal to the damage taken.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The spirit regains 2 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Push
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This mass of fused corpses resembles a butterfly with wings of skin, limbs of bone, and a head formed of several different skulls. The dark magic that formed this abomination swirls around it hungrily.*

fluffInfo.name: Bound by Necromancy
fluffInfo.value: Flutterfleshes are created in terrible necromantic rituals. Cultists gather in the name of a dark god, powerful lich, or crazed madman, and forever bind themselves body and soul into a single evil being. Flutterfleshes take recently severed limbs and fuse these new pieces to themselves in accordance with some unknowable aesthetic.

fluffInfo.name: Dilemma of Flesh
fluffInfo.value: The most horrifying thing about a flutterflesh, however, is its devious nature. A flutterflesh offers its prey the choice to either die or lose a limb. If it accepts the limb, the flutterflesh then leaves the victim alone. One can always tell where a flutterflesh resides because so many of the locals are missing appendages.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Merciful Exchange
traits.value: If the flutterflesh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack, it can cut off one of the creature's limbs. If it does so, the target is reduced to 1 hp instead.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The flutterflesh's weapon attacks are magical. When the flutterflesh hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The flutterflesh regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the flutterflesh takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the flutterflesh's next turn. The flutterflesh dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The flutterflesh has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The flutterflesh doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The flutterflesh makes three Bone Spur or Tormenting Gaze attacks. If two Tormenting Gaze attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bone Spur
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d12 + 4**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage, and the flutterflesh impales the target on one of its bone spurs, grappling the target (escape DC 16). The flutterflesh can have no more than two creatures impaled at a time.

actions.name: Tormenting Gaze
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Creeping Death (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The flutterflesh emits a wave of necromantic energy, hastening the journey toward death. Each creature within 20 feet of the flutterflesh must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature below half its hp maximum has disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: A Tinge Lucky (1/Day)
traits.value: The spirit can choose to grant itself advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the weapon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the weapon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal weapon.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the weapon takes 10 or more fire damage in a single instance, it falls prone and, until the end of its next turn, it is incapacitated and its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The weapon makes two melee attacks. It has one of the following attack options, depending on its anatomy.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

actions.name: Maul
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

actions.name: Pike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The flying polyp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The flying polyp makes up to four Grasping Tentacle attacks and uses Wind Blast (if available).

actions.name: Writhing Tentacles
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**1d10 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 24). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Wind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 24, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the flying polyp can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Cold damage and the target is pushed up to 30 feet away from the flying polyp in a straight line. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Grasping Wind
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 24, on creature within 2,000 feet. The flying polyp must have an unblocked line between it and its target, but the line does not need to be straight. The polyp does not need to see the target. *Failure:* The target's Speed is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased until the end of the flying polyp's next turn. *Success* No effect.

bonusActions.name: Invisibility (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The flying polyp gains the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This person has goatlike legs, small horns partially hidden beneath a hood, and a mouth full of rows of serrated teeth. Its clothes are a mixture of heavy leathers and bright silks.*

fluffInfo.name: Dimensional Merchants
fluffInfo.value: The folk of Leng are interplanar merchants and avid slavers, trading silks, rubies, and the magic-infused stones of Leng for humanoid slaves. They sail between worlds in peculiar ships with split, lateen-rigged masts and rigging that howls like the damned in high winds. They are said to befriend Void dragons, heralds of darkness, and other servants of the Void.

fluffInfo.name: A High Plateau
fluffInfo.value: Leng is a forbidding plateau surrounded by hills and peaks. Its cities are places which some claim have fallen into ruin, and which others claim to have visited in living memory.

fluffInfo.name: Love of Nets
fluffInfo.value: When in combat, the folk of Leng use nets woven from silk taken from their enemies, the spiders of Leng.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The folk of Leng can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Leng Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the folk of Leng dies on the Material Plane, it gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again, unless it is killed with radiant damage wielded by a good-aligned creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water within 24 hours of its death. The folk's new body appears in its family's crypt in Leng.

traits.name: Mortal Void Traveler
traits.value: The folk of Leng doesn't require air or ambient pressure.

traits.name: Phrenic Weapons
traits.value: The folk of Leng's weapon attacks are magical. When the folk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d6** psychic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The folk of Leng regains 2 hp at the start of its turn. If the folk of Leng takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the folk's next turn. The folk of Leng dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Psychic Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Hooked Spider Net
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage, and the target is restrained. While restrained, the target takes 5 (**1d10**) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature, including the restrained target, can take an action to remove the net by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the creature breaks the net instead, and the folk of Leng can't use the broken net again until it finishes a long rest.

bonusActions.name: Etherealness
bonusActions.value: The folk of Leng enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

fluffInfo.value: A cowardly bandit, ready to rob a defenceless victim, but capable of ambushing a lonely companion with the help of others.

traits.name: Gang Tactics
traits.value: The Footpad has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Footpad's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Great Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Visceral Sight
traits.value: The force of blood can see any creature within 120 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. This sight ignores effects that obscure sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The force of blood makes three Scarlet Longspear attacks. They can replace one attack with a Rend from Within attack.

actions.name: Scarlet Longspear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, the force of blood regains 5 hit points.

actions.name: Rend from Within
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) slashing damage plus 26 (**4d12**) necrotic damage, and the target spends 1 Hit Die with no effect and can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. Miss: 13 (**2d12**) necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Blood
bonusActions.value: The force of blood imbues the power of blood in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Boiling Blood.** The Elemental boils the blood of a creature within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target must choose to either take 27 (**5d10**) fire damage or make an attack with a weapon that has a damage die of **1d4** or greater against a creature of the Elemental's choice. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 11 (**2d10**) fire damage.

**Essence Thief.** The Elemental steals the essence of two creatures the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 19 (**3d12**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The Elemental can then teleport to an unoccupied space they can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.

traits.value: The force of earth can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the force of earth doesn't disturb the material they move through.

fluffInfo.value: *A relatively diminutive giant stalks beneath the forest's dark canopy, large spear in hand.*

fluffInfo.name: Painted Skin
fluffInfo.value: Roughly the size and shape of an ogre, the forest marauder is covered in paint or colored mud. An exaggerated brow ridge juts out over close-set eyes, and corded muscle stands out all over the giant.

fluffInfo.name: Keep to the Wilderness
fluffInfo.value: Cruel and savage when encountered, the forest marauders' demeanor has worked against them, and they have nearly been driven to extinction in places where they can be easily tracked. They have since learned to raid far from their hidden homes, leading to sightings in unexpected places.

fluffInfo.name: Orc Friends
fluffInfo.value: Forest marauders get along well with orcs and goblins, who appreciate their brute strength and their skill at night raids.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage

fluffInfo.name: Covetous Origins
fluffInfo.value: During the Age of Arcanum, magic inspired a deep arrogance in many of the gods' children, who assumed arcane gifts were proof of inevitable divinity. In response, many mortal folk experimented with manufacturing "life" of their own. The dwarves succeeded first, marrying divine gifts with technical skill to animate autonomous wardens as protectors of their ancestral halls. The dwarves' knowledge was quickly stolen and expanded upon by other folk, and creating golems eventually became less about proving that mortals can shape life as the gods do, and more about protecting life, wealth, and secrets from others.

fluffInfo.name: Forge Guardian
fluffInfo.value: Just as dwarves created the earliest golems, the __The All-Hammer__ fashioned forge guardians to guard the divine furnaces and hearths that designed the first dwarves. Shaped from extravagant marble and fused with adamantine, crafted with impeccable detail and care, these rare and massive constructs exemplify the highest form of artistry that every Exandrian blacksmith, forgemaster, and artisan spends a life-time hoping to achieve.

fluffInfo.name: Divine Spark
fluffInfo.value: A faceless, tireless being of immense strength, a forge golem is gifted life by a single shard from the __The All-Hammer__ own divine spark, lovingly kept safe inside a ring of arcane flame and ancient sigils. The __The All-Hammer__ divinity is akin to a volcano inside the golem, turning the construct's blood into lava. Fire no longer harms the construct, but instead heals it.

fluffInfo.name: Sacred purpose
fluffInfo.value: Where it looms over a divine forge, a forge guardian's appendages end in a stretched set of hooked forceps and a rune-adorned blade. The golem can assist a blacksmith in creating new golems, or it can trample, bludgeon, push, and knock down any who threaten this sacred process of creation.

Forge golems also serve as opponents for any wishing to engage in the __The All-Hammer__ trial of worthiness. A golem's attacks blind prospective heroes, who must then earn back their vision by risking a deadly counterattack.

fluffInfo.value: *When encountering a Fractal Lepidoptera, characters can get stranded in the Border Ethereal Plane. This has the potential to derail a campaign. Here are a few suggestions on how to run this scenario instead:*

entries: When the lepidoptera dies, the fabric of reality temporarily weakens and everyone can safely return to the Prime Material Plane.

Immediately after the lepidoptera dies, the party needs to succeed in a skill challenge to traverse the veil between the planes. Each character can contribute to the skill challenge by suggesting actions that they take to help find the veil, withstand the pull of the Ethereal Plane, and open a gate.
The group succeeds if they make 4 successful DC 15 skill checks before 3 failures.
The characters must harvest the animus of the lepidoptera and craft a fractal key.

fluffInfo.name: Lair effect
fluffInfo.value: Fractal Lepidoptera transform reality around them, manifesting the following effect:

fluffInfo.name: Quantum Entanglement
fluffInfo.value: Creatures taking a Long Rest within 1 mile of the lepidoptera must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or gain a pattern effect. Creatures can repeat the saving throw at the end of each Long Rest once they are outside the range of Quantum Entanglement. Casting __Lesser Restoration__ or similar spells of higher level on an affected creature can remove the pattern effect.

table.title: Fractal Lepidoptera Patterns
rows: Something unseen hampers you. You gain the Staggered condition.
On each of your turns, you can only walk in straight lines in the direction of either north, south, east, or west.
Your hands start to flutter uncontrollably. You gain the Clumsy condition.
You can only speak in haikus, rhyming couplets, or iambic pentameter.
You float an inch above the ground. Your walking Speed is unchanged and Difficult Terrain does not affect you.
You gain the ability to see polarized light and the ultraviolet spectrum. You see invisible objects and creatures, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a lepidoptera, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Mothlike Features
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Phototaxis trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Chaotic Patterns
fluffInfo.value: You learn the lepidoptera's Quantum Entanglement and Tessellation features.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Multidimensional
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Multidimensional Presence and Incomprehensible Vision features.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Creature of Energy
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Vulnerabilities and Energy Form trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The lepidoptera flies through creatures while making Fractal Wing attacks, scattering foes with its Energy Form trait. If at least one enemy is Staggered, it targets them with Tessellation. The lepidoptera uses Criss Cross to protect itself from attacks on the border Ethereal Plane.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The lepidoptera is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lepidoptera may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the lepidoptera can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lepidoptera has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The lepidoptera is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the lepidoptera's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Energy Form
traits.value: The lepidoptera can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature is moved 20 feet in a random direction.

traits.name: Incomprehensible Vision
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lepidoptera and can see it is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* The target is transported to the Border Ethereal. If the target is already on the Border Ethereal, they are transported to the Material Plane instead.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert their eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of their turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the lepidoptera until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the lepidoptera in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Multidimensional Presence
traits.value: If the lepidoptera is reduced to 0 Hit Points but hasn't taken damage from a source on both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal in the last round, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Phototaxis
traits.value: If a source of Bright Light is within 100 feet of the lepidoptera, it attempts to move closer to the light on its turn.

traits.name: Unraveling Reality
traits.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera when it dies. *Success* The target is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

actions.value: The lepidoptera makes two Fractal Wing attacks.

actions.name: Fractal Wing
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**5d10 + 7**) Force damage.

actions.name: Tessellation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera that doesn't have Total Cover. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Force damage, and the target begins its next turn by moving up to its Speed in a random direction.

If the target has the Staggered condition, it instead takes no damage, that condition ends, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). While Incapacitated, the target mutters rhymes in a singsong voice and dances to an unheard rhythm, moving up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of each of its turns.

fluffInfo.value: *This slight creature resembles a goblin, but its blue skin and the icicles hanging from the tip of its long nose speak to the chilling truth.*

The fraughashar are a race of short, tricky, cruel fey who inhabit cold mountainous regions. Fraughashar have light blue skin, short pointed ears, and needlelike teeth. Delighting in mayhem, they always seem to have devilish grins on their faces.

fluffInfo.name: Sacred Rivers
fluffInfo.value: The fraughashar view cold rivers and river gorges as sacred places in which their wicked god Fraugh dwells, and they likewise revere the snowy peaks where the Snow Queen holds sway. They are fiercely protective of their territory, and their easy mobility over frozen and rocky terrain lets them make short work of intruders.

fluffInfo.name: Chilling Tales
fluffInfo.value: The origin of the strange and deadly fraughashar is unclear. Some druidic legends claim the fraughashar were born out of a winter so cold and cruel that the spirits of the river itself froze. Bardic tales claim that the fraughashar are a tribe of corrupted goblins, and that they were permanently disfigured during a botched attempt at summoning an ice devil. Whatever the truth of their beginnings, the fraughashar are cruel and merciless. They kill anyone who enters their land.

traits.name: Deft Snow Walk
traits.value: The fraughashar can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check, and difficult terrain composed of ice and snow doesn't cost it extra movement. In addition, the fraughashar has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone while in icy or snowy terrain.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Fast and Dangerous

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dangerous Hunter

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics

So loud are their screams and screeches that it often attracts other Dregs and monsters to the area. Frenzied Dregs rarely flee; they pursue their enemies through Drakkenheim up to the edges of the Haze.

Creatures within the area of one or more explosions must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) cold damage and is restrained for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. Objects within this area take 28 (**8d6**) cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: *"They took the sled dogs first, and later the seal-skinner set to guard them. We'd hear a confused, muffled cry in the wind and then we'd find them—a raven harvest, cold and stiff on the ice. Next time, we hid ourselves and watched, and we saw them floating through the air like kites. A wisp of blowing snow that never dispersed, a billowing, snowflake sail moving with sinister purpose. The 'cloak of death' our guide called it."*

Whipped through the air by snowstorms and resembling a spider's web dangling with delicate ice crystals, these silently gliding, beautiful killers are semi-sentient plants adapted to the merciless cold of the north.

fluffInfo.name: Cloak of Death
fluffInfo.value: Flat nodes shaped like large snowflakes connect the frostveil's netlike body and trailing tails of transparent fibers. Gossamer tendrils stream behind and between the flying snowflakes, ready to grab and entangle any warm-blooded creature the frostveil detects.

fluffInfo.name: Seek Warmth
fluffInfo.value: Each starlike node contains crude sensory organs, able to detect warmth as meager as a living creature's breath and steer the gliding web toward it.

fluffInfo.name: Spirit Spores
fluffInfo.value: Northern shamans say the dance of the frostveils is beautiful when lit by the northern lights and a powerful omen. With great care, shamans sometimes harvest frostveils for their frozen spore-shards, which grant potent visions of the spirit world when melted on the tongue.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold; blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone

traits.name: Chilling Acidic Body
traits.value: A creature that touches the frostveil or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (**1d8**) acid damage.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.value: While engulfing a creature, the frostveil takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the engulfed creature takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the frostveil remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a formation of frost and ice.

traits.name: Windborne
traits.value: In windy conditions, the frostveil's flying speed increases to 30 feet. In a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour), its flying speed increases to 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The frostveil makes two Frozen Tendril attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the frostveil uses Snowy Engulf on it.

actions.name: Frozen Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Snowy Engulf
actions.value: The frostveil engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded and restrained, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the frostveil's turns or take 4 (**1d8**) acid damage and 3 (**1d6**) cold damage. If the frostveil moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The frostveil can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

actions.name: Spirit Spores (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The frostveil releases a puff of psychotropic spores around itself. Each creature within 10 feet of the frostveil must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) cold damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. When an incapacitated creature moves, it moves in a random direction. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Fungusfeaster

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The fungusfeaster can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Fungiphage

Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Bitterfrost Cyclone (1/Day)
actions.value: Galnafur whips up a bone-chilling cyclone that swirls around her for up to 10 minutes. The cyclone generates and repositions up to 3 feet of snow in a 15-foot radius that moves with her, creating Difficult Terrain for Large and smaller creatures. Additionally, the cyclone protects Galnafur from projectiles. All but the heaviest Ranged weapon attacks targeting her are made at Disadvantage. If she takes damage, she makes a *Concentration* check to maintain the cyclone. Otherwise, the cyclone lasts for the duration, until Galnafur is Incapacitated or spends a Bonus Action to end the effect.

bonusActions.name: War Cry (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Spirits of Gold and Stone
fluffInfo.value: The gantii'kaas are reclusive fey, serving the same role in the earth that dryads play in the woods. Rather than being bound to purely natural environments, the gantii'kaas are drawn to mines and to other subterranean stonework. The typical gantii'kaas is arrogant, vain, and proud—quick to anger, but also highly susceptible to flattery. If a gantii'kaas is pleased with the mortals that work in its domain, it might seed the stone with ore or gems. But should it feel unappreciated, or that the mortal miners are too greedy, a gantii'kaas can strip the bounty from the soil, trigger a collapse, or worse...

fluffInfo.name: Subjects of the King
fluffInfo.value: The gantii'kaas of the Graywall Mountains are subjects of the archfey known as King Greyfinger. Each watches over their stretch of stone on behalf of their monarch, and they expect tribute from those who work in the depths. If a miner takes something from the earth, they should leave a gift for the gantii'kaas and their king. Such a tribute can be simple—a single coin, a fresh-baked pie. The gesture matters more than the monetary value of the offering; it's about showing gratitude for what's taken from the stone.

fluffInfo.name: Voices in the Stone
fluffInfo.value: A gantii'kaas can shape stone and meld into it. These fey can also speak to stones, imbuing them with a temporary, rudimentary (some might say sedimentary) sentience. This gift also allows a gantii'kaas to remain aware of its surroundings even while melded with stone; the earth whispers to it, telling it everything that is happening in the vicinity.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The gantii'kaas has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Stone
traits.value: The gantii'kaas can communicate with rocks and stones as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Blinding Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 , reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eruption of Stone (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot Cube centered on a point the gantii'kaas can see on the ground within 120 feet. *Failure:* 19 (**3d12**) Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, and the ground in the target area becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared. Each 5-foot-square portion of the area requires at least 1 minute to clear by hand. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Training

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: Gargaths are massive bison-like creatures native to the Gargan Steppe in the land of Firnveldt. They are gentle creatures, herded by nomads who care for them and harvest their wool and milk.

traits.name: Cold Tolerance
traits.value: The gargath can exist comfortably in temperatures as low as −50 degrees Fahrenheit. It has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to resist effects that deal cold damage.

traits.name: Stampede
traits.value: If the gargath moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is knocked prone, the gargath can then make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Ram
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. *Hit:* 21 (**3d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Maggoty Hide
traits.value: A creature attacking the garmr in melee that is adjacent to the garmr is subject to the maggots crawling over its rank fur. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots, taking 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns. An infested target can make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the maggots are burnt away if it takes at least 5 Acid or Fire damage. After the creature successfully saves or the maggots are burnt away, it has Immunity to this trait for 1 hour.

traits.name: Pack Tactics

actions.name: Earth Rending Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature in a 20-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only. Unattended objects and structures in the area are not allowed a saving throw, they take double damage, and the howl ignores their damage threshold.

bonusActions.name: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature within 5 feet of the garmr. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots (see Maggoty Hide).

fluffInfo.value: Once thought to be related to gnolls, garmyr are bipedal canids unique to the Haze-ridden ruins of Drakkenheim. Often covered in thick fur, their colouration and features vary from hound-like to wolf-like, but all bear sharp teeth and claws. They form hyper-aggressive and predatory warpacks equipped with weapons taken from the many failed military attempts to reclaim the city. These beasts revel in their countless battles with adventurers and the Hooded Lanterns. The garmyr warpacks have made the Inner City their hunting ground, but have been sighted roving the countryside with increasing frequency. They live for the thrill of the hunt, and mock and taunt their prey as they chase them down. Though the warpacks are prone to infighting, a massive beast known as the __Lord of the Feast__ rules the garmyr as their overlord, master, and god.

traits.name: Rampage

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Once unleashed, the Garymyr Berserker uses Aggressive to close with its chosen target, using Howl indiscriminately then swinging away with its axes. Once engaged, the berserker is a mindless killer, and will attack the closest target to itself—whether an enemy or ally. Due to its madness, a berserker never flees.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Garmyr Bloodhound prefers to stick to rooftops and vantage points; moving from place to place, choosing a target, and hitting it with its barbed shot. The bloodhound chooses a quarry and focuses its attention on that target. Often, they are accompanied by other Garmyr who handle the ground assault, while the bloodhound focuses on slowing targets and using its allies to gain Advantage. If its target flees, the Bloodhound marks it as its quarry and leads the hunt after it.
If the Garmyr Bloodhound sees its allies losing, it flees before its enemies can reach its vantage point.

It attempts to position itself in a central location so its Aura of the Blood Moon trait affects as many targets as possible. It will use its Blood Call to target creatures from range; only when it has more than one ally on a target does the Thaumaturge consider running in and attacking in melee.
The thaumaturge will attempt to escape any situation where it is cornered or forced into melee, and if its soldiers numbers are dwindling, it will flee to recuperate.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Garmyr warriors fight as a pack, following their leader on the hunt. They choose the juiciest, most delicious-looking target as their prey, favoring unarmored or feeble-looking creatures. Garmyr group up and focus their attacks until they bring down their target, unless a more dangerous threat prompts them to respond.

Garmyr crave blood and close-quarters battle, closing the distance to attack with their bites even when it may be more advantageous for them to keep their distance using their spears. Garmyr don't stop attacking a foe once they've downed them—they start feasting instead. Garmyr make Bite attacks against downed foes in the midst of battle, making Unconscious and dying characters especially vulnerable to the Garmyr's appetites.

Garymr are mostly heedless in battle unless their numbers are significantly cut down. Although they prefer to start battles when they outnumber their enemies, they flee as the fight turns against them. However, Garmyr might also attempt to flee once they've secured a meal—a group of Garmyr who manage to down one character in a group might decide to scoop up the victim and enjoy their meal elsewhere rather than continuing to fight.

fluffInfo.value: *This blue-black freshwater crab scuttles through the mud by the stream, searching for prey.*

*Common to the Argent upriver from the Free City of Zobeck, garroter crabs are used by the Kariv and crab diviners in their divinations. The Kariv treat the crabs as sacred creatures and never eat them. However, local Zobeckers hold no such notions and find them quite delectable. Much larger garroter crabs exist, and the Kariv believe these incredibly rare crabs can be used to shape the future, as well as divine it.*

fluffInfo.name: Strangling Claws
fluffInfo.value: Garroter crabs are named for their abnormal right claws, which have evolved over time to strangle prey like a barbed whip. This long whip-claw is lined with powerful muscles and joints at the beginning, middle, and end that give it great flexibility.

fluffInfo.name: Clacking Hordes
fluffInfo.value: During mating season, thousands of garroter crabs congregate in remote riverbanks and marshes, and the males whip their shells with a loud clacking sound to attract mates. Familiar with the sound, locals avoid the rivers and streams near their homes during such times.

fluffInfo.name: Tasty Predators
fluffInfo.value: Garroter crabs prey on rodents, cats, and other small animals caught by the riverbank. Considered a delicacy by many, fishing communities near colonies of garroter crabs often have a few skilled fishers capable of bringing in the dangerous crabs.

fluffInfo.name: Unknowing Diviners
fluffInfo.value: Garroter crabs are touched by minor divination power that typically triggers when the crabs attack humanoids, though some humanoids have found ways to prepare the crabs' remains to create the same effect. Because of this peculiar ability, scholars speculate the crabs were created long ago as tools of divination or were gifted by some long-forgotten deity of fate to its followers.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The garroter crab can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Strangling Divination
traits.value: A Humanoid reduced to 0 hp while grappled by the garroter crab experiences a brief vision of the future. This effect works like the divination spell, except the reply is only as a mental vision and it can be about any specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 30 days. Once a creature has received a vision in this way, it can't do so again for 30 days.

actions.name: Whip-Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target can't speak or cast spells with verbal components, and the crab can't use its Whip Claw on another target.

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.value: The gasdra has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, or Unconscious conditions. The gasdra can take one Reaction for each of its heads. The extra Reactions can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: While the gasdra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gasdra makes three Beak attacks.

actions.name: Beak

actions.name: Pact Blade

fluffInfo.value: *This large reptile has dagger-like teeth and a scaly hide of shifting colors.*

fluffInfo.name: Chameleon Crocodiles
fluffInfo.value: While distantly related to crocodiles, gbahali have adapted to life away from the water. To make up for the lack of cover, gbahali developed hides that shift to match their environments. Gbahali hide changes color to match its surroundings so perfectly that it becomes nearly invisible. Any lonely rock on the grassland might be a gbahali waiting along a trail, caravan route, or watering hole. Their thick hide can be made into hide or leather armor, and with the proper alchemical techniques it retains some of its color-shifting properties.

fluffInfo.name: Strong Hunters
fluffInfo.value: Gbahalis are powerful predators, challenged only by rivals too large for a gbahali to take down or by predators that hunt in packs and prides, such as lions and gnolls. Gbahalis live solitary lives except during the fall, when males seek out females in their territory. Females lay eggs in the spring and guard the nest until the eggs hatch, but the young gbahali are abandoned to their own devices. Killing an adult gbahali is a sign of bravery and skill for many plains hunters.

fluffInfo.name: Sentries and Stragglers
fluffInfo.value: In combat, a gbahali relies on its camouflaging hide to ambush prey. It may wait quietly for hours, but its speed and stealth mean it strikes quickly, especially against weak or solitary prey. Its onslaught is strong enough to scatter a herd and leave behind the slowest for the gbahali to bring down.

traits.name: Shifting Camouflage
traits.value: The gbahali's hide adapts to its current surroundings. The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in nonmagical, natural terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gbahali makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gbahali can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The bronze and mithral figure advances with heavy movements. Its eye lenses glare a golden hue, and gears click when it swings its greatsword.*

fluffInfo.name: Mechanical Champion
fluffInfo.value: An intricate construction of bronze, steel, copper, and mithral, the gearforged templar is an imposing sight. A humanoid spirit contained in a soul gem animates the heavy body of gears and springs. Gearforged are relatively rare, and the templar is a paragon among them.

fluffInfo.name: Tireless Defender
fluffInfo.value: The gearforged templar is relentless in pursuit of its duty. More so than other gearforged, the templar becomes fixed on its charge to the exclusion of distractions and even magical coercion. Gearforged templars serve as commanders of military or guard units, bodyguards for important individuals, or personal champions for nobility.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The gearforged templar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gearforged templar makes four Greatsword or Javelin attacks. If two Greatsword attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the templar. The templar can choose not to push a creature.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The gearforged templar whirls its greatsword in a great arc. Each creature within 10 feet of the gearforged must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (**5d10**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: Gegazol can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Gegazol fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Gegazol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If destroyed while her soul vessel remains intact, Gegazol's unconscious body rejuvenates within 5 feet of the soul vessel, where she regains 78 (12d12) hit points each day. When she has regained half her hit points, she regains consciousness.

traits.name: Stench
traits.value: Any creature not immune to the poisoned condition that starts its turn within 30 feet of Gegazol must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the start of that creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to Gegazol's stench for 1 hour.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: Gegazol and undead within 120 feet of her have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Gegazol can use her frightful presence. She then makes three attacks: one with her bite and two with her claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**2d12 + 8**) piercing damage, 9 (**2d8**) cold damage and 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.value: Each creature of Gegazol's choice within 120 feet of and aware of her must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Gegazol's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Breath of Long Night (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Gegazol exhales frozen material and rot in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) cold damage and 45 (**10d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Those who fail the save also gain two levels of exhaustion until the end of Gegazol's next turn, and those who fail by 5 or more are also blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Acidic Touch
traits.value: At the start of the gelatinooze's turn, it can choose to secrete a small dose of acid (no action required). Each creature that is grappling it or that it is grappling takes acid damage equal to the gelatinooze's Constitution modifier.

traits.name: Dissolve Metal (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: Over the course of 1 minute, the gelatinooze can dissolve up to 1 pound of nonmagical metal it is touching.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) acid damage.

traits.name: Dungeon Born
traits.value: The geleton has advantage on any ability checks it makes to locate or identify hidden features of dungeons, such as traps or secret passageways.

traits.name: Ooze Ancestry
traits.value: The geleton doesn't need to breathe. The geleton doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The geleton has advantage on saving throws against disease.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The geleton makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

entries: **Resistances**: acid; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The gem jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gem jelly makes two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod (True Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Crystalline Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
actions.value: The jelly shatters their hardened outer layer, returning to their true form and sending crystal shrapnel in all directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the gem jelly must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (**8d8**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Gem jellies are immune to this damage.

bonusActions.name: Harden
bonusActions.value: The gem jelly transforms into a psionically hardened crystalline form or back into their true form. While in crystalline form, the jelly's AC increases to 20, their speed becomes 0, they can't make Pseudopod attacks, they have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and they gain vulnerability to thunder damage.

entries: **HP**: 8 + eight times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

traits.name: Flowing Jelly
traits.value: The jelly can occupy their caregiver's space and vice versa, and it doesn't count as difficult terrain for them.
While occupying the same space as the jelly, the caregiver can take the Hide action to hide from creatures outside the jelly.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Pseudopod)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The jelly makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and the jelly can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Crystallize (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The jelly grows sharp crystals from the ground in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the jelly. Until the start of the jelly's next turn, that area becomes difficult terrain for their enemies, and when an enemy moves into or within that area, the enemy takes 2 × PB piercing damage for every 5 feet they travel.

actions.name: 5th Level: Shatter (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The jelly ejects jagged crystals from their body toward each enemy within 10 feet of them.
Each target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The commoner's long jump is 30 feet, and its base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Team Tactics
traits.value: The commoner can take the Help action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage

entries: **Languages**: the languages its staff knew in life

traits.name: Alluring Affluence
traits.value: Whenever a humanoid ends its turn within 60 feet of the stall, it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has no hint that it is gradually falling under the effects of the stall's enchantment. If a creature succeeds on three of these saves, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. If the creature fails three of these saves, it becomes charmed by the stall and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the stall as possible. The effect lasts for 24 hours or until the stall dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or ends the effect on the creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Dedicated Staff
traits.value: The stall comprises a staff of 5 (2d4) __seed coin pollinators__. This staff collectively shares the stall's Innate Spellcasting and Magic Resistance traits, they can't willingly move more than 150 feet away from the stall, and they seek to defend the stall at all costs, including to their own peril. Some of the stall's effects can use a member or members of its staff as the point of origin.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: The stall is indistinguishable from a normal merchant stall. However, a creature that has truesight sees a deep red aura radiating from the stall, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a __detect poison and disease__ spell senses the insidious nature of the stall and knows it is a plant creature.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The stall has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.value: The stall doesn't require sleep. If the stall spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. If the stall dies, it decomposes and is reduced to dirt within 7 days.

actions.name: Enthralling Vines
actions.value: The stall causes dark, creeping vines to protrude from itself and its staff, lashing out at creatures nearby. Each creature of the stall's choice within 10 feet of it or a member of its staff must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the vines for 1 minute. While restrained in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the stall's Alluring Affluence. A creature restrained by the vines can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength check, freeing itself on a success. These vines disappear if the stall dies, or if it uses this action again. It can also choose to end the effect early on any number of restrained creatures it chooses as a bonus action.

actions.name: Hostile Takeover
actions.value: The stall attempts to magically compel one creature charmed by it that is within 5 feet of the stall or a member of its staff to swallow a __seed coin__. The target must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target swallows the coin and is subjected to the seed coin's Infestation. When subjected to the effect in this way, the diseased creature is killed in a number of hours equal to half its Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. If the target successfully saves against this effect or the effect ends for it, it regurgitates the coin and is no longer charmed by the stall, and it is immune to the stall's Alluring Affluence for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *This large water-striding insect resembles a strange cross between a camel and a wingless, long-legged locust. A large hollow in the small of its back holds enough space for a rider.*

*Since the elven retreat from Midgard almost 500 years ago, many of the gerridae have gone feral, and while normally shy and docile, they can attack in furious swarms if hunted or surprised in their claimed territories. Some enterprising elfmarked Barsellan pirates have domesticated them and use the water striders as chasers and boarding craft when taking on Bemmean and Septime ships.*

fluffInfo.name: Elvish Water Steeds
fluffInfo.value: Known by their Elvish name, these large fey water striders were enchanted and bred by the elves in ages past, when their explorers roamed the world. Elven mages started with normal water striders and—through elaborate magical procedures and complex cross-breeding programs—transformed the mundane water striders into large, docile mounts. They can cross large bodies of water quickly while carrying a humanoid rider, even in windy conditions.

fluffInfo.name: Fond of Sweet Scents
fluffInfo.value: Gerridae can sometimes be distracted by appealing scents, such as from apple blossoms or fresh hay. They are also fond of raw duck and swan.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 40 Ft., *swim* 80 Ft. (20 Ft. When Walking On Land)

traits.name: Bred to the Saddle
traits.value: The gerridae can't be charmed or frightened while it has a rider.

traits.name: Water Bound
traits.value: For every hour the gerridae spends on dry land, its hp maximum is reduced by 2 (1d4).

traits.name: Water Walker
traits.value: The gerridae can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground. This trait works like the __water walk__ spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gerridae makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Gerta can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Gerta can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: Gerta has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Patterned Feathers
traits.value: Gerta has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks when she attempts to hide in a forest.

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Gerta has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Gerta makes two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage. Gerta can choose to grapple a target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Brave
traits.value: The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Ephemeral Body
traits.value: The crawler can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Seer's Strand
traits.value: The crawler can see and hear through the space of its Ether Webs as if it were in that space.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.value: The crawler ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the crawler knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crawler makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the Poisoned condition until the start of the crawler's next turn.

actions.name: Ether Webs (2/Day)
actions.value: The crawler fills a 5-foot Cube with Invisible, ephemeral webs for 8 hours. If the web isn't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself and vanishes. When a creature touches the webbing, the crawler knows the location of the creature as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The dragon can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Horrifying Presence

If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself of a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Horrifying Presence for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a __greater restoration__ spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Chilling Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon exhales deathly cold energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (**18d6**) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: *The skeleton's armor creaks as its decaying mount shifts and emits a ghostly whinny. The skeleton sets its lance, skulls dangling from the hilt, and charges.*

fluffInfo.name: Servants Beyond Death
fluffInfo.value: Some orders of knighthood require service after death; ghost knights are one such group. Both the willing and the conscripts enter the order as living men and women, and those who serve bravely and loyally for five years or more are "raised up" into the ranks of the undead by their undead lords, becoming fully-fledged ghost knights.

fluffInfo.name: Undead Mounts
fluffInfo.value: To advance through the ranks of the order, the ghost knight accepts the blessing of undeath, which extends to its mount. Riding an undead warhorse (use the statistics of a warhorse skeleton), the ghost knight is a dangerous foe, spearing enemies with its lance and trampling foes under its mount's hooves.

traits.name: Locked Saddle
traits.value: The ghost knight can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

traits.name: Mounted Warrior
traits.value: The ghost knight is rarely seen without its warhorse skeleton mount. The warhorse skeleton wears custom barding that raises its Armor Class to 15, and it has immunity to necrotic damage. While the ghost knight is mounted, its mount can't be charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The ghost knight's weapon attacks are magical. When the knight hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d6** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Spirited Charge
traits.value: If the ghost knight moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits with a Lance attack on the same turn, the ghost knight can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The ghost knight and any undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The ghost knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ghost knight makes three Battleaxe or Lance attacks. If the ghost knight is mounted, it can make two Battleaxe or Lance attacks, and its mount can make one melee weapon attack.

actions.name: Lance

fluffInfo.value: *A pasty-white spider the size of a horse slinks through the shadows. It fades from sight with a ghostly blue shimmer.*

Ghostwalk spiders are malevolent hunters that sprang from misguided experiments on phase spiders. They are spindly, emaciated things all but devoid of color. The spider is 8 feet in diameter (including legs) and weighs 500 pounds.

fluffInfo.name: Phantom Webs
fluffInfo.value: Ghostwalk spiders spin ephemeral webs in secluded areas. They spend most of their time stalking prey to paralyze and drag back to their phantom web. As long as these remains lie tangled in ghostly webs, they go unnoticed by most creatures, but the spiders eventually cast old kills aside. Adventurers are wise to fear empty caves containing unexplained, desiccated remains.

traits.name: Ghostly Body (Ghostwalk Form Only)
traits.value: The ghostwalk spider has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it has immunity to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (Ghostwalk Form Only)
traits.value: The ghostwalk spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spider Climb

fluffInfo.value: *Several pony-sized ants swarm around an ant the size of a draft horse, clacking their serrated mandibles and threatening with their stingers.*

Giant ants look much like a normal ant with six legs, a waspish segmented body, and large antenna. Their hides are covered in thick chitin, and they have large, serrated mandibles flanking their mouths and stingers on their tails. These stingers are the size of a shortsword, and they're capable of stabbing and poisoning a human to death.

fluffInfo.name: Colony Defenders
fluffInfo.value: Giant ants form colonies under the control of a queen much like their normal-sized cousins. Sterile females form castes with the workers building the nest and caring for larvae. Queens and male drones rarely leave the colony. Soldiers defend the colony and forage for food.

fluffInfo.name: Carry Prey Home
fluffInfo.value: Giant ants are both predators and scavengers, working in organized groups to bring down large prey and carry it back to the nest. Giant ants tend to ignore animals away from the colony when not foraging for food, but they quickly move to overwhelm prey when hungry or threatened. A giant ant stands nearly four feet tall and weighs 400 pounds, while a giant ant queen is over five feet tall and weighs 900 pounds. Giant ants communicate with each other primarily with pheromones but also use sound and touch.

fluffInfo.value: Giant antlions are the kinds of creatures that inspire nightmares. Like their smaller relatives, giant antlions hide in sand or other loose earth, and wait to ambush hapless passersby with their deadly jaws, which resemble a massive, chitinous bear trap.

fluffInfo.name: Desert Trappers
fluffInfo.value: Once it has found a suitable location, an antlion will then set its trap. Juvenile and adult antlions will even dig a steep, conical pit lined with loose sand, creating a hazard that prey can easily slip and tumble down, rolling directly into the beast's waiting jaws.

fluffInfo.name: H'rethi Specimens
fluffInfo.value: In stark contrast to other regions, giant antlions of the H'rethi Desert seem to roam the dunes and dig their traps by night, resulting in occasional night ambushes and making it impossible to track their ever-changing territory.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Furry Monstrosities
fluffInfo.value: You understand these creatures have an excellent sense of smell, Darkvision, and are capable climbers and swimmers. They are Immune to Contamination, but have no other special Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Grab and Bash
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Giant Ratlings Hurl Ratling and Enrage actions.
