fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Giant Ratling will charge any enemy it sees that threatens its burrow or gets in its way. The ratling will Enrage and start hurling other ratlings at its enemy as it charges forward, bearing down on the creature with claws and teeth. These brutes are relentless in their attacks, and generally much braver—or dumber—than other ratlings. They are unlikely to flee from harm.
If the rest of the ratlings begin to flee, the Giant Ratling will follow, but it will usually be the last to turn tail as it enjoys pummeling and gnawing on flesh a bit too much.

traits.value: The gibbering mouther is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Primordial Influence
traits.value: A dazed enemy who starts their turn within 20 feet of the gibbering mouther must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature's body is altered in an otherworldly way of the GM's choice—they might flicker in and out of reality, sprout miniature fingers from their fingers, or have their physical form altered in a similarly alien way. This alteration doesn't affect the creature's game statistics. A cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect reverses this alteration.

On a failed save, their previous alteration worsens or they experience another chaotic alteration of the GM's choice. If a creature fails this saving throw three times after their initial alteration, they transform into a gibbering mouther controlled by the GM, and only a __wish__ spell can restore the creature to their original form.

traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Gil can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Gil lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Gil cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or sheilds (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Aerial Defense
traits.value: As long as Gil is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against him have disadvantage.

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Gil has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This tall, bronze-complexioned man is abnormally long-limbed and clad in armor of stained and battered coins. His wiry frame is festooned with mismatched bracelets, rings, and necklaces, each gaudier than the last.*

fluffInfo.name: Servants of Mammon
fluffInfo.value: Rarely seen in their natural form outside of Hell, gilded devils are the servitors of the devil‑god Mammon, Lord of Greed. They tempt and corrupt with promises of wealth and power, twisting mortal greed into sure damnation.

fluffInfo.name: Impression of Wisdom
fluffInfo.value: When pursuing a mortal of high standing, gilded devils prefer unassuming appearances, molding their flesh and gaudy trappings to make themselves look the parts of wise advisers, canny merchants, or sly confidants. Even in their humblest form, gilded devils always wear a piece of golden jewelry or a jeweled button or ornament.

entries: **Skills**: deception +9, history +5, insight +7, persuasion +9, sleight of hand +5
**Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Languages**: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the gilded devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Golden Flail
traits.value: The gilded devil's Golden Flail attacks are magical. When the devil hits with the Golden Flail, the flail deals an extra **4d6** fire damage (included in the attack). In addition, the devil can transform the flail into gold jewelry or back into a weapon as a bonus action.

traits.name: Liar's Largesse
traits.value: If a creature accepts a gift of jewelry from the gilded devil, the creature becomes cursed until cured by a __remove curse__ spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the devil's spells and abilities.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The gilded devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gilded devil makes two Golden Flail attacks or three Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Golden Flail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (**4d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) fire damage.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: The gilded devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Voracious Greed
actions.value: The gilded devil magically consumes up to 1 cubic foot of nonmagical jewelry or coins made of precious material within 5 feet of it. It regains 5 hp for every 200 gp of the consumed objects' value. If the jewelry or coins are being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the consumption.

bonusActions.name: Betrayal of Riches (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: One creature wearing jewelry (an object made of precious material and worth at least 100 gp) the gilded devil can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 13 (**3d8**) bludgeoning damage and suffers an effect until it finishes a short rest. The effect is based on the location of the worn jewelry (devil's choice if worn in multiple locations): on upper limbs, its melee damage is halved; on lower limbs, its speed is halved; on head, it is blinded or deafened (devil's choice); on body, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't suffer an additional effect.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The gilitrutt troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gilitrutt troll makes two Bite or three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Hound Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Claw (Troll Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: The gilitrutt troll shape-shifts into a Large hound (Speed 40 ft.), or it returns to its troll form. Its game statistics, other than its size and Speed, are the same in each form (except where noted). Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Occupation
traits.value: Counsellor, Seer

traits.name: Distinctive Features
traits.value: Grim, Wary

traits.name: Frigid Aura
traits.value: Nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the troll are snuffed out. Ongoing magical flames, such as those from a __Flaming Sphere__ or __Wall of Fire__ spell, also have a chance of being snuffed out. If any part of such a magical flame overlaps with the aura, the caster must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. *Failure:* The spell ends. If the caster succeeds on the save, they do not need to make additional saves for that casting of that spell.

traits.name: Icy Carapace
traits.value: A creature within 5 feet of the troll that hits it with a melee attack takes 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The glacial troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the glacial troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the glacial troll's next turn. The glacial troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The glacial troll makes three Ice Rend attacks. It can substitute one Ice Rend attack with its Hoary Breath.

actions.name: Ice Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Hoary Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16 One target within 5 feet of it. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6**) Cold damage, and the target has the Restrained condition for 1 minute due to ice forming around it. A creature with the Restrained condition can make a DC 16 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns to break free from the ice, ending the Restrained condition.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: The bulette can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Steam Aura
traits.value: At the end of each of the bulette's turns, each creature of the bulette's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the bulette takes 5 (**1d10**) Fire damage unless the bulette has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The bulette can burrow through solid ice and leaves a slick, 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d12 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: If the bulette is burrowed no more than 20 feet deep in solid ice, it spends 5 feet of movement to burrow directly upward, emerging from the ice and jumping to a space within 5 feet of where it emerged. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in the space where the bulette emerged or its destination space. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: The target is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the bulette emerged or its destination space.

fluffInfo.value: *A near-transparent crocodilian creature leaps from the water, the remnants of its last meal still visible in its transparent gut.*

fluffInfo.name: Strange Anatomy
fluffInfo.value: The body of a glass gator is most similar to a centipede, but with four oversized forelimbs and a more distinct head. Once the glass gator gets hold of prey, it wraps its body around the victim and squeezes, like a constrictor snake. Unlike a serpent, however, which uses powerful muscles to crush and suffocate its prey, the glass gator is only trying to bring its underbelly into contact with the prey. The glass gator's belly is lined with hundreds of stingers that deliver a virulent nerve toxin.

fluffInfo.name: Transparency
fluffInfo.value: The glass gator's transparency isn't total. Its digestive tract usually is visible, especially for a few hours after it eats. The creature sometimes uses this limited visibility as bait, making itself appear as a wriggling snake or eel. It is most vulnerable just after eating, when it's lethargic.

fluffInfo.name: Larval Form
fluffInfo.value: Subterranean variants—including some with bioluminescence—have been reported in caverns. It's been postulated that the glass gator may be the larval form of a larger creature, but what that larger creature might be is unknown.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The glass gator can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Constricting Lunge
traits.value: If the glass gator jumps at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the gator can make one Constrict attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The glass gator's long jump is up to 15 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.value: The glass gator has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide while underwater or in dim light.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 5 (**2d4**) poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and the glass gator can't use Constrict on another target.

fluffInfo.value: These over one-foot-long beetles have mirrored shells and translucent bodies that make them look as though they are made of living glass. The males of this species can play the insides of their wing casings like a glass harp to issue a hauntingly beautiful song used to call mates.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The everbug has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Shatterbite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* **1** piercing damage + 3 (**1d6**) thunder damage.

actions.name: Glass Song (1/Day)
actions.value: The glassbeetle weaves a strange and beautiful melody, which it can maintain for up to 10 minutes, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Creatures within 100 feet of the glassbeetle who can hear this song must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or become charmed by the glassbeetle for as long as they can hear the music.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, Sylvan, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Glinda can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Glinda lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Glinda cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Glinda can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Glinda can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Seedspeech
traits.value: Glinda can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d6 - 1**) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (**1d8 - 1**) bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

fluffInfo.value: *Blighted Treant*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Carving the Sylvan name of the forest the gloomwood once called home into the creature's trunk quells its aggression.

traits.name: Blighted Aura
traits.value: The ground in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the gloomwood is Difficult Terrain from mushrooms and fungus that grow in the area. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation takes 5 (**1d10**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Carved Past
traits.value: As an action, a creature can use a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve the name in Sylvan of the ancient home of the gloomwoods into the gloomwood's trunk. Until the gloomwood finishes a Long Rest, it can't use its Fungal Fling or Spore Stomp actions.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.value: The gloomwood ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gloomwood makes two attacks, using Slam or Fungal Fling in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of two branches. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Fungal Fling
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 60/180 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**5d6 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spore Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. *Hit or Miss:* Each creature within a 20-foot Sphere centered on the target must make the following saving throw. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 0 Ft. All +10 Ft. In Dreamscape, *fly* 20 Ft. (hover)
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Phantasmal Cone
traits.value: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (**4d10**) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

traits.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
traits.value: When the dreamholder takes 15 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Dreameater
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 49 (**8d10 + 5**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.value: The dreamholder shoots five of the following magical eye rays at random (roll a d6 to determine which ray isn't fired), choosing one to five creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries: **1. Charm Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.
**2. Confusion Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

**3. Static Ray**: The target must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**4. Rot Ray**: The target must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 28 (**8d6**) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

**5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 30 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 36 (**8d8**) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

**6. Nightmare Ray**: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw, taking 44 (**8d10**) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.
**Resistances**: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The seraph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Seraphic Weapons
traits.value: The seraph's weapon attacks are magical. When the seraph hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra (**2d8**) radiant damage (included in the attacks).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The seraph makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**3d12 + 5**) piercing damage and 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the seraph can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage and 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) bludgeoning damage and 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18) and pulled to within 5 feet of the seraph. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the seraph can't use its tongue or bite on another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: The seraph makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it holds grappled. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the grapple ends, and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, a creature is blinded and restrained, has Cover against anything originating outside the seraph, and takes 18 (**4d8**) acid damage and 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage at the start of each of the seraph's turns. The seraph can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the seraph takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the seraph must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the seraph. If the seraph dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: *A bear trap springs to clacking life, ready to tear flesh.*

fluffInfo.name: Hopping Motion
fluffInfo.value: All steel and springs, a gnarljak is easily mistaken for a simple bear trap when lying dormant. But once it starts hopping in pursuit of a target, it reveals its animated nature and its only motivation: destruction of living things.

fluffInfo.name: Endless Snapping
fluffInfo.value: Gnarljaks are mindless. They do not grow tired. They exist only to pull creatures to the ground and chew through them, then turn around and chew through them again.

fluffInfo.name: Defensive Traps
fluffInfo.value: Some try to use gnarljaks to guard treasures or booby-trap approaches to important locations, but their indiscriminate biting makes them quite dangerous to their owners as well. Certain monsters, such as redcaps and shadow fey, use gnarljaks with some regularity, and gnomes are very fond of making them part of a standard tunnel defense.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The gnarljak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the gnarljak remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bear trap.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gnarljak makes one Gnawing Bite attack and two Chain Tail attacks, or it makes three Chain Tail attacks.

actions.name: Gnawing Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage, and the gnarljak attaches to the target. While attached, the gnarljak can't make Gnawing Bite attacks, and at the start of each of the gnarljak's turns, the target takes 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage.

The attached gnarljak moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the gnarljak's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the gnarljak by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.

actions.name: Chain Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Secure Tail
bonusActions.value: When within 10 feet of the ground, structure, wall, or other solid surface, the gnarljak can secure its tail spike on a point in the surface within 10 feet of it. While secured, the gnarljak can't be knocked prone, it can't move more than 10 feet from that point, and its Chain Tail attack's reach is reduced to 5 feet. If the gnarljak is attached to a creature while its tail is secured, the creature is restrained until the gnarljak is no longer attached to it.

traits.name: Bloodscent
traits.value: The abyssal archer knows the location of each creature who doesn't have all their hit points within 60 feet of them.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target's walking speed is reduced by a cumulative 5 feet until they regain at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The summoner makes two attacks using Bite, Three-Tail Flail, Fire Blast, or a combination of them. They can replace one attack with a use of Demonic Howl, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, another creature the summoner can see within 30 feet of them magically regains 7 (**2d6**) hit points. If this attack is made against a willing ally, it automatically hits.

actions.name: Three-Tail Flail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**3d4 + 4**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the summoner.

actions.name: Fire Blast (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Demonic Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Until the beginning of the summoner's next turn, each ally within 30 feet of the summoner who can hear them has advantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Uplift (3/Day)
actions.value: The gnoll magically turns an allied __abyssal hyena__ into a __gnoll marauder__ for 1 hour.

bonusActions.name: Summon Abyssal Hyenas (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: The summoner summons 1d4 + 1 __abyssal hyena__s, who appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the summoner. The hyenas act immediately after the summoner's turn and follow the summoner's commands.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bonesplitter makes two attacks using Bite, Spiked Flail, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Bloody Roar, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage if the target is restrained.

actions.name: Spiked Flail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the bonesplitter can't make Spiked Flail attacks.

actions.name: Bloody Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The bonesplitter roars, spitting a spray of blood. Each ally within 10 feet of them who can see them can make a weapon attack (no action required), provided that ally isn't incapacitated.

bonusActions.name: Over Here!
bonusActions.value: The bonesplitter yanks a creature they are grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or swap spaces with the bonesplitter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bonesplitter makes two attacks using Bite, Spiked Flail, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Bloody Roar, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage if the target is restrained.

actions.name: Spiked Flail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the bonesplitter can't make Spiked Flail attacks.

actions.name: Bloody Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The bonesplitter roars, spitting a spray of blood. Each ally within 10 feet of them who can see them can make a weapon attack (no action required), provided that ally isn't incapacitated.

bonusActions.name: Over Here!
bonusActions.value: The bonesplitter yanks a creature they are grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or swap spaces with the bonesplitter.

traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gnoll brute hits with it (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Charge
traits.value: If the gnoll brute moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, the target takes one extra die of the weapon's damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

traits.name: Instinctive
traits.value: The gnoll brute has advantage on initiative rolls and saving throws against being charmed or frightened. If surprised, the gnoll can still act normally on its first turn.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.value: When the gnoll brute reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gnoll brute makes one bite attack and one claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cackler makes one Bite attack or one Chill Touch attack and uses Moment of Brutality.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Chill Touch (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the cackler's next turn.

actions.name: Moment of Brutality
actions.value: The cackler targets a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, magically flooding them with fury. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, which they can choose to fail. A creature who can't be charmed succeeds on this saving throw automatically. On a failed save, the target takes 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage, then makes a Bite attack against a creature of the cackler's choice within 5 feet of the target. If the target has no Bite attack, they make an unarmed strike that deals piercing damage equal to **1d4** + their Strength modifier on a hit.

actions.name: Fiendish Cackle (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The cackler unleashes a spine-chilling laugh. Each enemy within 30 feet of them who can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the cackler for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

entries: **HP**: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, intimidation +0 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus damage. Beginning at 7th level, the gnasher can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Frenzied Bite (3/Day)
actions.value: When a creature the gnasher can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the gnasher can use a reaction to move up to half their speed and then make a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Flurry of Fangs (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the gnasher makes a signature attack against up to PB creatures within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: 7th Level: Horrific Feast (1/Day)
actions.value: When the gnasher reduces a creature to 0 hit points with their signature attack, they can consume part of the creature as part of the attack, gaining **PBd10** temporary hit points. Each enemy within 30 feet of the gnasher who can see them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the gnasher until the end of the gnasher's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *A sprinting gnoll laughs as it runs, axe held high and flashing in the sun.*

With the bristly mane and spotted fur characteristic of all gnolls, havoc runners blend into their tribe. Only the canny glint in the eyes hints at the deadly difference before the havoc runner explodes into violence.

fluffInfo.name: Blinding Raids
fluffInfo.value: Havoc runners are scouring storms across the trade routes that crisscross the tribe's territory. Like all gnolls, they are deadly in battle. Havoc runners incorporate another quality that makes them the envy of many raiders: they can tell at a glance which pieces of loot from a laden camel or wagon are the most valuable, without spending time rummaging, weighing, or evaluating. Their ability to strike into a caravan, seize the best items, and withdraw quickly is unparalleled.

traits.name: Harrying Attacks
traits.value: If the gnoll attacks more than one creature in the same turn, the first target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The gnoll has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the gnoll's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gnoll makes one Bite attack and two Battleaxe attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Lightning Lope
bonusActions.value: The gnoll takes the Dash or Disengage action.

traits.name: Life Eater
traits.value: When an enemy the mage-gorger can see within 30 feet of them regains hit points, the mage-gorger chooses one non-minion ally they can see within 30 feet of them. That ally regains 2 hit points.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the mage-gorger takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mage-gorger takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Wizard Ripper (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 slashing damage plus 2 acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage (mage-gorger's choice), and until the start of the mage-gorger's next turn, the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain *concentration*, including any Constitution saving throw triggered by this attack. Only one damage type is chosen for this attack regardless of how many mage-gorgers joined it.

traits.name: Rampaging Charge
traits.value: If the marauder moves at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and hits them with a Flail attack on the same turn, the marauder can make a Bite attack against that target as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Flail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Death Feast
traits.value: When an ally within 5 feet of the wildling is reduced to 0 hit points, the wildling can deal 1 piercing damage to a creature within 5 feet of them (no action required), provided the wildling isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the wildling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the wildling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Flail (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and the target is grappled by each wildling who joined the attack (escape DC 10 plus the number of wildlings who have it grappled). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the wildling can't make a Flail attack against another creature. A wildling can choose to release the grappled creature while other wildlings still have them grappled, reducing the escape DC accordingly.

fluffInfo.value: *The maniacal-looking gnome before you has a large cask‑shaped apparatus strapped to his back. He stares intently with jaundice-yellow eyes and a too-wide grin. Half of the gnome's once-glorious red mustache has clearly been burned away, probably by acid*.
Gnomish distillers unlock the destructive secrets within alchemical reagents and brew them into highly volatile solutions.

fluffInfo.name: Strange Science
fluffInfo.value: Gnomish distillers are driven by the pursuit of knowledge and believe that all reagents, magical or otherwise, including shadowstuff, can be distilled to a more potent version of their natural state. The quest to unlock the secret nature hidden within all things has frequently led to catastrophic destruction in the name of natural philosophy.

fluffInfo.name: Wyrd Alchemy for Sale
fluffInfo.value: Wyrd gnomes embrace the darker side of invention, and gnomish distillers epitomize this trait. Distillers weaponize the knowledge gained from alchemical pursuits by creating deadly solutions, sprays, poisons, and explosives to sell to the highest bidder.

traits.name: Prescience
traits.value: When the gnome finishes a long rest, roll a d20 and record the number rolled. Before their next long rest, they can replace one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by them or a creature that they can see, using this prescience roll. They must choose to do so before the roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gnome uses Dispensing Apparatus and makes one weapon attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Acidic Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 11 (**2d10**) acid damage.

actions.name: Dispensing Apparatus
actions.value: A gnomish distiller carries a backpack-like apparatus designed to expel a variety of damaging mixtures. While wearing the apparatus, a distiller can create one of the following effects, the same effect cannot be used twice in a row:

entries: The apparatus expels a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous gas centered on a point the distiller chooses within 30 feet. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The gas lingers in the air for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or spend its action that turn retching and reeling.

The apparatus expels a shower of a caustic solution in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction of the distiller's choice. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The apparatus expels slick grease in a 10-foot square centered on a point the distiller chooses within 30 feet. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

bonusActions.name: Alchemical Capsule
bonusActions.value: The gnome breaks one of two capsules, contained in artificial teeth, and immediately gains the benefits of the stored potion. Either choose which two potions the gnome has or assume they have a potion of invisibility and a potion of growth.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The gnoph-keh has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gnoph-keh makes six Rending Claw attacks.

actions.name: Rending Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, Reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**1d8 + 7**) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Heart of the Storm
bonusActions.value: The gnoph-keh can generate a supernatural storm that fills the area around it in a howling blizzard. Driving snow and wind fill the area in a 300-foot Emanation centered on the gnoph-keh. The area is Heavily Obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused. This effect ends if the gnoph-keh has the Incapacitated condition or dies. It can also dismiss the effect as a Bonus Action.
A creature that ends its turn in this Emanation takes 3 (**1d6**) Cold damage.

entries: **Languages**: understands Dwarvish but can't speak it

traits.name: Summoned Nature

traits.name: Sure-Footed

fluffInfo.value: *This hunched, man-like figure lurches with a strange, half-hopping gait. Tattered clothing hangs from its muscled shoulders, and its legs are those of a ram, ending in cloven hooves.*

fluffInfo.name: Trespassers on the Rites
fluffInfo.value: The first of the goat-men was the victim of a powerful curse intended to punish him for spying on magical rites exclusive to the women of his tribe. Admiring the grotesque result, the Black Goat of the Woods With a Thousand Young adopted him as its servant, and ensured that all who committed the same taboo fell to the same curse, and thus into the Black Goat's service.

fluffInfo.name: Bleating Speech
fluffInfo.value: A goat-man's head is tusked, adorned with curling ram's horns, and its beard often drips with gore. Rows of transparent, needle-like, malformed teeth fill its mouth, making clear speech impossible for goat-men.

fluffInfo.name: Serve Foul Cults
fluffInfo.value: Cultists of Shub-Niggurath or the Black Goat in good standing are sometimes granted the services of a goat-man. The creatures guard ritual sites, visit settlements to capture or purchase suitable sacrifices, and perform certain unspeakable acts with cult members to call forth ritual magic.

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The folk who venerate the Old Ways believe that a seven-pointed star repels gobblegeists. They keep the monsters at bay by painting or weaving star sigils from wicker to hang from their homes or in trees.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

fluffInfo.value: A Goblin Archer is an Orc chosen for his keen eyes. His ability to see in the dark, coupled with a steady hand, lets him shoot arrows with precision by night or day.

fluffInfo.value: *The Royal Crypts below Castle Drakken housed the bodies of kings and queens, dukes and nobles of generations gone. They were tended by the many gravekeepers who worked diligently to light the lanterns below so the dead could have safe passage to the light. I shudder to think what has become of those crypts, and their keepers, in these dark times.* - Overheard from a party of nobles in the Red Lion Hotel

The Gravekeeper is a hovering mass of writhing appendages. Amongst its horrid and grotesque form one can make out the many faces of long lost gravekeepers of Castle Drakken, but their expressions are twisted in horror of their last moments, and their eyes are hollow with a dim octarine light emanating from within. Covering the floating mass are hundreds of arms, several of them holding softly glowing lanterns. The lanterns glow with octarine flames that cast flickering shadows across the crypt. The Gravekeeper wanders amongst the dead, awakening them into grasping souls, clawing their way out of the many graves amongst the lordly tombs of the castle.

traits.name: Dazzling Illumination
traits.value: The Gravekeeper projects a brilliant corona of light which sheds bright light to a range of 60 feet, and causes attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the Gravekeeper is incapacitated or has a speed of 0.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Gravekeeper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lantern Blast
actions.value: Magical octarine beams flash from the Gravekeeper's many lanterns. Each beam has a different power. Each creature within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper which is not behind Cover rolls a d6 to determine which colour ray affects it. The DC for all saving throws is 18:

entries: **1. Dispelling Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) psychic damage, and any spell or magical effect upon the target ends. A creature who fails this saving throw has their *concentration* broken on any spell they were actively maintaining.
**2. Forceful Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) force damage, be pushed 20 feet away, and knocked prone.

**3. Blinding Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) radiant damage and be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
**4. Contaminating Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) necrotic damage and gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

**5. Igniting Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) fire damage, and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 35 (**10d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

**6. Freezing Blast**: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 (**10d6**) cold damage, and it can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the blast's other effects.
