traits.name: Dazzling Aura
traits.value: The gravekeeper sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the Bright Light takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: The gravekeeper always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the gravekeeper can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the gravekeeper takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lantern Blast
actions.value: Magical octarine beams flash from one of the Gravekeeper's many lanterns at one creature it can see within 120 feet that is not behind Total Cover, subjecting it to one of the following effects (the gravekeeper can only use each blast once per round):

entries: **Dispelling Blast**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage. Any spell or magical effect on the target ends, and it has the Bewildered condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

**Forceful Blast**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the gravekeeper and has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.
**Blinding Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.
**Contaminating Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.
**Igniting Blast**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (10d6 Fire). *Success* Half damage only.
**Freezing Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Glide (1/Round)
actions.value: The gravekeeper moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Sludge Column (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot tall Cylinder, centered on a point within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper. *Failure:* 42 (**12d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Animate Walls (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature within 10 feet of any number of walls within 120 feet of the gravekeeper. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). The wall sprouts limbs to facilitate this grapple, which disappear when the condition ends.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The gravekeeper chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The gravekeeper can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: **Languages**: Understands Infernal but can't speak, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Maggoty Hide
traits.value: A creature attacking the garmr in melee that is adjacent to the garmr is subject to the maggots crawling over its rank fur. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots, taking 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns. An infested target can make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the maggots are burnt away if it takes at least 5 Acid or Fire damage. After the creature successfully saves or the maggots are burnt away, it has Immunity to this trait for 1 hour.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The garmr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The garmr makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Earth Rending Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature in a 20-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only. Unattended objects and structures in the area are not allowed a saving throw, they take double damage, and the howl ignores their damage threshold.

bonusActions.name: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13 Each creature within 5 feet of the garmr. *Failure:* The target is infested with maggots (see Maggoty Hide).

fluffInfo.value: *This dried-out body of a long dead traveler is still clad in the tattered remains of its clothes. Its skin, as dry as parchment, clings to its bones, and a hoarse moaning emanates from its dry, cracked lips.*

fluffInfo.name: Thirsting Undead
fluffInfo.value: The greatest danger to people traversing badlands and deserts is thirst, and even the best prepared can find themselves without water. The lucky ones die quickly, while those less fortunate linger in sun-addled torment for days. These souls sometimes rise from the sand as gray thirsters, driven to inflict the torment they suffered upon other travelers.

fluffInfo.name: Destroy Wells and Oases
fluffInfo.value: Gray thirsters destroy or foul sources of water and often lurk near such sources to ambush those seeking clean water.

fluffInfo.name: Thirsting Caravan
fluffInfo.value: Though they hunt alone, in at least one case an entire caravan died of thirst and rose again as gray thirsters. Called the dust caravan, it prowls the deep desert accompanied by skin-changing gnolls, shrieking ghouls, and a mummy lord, building a strange, nomadic army.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Thirst Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the gray thirster must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the gray thirster's Thirst Aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Thirsting Dead Nature
traits.value: The gray thirster doesn't require air, food, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gray thirster makes two Claw attacks, or it makes one Claw attack and one Withering Turban attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Withering Turban
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target has disadvantage on this saving throw if it failed the saving throw against the thirster's Thirst Aura. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest with no levels of exhaustion. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Drought (1/Day)
actions.value: The gray thirster draws the moisture from containers and creatures around it. Nonmagical water and other liquids within 20 feet of the thirster that aren't being worn or carried turn to dust. Each creature within 20 feet of the thirster that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage and up to 5 gallons of nonmagical liquid it is wearing or carrying turn to dust. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and nonmagical liquids it is wearing or carrying don't turn to dust. Plants, Oozes, creatures with the Amphibious or Water Breathing trait, and creatures made mostly of water, such as water elementals or steam mephitis, have disadvantage on the saving throw.

fluffInfo.value: Feared by its own handlers, a Great Cave-troll is sent by Orcs to smash the defences and the morale of the foes they fear the most.

entries: **Resistances**: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the Great Cave-troll takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Great Cave-troll makes two melee attacks, only one of which can be with its bite. It can use its Strike Fear instead of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16). If the target is Small or smaller, it is also restrained until this grapple ends. While grappling the target, the Great Cave-troll has advantage on attack rolls against it and cannot use this attack against other targets.

actions.name: Strike Fear
actions.value: Each non-undead creature of the Great Cave-troll's choice that is within 60 feet of the Great Cave-troll and aware of it gains 2 Shadow points from Dread, resisted by a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is also stunned while frightened in this way. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Great Cave-troll's Strike Fear for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Even Death May Die
traits.value: When Great Cthulhu drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a cloud of green mist that fills its space. At the start of each of Great Cthulhu's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum Hit Points return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost Hit Points. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.

If Great Cthulhu is the target of a __Banishment__ spell while in this cloud form cast with a 9th-level spell slot, it automatically fails its saving throw and is instead sent to R'lyeh where it slumbers for 10d10 years.

traits.name: Horrid Aura
traits.value: A non-mythos entity that starts its turn within 30 feet of Great Cthulhu takes 10 Psychic damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.value: If Great Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Great Cthulhu makes six Crushing Claw attacks.

actions.name: Crushing Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, Reach 25 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage and the target is either knocked Prone or moved up to 20 ft. in a straight line from Great Cthulhu.

actions.name: Apocalyptic Majesty (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 23, creatures of Great Cthulhu's choice that can see or hear it within 500 ft. *First Failure:* The target takes 110 (**20d10**) Psychic damage, and is Frightened of Great Cthulhu until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. *Second Failure:* On its next turn, Great Cthulhu controls the target. This effect ends at the end of that turn.

fluffInfo.value: Guardians of flourishing alpine forests, great fir drakes live peacefully among their saplings. Each day, the iridescent drakes use powerful magic to replenish their forest's soil and promote the growth of their beloved fir trees. Over the centuries, villagers and townsfolk have learned to live in peace with these largely benevolent beings.

People who live near a great fir drake's lair can visit its forest home and leave the drake small shiny tokens under trees they wish to cut down. If the people return the next day to find the tokens have been gathered and taken, they know the great fir drake has given its blessing for those tree to be felled. In thanks, villagers decorate the trees with lights to resemble the drake. Those who fail to leave an offering for the drake's hoard and cut down its fir trees enrage the legendary creature, and should prepare to face its thrashing, needle-covered tail.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.value: As a Bonus Action, the drake can produce dim light in a 15 ft radius, or bright light in a 15 ft radius and dim light for an additional 15 ft radius. The drake can end this effect as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Prickly Pines
traits.value: If a creature successfully hits the drake with a melee attack, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the drake fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drake makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Incandescent Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast __Color Spray__.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Incandescent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 90 ft long, 5 ft wide Line. *Failure:* 55 (**10d10**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Massive Frame
traits.value: The great ogre has Advantage on Strength saving throws and Strength (*Athletics*) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The great ogre makes two greatclub attacks or throws two javelins.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/200 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hideous Belch (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13 All creatures in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Poison damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only. A creature with the Poisoned condition can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect upon itself.

fluffInfo.value: Less cunning than those who lead them, these fell creatures protect their captains at the cost of their lives.

traits.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the Great Orc Bodyguard takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Horrible Strength
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Great Orc Bodyguard hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Great Orc Bodyguard has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Great Orc Bodyguard makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

actions.name: Battle Axe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage or 14 (**2d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) piercing damage, or 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Bodyguard can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

fluffInfo.value: Great Orcs are often encountered as leaders and chieftains of their weaker-blooded relatives.

traits.name: Horrible Strength
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Great Orc Chief hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Great Orc Chief has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Great Orc Chief makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

actions.name: Heavy Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 15 (**2d10 + 4**) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: Each creature of the Great Orc Chief's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gain advantage on attack rolls and Charisma (*Intimidation*) checks until the start of the Great Orc Chief's next turn. The Great Orc Chief can then make one attack as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Chief can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +9, deception +4, history +9, nature +9, perception +6, religion +9

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Yithian has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Time Master
traits.value: When the Yithian rolls Initiative, it may choose to treat the result of its d20 roll as a 5 or 15. It may also apply this effect to up to six willing creatures it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Yithian makes two Snapping Claw attacks.

actions.name: Snapping Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, Reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 7**) Slashing damage.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regenerative State
traits.value: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Sticky Mucus
traits.value: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape DC 20) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

traits.name: Transitional State
traits.value: The chrysalis turns into an aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chrysalis makes four Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

actions.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape DC 20).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The greater crawling one has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable Evil
traits.value: When a greater crawling one is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it falls into a pile of rotting flesh, worms, and maggots. If it takes at least 40 Fire damage before the end of its next turn, the greater crawling one is permanently destroyed. It can still be targeted by spells and effects that target creatures. Otherwise, the greater crawling one reforms in 2d6 days. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the tomb it was originally buried in.

actions.name: Slimy Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, Reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 3**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes four Flailing Tentacle attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Flailing Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, Reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).

fluffInfo.value: *Enormous clouds of orange and green butterflies add a reek of putrefaction to the air, stirred by the flapping of delicate wings.*

fluffInfo.name: Demon-Haunted
fluffInfo.value: A death butterfly swarm results when a rare breed of carrion-eating butterfly, drawn en masse to the stench of decay, feeds on the corpse of a fiend, demon, or similar creature.

fluffInfo.name: Dizzying and Poisonous
fluffInfo.value: The colorful, chaotic flapping of the insects' wings blinds and staggers those in its path, allowing the swarm to necrotize flesh from those it overruns. Attracted to rotting material, the swarm spreads a fast-acting, poison on its victims, creating carrion it can feed on immediately.

fluffInfo.name: Devour the Undead
fluffInfo.value: Undead creatures are not immune to a death butterfly swarm's poison. A swarm can rot an undead creature's animating energies as easily as those of the living. Given the choice between an undead and living creature, a death butterfly swarm always attacks the undead, finding ghouls and vampires particularly appealing. Some good-aligned forces regard summoning these swarms as a necessary evil.

traits.name: Potent Poison
traits.value: Undead with resistance or immunity to poison damage or the poisoned condition can be affected by the swarm's poison.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

traits.name: Weight of Wings
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space has its speed halved and must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature ends its turn outside the swarm's space. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the blinding effect of Weight of Wings for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The swarm makes two Bites attacks.

actions.name: Bites
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 21 (**6d6**) piercing damage, or 10 (**3d6**) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 (**3d6**) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu makes two Crushing Fist attacks.

actions.name: Crushing Fist
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The winged wretch makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The winged wretch emits a cacophonous wave of energy. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Envenom
traits.value: Each ally within 30 feet of the hag deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) poison damage with weapon attacks, provided the hag isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes one Poison Claw attack and uses Granny Says.

actions.name: Poison Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Granny Says
actions.value: The hag affects one other willing creature they can see within 30 feet of them with one of the following effects:

entries: The target magically switches places with the hag.
The target uses their reaction, if available, to make an attack.

actions.name: Naughty Mousey (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.value: The hag chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them and attempts to transform them into a Beast of the hag's choice with a challenge rating of 2 or lower. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While transformed, the target's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen Beast, though they retain their alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target's gear melds into the new form. They can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of their equipment. They can't speak or cast spells but can take any action the Beast can take. If the target drops to 0 hit points while in this form, they revert back to their original form with half the number of hit points they had before they transformed.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The green slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Spike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) acid damage.

actions.name: Flee
actions.value: To save itself from danger, the green slime can sever off a part of its body to cause a distraction. The slime chooses to lose any number of hit points when using this ability. For each hit point lost, a tiny copy of the slime leaps from its body and moves 30 feet in a random direction, after which it falls lifeless.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.

actions.name: Tree Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Trash Lob
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Gregor can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Gregor can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward a distance equal to half his movement speed. He can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: Gregor can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.value: Gregor is resistant to poison damage.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: Gregor has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The grendelkyn can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shadow Armor
traits.value: The grendelkyn is surrounded by a writhing mantle of shadows. This mantle adds 3 to its AC (included in its stats) and grants it Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks in Darkness or Dim Light.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the grendelkyn has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls, and it loses its Shadow Armor. Additionally, it cannot use its Shadow Snare Action, and any existing Shadow Snare melts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The grendelkyn makes one Bite and one Claws attack. It can replace its Claws attack with Shadow Snare.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Piercing damage. On a Critical Hit, the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the grendelkyn's next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Snare
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage, and the target is wrapped in shadowy tendrils extending from the grendelkyn's body, and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions. A creature can make a new Dexterity Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns to free itself. Otherwise, it remains ensnared by the tendrils for 1 minute. The Shadow Snare also vanishes if it is exposed to sunlight, the grendelkyn dies or has the Incapacitated condition, or it chooses to use Shadow Snare against a new target.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Port
bonusActions.value: A grendelkyn in an area of Dim Light or Darkness can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see in Dim Light or Darkness. If the grendelkyn teleports while it has a creature trapped in a Shadow Snare, that creature also teleports 30 feet, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the grendelkyn that is in Dim Light or Darkness. If no such space is available, the grendelkyn releases the trapped creature when it teleports.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The grep can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This furred humanoid glides silently through the canopy of trees, gripping a blowgun. It observes visitors cautiously with two intelligent, bulbous eyes.*

fluffInfo.name: Jungle Rulers
fluffInfo.value: These small, squirrel-like humanoids live in reclusive societies deep in the jungle. They are omnivorous gliders, subsisting on fruits and roots, insects and larvae, bird and snake eggs, and birds and small mammals. They sometimes barter with other humanoids for metal and forged items, but they prefer to rely on the forest for most of their needs.

fluffInfo.name: Greyfur Elders
fluffInfo.value: Greyfurs are the eldest and most revered lemurfolk, as much as 80 years old. Their age can be estimated by the graying of their fur, but they don't track the years. Greyfurs are cunning individuals and command the arcane arts, though they rarely pursue the art of necromancy—a strong taboo prohibits them from interacting with the dead. A typical lemurfolk stands 2 feet tall and weighs 30 pounds.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: The greyfur has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand when falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The greyfur can't gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The greyfur lemurfolk makes two Greyfur's Staff or Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Greyfur's Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (**2d4**) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) force damage.

traits.name: Steady
traits.value: The griffon has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked prone.

traits.name: Swoop
traits.value: If the griffon flies more than 20 feet in a straight line toward their target and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target is grappled (escape DC 14). While the target is grappled in this way, the griffon has advantage on Beak attacks against the target but can't make Claw attacks. Grappling a Medium or smaller creature imposes no penalty on the griffon's speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The griffon makes one Beak attack, and they can make one Claw attack, use Buffet, or use Piercing Cry.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Buffet
actions.value: The griffon beats their wings in mighty gusts of wind. Each creature not grappled by the griffon within a 30-foot cone originating from the griffon must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 (**2d4**) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 5 feet away from the griffon, and is knocked prone.

actions.name: Piercing Cry
actions.value: The griffon lets out an earsplitting screech. Each enemy within 60 feet of the griffon who can hear them must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the griffon for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Piercing Cry of all griffons for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: 1st Level: Violent Attack (2 Ferocity)

actions.name: 3rd Level: Grabbed from Above (5 Ferocity)

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: Grihoo can hold its breath indefinitely.

traits.name: Infinite Heads
traits.value: Grihoo has an infinite number of heads. Whenever it takes 60 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. On its next turn, the number of attacks it makes as part of its Multiattack decreases by one (to a minimum of three) and it can't use its Snapping Frenzy. At the end of Grihoo's turn, it replaces all of its missing heads that died since its last turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.value: If Grihoo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Grihoo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: Grihoo's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.value: Grihoo can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Grihoo makes five bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**2d10 + 9**) piercing damage plus 11 (**2d10**) force damage.

actions.name: Snapping Frenzy
actions.value: Grihoo unleashes a flurry of bites in its vicinity, making one bite attack against any number of creatures within 30 feet of it, with a separate attack roll for each target.

actions.name: Transpositional Swallow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Grihoo chooses one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be teleported inside of Grihoo's stomach. While inside Grihoo, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Grihoo, and it takes 28 (**8d6**) acid damage and 28 (**8d6**) force damage at the start of each of Grihoo's turns.

If Grihoo takes 60 damage or more on a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel all creatures that were teleported inside of it, teleporting them to a random space on the ground within 60 feet of Grihoo. If Grihoo dies, a creature that was teleported inside of it is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 60 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Shifting Camouflage
traits.value: The grilp has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks and can hide from creatures who are observing them.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or gain vulnerability to fire and necrotic damage until the start of the grilp's next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Mote
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The grim can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. The grim takes **1d10** Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Shared Fate

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Grim Custodian, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Undead Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unrelenting Unlife
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Caster
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature possesses significant spellcasting abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Grim Custodian does everything in their power to avoid combat, liberally using __Suggestion__ and __Detect Thoughts__. When directly confronted and with no one to protect them, they cast __Invisibility__ on themselves and flee. They focus on hiding their undead nature. Grim Custodians can use __Nystul's Magic Aura__ and __nondetection__ to foil divinations which would otherwise detect them, and __Major Image__ and Seeming to further disguise the truth.

traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Claws

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Step
bonusActions.value: The vampire teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

fluffInfo.value: *A skeletal cadaver bedecked in the motley attire of a fool capers about while making jokes that mock mortality.*

fluffInfo.name: Amusing Death
fluffInfo.value: When a jester on its deathbed moves an evil death god to laughter, the fool sometimes gains a reprieve as a grim jester. Their purpose is to bring an end to mortal lives in a gruesome, comic, and absurd manner. As long as such jesters keep the death god amused, their continued unlife is assured.

fluffInfo.name: Grisly Humor
fluffInfo.value: A grim jester's jokes are not funny to their victims, but they offer a grim finality in combat. A killing joke might be absurd or sheer braggadocio, while others might be high-flown. Grim jesters are famous for grim, bitter mockery, but such humor rarely entertains mortals.

fluffInfo.name: Randomness
fluffInfo.value: Grim jesters enjoy randomness and often get their hands on wands of wonder and scrolls of chaos magic. Beware the grim jester with a deck of many things—they are quite talented in pulling cards whose magic then applies to foes and spectators.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +10, deception +9, perception +7, performance +9, sleight of hand +10, stealth +10

traits.name: Last Laugh
traits.value: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a place of the god's choosing.

traits.name: Mock the Dying
traits.value: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the grim jester have disadvantage.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The grim jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The grim jester doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Necrotic Claw
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Killing Joke
actions.value: The grim jester tells an ancient, nihilistic joke to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone in a fit of laughter, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for 1 minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is reduced to 0 hp instead. The incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save or ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Joker's Shuffle (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The grim jester exchanges locations with a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The jester and target each teleport to the other's space, and each becomes covered in a magical illusion to look and sound like the other. A creature must take an action to visually inspect an illusion and succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the jester and target are disguised. The illusions last for 1 minute, until the jester dies, or until the jester dismisses them as a bonus action.

fluffInfo.name: Grog Strongjaw
fluffInfo.value: Towering, broad, and ready for battle, Grog Strongjaw is a paragon of raw strength and unwavering determination. The son of Stonejaw Strongjaw joined Vox Machina in their first meeting in Stilben, and went on to defeat his tyrannical uncle Kevdak, bear the mythic Titanstone Knuckles, and save Exandria twice over alongside his companions.

fluffInfo.name: Kindhearted Berserker
fluffInfo.value: Grog is a man of simple pleasures. When he traveled the world with Vox Machina, his great loves in life were famously battle, women, and ale. And though he was renowned for his crass manners, vicious weapons, and relentless battle rage, he was just as well known for his love for his friends. It was never just about saving the world for Grog. Rather, it was about overcoming ever-greater challenges, and doing so side by side with his chosen family.

fluffInfo.name: After the Epilogue
fluffInfo.value: After __The Whispered One__ defeat, Grog Strongjaw retired to Westruun to live with his best friend __Pike Trickfoot__. Since then, he has dedicated himself to learning to read and strengthening his mind. In the course of his study of letters, shapes, colors, and numbers, Grog has organized a quadrennial event in Whitestone that he calls the Luncheon of Champions. He personally sends a handwritten invitation to the greatest warriors of Exandria to battle in an all-out brawl—and then join him for lunch and ale.

traits.name: Brutal Critical
traits.value: When Grog scores a critical hit, he rolls double weapon damage dice as usual, then rolls 3 additional weapon damage dice.

traits.name: Feral Instinct

traits.name: Melee Master

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of his turn, Grog can gain Advantage and Disadvantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have Advantage and Disadvantage until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Relentless Rage
traits.value: If Grog is reduced to 0 hit points while raging, he drops to 1 hit point instead if he succeeds on a DC 10 Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Grog wears a belt of dwarvenkind. He wields the Bloodaxe (a +2 magic weapon), a dwarven thrower, and the Titanstone Knuckles.

traits.name: Spellbreaker
traits.value: When Grog damages a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has Advantage and Disadvantage on the saving throws to maintain its *concentration*. In addition, Grog has Advantage and Disadvantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of him.

traits.name: Toughness
traits.value: Grog has an additional 40 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Grog makes two attacks (three when raging) with his Bloodaxe, dwarven thrower, or Titanstone Knuckles.

actions.name: Bloodaxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**1d12 + 14**) slashing damage and 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points, Grog gains 10 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Dwarven Thrower
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +17 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. *Hit:* 24 (**2d8 + 15**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Titanstone Knuckles
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**1d4 + 12**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a resting)
actions.value: Grog casts __enlarge/reduce__ on himself to grow in size for 10 minutes. While enlarged in this way, he has resistance to cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage.

bonusActions.name: Rage (Recharges after a resting)
bonusActions.value: Grog enters a rage that lasts until he falls unconscious or chooses to end it (no action required). While raging, Grog gains the following benefits:

entries: He has Advantage and Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
He deals an extra 4 damage when he hits a target with a melee weapon attack (included in attacks)
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage
He can't be charmed or frightened
He can make an additional melee weapon attack (included in the Multiattack action)

bonusActions.value: When Grog's rage ends, he gains one level of exhaustion.

fluffInfo.value: These mutated human monstrosities have grown to tremendous size. Delerium shards are merged into their disfigured bodies, and their muscles pulse with arcane energies as they lumber forward. Furiously territorial, these creatures are occasionally sighted hauling massive delerium crystals from the crater and placing them like obelisks in the ruins.

traits.name: Misty Camouflage

actions.name: Contaminating Beam
actions.value: The grotesque gargant magically forces a creature it can see within 60 feet of it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 27 (**6d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save and gains one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Vanish into the Haze
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Gargantuan's Misty Camouflage trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Crystal Missiles
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Gargantuan's Hurl Delerium attack.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Nearly Indestructible
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Grotesque Gargantuans are violently territorial creatures. Unlike the randomly mutated creatures found throughout the Haze, these hideous entities are more in tune with the arcane elements of Drakkenheim. Their form appears more intentional, as does their purpose, though the truth behind this intention remains a mystery

Gargantuans often drag chunks of delerium along with them, and their massive arms can swing or throw them with ease. They place the stones in odd formations around the city and, if witnessed by another creature who isn't a Dreg or a Haze Hulk, they will violently lash out and chase the observerer down. The Gargantuan hurls huge boulders of delerium at them. Whatever their intention is, they will not abandon their territory, or their work, and rarely flee from the site they are working in.

traits.value: At the start of its turn, the plushies in the swarm spout inane statements—in extremely saccharine tones—such as "You're my best friend!" "I love you!" "Hugs are my favorite!" "It's time for some fun!" and "Let's play!" The incessant babble has no effect on Fey, Constructs, or Undead. Each other creature within 60 feet of the swarm that can hear it must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage and becomes frightened of the swarm for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the swarm's incessant babble for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Underworld Godlings
fluffInfo.value: Gugs are giants of the underworld that enjoy smashing and devouring lesser creatures. Their burbling and grunting speech displays a surprising and malign intelligence to those who can understand it. Gugs are occasionally worshipped by tribes of derro, and their strange underworld cities are filled with esoteric monoliths and constructs.

fluffInfo.name: Nocturnal Raiders
fluffInfo.value: While gugs were banished into the underworld by forgotten gods long ago, they regularly flout this prohibition by raiding the surface by night. They also spend much time in the Ethereal Plane, and some gug spellcasters travel the planes with entourages of fext or noctiny.

fluffInfo.name: Prey on Ghouls
fluffInfo.value: Gugs devour ghouls and darakhul as their preferred food. When these are not available, they seem to prefer carrion and particular varieties of psychotropic mushrooms, as well as something that is best described as candied bats.

traits.name: Towering Strength
traits.value: The gug is considered to be a Gargantuan giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Grasping Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The gug has four Grasping Claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**2d12 + 7**) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Fling

If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow

While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the gug, and it takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the gug takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the gug must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the gug. If the gug dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

fluffInfo.value: Gurt is a small, green-tinged hedge who owns Gurt's Emporium, a small slime shop in Winnowing Reach. They wear a rough hide smock and a linen jumpsuit lined with pockets. Each pocket holds a different tool to extract or handle slime. Different sized vials and bottles are fastened to Gurt's belt and bandolier. Some of these glass containers are filled with slime. Their dark eyes are covered in large goggles, caked in residue from countless slime explosions. Gurt is missing the ring finger on their right paw. A big smile reveals two missing teeth, and their voice is fairly deep for their small size.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Gutbuster is a massive, bloated hulk that constantly grows fleshy masses within its ever expanding belly. If left unchecked, a Gutbuster Hulk can grow to proportions so large that it crushes itself under its own weight. Ratlings love when this happens—it supplies them with food for weeks.

The Gutbuster maintains its form by ripping chunks of flesh from its body, hurling them at enemies. This contaminated flesh erupts in a shower of gore and necrotic fluids. A Gutbuster usually opens with this attack to ward off foes, and then waits for more flesh to grow to hurl it again. If its enemies close in around it, it uses its Bile Blast to coat the creatures in acid, or will Slam them with its massive fists.
The Gutbuster is slower moving than other Haze Hulks and rarely runs from a fight.

fluffInfo.value: The Gutwretch Dreg keeps its distance from other combatants, watching all creatures who dare approach while swinging its flail over its head. It often protects other Dregs, standing watch over them while they eat or tend to other matters.

The Dreg uses its Reactive trait, as well as its Flailing Guts Reaction to knock creatures out of its way the moment they come near. It will always try to move away from direct combat, preferring to keep its enemies at arm's length so it can continue to pummel them with its Gut Flail.
The Gutwretch Dreg will fight to protect its fellow Dregs and is often the last one to flee from combat.

fluffInfo.value: *With black wings and a body pale as alabaster, the vulture-beaked sphinx is a striking figure.*

As powerful servants of the gods of death and the desert, the gypsosphinx's riddles and obsessions all hinge on death and carrion. Their eyes can spot prey miles away, and the distance they climb into the sky hides their enormous size. The pale gypsosphinx shines in the desert sun and stands out in underground tombs and caverns, yet it can conceal itself when it flies in moonlit clouds. Gypsosphinxes are found anywhere bodies are buried or left to rot, and they harvest corpses from battlefields of warring desert tribes.

*Accompanied by flocks of vultures and often served by packs of gnolls, ogres, and hyenas, gypsosphinxes living in deserts, plains, hills, and even mountainous terrain often acquire a large number of followers and would-be helpers. This eventually leads a gypsosphinx to anger, as it requires some solitude and peace, and (depending on its mood) it either abandons its entourage or turns them into a hearty meal. In either case, survivors sometimes tell the tale of the creature's wrath, discouraging others from following a gypsosphinx in search of wisdom.*
*Gypsosphinx temples are another matter; there the sphinx is served by an order of priests who understand its hunger, entertain it with discussions of philosophy, butchery, and gossip, and know when to withdraw and leave their patron to silent contemplation. Such temples are often quite rich, as the gypsosphinx at its heart demands its priests live well, the better to reflect its own importance and status.*
***11 Riddles**: The best riddles are ones you create yourself. However, here are a few easy and a few more difficult ones for a gypsosphinx.*

entries: It is light as a feather yet no one can hold it for long. What is it? (Breath)
I live where there is light, but I die if it shines on me. What am I? (A shadow)
Always smiles or maybe frowns, sinks in water, never drowns. Catches prey on its barbed teeth, hunts all day but never eats. (A fishhook)
I have rivers without water, forests without trees, mountains without stones, cities without houses. What am I? (A map)
Soft as velvet, can't be touched, hides the world, but isn't much. (Darkness/night)
I have a tail and a head but no body. What am I? (A coin)
What should you add to a barrel of ale to make it lighter? (A hole)
Round as an apple, deep as a cup, all the king's horses can't pull me up. What am I? (A well)
I am open when I'm closed and closed when I'm open. (A drawbridge)
Born of the earth, strengthened in fire, I sit on high, a master of water. (A roof tile)
Unwelcome, difficult, precious, and rare. What am I? (The truth)

fluffInfo.name: Gossips and Riddlers
fluffInfo.value: Gypsosphinxes converse with intelligent undead, priests of death gods, and with other sphinxes, but they rarely gather among their own kind. They guard their territory jealously, typically claiming a necropolis as the heart of their region. Like all sphinxes, gypsosphinxes enjoy riddles. They rely on magic to solve challenging riddles they can't solve on their own.

fluffInfo.name: Night Flyers
fluffInfo.value: Gypsosphinxes are gifted fliers capable of diving steeply from the night sky to snatch carrion or a sleeping camel. The stroke of midnight has a special but unknown significance for them.

fluffInfo.name: Foretell Doom
fluffInfo.value: Occasionally, a paranoid noble seeks out a gypsosphinx and entreats the creature to reveal the time and place of his or her death, hoping to cheat fate. A gypsosphinx demands a high price for such a service, including payment in corpses of humans, unusual creatures, or near-extinct species. Even if paid, the gypsosphinx rarely honors its side of the bargain; instead, it turns its death magic against the supplicant, bringing about his or her death then and there.

traits.name: Death Sense
traits.value: The sphinx can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each creature below half its hp maximum within 60 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction of creatures that don't have all of their hp within 1 mile of it. In addition, the sphinx can foretell the age and manner of a creature's death by looking at it. This effect doesn't take into account possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of powerful spells or the creature making a radical change in its life's path.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: Hamlin is a surly, grizzled, stout strig, a retired hunter who lives out in a cabin deep in the forest. Once considered one of the most skilled hunters in all of Humblewood, Hamlin is now seen to be long past his prime. Much of his past acclaim has been overshadowed by his obsession with the monstrous creatures he claims are everywhere in the forest.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The hammerhead can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hammerhead has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The hammerhead's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hammerhead makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its slam, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Banishing Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the hammerhead. A swallowed creature is considered to be on the Ethereal Plane, it is incapacitated, and it takes 22 (**4d10**) force damage at the start of each of the hammerhead's turns. A swallowed creature can make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead.

If the hammerhead takes 50 or more damage in a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. If the hammerhead dies, a swallowed creature can make a DC 10 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. On a failed save, the creature is no longer incapacitated, but it is banished to the Ethereal Plane.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) force damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.value: The hammerhead enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The runewright has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The runewright makes three Rune Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Runic Gaze.

actions.name: Rune Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**3d10 + 5**) Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Radiant damage (the runewright's choice based on the rune being used).

actions.name: Runic Gaze
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17 One creature the runewright can see with 60 feet. *Failure:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed or Frightened condition (the runewright's choice) until the start of the runewright's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Hannity can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Hannity can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: Hannity can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: Hannity has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Hannity can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half his movement speed. Hannity can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +8, arcana +9, deception +12, insight +4, intimidation +9, performance +12, persuasion +9, stealth +8
**Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks with shadow form
**Languages**: Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Halfling, thieves' cant, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amethyst Die (3/Day)
traits.value: When Harlo makes an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, he can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to the number rolled on the d20 roll. He then takes psychic damage equal to twice the number rolled on the d6.
Harlo can use this die even in his shadow form.

traits.name: Fear Resistant
traits.value: Harlo has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the frightened condition on himself.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.value: Harlo can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.value: Harlo is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Harlo makes two Mind Splinter attacks.

actions.name: *Mind Splinter (1st-Order Power)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Power Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) psychic damage, and Harlo is invisible to the target until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Form (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
actions.value: Harlo transforms his body into an amorphous shadow, along with everything he is wearing or carrying, and gains the following benefits for 10 minutes:

entries: He has a flying speed of 60 feet.
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.
He has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks and can attempt to hide without cover.
He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.value: While in this form, Harlo can't pick up or wield objects except for his Amethyst Die.

bonusActions.name: I'm Over Here
bonusActions.value: Harlo chooses an enemy within 60 feet of him who he can see but who can't see him. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or make a weapon attack against a creature of Harlo's choice.

bonusActions.name: Sneaky
bonusActions.value: Harlo takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.value: The harpy can't use their blindsight while deafened.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**3d4 + 2**) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature charmed by the harpy, they are also grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the harpy can't use their Talons attack on another target.

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Alluring Song
actions.value: The harpy starts singing a beautiful song. They continue singing until they choose to stop (no action required) or until they become deafened or incapacitated. When a non-harpy creature starts their turn within 200 feet of the singing harpy, if that creature shares a language with the harpy and can hear them, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the harpy until the harpy stops singing or the target can't hear them anymore.

While charmed in this way, the target can't willingly move on their turn, and they can't attack, damage, or target any unwilling harpy with any effect. If the charmed target takes damage from a source other than a harpy, they can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
A creature who succeeds on a saving throw to resist or end this effect is immune to the Alluring Song of all harpies for 1 hour.

bonusActions.name: Beckon
bonusActions.value: The harpy chooses any number of creatures charmed by their Alluring Song. Each target must use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction chosen by the harpy. If this movement would lead the target into hazardous terrain, they can make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw before moving. On a successful save, the target's reaction is not used and they are no longer charmed by Alluring Song.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The Harpy has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Dive Bomb
traits.value: If the Harpy misses its attack while flying, its movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from the target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The harpy makes two attacks with its Claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) slashing damage.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, performance +1 plus PB

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.value: The harpy can't use their blindsight while deafened.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Talons)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **2d4 plus PB** slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the fledgling can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Wind Sweep (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the fledgling moves up to their flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they end this movement within 5 feet of an enemy they can see, the fledgling can make a signature attack against them.

actions.name: 5th Level: Food Grab (3/Day)
actions.value: When the fledgling hits a Medium or smaller creature with a signature attack, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). The fledging then moves up to their fly speed without provoking opportunity attacks (no action required). While grappling the target, the fledgling can't attack another creature.

actions.name: 7th Level: Harpy Song (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the fledgling starts singing for 1 minute. Each creature within 60 feet of the fledgling who can hear them and who understands Common or Giant must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the fledgling until they can't hear the fledgling singing anymore. While charmed in this way, a creature can't willingly harm any of the fledgling's allies.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Coat of Lies
traits.value: While wearing their specially prepared coat, the harvester's AC is increase by 2 and it can use its innate spellcasting.

traits.name: Hear Lies
traits.value: The harvester hears all lies uttered within 1 mile of it and knows the liar's distance and direction while the harvester choses to concentrate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The harvester can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Trackless
traits.value: The harvester leaves no tracks to indicate where it has been or where it's headed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The harvester makes three attacks, only one of which can be sever tongue.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Sever Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one humanoid grappled by the harvester of lies. *Hit:* 33 (**8d6 + 5**) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have their tongue ripped out. A creature without a tongue cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a tongue, or has legendary actions.
A tongue can be reattached within 1 hour of being severed with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check, or at can be regrown using magic that replaces lost limbs.

fluffInfo.value: *A thick swirl of dust rises, settles, and forms the vague outline of a human—two points of yellow light shine where its eyes should be, staring malevolently.*

fluffInfo.name: Mound Haunter
fluffInfo.value: A haugbui is an undead spirit tied to its burial mound or barrow. It serves as a familiar, protective spirit to nearby farmsteads or villages, so long as tribute is regularly paid to the haugbui. Traditional offerings may include pouring the first beer from a barrel, leaving portions of meals out overnight, sacrificing blood or livestock, or burying a portion of any income in the mound. A freshly-woken haugbui devours the remains of creatures it was buried with, such as a hawk, hound, or horse.

fluffInfo.name: Milder Spirits
fluffInfo.value: Haugbuis are similar to vættir but much older. They are more humble and less prone to taking umbrage, and indeed, a great many haugbui have long since forgotten their own names. They are not quick to spill blood when irritated and thus are viewed with greater tolerance by the living.

fluffInfo.name: Scrye and Watch
fluffInfo.value: Haugbuis prefer to watch over their people from within their mound, and only come forth over the most grievous insults or injuries. They can do a great deal from within their mounds thanks to their scrying ability.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The haugbui can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the haugbui has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The haugbui has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The hangbui doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The haugbui makes three Psychic Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**5d8 + 5**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The haugbui magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the haugbui wears or carries is invisible with it.

bonusActions.name: Sepulchral Scrying (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: While within 1 mile of its burial mound, the haugbui creates an invisible sensor within 5 miles of the mound for 1 minute. When it uses this bonus action and as a bonus action on each of its turns for the duration, the haugbui can switch between using its own senses and projecting its senses through the sensor. While projecting its senses through the sensor, it can see, hear, telepathically communicate, and cast spells as if it was in the sensor's space, and it is blinded and deafened with regard to its own senses. The sensor can be dispelled (DC 14).

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, flanked, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Cloud
traits.value: The haunt can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, the haunt can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.
The haunt takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.value: The haunt is invisible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The haunt makes two Spectral Wrath attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Wrath
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the haunt's space. *Hit:* 17 (**2d12 + 4**) force damage.

actions.name: Wave of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The haunt unleashes a wave of psychic pain. Each enemy within 20 feet of the haunt must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, taking 33 (**6d10**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Possess Object
bonusActions.value: The haunt can magically manipulate a Large or smaller object within 30 feet of them that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. The haunt can exert fine control on objects under their control, such as playing piano keys, slamming doors, opening windows, or writing with a quill.

As part of this bonus action, the haunt can hurl the object up to 30 feet in any direction or use it as a ranged weapon to attack one creature within 30 feet of the object. The object has a +8 bonus to hit and deals 15 (**2d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage on a hit. The GM might rule that a specific object deals piercing or slashing damage based on its form.
