fluffInfo.name: Undead Nature
fluffInfo.value: A haunted reflection doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, radiant; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
**Languages**: understands any languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The reflection can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

traits.name: Death Shift
traits.value: If damage reduces the reflection to 0 hit points, it can make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is thunder or from a critical hit. The reflection automatically fails this saving throw if there are no other reflective surfaces within 60 feet of it. On a success, the reflection regains 10 hit points and uses its Mirror Step (no action required) as the previous reflective surface that contained it is destroyed.

traits.name: Unsettling Glare
traits.value: When a creature that can see the reflection starts its turn within 60 feet of the reflection, the reflection can force the creature to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw if the reflection isn't incapacitated. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be frightened. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the reflection until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the reflection in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

actions.name: Concentrated Ire
actions.value: The reflection focuses a wave of psychic fury at one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has averted its eyes from the reflection has advantage on this saving throw, and takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

actions.name: Mirror Step
actions.value: The reflection teleports into another nonmagical, metallic reflective surface of its choice that it can see within 60 feet of it.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Druidic, Sylvan, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Havel can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Havel cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Havel can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. He can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Seedspeech
traits.value: Havel can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

traits.name: Arcane Siphon
traits.value: Once per turn, when Hawkren deals damage to a creature with a spell, he regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

traits.name: Deathly Resilience (1/Day)
traits.value: When Hawkren takes damage that would reduce him to 0 hit points, he is reduced to 1 hit point instead and can immediately use his reaction to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: Delerium dregs continue to be wracked with new mutations. Eventually, many simply collapse into a mewling mass of flesh and organs and become gibbering mouthers. Others grow into much larger and twisted forms.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The haze hulk makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Mutant Fortitude
traits.value: If damage reduces the hulk to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the hulk drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Trample (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hulk moves its speed. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Medium and smaller creatures, as well as structures made of wood or stone that are less than 1 foot thick. When the hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this movement, it can make one Slam attack against that creature. If the target is a creature, it is subject to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The targeted creature has the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: Those who die in the ruins find no respite. The Haze reanimates their remains to wander the streets as shells forever stuck in the terror of their final moments. Billowing eldritch energies emanate from their eyes, mouth, and wounds and delerium fragments are fused into their flesh.

entries: **Languages**: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: If damage reduces the haze husk to 0 hit points, the delerium fragments in its body explode in a burst of contaminated energy, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage. Creatures who fail this saving throw by 5 or more gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

actions.name: Slam

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I speak softly imagining myself to be in a tragic fairytale while casting others in fictional roles.
**Ideal**: The world is a mirror held to my glorious reflection.
**Bond**: I obsessively crave beauty, decadence, and relish all art. I especially love my garden and my lilies. They are all I have left.
**Flaw**: I fly into an enraged fury at the sight of my own likeness or the names of my lost family members.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study Queen Lenore, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutated Queen of Drakkenheim
fluffInfo.value: You recognize she is an Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Deadly Gaze
fluffInfo.value: You learn of her Radiant Gaze ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Formidable Foe
fluffInfo.value: You understand her highest and lowest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lenore does not often outright engage in combat, throwing Dregs and her handmaidens at enemies who threaten her. She prefers to stay behind her minions where she is safe, relying on her Radiant Gaze to slowly disable and contaminate her foes..
If forced into melee, she uses her Tentacle Hair to attack and will take the first opportunity to escape if she can.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

fluffInfo.name: Trophy:
fluffInfo.value: Lenore von Kessel's Porcelain Mask.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature starting its turn within 30 feet of Lenore is subjected to the following effect: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level. *Failure or Success*: 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Tendrils
traits.value: Lenore's long hair can latch onto surfaces to pull her in any direction. She has a Flying Speed of 40 feet (included in Speed) but cannot move more than 30 feet from a solid surface, including walls and ceilings.

actions.name: Lenore always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lenore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Eye Blast
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Force damage, plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Grim Reveal (1/Round)
actions.value: Lenore removes her mask, revealing her horrific form. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, creatures within 60 feet of her who can see her. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
actions.value: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19. Failure:

Layer 1: 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination and has the Dazed condition; Layer 2: 17 (**5d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of Contamination and has the Defenseless condition; Layer 3: 35 (**10d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of Contamination and the Helpless condition. *Success* Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

actions.name: Radiant Gaze (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of Contamination. *Success* Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the Cone, she gains the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions for 1d6 hours and can't take the Epic Resistance Epic Action for the duration.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Lenore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on her. Lenore can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: A haze wight is more sentient than their haze husk minions, but has still been stripped of their former life. Many were former adventurers, military officers, or mighty warriors who died in the Haze. Many still believe themselves to be great heroes rallying the common folk of Drakkenheim against invaders, but in their madness they see all humanoids as monsters.

actions.name: Create Haze Husk
actions.value: The wight targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. It rises as a haze husk in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The haze husk is under the wight's control. The wight can have no more than 12 haze husks under its control at one time.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) slashing damage, or 7 (**1d10 + 2**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Reanimated by the Haze
fluffInfo.value: Left undisturbed in the ruins of Drakkenheim, the corpse of a humanoid character of 6th level (or Challenge Rating 6) or higher has a 10 percent chance each day of rising as a Haze Wight.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study a Haze Wight, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Delusional Undead
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that these creatures think they are still alive, and that we are the monsters!

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Contaminated Eldritch Power
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Haze Wight's Contaminated Blast.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Awaken Minions
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Animate Haze Husk Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Made With Delerium
fluffInfo.value: You understand that it's possible to create these zombies with delerium and the __Animate Dead__ spell (see the Creating Haze Husks sidebar).

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Haze Wights are intelligent warriors who can engage in melee or ranged combat. However, they mistakenly believe their foes are mindless monsters not requiring careful tactics, seeing most targets as beasts to be put down. When a foe demonstrates unexpected magic or strategy, some fight more carefully, commanding minions to surround and corner their opponents.

Groups of these wights sometimes believe they are still-living, acting as if they still possess their former abilities, using teamwork and "healing" each other by reanimating the fallen as Haze Husks. Nevertheless, their delusions render them incapable of imagining defeat; they do not flee when wounded, nor when allies fall. Instead, they believe they fight in a heroic last stand, desperately rallying against the inevitable doom they already suffered.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: Adventurers who interact with He Who Laughs Last must endure his mocking laughter and jeering comments, as he remarks on the futility of their actions, the dramatic irony of their mistakes, and the meaninglessness of their quests. In doing so, He Who Laughs Last carefully offers an escape or solution—if the adventurers will offer him service in exchange, one that is almost certain to have unforeseen consequences.

He Who Laughs Last loves nothing more than when mortal heroes attempt to outmaneuver him. As befitting his name, there is almost always some unfortunate upset or surprise twist the demon has in store. Even when he is seemingly defeated, he is always sure to remind his foes who will have the last laugh.

fluffInfo.name: Personality Traits
fluffInfo.value: In conversation, I cannot contain my dark mirth, which manifests from a low chuckle to a belly-bursting guffaw. Most of all, I love the moment when mortals realize the cost of their terrible mistakes and poor decisions.

fluffInfo.name: Ideal
fluffInfo.value: Mortals fear death. I play upon that fear, and with it I can catch the conscience of any soul.

fluffInfo.name: Bond
fluffInfo.value: I harvest of souls at life's curtain call, binding them to my cast of players in my Theatre of the Danse Macabre.

fluffInfo.name: Flaw
fluffInfo.value: I oft direct the play too long, delighting in extending the final act. My patience is as deep as the grave, allowing me to savor each move in the mortal game, though sometimes to the detriment of a timely demise.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.value: You are aware of his Truesight and telepathy, his Resistances and Immunities, and his Epic

fluffInfo.name: Resistance.
fluffInfo.value: You also know this eldritch entity is beyond life and death and can reform years later if killed.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Killing Aura.
fluffInfo.value: You know of his Mortal Coil aura, and his spellcasting Epic Actions.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Powerful Presence.
fluffInfo.value: You know his highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: He Who Laughs Last approaches battle lazily, as his mere presence causes mortals to die in short order from his Mortal Coil aura. Nevertheless, he casually ends lives using Sleep No More, Dusty Death, and Out Brief Candle, trapping another foe in a Cage of Sorrows so they must bear witness to the death around them before they expire to his Mortal Coil.

He Who Laughs Last does not fear his own destruction, confident that he will reappear if his corporeal form is destroyed. He is certain of his fate to watch the end of the universe, and even when slain his echoing laughter remains as a grim reminder of his power.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: He Who Laughs Last is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as any divination spell that he refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the demon lord's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Mortal Coil
traits.value: He Who Laughs Last projects a 150-foot Emanation of death and decay. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation suffers an Exhaustion level and ages 10 (3d6) years. The creature removes an Exhaustion level gained in this way at the end of its turn, but only if it ends its turn outside the Emanation. A creature's original age can be restored with __Greater Restoration__ or similar magic.

actions.name: He Who Laughs Last always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, He Who Laughs Last takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Scornful Whip**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +16, reach 120 ft. *Hit:* 30 (**5d8 + 8**) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.
**Walking Shadow (1/Round)**: He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his Speed.

actions.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Power Word Kill__.

actions.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Finger of Death__ (save DC 24).

actions.name: Dusty Death (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Disintegrate__ (save DC 24).

actions.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage).

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, can also speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

traits.name: Taunt (2/Day)
traits.value: The bard can use a bonus action on their turn to target one creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the bard, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bard makes two weapon attacks, one with their rapier and one with their dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: The bard curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way they cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and their base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses the hedge bard with a melee attack while they are curled up takes **2d4** points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits the bard while they are curled up, however, the bard is knocked prone in their space at the end of the turn. The bard may uncurl themselves at any point during their turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Not every graduate of the Amethyst Academy remains a part of the institution. A few depart to find their own way in life, quietly using their magical talents pursuing their own interests. So long as they keep the edicts and laws, they may practice magic undisturbed.* - Eldrick Runeweaver

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

entries: **Languages**: Abyssal, Birdfolk, Hedge, can also speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders insects worms or other bugs

traits.name: Dark One's Blessing
traits.value: When the witch reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, the witch gains 5 temporary hit points.

traits.name: Repelling Blast
traits.value: When the witch hits a creature with eldritch blast, they can push the creature up to 10 feet away in a straight line.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d6 - 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fiendish Vigor
actions.value: The witch can cast __false life__ at will as a 1st-level spell.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: The witch curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way they cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and their base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses the witch with a melee attack while they are curled up takes **2d4** points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits the witch while they are curled up, however, the witch is knocked prone in their space at the end of the turn. The witch may uncurl themselves at any point during their turn.

fluffInfo.value: Hedy is a venerable mistral raptor who takes pride in her career in the Perch Guard. She is calm, composed, and unbending in her principles. Although she is still disciplined, the sternness of her youth has been long since eroded by time and good-humored company, and she spends her off-hours at the Rose Hip teahouse, catching up with her old friend Christophe and enjoying hid delicious tea.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Hedy can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Hedy lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. Hedy cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Hedy has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Aerial Defense
traits.value: As long as Hedy is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against her have disadvantage.

traits.name: Woodland Hunter
traits.value: Hedy treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Hedy makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

entries: **AC**: 15 (Natural Armor) or 18 With Hardened By Flame
**Languages**: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Hardened by Flame
traits.value: When the hound is subjected to fire damage, they take no damage. Instead, their skin darkens and hardens, and their AC increases to 18 until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Stealthy Hunter
traits.value: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to track other creatures and on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to hide from creatures who are unaware of their presence.

actions.name: Hellish Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hound exhales flame in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (**3d6 + 4**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who isn't a hellhound who fails the saving throw is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

entries: **AC**: 15 (Natural Armor) or 18 With Hardened By Flame
**Languages**: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Hardened by Flame
traits.value: When the hound is subjected to fire damage, they take no damage. Instead, their skin darkens and hardens, and their AC increases to 18 until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Stealthy Hunter
traits.value: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to track other creatures and on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to hide from creatures who are unaware of their presence.

actions.name: Hellish Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hound exhales flame in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (**3d6 + 4**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who isn't a hellhound who fails the saving throw is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.name: Consult Hell (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: The hound's caregiver can talk to the hound about a specific course of action that the caregiver plans to take within the next 30 minutes, tapping into divinatory power through the hound's connection to the infernal realm. After 1 minute, the hound then gives a response based on its own objective prophetic sense of the outcome: one bark for good results, two barks for bad results, three barks for both good and bad results, and no barks for results that aren't especially good or bad.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite (Signature Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Lava Spittle (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hound makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and the hound can choose another creature within 5 feet of the target, dealing PB fire damage to that creature.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Brutal Charge (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hound can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or at the end of this move, they can make a signature attack against one target within reach.

actions.name: 5th Level: Fire Breath (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Crossfire
traits.value: If a creature starts their turn within 10 feet of two or more curs, that creature takes **4** fire damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the cur takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the cur takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Hellish Bite (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **3** fire damage, and if the target isn't a hellhound and the attack was made by more than one cur, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to 10 plus the number of curs who joined the attack. On a failed save, the target is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes fire damage equal to the number of curs who joined the attack. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The hand can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Finger Jab
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1 Bludgeoning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Latch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* The hand attaches itself to the target. While latched, the hand cannot attack. Instead, at the start of each of the hand's turns, the latched creature takes 2 (**1d4**) Necrotic damage. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the hand with a successful DC 13 Strength check. The hand can also detach itself at any time during its turn (no action required).

bonusActions.name: Helper
bonusActions.value: The hand takes the Help action.

fluffInfo.value: *Sanguine Servitor (Fresh blood and gem dust)*

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.value: The hemonculus knows the location of any *Bloodied* creature within 60 feet of it, unless the creature is a Construct or Undead.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The hemonculus doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hemonculus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage, and the hemonculus attaches to the target. While attached, the hemonculus automatically hits the target with its Claw attacks.
The hemonculus can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the hemonculus as an action.

actions.name: Exsanguinate (1/Day)
actions.value: The hemonculus magically draws blood from nearby creatures. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature of the hemonculus' choice in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the hemonculus. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of the hemonculus's next turn. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If the hemonculus is attached to a creature, the hemonculus regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken by that target.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ratatosk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ratatosk makes two Gore or Annoying Chitter attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Divisive Chatter, if available.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Annoying Chitter
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Divisive Chatter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ratatosk causes division and strife in up to four creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be irritated for 1 minute. While irritated, a creature must spend its action on each of its turns arguing with, complaining about, or otherwise expressing unhappiness toward one of its allies over a trivial matter. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Skitter
bonusActions.value: The ratatosk takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The giant has bruised, purple skin and wart-like blood blisters that deform its features. It wears cowled robes, and its staff is ebony and mithral embedded with precious stones.*
As powerful sorcerers and blood mages, heralds of blood are without peer. They enjoy enslaving ogres and giants whenever possible, though they make do with lesser slaves when they must.

fluffInfo.name: Dark Prophets
fluffInfo.value: Their stirring speeches proclaim that the end times are fast approaching and that all must prepare for a bloody reckoning. Their charismatic preaching serves various elder earthly gods, who demand blood sacrifices, and dark druid orders devoted to hunting and murdering innocents. They have the power to grant strength, lust, and vitality—or to wither those who cross them.

fluffInfo.name: Blood Magic Vortexes
fluffInfo.value: Beneath their giant-like veneer, heralds of blood are swirling vortexes of blood, bone, and raw magical power. They feed on ley line magic and the black blood of the earth as much as on flesh and blood.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.value: Each time a creature with blood hits the herald with a melee attack while within 10 feet of the herald, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage, and the herald's AC increases by 1 until the end of its next turn. The herald's AC can't be increased to more than 20 from this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The herald makes three Herald's Staff or Blood Bolt attacks, or it makes two Herald's Staff attacks and one Grasping Slam attack.

actions.name: Herald's Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grasping Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the herald can't use its Grasping Slam on another target.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**5d8 + 3**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Call Blood (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of exhaustion.

bonusActions.name: Grant Blood Rage
bonusActions.value: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. A creature with any levels of exhaustion automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: all languages known before the curse

traits.name: Aura of Calamity
traits.value: An aura of misfortune surrounds the herald in a 30-foot Emanation. Creatures other than the herald within the area have Disadvantage on d20 Tests. Whenever a creature in the area other than the herald takes damage from any source other than another creature (such as a trap, a hazard, or a fall), it takes the maximum possible damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The Herald of Calamity can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.value: The Herald of Calamity has the Invisible condition unless it is in an area illuminated by moonlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Herald of Calamity makes two Life Drain attacks.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Necrotic damage, and the Herald of Calamity regains Hit Points equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

fluffInfo.value: *A tall and beautiful fiend, this creature resembles a dark-haired fey wearing a cloak and armor glittering with dark light.*
Heralds of darkness speak in fluid tones and sing with the voices of angels, but their hearts are foul and treacherous.

fluffInfo.name: Vision of Evil
fluffInfo.value: Heralds of darkness can take on another appearance entirely, disappearing into insubstantial shadows and unveiling an evil majestic form that leaves those who see it shaken and weak—and often blind. Speaking of this form is difficult, but poets and bards trying to describe it have said it resembles an apocalyptic horror built of chained souls and the slow death of innocents carried along in a glacial river, rushing to an inevitable doom.

fluffInfo.name: Sword and Cloak
fluffInfo.value: The black sword and star-scattered cloak of a herald of darkness are part of its magical substance and cannot be parted from it. Some believe the cloak and blade are true visions of its body, and that the smiling face and pleasing form are entirely illusory.

fluffInfo.name: Corruptors of the Fey
fluffInfo.value: Heralds of darkness are companions and sometimes masters to the shadow fey. They seek to draw many others into their orbit with wild promises of great power, debauchery, and other delights. They are rivals to the heralds of blood and bitter foes to all angels of light.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
traits.value: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the herald's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness (Shadow Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Sword (Fiend Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Majesty of the Abyss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (**6d8**) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Shape
bonusActions.value: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Leader of Fiendish Revels*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Heralds of fools are wonderful dancers, and they must never stop dancing, or they quickly perish.

traits.name: Endless Footwork
traits.value: When the herald's Speed is 0, attack rolls made against it have Advantage, and if its Speed is 0 at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Perfect Grace
traits.value: The herald doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it leaves an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The herald makes three Banner Pole attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lethal Jape.

actions.name: Banner Pole
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10 (with Advantage if the target's Speed is 0), reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the herald can move it to any other unoccupied space within the Banner Pole's reach.

actions.name: Lethal Jape
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, a creature the herald can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 24 (**7d6**) Psychic damage, and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to two resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 7 (**2d6**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 13 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d6):
1. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) force damage.
2. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) cold damage.
6. The target takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ophelia makes two Spiritual Weapon attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Spiritual Weapon
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**6d6 + 4**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: Ophelia casts __Healing Word__ using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +14, athletics +10, deception +13, history +14, perception +13, persuasion +13
**Resistances**: fire, cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
**Languages**: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Draining Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Vairae fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, Vairae has disadvantage on spell attacks until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: Vairae has the Rejuvenation trait found in the lich stat block.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Vairae has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.value: Vairae is immune to effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Vairae uses Glare of Undeath and makes four attacks using Conflagration, Immortal Pain, Magic Drain, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Conflagration (4th-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +14 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) fire damage, and if the target takes both an action and a bonus action on their next turn, they take an extra 17 (**5d6**) fire damage at the end of that turn.

actions.name: Immortal Pain (4th-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) psychic damage, and the target is afflicted with pain. While afflicted in this way, the creature's attacks deal half damage. After each attack the afflicted creature makes against an enemy, the afflicted creature can make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success. A cure ailment power, a __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect also ends the effect.

actions.name: Magic Drain (4th-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 26 (**4d12**) necrotic damage. If the target is currently affected by any spells not cast by Vairae, the target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or those effects end for the target.

actions.name: Glare of Undeath
actions.value: Vairae glares at one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to hug themself tightly as protection against an unbearably cruel world. A creature hugging themself in this way is restrained for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to make a DC 22 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Machinations of Bone (2/Day)
actions.value: Each enemy within 30 feet of a point Vairae can see within 150 feet of them must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target's innards fly from their body and they take 54 (**12d8**) piercing damage, fall prone, and can't stand up until they recieve supernatural healing.

bonusActions.name: Necrotic Form (3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: Vairae enters a shadow form and can move up to their speed. While in this form, Vairae is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and the grappled and restrained conditions, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. Vairae reverts to their true form at the end of their turn.

fluffInfo.value: *A pile of gold, jewelry, and weapons rises on its own like a tidal wave of riches, with a cold and determined face.*

fluffInfo.name: Dragon Fears Made Real
fluffInfo.value: Hoard golems were born from the paranoia of dragons. Despite their great physical and intellectual power, dragons are always suspicious of any creature willing to work for them. The first hoard golem was created when a dragon realized that there could be no guardian more trustworthy with its hoard than the hoard itself. Since then, the secret of hoard golem construction has emerged, and rich nobles have followed suit, enchanting their wealth to defend itself from thieves.

fluffInfo.name: Patient Homebodies
fluffInfo.value: As constructs, hoard golems are mindless, lying in wait for anyone other than their creator to come within striking distance. In the case of evil dragons, this may include the wyrmlings of dragon parents looking to establish dominance in the family. Hoard golems fight to the death, but they rarely leave the rooms they inhabit for fear that clever treasure hunters might trick the hoard into walking itself right out of the owner's den.

fluffInfo.name: Silent and Wealthy
fluffInfo.value: Hoard golems cannot speak. A hoard golem is 25 feet tall and weighs 20,000 pounds. A hoard golem's body is composed of items—copper, silver, gold, works of art, armor, weapons, and magical items—worth at least 5,000 gp

actions.name: Thieving Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hoard golem partially disperses into a whirlwind of coins, gemstones, and other valuables then re-coalesces. Each creature within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 (**8d10**) bludgeoning damage and loses one object it is wearing or carrying. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't lose an object. Each object the golem steals must weigh no more than 20 pounds and not be wrapped around or firmly attached to a creature. For example, the golem could steal a belt pouch full of coins or a creature's jewel-encrusted dagger, but it can't steal a creature's shirt or armor. The hoard golem steals objects of high value over those of minimal value. The stolen object becomes part of the golem's body and can't be retrieved until the golem dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Resembling a cave cricket the size of a dog, this beast's black, chitinous thorax is topped by a translucent digestive sac. Half-digested eyeballs of various sizes and colors float in the sac.*

fluffInfo.name: Leaping Claws
fluffInfo.value: Insectoid killing machines with a penchant for consuming their victim's eyes, the bloodthirsty horakhs travel in small packs and make lightning-fast attacks against the weak or vulnerable. Their powerful rear legs enable enormous bounding leaps, while the sharp hooks at the end of their powerful claws help them to climb and latch onto prey. Heads dominated by scooped mandibles can shoot forward like pistons, shearing meat from bone.

fluffInfo.name: Leaping Screech
fluffInfo.value: When attacking, a horakh leaps from its hiding spots while making a deafening screech. Horakhs are highly mobile on the battlefield. If threatened, horakhs return to the shadows to attack from a more advantageous position.

fluffInfo.name: Herd the Blinded
fluffInfo.value: After blinding their prey, horakhs often herd the blind like sheep until they are ready to consume their prey and sometimes even use the blinded prey as bait to capture other creatures. Many an explorer has been ambushed, blinded, and condemned to death in the bowels of the earth by these predators.

traits.name: Implant Egg
traits.value: If the horakh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a Bite attack or as a bonus action while within 5 feet of a creature with 0 hp, the horakh can implant an egg in the creature. The implanted egg rests in the creature's eye socket for 14 days while it incubates. A host creature can carry only one horakh egg to term at a time. While the egg is implanted, the host can't use its eye and has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight. Exactly 24 hours before the egg hatches, the host becomes blinded. When the egg hatches, the young horakh erupts from the host's head, killing the host in the process.

A __lesser restoration__ spell cast on the host destroys the egg. Alternatively, a creature other than the host can take an action to remove the egg by succeeding on a DC 16 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. On a failure, the host takes 9 (**2d8**) slashing damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The horakh's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The horakh makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the horakh scores a critical hit, it removes one of the target's eyes, provided the target has eyes, and places the eye in a fluid sac on its thorax. While missing half or less of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is blinded until its sight is restored.

actions.name: Claw

traits.name: Charge

traits.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)

fluffInfo.value: Chosen for its ferocity and malicious intelligence, a Hound of Sauron is a minion of the Dark Lord, a servant sent on a precise errand, be it the gathering of forces for a coming war, the hunt for a specific individual, or spying on an area. Hidden behind the shape of an ordinary Warg, a Hound of Sauron conceals much greater powers.

fluffInfo.value: *This enormous black hound pants in the moonlight, wisps of steam rising from its muzzle, as it follows its elvish master.*

fluffInfo.name: Fey Bloodhounds
fluffInfo.value: Hounds of the night are bred by the shadow fey for use as hunting companions and guardians, and they excel at both tasks. Far more intelligent than other hounds, they are difficult to evade once they are on a quarry's trail, because they can think their way past problems that would throw their lesser kin off the trail. Their shadow fey masters claim that hounds of the night can smell a shadow on running water and can sniff out a ghost passing through a wall.

fluffInfo.name: Cousins to Winter
fluffInfo.value: Somewhere in their early existence as a breed, some enterprising hunter interbred them with winter wolves. Every trace of their white fur is long gone, but the cold breath of those dread canines remains.

fluffInfo.name: Dimensional Stepping
fluffInfo.value: Hounds of night excel at distracting prey while some of their pack teleport away to achieve some larger goal, such as dragging off a treasure or overwhelming a spellcaster in the back ranks.

entries: **Languages**: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Fey Scent
traits.value: The hound of the night has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell. If it is tracking a Fey, Giant, or Humanoid whose scent it knows, the hound can continue tracking that creature if the creature moves into the Border Ethereal or teleports, provided the creature isn't in the Border Ethereal for more than 1 minute or that the creature doesn't teleport more than 100 feet at a time.

traits.name: Construction
traits.value: Creatures can enter the house's space and navigate it as a normal building. The house makes attacks from any surface or object that isn't being worn or carried within its space. It doesn't have Disadvantage on ranged attack rolls due to an enemy being within 5 feet of it.

If a creature deals 30 or more damage in a single turn to a 5-foot section of the house's structure, the house must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or a 5-foot opening appears in that space until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Exorcism Susceptibility
traits.value: If the house is targeted by a __Dispel Evil and Good__ spell, it has the Stunned condition. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. As a Magic action, a creature inside the house that throws a flask of Holy Water against the house and succeeds on a DC 20 Charisma check affects the house as above.

traits.name: Soul Trap
traits.value: A Humanoid that dies within the house has its soul trapped there until the house dies. The creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a __True Resurrection__ or __Wish__ spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The house makes three attacks, using Structure Slam or Object Fling in any combination, and it uses Agonized Souls.

actions.name: Structure Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). The house can grapple up to two creatures at a time, using animated furniture, objects, or fixtures such as stair railings.

actions.name: Object Fling
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +11, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d4 + 6**) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (house's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Agonized Souls

fluffInfo.value: *The giant stands braced in the midst of powerful wind. With a baleful stare, he shakes his fist and bellows a war cry. The cry becomes an avian shriek, and the giant's form melts into that of a massive bird whose wings blot out the sky*.
A giant with divine blood in his veins, Hraesvelgr the Corpse Swallower is powerfully muscled. His skin is a pale bronze, his eyes are violet, and his hair is the color of storm clouds.

fluffInfo.name: Roc Form
fluffInfo.value: When he takes his alternate form, Hraesvelgr becomes a tremendous roc, with massive wings that stir the wind across the sky. His eyes remain the same violet and these roc-form feathers match the color of his hair, sparkling with specks of color here and there, like jewels set in steel.

fluffInfo.name: Birth of the Wind
fluffInfo.value: Hraesvelgr dwells on the fringe of the world itself. From atop the peak of his home, he creates the wind and sends it across the globe. As befits a creature of such primal power, Hraesvelgr doesn't take kindly to intruders. He gluts himself on the bodies of fools who test his might in search of the fabled riches in his home.

traits.name: Influence Weather
traits.value: Nearby weather responds to Hraesvelgr's desires. At the start of each minute, Hraesvelgr can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 3 miles of him by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the __control weather__ spell, except Hraesvelgr can't change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

actions.value: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack against a Large or smaller creature he is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside Hraesvelgr, and it takes 17 (**5d6**) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. Hraesvelgr can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If Hraesvelgr takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, Hraesvelgr must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of Hraesvelgr. Hraesvelgr has disadvantage on this saving throw if he isn't in his roc form. If Hraesvelgr dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by him and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

fluffInfo.name: Emotional Giant
fluffInfo.value: A hulking whelp is a tightly wound ball of emotion, extremely defensive of its personal space and terrified of the world around it. When it feels its personal space is violated, or its fragile concentration is broken, the small, quivery fey grows into a muscled beast of giant proportions.

fluffInfo.name: Calm Friend
fluffInfo.value: When its emotions are under control, a hulking whelp is friendly and even helpful, although this has more to do with its guilt over past actions than a true desire to help others. In its calm form, a hulking whelp is just over three feet tall at the shoulder and weighs 50 pounds. Unleashed, it is 20 feet tall and 4,000 pounds.

traits.value: A friendly creature that has interacted peacefully with the hulking whelp in its whelp form can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The hulking whelp must be able to hear the creature, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check. If the check succeeds, the hulking whelp transforms back into its whelp form on its next turn and stops attacking. If the hulking whelp takes damage before then, it remains in its hulking form and continues attacking.

traits.name: Unleashed Emotion (Hulking Form Only)
traits.value: On each of the hulking whelp's turns, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hulking whelp attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack for two turns in a row, the hulking whelp uses Change Shape to return to its whelp form and stops attacking.

fluffInfo.value: *The only time I ever felt like a pincushion. Incredible speed and furiosity, if they weren't a machine-corpse enemy I'd be impressed.*

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Humongous Fungus Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Spore Slam and Grasping Tendrils Actions.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Humongous Fungus Trolls remain motionless and observe trespassers to see if they are a threat. If combat is initiated, the Humongous Fungus Troll uses its Grasping Tendrils to pull victims towards it, then use its Entangling Mycelia to entangle as many creatures as possible within its Rotting Aura.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the troll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a gigantic mushroom.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 30 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rotting Aura
traits.value: Any creature who starts its turn in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the troll takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage unless the troll has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: On its turn, the troll can move as normal
actions.value: However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the troll takes one of the following Epic Actions of its choice at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Spore Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**6d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendrils
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Slashing damage and if the target is Huge or smaller, the troll pulls the target up to 20 feet straight towards itself.

actions.name: Entangling Mycelia (Recharge when *Bloodied*)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature of the troll's choice in a 30-foot radius centered on it. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition (save ends).

actions.name: Spawn Trolling (1/Round)
actions.value: The troll creates a Fungal Trolling which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the troll uses this action, then acts after the troll's turn on subsequent rounds.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The troll chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. A troll can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *A toothless mouth adorns the headless shoulders of this oversized, four-armed, doughy humanoid. Colors and half-formed phantasmal shapes appear and vanish around it, to the creature's obvious delight.*

fluffInfo.name: Creative Chaos
fluffInfo.value: Wise yet child-like creatures of chaos, hunduns are four-armed, headless humanoids that embody spontaneous creation and the confusion that precedes enlightenment. Taking delight in creation of all kinds, they bring change to the staid and stagnant, spin revelation from confusion, and inspire moments of great creation—from works of art to new nations and faiths, and even the formation of planets and planes.

fluffInfo.name: Nonsense Speech
fluffInfo.value: Although not mindless, hunduns rarely seem to act out of conscious thought; however, their actions seem wise and are usually benevolent. They communicate only in nonsense words but have no trouble communicating among themselves or acting in coordination with other celestials.

fluffInfo.name: Flesh of Creation
fluffInfo.value: Hundun blood is a powerful catalyst, and their spittle is a potent drug. Each hundun's heart is an Egg of Worlds—an artifact that can give birth to new concepts, powers, or even worlds. Obviously, the hundun must die for its heart to be used this way, but this is a sacrifice one might make willingly under the right circumstances.

traits.value: The hundun is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the hundun's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Motivating Babble
actions.value: The hundun babbles incoherently at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects until the end of its next turn. Roll a d4 to determine which effect happens.

actions.name: 1 Distracted
actions.value: The target is distracted with a flood of new ideas and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: 2 Enlightened
actions.value: The target's mind fills with solutions to many of its problems, reducing its burden on itself. Its speed is increased by half, and its jump distance is doubled.

actions.name: 3 Inspired
actions.value: The target is inspired by new ideas and has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: 4 Struck with Genius
actions.value: The target's speed is reduced to 0 and it must use its next action to write itself a note, tie a small knot, or create some other physical reminder of the great idea that just struck it.

fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Hulk's Lashing Tendrils attack and Reel Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Strong and Tough
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Hulk's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Hunter Hulks hide in the ruins of Drakkenheim, often Invisible, attempting to get the drop on their prey. Once the Hulk's target is in a prime position, it lunges out and whips its arms around them, pulling in the unfortunate target. The Hunter Hulk then devours them with its Belly Maw. If the creature breaks free, or if the Hunter Hulk is being too heavily damaged, it turns Invisible again and slinks back into the shadows. However, the Hunter Hulk will not so easily give up on its prey, and it may stalk the target and their party for a time, looking for a better moment to strike again. Sometimes it launches another ambush almost immediately, other times it will stalk them for several hours.

On each of the hunting horror's subsequent turns, it can take a Bonus Action to deal 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage to the target automatically.

This effect ends if the target is ever outside the range, if it has Total Cover from the hunting horror, if it is on a different plane of existence, or if hunting horror uses this Bonus Action on a different creature.

When this effect ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration hasn't expired in the meantime. Alternatively, the hyphan can make the target indifferent about creatures of its choice that the target is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the effect ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the GM rules otherwise.
