actions.value: The brute makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broken Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.value: The duskcap can take a bonus action on each of its turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: The duskcap deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the duskcap that isn't incapacitated and the duskcap doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 10 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the duskcap has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The duskcap dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Spike
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Sorcery Points
traits.value: The sporeslinger has 7 sorcery points. It regains all its spent sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend its sorcery points on the following options:

entries: **Quickened Spell**: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

**Twinned Spell**: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 10 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the sporeslinger has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The sporeslinger dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Sporestaff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the sporeslinger and its hyphan allies until the end of the sporeslinger's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: Strange new life germinates in the Haze. These multicoloured flowers emit a hallucination-inducing pollen and overflow with contaminated nectar. They are often fatally mistaken for an eldritch lily.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

actions.name: Contaminated Nectar
actions.value: The Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (recharges on a short or long rest)
actions.value: The Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom releases a cloud of glittering pollen out to a radius of 30 feet. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature is incapacitated and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom as possible.
The effect ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks when they Study a Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Slow Moving Plant.
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the plants movement, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Enchanted Blossoms.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Hypnotic Pollen action and Spell Reflection Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Tough and Unthinking.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the blossom's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: These plants typically grow in places protected from easy access, such as a pool of contaminated water, and they weaponize their environment against threats. The blossom attempts to contaminate victims with its nectar and uses the surroundings to amplify the danger of contamination. The flower is not agile enough to escape attacks, and relies on its Hypnotic Pollen to keep itself alive. Hypnotized victims view the flower as an impossibly beautiful object and are lured into any nearby hazards.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Plant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Sap.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Flowers.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Stem.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Spores.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Plant Dust.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the eldritch blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. If the target is Charmed by the eldritch blossom, it is hit automatically and has Disadvantage on its save.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the eldritch blossom. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and must approach the eldritch blossom on its turns, taking the most direct path possible and moving through hazards. The effect ends early if a creature takes an action to shake the target out of its stupor.

fluffInfo.value: *Hungry Hypnotizing Wolf*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Hypnovulfen have no power to mesmerize anyone holding a keepsake or memento received from a loved one, as it overpowers the false beckoning of the monster's gaze.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hypnovulfen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hypnovulfen makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20, one Medium or smaller creature Grappled by the hypnovulfen (the hypnovulfen can have only one creature swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The hypnovulfen swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the hypnovulfen, and takes 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage at the start of each of the hypnovulfen's turns. If the creature dies from this damage, the hypnovulfen absorbs its memories and regains 25 Hit Points.

If the hypnovulfen takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the hypnovulfen must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hypnovulfen and has the Prone condition. If the hypnovulfen dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. A creature holding a keepsake from a loved one succeeds automatically. *Failure:* The creature has the Charmed condition until it takes damage. While charmed, it has the Incapacitated condition and must move as close to the hypnovulfen as possible by the safest route. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

fluffInfo.value: Ice elementals are native to the Para-elemental Plane of Ice, where the Plane of Air and Plane of Water collide. The ice that makes up an ice elemental ranges in color from pale blue to frosty white to gray, although some are transparent. Sharp icicles protrude from their angular forms. The ice elementals can fire these icicles at enemies or use them to pierce foes.

Ice elementals sometimes cross into mortal worlds where cold winds blow across even colder waters. These conditions most often occur in a world's polar regions or where the connections between the world and the Elemental Planes are particularly strong.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, poison; exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.value: If the elemental takes Fire damage, its Piercing Form trait doesn't function on its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Piercing Form
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the elemental deals 5 (**1d10**) Piercing damage to any creature with 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Ice Claw attacks.

actions.name: Ice Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Shard Spray (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Cold damage, and the creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gargoyle makes two attacks, using Claw or Ice Dart in any combination.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ice Dart
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This alluring beauty has flesh and hair as white as snow and eyes as blue as glacial ice.*

fluffInfo.name: Born of the Ice
fluffInfo.value: Ice maidens are the daughters of powerful creatures of the cold, such as the Snow Queen, frost giants, and thursir. A few result from pleas by pregnant women lost in the snows, desperate to save their children. Fraughashar often raise these infants as ice maidens.

fluffInfo.name: Solitary Lives
fluffInfo.value: Most ice maidens live solitary existences save for a servant or two under their thrall. They're lonely creatures, desperate for love but condemned to know companionship only through their magical kiss. If genuine love ever fills an ice maiden's heart, she melts into nothingness.

fluffInfo.name: Killing Dilemma
fluffInfo.value: An ice maiden's hunger for affection and contact leads her to harm those she approaches, which only drives her harder to seek warmth and love. An ice maiden can become a dryad or even a humanoid if she keeps a lover's heart warm for a full year.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Chilling Presence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the ice maiden must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) cold damage. Unprotected, nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the maiden are extinguished, and water freezes if it remains within 15 feet of the maiden for at least 1 minute.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: The ice maiden can move across icy and snowy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ice maiden has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Snow Sight
traits.value: The ice maiden can see through areas obscured by snow or fog without penalty.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ice maiden makes two Ice Blade or Ice Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Ice Blade
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) cold damage.

actions.name: Kiss of the Frozen Heart
actions.value: The ice maiden kisses a willing Humanoid, freezing the target's heart. The target has immunity to cold damage, but it is charmed by the ice maiden until the maiden ends the effect (no action required) or until the target is kissed by a creature that loves it. The charmed target obeys the maiden's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm from the maiden or her allies, or if it receives a suicidal command, it can make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The maiden can have no more than three Humanoids charmed at a time.

actions.name: Icy Embrace (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ice maiden blasts wintry weather on a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) cold damage and is restrained by ice until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained. The area then becomes icy, difficult terrain for 1 minute.

bonusActions.name: Snow Step
bonusActions.value: The ice maiden teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain snow or ice.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of jagged ice. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (**1d8**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shard of ice.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) cold damage.

actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of cold air. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (**2d4**) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to six resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the ooze fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze uses Engulf and makes three Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 21 (**2d20**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 42 (**4d20**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 21 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d20):
1. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) force damage.
2. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) fire damage.
6. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) cold damage.
7. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) radiant damage.
11. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) poison damage.
12. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) psychic damage.

13. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The target or a creature within reach of the target can use its action to make a DC 21 Strength check, freeing the restrained creature on a success.
14. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the __confusion__ spell for 1 minute*.
15. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the reduce effect of the __enlarge/reduce__ spell for 1 minute*.
16. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the enlarge effect of the __enlarge/reduce__ spell for 1 minute*.
17. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the __zippit!__ spell for 1 minute*.

18. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 **1d20** until it finishes a long rest. The ooze regains a number of hit points equal to this value. A creature whose hit point maximum is reduced to 0 dies.
19. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be engulfed by the ooze.
20. Roll twice more on this table.
*These spells don't require *concentration*. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *This small demonic idol emits a palpable malice.*

fluffInfo.name: Relics of Dark Gods
fluffInfo.value: Idolic deities are found in ancient temples and deserted tombs. They are relics of an elder age and all that remain of the favored children of a deceiving dark god—mighty lordlings like Akoman the Evil Thought, Nanghant the Discontented, and Sarvar the Oppressor. Sent to consume the souls of those worshiping gods of light, these beings of shadow and sand labor slowly through corruption of the soul rather than outright war.

fluffInfo.name: Imprisoned Corruption
fluffInfo.value: The first idolic deities were created when corrupted ancient tribes and their priests began worshiping idols as gods, forsaking their masters' purposes to revel in their pride and vanity. Their deities struck them down for their treachery and imprisoned their corrupted souls in the idols they worshiped.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Apostasy Aura
traits.value: The idolic deity's presence causes devout followers to doubt their faith. When a creature attempts to use divine or celestial power, such as a cleric casting a spell or a paladin using Divine Smite, it must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the spell, class feature, or other divine or celestial power is expended, but it has no effect.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The idolic deity doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the idolic deity remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The idolic deity can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The idolic deity can use its Seduce the Righteous. It then makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (**4d8**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Seduce the Righteous
actions.value: The idolic deity corrupts one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws (the idolic deity's choice) until the end of its next turn. Creatures that wield divine or celestial power, such as clerics, paladins, or aasimars, have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: While in dim light or darkness, the idolic deity takes the Hide action.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.

fluffInfo.value: *An imperial ghoul stands tall and proud, its gray flesh robust and muscled, and its clothing strangely well kept. Its flickering red eyes have an intelligent, malicious gleam.*

*Spread mainly through bite wounds, this disease makes itself known within 24 hours by swiftly debilitating the infected. An infected creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw after every long rest. On a failed save, the victim takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the victim finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The victim recovers from the disease by making two consecutive successful saving throws. Greater restoration cures the disease, while lesser restoration gives the victim advantage on the next saving throw. Primarily spread among Humanoids, the disease can affect ogres, and therefore other Giants may be susceptible. If a creature dies while infected with darakhul fever, roll a d20, add the character's Constitution modifier, and find the result on the Adjustment Table below to determine what Undead form the victim's body rises in.*

fluffInfo.name: Shock Troops
fluffInfo.value: Imperial ghouls are the shock troops of the ghoul empire, eager to expand its power and influence. Treated like auxiliaries, they get the most difficult tasks: to engage and hold foes while the darakhul, iron legionnaires, and others outflank them.

fluffInfo.name: Ambitious Strivers
fluffInfo.value: Many believe that the hunger cults or the necrophagi know some secret of transforming imperial ghouls into iron ghouls. This rumor gives them hope of advancement. Their power over the lesser ghouls and slaves gives them a taste of tyranny. Because they are ambitious and always hungry for power, imperial ghouls are eager to prove themselves as hunters, as warriors, and as spies.

fluffInfo.name: Immune to Sun
fluffInfo.value: Unlike a standard darakhul, an imperial ghoul does not suffer from sunlight and feels little need to disguise its true appearance.

traits.name: Hungry Dead Nature
traits.value: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The imperial ghoul makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage, and, if the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach, one target. *Hit:* 17 (**4d6 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: The amphithere is a large aquatic serpent with a spiny tail fin and two large pectoral fins which it can flap to achieve powered flight. Its mouth contains venom-filled fangs as well as a forked tongue which it can use to sense its prey. Though it primarily resides in the sea feeding on schools of fish, it uses its fins to fly over coastal land to hunt whatever it can catch when fish are scarce.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The amphithere can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The young amphithere exhales a blast of stinging venom in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this attack remains stable but is poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. If a creature has total cover from the young amphithere, it is not affected by the breath attack.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +9, deception +12, insight +9, perception +9, persuasion +12, religion +9
**Resistances**: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: fire; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, flanked, frightened, paralyzed, stunned

traits.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
traits.value: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: True Name
traits.value: If a creature Lazivos can hear within 60 feet of him speaks his true name aloud, Lazivos loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours. Lazivos's true name is Minto Abi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lazivos makes three attacks using Infernal Rapier, Chancellor's Decree, or both.

actions.name: Infernal Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being invisible, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

actions.name: Chancellor's Decree
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) psychic damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

actions.name: Diabolic Deposition (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 (**6d8**) fire damage plus 27 (**6d8**) psychic damage or be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be dazed until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already dazed, they must choose the damage

bonusActions.name: As I Say
bonusActions.value: Lazivos commands a creature charmed by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +9, deception +12, insight +9, perception +9, persuasion +12, religion +9
**Resistances**: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: fire; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, flanked, frightened, paralyzed, stunned

traits.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
traits.value: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: True Name
traits.value: If a creature Lazivos can hear within 60 feet of him speaks his true name aloud, Lazivos loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours. Lazivos's true name is Minto Abi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lazivos makes three attacks using Infernal Rapier, Chancellor's Decree, or both.

actions.name: Infernal Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being invisible, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

actions.name: Chancellor's Decree
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) psychic damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

actions.name: Diabolic Deposition (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 (**6d8**) fire damage plus 27 (**6d8**) psychic damage or be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be dazed until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already dazed, they must choose the damage

bonusActions.name: As I Say
bonusActions.value: Lazivos commands a creature charmed by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Fiendish Audacity
traits.value: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Fiendish Fury
traits.value: The handler deals an extra 16 (**3d10**) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Fiendish Vigour
traits.value: The handler gains 15 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The handler makes four attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 30/120 ft., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) piercing damage. Reload (5).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The infernal tormentor makes two greatsword attacks. It can use infernal leash in place of one attack.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage and 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Infernal Leash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: A flaming whip appears in the infernal tormentor's hand or from its greatsword and lashes at a creature the tormentor can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. A creature that has signed a fiendish contract has disadvantage on this save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (**4d6**) fire damage, is pulled 10 feet closer to the tormentor, and is cursed for 1 minute or until the tormentor uses this action again. This curse also ends if the target enters hallowed ground.

While cursed, the target can't move more than 30 feet from the tormentor. Also while the curse lasts, the target takes 7 (**2d6**) extra fire damage from the tormentor's greatsword attacks. The tormentor can use a bonus action to move the target 10 feet to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the tormentor. If this space is dangerous, the target receives a new saving throw before moving, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Eldritch Heads (3/Day)
traits.value: When the leader hits a creature with an attack, the leader can cause the target to take an extra 9 (**2d8**) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, the leader can regain 9 (2d8) hit points. While the leader has at least one use of this trait remaining, it can't be *surprised* and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against the leader.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fate's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the skein witch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The skein witch has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The skein witch makes three Inexorable Thread attacks.

actions.name: Inexorable Thread
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 27 (**5d8 + 5**) Radiant damage. If the skein witch hits with this attack, it can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Destiny Distortion Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17 Each creature of its choice in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 55 Force damage, and the creature has Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute. A creature can make a save at the end of each of its turns to end this effect. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Bind Fates (1/Day)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17 One creature the skein witch can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target's fate is bound to that of one of its allies of the witch's choice. Any damage or condition the target suffers is inflicted on the ally to which it is bound instead, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. This binding lasts until lifted by a __Greater Restoration__, __Heal__, or __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

bonusActions.name: Cutting the Thread
bonusActions.value: The skein witch chooses a creature within 30 feet of it that it can see and that is at 0 Hit Points. If the creature was Stable, it is no longer Stable. In addition, it must make an immediate Death Saving Throw.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Injector, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Impervious to Pain
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Be careful, it's volatile!.
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Unstable Tank Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hardy Creature
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Injector's AC, Hit Points, and weakest ability score and saving throw.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: If the Injector has allies nearby, it uses Booster Dose to bolster them before combat. Otherwise, it ruthlessly attacks with its Syringe Arms. It feels no pain and does not waver or retreat.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Chemical Solution.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts..

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Plates.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

actions.name: Syringe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d4 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll 1d4; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

entries: **Lethal Injection**: The target takes 21 (**6d6**) Poison damage.
**Numbing Solution**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frozen condition (DC 16).

**Mind Dampener**: The target takes 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

**Induced Necrosis**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Booster Dose
actions.value: The injector administers a tincture to a Friendly creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Adrenaline Rush
actions.value: The target can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action or make one weapon attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Inoculation
actions.value: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

actions.name: Restorative Fluid
actions.value: The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. If the target is already at its Hit Point Maximum, it gains these as Temporary Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Focus
actions.value: The target has the Valor condition 1d4 for 1 minute.

fluffInfo.value: *This small devil wears a small red hat. A wicked grin flashes black teeth, and the creature nervously wrings its hands, baring long, needle-like claws.*

Ink devils have small, pursed mouths and long, thin, bony fingers with nails that resemble quills. Their heads are often bald or shaved in a monastic tonsure, and they have two small horns, no larger than an acorn. Their skin tends toward walnut, indigo, and black tones, though the eldest are as pale as parchment. They often wear robes and carry scroll cases.

fluffInfo.name: Cowards at Heart
fluffInfo.value: Ink devils are talkers and cowards. They prefer chatting, whining, and pleading to any form of combat. When they are forced to fight, they prefer to hide behind other devils. They force lesser devils, like lemures, to fight for them, resorting to their sharp claws only as a last resort.

fluffInfo.name: False Gifts
fluffInfo.value: They often give strangers false gifts, like letters of credit, charters, or scholarly papers inscribed with a dangerous glyph.

fluffInfo.name: Bibliophiles and Bookworms
fluffInfo.value: Ink devils live in libraries and scriptoria in Hell and related planes. Their speed and keen vision make them excellent accountants, record keepers, translators, and note takers. They cannot be trusted, and they delight in altering documents for their own amusement or in their master's service.

**Languages**: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the ink devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ink devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Devil's Ink
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be marked with a small, fiendish tattoo for 24 hours. Devils have advantage on attack rolls against the marked target, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the spells and abilities of devils.

actions.name: Corrupt Scroll
actions.value: The ink devil touches a scroll, corrupting it. A creature using the scroll must succeed a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or the spell harms the caster (if an offensive spell), helps the nearest devil (if beneficial), or fails, consuming the scroll (if not offensive or if no devils are in range to benefit from the magic).

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The ink devil magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Disrupt Concentration, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the ink devil wears or carries is invisible with it.

bonusActions.name: Disrupt Concentration
bonusActions.value: One spellcaster *concentrating* on a spell within 30 feet of the ink devil that the devil can see must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or lose *concentration* on the spell.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Innocent Harvester, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Metal and Wood
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Innocent Harvester's creature type as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (12+) Clamber and Leap
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Innocent Harvester's Leap.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple Construct
fluffInfo.value: You know the Innocent Harvester's mental saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Though small and innocent in appearance, Innocent Harvesters are not defenseless. They are fast and agile, equipped with surgical tools in place of one hand and a syringe in the other. Made to subdue trespassers, or remove body parts from corpses, these unflinching minions will not hesitate to leap atop targets. However, they are more comfortable hiding and fleeing than fighting. Their job is to collect body parts. If threatened, they leap onto a target and begin using their surgical tools on them. Harvesters attempt to sedate wounded targets and flee.

fluffInfo.value: Construct.

traits.name: Normal Semblance
traits.value: The harvester has Advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) and Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

actions.name: Surgical Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Syringe (1/Day)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Poison damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Latch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The harvester moves up to its Speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. *Hit:* The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has Advantage on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful DC 13 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The harvester takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +2, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.value: The inspired has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The inspired makes two Crysteel Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with __Vicious Mockery__.

actions.name: Crysteel Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Force damage.

fluffInfo.value: Within the Space Between Worlds, creatures exist that feed on arcane power, craving magic of all sorts, but particularly power that extraplanar patrons grant to mortals. One such creature identified by the Amethyst Academy has been classified simply as an Interloper.

fluffInfo.name: Drawn to Magic
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers crave magic, especially delighting in extracting the arcane power wielded by warlocks.
They latch onto the connection between a warlock and their patron, attempting to follow that connection into the Material plane where they lie in wait for their victim.

fluffInfo.name: Clustered Predators
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers seldom appear alone, preferring to attack in groups of three or more. Occasionally, they have been observed to bicker, fighting each other for the largest share of the spoils.

fluffInfo.name: Spell Snatchers
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers are feared by spellcasters because of their ability to Siphon Spells thrown at them. Once spellcasters recognize an area is infested with these creatures, they often commission Paladins of the Silver Order or grizzled monster hunters to hunt them down.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study an Interloper, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Multidimensional Senses
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Blindsight trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Magical Entity
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Siphon Spell ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Agile and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You know the Interloper's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: An Interloper has only one objective, to feast on the spellcaster's magic that attracted it, and then to return to whence it came. It pursues the nearest spellcaster, prioritizing warlocks, assailing them until they are dead, or the caster's magic is spent It Teleports to evade physical attacks. If an Interloper drops below 10 Hit Points, it will __Plane Shift__, retreating into the Space Between Worlds to recover, seeking to return to feast again, likely in greater numbers.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the interloper can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The interloper is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the interloper's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Interloper is immune to the Jinxed condition.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The interloper has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the interloper's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

actions.name: Spindly Claw
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11, one creature within 5 ft. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. Succes: half damage only.

actions.name: Suckered Bite

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.value: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.value: The interloper casts __Plane Shift__ targeting only itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The interloper teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

fluffInfo.value: *Intruder From Beyond the Stars*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The invaders have little resilience to the toxic and virulent threats of the Material Plane, and they succumb quickly to diseases and poisons.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.value: If a creature tries to read the intruder's mind or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the Stunned condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Gliding Levitation
traits.value: The invader hovers 6 inches above the ground and leaves no tracks. It ignores Difficult Terrain caused by conditions on the ground, can move over liquids, and takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The invader has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Weak Constitution
traits.value: The invader has Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. If the invader is Poisoned at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The invader makes three Disrupting Touch attacks and uses Unnerving Glare if available.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Force damage. A creature killed or an object destroyed by this damage is reduced to a fine gray dust.
Magic items, and any equipment worn or carried by a disintegrated creature, don't disintegrate.

actions.name: Unnerving Glare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the invader can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the invader's next turn.

traits.value: The stalker is invisible.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.value: The stalker is given a quarry by its summoner. The stalker knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The stalker also knows the location of its summoner.

traits.name: Death Flash

It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Invisible
traits.value: The invisiboar always has the Invisible condition unless it's in the area of an __Antimagic Field__ spell or similar effect.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (**2d6**) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: *A vicious-looking ghoul carries a cruel glaive, its forearms stained with dried blood. Its glowing, rust-colored eyes penetrate with a calculating stare of restrained hunger.*

*Spread mainly through bite wounds, this disease makes itself known within 24 hours by swiftly debilitating the infected. An infected creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw after every long rest. On a failed save, the victim takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the victim finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The victim recovers from the disease by making two consecutive successful saving throws. Greater restoration cures the disease, while lesser restoration gives the victim advantage on the next saving throw. Primarily spread among Humanoids, the disease can affect ogres, and therefore other Giants may be susceptible. If a creature dies while infected with darakhul fever, roll a d20, add the character's Constitution modifier, and find the result on the Adjustment Table below to determine what Undead form the victim's body rises in.*

fluffInfo.name: Backbone of the Legions
fluffInfo.value: Iron ghouls and ghasts are the elite members of the imperial legions, acting as officers, non-commissioned officers, and standard-bearers. They feed from the slave pits and march on the orders of the darakhul nobility.

fluffInfo.name: Fond of Uniforms
fluffInfo.value: Iron ghouls are proud of their status and uniforms. Their standard breastplates and open-faced helms are black iron with brass trim, and the helm's crest is often a ruby-dyed fan of bat wings or carrion beetle bristles to indicate their authority.

fluffInfo.name: Tooth and Bone Weaponry
fluffInfo.value: Many items of an iron ghoul's gear are decorated with inlaid bone or set with teeth, much as pearls might be used for weapons crafted elsewhere.

traits.name: Hungry Dead Nature
traits.value: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The iron ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The iron ghoul makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, or it makes three Glaive attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 100/400, one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The golem makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**3d10 + 7**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Hellborn
traits.value: The barbarian has advantage on any Charisma (*Intimidation*) or Charisma (*Persuasion*) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

traits.name: Rage (3/Day)
traits.value: As a bonus action, the barbarian can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the barbarian is knocked unconscious or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the barbarian gains the following benefits:

entries: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +2 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the barbarian can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the barbarian isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: While the barbarian is raging, it makes two melee attacks, one of which must be with its claw.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage, or 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage while raging.

actions.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 bludgeoning or slashing damage (barbarian's choice) plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

traits.name: Feral Instinct
traits.value: The gladiator has advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if the gladiator is *surprised* at the beginning of combat and isn't incapacitated, it can act normally on its first turn, but only if it enters its rage before doing anything else on that turn.

traits.name: Hellborn
traits.value: The gladiator has advantage on any Charisma (*Intimidation*) or Charisma (*Persuasion*) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

traits.name: Planar Conspirator (1/Day)
traits.value: The gladiator can cast the __contact other plane__ spell, but only as a ritual.

traits.name: Rage (4/Day)
traits.value: As a bonus action, the gladiator can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the gladiator is knocked unconscious or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the gladiator gains the following benefits:

entries: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +3 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
If it succeeds on a grapple check, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage, and it takes another 3 (**1d6**) fire damage at the end of each of its turns until the grapple ends.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the gladiator can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the gladiator isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The gladiator makes two melee attacks. While the barbarian is raging, it can make one additional attack with its claw.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage, or 14 (**2d6 + 7**) slashing damage while raging.

actions.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning or slashing damage (gladiator's choice) plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**3d10 + 3**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrific Visage
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the ghost and isn't an Undead. *Failure:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the ghost's next turn. *Success* The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. *Success* The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *The creature's mighty tail thrashes ships, docks, and sailors in its path of destruction.*

fluffInfo.name: Coastal Destroyer
fluffInfo.value: The isonade is a beast of destruction, sweeping away entire islands and villages. Though not very intelligent, it singles out a community and tries to lure residents into the waves by forcing plentiful fish to the surface, easy pickings for even the most amateur fishers.

fluffInfo.name: Ocean Sacrifices
fluffInfo.value: When coastal villagers suffer from a hurricane or tsunami, they fall back on folklore and blame the stirrings of the isonade. Some say that a degenerate group seeks to draw the beast forth by dumping a long chain of bound and screaming sacrifices into the lightless depths of the sea.

fluffInfo.name: Ancient Being
fluffInfo.value: The beast's age is unknown, and many coastal bards tell various legends of the creature. Some say it is the last of its kind, while others say that a small group of isonades lurks in the depths.

entries: **Languages**: understands Aquan and Elvish, but can't speak

traits.name: Influence Weather
traits.value: Nearby weather responds to the isonade's desires. At the start of each minute, the isonade can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 1 mile of it by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the __control weather__ spell, except the isonade can't change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The isonade has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The isonade deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.value: The isonade can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The isonade makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slap attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 36 (**4d12 + 10**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the isonade. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the isonade, and it takes 21 (**6d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the isonade's turns. An isonade can have no more than four creatures swallowed at a time. If the isonade takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the isonade. If the isonade dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**4d6 + 10**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breach
actions.value: If the isonade swims at least 20 feet as part of its movement, it can use this action to emerge in a space on the surface of the water that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures and each creature within 10 of the isonade's space must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 (**14d6**) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and is pushed up to 10 feet out of the isonade's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the isonade's space.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The ithjar has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Slippery Serpent
traits.value: The ithjar has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple or saving throws to avoid being paralyzed or restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ithjar attacks once with its bite and once with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ithjar can't use its tail on another target.

entries: **Languages**: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: Ithu'rath can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: Ithu'rath is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Slimy Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Ithu'rath fails a saving throw, they can succeed on the save by channeling the power of their protective slime. Until the end of Ithu'rath's next turn, creatures have advantage on the saving throw for Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle attack.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Ithu'rath has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ithu'rath makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or __lesser restoration__ spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: Ithu'rath targets a creature with a head, legs, or torso they can see within 60 feet of them, blasting them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the Ithu'rath's choice:

entries: **Head.** The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
**Legs.** The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

**Torso.** The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

actions.value: The transformation lasts until a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or the __greater restoration__ spell affects the target. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a __wish__ spell or similar supernatural effects.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.value: Ithu'rath teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.
