fluffInfo.value: *This strong and handsome warrior has a snarling hyena's face at the back of its head.*

fluffInfo.name: Dark Appetites
fluffInfo.value: Kishi are two-faced male demons perpetually driven by their voracious appetites, carnal or otherwise, with a predilection for female humanoids. Kishi frequently behead, scalp, or skin their conquests and decorate their shields with their trophies.

fluffInfo.name: Hats and Veils
fluffInfo.value: Kishi demons typically masquerade as muscular warriors or glib storytellers, wearing elaborate headdresses or clan veils to hide the demonic hyena face on the back of their head.

fluffInfo.name: Deadly Charmers
fluffInfo.value: They use magical and nonmagical means of persuasion to inveigle women into their embrace, but their trysts always end in a grisly feast upon their victim's flesh.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Fiendish Weapons
traits.value: The kishi's weapon attacks are magical. When the kishi hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d8** cold damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.value: The kishi has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The kishi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kishi makes one Bite attack and two Spear attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage.

bonusActions.name: Trophy Shield
bonusActions.value: The kishi absorbs some of the essence of a creature it killed since the end of its previous turn and magically creates a grisly trophy of the creature on its shield or spear. For 1 hour, its Armor Class becomes 20, and creatures of the same type as the slain creature have disadvantage on attack rolls against the kishi.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Kishina has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Light Landing
traits.value: Kishina takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Kishina's long jump is up to 45 feet and her high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Kishina makes four Unarmed Strike attacks or three Throwing Knife attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage, or 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage on a critical hit.

actions.name: Throwing Knife
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d4 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Painful Sprint (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Kishina moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks, hitting a pressure point on each enemy she can see who she passes within 5 feet of during this move. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throwing or be poisoned until the start of their next turn. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Throw
bonusActions.value: Kishina attempts to throw a Large or smaller enemy she can see within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet away from her and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: Klar can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: Klar can mimic animal sounds. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Klar's long jump is up to 40 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Klar makes one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mantis Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 f., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller target doesn't halve Klar's speed. Klar can have only one target grappled in this way at a time.

bonusActions.name: Bellowing Roar (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Klar lets loose a terrifying roar.

Each creature within 30 feet of Klar who can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Klar for 1 minute. If a creature frightened in this way takes damage, they can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on themself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Kangaroo Leap
bonusActions.value: Klar jumps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffInfo.value: A knifewing is a gliding lizard about the size of a small dog. Its gliding flaps have hard edges that are sharp while stretched taut when the lizard glides.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The knifewing doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Glider
traits.value: The knifewing can't ascend while flying and its altitude decreases by 5 feet for every 30 feet it flies. If flying, the knifewing falls if it doesn't fly at least 30 feet during its turn.

actions.name: Knifewing (Flying Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *A grey-skinned figure in an impressive suit of reflective black plate armor towers over you. The cruelness of the spikes of his tower shield are matched only by his sneering smirk.*

Humanoids who dwell in the Shadow Realm sometimes pursue the path of a shadow knight to better serve their liege lords. Blessed by the shadow fey, these glorified bruisers are dark reflections of the cavaliers who protect the mortal world.

fluffInfo.name: Dark Arms
fluffInfo.value: Knights of shadow carry shadow fey forged swords and shields imbued with potent magic. Merely touching the surface of these armaments is enough to drain warmth and vitality.

fluffInfo.name: Sensory Training
fluffInfo.value: Every knight of shadows is trained to fight in magically dark conditions, so they are equipped to deal with the many light‑manipulating creatures who haunt the Shadow Realm. They combine their talents for blind fighting with their magical control of darkness to get the drop on unsuspecting foes.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the knight has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Unseelie Blessing
traits.value: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put them to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes two Longsword attacks and one Shield Bash attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of the knight's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Commander
bonusActions.value: The knight casts __darkness__, requiring no material components. The knight must concentrate on this spell as normal.

fluffInfo.value: Knight-Captain Theodore Marshal is a man in his prime. He is athletic and tall with boldly sculpted features, bronzed skin, and unkempt sandy brown hair. Unshaven stubble has grown into a beard over the criss-cross of scars on his face. A leather patch covers his right eye. He wears gleaming silver plate armour etched with golden trim, and carries a shimmering sword and a broad shield engraved with the symbol of the Sacred Flame.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I act with determined calm and respect. Little rouses my anger, instead I respond with disappointment when others incite my ire.
**Ideal**: I believe that good-hearted people can set aside their differences to work together.
**Bond**: I am willing to lay down my life for a just and righteous cause.
**Flaw**: I will never give up on my comrades. I do not trade lives.

traits.name: Divine Strikes
traits.value: Theodore Marshal's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **4d8** radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Theodore Marshal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Theodore Marshal wields a holy avenger longsword.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Theodore Marshal makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Holy Avenger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**1d8 + 8**) slashing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage.

traits.name: Aura of Righteousness
traits.value: Theodore projects a 30-foot Emanation of radiant power. Allies in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Theodore always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Theodore can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Theodore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Holy Avenger Longsword**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of Theodore's choice.
**Divine Smite**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Searing Smite
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Thunderous Smite
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Theodore and has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Shield
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft or range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn. *Hit or Miss:* After being thrown, the shield returns to Theodore's hand.

actions.name: Charge (1/Round)
actions.value: Theodore moves up to his Speed toward a Hostile creature he can see. He gains Advantage on the next weapon attack he makes this round.

actions.name: Call the Sacred Flame (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within 60 feet of Theodore. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Radiant damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends).

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Theodore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Theodore can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The adeptus gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the adeptus must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Firecracker
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**2d4**) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. The adeptus has advantage on this attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor.

actions.name: Lesser Magic Missile (1/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
actions.value: The adeptus creates three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of their choice who they can see within 120 feet of them. A dart deals 2 (**1d2 + 1**) force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and the adeptus can direct them to hit one creature or several. This action is considered to be the __magic missile__ spell for the purpose of other spells and effects.

fluffInfo.value: *This slight, reptilian humanoid is bedecked with ceramic flasks and glass vials. An acrid reek follows in its wake.*

Kobold alchemists are usually smelled before they are seen, thanks to the apothecary's store of chemicals and poisons they carry. Alchemists often sport mottled and discolored scales and skin, caused by the caustic nature of their obsessions. They raid alchemy shops and magical laboratories to gather more material to fuel their alchemical experiments.

fluffInfo.name: Dangerous Assets
fluffInfo.value: Alchemists can be a great boon to their clan, but at a cost. Not only do the alchemists require rare, expensive, and often dangerous substances to ply their trade, they tend to be a little unhinged. Their experiments yield powerful weapons and defensive concoctions that can save many kobold lives, but the destruction caused by an experiment gone awry can be devastating for the alchemist's neighbors.

traits.name: Apothecary
traits.value: At the start of each of the kobold alchemist's turns, the alchemist chooses one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The alchemist has resistance to that damage type until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kobold makes two Alchemical Dagger or Alchemical Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Alchemical Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 **1d4 + 3** piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) damage of the type determined by Apothecary.

actions.name: Alchemical Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) damage of the type determined by Apothecary.

actions.name: Alchemical Vapors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The kobold alchemist releases alchemical vapors pleasing to draconic senses and unpleasant to all others. Each creature that isn't a dragonborn or kobold within 15 feet of the alchemist must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (**5d6**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each dragonborn and kobold within 15 feet of the alchemist has resistance to damage of the type determined by Apothecary for 1 minute.

actions.name: Explosive Flask (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The kobold alchemist throws a flask of volatile substances at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The flask explodes, and each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 **4d6** damage of the type determined by Apothecary and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The artifex gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the artifex must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The artifex makes one Chain Hook attack and uses Activate Trap, if available.

actions.name: Chain Hook
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the artifex.

actions.name: Activate Trap (3/Day)
actions.value: The artifex activates one of the following hidden traps; the artifex can't use the same trap two rounds in a row:

actions.name: Spiky Pit Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, opening a concealed 15-foot-square trapdoor on the ground centered on that point to reveal a 10-foot-deep pit trap lined with spikes. Creatures on the ground in the trapdoor's area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the pit and takes 3 (**1d6**) piercing damage from the spikes and 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage from the fall. On a successful save, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside that area.

actions.name: Swarm of Bees Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, causing a buried canister to erupt and release a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder of swarming bees. When a creature enters the swarm's area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 (**2d4**) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. At the start of each of the artifex's turns, the swarm moves 10 feet away from the artifex in a straight line. The swarm disperses after 1 minute or when the artifex dies.

actions.name: Wall of Fire Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, igniting a concealed trench of oil and creating a 20-foot long, 15-foot high, and 1-foot-thick wall of fire. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. The wall is opaque and lasts for 1 minute.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The centurion gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the centurion must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Pilum
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Firetail Pilum (2/Day)
actions.value: The centurion ignites a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the target and each creature in a 5-foot-wide line between the target and the centurion must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**2d4**) fire damage. The line smolders for 1 minute, creating a 5-foot-wide, 20-foot-tall wall of opaque smoke. A creature within reach of the pilum can use an action to extinguish it, causing the smoke to dissipate.

actions.name: Boom Pilum!!! (1/Day)
actions.value: The centurion straps a vial of unstable ores to a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the ores explode after the attack. The target and each creature within 10 feet of them must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) thunder damage, is knocked prone, and is deafened for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and isn't knocked prone or deafened.

fluffInfo.value: *This small, draconic humanoid struts as though it were ten feet tall. It wears the gilded skull of a small dragon as a helmet, and its beady eyes gleam out through the skull's sockets. It hefts its spear and shield and lets out a blood-curdling shriek, signaling the attack*.

While most kobolds are scuttling scavengers or pathetic sycophants, a few carry a spark of draconic nobility that can't be ignored. These few forge their tribes into forces to be reckoned with, rising to the rank of chieftain. A kobold chieftain stands proud, clad in war gear of fine quality and good repair. Their weapons are tended by the tribe's tinkerers, particularly evident in their springspike shields.

fluffInfo.name: Living Legend
fluffInfo.value: A kobold chieftain is more than a leader, it is a symbol of the tribe's greatness. The strongest, most cunning, most ruthless of a kobold tribe embodies their connection to the revered dragons. When a chieftain sounds the call to battle, the kobolds meld into a fearless, deadly force.

traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the chieftain hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Chieftain's Presence
traits.value: Dragons and kobolds within 30 feet of the chieftain can't be charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The kobold chieftain has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the kobold chieftain has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kobold makes three Spear or Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Inspiring Shriek (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The kobold chieftain shrieks a draconic battle cry. Each creature that isn't a dragonborn or kobold within 30 feet of the chieftain must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Each dragonborn and kobold within 30 feet of the chieftain is inspired for 1 minute. Whenever an inspired creature makes an attack roll or saving throw, the creature can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

entries: **HP**: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, history +1 plus PB, perception +0 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Gladius)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d8 plus PB** piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the decanus can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Reinforce (3/Day)
actions.value: When the decanus sees an ally within 30 feet of them being targeted by an attack, the decanus can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the target. If the decanus ends their movement within 5 feet of the target, the target gains a +PB bonus to their AC until the beginning of the decanus's next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: 5th Level: Shield Bash (3/Day)
actions.value: The decanus attempts to topple a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Succeed or fail, the decanus then makes two signature attacks against any creature within reach.

actions.name: 7th Level: One-Kobold Army (1/Day)
actions.value: The decanus moves up to their speed, then makes a number of signature attacks equal to the number of enemies within 5 feet of them (minimum of three attacks). Each enemy within range must be attacked at least once. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Charisma saving throw or be frightened of the decanus for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

entries: **HP**: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, history +1 plus PB, perception +0 plus PB

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d8 plus PB** piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the decanus can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Reinforce (3/Day)
actions.value: When the decanus sees an ally within 30 feet of them being targeted by an attack, the decanus can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the target. If the decanus ends their movement within 5 feet of the target, the target gains a +PB bonus to their AC until the beginning of the decanus's next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: 5th Level: Shield Bash (3/Day)
actions.value: The decanus attempts to topple a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Succeed or fail, the decanus then makes two signature attacks against any creature within reach.

actions.name: 7th Level: One-Kobold Army (1/Day)
actions.value: The decanus moves up to their speed, then makes a number of signature attacks equal to the number of enemies within 5 feet of them (minimum of three attacks). Each enemy within range must be attacked at least once. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Charisma saving throw or be frightened of the decanus for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The legionary gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the legionary must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The legionary makes two Gladius attacks. They can replace one attack with a Shield Bash attack.

actions.name: Gladius
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness
traits.value: The kobold mech has the following flaw:

entries: **Rustable**: If the kobold mech takes 10 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The kobold mech has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Piloted
traits.value: The kobold mech is piloted by a kobold. The kobold dies if the kobold mech is reduced to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Self-Destruct
traits.value: When the kobold mech is reduced to 0 hit points, its cache of dynamite immediately explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of the kobold must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Multiattacks
actions.value: The kobold mech makes two attacks with its Cavitation Drill. It can replace one of these attacks with a Javelin Missile.

actions.name: Cavitation Drill
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) thunder damage.

actions.name: Javelin Missile (6/Day)
actions.value: The kobold mech fires a dynamite-strapped javelin at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The signifer gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the signifer must be wielding a shield.

traits.name: Standard Bearer
traits.value: Each kobold unit can have one or more signifers, whose weapon is their unit's battle standard. If a signifer drops their signum, they use the kobold tiro stat block instead. If an allied kobold tiro uses an action to pick up a signum not carried by another creature, that tiro uses the kobold signifer stat block instead. When a signifer or tiro's stat block changes in this way, any conditions or effects currently affecting them remain active, and their hit points and hit point maximum remain the same.
A signum that isn't being held by a creature can be damaged; it has AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The signifer makes two Signum attacks.

actions.name: Signum
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shield Wall Formation
actions.value: The signifer chooses up to four kobolds within 60 feet of them who can hear them. Each kobold can use their reaction to move up to their speed, and each kobold who does so must end this movement within 5 feet of an ally.

bonusActions.name: Glory to the Legion (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The signifer and each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them regains 5 (**2d4**) hit points.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the tiro takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tiro takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The tiro gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the tiro must be wielding a shield.

traits.name: Testudo
traits.value: When the tiro finishes a long rest, they choose a non-minion creature to be their commander. While a tiro who isn't incapacitated or prone is within 5 feet of their commander, the commander gains a cumulative +1 bonus to AC (maximum bonus of +5).

actions.name: Pugio (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This kobold is bedecked in satchels, pouches, sacks, and bandoliers. All of these are bursting with tools, bits of scrap, wire, cogs, and twine. Impossibly large eyes blink through the lenses of its goggles*.

Some kobolds hatch a bit cleverer than their counterparts. These sharp-witted creatures feel driven to fiddle with the world, and those that don't meet an early demise through accident or violence often take up tinkering. Trapsmiths make a kobold lair into a deadly gauntlet of hidden pain.

fluffInfo.name: Improvisers
fluffInfo.value: Trapsmiths are adept at improvising on-the-fly. They can use whatever spare parts are at hand to create simple thieves' tools or construct makeshift traps to fling at foes.

fluffInfo.name: Shifting Peril
fluffInfo.value: Trapsmiths aren't warriors and avoid direct confrontation with enemies that aren't mired in traps or engaged with other foes. If the trapsmith senses that invaders in its lair are likely to get past its traps, it tries to hide or escape. A trapsmith delights in laying traps and snares behind invaders, along tunnels and paths they've already cleared and believe to be safe, then luring them back through its handiwork.

traits.name: Improvised Tools
traits.value: The kobold trapsmith can use any Tiny objects at hand to pick locks and disarm traps, as if any such object was part of a set of thieves' tools. It is proficient in using Tiny objects in this way. In addition, the trapsmith has advantage on ability checks to pick locks and disarm traps.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The kobold trapsmith has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the trapsmith's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the kobold trapsmith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The trapsmith uses Makeshift Trap then makes one Dagger or Spare Part attack.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spare Part
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage or slashing damage (the trapsmith's choice).

actions.name: Makeshift Trap
actions.value: The kobold trapsmith cobbles together a quick trap with materials at hand and throws it at a point on the ground it can see within 30 feet of it. The trapsmith chooses one of the following traps. Each creature in the trap's area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or suffer the trap's effects.

entries: **Bursting Much-Heavy Net**: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage and is restrained for 1 minute. A creature can take an action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.
**Spikes-on-Spikes**: Each creature within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 10 (**4d4**) piercing damage and the area within 10 feet of the point is difficult terrain for 1 minute.

**Spring-Loaded Whirly Blades**: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 14 (**4d6**) slashing damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
**Static-Generating Thingamabob**: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 5 feet of where the trap lands takes 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The veles gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the veles must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Pilum
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage. If the attack hits a creature wielding a shield, the veles can embed the pilum in the shield, giving the target disadvantage on attack rolls until the target either stops wielding the shield or uses an action to remove the pilum from it. The veles carries six pila.

bonusActions.name: Pivot
bonusActions.value: The veles moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Not What I Seem
traits.value: The venator begins combat disguised as an inexperienced warrior. They have advantage on their first weapon attack roll against a creature who hasn't seen them make an attack.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The venator gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the venator must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Dolabra
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Net
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. *Hit:* The target is restrained until they are freed. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming them and destroys the net. The venator carries one net.

bonusActions.name: Lost in the Crowd
bonusActions.value: The venator takes the Hide action. They have advantage on their Dexterity (*Stealth*) check if they are within 5 feet of two or more allied kobolds.

bonusActions.name: Then We Light the Net on Fire!
bonusActions.value: The venator chooses a creature within 5 feet of them who is restrained by a net and lights that net on fire. While restrained by the net, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. Each time the net deals damage, roll any die. On an odd result, the net burns away and is destroyed, freeing the restrained creature. A creature who attempts to free the restrained creature from the net (as described in the venator's Net attack) automatically puts out the fire as part of that action, regardless of whether that check succeeds.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 20 Ft. But See Loose Plating, *burrow* 20 Ft.
**Immunities**: fire, poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralysed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 310 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 18 (+4). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 33,000 XP (66,000 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness
traits.value: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

entries: **Arcanothermic Engine**: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.
**Rustable**: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Loose Plating
traits.value: When the koboldzilla is reduce to 165 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 19, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koboldzilla makes two attacks: one with its Gazebo Smash and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Gazebo Smash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**4d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (**12d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the trollkin has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The trollkin regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The trollkin berserker makes four attacks, using Freezing Bryntroll or Freezing Handaxe in any combination.

actions.name: Freezing Bryntroll
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage. Once per round, if the berserker hits with its bryntroll, it can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first, and that is within reach. On a hit, the second creature takes 13 (**2d12**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Freezing Handaxe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This large pterodactyl has emergent feathers and a long, beaklike jaw.*

fluffInfo.name: Boat Breaker
fluffInfo.value: The kongamato's name means "breaker of boats," and, as that implies, it delights in systematically destroying the small vessels of those who come too close to its perch. No one knows what motivates this form of attack, although some sages suppose that the kongamato mistakes canoes for large prey like hippopotamuses or crocodiles.

fluffInfo.name: Spoken in Whispers
fluffInfo.value: For some tribes, kongamatos present a terrible threat, and the villagers speak only in whispers about them, fearing that mention of the beasts could attract their wrath. In some cases, evil priests and cultists summon these beasts as their servitors and use them to terrify villagers.

fluffInfo.name: Maneaters
fluffInfo.value: Kongamatos that have eaten human flesh develop a preference for it. These maneaters perform nightly raids on small towns, snatching locals in their claws and flying away.

traits.name: Breaker of Boats
traits.value: The kongamato deals double damage to objects and structures made of wood or lighter materials.

traits.name: Carry Off
traits.value: The kongamato can fly at half its flying speed when dragging two creatures it has grappled or at its full flying speed if dragging only one creature it has grappled.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The kongamato doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kongamato makes one Beak attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The kongamato has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Terrifying Screech (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The kongamato releases a screech in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) thunder damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breathless Aura
traits.value: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Wings of Breath
traits.value: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Choking Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

actions.name: Last Gasp
actions.value: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breathless Aura
traits.value: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Wings of Breath
traits.value: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Choking Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

actions.name: Last Gasp
actions.value: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

fluffInfo.value: *The fiendish hulk bears features taken from a nightmare scorpion, with three stinging tails and four limbs. It wields a massive scythe.*

fluffInfo.name: Shaped by Arbeyach
fluffInfo.value: These fiends sprang from the dark imagination of Hell's Prince of Swarms, Arbeyach, who twisted them into being from lemures and scorpions. Arbeyach shaped the koralk to be annihilators in battle and to gather souls from the fallen, bypassing typical soul collection methods to feed his war machine more quickly. They are sometimes called "harvester devils."

fluffInfo.name: Transforming Poison
fluffInfo.value: Poison from the koralk's stingers liquefies the victim's insides in an agonizing transformation. The creature swells as its organs, muscles, and skeleton rapidly break down and reform, transforming the creature into a lemure in a burst of fiendish goo. The new lemure is subject to the will of more powerful devils, and its fate from that moment on is the same as any lemure's. The koralk's poison can work this transformation on demons, giving Arbeyach's armies a unique edge.

fluffInfo.name: Infernal Mounts
fluffInfo.value: A koralk is strong enough for many devils to ride. They prefer only powerful devils as riders, but they obey their superiors and carry even the lowest of devils into battle if directed. Arbeyach often rides an especially large specimen into battle, called the Grand Annihilator by his devilish troops.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness does not impair the koralk's darkvision.

traits.name: Harvester Venom
traits.value: The koralk produces a potent poison that liquefies the innards of those affected by it. Every hour that elapses after a creature succumbs to this poison, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) poison damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. Creatures with resistance or immunity to poison or the poisoned condition can be affected by this poison. Such creatures have advantage on the saving throw. This potent poison remains within the creature's body until removed by the __greater restoration__ spell or similar magic. If a creature dies while suffering from this poison, it rises as a lemure 1 hour later under the control of the nearest non-lemure devil within 1 mile.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The koralk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Steadfast
traits.value: The koralk can't be frightened while it can see an ally within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koralk makes one Bite attack, one Scythe attack, and three Stinger attacks. It can replace its Scythe attack with a Vestigial Arms attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or succumb to the devil's venom (see the Harvester Venom trait).

actions.name: Vestigial Arms
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the devil can't use its Vestigial Arms on another target.

traits.name: Trader's Eye
traits.value: The merchant has Advantage on Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to determine if goods are of poor quality or a forgery, and it has Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) checks to recognize when a creature is attempting to sell it poor quality or forged goods.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The merchant captain makes four attacks, using Shortsword or Quip in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Quip
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Fast Talk
bonusActions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15 A creature the merchant captain can see within 30 feet of it. *Failure:* The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the merchant captain's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This oddly colored cat appears at first to be a powerful panther of some kind. Its wide mouth pulls into something like a human grin, and its knowing eyes hint at intelligence beyond that of a typical jungle cat.*
Enemies of elves and blink dogs, kot bayuns are magical hunting cats gifted with eloquent speech and cunning abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Speaking Fey Cats
fluffInfo.value: These brutal and temperamental creatures get along well with cruel-minded fey. Gentler fey rightfully find the creatures to be a menace. A kot bayun measures six feet long and weighs over 200 pounds. They are long-lived, and some stories record the same kot bayun in a region for over 400 years.

fluffInfo.name: Sing to Sleep
fluffInfo.value: In addition to their stealthy natures and physical prowess, kot bayun have the ability to put prey to sleep with song. They carefully stalk victims for a time, learning the victim's strengths and weaknesses before making their attack. They lie in wait until their prey is vulnerable and then begin their song. Those resisting the call to slumber are always the kot bayun's first victims as the predator launches from cover and attempts to disembowel its prey. In forests with a thick canopy, a kot bayun stealthily creeps among tree limbs, tracking the movement of its prey below.

fluffInfo.name: Healing Poetry
fluffInfo.value: If discovered by intelligent prey, a kot bayun opens with a parley instead of claws. In rare cases, a kot bayun finds something in its prey it likes, and cold predation turns to a lukewarm association. Befriending a kot bayun has benefits, as the creature's poems, tales, and sagas have healing power. A kot bayun tells its stories in the form of strange epics and poetry, ranging from simple rhyming folk poems to complex sonnets, and it heals listeners only at the end of the poem.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kot bayun can use its Slumbering Song. It then makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The kot bayun magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Slumbering Song, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the kot bayun wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Slumbering Song
actions.value: The kot bayun sings a magical song to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw on fall unconscious for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the kot bayun uses a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing, the target has disadvantage on this saving throw. Otherwise, the effect ends for a target if the target takes damage while below half its hp maximum.

If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the kot bayun's Slumbering Song for the next 24 hours. The kot bayun can have up to two creatures unconscious from its song at a time.

actions.name: Healing Purr (2/Day)
actions.value: The kot bayun purrs at a creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target magically regains 10 (3d6) hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.value: Whenever the goat-knight or a creature friendly to it within 10 feet of it makes a saving throws, that creature gains a +2 bonus (included in the goat-knight's saving throws above). The goat-knight must be conscious to grant and gain this bonus.

traits.name: Divine Health
traits.value: The goat-knight is immune to disease.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.value: The goat-knight has resistance to poison damage and Advantage and Disadvantage on saving throws against poison.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The goat-knight makes two warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

fluffInfo.value: *This twisted, beast looks like the unholy union of squid and spider. Its shell-covered core has six small rubbery legs, peculiar antennae, and six tentacles around a squid's enormous beak.*

fluffInfo.name: Demonic Crossbreeds
fluffInfo.value: Some believe krake spawn are demonic crossbreeds created by the aboleth, fusing kraken blood with demonic souls. Others say that krake spawn are the horrible creation of a long-forgotten meddling god, summoned to the mortal world by deep ones. Certainly, krake spawn respond to summoning magic, and spellcasters summon krake spawn through blood sacrifices to work evil in the world. However, they do so at considerable peril: unlike demons and devils, krake spawn are seldom bound by pacts of any kind.

fluffInfo.name: Outwit Humans
fluffInfo.value: Though enormous and carrying an armored green shell on their six spindly legs, krake spawn are surprisingly quick and agile. Worse, they have a malicious and bloodthirsty intellect. A krake spawn is considerably smarter than most humans, who often mistake them for dumb beasts—an error that can often prove fatal.

fluffInfo.name: Iceberg Fortresses
fluffInfo.value: Krake spawn live in remote, icy regions, where they fashion elaborate iceberg fortresses. These fortresses are stocked with frozen creatures (an emergency food supply), the krake spawn's treasure and library, slaves or prisoners of many races, and a hellish nest filled with the krake spawn's offspring.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The krake spawn can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The krake spawn makes one Bite attack and eight Tentacle attacks, or it makes four Freezing Water Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. *Hit:* 12 (**1d10 + 7**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d6 + 7**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The krake spawn has eight tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Freezing Water Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Ink Cloud (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: While underwater, the krake spawn emits a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink all around itself. Each creature in the cloud must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (**10d10**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.

actions.name: Vomit Forth the Deeps (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The krake spawn sprays half‑digested food from its maw in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (**6d8**) acid damage plus 27 (**5d10**) poison damage and is incapacitated. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.

bonusActions.name: Water Jet
bonusActions.value: Each creature within 5 feet of the krake spawn must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The spawn then swims up to half its swimming speed without provoking opportunity attacks. The spawn must be underwater to use this bonus action.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, lightning, psychic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks; blinded, charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, poisoned, paralyzed, petrified, stunned
**Languages**: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 150 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The Kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.value: When the Kraken drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for them. They teleport back to the place where they slumber, return to life with all their hit points, and fall unconscious.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The Kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Slowed Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Kraken fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead, and their speed is reduced by a cumulative 10 feet for 24 hours.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The Kraken has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Kraken makes four Tentacle attacks or uses Mental Lance three times.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). The Kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Mental Lance (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: *Ranged Power Attack:* +18 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 22 (**4d10**) psychic damage, and the target is frightened of the Kraken until the start of the Kraken's next turn.

actions.name: Psionic Storm
actions.value: The Kraken creates a psionic storm, entrapping a vehicle they can see within 120 feet of them. While entrapped in the storm, the vehicle is restrained. The storm ends if the Kraken's *concentration* is broken (as if *concentrating* on a spell) or if they are more than 120 feet from the vehicle. If the Kraken's turn ends three times before the storm ends, the vehicle is reduced to 0 hit points and this effect ends.

actions.name: Skull-Splitting Howl (1/Day)
actions.value: The Kraken telepathically howls in the mind of each enemy within 120 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 (**10d10**) psychic damage and can't concentrate on powers or spells until the start of the Kraken's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonusActions.name: Telekinetic Fling
bonusActions.value: The Kraken throws a creature they are grappling into an unoccupied space the Kraken can see within 60 feet of them. The target lands prone and takes 22 (**4d10**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: Krall has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: Krall has advantage on *Stealth* checks made in dim light or total darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Krall makes three melee attacks, two with his rapier and one with his parrying dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Parrying Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: This nightmare was conjured from Arrevis' mortal fear of the Amaranthine __Kren__, whose wrath he now dreads after breaking ties with the devotees. It takes the shape of a ferocious shadowy fox with two tails and glistening fangs.

traits.name: Death in Shadow
traits.value: When the fang dies, its body dissolves into shadows and disappears, leaving nothing behind.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The fang has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Shadow Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fang's darkvision.

traits.name: Shadow Stalk
traits.value: The fang can hover 5 feet above land or water as part of its movement, requiring no action. While hovering, it is unaffected by difficult terrain and makes no sound as it moves.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Shadow Manipulation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The fang conjures chilling shadows near itself. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from the fang must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area inside the cube is heavily obscured by magical darkness until the start of the fang's next turn.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks when they Study a Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Infected Vermin.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Infestation Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Speed and Dread.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Loathsome Presence action and Scuttle Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Broken Personality.
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Kronen is usually agitated and alarmed when encountered, and its first instinct in combat is to find a new hiding place or flee deeper into its lair. It uses its Loathsome Presence while clawing at any in the way of its escape using Scuttle, reflexively spreading roaches to attackers via its Infestation Reaction.

If it escapes, a Kronen is eventually drawn to return to its old hiding place. Should characters remain there, the Kronen will furiously attack to reclaim its shelter but won't pursue charac ters who leave it alone in its hideout.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Carapace.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kronen makes two Claw attacks and uses Loathsome Presence.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Loathsome Presence
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature that can see the kronen. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (save ends). If the creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the kronen's Loathsome Presence for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Scuttle
bonusActions.value: The kronen takes the Dash action.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.value: The heat Krusgr exudes from his body is so intense it provides him with Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, any creature within 5 feet of him that strikes his heated body with a melee attack takes 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Krusgr makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Sword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 8**) Slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hammer Throw
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**3d10 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from Krusgr and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Angrboda's Tears (Recharge 5-6).
actions.value: Krusgr can expel a stream of boiling iron from his eyes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Fire damage, and the creature suffers 1 Exhaustion level from the hot metal. *Success* Half damage and negates any further effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.

actions.name: Tree Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Trash Lob
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Disgrace Bound
traits.value: The arcane guardian is bound to a tomb, castle ruins, or other place related to the disgrace in life that caused it to rise as a arcane guardian in death. If the guardian starts its turn more than 1 mile from its bound location, it loses its Spectral Blade action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to its bound location after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The arcane guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The arcane guardian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane guardian makes three Spectral Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Spectral Burst
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) force damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.value: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Fiend Between
traits.value: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.

actions.name: Grief-Eater
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 7**) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Infuse Sadness (1/Day)
actions.value: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.

bonusActions.name: Slip Between
bonusActions.value: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Avalla makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Avalla has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Lightning Lash (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) lightning damage, and Avalla can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Iron Terror (1/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Avalla projects a terrifying illusion of the High Command to each enemy in a 30-foot cone. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage and be frightened of each member of the High Command for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Iron Shackles (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.value: Avalla conjures animated iron chains at a point she can see on the ground within 60 feet of her. The chains fill a 15-foot- square on the ground centered on that point and last for 1 minute. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (save ends at start of turn). A creature restrained in this way takes 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.value: If not in the Cyst, Avalla teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

fluffInfo.value: Once a valorous Dúnadan noble lady, but when her city fell, she survived, only to be slowly consumed by grief and by the curse of the Chief of the Ringwraiths—Lady Elwen is now a Fell Wraith, bound to roam the ruins of her castle.

As a Fell Wraith, she appears as a crooked hag, wrapped in tatters hiding her spectral features. Her flesh is almost transparent, and her eyes glow like embers. Thin strands of white hair escape her hood.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from weapons that aren't enchanted with spells for the Bane of the undead
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Deathless
traits.value: If damage reduces the Fell Wraith to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant, from a critical hit, or from a weapon enchanted with spells for the Bane of the Undead. On a success, the Fell Wraith drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Fell Wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Fell Wraith can use its Strike Fear. It then makes a melee attack.

actions.name: Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Strike Fear
actions.value: Each non-undead creature of the Fell Wraith's choice that is within 60 feet of the Fell Wraith and aware of it gains 1 Shadow point from Dread, resisted by a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is also stunned while frightened in this way. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Fell Wraith's Strike Fear for the next 24 hours.

entries: **Skills**: athletics +8, deception +8, perception +7, persuasion +8, stealth +11, survival +7

traits.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 17 (**5d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of Emer's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can't take reactions.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.value: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is restrained by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature restrained in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.value: Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Envenomed Stone (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (**8d10**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
bonusActions.value: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the target's next turn. A target charmed in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.
