traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Feluciana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Feluciana has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Petrifying Glare
traits.value: When a creature that can see Feluciana's eyes starts its turn within 60 feet of her, she can force the creature to make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw if she isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a __greater restoration__ spell cast at 7th level or higher spell or other magic.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Feluciana until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Feluciana in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Serpentine Reactiveness
traits.value: Once per turn, Feluciana can make an opportunity attack with her snake hair without expending her reaction.

traits.name: Virulent Weapons
traits.value: Feluciana's weapon attacks are magical. In addition, damage from her weapon attacks ignores resistance to poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Feluciana makes four attacks: one with her bident and three with her snake hair. When available, she can use her Petrifying Beam in place of her three attacks with her snake hair.

actions.name: Bident
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) poison damage and 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The bident flies back to Feluciana's hand immediately after making a ranged attack with it.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Petrifying Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Feluciana's snakes focus a beam of petrifying energy at one creature she can see within 90 feet of her. A creature that has averted its eyes from Feluciana gains no benefit against this effect. The targeted creature must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of its next turn or become petrified until freed by a __greater restoration__ spell cast at 7th level or higher or other magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warpriest makes three attacks, using Blessed Warhammer or Divine Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Blessed Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (**3d8**) Radiant or Necrotic damage (warpriest's choice).

actions.name: Divine Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Radiant or Necrotic damage (warpriest's choice)

fluffInfo.value: *Undead Aquatic Monster*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Lake dredgers exist because of the fear of the unknown, and their essence is undone in the presence of a captured or crafted depiction of themselves, such as a drawing or carving.

traits.name: Depicted Demise
traits.value: The lake dredger takes 20 Force damage at the start of its turn if it can see a creature holding a created depiction (such as a drawing, painting, or carving) of the lake dredger.

traits.name: Silt Stealth
traits.value: The lake dredger has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made when in an area with aquatic plants or seaweed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lake dredger makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**4d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the lake dredger (the lake dredger can only have one creature swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The lake dredger swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, the creature has the Restrained condition, has Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and other effects outside the lake dredger, and takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the lake dredger's turns.

As an action, the swallowed creature can escape through the lake dredger's ribcage. The creature takes 11 (**2d10**) Piercing damage and emerges in a space within 5 feet of the lake dredger. If the lake dredger dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

fluffInfo.value: *This large, lanky creature has arms too long for its body. Its hands are webbed and equipped with wicked claws. Its skin is covered in dull green scales and embedded with stones, and limp hair like scraggly seaweed hangs across its long-nosed face*.

Water-dwelling cousins of the more common trolls, lake trolls are both stronger and slightly more intelligent, but thankfully less common. Accompanied by a reek of old, rotting fish, these slimy creatures live beneath the surface of lakes, ponds, rivers, and sometimes even ocean coves.

fluffInfo.name: Violently Territorial
fluffInfo.value: A lake troll is savage in the defense of its claimed expanse of territory; any encroachment into the creature's water is met with sudden violence from the depths. Fishermen are the most vulnerable to these attacks, especially when they explore new bodies of water.

fluffInfo.name: Cruel Cunning
fluffInfo.value: Even seasoned soldiers are wise enough to fear the claws of a lake troll; a person with no weapon facing the creature is doomed. Lake trolls delight in splintering wood and twisting metal with their talons and in shrugging off the deadliest of blows with their tough hide. They often prioritize wielders of grand weapons because they delight in the horror brought on by dulling their prey's weapons with a few strokes of their powerful claws. Lake trolls are cunning ambushers. They make use of the water to cover their attack and to protect themselves from the flames of would-be troll hunters.

fluffInfo.name: Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: A lake troll's regeneration is shut down only by cold and fire damage at nearly the same time, making them tricky to fight and exceedingly difficult to kill. Many adventurers have been shocked or slain when a lake troll they presumed was burned to death suddenly leapt back into the fray. Because they're reclusive and so very lethal, these creatures are poorly understood by most scholars.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The lake troll can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The lake troll has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The lake troll regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the lake troll takes cold or fire damage, it regains only 5 hp at the start of its next turn. If the lake troll takes both cold and fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the lake troll's next turn. The lake troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lake troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature that is wielding a weapon, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or the target's weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If the weapon's penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. If the target is wielding more than one weapon, the troll chooses which weapon to affect.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Cave Apex
traits.value: The lamasombra's unnatural scales, padded feet, and bones allow them to avoid detection. They can't be detected with tremorsense. When the lamasombra is in darkness or dim light, they are invisible to creatures with darkvision, but they are visible in dim light to creatures without darkvision.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The lamasombra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lamasombra makes one Bite attack and one Tongue attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**6d8 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract boiling wastes disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points, and the lamasombra can sense the direction to the creature's location as long as they're on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, or 37 (**9d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage if the target is a creature who can't see the lamasombra. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are pulled up to 15 feet in a straight line toward the lamasombra.

bonusActions.name: Nightmarish Cunning
bonusActions.value: The lamasombra takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Lambent Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Drawn to Contamination
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Dreg's Arcane Hunger trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Urge to Contaminate
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Lambent Dreg's Octarine Beam and Wave of Contamination attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Smart and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Lambent Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lambent Dregs tends to gather around delerium clusters throughout the city, often appearing in groups in highly contaminated areas. Creatures who have Contamination levels are prime targets for Lambent Dregs. The Dregs chase them down, avoiding non-contaminated targets when possible.

If threatened, Lambent Dregs run into the middle of a group of enemies and expel their Wave of Contamination, attempting to render their foes into a state of contamination, allowing the Dreg to easily engage with them.
Lambent Dregs flee if outnumbered and in a losing situation.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Octarine Glow
traits.value: The dreg sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

traits.name: Arcane Hunger
traits.value: The dreg has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have one or more levels of Contamination.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dreg makes three Octarine Beam attacks.

actions.name: Octarine Beam
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**3d6 + 3**) Radiant damage, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Wave of Contamination (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: The creature is cloaked in dark rags that hang off their hunched form, two massive lanterns dangling from fleshy protrusions off their back. Their arms and legs are gangly and long, as though they walk on stilts as they lumber forward on all fours. Their face is expressionless and pale, with hollow black pools for eyes. As their mouth opens, their jaw unhinges to reveal a gaping maw filled with spiked, hooked teeth. The creature's screech is harrowing as lamps glow brighter and motes of arcane energy flit about them.

Before the cataclysm that claimed Drakkenheim, lamplighters would traverse the city's streets at dusk, ensuring all the lanterns along the main thoroughfares were lit. Once, those lanterns were guiding lights to those making their way home at the end of the day. Now, the contamination that spreads through Drakkenheim has transformed the former lamplighters into twisted abominations. Their forms have merged with the lanterns they once kept lit, letting them lure creatures in the ruins toward their comforting lights—then devour those creatures while they bask in the glow.

In their contaminated madness, lamplighters view other creatures as pests desiring to put out their lanterns, and so they have resolved to snuff out those creatures instead. One can sometimes hear the muttering and wailing of the lamplighters echoing these delusions, as they cry out, "Keep the lights!" or "Must not let the darkness in ..."

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lamplighters hide in dark, ruined buildings or small hovels during the day, emerging only at dusk. They patrol through the night, magically lighting the ruined lanterns of the city to ensure that the main roads are well illuminated.

From a distance, a lamplighter appears as a softly glowing light that bobs as it moves through the ruins. The creature uses their Lantern Beams action to either fend off creatures from a distance, or to lure unsuspecting prey in toward them. When a creature is close enough, the lamplighter uses their ravening maw to attack and devour them.

A lamplighter reduced to below a quarter of their Hit Points usually attempts to flee into the ruins to recover. These creatures are territorial to the streets they worked in life, and they will return to that territory once healed, continuing to protect their precious lights against intruders.

Because lamplighters are inherently drawn to the dark places of Drakkenheim, characters can often avoid them by sticking to areas already illuminated by lantern light. At the same time, lamplighters can be drawn to specific locations by snuffing out the lights in the area along a main road, compelling the creatures to come and reignite their lanterns.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: A character proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* has advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Lamplighter. They learn the following information based on their check result:

entries: **10 or higher**: This check result reveals the lamplighter's resistances.
**15 or higher**: This check result reveals the creature's Lantern Beams feature and its multiple options.
**20 or higher**: This check result reveals the creature's highest (Str, Dex) and lowest (Int, Cha) ability scores and saving throws.
**Languages**: understands Common but does not speak

traits.name: Lantern Light
traits.value: The lamplighter sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. This light goes out if the lamplighter dies.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lantern Beams
actions.value: The lamplighter emits two different magical beams from their lanterns, choosing two targets they can see within 60 feet.

entries: **Blasting Light**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage.

**Blinding Light**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the lamplighter's next turn. *Success* Half damage.
**Burning Light**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage, and the target is burning. *Success* Half damage.

**Witch Light**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition. While Charmed in this way, the target must use all of their movement on their turns to move toward the lamplighter. At the end of each of their turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on themself on a success. The target has advantage on its saves to end this effect if it's taken damage from the lamplighter. After 1 minute, the target is no longer Charmed by the lamplighter.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The commoner's long jump is 30 feet, and its base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Team Tactics
traits.value: The commoner can take the Help action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage

fluffInfo.value: *This cat-sized drake with a waxy appearance and a glow emanating from its belly can hover in midair, filling a small area with a warm glow.*

The lantern dragonette is named for its belly, which glows with a warm light. The beast's yellow, waxy scales darken with age, though the dragonettes rarely live more than 50 years. They weigh from 5 to 10 pounds and are 18 inches long.

fluffInfo.name: Eat Candle Wax
fluffInfo.value: The dragonette devours four ounces of candle wax each day, plus four more ounces if it has made its belly glow. A lantern dragonette's unusual diet leads it to lair in libraries, abbeys, and other places of study. Even though the dragonettes eat candles essential for study during dark hours, they still provide light and protect their adopted homes. Residents and caretakers consider them good luck and enjoy conversing with them.

fluffInfo.name: Telepathic Chatterbox
fluffInfo.value: This gregarious dragonette prefers to speak with its companions but uses telepathy if necessary; the creature hisses when surprised or displeased. It loves nothing more than discussing magic and history with an intelligent and informed individual.

fluffInfo.name: Adventurous Companions
fluffInfo.value: Occasionally, a dragonette wishing to learn more about the world finds a spellcaster or adventuring party to travel with, purely for the sake of learning or to acquire new sources of knowledge. Most parties enjoy the traveling light source and the abilities these companions bring to bear. A lantern dragonette avoids combat and uses its abilities only to escape or to defend its lair, family, and friends.

fluffInfo.name: Diligent Parents
fluffInfo.value: A mated pair produces one clutch of two to five eggs every five years. One parent raises the young dragonettes until they mature, typically in a year, while the other scours the area for candle wax to feed the hungry hatchlings.

traits.name: Magical Darkness Hypersensitivity
traits.value: While in an area of magical darkness, the lantern dragonette can't fly or use Lantern Belly, and it takes 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage each minute.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.value: The lantern dragonette breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half the damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Lantern Belly
bonusActions.value: The dragonette sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet or stops shedding light. To shed light, it must have eaten at least 4 ounces of candle wax in the past 24 hours. It can shed light for up to 1 hour for every 4 ounces of candle wax it has eaten in the past 24 hours, to a maximum of 4 hours every 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study a Last Memory, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Deathless Memory.
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's monster type, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Painful Recall.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Anguish action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak Undead.
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Last Memories can move along the ground or up walls, often hiding as shadows on the ground. They have even followed prey, appearing as a strange movement in one's peripheral vision, or a shifting shadow from an unknown source.

When they reveal themselves, Last Memories cry out in anguish, causing those nearby to suffer visions of their last moments, inducing emotional trauma to any who succumb to it. They grasp those nearby, terrorizing them with waves of sorrow. Last Memories seem to embody the raw emotions of their death, using those emotions as weapons against the living. They do not flee, for they do not cherish their existence. Their only purpose is to spread the fear and the pain of their own death before fading away, only to reappear days later to relive their agony.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Ectoplasm, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Eternal Torment
traits.value: If a last memory dies, it reappears 1d4 days later, unleashing a howling scream that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

traits.name: Silhouette
traits.value: The last memory can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors. It cannot fly or swim and must always be in contact with a surface. Additionally, the last memory ignores all natural Difficult Terrain and can climb without making an ability check.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.value: The last memory doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Sorrowful Touch
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Anguish (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the last memory that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage and the target becomes Jinxed 1d6 (save ends).

entries: **HP**: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, insight +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Molten Slam)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 + PB** bludgeoning damage plus 4 (**1d8**) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this attack ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Beginning at 7th level, the bastion can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Burning Embrace (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the bastion makes a signature attack against a creature within range. If the attack hits, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). While grappled in this way, a target is restrained and takes **PBd6** fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

actions.name: 5th Level: Melting Grasp (3/Day)
actions.value: When the bastion hits a creature with a signature attack, the creature takes an extra **PBd4** fire damage. If the target is wielding a mundane metal weapon, the bastion partially melts the target's weapon, giving it a permanent -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls. If the target is wielding a supernatural metal weapon, the penalty lasts for 1 hour instead.

actions.name: 7th Level: Eruption (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the bastion erupts, shooting a 30-foot cone of earth and lava from their head. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **PBd6** bludgeoning damage plus **PBd6** fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone. The lava spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

entries: **Languages**: understands Draconic, Ignan, and Terran but can't speak them

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The wurm can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Noxious Resilience
traits.value: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Volcanic Body
traits.value: The wurm sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 5 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) fire damage.

actions.name: Molten Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14 (**4d6**) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes restrained. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

fluffInfo.value: *This furred humanoid glides silently through the canopy of trees, gripping a blowgun. It observes visitors cautiously with two intelligent, bulbous eyes.*

fluffInfo.name: Jungle Rulers
fluffInfo.value: These small, squirrel-like humanoids live in reclusive societies deep in the jungle. They are omnivorous gliders, subsisting on fruits and roots, insects and larvae, bird and snake eggs, and birds and small mammals. They sometimes barter with other humanoids for metal and forged items, but they prefer to rely on the forest for most of their needs.

fluffInfo.name: Greyfur Elders
fluffInfo.value: Greyfurs are the eldest and most revered lemurfolk, as much as 80 years old. Their age can be estimated by the graying of their fur, but they don't track the years. Greyfurs are cunning individuals and command the arcane arts, though they rarely pursue the art of necromancy—a strong taboo prohibits them from interacting with the dead. A typical lemurfolk stands 2 feet tall and weighs 30 pounds.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: The lemurfolk has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand when falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The lemurfolk can't gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blowgun
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 25/100 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: fire, poison, radiant; charmed, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Berserk
traits.value: Whenever the lenchtahg starts its turn with 54 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 1, the lenchtahg recalls its former life and current agony, and it goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the lenchtahg attacks the nearest creature it can see. It treats all creatures as enemies and makes any opportunity attack it can. Also, it has advantage on attack rolls, but all attack rolls against it have advantage. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the lenchtahg moves as far as it can toward the closest creature.

Once the lenchtahg goes berserk, it remains so until destroyed or it has more than 54 hit points. Also, a fiend can calm the lenchtahg. The lenchtahg must be able to understand the fiend, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check. If the check succeeds, the lenchtahg ceases being berserk.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lenchtahg has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The lenchtahg's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the lenchtahg is subjected to radiant damage from a source other than a lenchtahg, it takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to half the radiant damage dealt to it.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the lenchtahg's head survives its demise, the head must be doused in holy water and ritually consecrated in a 1-hour ceremony or be the target of a __dispel evil and good__ spell. If it isn't, then the lenchtahg reappears in 6 days, emerging from a fiery explosion in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the head. Creatures in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 **8d6** damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The head can't rejuvenate in a holy __hallow__ spell's area.

traits.name: Water Aversion
traits.value: If drenched in 5 gallons or more of water, or any amount of holy water, the lenchtahg has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lenchtahg makes two claw attacks, makes one claw attack and uses radiant gaze once, or uses radiant gaze twice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) slashing damage and 9 (**2d8**) fire damage.

actions.name: Radiant Gaze
actions.value: The lenchtahg targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it with burning radiance. The target gains no benefit from cover and must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage.

fluffInfo.value: Lendarick is a powerful mage graduate of the Avium, and his quest to improve the lives of the poor folk of the Roots caused him to change into a horrible slime monster known as the __Slime King__. Before his transformation, Lendarick was a sable luma with silky, red-brown feathers and a black mask-like streak across his eyes. He wore robes of blue silk. Lendarick was commonly seen scribbling in a beautifully bound notebook, and was rarely without a fresh cup of rose tea, taken with two sugars. Soft-spoken and good-natured, he was never a burden to others and always tried to help those less fortunate. Unfortunately, his ambitions to help led to his transformation.

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: Lendarick can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Lendarick can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: Lendarick has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Lendarick can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Lendarick can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d6 - 1**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: Lenny can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Lenny can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects or heavy weapons (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Lenny can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Lenny can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: Lenny has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lenny makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortened Spear
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, or 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage if used with two hands.

fluffInfo.value: Transformed by the Haze, Lenore is a mockery of her former self and abhorrently reacts to her own appearance. She dimly remembers seeking shelter in her grotto, but has no recollection of how she escaped the castle.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I speak softly in a perpetual daydream, rhapsodically imagining myself to be in a tragic fairytale while casting others in fictional roles.
**Ideal**: The world is a mirror held up to my own glorious reflection.
**Bond**: I obsessively crave beauty, decadence, and relish in art of all kinds, and especially love my garden and my lilies. They are all I have left.
**Flaw**: I fly into an enraged fury at the sight of my own likeness or the names of my lost family members.

fluffInfo.value: Any character proficient in
*History*

can instantly recognize Lenore despite her mutations. Before her transformation, Lenore was extraordinarily vain and narcissistic, though was uncharacteristically kind and gentle to her servants. She wore outrageously ornamented gowns, hats, makeup, and jewelry, including a famous golden necklace set with eleven emeralds. She loved her children only as extensions of herself, and absolutely despised her husband.

traits.name: Radiant Gaze
traits.value: When a creature that can see Lenore's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, Lenore can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if she isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. The creature takes 22 (**4d10**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, creatures who fail this saving throw gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Lenore until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Lenore in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If Lenore sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of her and in an area of bright light, she becomes blinded and incapacitated for 1d6 hours.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

entries: **Personality Trait**: I speak softly imagining myself to be in a tragic fairytale while casting others in fictional roles.
**Ideal**: The world is a mirror held to my glorious reflection.
**Bond**: I obsessively crave beauty, decadence, and relish all art. I especially love my garden and my lilies. They are all I have left.
**Flaw**: I fly into an enraged fury at the sight of my own likeness or the names of my lost family members.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study Queen Lenore, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutated Queen of Drakkenheim
fluffInfo.value: You recognize she is an Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Deadly Gaze
fluffInfo.value: You learn of her Radiant Gaze ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Formidable Foe
fluffInfo.value: You understand her highest and lowest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lenore does not often outright engage in combat, throwing Dregs and her handmaidens at enemies who threaten her. She prefers to stay behind her minions where she is safe, relying on her Radiant Gaze to slowly disable and contaminate her foes..
If forced into melee, she uses her Tentacle Hair to attack and will take the first opportunity to escape if she can.

fluffInfo.value: *This strange man is covered in bark and root-like growths and wears loose scraps of clothing. The hair and beard that frame his piercing green eyes writhe like living vines.*

fluffInfo.name: Expanding the Wild
fluffInfo.value: Solitary leshy tend plants and animals in groves around great forests, and they are the self-proclaimed protectors of the forest outskirts. Leshy have little patience for interlopers and often kill, abduct, or frighten off trailblazers and guides. They sabotage cultivated land, wipe out trails, and cultivate weed walls and thickets to keep civilization at bay. They transplant dangerous plant creatures to discourage new settlements, and some wrangle rabid animals to the same purpose.

fluffInfo.name: Ax Thieves
fluffInfo.value: Leshy prefer trickery to combat, leading intruders astray by mimicking animal and humanoid sounds. If challenged, they do everything in their power to scare intruders away, but they never hesitate to fight to the death in service to the forest if necessary. Leshy hate metal, especially axes, and they go out of their way to steal metal items and lead those who use them astray.

fluffInfo.name: Accept Bribes
fluffInfo.value: With careful courting and appropriate gifts, it is possible to gain a leshy's capricious assistance. This can be risky, because leshy love mischief. Still, a leshy's help is sometimes essential to a group traversing ancient woodlands.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The leshy can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.value: The leshy has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.value: The leshy can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Vine-Wrapped Weapons
traits.value: The poisonous vines growing from the leshy entwine around its weapon. When the leshy hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d4** poison damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Woodland Stride
traits.value: Difficult terrain composed of magical or nonmagical plants doesn't cost the leshy extra movement.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (**2d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Frightening Mien (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The leshy briefly appears to grow to an enormous size, taking on a malicious mien before returning to normal. Each creature within 15 feet of the leshy and that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature is immune to Frightening Mien if it can see through illusions.

actions.name: Encourage Growth (1/Day)
actions.value: The leshy whispers magical words of growth to nonmagical plants on a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The plants burst with life and spread rapidly. The area within 20 feet of that point becomes difficult terrain for 24 hours.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Infectious Mucus
traits.value: The aboleth is surrounded by infectious mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased. For the first hour of the disease, the creature takes 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage if it ends its turn out of water (it must be at least neck-deep to avoid this damage). After the first hour and until the disease is cured, a creature is unable to gain the benefits of a short or long rest if it does not spend the rest at least neck-deep in water.
A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more becomes a host of a broodling egg that hatches in 3d6 days.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.value: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Birth, if available.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a saving throw against the aboleth's Infectious Mucus trait.

actions.name: Birth (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: The aboleth produces a broodling in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Entrance (3/Day)
actions.value: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The seraph makes three attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage and 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Tempting Call
actions.value: The seraph calls out a tempting promise to one creature that can hear it withing 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature cannot take actions for 1 minute, as it dwells on the promise the seraph made. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. Each failed saving throw after the initial failure deals 9 (**2d8**) psychic damage to the target

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.value: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regenerative State
traits.value: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Sticky Mucus
traits.value: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape DC 15) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

traits.name: Transitional State
traits.value: The chrysalis turns into a lesser aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chrysalis makes three Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

actions.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape DC 15).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lesser crawling one has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Relentless Evil
traits.value: When a lesser crawling one is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it falls into a pile of rotting flesh, worms, and maggots. If it takes at least 15 Fire damage before the end of its next turn, the lesser crawling one is permanently destroyed. It can still be targeted by spells and effects that target creatures. Otherwise, the lesser crawling one reforms in 2d6 days. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the tomb it was originally buried in.

actions.name: Slimy Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, Reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 1**) Necrotic damage, and a Medium or smaller creature has its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn as it is covered in slime and maggots.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes four Flailing Tentacle attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Flailing Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.value: The demon makes two attacks, one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Foul Odor (1/day)
actions.value: The demon emits a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 20-foot sphere and persists for 1 minute until it disperses into the surrounding air. The cloud spreads around corners, and the affected area is heavily obscured. Any creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against the poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action on that turn retching and reeling. Creatures immune to poison are immune to this effect. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) will disperse it after 1 round.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) bludgeoning damage and 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and pulled to within 5 feet of the seraph. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the seraph can't use its tongue or bite on another target.

fluffInfo.value: *This winged fiend looks like something that has stepped out of a nightmare. Its elongated head is dominated by a mouth filled with razor-sharp teeth, and its spindly arms and legs end in long vicious talons. Where the moonlight catches it, its body appears almost transparent*.

These nightmarish creatures are smaller, weaker versions of the lunar devil, lazy and boastful fiends that draw strength from the light of the moon. Lesser lunar devils are often found serving their more powerful brethren, sent as advance scouts to spy on a druid circle their master intends to subvert, or to identify the werewolf pack leader that must be removed before the lunar devil can seize control of the pack.

*Unlike most devils, these fiends are uncommon in the Eleven Hells, rarely found outside of Sa-Mozan, the City of Silences, in the Third Hell of Qes-al-Marit, home of Alquam, Demon Lord of Night. Lesser lunar devils are much more widespread in the Shadow Realm. At any one time, a dozen or so of the creatures roost atop the Tower of the Moon where the Moonlit King once dwelt in exile, and hundreds of them flitter about his new skyborne palace, partially taking the role that shadow goblins perform in other courts. The Moonlit King dispatches the devils on bizarre missions across the plane and to Midgard, rewarding those that please him, by promoting them to full-fledged lunar devils, and demoting others to lesser status, seemingly on a whim.*

actions.name: Crushing Fist
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, Reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Communication Spores
traits.value: The Veiled Lady's telepathy extends throughout its lair. It communicates using images and emotion.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the Veiled Lady fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mycelial Form
traits.value: The Veiled Lady can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the Veiled Lady has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The Veiled Lady dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Veiled Lady uses either its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain, if available, then makes a Halluciwhip attack.

actions.name: Halluciwhip
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**3d4 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Infectious Spores (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become afflicted by the fungal infection* spell for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Shackles of Pain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become afflicted by the shackles of pain* spell. The Veiled Lady can have only one creature afflicted by Shackles of Pain at a time.

bonusActions.name: Detritivore
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the Veiled Lady can target one Small or larger corpse not under the effects of the gentle repose spell within 15 feet of it, draining it of its essence and regaining 10 (**3d6**) hit points. Once a corpse has been targeted by this feature, it becomes desiccated and can't be targeted again.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Lestheris has advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Dark Calling
traits.value: Each other creature within 30 feet of Lestheris has disadvantage on death saving throws.

traits.name: Tome of the Ethereal
traits.value: Lestheris can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lestheris makes two Grave Grasp or two Necrotic Lance attacks.

actions.name: Grave Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Lestheris's next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Lance (1st-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.
Lestheris can destroy a shade under her control within 30 feet of her and deal an extra 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage to the target.

actions.name: Animate Spirits (2/Day)
actions.value: Lestheris animates two shades.

The shades appear in unoccupied spaces Lestheris can see within 30 feet of her. The shades act immediately after Lestheris on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Lestheris dies, the shades are destroyed.

entries: **HP**: 70 + 10 for each spell slot level above 7

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The spirit can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d10 + 5 + summonSpellLevel** Piercing damage.

actions.name: Roar
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn. *Success* No effect.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The leyleech has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can cast spells, the leyleech chooses one of the target's spellcasting abilities. That ability score is reduced by 1 (min- imum score of 1) until the target finishes a short or long rest, and the leyleech's form becomes charged for 1 minute or until they use Magic Purge.

actions.name: Magic Purge (Charged Form Only)
actions.value: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The leyleech is no longer charged, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Sparking Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The leyleech makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and if the target hits the leyleech with an attack before the start of the leyleech's next turn, the target takes PB lightning damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Anomalous Terrain (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The area within 10 feet of the leyleech becomes difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of their next turn. When an enemy enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or take **PBd4** force damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Magic Purge (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd8** force damage and is dazed until the start of the leyleech's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

fluffInfo.value: *The humming of servos, ticking of gears, and petite discharges of steam precede the library's diminutive custodian.*
Library automatons are small constructs created to fulfill organizational responsibilities of huge libraries.

*The library automaton's scholarly nature leads some of them to serve spellcasters and learn more of the world. Such automatons have the following trait.*
***Familiar**: The library automaton can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a magic, telepathic bond with that willing companion. While the two are bonded, the companion can sense what the automaton senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. While the automaton is within 10 feet of its companion, the companion has resistance to psychic damage. At any time and for any reason, the automaton can end its service as a familiar, ending the telepathic bond.*

fluffInfo.name: Eyes of the Past
fluffInfo.value: Each automaton includes a single humanoid eyeball mounted at the end of an articulated appendage. These eyes are typically donations from the library's ailing scholars, allow them to continue serving the repositories of knowledge that were their life's work.

fluffInfo.name: Telekinetic
fluffInfo.value: The automatons can move and manipulate written materials telekinetically, and they can store such works in an extradimensional space within their bodies. The library automaton tirelessly pores through tomes, translates ancient texts, catalogs the institution's volumes, fetches texts for visitors, and occasionally rids the vast halls of uninvited pests.

fluffInfo.name: Scholarly Familiars
fluffInfo.value: Many spellcasters have discovered library automatons make particularly effective caretakers for their spellbooks and scrolls while on adventure.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Bibliophile
traits.value: The library automaton understands any written language it can see, provided it is touching the surface on which the words are written.

traits.name: Bibliotelekinesis
traits.value: The library automaton is surrounded by an invisible, shapeless, magical force that can perform simple tasks at the automaton's command. This force has a Strength equal to the automaton's Strength, and it can interact with objects up to 15 feet away from the automaton. The automaton can use this force to perform simple tasks that a Small humanoid with two hands could do, such as opening a door, moving a bookshelf's ladder, picking up and organizing books, and similar tasks. The automaton can't use this force to make attacks or wield a weapon or shield.

traits.name: Book Safekeeper
traits.value: The library automaton's body contains a small, extradimensional space. This space can hold up to 100 pounds of Small or smaller objects. This space can hold only books, scrolls, parchment, or other written works on paper or other paper- or wood-like materials. The automaton is the only creature capable of retrieving items from this space while it is alive. If the automaton is destroyed, the objects within its extradimensional space are ejected into an unoccupied space nearest it.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The library automaton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Piston-Powered Kick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**2d4 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Unnerving Gaze
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the start of the automaton's next turn.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +11, athletics +11, deception +12, history +11, perception +10, stealth +9
**Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the lich is destroyed but their soulstone is intact, their soul retreats into the stone. While the lich's soul is in the stone, a creature who can see the stone at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the stone until the end of their next turn. While charmed in this way, the creature must do everything in their power to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding obvious hazards.

If a creature touches the stone while the lich's soul is inside, the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature drops to 0 hit points and the lich reforms with all their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone. On a successful save, the creature loses half their hit points and the lich reforms with half their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone.
The soulstone has AC 19, 50 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force and thunder.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The lich has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.value: The lich is immune to effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lich uses Glare of Undeath and makes four attacks using Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, Pain of Ages, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Biting Acid (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**5d8**) acid damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the lich's next turn.

actions.name: Disruptive Thunder (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d10**) thunder damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, the lich can move them up to 45 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Pain of Ages (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage, and the first time the target hits a creature with an attack before the start of the lich's next turn, that attack deals half damage.

actions.name: Glare of Undeath
actions.value: The lich's eyes flare with supernatural power at one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to hug themself tightly as protection against an unbearably cruel world. A creature hugging themself in this way is restrained for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to make a DC 20 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Horrid Woe (2/Day)
actions.value: The lich sends negative energy coursing through a creature they can see within 90 feet of them. The target is seared with pain and must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (**7d8 + 30**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this damage becomes stable but can't regain hit points, and their spirit turns into a wraith who appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of their body. This wraith acts on the lich's turn immediately after them, and they obey the lich's verbal commands to the best of their ability. If the wraith or lich are destroyed, the wraith disappears, the target's spirit returns to their body, and the target can regain hit points.

actions.name: Life Absorption (1/Day; 9th-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.value: The lich unleashes a wave of life-sapping energy. Each enemy within 120 feet of them must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute, and the lich gains temporary hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Necrotic Form (3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: The lich enters a shadow form and moves up to their speed. While in this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and the grappled and restrained conditions, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The lich reverts to their true form at the end of their turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Half bone, half purple fire, this deathly hound releases an eerie howl that echoes with the voices of the damned.*

fluffInfo.name: Fiery Bones
fluffInfo.value: Bright white skulls with a heavy jaw and thick, robust skeletal bodies define the ferocious lich hounds. Their eyes burn green or blue, and their tongues resemble black fire. Fueled by necromantic power, these creatures are loyal servants of undead high priests or liches.

fluffInfo.name: Echoing Howls
fluffInfo.value: Even on their own, lich hounds are relentless hunters, pursuing their prey with powerful senses and a keen ability to find the living wherever the creatures may hide. Lich hound howls fade into and out of normal hearing, with strangely shifted pitch and echoes.

fluffInfo.name: Murdered Celestials
fluffInfo.value: The dark process of creating a lich hound involves a perverse ritual of first summoning a celestial canine and binding it to the Material Plane. The hound's future master then murders the trapped beast. Only then can the creature be animated in all its unholy glory. Houndlike celestials have long been outraged by the creation of lich hounds, and every few centuries, they band together to rid the world of those practicing this particular dark magic. Inevitably some knowledge survives this purge, leaving lich hounds a constant, painful reality for the celestials.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: understands Common and Darakhul but can't speak

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.value: The lich hound can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The lich hound has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The lich hound doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lich hound can use its Eerie Howl. It then makes two Bite attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) slashing damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Eerie Howl
actions.value: The lich hound releases an eerie howl that fades in and out and echoes strangely. Each creature within 30 feet of the lich hound must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the lich hound's Eerie Howl for the next 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonusActions.value: The lich hound magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

entries: **Languages**: the languages it knew in life and Giant

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the lich troll fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The lich troll regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the lich troll takes acid or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the lich troll's next turn. The lich troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lich troll makes two claw attacks. Alternately, the lich troll can cast __chill touch__ or ray of frost twice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Petra makes three attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of Petra's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: Petra takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.value: If the lightbender is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

traits.name: Pounce

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lightbender makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or uses their Tail Whip twice.

actions.name: Tail Whip

actions.name: Hypnotic Mane (1/Day)
actions.value: The lightbender discharges the light absorbed in their mane into a brilliant, mesmerizing display. Each creature within 15 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the lightbender for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, a creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. If a creature charmed in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends for that creature.

actions.name: 1st Level: Tail Whip (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The lightbender makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** radiant damage to the target, and a different creature the lightbender chooses within 15 feet of them takes PB radiant damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The lightbender teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Before or after teleporting, the lightbender can make a signature attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 8 hours.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.value: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on themself.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Electric Pulse
actions.value: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 20 feet of them. The target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (**4d8**) lightning damage and is dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

traits.name: Electrifying Flesh
traits.value: A lightning giant's flesh constantly sparks with electricity. A creature striking a lightning giant with a melee weapon must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) Lightning damage, or 5 (**1d10**) damage if the weapon is made out of a conductive metal such as iron. A lightning giant can suppress this ability with a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lightning giant makes two attacks, using Lightning Staff or Static Fling in any combination.

actions.name: Lightning Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Static Fling
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet.

actions.name: Static Discharge (Recharge 6 or Special)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15 All creatures in a 20-foot radius Sphere surrounding the lightning giant. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Lightning Damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the panther is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Feline Fall
traits.value: When the panther falls and isn't incapacitated, it can subtract up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating falling damage.

traits.name: Flashing Movement
traits.value: Whenever the panther moves on its turn, it can instead choose to teleport to an unoccupied space it can see, including into the air, leaving a harmless streak of electrical energy in its path. When it teleports in this way, it must spend an amount of movement equal to the distance it teleported.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The panther makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: If the panther teleports at least 20 feet into the air as part of its movement, it can then use this action to fall into a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity or Constitution saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 9 (**2d4 + 4**) slashing damage and 21 (**6d6**) lightning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the panther's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the panther's space.

entries: **Languages**: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

actions.name: Necrotic Drain
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) necrotic damage, or 13 (**3d6 + 3**) necrotic damage if the target can't see the lightthief.

actions.name: Into the Light (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The lightthief teleports inside a light source they can see within 15 feet of them that is emitting bright or dim light. While inside the light source, the lightthief has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the light source. If the light source is extinguished by any means other than the lightthief's Steal Light action, the lightthief is forced out, appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source, and is paralyzed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only)
actions.value: The lightthief can cause the light they are inside to erupt in a burst of brilliant radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the light source must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) radiant damage and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't lose their darkvision. After this, the light source extinguishes and the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source.
