fluffInfo.value: *This goblin-like creature bears one large, strange eye in the middle of its face. It wears dark and dirty rags, and its spindly claws and arms match its hunched torso.*

fluffInfo.name: Ferocious Attitude
fluffInfo.value: Likhos are scrappy fighters. They weaken foes from afar with their magical gaze, then rush forward, shredding the victims with their claws. Once a likho has leapt onto a creature, it shreds flesh using the claws on both its hands and feet.

fluffInfo.name: Jeers and Insults
fluffInfo.value: A likho uses its limited telepathy to taunt and jeer at its target from a distance during the hunt. A likho enjoys stalking intelligent humanoids and tormenting them from hiding until discovered or when it grows tired of the hunt.

fluffInfo.name: Organ Eaters
fluffInfo.value: Likhos thrive when they drain away luck and aptitude. Once the likho immobilizes a creature, it gnaws at the creature's abdomen with its jagged teeth, devouring the organs of its still-living prey. A likho consumes only a humanoid's organs and leaves the rest of the body behind.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The likho can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.value: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the likho can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The likho can use its Disruptive Gaze. It then makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disruptive Gaze
actions.value: One creature the likho can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Liminal Herald, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Guarded Existence
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Psychic Retribution
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Reflect Pain Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Weak but Perceptive
fluffInfo.value: They learn the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Liminal Herald is a contaminated entity from the deepest corners of the Space Between Worlds. It undoes creatures atom by atom with its Eldritch Beams. It targets the intellect of other creatures with its Mind Scramble, especially spellcasters *Concentrating* on spells. The Liminal Herald harnesses the very fabric of magic itself and uses that force against mortals who would attempt to dabble in it.

When targeted by an attack, the Liminal Herald bends space and time around it using its Reflect Pain feature, causing the creature who attacked it to take on a mental payload of pain felt by the creature.
If it is reduced below half its Hit Points, the Liminal Herald attempts to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Languages**: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The liminal herald is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The liminal herald may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the liminal herald can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the liminal herald has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The liminal herald is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the liminal herald's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The liminal herald makes two Eldritch Beam or contaminated touch attacks. It can also use Mind Scramble or Warp Call.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, one target within 5 ft. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* half damage only.

actions.name: Eldritch Beam
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) Force damage.

actions.name: Mind Scramble (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone (creatures maintaining *Concentration* have Disadvantage). *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, or 28 (**8d6**) Psychic damage if the target is maintaining *Concentration*.

actions.name: Warp Call
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the liminal herald can see within 90 feet. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target is teleported into an unoccupied space the liminal herald can see within 60 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

bonusActions.name: Dimension Hop
bonusActions.value: The liminal herald teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

fluffInfo.value: *Coiling like a living corkscrew and moving with a scraping hiss, this serpentine creature skates nimbly across ice on long curving claws, maw agape and stinking of a hundred graves.*

fluffInfo.name: Swift and Smooth as Ice
fluffInfo.value: Lindwurms have long bodies and crocodilian jaws, but they skitter overland on spindly limbs. Their talons are long and curved, acting as skates or short skis when moving over ice. Few things are swifter on the ice.

fluffInfo.name: Sea Hunters
fluffInfo.value: In the wild, lindwurms hunt in groups, looking for breaching whales, seals, or incautious fishermen. They enjoy surrounding and surprising foes. With their considerable cunning, they may skate by their prey at speed, snapping a bite as they pass or snatching up prey with their constricting tails.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: The lindwurm can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Sure-Footed Skater
traits.value: While the lindwurm is on snow or ice, it has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lindwurm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with one Constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease and be poisoned until the disease is cured. At the end of each long rest, the diseased creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers one level of exhaustion and doesn't regain expended Hit Dice from the rest. On a success, the creature's exhaustion level decreases by one, and it regains expended Hit Dice as normal from the rest. If a successful saving throw reduces the diseased creature's level of exhaustion below 1, the creature recovers from the disease, ending it.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lindwurm can't Constrict another target.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Disease Immunity
traits.value: The lindwyrm is immune to all nonmagical diseases.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the lindwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lindwyrm makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. The lindwyrm can substitute a swallow attack for one of its claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a hit, the target is also grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lindwyrm can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature the lindwyrm is grappling. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) piercing damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the lindwyrm, and it takes 27 (**6d8**) acid damage at the start of each of the lindwyrm's turns. The lindwyrm can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the lindwyrm takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the lindwyrm must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the lindwyrm. If the lindwyrm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Thorn-Covered
traits.value: If the Lion's Blume attempts to grapple a creature, the target takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage whether the grapple succeeds or not. While Grappled by the Lion's Blume, the target takes 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.value: The Lionfish King can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 12 hours to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Lucky Fool (2/Day)
traits.value: When the Lionfish King would fail an ability check or miss with an attack roll by rolling a 5 or lower on the die, he can choose to replace the die roll with a 15 instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Lionfish King makes three attacks: one with his Chomp and two with his Cutlass.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Spray
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d12**) poison damage.
Whether the attack hits or misses, the target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Royal Decree
bonusActions.value: The Lionfish King commands a Fish Folk that can hear him to use its reaction to make an attack against a creature that he can see.

fluffInfo.value: *The curtain of rippling colors assumes a humanoid form. Its kaleidoscope body shifts and glitters with mesmeric patterns.*

Sometimes known as "light elves" because they assume a vaguely elvish shape, these enigmatic elementals make their home at the edge of the world, where reality bends and physical laws unravel. Liosalfars' mutable bodies are composed entirely of shifting colors. Among themselves, they communicate through flashing patterns and hues, but they talk to others in an echoing, choral tone that seems to emanate from everywhere and nowhere around them.

fluffInfo.name: Servants of Fate
fluffInfo.value: Their aims often seem inconsequential or simply baffling, but they've also sundered mountains and toppled kingdoms. Many believe liosalfars are agents of Fate, while others believe their motivations are an alien aesthetic or for their own amusement. Those who've spoken with liosalfars say they talk as if all existence was a sea of patterns and colors to be set in pleasing shapes.

fluffInfo.name: Enemies of the Ramag
fluffInfo.value: Liosalfars have a longstanding rivalry with the portal-making ramags, whom they despise as "corruptors of the patterns."

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic, radiant; blinded, charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Darkness Hypersensitivity
traits.value: The liosalfar takes 15 necrotic damage when it starts its turn in magical darkness. While in magical darkness, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.value: The liosalfar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: The liosalfar is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the liosalfar's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Light Form
traits.value: The liosalfar can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, it sheds bright light in a 10- to 30‑foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The liosalfar can alter the radius as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The liosalfar makes two Radiant Touch or Ray of Light attacks. If both Radiant Touch attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Radiant Touch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 7**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Ray of Light
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**6d8 + 4**) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Radiance
actions.value: The liosalfar causes the light radiating from its body to shift color and pattern in a spellbinding display. Each creature within 60 feet of the liosalfar and that can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the display ends. The liosalfar must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue the display. It can stop the display at any time, and the display ends if the liosalfar is incapacitated. While charmed by the liosalfar's display, a creature is also incapacitated, and its speed is reduced to 0, as it is transfixed by the display. The effect ends for a charmed creature if it takes any damage or if someone uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

traits.name: Exceptional Smell
traits.value: The bear has a +10 bonus to Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.value: The bear has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in their native terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage, or maximum damage if the target is a Plant.

actions.name: Swat
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing or bludgeoning damage (bear's choice), and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Agile Landing
traits.value: The wildcat takes no damage from falling 40 feet or less, provided they aren't incapacitated.

traits.name: Hunter's Pounce
traits.value: If the wildcat hits a Small or smaller target and had advantage on the attack roll, the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappling the target in this way, the wildcat can't attack another creature.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.value: The wildcat has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in their native terrain.

traits.name: Sprint (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: When the wildcat moves on their turn in combat, they can triple their speed until the end of their turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, plus an extra 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage if the target is grappled or restrained.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage, plus an extra 2 (**1d4**) slashing damage if the wildcat had advantage on the attack roll.

bonusActions.name: Sneak
bonusActions.value: The wildcat takes the Hide action.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Living Biohazard, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Thick and Acidic
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Living Biohazard's Liquid Form and Hazardous Fumes traits.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Living Biohazard remains completely still until it is close enough to either drop down onto a creature or slide into position surrounding it. Its only goal is to dissolve and consume. It does not flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Guts.

traits.name: Hazardous Fumes
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ooze has the Burning condition (4d4 Acid). While Burning, the creature also has the Slowed condition. While the creature remains within 10 feet of the ooze, the Burning condition cannot be removed in any way.

traits.name: Liquid Form
traits.value: The ooze can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 10 (**4d4**) Acid damage. The ooze has Advantage on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**4d4**) Acid damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Living City, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Animated Building.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Living City's Structural Form and No Exit traits, as well as its Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Escape Routes.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that destroying the creature's walls and doors creates exits, but these are short-lived because of its Shifting Form Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Slow, Smart, and Tough.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Living City's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Living City takes the form of an oddly intact residence, workshop, or warehouse using its Structural Form trait, and waits for hapless creatures to wander inside. A Living City may deceive characters into entering it using its telepathy and Haunting Whispers. It suppresses its Digestive Aura and so it can take full advantage of its False Appearance trait.

Typically, a Living City shapes its body to create outer rooms that have walls bordering the edge of the Living City's space, and inner rooms deep within which do not have walls, ceilings, or floors immediately adjacent to spaces outside the Living City. The Living City will create doors, windows, or even stairs within it so that its prey can easily move from outside, to the outer rooms, and then further inside to the inner rooms. Often, the Living City might place any treasure or valuables it has collected in these inner rooms as bait.

Once a few characters have entered one of its innermost rooms, the Living City attacks and activates its Digestive Aura. When it rolls Initiative, it uses its No Exit trait to close all the doors and windows in its body, trapping characters inside. Then, it attacks them with its Grasping Tendrils, Bite, and Haunting Whispers, while using its Shifting Form Epic Action to slowly change its interior, separating the characters and cutting off their escape routes.

Should the player characters break a hole in one of its walls, the Living City uses its Shifting Form trait to plug the hole. Note that some area-of-effect attacks and spells (such as __Burning Hands__) can damage or destroy multiple sections of the Living City. However, a Living City can only take damage from one section being destroyed per turn. If characters manage to slip outside the Living City through a breached hole or exit, the Living City may use its Grasping Tendrils to pull them back in. It then tries to quickly seal them inside again with Shifting Form.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Montrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Acidic Bile

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Glands.

traits.name: Digestive Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 (**4d4**) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

traits.name: Structural Form
traits.value: The living city can spend 10 minutes in *Concentration* to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points. Reducing a section to 0 Hit Points destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 Hit Point. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

traits.name: No Exit
traits.value: When it rolls for Initiative, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space.

A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* 27 (**5d10**) Psychic damage. *Failure or Success*: The teleportation or planar travel fails.

actions.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

actions.name: Haunting Whispers
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature in the living city's space. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Shifting Form
actions.value: The living city alters the composition of a 10-foot-by-10-foot area inside it, creating walls, doors, windows, stairs, or furnishings. It can choose to make the area Difficult Terrain. Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom (*Perception*) check to notice the change.

If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The living city can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Elementals can be found all over Drakkenheim, often in areas where the eldritch magics are especially concentrated. Many who have encountered these elementals have spoken of the city itself coming to life to attack them. Reports of ruins reaching out and crushing adventurers, burning flames moving and hunting with minds of their own, or contaminated pools lurching to engulf passersby have been heard. Even the blowing air itself has mustered parts of the Haze into shifting clouds that stalk adventurers through the streets. These magical creatures are a constant reminder that nothing in the city can be trusted, and that nowhere is truly safe.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Fog Form
traits.value: The Living Deep Haze can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Deep Haze
traits.value: A creature who enters or starts its turn in the same space as the Living Deep Haze must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage and gain one level of contamination (DungeonsDrakkenheim).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Living Deep Haze makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Living Deep Haze, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mundane Immunity
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the elemental's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Animate Haze
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Fog Form and Deep Haze traits.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fast but Dim-Witted
fluffInfo.value: You understand its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: When it encounters an uncontaminated creature, the Living Deep Haze rapidly moves into its space thanks to its Fog Form trait. It then tries to remain there as much as possible so the creature is exposed to its Deep Haze trait. The Living Deep Haze wants to transform its targets into monsters, so it uses its Slam attacks to knock them Unconscious so they can awaken to a new existence as mutant horrors.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Fog Form
traits.value: The elemental can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Deep Haze
traits.value: A creature that enters the same space as the elemental or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The small, rough wax sculpture of a human stands at attention, a halo of light flickering around its head from some source behind it.*

fluffInfo.name: Enchanted Wicks
fluffInfo.value: Living wicks are obedient wax statues brought to life by an enchanted wick that runs from the nape of their neck to their lower back. When new, a living wick looks and moves like a human. However, as the wick burns, the wax features melt, and the statue takes on a twisted, hunchbacked appearance.

fluffInfo.name: Short-Lived as a Candle
fluffInfo.value: Living wicks are powered by flames, and therefore they have a predetermined life cycle. They are typically reduced to formless lumps in a month, but some say a living wick's affordability more than makes up for its inevitable obsolescence. Individuals looking to quickly construct a building or fortification without the expense of paid labor or the questionable ethics of necromancy find living wicks obedient and efficient, as do those needing an army for a single battle. They are active only when their wicks are lit, and they respond only to the commands of whoever lit them. This makes it easy to transfer living wicks between owners, even those not well-versed in the use of magic.

fluffInfo.name: Explosive Ends
fluffInfo.value: The amount of magical energy contained within a living wick, paired with the manner in which it is released, gives them a remarkable capability for self-destruction. If their controller demands it, all living wicks can release the magic contained within their form all at once, engulfing themselves and anyone nearby in flames. This can make storing them a gamble, but many see it as an asset, especially those seeking to destroy evidence or anonymously attack their enemies.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The living wick doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Wick-Powered
traits.value: The living wick is inactive and unconscious while its wick is unlit. When its wick is lit, it obeys the commands of the creature that lit the wick, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The living wick's hp maximum is reduced by 2 (1d4) for every 24 hours it remains lit and active, and no effect short of a __wish__ spell can remove this reduction. The living wick dies when its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

A creature grappling the active living wick can take its action to extinguish the wick by succeeding on a DC 12 Dexterity check. A creature within 5 feet of a living wick that is dormant from an unlit wick can take an action to light the wick, gaining command of the living wick.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Consuming Inferno
actions.value: The living wick's controller can command the living wick to rapidly burn through the remains of its wick, creating a devastating ball of fire. Each creature within 20 feet of the living wick must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area and that aren't being worn or carried ignite. The living wick then dies, becoming a lifeless puddle of wax.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bola
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained by the bola. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach from the bola on a success. fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Loathsome Gag Fly, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Loathsome Gag Fly is a simple-minded creature who wants to feed on flesh and lay larva on the corpses of the dead. It sprays acid on any creature that it sees nearby in an attempt to weaken it. It then lands on them and begins feeding.

Gag Flies usually attack in groups and care very little for the wellbeing of each other. As a matter of fact, when a Gag Fly is killed and explodes in a shower of acid, this usually causes other nearby flies to go into a feeding frenzy on targets sprayed in the gore, as they are drawn to any flesh dissolving in the acids of their mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lob Frogs are keen to keep their distance from predators and threats, but are constantly on the lookout for hosts for their offspring. They attempt to lob their contaminated eggs at potential threats, hoping to produce more Lob Frogs. If confronted directly, their Poison Skin acts as a defense while they use their Standing Leap to escape unfavorable situations.

If a Lob Frog has at least two or more targets with attached eggs, or if they are reduced below half Hit Points, they leap away to find somewhere safe and wet to hide. They would rather not risk their life, and simply hope to infect as many targets as possible to continue their species.

fluffInfo.value: Lord Commander Elias Drexel is a man in his early fifties. He is stocky and imposing with a furrowed brow and a grim frown on his wide and angular face. His harsh features are framed with a thick moustache, side chops, and a mane of long braided brown hair. He is garbed in chainmail armour with heavy leather gloves and boots, worn under a fur-lined dark green cloak and iron pauldrons. He wears a pinned brooch - the Lord Commander's Badge, the symbol of his office. A quiver, a longbow, and two longswords are strung on his back.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I am blunt and direct, and expect my soldiers to obey my commands and deliver results promptly. I find no humor in anything.
**Ideal**: Loyalty and trust are priceless. They must be carefully given, but staunchly held. There is nothing worse than betrayal and treason.

**Bond**: During the Civil War, I switched sides and killed several scions of House von Kessel who could have claimed the throne. I once believed it was for the right cause, but now I feel personally responsible for breaking the royal line. My mission in Drakkenheim is penance and redemption.
**Flaw**: I'm filled with rage and conflict because of my contradictory actions and beliefs, and I don't take defeat, setbacks, or even missteps lightly.

fluffInfo.value: Lord Commander Elias Drexel was appointed to the office of Lord Commander before the fall of Drakkenheim, and was outside the city leading training drills when the meteor fell. Afterwards, he took part in three military expeditions to reclaim Drakkenheim, and saw firsthand their horrors. He then went on to fight in the Westemär Civil War alongside Mannfred von Kessel. However, the idea that his soldiers died for nothing in Drakkenheim festered in his mind, and made him doubt Mannfred's ability to be a good ruler. He secretly participated in a successful conspiracy to assassinate Mannfred von Kessel. Little did he know that shortly thereafter, tragedy would soon befall Cecilia von Kessel. He isn't exactly proud of his choice to betray Mannfred, and that causes him considerable guilt, regret, and internal self-loathing.

traits.value: Elias projects a 30-foot Emanation of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the Emanation has Advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Lord Commander's Blade**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Wound**: The target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Topple**: The target has the Prone condition.
**Sap**: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.
**Longbow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Push**: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.
**Slow**: The target has the Slowed condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

fluffInfo.value: This horrific albino garmyr stands well over twelve feet tall. He is covered in a mass of yellowish-white mangy fur, bloodstained and scarred from countless battles, and clad in a patchwork armour of leather, chain, and bladed plate with trophies—mummified heads—hanging from his belt. A mane of bony spines and tufts of barbed grey hair jut out from his head and down his back to a long white tail braided with skulls and bone fragments. His snarling visage is filled with long, razor-sharp fangs and smouldering red eyes. The Lord of The Feast holds an oversized longbow, strung with thick sinew. A quiver on his back holds enormous arrows, some bristling with barbed snares, others connected to coils of chains around the beast's wrists, while others are tipped with delerium shards.

A restrained target can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Harpoon Arrow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet directly toward the Lord of the Feast.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Lord of the Feast learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Difficult to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Regeneration ability.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Dangerous Archer
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that he carries special arrows revealing his Poison Arrow, Ensnaring Arrow, and Harpoon Arrow attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Cunning Combatant
fluffInfo.value: You learn their strongest and weakest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lord of the Feast stalks the Temple Ward of Drakkenheim with his war dogs, searching for glorious kills. He seeks out the most fearsome monsters, and loves picking fights with faction agents and adventurers. When a band of plucky heroes enters his territory, the Lord of the Feast tracks and hunts them until they leave the Inner City or he has their skulls.
The Lord of the Feast uses a variety of arrows in combat:
Poison Arrow to debilitate foes, Ensnaring Arrow to stop them fleeing, and Harpoon Arrow to pull them toward him to engage in melee combat.
If the Lord of the Feast is reduced below 100 Hit Points, he attempts to escape, but regroups as soon as possible with more hunters in tow to continue the hunt.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Aura of Hunger
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Lord of the Feast takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
traits.value: Being within 5 feet of a Hostile creature doesn't impose Disadvantage on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

traits.name: Hunter's Sense
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on attack rolls against a *Bloodied* creature.

traits.name: Predatory Senses
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him with the Invisible condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

actions.name: The Lord of the Feast always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Lord of the Feast can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Lord of the Feast takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

**Poison Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Poison damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition (save ends).
**Ensnaring Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (DC 17 Dexterity saving throw ends).
**Harpoon Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee or ranged attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Astride a midnight horse sits a shirtless elven huntsman. His broad chest is thickly muscled and sports tattooed knot work. Great stag antlers crest the huntsman's head, curving above his rich brown hair. The pale green glow that shines from his eyes obscures the elf 's strong features, and a massive spear twined with glowing green vines drives forward in his clenched fist*.

The baying of shadow hounds, the thundering of hoof beats, and a brassy horn note; the Wild Hunt is coming, and pity its quarry. The Lord of the Hunt is an enigma among the fey nobles. His true identity beyond title and position as master of the Wild Hunt is unknown, but he has some connection to the Black Prince of the shadow fey—while also answering to elvish druids and consorting with powerful hags and dryads.

fluffInfo.name: The Wild Hunt
fluffInfo.value: The Lord's court is the Wild Hunt itself, a group of huntsmen, revelers, intelligent hounds, and poor souls they sweep up in their frenzy. His home, if he has any permanent dwelling, is as mysterious as his true identity. He and his Hunt constantly move between the Plane of Shadow and the most ancient forests.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons
**Immunities**: cold, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Huntsman's Weapons
traits.value: The Lord of the Hunt's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 14 (**4d6**) poison damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Lord of the Hunt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sure Seat
traits.value: While mounted and not incapacitated, the Lord of the Hunt can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against his will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Lord of the Hunt makes three Spear or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage, or 9 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage if used in two hands, plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage. If the Lord of the Hunt throws the spear, the spear teleports up to 120 feet to the Lord of the Hunt's hand at the start of his next turn. If he has no hand free, the spear teleports to the ground at his feet.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Hunter's Quarry
actions.value: The Lord of the Hunt magically calls 3d6 elk or boars, 1d4 giant boars or giant elk, or 1 elephant. The called Beasts arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the Lord and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the Lord dies, or until the Lord dismisses them as a bonus action. The Lord can have any number of Beasts under its control at one time provided the combined total CR of the Beasts is no higher than 8.

bonusActions.name: Fey Mount
bonusActions.value: The Lord of the Hunt can summon or dismiss a magical Fey mount, mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action without spending movement. The mount uses the statistics of a warhorse, except it has 40 hp, is a Fey, has the same damage and condition resistances and immunities as the Lord of the Hunt, and uses the Lord's saving throw bonuses in place of its own. If the mount is slain, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form, and the Lord of the Hunt must wait 1 hour before summoning the mount again.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +16, deception +10, insight +10, perception +10, persuasion +10, stealth +8

traits.name: Draw In
traits.value: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all grappled creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**4d10 + 6**) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Psionic Repeater
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) force damage.

actions.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (**14d10**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

actions.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 (**10d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Memory Transfer
actions.value: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (**8d10**) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

entries: The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the cure ailment power, a __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is charmed by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is charmed, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a DC 19 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonusActions.name: Grappling Jaunt
bonusActions.value: Lord Syuul and each creature grappled by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +16, deception +10, insight +10, perception +10, persuasion +10, stealth +8

fluffInfo.value: *Lounging on a large river rock, this breathtaking fey calls plaintively to travelers.*

fluffInfo.name: Death to Men
fluffInfo.value: A people born from an ancient oath to the River King, the loreleis' cruelty stems from whatever happened to their people long ago that brought about their transformation into loreleis. Now, these callous river sirens compete with one another in manipulating and destroying male travelers, using their deadly kisses to great effect.

fluffInfo.name: Beautiful Humanoids
fluffInfo.value: Although legends describe the lorelei as golden-haired and fair-skinned, they come in all varieties, taking on the form of their most frequent prey. While most resemble sensual humans, a lorelei's form can include elf, dwarf, and, in some recorded cases, even orc or hobgoblin.

fluffInfo.name: Ignore Women
fluffInfo.value: Women travelers are vexing for the lorelei. While the siren's powers affect women as readily as men, the lorelei lacks the urge to destroy them. Women traveling alone or in all-female groups may pass through a lorelei's territory safely, and they might even make peaceful contact.

traits.name: Alluring Presence
traits.value: When a Humanoid that can see the lorelei starts its turn within 30 feet of the lorelei, the lorelei can force it to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw if the lorelei isn't incapacitated and can see the Humanoid. On a failed save, the Humanoid is charmed until the start if its next turn. While charmed, the target is incapacitated and must move on its turn toward the lorelei by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the lorelei for a kiss from her. The Humanoid doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage, the Humanoid can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends for it, and it regains its senses for the remainder of its turn.

Unless surprised, a Humanoid can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the Humanoid does so, it can't see the lorelei until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the Humanoid looks at the lorelei in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The lorelei can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Free Water Spirit
traits.value: While in contact with water, the lorelei ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. In addition, she can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lorelei can use her Stunning Glance. She then makes three Psychic Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Corrupted Kiss.

actions.name: Corrupted Kiss
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is incapacitated or restrained. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) necrotic damage, and the lorelei regains hp equal to that amount.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Stunning Glance
actions.value: The lorelei sends a seductive glance at a creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this lorelei's Stunning Glance for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The commoner's long jump is 30 feet, and its base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Team Tactics
traits.value: The commoner can take the Help action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage

entries: **Skills**: history +12, insight +22, nature +12, perception +14, persuasion +15, stealth +11

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.value: If Lothrem fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Nature's Restoration
traits.value: Lothrem regains 10 hit points at the start of their turn if they have at least 1 hit point. If they are in sunlight, they instead regain 20 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lothrem can use their Frightful Presence. They then make three attacks: one with their bite and two with their claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage, plus 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d6 + 8**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d8 + 8**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.value: Each creature of Lothrem's choice that is within 120 feet of Lothrem and aware of them must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Lothrem's Frightful Presense for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Ensnaring Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Lothrem exhales enriching breath on the ground in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide, causing a thick wall of tangled, thorny brush to magically grow in the area. The wall is 20 feet high and blocks line of sight. Each creature in the area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 63 (**14d8**) piercing damage and is restrained in the wall. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

The wall remains until the end of Lothrem's next turn, at which point it withers and disappears. A creature restrained in the wall or one that is within 5 feet of the creature can use its action to make a DC 19 Strength check, freeing the creature on a success. For the duration, the area is difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 9 (**2d8**) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.value: Lothrem magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than their own, or back into their true form. Lothrem reverts to their true form if they die. Any equipment Lothrem is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Lothrem's choice).

In a new form, Lothrem retains their own alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Lothrem's statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except and class features or legendary actions of that form.

fluffInfo.value: *This massive creature combines the torso of an ogre and the body of an elephant as it lumbers through the open plains.*

fluffInfo.name: Nomadic Families
fluffInfo.value: Loxodas live in small herds of two to three extended families. Several of these communities will usually cluster together, allowing members to move between groups as they get older. They have no permanent settlements, and instead loxoda families travel to new areas when they deplete the available food. Voracious omnivores, a family of loxodas will quickly strip trees bare of leaves, or hunt and cook an entire elephant.

fluffInfo.name: Often Underestimated
fluffInfo.value: Many people assume that loxodas are as dull witted as the ogres they resemble. This is often a fatal mistake, as the loxoda are quite intelligent. Their simple equipment and straightforward living come not from a lack of skill or knowledge, but their own isolationism and xenophobia. Their immense size and quadruped body make it difficult for them to mine metal ore, and they violently reject communications and trade with other people. The little metal they can gather is either taken from the bodies of their prey or stolen in raids on dwarven, human, or gnoll settlements.

fluffInfo.name: Vestigial Tusks
fluffInfo.value: All loxodas have curved tusks. While they are too small for use in even ritual combat, they are often decorated with intricate carvings or inlays or are dyed in a pattern developed by their family. Each individual also adapts the patterns with their own individual marks, often inspired by important events in their lives. Some loxodas put golden rings or jeweled bracelets stolen from humanoids onto their tusks as trophies. A loxoda matriarch may have long, dangling chains of such ornaments, indicating her high status and long life.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.value: If the loxoda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the loxoda can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The loxoda makes one Slam attack and one Spear attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 17 (**3d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tooth-Rattling Pound (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The loxoda rears up and lands heavily, rattling the land and creatures around it. Each creature in contact with the ground within 20 feet of the loxoda must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (**8d8**) bludgeoning damage and takes an extra 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage at the end of its next turn as the shock waves from the Tooth-Rattling Pound continue up through its body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't take extra thunder damage from shock waves.

traits.name: Evasive
traits.value: Lucas adds his Intelligence modifier as a bonus to Dexterity saving throws (already included in the stat block).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lucas makes two rapier attacks and one bite attack. Or Lucas makes two ranged attacks with his twinshot hand crossbow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Twinshot Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage. This special hand crossbow can be fired twice before it needs to be reloaded.

fluffInfo.value: Born Sevran Dusktalon, this notorious hitman gained the nickname "Lucky" for his uncanny ability to eliminate targets and escape unseen, even against impossible odds. What many have discounted as luck is, in fact, the result of Sevran's careful observation and keen intellect.

Lucky takes his jobs very seriously, and takes a careful, methodical approach to his work. He will devote himself to studying a target for weeks before striking, and will not accept more than one assignment at a time.

This young male dusk corvum was a former assassin employed by various criminal contacts throughout the city. He has dark, iridescent plumage with a prominent neck-ruff and amber-colored eyes. He is known to hide poisoned daggers on his person.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Jerbeen, Thieves' cant, Vulpin, can understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Lucky can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Lucky can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Lucky has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.value: During his first turn, Lucky has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Lucky scores against a *surprised* creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Fortunate Insight (3/Day)
traits.value: Lucky can spend his reaction to add a d8 to the result of an attack roll, damage roll, saving throw, or Dexterity (*Stealth*) check.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: Lucky has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.value: Once per turn, Lucky deals an extra 14 **4d6** damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Lucky that isn't incapacitated and Lucky doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lucky makes two attacks with his shortsword. He can replace one of these attacks with a hand crossbow attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must make a constitution saving throw, taking 24 (**7d6**) poison damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must make a constitution saving throw, taking 24 (**7d6**) poison damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: Lucretia Mathias is a willowy and wizened woman with piercing eyes and pursed lips. She is in her early nineties, and keeps her greying black hair in a coiled bun beneath a linen shawl. She wears simple grey robes, and clutches a heavy leather-bound tome. A glowing golden crystal dangles from a silver chain around her neck. Her garb lightly conceals the delerium shard embedded in her heart.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I speak in proverbs and quote scripture when I speak, inspiring others to interpret my cryptic words and come to their own revelations.
**Ideal**: The brightest lights shine in the darkest of places. None are beyond redemption, and all may find their inner truth and purpose by following the Falling Fire.
**Bond**: I have foreseen the inevitable end of our world, but through our sacred self-sacrifice we shall set alight the Sacred Flame to bring enlightenment and salvation to the universe.
**Flaw**: I only reveal the greatest truths I have seen to those I am certain can grasp them fully, and will understand them as I do.

traits.name: Prescient
traits.value: Lucretia Mathias can't be surprised while she is conscious.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While Lucretia Mathias is wearing no armour and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Undeniable Faith
traits.value: Lucretia Mathias automatically succeeds on Constitution saving throws to maintain *concentration* on her spells. Any spell she casts is treated as if it were cast using a 9th level spell slot, regardless of the spell slot used to cast the spell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Lucretia Mathias fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.value: Any creature who targets Lucretia Mathias with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This effect doesn't protect Lucretia Mathias from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball.
If Lucretia Mathias makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this effect ends until the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Pacifying Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is stable at 0 hit points. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. This effect ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage.

actions.name: Divine Intervention (1/ week)
actions.value: Lucretia Mathias calls on the Sacred Flame for aid. The GM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate.

traits.name: Holy Aura
traits.value: Lucretia projects a 60-foot Emanation of holy power. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.value: Creatures in the Emanation that target Lucretia with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This effect doesn't protect Lucretia from area effects, such as the explosion of a __Fireball__. If Lucretia makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this trait ends until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Pacifying Presence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Weakened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Flame

traits.name: Prescient

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When Lucretia dies, her soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in her chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Lucretia Mathias is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While Lucretia is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier (included above).

traits.name: Undeniable Faith
traits.value: Lucretia automatically succeeds on Constitution saving throws to maintain *Concentration* on her spells.

actions.name: Lucretia always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Lucretia can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lucretia takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Pacifying Touch**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 5 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, even after regaining Hit Points.

**Sacred Flame**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 60 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Divine Intervention (1/Day)
actions.value: Lucretia chooses any spell which doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of this Epic Action, she casts that spell without Material components. If she uses this Epic Action to cast the __Wish__ spell, she can't use this Epic Action for the next 1d4 days.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Lucretia chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Lucretia can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *A hulking figure floats in the air, a winged horror painted in mist and moonlight.*

fluffInfo.name: Corruptors of the Moon
fluffInfo.value: Lunar devils can be found subverting druidical orders or leading packs of werewolves. They are a lazy breed of devil and prefer lounging in the light of the moon over more vigorous activity. The only exception is an opportunity to corrupt druids and moon-worshippers, pitting them against followers of sun gods.

fluffInfo.name: Vain and Boastful
fluffInfo.value: Lunar devils are as vain as they are indolent. Tales the fey tell involve thwarting them by appealing to their vanity. Lunar devils frequently befriend the dark fey.

fluffInfo.name: Flying in Darkness
fluffInfo.value: In combat, lunar devils sometimes bring allies along, bestowing magical flight on them. The devils stay in areas of moonlight whenever they can. Lunar devils have excellent vision in total darkness, though, and are happy to use that against foes. They prefer attacking from range, allowing allies to take the brunt of any opposition.

traits.name: Lightwalking
traits.value: Once on its turn, the lunar devil can use half its movement to step magically into one area of moonlight within its reach and emerge from a second area of moonlight within 80 feet of the first, appearing in an unoccupied space within that second area.

traits.name: Rage
traits.value: The lupine can give itself Advantage on its first D20 Test each turn. If it does so and fails that D20 Test, it's overcome with rage. On each of its turns while raging, the lupine attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, its rage ends. A lupine's ally, if within 60 feet of the raging lupine, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check; the lupine must be able to hear its ally. If this check succeeds, the lupine ceases its rage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The lupine regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the lupine takes Fire damage or damage from silver objects, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The lupine dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack

After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: The lupine shape-shifts into a Large wolf-humanoid hybrid form or a Medium wolf, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

fluffInfo.value: *Thing That Goes Bump in the Night*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Frightened children know that lurkers in the dark can be held at bay by clutching a beloved stuffed animal.

traits.name: Nightmarish Contortion
traits.value: The lurker can fit into a space as small as a 1-foot Cube and can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The lurker can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ward of Innocence
traits.value: The lurker can't attack or willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a creature holding a stuffed animal once owned by a child.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

bonusActions.name: Dark Teleport
bonusActions.value: While the lurker isn't in Bright Light, it teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. If the destination space isn't in Bright Light, the lurker doesn't need to see it. A creature the lurker is grappling must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or teleport with the lurker to an unoccupied space closest to the lurker's destination.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Lurker on the Threshold, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Baleful Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Beams
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Cosmic Rays attack action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Enduring
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lurker on the Threshold is a creature of pure arcane energy and twisted realities. It fires Cosmic Rays at mortal creatures,warping their minds, showing truths that drive them mad, or undoes their very existence on a cellular level. It grabs creatures with its Tendrils and blasts its beams while holding them in place, undoing the creatures from the inside out, before tossing them aside and moving on to the next. The Lurker on the Threshold only flees if it is reduced to under half its Hit Points, not because of any sense of fear, but because it finds specific enemies a nuisance.
