traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The lurker is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lurker may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the lurker can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lurker has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The lurker is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the lurker's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Eldritch Blood
traits.value: A creature that deals Piercing or Slashing damage to the lurker while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**1d10**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lurker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lurker makes three Tendril attacks. It can replace each Tendril attack with a use of Cosmic Rays.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The lurker has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Cosmic Rays
actions.value: The lurker randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet (roll 1d4; reroll if the lurker has already used that ray this turn):

entries: **Disintegrating Ray**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

**Memory Lapse Ray**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't take the Magic action, use class features, or understand language, and has Disadvantage on ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
**Contaminating Ray**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 16 (**3d10**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.
**Existential Dread Ray**: On the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the Dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a Bonus Action, it takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to study a Lurking Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Something's Off
fluffInfo.value: You suspect this person may have been exposed to eldritch contamination.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Hiding Something
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Lurking Dreg's Cunning Action trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Not A Humanoid
fluffInfo.value: You realize this is a Dreg appearing to be a normal humanoid and recognize the Lurking Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Some Lurking Dregs hide in the shadows, waiting for an opportune moment to strike. Others pose as human and attempt to converse with prey, hoping to draw them deeper into the ruins. Lurking Dregs have been known to use stories of lost allies, trapped children, and more to lure adventurers into an ambush.

When they attack, Lurking Dregs use their Furious Ambush right away to get as many attacks in as possible. They Disengage if they can and attempt to keep their enemies at bay, possibly having other Dregs tie them up while the Lurking Dreg darts in and out.
If Lurking Dregs find themselves outnumbered at any point, they run into the shadows and Hide, attempting to escape.

A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time.

fluffInfo.name: Covetous Origins
fluffInfo.value: During the Age of Arcanum, magic inspired a deep arrogance in many of the gods' children, who assumed arcane gifts were proof of inevitable divinity. In response, many mortal folk experimented with manufacturing "life" of their own. The dwarves succeeded first, marrying divine gifts with technical skill to animate autonomous wardens as protectors of their ancestral halls. The dwarves' knowledge was quickly stolen and expanded upon by other folk, and creating golems eventually became less about proving that mortals can shape life as the gods do, and more about protecting life, wealth, and secrets from others.

fluffInfo.name: Mage Hunter Golem
fluffInfo.value: The gods cursed mortals with free will, but also blessed them with the means to survive the Primordials' wrath—the arts of magic. With magic, the people of Exandria fend off droughts, famines, volcanic flame, slashing ice, and angry earth. But knowing that the power of magic might inevitably tear Exandria apart, the gods also created the ultimate magical failsafe—antimagic.

fluffInfo.name: Hunter of Magic
fluffInfo.value: For many heroes who employ magic, the most terrifying nightmare is facing a hulking creature whose mere presence can strip away the power of spells and magic relics alike. Mage hunter golems are brutally efficient in their tactics, sweeping the battlefield with their disruptive antimagic, devouring spells used against them, and fitting collars to spellcasters that can leave them at the golem's mercy.

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claw (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throws or have a magic collar placed upon its neck. While the target wears the collar, it is magically prevented from speaking and cannot cast any spell. A successful DC 25 Dexterity check using thieves' tools removes the collar.

actions.name: Antimagic Jolt
actions.value: Each creature within the golem's Antimagic Cone that has the ability to cast a spell of 1st level or higher must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throws, taking 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Justicar's Smite
traits.value: When the mage-arbiter hits with any attack, the target takes an extra 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage (included in the attack). If the target has any remaining spell slots, it instead takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage.

traits.name: Legendary Spell Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the mage-arbiter fails a saving throw against a spell, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The mage-arbiter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mage-arbiter makes three attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage, or 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage, or 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

traits.name: Justicar's Smite
traits.value: When the magebreaker hits with any attack, the target takes an extra 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage (included in the attack). If the target has any remaining spell slots, it instead takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The magebreaker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The magebreaker makes two attacks.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) radiant damage, or 9 (**2d8**) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

fluffInfo.value: Magma elementals are native to the Para-elemental Plane of Magma, where the Plane of Earth and Plane of Fire collide. The inner inferno that sustains magma elementals constantly spews forth more material. This allows the creatures to use pieces of themselves as weaponry, hurling roiling globs of magma at individual targets or throwing a large mass of lava that explodes to damage groups of foes.

In mortal worlds, magma elementals are found in areas where strong volcanic activity is present. Eyewitnesses from inhabited areas destroyed by lava flows often sometimes report molten creatures at the vanguard of the lava, smashing and burning everything long before the lava arrives.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Aversion to Cold
traits.value: If the elemental takes Cold damage, its movement is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, and its Heat Aura trait doesn't function on its next turn.

traits.name: Earth Passage
traits.value: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.value: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Burning Slam attacks.

actions.name: Burning Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Roiling Lava (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the elemental can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.value: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the landshark takes 11 (**2d10**) fire damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The landshark's jumping is up to 40 feet and its jumping is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.value: The landshark sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 45 (**6d12 + 6**) piercing damage, and 14 (**4d6**) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throws or be swallowed by the landshark. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has cover against attacks and other effects outside the landshark, and it takes 42 (**12d6**) fire damage at the start of each of the landshark's turns.

If the landshark takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the landshark must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throws at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the landshark. If the landshark dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.value: If the landshark jumping at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity saving throws (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 27 (**6d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (**6d6**) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the landshark's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the landshark's space.

actions.name: Lava Pool (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: If the landshark is on solid ground, it melts the area around it, creating a pool of lava in a 10-foot radius. Any creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 44 (**8d10**) fire damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mound of magma.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to study a Magma Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Magma Trolls hunt for food during the hottest days of summer or in places of extreme temperatures. Often accompanied by sweltering heat, they begin combat by unleashing their Sulfurous Belch before rushing in to maul foes with their claws and bites.
If a Magma Troll takes Cold damage, it immediately flees and attempts to find a safe place to recuperate.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Giant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The troll is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes two Fiery Claw attacks and one Volcanic Bite attack. It can replace its Volcanic Bite attack with Sulphurous Belch, if available.

actions.name: Volcanic Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Claw
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 feet. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Sulfurous Belch (Recharges 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on the troll. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage and has the Blinded condition until it or another creature within 5 of it uses an action to clean the ash from their eyes. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the armour made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the armour remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a pile of armour plates.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the armour takes 10 or more fire damage in a single instance, it falls prone and, until the end of its next turn, it is incapacitated and its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The armour makes two melee attacks or casts Magnetobolt twice.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Magnetobolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature wearing ferrous armour makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the weapon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.
The area within 10 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures wearing ferrous armour.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the dragon takes 1 or more fire damage in a single instance, its flying speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn. If its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet, it immediately falls 100 feet, and falls a further 100 feet at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sword Shot
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4+2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

actions.name: Storm of Swords
actions.value: The dragon fires a torrent of sharp metal objects in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 **4d6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.value: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 30 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

fluffInfo.value: *Bird of Fate and Fortune (Crystal or gemstone shards)*

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The magpie doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The magpie makes two Beak attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Bonded Voice
bonusActions.value: The magpie can form or dissolve a magical bond with a willing creature within 5 feet. While the bond lasts, the bonded creature can speak through the magpie using the creature's own voice and language, but with a birdlike lilt. The bond ends when the creature dies or if the magpie creates a new bond.

fluffInfo.value: *A white fin cut the surface of the water as the serpentine creature approached. Its wolfish head burst from the surface, revealing a body covered in fine, white fur.*

fluffInfo.name: Valuable Teeth and Fur
fluffInfo.value: A mahoru's heavy jaws are filled with triangular, serrated teeth adept at tearing flesh and sundering bone. Their white fur is prized for its warmth and waterproof qualities. Their pectoral fins feature stubby, claw-tipped paws. Mahoru is a totem beast for many northern tribes. Some make arrowheads and tooth-studded clubs with the beast's fangs.

fluffInfo.name: Iceberg Hunters
fluffInfo.value: Mahoru prowl northern coasts and estuaries, hunting among the fragmenting pack ice each summer. They lurk beneath the surface, catching swimmers or lurching up onto the ice to break or tilt it and send prey tumbling into the water. When necessary, they stalk beaches and riverbanks in search of carrion or unwary victims.

fluffInfo.name: Work in Pairs and Packs
fluffInfo.value: Mahoru work together in mated pairs to corral everything from fish and seals to larger prey like kayaking humanoids and even polar bears. They gnaw at ice bridges and the frozen surface of lakes and rivers to create fragile patches that plunge unwary victims into waiting jaws.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The mahoru can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The mahoru has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all of its hp.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.value: The mahoru has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The mahoru has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the mahoru's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) slashing damage. If the mahoru scores a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or the mahoru bites off one of the target's limbs. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar
actions.value: The mahoru roars while above water or emits a loud, low thrum while underwater. Each creature within 30 feet of the mahoru that can hear the roar or thrum must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Roar of all mahoru for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *Twitch-Warped Ambushing Tree*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The curse that maintains a maidenwood unravels if one is offered an apple—an ancient trick used by witches turned against them.

traits.name: Undoing Gift (1/Day)
traits.value: The maidenwood must accept and eat an apple offered to it or to its lure. The maidenwood then takes 55 (**10d10**) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The maidenwood makes two Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a Chew attack.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of two tendrils. Until the grapple ends, it has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Chew
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) Piercing damage. If the target has the Restrained condition, it takes an extra 18 (**4d8**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Lure
bonusActions.value: The maidenwood shapes its lure into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it retracts the lure. The maidenwood can speak through the lure and move it anywhere within reach of its tendrils, and it causes the following effect—*Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 30 feet of the lure. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the maidenwood's next turn. The Charmed target must approach the lure as closely as it can. The maidenwood has Advantage on attack rolls against the Charmed target. If the target takes damage, the Charmed condition ends at the end of the current turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Within a blinding wave of heat and glare walks a long-limbed, misshapen form. The creature scorches everything in its path as it strides forward.*

What most people recall most vividly from an encounter with a malakbel is the blinding light and blistering heat surrounding it. Rippling distortion obscures the creature's body, which is roughly the size and shape of an adult human.

fluffInfo.name: Demonic Messengers
fluffInfo.value: Malakbel demons are contradictory creatures. They are both messengers and destroyers who carry the words of demon lords or even dark gods to the mortal realm. Paradoxically, once their message is delivered, they often leave none of its hearers alive to spread the tale.

fluffInfo.name: Where Virtue Cannot Look
fluffInfo.value: The malakbel is the embodiment of all that is forbidden and destructive. Despite its vital role as a messenger, its destructive nature always comes to the fore. A malakbel descends upon settlements and travelers with the merciless and relentless onslaught of the raging sun, burning all it sees to cinders before vanishing like heat shimmers at dusk.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Blistering Radiance
traits.value: The malakbel sheds searing, bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. At the start of each of the malakbel's turns, each creature in the bright light shed by the malakbel takes 11 (**2d10**) radiant damage. If any of the bright light overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell creating the darkness is dispelled.

traits.name: Distortion
traits.value: Ranged attacks against the malakbel are made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The malakbel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The malakbel makes two Scorching Blast attacks.

actions.name: Scorching Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) fire damage.

actions.name: Searing Flare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The malakbel intensifies the heat and light it sheds to withering levels. Each creature in the bright light shed by the malakbel's Blistering Radiance trait must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 13 (**3d8**) fire damage and 22 (**4d10**) radiant damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer exhaustion.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.value: The malakbel magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 100 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Massive Bulk
traits.value: A flab giant can't take the Dash action. In addition, a creature attempting to grapple, push, or knock the giant prone has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squatting Pin
actions.value: One creature grappled by the flab giant must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (**5d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage and is restrained until the grapple ends. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained, but it remains grappled until it escapes. While restrained, a creature takes 8 (**1d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the giant's turns. If the flab giant moves, the target is no longer restrained or grappled.

actions.name: Chain Whip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**3d4 + 5**) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Ever Vigilant
traits.value: At least two of the thrudgelmir's heads are awake at all times. The creature has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The thrudgelmir has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Runic Tattoos
traits.value: The thrudgelmir giant's body is covered in magical, runic tattoos. A successful __Dispel Magic__ cast on the tattoos (against DC 15) causes them to vanish for 1 minute. During that time, the thrudgelmir loses its Magic Resistance and the energy damage from its Elemental Hammer attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The thrudgelmir makes three Elemental Hammer attacks.

actions.name: Elemental Hammer
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) damage (roll 1d6 to determine damage type: 1. Acid, 2. Cold, 3. Fire, 4. Lightning, 5. Poison, 6. Thunder).

actions.name: Faces of Evil (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* All creatures within 30 feet of the thrudgelmir that can see it are subjected to one of the following conditions or effects until the end of the giant's next turn.

rows: The creature sees allies as enemies and the thrudgelmir as an ally

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12 range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**3d10 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, necrotic, radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.value: Malfuriel is immune to the diseases described in the [Bloodmire Diseases](https://5e.tools/tables.html#bloodmire%20diseases_griffonssaddlebag2) table.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede Malfuriel's darkvision.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.value: Malfuriel knows if he hears a lie.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.value: If Malfuriel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Malfuriel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Forsaken Weapons
traits.value: Malfuriel's weapon attacks are magical. When Malfuriel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Malfuriel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) slashing damage, plus 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch (2/Day)
actions.value: Malfuriel touches a creature, and that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 hour. The charmed target obeys Malfuriel's spoken or telepathic commands.

If the target suffers any harm, or receives a command to harm itself, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Malfuriel's Corrupting Touch for the next 24 hours.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Creeping Corruption
traits.value: Creatures within 30 ft. that the Malikirian imp can see must make a DC 12 Charisma saving throw at the start of their turn. On a failure, the creature acts in accordance with its most selfish, venal, and ruthless impulses to the best of its ability. After 24 hours, the creature must make another Charisma saving throw, ending the compulsion on a success. Failure indicates the compulsion lasts indefinitely until the affected is subject to remove curse or similar magic. Creatures that cannot be charmed are immune to this effect.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Malikirian imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* -1 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 (**1d4 - 2**) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The Malikirian imp becomes invisible until its *concentration* ends or it makes an attack.

fluffInfo.value: *With skin stretched like vellum over wizened limbs, a desiccated humanoid form clad in splendid regalia emerges from a funerary tower. The imposing figure has yellow points of light for eyes.*

fluffInfo.name: Cold Plateau Mummies
fluffInfo.value: The people of the cold, rainless, mountain plateaus take advantage of their dry climes to mummify their honored dead, but without the embalming and curing of the corpse practiced in hotter lands. To preserve the knowledge and the place of their ancestors in the afterlife, their dead remain among them as counsellors and honorees on holy days.

fluffInfo.name: Undead Judges
fluffInfo.value: The mallqui are not seen as malevolent, though at times they are severe judges against transgressors of their culture's ideals.

fluffInfo.name: Icons of Growth
fluffInfo.value: Through their ability to draw the very moisture from the air, they are seen as conduits to the fertility of the earth. Mallqui also means "sapling" in the language of the people who create them.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
**Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The mallqui regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the mallqui takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the mallqui's next turn. The mallqui dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The mallqui doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Water Hypersusceptibility
traits.value: For every 5 feet the mallqui moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 (**1d4**) radiant damage. In addition, the mallqui takes 10 radiant damage when it starts its turn at least partially submerged in water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mallqui can use its Xeric Aura. It then makes three Xeric Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Xeric Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Xeric Aura
actions.value: Each creature within 20 feet of the mallqui must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion, as moisture is drained from its body. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to the mallqui's Xeric Aura for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *Keen eyed and dangerous, this winged fey warrior is dressed in finery.*

fluffInfo.name: Sworn to the Shadow Fey
fluffInfo.value: Raised with a sword in their hands, the malphas are fierce warriors who serve the aristocracy of the shadow fey unswervingly.

fluffInfo.name: Corvid Fey
fluffInfo.value: The malphas have many crow-like features, including beaks, black-feathered bodies and wings, and clawed feet and hands. On occasion, a cloaked ravenfolk traveling in fey lands might be mistaken for a malphas, and some less scrupulous ravenfolk use this to their advantage to manipulate fey they encounter. Malphas don't take kindly to such impersonations and are merciless toward any ravenfolk they discover pretending to be one of them.

fluffInfo.name: Messengers
fluffInfo.value: Laconic in speech, they nevertheless serve as envoys and messengers from time to time. However, as much or more is communicated by the choice in messenger as in the message itself. Their crow-like features and the tendency of their masters to send bad news via malphas has earned them the nickname "storm crows" among many fey.

traits.name: Shadow-Infused Weapons
traits.value: The malphas's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d6** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the malphas has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The malphas makes two Longsword attacks or three Shadow Bolt attacks. If both Longsword attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn, as shadows fill its eyes. A creature that can see through magical darkness has advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Bristles
traits.value: A creature that hits the malrgotr with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (**1d8**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The malrgotr makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Glorious Flare (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13 All creatures in a 15-foot radius around the malrgotr. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This atrocity combines the worst elements of a dead frog and a rotting fish. Its slimy, scaly, vaguely humanoid form has eyes and three clawed arms arranged radially about its body. Its green, bat-like wings seem too small to work, yet it flies well*.

*The mamura are servants of the Black Goat of the Woods, and they live in the Wasted West and various fetid swamps and badlands. They seem friendly with the selang, and they arrange strange and orgiastic rites with them at the equinoxes.*

fluffInfo.name: Twisted Field Sprites
fluffInfo.value: Mamuras are the twisted faeries of magical wastelands and barren plains. They were once good-aligned, pixie-like fey called "polevoi," or "field sprites." At some point, they swore their souls to a dark goddess and were corrupted by her foul magic. Now they are twisted, alien things.

fluffInfo.name: Cross-Dimensional
fluffInfo.value: The mamura is one degree out of phase with reality. It appears blurry and indistinct even in bright light, and it seems translucent in dim light. They babble constantly, but their talk is mostly nonsense. Their minds operate in multiple dimensions in time as well as space, and this allows them to talk to and understand creatures of the Void. Because of this, their babble may be prophetic for the few who can decipher it.

fluffInfo.name: Prophetic Followers
fluffInfo.value: They occasionally align themselves with powerful goblin tribes or evil wasteland sorcerers for their own unknowable purposes.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Distracting Babble
traits.value: When a spellcaster that is *concentrating* on a spell starts its turn within 20 feet of the mamura, the spellcaster must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose *concentration* on the spell. In addition, if a spellcaster within 20 feet of the mamura casts a spell, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or the spell fails to cast, using the action, bonus action, or reaction to cast the spell but not expending the spell slot.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The mamura doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The mamura has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Radial Eyes
traits.value: The mamura has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being blinded. In addition, if the mamura isn't blinded, creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the mamura, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mamura makes three Claw attacks and one Whiptail Stinger attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whiptail Stinger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the creature takes 3 (**1d6**) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: While in dim light or darkness, the mamura takes the Hide action.

entries: **Languages**: understands any one language but speaks only through the use of their Mimicry trait

traits.name: Agile Predator
traits.value: When the manticore hits a creature with an attack on the manticore's turn, the manticore doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of that turn.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The manticore can mimic any words or phrases they have heard in a language they understand. A creature who hears the speech can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The manticore makes one Bite and one Claw attack, or two Tail Spike attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who is frightened of the manticore, they take an extra 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage, and the manticore can move the target up to 5 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.

bonusActions.name: Trumpeting Howl (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Each enemy within 120 feet who can hear the manticore must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the manticore for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the initial saving throw fails by 5 or more, a creature is also dazed while frightened in this way.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: perception +1 plus PB, stealth +1 plus PB

traits.name: Learning to Fly
traits.value: The manticore has a flying speed of 10 × PB feet.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The manticore can mimic any words or phrases they have heard in a language the manticore's caregiver understands. A creature who hears the speech can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 10 plus PB Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Tail Spike (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The manticore hurls a spine from its tail. This attack uses the statistics for their signature attack, except the spine is a ranged weapon with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet, and on a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** of poison damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Trumpeting Howl (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: Each enemy within 30 feet of the manticore who can hear them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of them until the end of the manticore's next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Poisoned Sting (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The manticore stings a target within 10 feet of them with their tail. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd10** poison damage and becomes dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

fluffInfo.value: *A treasure map flaps as if caught in a strong wind. It suddenly splits open, revealing a fanged mouth and face.*

fluffInfo.name: Mimic Spawn
fluffInfo.value: Mimic adhesive is not just a powerful means of trapping prey, it also contains millions of microscopic larvae that feed on flesh. Most of the larvae are consumed by the mimic when it eats. Mimics are either unaware of this, or they're indifferent to the fact that they routinely cannibalize their own offspring. A few larvae survive by adhering to the clothing or equipment of someone who escaped from a full-grown mimic's attack. These larvae hitch a ride, their host taking them far from the dungeon, cavern, or ruin of their birth. There, they drop off and grow into wormlike mimic young called map mimics. In time, map mimics grow into typical mimics.

fluffInfo.name: Smaller than a Dinner Plate
fluffInfo.value: Map mimics are too small to mimic the types of objects their parent does, but they still deceive prey by altering their forms. They can assume the shape, texture, and coloration of anything up to the size of a dinner plate.

fluffInfo.name: Paper Scrolls
fluffInfo.value: Their preferred form is parchment paper. They can display the path they've followed on their hide, complete with important landmarks. In this form, they curl up and wait inside bottles, or in the clutches of a corpse in plain view, until an unsuspecting adventurer discovers them. If the mimic is hungry, it attacks and attaches to the finder's face. Otherwise, it continues its charade as a map, eventually leading the reader back to the parent mimic.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.value: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Life Path
traits.value: Regardless of the form it takes, the map mimic can make a map on its surface (no action required) that shows the route it has traveled since it left its parent mimic. The map shows terrain features and landmarks of where it has been, but doesn't show the names of those places.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, and it attaches to the target. While attached, the mimic can't attack, the target is blinded, and at the start of each of the mimic's turns, the target takes 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

The attached mimic moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the mimic's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the mimic by succeeding on a DC 8 Strength check.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The mimic transforms into a Tiny object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The bandit has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: The bandit has advantage on *Stealth* checks made in dim light or total darkness.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The brute has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: The brute has advantage on *Stealth* checks made in dim light or total darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brute makes three melee attacks, two with their rapier and one with their parrying dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Parrying Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: This is the stat block of the __thug__, adjusted with mapach traits.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The thug has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The thug has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: The thug has advantage on *Stealth* checks made in dim light or total darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The thug makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d10**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The tinkerer has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: The tinkerer has advantage on *Stealth* checks made in dim light or total darkness.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tinker's Toys
actions.value: The tinkerer uses one of the following options (roll a d4 or choose one); the tinkerer can use each one no more than once per day:

actions.name: 1. Cogwork Bird
actions.value: The tinkerer winds and releases a small mechanical bird that flies to a target creature within 30 feet and distracts it. The next attack against that creature is made with advantage.

actions.name: 2. Flash-bangs
actions.value: The tinkerer targets a space up to 10 ft. away, and throws some small explosive shells that flare up in a blinding light. All creatures within 10 ft. of the target space must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the tinkerer's next turn.

actions.name: 3. Nettle Gun
actions.value: The tinkerer turns the crank on a small gadget that sprays nettles at a target. *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 10/20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage. All creatures within 5 ft. of the target must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**1d10**) piercing damage.

actions.name: 4. Grease Balloon
actions.value: The tinkerer targets a 10-foot by 10-foot area up to 15 feet away, and makes it slick with grease. The area is considered difficult terrain, and each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks that aren't adamantine

traits.name: Agility Rune
traits.value: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage on the giant's ranged attack rolls.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While motionless, the giant is indistinguishable from a statue.

traits.name: Stone Flesh
traits.value: When a creature attacks the giant with a melee weapon that isn't adamantine and rolls a 1 on the d20 for that attack, that weapon is destroyed if it is mundane. If that weapon is supernatural, it loses all supernatural properties for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two Greatsling attacks.

actions.name: Greatsling
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60/240 feet, one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the giant.

actions.name: Boulder Roll (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The giant bowls a boulder in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line along the ground. Each creature in this line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (**5d10**) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone. Each object in this line that isn't supernatural or worn or carried by a creature takes 27 (**5d10**) bludgeoning damage. At the end of its roll, the boulder crumbles, creating a 10-foot square of difficult terrain.

bonusActions.name: Siege Stance
bonusActions.value: The giant digs their heels into the ground, reducing their speed to 0. While in this stance, the normal and long ranges of the giant's Greatsling attack are doubled, and when this attack hits, each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage. The giant's stance lasts until they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained, or until the giant ends it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The marsh hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Roll Over
traits.value: If the marsh hydra moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits them with an Entangling Serpents attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The marsh hydra makes two Entangling Serpents attacks. They can replace one attack with a Many Bites attack.

actions.name: Entangling Serpents
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Many Bites
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (**4d8**) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of the marsh hydra's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Serpent Surprise
bonusActions.value: The marsh hydra activates one of the following effects; if the effect targets another creature, the marsh hydra targets one creature they can see within 30 feet of them:

entries: **1. Poison Spit**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) poison damage and be blinded until the end of the marsh hydra's next turn.

**2. Entrancing Gaze**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the marsh hydra for 1 minute or until the marsh hydra harms the target (save ends at end of turn).
**3. Terrifying Rattle**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened by the marsh hydra for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
**4. Reinforcements**: The marsh hydra shuffles which heads are on the outside of their body and regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

fluffInfo.value: The Marsh-dwellers are shambling humanoid creatures with a clammy pale flesh, like that of a corpse left to rot in the water. A fell light in their small eyes suggests a wicked vitality and intent. They dwell among ruins where Men used to live, often by dark pools of stagnant water. They hide underground in small groups, ready to ambush unwary travellers and drag them into the cellars where they hoard their stolen gold.

traits.name: Deathless
traits.value: If damage reduces the Marsh-dweller to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant, from a critical hit, or from a weapon enchanted with spells for the Bane of the Undead. On a success, the Marsh-dweller drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Marsh-dweller has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Marsh-dweller makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 11) and the Marsh-dweller cannot use its claws on another target.

fluffInfo.name: Changing Martha's Attitude
fluffInfo.value: Despite the horrors occurring at her doorstep, Martha is easy to befriend. She becomes immediately Friendly if they save __Jonah__ from death in the "The Burning Mill" encounter. Otherwise, she is Indifferent.

Her attitude increases one step if the characters demonstrate selfless heroism or emotional tenderness. Her attitude decreases one step if they are selfish or try to Influence her to learn a secret from her and fail their Charisma check.

fluffInfo.name: Martha's Secret
fluffInfo.value: Farmer Malachai, Martha's husband, was a violent drunk, and Martha accidentally killed him while defending herself. She has kept this secret ever since to protect her children.

fluffInfo.name: Learning Her Secret
fluffInfo.value: As an Influence action, a character convinces Martha to reveal this secret with a successful DC 15 Charisma (*Intimidation* or *Persuasion*) check. This secret is in addition to her extramarital role in William's secret (see above).

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Scent Reliance
traits.value: The marvorok can't use their blindsight if they can't breathe or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The marvorok makes three Claw attacks and one Eviscerate attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The marvorok can grapple up to two creatures at a time.

actions.name: Eviscerate
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the marvorok. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage plus 17 (**2d10 + 6**) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Taste the Air
bonusActions.value: The marvorok makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

bonusActions.name: Underground Stalker
bonusActions.value: The marvorok teleports, along with any creatures they are grappling, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the marvorok teleports into an area of dim light or darkness, they can take the Hide action as part of this bonus action, and any creatures they are grappling can't speak or make noise until the end of the marvorok's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *The frame of this withered demon's corpse barely fills the ash-colored plate armor that encases it. It carries a khopesh made of violet smoke, and a horned ivory mask devoid of features is nailed to its face.*

fluffInfo.name: Children of Fiends
fluffInfo.value: Long ago, a demon lord of shadow fell in love with a demon goddess of the underworld. The two devised a plan to not merely slay their peers, but expunge them from time itself, leaving only each other. Shortly thereafter, the mask wights were conceived.

fluffInfo.name: Rites of Annihilation
fluffInfo.value: To create these undead, the lovers stole bodies of death knights from beneath the necropolis of an arch-lich and sacrificed a million condemned souls, draining their essence into ivory masks. Finally, the masks were hammered onto the knights with cold iron nails, and their armored husks were left at the bottom of the memory-draining River Styx for 600 years. When they rose, the mask wights marched out into the planes to bury knowledge and erase their quarry from memory and history.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.value: The mask wight's weapon attacks are magical. When the mask wight hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Single-Minded Purpose
traits.value: The mask wight has advantage on attack rolls against fiends and creatures wielding fiendish power, such as tieflings or some sorcerers and warlocks.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The mask wight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mask wight makes two Khopesh of Oblivion attacks and one Spiked Gauntlet attack. If both Khopesh of Oblivion attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or forget cherished memories of one object or location until it interacts with that object or location again. The object or location can't be an object on the target or a location within its sight when it fails this saving throw.

actions.name: Khopesh of Oblivion
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spiked Gauntlet
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Wail of the Forgotten (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mask wight emits an ear‑piercing wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the mask wight must make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (**10d6**) thunder damage and 27 (**6d8**) psychic damage and is deafened for 1 hour. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't deafened. A creature killed by this wail is erased from the memories of every creature in the planes that ever saw or interacted with it, all written or pictorial references to the target fade away, and its body is obliterated. Only divine beings and creatures that saw the creature die are unaffected by this memory erasure. The slain creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a __wish__ spell.

fluffInfo.name: Perfect Obedience
fluffInfo.value: As constructs, adranachs are unfailingly loyal servants to the spellwrights who created them. To the people of Tal'Dorei, they are best known as the creatures that allowed cities razed by the Chroma Conclave to be rebuilt in a matter of weeks, rather than years. But adranachs are also mighty combatants that serve their masters as hunters, bodyguards, and even assassins.

fluffInfo.name: Astral Body
fluffInfo.value: An adranach's body is formed from the energy of the Astral Plane. Their claws and face, as well as a number of rune-inscribed braces on their body, are made of mithral and are necessary to keep their form of pure energy from losing cohesion. The methods for creating these mithral foundations and for binding astral energy to them are known only to the Wonderworker (the leader of the League of Miracles) and the spellwrights who learn from them.

This secret knowledge is granted to worthy spellwrights in the form of an orb of mithral bands, about three feet in diameter, called a dormen. As the bands are removed and forged into the adranach's braces and mask, the dormen speaks aloud the instructions of how to craft an adranach in the magically recorded voice of the Wonderworker.

fluffInfo.name: Mithral Mask
fluffInfo.value: Each adranach has a unique mask crafted by its creator as their signature. This mask is crafted from pure mithral, and is the key to summoning and dismissing an adranach to a unique pocket dimension where it can rest and repair itself. When not in use, the mask magically shrinks from its true size to an easily concealable size fit for a humanoid face. Most spellwrights keep this mask in a chest stored on the Ethereal Plane with the __Leomund's Secret Chest__ spell, and only produce the mask when it is time to call their adranach forth.

fluffInfo.name: Master Adranach
fluffInfo.value: The secretive master spellwrights of the League of Miracles are taught how to build adranachs of monumental size, with strength to match. These legendary constructs are also inevitably outfitted with unique enhancements of their creators' own devising, from upgraded espionage tools to the ability to sublimate their starry form and travel through the Astral Plane.

fluffInfo.name: Arcane Nature
fluffInfo.value: An adranach doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: the languages spoken by its creator

traits.name: Arcane Leak
traits.value: When the adranach is reduced to half its hit point maximum (145 hit points), its mithral mask cracks and its arcane form begins to waver, creating a field of unstable magic around it. Any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the adranach or enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 21 (**6d6**) radiant damage. Additionally, if a creature casts a spell within this area, it must make a DC 18 ability check using its spellcasting ability. On a failure, the spell backfires, consuming the spell slot and dealing 7 (**2d6**) force damage to the caster for each level of the spell slot that was consumed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The adranach is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The adranach has Advantage and Disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The adranach's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Colossal Build
traits.value: The adranach's carrying capacity is doubled, as is the weight it can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Slipstream
traits.value: The adranach can cast __invisibility__ on itself at will. While it is invisible, its speed is doubled.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the adranach fails a saving throws, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The adranach makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its tail.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, one target, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, one target, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**2d12 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Force Bolts (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The adranach targets up to six creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throws or take 35 (**10d6**) force damage.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.value: The mage can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mage makes three Prismatic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (mage's choice).

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.value: As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (**3d6**) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 1st.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *With burnt and blackened skin, burnt twigs for hair, and clawed hands and feet that resemble burnt and twisted roots, this creature appears scorched and even frail. Pupilless red eyes gleam in its sockets with a hellish green flame.*
Mavkas are twisted dryads created by undead warlocks and vampiric experiments.

*There were once three dryad sisters named Mica, Anthelia, and Saramantha. After his conquest of Morgau, the Black Prince Lucan had the dryads and their trees killed and then raised them as powerful undead—mavkas. His warlocks bonded the new undead with nightmares instead of trees to complete their corruption.*
*These three sisters have since spawned many more such undead fey. Some serve the Black Prince as generals or concubines, while others pursue their own ends, destroying vampires, laying waste to villages, and seeking power in the Shadow Realm.*

fluffInfo.name: Death Riders
fluffInfo.value: Mavkas ride nightmares and are fearsome raiders, snatching victims up into the saddle, never to be seen again. They despise and trample foot soldiers as peasants unworthy of attention.

fluffInfo.name: Hag Killers
fluffInfo.value: Mavkas are the mortal enemies of red hags, who call these undead horrors "greenbanes." When red hag covens discover vampires and other undead turning local dryads into mavkas, they go on a rampage, destroying all undead they encounter.

entries: **Resistances**: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Mounted Warrior
traits.value: While the mavka is mounted, her mount can't be charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Nightmare Mount
traits.value: The mavka has formed a bond with a nightmare. The nightmare acts as a controlled mount while carrying the mavka, obeying the mavka's spoken commands. Mounting and dismounting the nightmare costs the mavka only 5 feet of movement.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.value: The mavka takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The mavka doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mavka makes two Enervating Slam attacks or three Necrotic Bolt attacks. If she is riding a nightmare, the nightmare can then make one Hooves attack. If both Enervating Slam attacks hit one creature, the mavka regains hp equal to the total necrotic damage dealt by both attacks.

actions.name: Enervating Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d10 + 4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Flame Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: While riding a nightmare, the mavka channels her power into her mount, causing its fiery light to burn those nearby. Each creature within 20 feet of the mavka must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (**12d8**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Maw Vermin, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Filled with Delerium
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that this creature gained the Magic Resistance trait, and has Resistance to Acid, Poison, and Necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Chew and Spit!
fluffInfo.value: You learn the details of the Maw Vermin's Bite, and Glob Launcher.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Dim but Enduring
fluffInfo.value: You know the Maw Vermin's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Maw Vermin is a primal creature that cannot comprehend anything beyond its next meal. Ratlings give them a wide berth, as it is just as likely to consume them as anything else. When a Maw Vermin senses anything it can eat, it lumbers towards the meal, using its Grasping Maw to pull targets closer so it can Bite them. Maw Vermin want to consume anything in sight, using its own food to secure even more. It uses Glob Launcher to spit half-digested morsels, happily eating whatever mess is left over.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws, Teeth, Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The maw vermin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The maw vermin makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, and it can use Grasping Maw or Glob Launcher.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and has Total Cover from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level.

The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the Prone condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) Slashing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this Claw on another target. The maw vermin has three Claws.

actions.name: Grasping Maw
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Medium or smaller creature the maw vermin can see within 15 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

actions.name: Glob Launcher
actions.value: The maw vermin coats a swallowed creature in acidic goo and launches it at a point within 120 feet of it. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature within 10 feet of the launched creature as it lands (the launched creature automatically fails). *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Restrained condition.

fluffInfo.value: *This lumbering saurian quadruped has large, oblong plates of bone covered in greenish slime protruding from its back and its thick, club-like tail.*

fluffInfo.name: Large Plates
fluffInfo.value: People describe this reptilian herbivore as "the animal with planks growing out of its back." The mbielu is a large dinosaur akin to a stegosaurus, with square dorsal plates that support symbiotic colonies of toxic, green algae. The plates themselves are as large as shields.

fluffInfo.name: Aquatic Herbivore
fluffInfo.value: An mbielu spends most of its life underwater, feeding on aquatic plants and avoiding the withering glare of the harsh sun, but it comes onto land frequently to sun itself for a few hours before immersing itself once again.

fluffInfo.name: Toxic Alchemy
fluffInfo.value: Its dorsal plate algae undergo an alchemical reaction in the continual transition between water and sky, especially during mbielu migrations to new watery dens. The algae produce a hallucinogenic poison that clouds the minds of most creatures. Mbielus themselves are immune to the toxin.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The mbielu can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Toxic Skin
traits.value: A creature that touches the mbielu or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws as it experiences mild hallucinations. The poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Rumbling Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mbielu releases a deep bellow that vibrates within the bodies of those nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the mbielu must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature poisoned by the mbielu's Toxic Skin fails this saving throw, it is also incapacitated until the end of its next turn as the combined vibrations and hallucinations disorient it.

entries: **Skills**: deception +4, investigation +3, sleight of hand +4, stealth +4

traits.name: Helpful-ish
