traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the rotwrap takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the rotwrap takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Words of Ancient Doom (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 necrotic damage, and if three or more rotwraps joined the attack, the target can't speak or use telepathy until the end of their next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *She doesn't look so tough, now surrender before you...uh oh*

A Mutagenist has researched a serum that they inject to transform into a monstrous form. They use themselves as the conduit for this power and hurl themselves towards their enemies as a hulking abomination. They spend their lives researching and discovering new ways to improve and modify the serum in hopes of becoming the perfect Apex form.

fluffInfo.name: Mutagenist Minions
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist is constantly experimenting on other creatures before turning their concoctions onto themselves. First their tests involve small rodents, birds, or other unassuming livestock. Skinwings are one such example of a Mutagenist's early experimentation. When they move on to humanoid subjects, they create abominations like the __Cerebrograft__, while their failed experiments end up as Uncontained Growths.

Every Mutagenist strives to accomplish the ultimate goal of the Apex Formula, the elixir that will transmogrify them into the perfect specimen of humanity, at least in their altered and maddened view.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I bury myself in books and research, and seldom talk to others.
**Bond:** My work is important, with my research I could cure so many of humanity's inherent weaknesses, and make us stronger as a species.
**Ideal:** Perfection is achievable if one just puts the time and effort into obtaining it.
**Flaw:** I know my view of the perfect human is flawless, I will not hear otherwise..

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Mutagenist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Physiological Experts
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Mutagenist's saving throws, as well as the Grotesque Gargantuan's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Forced Mutation
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Mutant Strain and Transmogrifying Elixir action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hulking Form
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Transmogrified Form's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist relies on their spellcasting and Forced Mutation, attempting to cause debilitating effects on its foes while altering their forms.

If the Mutagenist is in a losing situation, it drinks its Transmogrifying Elixir to become its Transmogrified Form. In this form, it hurls rocks at its targets, knocking them Prone. The hulking Mutagenist then bounds up to them and slams them with its Meaty Fists.

traits.name: Noxious Blood
traits.value: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

actions.name: Scalpel
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d6).

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Anatomical Precision
bonusActions.value: The mutagenist gains Advantage on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Caregiver Twisted by Mutation*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Mutant nurses go berserk if their masks are destroyed or taken from them, or they become unresponsive if there are no other creatures nearby.

traits.name: Anchoring Mask
traits.value: The nurse has a porcelain mask (AC 15; HP 15; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). If the nurse starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nurse makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

actions.name: Stab
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Inject (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, a creature the nurse hit with a Stab attack this turn. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The Poisoned target also has the Unconscious condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Mutation
actions.value: The nurse has one of the following mutation action options:

entries: **Cerebral Graft**: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to the nurse's own. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

**Tentacle Lash**: A tentacle writhes beneath the nurse's skin or clothes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Catalyst (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The nurse injects itself with a stimulant. Until the start of the nurse's next turn, its Speed is doubled, it can make one extra Stab attack when it takes the Multiattack action, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC.

traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
traits.value: Whenever Mycete is subjected to necrotic damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Parasitic Spores
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, Mycete regains 3 (1d6) hit points.

actions.name: Fungal Growth
actions.value: Mycete causes fungi to proliferate from a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Solid surfaces in a 10-foot square centered on that point become difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Animate Husks (1/Day)
actions.value: Mycete animates three rotting zombies, who appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 feet of her. The zombies act immediately after Mycete on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Mycete dies, the zombies are destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Spore Eruption
bonusActions.value: Mycete destroys a rotting zombie under her control, and the zombie violently erupts with toxic spores.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the zombie must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: *Dressed in rags, this small humanoid has cold, blue skin and large, black eyes.*

Mylings are the souls of the unburied, those who died in the forest from abandonment or exposure and can find no peace until their bodies are properly interred. Given the circumstances around their deaths, mylings tend to be solitary, haunting the places where they died. When some tragedy ended in multiple deaths, the resulting mylings stay together and hunt as a pack.

fluffInfo.name: Attack in a Rage
fluffInfo.value: Mylings prefer to attack lone wanderers. They target a group when desperate or when there's more than one myling in the pack. They shadow a target until after dark, then jump onto the target's back and demand to be carried to their chosen burial ground. They cling tightly to a victim with arms and legs locked around the victim's shoulders and midsection, begging, threatening, and biting until the victim gives in to their demands. Mylings bite victims to death if the victim is unable or unwilling to carry them, or if a victim moves too slowly.

fluffInfo.name: Ungrateful Rest
fluffInfo.value: While all mylings seek a creature to carry them to their final resting place, even when a "mount" is willing, the creature's body grows immensely heavy as it nears its burial place. Once there, the myling sinks into the earth, taking its bearer with it.

fluffInfo.name: Urchin Rhymes and Songs
fluffInfo.value: Some mylings maintain traces of the personalities they had while alive—charming, sullen, or sadistic—and can speak touchingly and piteously. Dressed in ragged clothing, their skin blue with cold, they sometimes reach victims who believe they are helping an injured child or young adult. They hide their faces and sing innocent rhymes when they aren't screeching in fury, for they know that their dead eyes and cold blue skin cause fright and alarm.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious
**Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Enfeebling Attacks
traits.value: Each time the myling deals necrotic damage to a creature that is below half its hp maximum, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The myling doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or the myling attaches to it. While attached, the myling sinks its teeth into the target and can't attack, and at the start of each of the myling's turns, the target takes 17 (**5d6**) necrotic damage.

The attached myling moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the myling's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the myling by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

bonusActions.name: Bury Alive (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The creature to which the myling is attached is knocked prone, dragged into the ground, and buried just below the surface, ending the attachment. The buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the buried creature, can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 90 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This draconic creature is plumed and scaled in glittering, multicolored hues.*

fluffInfo.name: Dragons in Human Form
fluffInfo.value: These minor dragons can take the shape of wise, old, human women. They retain full use of their sorcerous powers in their humanoid forms, and they can retain that form indefinitely.

fluffInfo.name: Difficult to Spot
fluffInfo.value: A naina shapeshifted into human form is nearly impossible to spot as anything but human unless she makes a mistake that gives away her true nature. This seldom happens. Draconic roars, a flash of scales, a fondness for raw meat, and a flash of wrathful dragon breath are the most common tells.

fluffInfo.name: Hunted by Rumor
fluffInfo.value: When rumors of a naina circulate, any woman who is a stranger may be persecuted, ostracized, or even tortured unless she can prove that she's entirely human.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Senses**: magic. the naina senses magic within 120 feet of her at will. this trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The naina makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or she makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Bite (True Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**3d12 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw (True Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**3d12 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The naina uses one of the following breath weapons:

entries: **Poison Breath**: The naina exhales poison breath in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 40 (**9d8**) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**Paralysis Breath**: The naina exhales paralyzing breath in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**Sleep Breath**: The naina exhales sleep gas around it. Each creature within 20 feet of the naina must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The naina transforms into a Medium Humanoid or back into her true form, which is a Dragon. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true from if she dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Unknowable Lifeform from Beyond (Meteorite fragments)*

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The nameless thing doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Psychic Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d12 + 3**) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the Frightened condition until the start of the nameless thing's next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The Nameless Thing can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Nameless Thing has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Nameless Thing makes two attacks: one with its primary natural weapon and one with its secondary natural weapon.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When Nathaniel dies, his soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in his chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Nathaniel is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Sacred Fire
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Five snaking necks sprout from this decayed, draconic body. However, instead of reptilian heads, each neck ends in a humanoid head.*

Necrohydras are created by powerful, evil necromancers and often used as guardians or placed at the vanguard of an undead army to strike fear and despair into the enemy. The wordless, heart-wrenching dirge the creature produces can drain all hope from listeners. The necrohydra can speak, though the few words it croaks out are usually only in response to questions by its master.

fluffInfo.name: Familiar Heads
fluffInfo.value: Sometimes a necrohydra is created as an instrument of revenge or a tool to further damage the morale of a necromancer's enemies. In these instances, the necromancer uses the heads of humanoids that are familiar to those that will face the necrohydra—heroes, beloved leaders or officers, loved ones, or close allies. A necromancer may coach the necrohydra to say certain mocking phrases to strike at the hearts of the necromancer's enemies.

entries: **Languages**: the languages its heads knew in life

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The necrohydra has five fleshy heads. While it has more than one head, the necrohydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. Whenever the necrohydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its fleshy heads dies. If all its fleshy heads die, the necrohydra can't use or maintain Dreadful Dirge. At the end of its turn, it grows two skeletal heads for each of its fleshy heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken radiant damage since its last turn. The necrohydra regains 10 hp for each skeletal head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.value: For each head the necrohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The necrohydra doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The necrohydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Dirge
actions.value: The necrohydra's heads emit a cacophonous, moaning wail. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 30 feet of the necrohydra that can hear the wail must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the wail ends. The necrohydra must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue wailing. It can stop wailing at any time. The wail ends if the necrohydra is incapacitated. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Necrotic Bile (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The necrohydra spews rotten bile soaked in necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) poison damage and 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: *Subterranean Spirit-Devouring Drake*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Necrolisks are severely allergic to a concoction of lavender, nightshade, and lilies, which causes them to vomit uncontrollably—a boon to anyone swallowed by the monsters.

traits.name: Entrapping Saliva
traits.value: The necrolisk ignores Immunity to the Grappled and Restrained conditions of a creature with the Incorporeal Movement trait. Creatures swallowed by the necrolisk can't pass through it using Incorporeal Movement or through the Ethereal Plane, and creatures can't teleport out of its stomach.

traits.name: Herb Allergy
traits.value: If the necrolisk eats a specific concoction of herbs worth 25 GP (such as if a swallowed creature pours them into its stomach as a Utilize action), at the end of the turn, the necrolisk regurgitates anything in its stomach as if it failed the saving throw described in its Swallow Bonus Action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The necrolisk can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The necrolisk can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The necrolisk makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, it has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d6 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Force damage.

actions.name: Ephemeral Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 42 (**12d6**) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the necrolisk (the necrolisk can only have one creature swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The necrolisk swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the necrolisk, and takes 21 (**6d6**) Force damage at the start of each of the necrolisk's turns.

If the necrolisk takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the necrolisk must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the necrolisk and has the Prone condition. If the necrolisk dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

fluffInfo.value: *This ill-tempered, six-horned creature resembles a triceratops the size of an ox, with pairs of horns atop its nose and brows, as well as great tusks jutting from each side of its mouth.*

fluffInfo.name: Hatred of Elephants
fluffInfo.value: Ngobous are ox-sized dinosaurs often at war with elephants over territory. Ngobous are irascible and suspicious by nature, prone to chasing after any creature that stays too long inside its territory. They also become aggressive when they can see or smell elephants. Even old traces of elephant scent are sufficient to trigger an ngobou's rage.

fluffInfo.name: Poor Beasts of War
fluffInfo.value: Grasslands tribes sometimes try to train ngobous as beasts of burden or war, but most have given up on the ill-tempered animals. Most believe the ngobou's behavior is too erratic, especially if elephants are nearby or have been in the area recently.

fluffInfo.name: Trample Crops
fluffInfo.value: Stampeding ngobou herds can smash fields of crops flat in minutes, and their horns can tear through a herd of goats or cattle in little time.

traits.name: Elephants' Bane
traits.value: The ngobou has advantage on attack rolls against elephants. It can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any elephant or elephant material no older than 48 hours within 120 feet of it.

traits.name: Jagged Hide
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the ngobou deals 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the ngobou can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. If the ngobou detects an elephant within 120 feet of it, this trait is always active, and the ngobou can't choose to end it until it starts its turn more than 120 feet from an elephant.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.value: If the ngobou moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ngobou can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *These ancient creatures resemble nothing so much as black cats dressed in sumptuous, archaic, clothing.*

*Known as dolia ("fate speakers") in Old Elvish, elven legend says the nichny welcomed the first elves to Midgard. They also gifted the first Emperor of the Elves with three prophecies: humans would cause a great schism and estrangement among the elves, forcing them to flee Midgard; an elfmarked child would be the doom of all elvenkind; and a third prophecy so horrific that the elves erased it with powerful magic.*

fluffInfo.name: Xenophobic
fluffInfo.value: The nichny are highly xenophobic and gleefully carnivorous fey who dwell in deep, primeval forests.

fluffInfo.name: True and False Prophets
fluffInfo.value: Nichny have oracular powers, but they rarely share their prophecies with outsiders. Their prophecies are always delivered in triples, and legend holds that two inevitably prove true and one proves false.

fluffInfo.name: Answer Three Questions
fluffInfo.value: One final legend claims that if a nichny can be bound with gold or orichalcum chains, it must answer three questions. As with their prophecies, two answers will be true and one will be a lie. All three questions must be posed before any will be answered. When the third answer is given, the nichny and the chains disappear.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Aura of Luck
traits.value: The nichny is surrounded by an aura that manipulates the luck of those near the nichny. Each friendly creature, other than the nichny, within 10 feet of the Nichny nichny has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Each hostile creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the nichny must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The nichny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soothsaying (1/Day)
traits.value: The nichny can spend 1 minute conversing with a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. During this time, the creature can ask up to three questions about the past, present, or future. At the end of the minute, the nichny then offers two truthful answers and one false answer, each in the form of a paradox, riddle, or cryptic rhyme.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nichny makes two Claw or Luck-Stealing Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Luck-Stealing Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) force damage, and the target has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Create Lucky Stone
actions.value: The nichny magically imbues a small stone with good luck. A creature, other than the nichny, wearing or carrying the stone has a +1 bonus to saving throws. The nichny can have no more than three such stones actively imbued at a time. If it imbues a fourth, the effect on the oldest imbued stone ends. The nichny can end the magic on any of the stones at any time (no action required).

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The nichny magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Dendallen makes four attacks, using Staff or Chilling Ray in any combination. He can (A) replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast __Magic Missile__ or (B) replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast __Blight__ (level 5 version).

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) Force damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Chilling Ray
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**4d8**) Cold damage.

traits.name: Ancient Imprisonment
traits.value: Rage and terror at Nidhogg's imprisonment by Wotan reverberates down the generations within his brood. When rolling saves against effects that cause the Restrained or Grappled condition, as well as any that would entrap it, the Nidhogg spawn drake has Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The drake makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the drake's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Venom Spit (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**4d6 + 2**) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Earth Wyrm
bonusActions.value: The drake burrows 20 feet.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Night Blade, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Undead Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Ghostly Blade
fluffInfo.value: You know its Spectral Weapons attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Shadowy Retreat
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Meld Into Shadow and Spectral Dodge features.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Night Blade sticks to the shadows and darkness, attempting to surprise their foes and gain Advantage as often as possible. They attack their foes using their spectral weapons, using the Mindmuddler option against spellcasters. If the target is still alive by the 2nd round, the Night Blade takes the Disengage action to escape.
The Night Blade flees if it is at a Disadvantage, is surrounded, or is in direct sunlight.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.value: The vampire has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the *Bloodied* or Bleeding condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Spectral Weapons
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice (the vampire can't select the same option more than once per turn):

entries: **Poison**: The target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition (save ends, *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16).
**Open Wounds**: The target has the Bleeding condition (3d6).
**Mindmuddler**: The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends, *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Meld Into Shadow
bonusActions.value: In Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire casts __Invisibility__ on itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

fluffInfo.value: *Bestial Blood Hunter*

fluffInfo.name: Secrets
fluffInfo.value: Night creatures are quickly undone by the purity of salt if wiped on a weapon and driven into a wound.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, poisoned; charmed (except from its creator)

traits.name: Blood Stalker
traits.value: The night creature has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to find or track a creature that is missing any Hit Points.

traits.name: Salt Susceptibility
traits.value: The night creature has Vulnerability to damage from weapons wiped with salt. A creature can take a Bonus Action to wipe salt onto a weapon, which remains coated for 1 minute, or until it hits a creature.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The night creature can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.value: The night creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The night creature makes one Claw attack and uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the night creature regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: If the night creature isn't in sunlight, it shape-shifts into a Medium Humanoid or returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries: **Skills**: deception +10, insight +6, perception +6, stealth +7 (+17 with pass without trace)
**Resistances**: fire, necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The hag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Dream Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dream Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage. If a target is hit by this attack more than once on a turn, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), until the target takes damage, or until another creature who can reach the target uses their action to wake them. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeed on this saving throw.

actions.name: Vicious Visions (1/Day; 6th-Level Spell)
actions.value: The hag releases magic dream dust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute or until they deal damage to another creature. While charmed, the creature sees all allies as enemies and all enemies as allies.

actions.name: Tiny Time
actions.value: The hag magically shrinks down to a height of 1 inch, becoming Tiny along with any items they wear or carry. While Tiny, the hag has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide, and they can use a bonus action to enter the head of an unconscious Humanoid they can reach or to grow back to the hag's normal size. The hag's game statistics otherwise remain the same.

While the hag is inside a Humanoid's head, that Humanoid is considered haunted by the hag, and the hag has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the head. The hag can speak telepathically to the haunted Humanoid, but the Humanoid is unaware of the source of this telepathic speech. The haunted Humanoid can't gain any benefit from rest unless the hag allows it, and when the Humanoid attempts to sleep, the hag can fill the Humanoid's mind with nightmarish visions.

The hag is expelled from the head and grows back to their normal size if the haunted Humanoid is affected by a __dispel evil and good__ spell or similar supernatural effects, or if the hag chooses to exit the head as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Sleepwalk
bonusActions.value: The hag moves one unconscious creature they can see within 60 feet of them up to 30 feet horizontally.

entries: **Skills**: deception +10, insight +6, perception +6, stealth +7 (+17 with pass without trace)
**Resistances**: fire, necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.value: The hag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Dream Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dream Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage. If a target is hit by this attack more than once on a turn, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), until the target takes damage, or until another creature who can reach the target uses their action to wake them. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeed on this saving throw.

actions.value: The hag releases magic dream dust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute or until they deal damage to another creature. While charmed, the creature sees all allies as enemies and all enemies as allies.

actions.name: Tiny Time
actions.value: The hag magically shrinks down to a height of 1 inch, becoming Tiny along with any items they wear or carry. While Tiny, the hag has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide, and they can use a bonus action to enter the head of an unconscious Humanoid they can reach or to grow back to the hag's normal size. The hag's game statistics otherwise remain the same.

While the hag is inside a Humanoid's head, that Humanoid is considered haunted by the hag, and the hag has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the head. The hag can speak telepathically to the haunted Humanoid, but the Humanoid is unaware of the source of this telepathic speech. The haunted Humanoid can't gain any benefit from rest unless the hag allows it, and when the Humanoid attempts to sleep, the hag can fill the Humanoid's mind with nightmarish visions.

The hag is expelled from the head and grows back to their normal size if the haunted Humanoid is affected by a __dispel evil and good__ spell or similar supernatural effects, or if the hag chooses to exit the head as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Sleepwalk
bonusActions.value: The hag moves one unconscious creature they can see within 60 feet of them up to 30 feet horizontally.

fluffInfo.value: *These midnight-black scorpions have a bright-red stripe on their tails, signaling the crippling poison within.*

fluffInfo.name: Blinding Poison
fluffInfo.value: This aptly named arachnid hunter blinds victims with a dose of its crippling poison. It feeds on whole camels when given the chance, but it more commonly devours goats, sheep, and people. It hunts by night, when its senses are most effective.

fluffInfo.name: Underdark Giants
fluffInfo.value: The species is common in deep caves and underworld realms. They are eight feet long with a seven-foot tail and daggerlike stinger. They weigh up to 200 pounds.

fluffInfo.name: Valuable Venom
fluffInfo.value: Night scorpion venom is highly prized and can command upwards of 400 gp per dose.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 (**2d6**) poison damage and is blinded for 1 hour. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also poisoned for 1 minute, and it is paralyzed while poisoned in this way. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *This red-furred lupine creature has a too-wide mouth and blood-soaked claws.*
Created in a ritual performed over a pregnant worg, nightgarms are always born female and are followers of the Great Wolf.

*The corpse of any Humanoid can become a falseheart if eaten whole by a nightgarm. When a Humanoid becomes a falseheart, it retains its statistics, except as described below.*
***Type**: The Humanoid's type changes to Monstrosity*
***Alignment**: The falseheart's alignment changes to chaotic evil.*
***New Trait: Convincing Copy**: A creature very familiar with the Humanoid the falseheart replaced can tell the falseheart is an imitation with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.*
***New Trait: Keen Smell**: The falseheart has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.*
***New Trait: Mother's Love**: The falseheart is magically bound to the nightgarm that birthed it, following the nightgarm's telepathic commands.*

fluffInfo.name: Wide-Jawed Lupines
fluffInfo.value: Nightgarms resemble red-furred worgs with wide mouths, half-formed fingers, and comfort with bipedal and quadrupedal movement. They can hold items in their front paws, and their jaws can open to swallow especially large creatures.

fluffInfo.name: Mother of Falsehearts
fluffInfo.value: If a nightgarm eats a humanoid corpse whole, it gives birth nine hours later to a duplicate of the victim, known as a falseheart (see the Falseheart Template sidebar). Falsehearts are loyal to the nightgarm that birthed them and retain enough of the victim's memories and capabilities to integrate into society as the victim.

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.value: The nightgarm ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a falseheart it has birthed. The nightgarm and its falseheart don't need to be on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nightgarm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the nightgarm, and it takes 10 (**3d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the nightgarm's turns. The nightgarm can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the nightgarm takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the nightgarm must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the nightgarm. If the nightgarm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by her and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lupine Howl (1/Day)
actions.value: The nightgarm magically calls 2d4 wolves or 2 dire wolves. The wolves arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the nightgarm and obeying her telepathic commands. The wolves remain for 1 hour, until the nightgarm dies, or until the nightgarm dismisses them as a bonus action.

fluffInfo.value: *Eons ago, a group of aboleth left the Material Plane to wander through distant planes—seeing them through magical scrying was not enough, so these aboleth used astral magic and bodily travel to see far beyond normal realms*.

fluffInfo.name: A Forgotten Tribe
fluffInfo.value: As ages passed, memories of those who departed slowly faded from the minds of those aboleth who remained behind. Those few aboleth who did remember that long ago some of their kin had gone plane-wandering assumed that the wanderers died in distant hells or paradises.

fluffInfo.name: Changed by Planar Wandering
fluffInfo.value: The plane-wanderers hadn't died. Instead, their eons-long exposure to alien realms and the space between changed them, restructuring their life force, making them into something even more nightmarish—but better able to withstand both strange hells and golden realms of eldritch delight. They returned even more corrupt and powerful than when left, and these wandering nihileths returned to the mortal world intent on spreading the influence of the Void and the utter evil they found in the vast darkness between worlds.

fluffInfo.name: Undead Servitors
fluffInfo.value: Humanoids, giants, and monstrosities that succumb to the nihileth's disease transform into servitors for the twisted aboleths. Most humanoids transform into nihilethic zombies, while the larger giants and monstrosities transform into nihilethic dominators. While the creatures retain much of the general shape they had in life, these servitors have translucent and slimy skin, and are adept swimmers, able to function in water or on land in service to their nihileth masters.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 10 Ft., *swim* 40 Ft., *fly* 40 Ft. (hover) In Void Ghost Form, *canHover* (hover)
**Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Ghostly Body (Void Ghost Form Only)
traits.value: The nihileth has resistance to acid, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, it has immunity to the prone condition, and it has immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, the nihileth can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Infecting Telepathy
traits.value: If a creature communicates telepathically with the nihileth, or deals psychic damage to it, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become infected with the nihilethic rot disease.

traits.name: Nihilethic Rot
traits.value: This disease takes 1 minute to manifest in an infected creature, during which time the disease can be removed with the __lesser restoration__ spell. After 1 minute, the creature's flesh becomes slimy and translucent, and the disease can be cured only by the __heal__ spell or similar magic. Until this disease is cured, the creature can't regain hp unless it is submerged in water, and it can breathe air and water. The creature must be submerged in water at least once every 2 hours to avoid suffocating, and if it is outside a body of water, it takes 7 (**2d6**) acid damage every 10 minutes, unless moisture is applied to its skin before 10 minutes have passed. If a Humanoid dies while infected with this disease, it rises 1 minute later as a nihilethic zombie under the nihileth's control. If a Large giant or monstrosity dies while infected with this disease, it rises 1 minute later as a nihilethic dominator under the nihileth's control.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.value: If damage reduces the nihileth to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the nihileth drops to 1 hp instead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The nihileth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Void Aura
traits.value: The nihileth is surrounded by a chilling cloud. A creature that isn't a construct or undead and that starts its turn within 5 feet of the nihileth must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its speed is halved until the start of its next turn. In addition, a creature infected with nihilethic rot takes 7 (**2d6**) cold damage when it starts its turn within this aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nihileth makes two Tentacle attacks and one Tail attack, or it makes three Withering Touch attacks.

actions.name: Tail (Undead Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tentacle (Undead Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract the nihilethic rot disease (see the Nihilethic Rot trait).

actions.name: Withering Touch (Void Ghost Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Void Shape
bonusActions.value: The nihileth magically transforms into a dark purple, Void ghost form or back into its Undead form. Its statistics, other than its speed, resistances, and immunities, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying changes with it. It reverts to its Undead form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nihilethic dominator makes three Claw attacks, or it makes two Tendril of the Void attacks.

actions.name: Claw (Undead Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tendril of the Void (Void Ghost Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) cold damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Slam (Undead Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Withering Touch (Void Ghost Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d6 + 1**) necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.value: *With a thick mane of beaded locks, this leonine humanoid grins with a mouthful of pointed teeth.*

fluffInfo.name: Beads and Braids
fluffInfo.value: The nkosi resemble bestial humans with cat's eyes, slender tails, and the fangs and fur of a lion. Most grow their hair long, braiding colorful beads into their locks to mark important events in their lives. Although the nkosi's true form is that of a feline humanoid with leonine features, the most striking feature of the nkosi is their ability to change their shape, taking the form of a lion.

fluffInfo.name: Pridelords
fluffInfo.value: Nkosi pridelords are exceptionally tall and muscular leaders. They keep impressive manes, but they are known for their roar, which wakes the feral heart inside all nkosi.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The nkosi has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.value: If the nkosi moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Mambele attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the nkosi can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mambele (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The nkosi transforms into a Large lion or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
