traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the pridelord hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The pridelord has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.value: If the pridelord moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Mambele attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the pridelord can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The pridelord makes three Bite or Mambele attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Pridelord's Roar, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mambele (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage or 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage if used to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Pridelord's Roar (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: Each nkosi of the pridelord's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the pridelord's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.value: The pridelord transforms into a Large lion or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

fluffInfo.value: *A grinning man brandishes a staff surmounted by a rune-covered skull. Blasphemous sigils adorn his clothes, and ashes stain his skin a sickly gray.*

Noctiny are humanoids corrupted by fell power. Their skin is sallow and gaunt even before they smear it with ash, bone dust, and worse materials to wash all living color from their bodies. The noctiny embrace all manner of blasphemous and taboo behaviors to please their masters.

fluffInfo.name: Pyramid of Power
fluffInfo.value: The noctiny's lust for power drives them away from decency and reason. They are initiates who form the lowest rung of fext society. They swear themselves into service to the undead fext as thugs, servants, acolytes, and cannon fodder, and in exchange draw a trickle of power for themselves.

fluffInfo.name: A Race Apart
fluffInfo.value: Though they arise from any humanoid stock, the noctiny are corrupted by the powers they serve, changing them. Noctiny retain the cosmetic traits that identify their original race if one looks hard enough, but any connection they once had to their fellows is overpowered by their transformation into noctiny.

traits.name: Eldritch Weapons
traits.value: The noctiny's weapon attacks are magical. When the noctiny hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **1d6** force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The noctiny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The noctiny makes two Quarterstaff or Eldritch Fury attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage if used in two hands, plus 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) force damage.

traits.name: Arctic Tracker
traits.value: The Northern hunter has Advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to track creatures in forest, cold grassland, and glacial terrain. In addition, Difficult Terrain composed primarily of snow or ice doesn't cost the Northern hunter extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Northern hunter makes four attacks, using Longbow or Spear in any combination. The hunter can choose to deal Force damage instead of the weapon's normal damage type.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Poison damage. The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the hunter's next turn. Multiple reductions are not cumulative.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Slashing damage. The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the Northern Hunter's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Slayer (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: The next attack the Northern hunter makes ignores all Resistances and Immunities to damage.

bonusActions.name: Swift Hunter
bonusActions.value: The Northern hunter moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see.

traits.name: Central Nervous System
traits.value: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sensitive Gut
traits.value: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Warded
traits.value: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**4d4 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squirt
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**4d4 + 7**) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.

actions.name: Tree Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Trash Lob
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Anchoring Mask
traits.value: The nurse has a porcelain mask (AC 15; HP 15; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). If the nurse starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nurse makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

actions.name: Stab
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Inject (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, a creature the nurse hit with a Stab attack this turn. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The Poisoned target also has the Unconscious condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Mutation
actions.value: The nurse has one of the following mutation action options:

entries: **Cerebral Graft**: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to the nurse's own. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

**Tentacle Lash**: A tentacle writhes beneath the nurse's skin or clothes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Catalyst (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The nurse injects itself with a stimulant. Until the start of the nurse's next turn, its Speed is doubled, it can make one extra Stab attack when it takes the Multiattack action, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC.

traits.name: Defeat from Victory
traits.value: When Nyarlathotep drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, he is not slain. Instead, his body ripples with energy as it undergoes a horrific transformation. He returns to whatever strange realm he dwells in as his defeated form is torn apart by unseen forces. Mythos creatures with a combined CR of up to 20 emerge from the pile of gore, occupying the nearest, empty space. These creatures attack those who were hostile to Nyarlathotep and fight to the death.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.value: If Nyarlathotep fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Nyarlathotep has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poisoned Words, Rotten Soul
traits.value: A creature that succeeds in a Wisdom (*Insight*) check to detect one of Nyarlathotep's lies takes 66 (**12d10**) Psychic damage and cannot communicate with other creatures for 3d6 minutes. A creature killed by this trait appears to have died of a heart attack or similar cause.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Nyarlathotep makes two Rending Claw attacks and two Piercing Talon attacks.

actions.name: Rending Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, Reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 8**) Slashing damage and the target gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Piercing Talon
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, Reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**1d10 + 8**) Piercing damage. Prone creatures have Vulnerability to this attack's damage.

actions.name: Horrid Tongue Lash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 24, creatures of Nyarlathotep's choice within 20 ft. of it; *Failure:* The target takes 66 (**12d10**) acid damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.value: Nyarlathotep shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to this form. Other than his size, his game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The nymph can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blinding Beauty
traits.value: When a creature that can see the nymph starts its turn within 30 feet of the nymph, the nymph can force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw if the nymph isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is permanently blinded. Otherwise, a creature that fails its save is blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nymph until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the nymph in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Water Spirit
traits.value: While the nymph is in contact with or submerged in a body of water, she ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. She can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nymph uses Nymph's Gaze. She then makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Nymph's Gaze
actions.value: The nymph directs her gaze at one creature she can see within 30 feet of her, targeting the creature with one of the following effects:

entries: **Concerned Look**: The target regains 10 (3d6) hit points. Once a creature has regained 20 hit points from this stare, it can't regain more hit points from this nymph's Concerned Gaze until it finishes a long rest.
**Glare of Nature's Fury**: The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Stunning Stare**: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become stunned until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Stunning Stare of all nymphs for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study an Oak Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Bite and Gnarled Claw actions.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: With their thick shroud of leaves, Oak Trolls are well protected from their enemies. They always look for an opportunity to send their leaves bursting off to Blind their enemies.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Giant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Sap.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts, Flesh. Bones: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Bark.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Forest Sense
traits.value: The troll can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects within 120 feet of it as long as both it and the anything it is detecting is in a natural forested area.

traits.name: Shroud of Leaves
traits.value: The troll is covered head to toe in a shroud of thick leaves. While it has this shroud it is immune to all damage except Fire damage. If the troll takes any Fire damage, the leaves all burn away revealing the gnarled oak wood body of the troll and it loses this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes two Gnarled Claw attacks and one Bite attack

actions.name: Gnarled Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Piercing damage and if the target is a creature, the target has the Bleeding condition (2d8) as thick splinters pierce and remain in the creature's flesh.

bonusActions.name: Abundant Growth
bonusActions.value: The troll regains its Shroud of Leaves trait.

bonusActions.name: Leaf Burst
bonusActions.value: As long as the troll has its Shroud of Leaves, it can shed its Shroud of Leaves in a burst, losing the trait in the process. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature within 15 feet of the troll. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Slashing damage and has the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance (Treant)
traits.value: While Oakheart remains motionless, he appears as a great oak with charred bark that smolders in places and flames in place of leaves.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The Oakheart deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Oakheart makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 5**) fire damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**4d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.value: Oakheart magically animates one or two trees he can see within 60 feet of him. These trees have the same statistics as Oakheart, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of Oakheart. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until Oakheart dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until Oakheart takes a bonus action to turn him back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.value: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion brute can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the oblivion brute has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 16 (**3d8 + 3**) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls unconscious. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion brute kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

actions.name: Unbearable Howl (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The oblivion brute emits a howl in a 30-foot cone. Each creature that isn't deafened or undead in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened this way, a creature's speed is halved. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to any oblivion brute's Unbearable Howl for the next 24 hours.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.value: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion juggernaut can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the oblivion juggernaut has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The oblivion juggernaut uses unbearable roar and then uses soul drain.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 26 (**4d10 + 4**) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 2. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls unconscious. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion juggernaut kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

actions.name: Unbearable Roar
actions.value: Each creature of the oblivion juggernaut's choice that isn't deafened and is within 120 feet of the juggernaut must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any oblivion juggernaut's Unbearable Roar for 24 hours.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Shadow Leap
traits.value: Starting in an area of dim light or darkness, an oblivion leaper can teleport to an unoccupied space also in dim light or darkness. Every foot of teleportation costs the oblivion leaper 1 foot of movement.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.value: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion leaper can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the oblivion leaper has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 3**) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls unconscious. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion leaper kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.value: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion whistler can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the oblivion whistler has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

traits.name: Unbearable Whistling
traits.value: Creatures of the oblivion whistler's choice that aren't deafened and start their turn within 30 feet of the oblivion whistler must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. A target that fails is frightened until the start of its next turn and unable to hide the distress of hearing the whistling, which is the source of the fear and considered to be within line of sight while the target can hear and is within 30 feet of it. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to any oblivion whistler's Unbearable Whistling for 1 hour.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls unconscious. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion whistler kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

traits.name: Eldritch Heads (6/Day)
traits.value: When Elson hits a creature with an attack, he can cause the target to take an extra 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, Elson can regain 11 (2d10) hit points. While Elson has at least one use of this trait remaining, he can't be *surprised* and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against him.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 120 ft., up to four targets. *Hit:* 22 (**5d8**) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or become stunned until the end of Elson's next turn.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to three resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 9 (**2d8**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 18 (**4d8**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d8):
1. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) force damage.
2. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) cold damage.
6. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) fire damage.
7. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 4 (**1d8**)thunder damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Octarine Tree Fly, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resilient Sapling.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Octarine Tree's type, its Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Flying Fruit.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Delerium Fruit action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Combustible Timber.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's vulnerability to fire.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Octarine Tree grows in clusters within Queen's Park Garden, or in the forests north of Drakkenheim, but lone trees have been spotted in advantageous positions throughout the city. Whether in market squares or growing on cliff sides overlooking parts of the city, the trees seem to keep watch over large stretches of road. The Octarine Tree is surprisingly fast when it decides to move but usually opts to root itself in a good position and throw Delerium Fruit at its enemies.

When engaged in melee, an Octarine Tree tangles up creatures in its Crushing Roots and Thwacks them. It will take an opportunity to lumber to a better position and plant itself in the ground to continue hurling fruit if it can.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Plant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Sap.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Flowers.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Bark.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Plant Dust.

traits.name: Enraged
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the octarine tree gains Advantage on all attack rolls.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.value: The octarine tree has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to Hide in forests.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The octarine tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The octarine tree makes three attacks.

actions.name: Thwack
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**2d12 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Crushing Roots
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

actions.name: Delerium Fruit
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) centered on itself.

bonusActions.name: Take Root
bonusActions.value: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 (4d8) Hit Points and has the Immobilized condition until the start of its next turn. While Immobilized, the octarine tree has Immunity to the Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This collection of hundreds of eyes floats along, trailing ganglia and dripping caustic fluid that sizzles when it hits the ground.*

*Bemmean wizards have been known to employ oculo swarms as lie detectors during negotiations. An oculo instinctively reads eye movements, and it can communicate what it sees to the wizard by moving in a specific way or by changing the color of its irises. If negotiations go poorly, the mage gives the swarm permission to add a fresh pair of eyes to its number.*

fluffInfo.name: Failed Experiment
fluffInfo.value: Oculo swarms came about from failed experiments to create living scrying sensors. Once set loose, these horrors attain a form of distributed self-awareness. Exactly what motivates them is unknown, except that they are driven to survive.

fluffInfo.name: Flesh Stealers
fluffInfo.value: A weakened oculo swarm can reinvigorate itself by tearing fresh eyes from almost any type of living creature. If a badly depleted oculo swarm escapes from battle, it attacks lone creatures or weak groups until the mass of gore-spattered eyeballs is replenished. The more dismembered eyeballs the swarm contains, the more powerful it becomes.

fluffInfo.name: Single Eye Scouts
fluffInfo.value: The entire swarm sees what any single member sees. Before attacking or even entering a potentially dangerous area, individual eyes scout ahead for prospective victims or dangerous foes. Though harmless and easily destroyed, these lone eyes provide plenty of information to the oculo swarm before perishing.

traits.name: Hundreds of Eyes
traits.value: The oculo swarm has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being blinded. In addition, if the swarm isn't blinded, creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the swarm, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny eyeball. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The oculo swarm makes two Extract Eye attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or the swarm removes one of its eyes. While missing half or fewer of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is blinded until its sight is restored. If the target's eye is recovered from the defeated swarm, it can be reattached with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check, provided the eye is reattached within 1 hour of the target losing the eye.

actions.name: Extract Eye
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 18 (**4d8**) piercing damage, or 9 (**2d8**) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

actions.name: Disorienting Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The swarm's many eyes suddenly turn in different directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the oculo swarm must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage and is disoriented until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't disoriented. A disoriented creature is incapacitated and moves in a random direction when it moves.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Cold damage. *Success* Half damage.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, any two other languages, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Odwald can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Odwald lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Odwald cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Odwald has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Convincing
traits.value: Odwald has advantage on all Charisma checks used to convince someone of his knowledge of subject matter pertaining to the Arcana skill.

traits.name: Life Leech
traits.value: Once per turn, when Odwald kills one or more creatures with a spell of 1st level or higher, he can regain hit points equal to twice the level of the spell, or three times the level if it is a necromancy spell.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d6 - 1**) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (**1d8 - 1**) bludgeoning damage if wielded with both hands.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Empowered Undead
traits.value: Any undead that is under Ogden's control has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead. In addition, it gains a +5 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and its hit point maximum increases by 20.

traits.name: Leech (5/Day)
traits.value: When Ogden hits a creature with his quarterstaff that isn't a construct or undead, he can choose to deal an extra 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the number rolled.

actions.name: Leeching Quarterstaff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonusActions.name: Grave Sacrifice
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, Ogden can cause one undead under his control to drop to 0 hit points. When he does so, he gains 14 (4d6) temporary hit points.

traits.name: Defiant Anger
traits.value: When the ogre has half their hit points or fewer, they are resistant to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ogre makes one Spiked Club attack and one Fist attack.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the ogre can't use this fist to attack other targets. The ogre has two fists, one of which holds their club.

actions.name: People-Bowling
actions.value: The ogre throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling up to 30 feet horizontally. Each creature in the thrown creature's path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After this throw, the thrown creature takes 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Bellow (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The ogre yells in the face of one creature within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the ogre until the end of the ogre's next turn. A creature who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to all ogres' Bellow for 24 hours.

entries: **HP**: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, perception +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Spiked Club)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **2d4 plus PB** piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the basher can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Angry Denial (3/Day)
actions.value: When the basher takes damage from a creature the basher can see within 5 feet of them, the basher can use their reaction to instead take no damage and make a signature attack against the creature.

actions.name: 5th Level: Throw Away (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the basher grabs a willing Medium or smaller creature they can see within 5 feet of them and hurls the creature to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the basher. If the creature lands within 5 feet of an enemy, the creature can use a reaction to make a melee attack against that enemy.

actions.name: 7th Level: Wide Sweep (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the basher sweeps their spiked club in an enormous circle, making a signature attack against each enemy within 10 feet of them. This attack has a +PB bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and if it hits a Large or smaller creature, the basher can push the target up to 10 feet away from them.

fluffInfo.value: *Spikes adorn the green skin of this large ogre, and it brandishes a nail-studded club.*

Twisted by wild magic, fiendish power, or arcane disease, the corrupted chieftain has turned its mutation into an advantage. The corruption within makes this chieftain stronger and more savage than the ogres it bullies and commands.

fluffInfo.name: Changed Form
fluffInfo.value: The power that changed the corrupted chieftain's body caused its skin to toughen and produce dozens of bony spikes. It also caused the chieftain to become stronger, hardier, and more imposing than its ogre kin, solidifying its position as a clan's chieftain.

fluffInfo.name: Powerful Leader
fluffInfo.value: Though the corrupted chieftain remains as tactical as it was before coming into contact with the force that changed it, the power coursing through its veins gives it uncanny sway over other ogres. The chieftain can belt out orders without receiving grumbles and can even imbue a measure of its power into its underlings.

traits.name: Magic-Infused Weapons
traits.value: The power coursing through the corrupted chieftain's veins flows into its weapons. The chieftain's weapon attacks are magical. When the chieftain hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d8** force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Spiked Hide
traits.value: A creature that touches the ogre or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**2d4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The corrupted ogre can use its Chieftain's Command or Chieftain's Might. It then makes two Greatclub or Javelin attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Chieftain's Command
actions.value: The corrupted chieftain barks an order to one Giant it can see within 30 feet of it, sharing a measure of its power with the target. The target has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the chieftain's next turn. In addition, the next attack roll against the target before the start of the chieftain's next turn has disadvantage.

actions.name: Chieftain's Might
actions.value: The corrupted chieftain causes its eyes to glow, its muscles to swell, and the ground beneath its feet to rumble. Each creature within 15 feet of the chieftain must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.value: The corrupted chieftain moves up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the goon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the goon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Fist (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 bludgeoning damage, and if this attack was made by more than one goon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and moved up to 10 feet horizontally. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of goons who joined the attack.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d12 + 3**) Slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Devout Follower of Old Gods*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Old Ways chosen bind their power into a mask they use as a focus. Without the mask, their magic unravels.

traits.name: Animal Mask
traits.value: The chosen wears the mask of an animal, imbuing it with the strength of the old gods. When a creature is grappling the chosen, the creature can remove the mask as an action, or as an attack during the Attack action, with a successful DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) check. Without its mask, the chosen can't cast spells, its *Concentration* on any existing spells ends, and the save DC of Song of the Old Ways is reduced by 4.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chosen makes three Ritual Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Ritual Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Radiant or Necrotic damage (the chosen's choice).

actions.name: Songs of the Old Ways (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The chosen sings one of the following songs:

actions.name: Blessing of the Harvest
actions.value: Each creature of the chosen's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the chosen regains 14 (4d4 + 4) Hit Points.

actions.name: Song of Sacrifice
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the chosen's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wicker Chant
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature of the chosen's choice in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the chosen. *Failure:* 31 (**9d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Jump (Requires Animal Mask)
bonusActions.value: The chosen casts __Jump__, using the same spell components and spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries: **Languages**: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The olothec can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The olothec is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The olothec has advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The olothec makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or __lesser restoration__ spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: The olothec targets a Humanoid they can see within 60 feet of them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the olothec's choice:

entries: **Head.** The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
**Legs.** The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

**Torso.** The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

actions.value: This transformation lasts until the target is affected by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or a __greater restoration__ spell. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a __wish__ spell or similar magic.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.value: The olothec teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

fluffInfo.value: *Oma Rattenfanger resembles a small, plump, motherly elf with a kind smile and cold, wicked eyes. She wears a well-made, clean but slightly worn dress with a large skirt and a matching bonnet-style cap*.

Oma's slightly iridescent wings give away that she was once a pixie, though her time in the Shadow Realm has significantly changed her. The fey has a fondness for young lost souls who make their way to the Shadow Realm, and she eagerly takes them under her wing.

fluffInfo.name: Tenebrous Plain
fluffInfo.value: Oma Rattenfanger staked her claim in the Tenebrous Plain a great time ago. Since then, the plain has grown and shifted under her care, giving her orphans a home where they can thrive. With the addition of other creatures over the centuries, Oma's power in the Tenebrous Plain has only grown. Her home is a small, thatched hut that can appear wherever she wants on the plain.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Oma fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Shadowy Weapons
traits.value: Oma's weapon attacks are magical. When Oma hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Oma makes two Mentor's Cane attacks or one Mentor's Cane attack and one Scold attack.

actions.name: Mentor's Cane
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Scold
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Call Children (1/Day)
actions.value: Oma magically calls 2d4 skeletons or zombies or one orphan of the black (see Tome of Beasts 2 or substitute with will-o'-wisp). The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Oma and obeying her spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour or until Oma dies or dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: Oma turns invisible until she attacks or uses Call Children or until her *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.

bonusActions.name: Keeper of the Children
bonusActions.value: Oma instructs one allied skeletons, zombies, or orphan of the black (see Tome of Beasts 2 or substitute with will-o'-wisp) within 30 feet of her to make one attack as a reaction against a creature Oma attacked this round.

fluffInfo.value: *The oasis appears as an idyllic desert respite, offering water, shade, and even edible fruit and nuts in the trees above.*

fluffInfo.name: Mockmire
fluffInfo.value: The oozasis, or oasis ooze, is also known as a mockmire in other climates. It mimics a peaceful, pristine watering hole to draw in unsuspecting prey. An oozasis cycles seemingly at random between activity and dormancy.

fluffInfo.name: Quest Givers
fluffInfo.value: Within its odd physiology stirs an ancient mind with an inscrutable purpose. Far from being a mindless sludge, its fractured intelligence occasionally reads the thoughts of visitors. At these times, it tries to coerce them into undertaking quests for cryptic reasons.

fluffInfo.name: Ancient Minds
fluffInfo.value: Some tales claim these creatures preserve the memories of mad wizards from dead empires, or that they have unimaginably ancient, inhuman origins.

entries: **Resistances**: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
**Languages**: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Oasis Appearance
traits.value: While the oozasis remains motionless and partially submerged on the surface of sand or soil, it is indistinguishable from a small oasis or pond. The oozasis's body provides enough water for plants to grow around it, provided the oozasis remains in the area for an extended period of time. A creature that eats a fruit from a plant growing in the oozasis's water is affected by the Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait as if it drank the water.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.value: The oozasis doesn't require sleep.

traits.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
traits.value: A creature that drinks the water of an oozasis experiences a cryptic dream the next time it sleeps. When it wakes, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the __geas__ spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must perform a specific, seemingly minor task that furthers the decades-long goals of the oozasis. Such a task could be planting a white rose in a specific garden, rescuing the next endangered young animal the target encounters, or standing in a specific spot at a certain time each day for three days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The oozasis makes three Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The oozasis can have up to two creatures grappled at a time.

actions.name: Compelling Vapors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The oozasis emits mind-altering vapors. Each creature within 20 feet of the oozasis must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (**10d8**) psychic damage and suffers either tranquility or turmoil for minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer tranquility or turmoil. A creature suffering tranquility is charmed and can't attack. A creature suffering turmoil is unable to distinguish friend from foe and must move to and attack the nearest creature other than the oozasis on each of its turns, stalking off in a random direction if no creature is in range. A creature suffering tranquility or turmoil can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The oozing vulture has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.value: The oozing vulture has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries: **Immunities**: lightning, poison, thunder; dazed, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Turbulent Escalation
traits.value: When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not incapacitated, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

entries: If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.

actions.name: Cyclone Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (**4d10**) thunder damage, and the oracle moves the target up to 10 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Tempest Bolt
actions.value: A bolt of lightning streaks from the oracle to strike one creature they can see within 90 feet of them, or within 300 feet of them if the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (**7d8**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Storms (2/Day)
bonusActions.value: The oracle imbues the power of storm in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Lightning Within.** The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 (**6d10**) lightning damage.

**Thunder Burst.** A concussive shock wave erupts from the Elemental toward four creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (**4d10**) thunder damage, be pushed up to 10 feet away from the Elemental, and be deafened until the end of the target's next turn.
**Immunities**: lightning, poison, thunder; dazed, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study an Oracle of the Rat God, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Divinely Resistant
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Oracle of the Rat God's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Fiendish Foresight
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the oracle's Death Toll and Squeak of Doom actions, as well as its Tail Barbs Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Aware and Commanding
fluffInfo.value: You know the Oracle of the Rat God's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: These revered figures are seldom encountered alone. Instead, they are often in the company of several Swarms of Ratlings and perhaps even borne aloft on a litter by a squadron of Giant Ratlings. They may even have several Warlocks of the Rat God serving them as underlings. These minions are disposable to the oracle, who commands their underlings to throw themselves against their foes with wild abandon.

In battle, a ratling oracle fights from the back, calling out proclamations of doom on their foes using Death Toll and Squeak of Doom. They mock their foes' attempts at any success, attempting to use Tail Barbs to turn an opponent's luck against them.

fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Death Toll
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the ratling can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Squeak of Doom (1/Day)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 16, each Hostile creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the ratling that can hear it. *Failure:* 55 (**10d10**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Ratling Cunning
bonusActions.value: The ratling takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The Orange Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Explosive
traits.value: If the Orange Slime takes fire damage, a portion of its body explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of the slime must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to the amount dealt to the slime on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Steaming
traits.value: If water touches the Orange Slime, a burning hot wave of steam erupts from it, filling the area within 20 feet of the slime. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the slime's next turn or until a strong wind disperses it. This steam doesn't impede the vision of Orange and __Yellow Slimes__.

traits.name: Sulfurous Haze
traits.value: Creatures within 60 feet of the slime take a -5 penalty to ranged attack rolls against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Orange Slime makes two Spike attacks and uses its Arrange.

actions.name: Spike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Arrange
actions.value: The Orange Slime attempts to pull a creature within 10 feet of it through its body and into another space. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 13 (**3d8**) fire damage and be moved to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the slime.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast __Fog Cloud__.

actions.name: Thunderous Mace
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**3d8 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Thundercloud
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 240 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d6 + 8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.value: A humanoid may bind themselves to the ordeal tree. Each day the petitioner is bound to the tree, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to 15 + number of days bound or suffer a level of exhaustion. If they survive for 7 days, the ordeal tree may choose to grant a blessing. The tree only does this if the humanoid is evil, once per humanoid. If the humanoid is neutral or good, the tree attacks them.

The blessing is tailored to the petitioner's desires (GM discretion) but might include +1 to an ability score, a feat, expertise in a skill, or the ability to innately cast a 3rd-level (or lower) spell once per day using Charisma as the petitioner's spellcasting ability.

fluffInfo.value: What if all the world was still, silent, and peaceful? What if everything was stone, perfect, and eternal? This is the promise of the Still Lord. Stone feels no pain. Stone doesn't fear the passage of time. Embrace Orlassk and you can be immortal and serene. With this in mind, Orlassk and its cults typically follow one of two themes. The first is the idea of flesh becoming stone, of bringing peace and silent perfection to the world. The second is that the stone is alive—that there are voices in the stone, whispering secrets and offering wonders. Cultists of Orlassk often begin as miners guided to rich veins of ore, sculptors who hear the stone telling them how to unlock beauty, or prisoners saved from solitude by the comforting voices in the rock walls. As for Orlassk itself, its motives can only be guessed at. Does it prefer breathing life into stone, as it did with the gargoyles? Does it wish to petrify all organic creatures? Or does it hold the key to a deeper mystery yet to be understood?

fluffInfo.name: Quick Stone
fluffInfo.value: Orlassk's creations straddle the line between organic and inorganic. One example of this is quickstone, a substance that can shift between malleable and rigid states. Treasures tied to Orlassk may use supernaturally hard stone in place of metal, or involve mineral intelligence. Orlassk creates Ioun Stones that sing to the characters attuned to them, and Barrier Tattoos that give skin the strength of stone. Orlassk is also a source of Figurines of Wondrous Power; while the figurines Orlassk creates can use the stat blocks assigned to the traditional figurines, they are usually carved in the shapes of creatures never seen in Eberron.

fluffInfo.name: Orlassk's Minions
fluffInfo.value: Orlassk turns flesh into stone and brings stone to life. Places where its influence is strong may be infested with cockatrices or gorgons. His cults often work with gargoyles, stone or clay golems, and earth elementals—though these creatures are all created by Orlassk's whims, and have no kinship with traditional golems or elementals. But Orlassk isn't limited to elementals; almost any creature can be carved from stone and given life. In the last days of Dhakaan, Orlassk petrified the dar population of Cazhaak Draal and then animated them, unleashing this stone army against their kin. Legends speak of purple worms made from stone burrowing through the foundations of Dhakaani citadels. A cult of Orlassk could be led by a sphinx made of stone. All of these creatures would be represented with the Stoneborn Template provided in this chapter. As for Orlassk's cultists, their flesh often shifts to stone, though this is usually hidden beneath their skin. Those that follow this path eventually become stoneborn, but along the way they become Stone Speakers or Stone Listeners. Others never fully transform. After a cult was exposed in Ardev and eliminated, its members were found to be purely flesh and blood—except for their brains, which had turned into marble.
