The Pixie can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). The Pixie can only grant this effect to one creature at a time, and when the effect ends, it must wait 1 minute before using it again.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Plague Carrier, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Multiple Disease Carrier
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Plague Carrier can carry Fatigue, Coughing Fits, and Shivers.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dangerously Infectious
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Bile Spreader action.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Plague Carrier is a vile creature whose sole purpose is to spread its infection. It runs into a crowds and use its Bile Spreader to infect as many targets as possible, resorting to biting any who get too close. It cares little for its own safety and does not retreat

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches, Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Plague Symptoms
traits.value: The plague carrier is host to a disease created by a pathogenist, chosen from the options below. A creature infected by this disease is subjected to the chosen effect at the start of each of its turns. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers the disease's effect. Third Success: The disease ends.

traits.name: Coughing Fits
traits.value: The target is unable to speak until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fatigue
traits.value: The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shivers
traits.value: The target shakes uncontrollably. Each time it fails its saving throw, it drops whatever it is holding.

actions.name: Festering Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms.

actions.name: Bile Spreader
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Languages**: all languages known before the curse

traits.name: Cloud of Blight
traits.value: A miasma surrounds the Plague Carrion in a 20-foot Emanation. Each time another creature starts its turn or enters the area, it gains a -1 penalty to damage rolls. Multiple instances of this penalty stack, but a creature can't gain it more than once each round. The penalty is removed when the creature finishes a Quick, Short, or Long Rest.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the Plague Carrion dies, it explodes in a cloud of sickening gas. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation centered on the Plague Carrion. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Poison damage, and the creature's Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down). *Success* Half damage only.
The Hit Point maximum reduction lasts until the creature finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Plague Carrion makes one Bite attack and one Plague Touch attack, or two Plague Beam attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d8 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Plague Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 49 (**10d8 + 4**) Poison damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down).

actions.name: Plague Beam
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d8 + 3**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the Plague Carrion's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Market Value
fluffInfo.value: Plainscows can be bought in Westruun for 200 gp. A plainscow has a carrying capacity of 1,500 pounds.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.value: If the plainscow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throws or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the plainscow can make another attack with its hooves as a bonus action.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The brilliant lasso tightened around the eldritch monster as the faceless winged creature dragged it across a hellish landscape.*

A planewatcher is sworn to protect the order of the boundaries between worlds. These angelic creatures fearlessly track down people and monsters who cross the boundaries of the planes and drag them back to where they came from, willingly or otherwise. Each planewatcher is bound to a single plane of existence.

fluffInfo.name: Friend or Foe
fluffInfo.value: Planewatchers are dedicated to their purpose, regardless of morality. Heroes may find themselves beseeching a planewatcher for help to battle an interplanar foe, or find themselves fighting one while on a planar mission. Planewatchers track down trespassers based on the perceived threat to the multiverse.

fluffInfo.name: Unlikely Allies
fluffInfo.value: Star drakes protect the Material Plane in much the same way planewatchers protect their respective planes. Because of this, the Material Plane has fewer planewatchers than other planes, and the two beings can work in concert to maintain the natural order of the multiverse.

entries: **Resistances**: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The planewatcher has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Planar Sense
traits.value: The planewatcher can pinpoint the location of creatures not native to the plane the planewatcher currently occupies and planar portals within 60 feet of it, and the planewatcher can sense the general direction of such creatures and portals within 1 mile of it.

traits.name: Plane Bound
traits.value: The planewatcher is immune to any spell or effect that would force it to leave its current plane, unless it wants to leave.

traits.name: Word-Bound
traits.value: The planewatcher always knows the direction and distance to any creature that dispels, breaks, or otherwise avoids the geas of the promise it made via Planar Ultimatum, provided the planewatcher and the creature are on the same plane of existence. While grappling such a creature, it can cast the __banishment__ spell as a bonus action (spell save DC 17) on that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The planewatcher makes one Radiant Lasso attack and two Enervating Blast attacks, or it makes three Enervating Blast attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Planar Ultimatum.

actions.name: Radiant Lasso
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d6 + 4**) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the planewatcher isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, can't tell a lie, and can't teleport or be transported to another plane of existence unless the planewatcher wills it.

actions.name: Enervating Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) force damage, and the target has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Planar Ultimatum
actions.value: The planewatcher demands one creature grappled by it to return to the creature's home plane within 24 hours. If the creature doesn't swear to do so, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one If the creature swears to return, it becomes affected by the __geas__ spell for 30 days, which compels the creature to return to its home plane as soon as possible.

bonusActions.name: Reel
bonusActions.value: The planewatcher pulls a creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

entries: **HP**: 20 (Blooming and Thorny Only) or 30 (Oaken Only) + 10 for each spell level above 2

traits.name: Sylvan Regeneration
traits.value: The spirit regains 1 Hit Point at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and is in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The plant makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Petal Burst (Blooming Only)
actions.value: The plant causes a burst of petals to fill the air within a 10-foot Emanation. The area is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel** Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (Thorny Only).

fluffInfo.value: Plasmids are shape-shifters, magebred by the sahuagin of the Thunder Sea using mimic stock infused with the ichor of the dreamers. Plasmids serve both as deadly guardians and living tools, reshaping their mutable bodies to serve the needs of their sahuagin masters.

fluffInfo.name: Skin of Stone and Steel
fluffInfo.value: A plasmid can change the texture of its flesh as well as its appearance. In addition to making the plasmid resistant to injury, this allows the creature to assume many functional forms. A plasmid can serve as a door with no lock or a chest with no lid, creating an obstacle that can only be opened by killing the plasmid. Plasmids can also be trained to assume shapes that serve as functional tools. A plasmid can become an alchemist's lab or a smith's forge, providing all the elements needed to pursue a trade. While this allows the plasmid to "serve as a tool," the plasmid remains a Large creature; it essentially becomes a workbench, with individual smaller tools connected to the primary mass by fibrous strands.

fluffInfo.name: Loyal Servants
fluffInfo.value: For Now. Plasmids possess a passive form of telepathy that allows them to sense the commands of nearby sahuagin. While they are conscious, they have a limited sense of self and no desires beyond service. At least, that's how they were designed and what the sahuagin believe. But it might be possible for a plasmid to develop greater intellect and independence—or for the plasmids of a city to be shaped by the desires of the local dreamer.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The plasmid can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Receptive Telepathy
traits.value: The plasmid is considered a shark for the purpose of being magically controlled by any sahuagin's Shark Telepathy trait.

traits.name: Solid State (Object Form Only)
traits.value: When formed into an inanimate object, the plasmid has an AC of 18 and regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. However, the plasmid's Speed becomes 0 in this form and it cannot attack. It can be used as an item or a set of Artisan's Tools when it is in this form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The plasmid makes three Vicious Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Vicious Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Adaptive Shape-Shift (Amorphous Form Only)
actions.value: When in its true, amorphous form, the plasmid gains one of the following benefits until it uses this action again:

entries: **Truesight**: The plasmid gains Truesight with a range of 30 feet.
**Blindsight**: The plasmid gains Blindsight with a range of 60 feet.
**Speed**: The plasmid's Speed and Swim Speed increase to 30 feet.
**Extra Damage**: The plasmid's Vicious Pseudopod deals an extra **1d6** Acid damage on a hit.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: The plasmid shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true amorphous form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

fluffInfo.name: Covetous Origins
fluffInfo.value: During the Age of Arcanum, magic inspired a deep arrogance in many of the gods' children, who assumed arcane gifts were proof of inevitable divinity. In response, many mortal folk experimented with manufacturing "life" of their own. The dwarves succeeded first, marrying divine gifts with technical skill to animate autonomous wardens as protectors of their ancestral halls. The dwarves' knowledge was quickly stolen and expanded upon by other folk, and creating golems eventually became less about proving that mortals can shape life as the gods do, and more about protecting life, wealth, and secrets from others.

fluffInfo.name: Platinum Golem
fluffInfo.value: This animated construct plated in precious platinum is the primary choice of prestigious mages and paranoid dragons to guard their most precious treasures. Its clanking footsteps make its approach audible to all intruders, who should recognize that fleeing is the best option: for the golem's form is nigh-invulnerable, and its mighty fists can obliterate life with a single blow.

fluffInfo.name: Devoted Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Their creators fashion platinum golems from the spirits of indomitable warriors who died failing to protect what they loved most. This final regret fuels the golem's need to execute its master's orders to perfection. Temples of the __The Platinum Dragon__ also craft these golems using divine rituals and imbue them with the unflinching devotion to justice epitomized by their god.

entries: **Immunities**: acid, cold, fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Divine Custodian
traits.value: When the golem hits a creature with an opportunity attack, that creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The golem has Advantage and Disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The golem makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Radiant Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The golem emits a burst of radiant light in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throws. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (**4d8**) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is not blinded.

fluffInfo.value: A young-looking, gangly hedge bard, Pleasantpaw has been thrown out of inns all across Humblewood. He has made it his life's goal to popularize new instruments developed at scroungecrafting competitions, which he purchases and plays at every opportunity. He is an atrocious musician and an even worse judge of scroungecrafted items. __Elora Quickwit__ employs him to smuggle contraband across Humblewood, which Pleasantpaw does gladly, knowing he is always welcome back at her inn in Marshview.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs

traits.name: Racket (2/Day)
traits.value: Pleasantpaw can use a bonus action on his turn to target any number of creatures within 30 feet of him. Any of these creatures that can hear Pleasantpaw play or croon his music must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for one minute. A creature can attempt a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on their saving throw against this effect, or has the effect ended for it, is immune to Pleasantpaw's racket for 24 hours. Creatures that are immune to being frightened are immune to this effect.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) slashing damage, or 6 (**1d10 + 1**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: Pleasantpaw curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way he can't move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and his base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Pleasantpaw with a melee attack while he is curled up takes 2d4 points of piercing damage from his sharp quills. If a creature hits Pleasantpaw while he is curled up, however, Pleasantpaw is knocked prone in his space at the end of the turn. Pleasantpaw may uncurl himself at any point during his turn.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, Mapach, Vulpin, can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.value: Podge curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way he cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and his base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Podge with a melee attack while they are curled up takes 2d4 points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits Podge while he is curled up, however, Podge is knocked prone in his space at the end of the turn. Podge may uncurl himself at any point during his turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This squat little man has long limbs and skin the color of coal. The backs of its hands and tops of its feet are covered in thick hair. Its face seems a bit too wide for its head, and its eyes gleam a little too brightly in the pale light*.

Pomberos are strange tricksters, born of shadows in the wild. At rest, they tend to adopt a squatting posture, which accentuates their too-long limbs. They shun bright light, though it doesn't harm them, and seek out shadows and half-light. For this reason, many people call pomberos the Night People.

fluffInfo.name: Joy of Trespassing
fluffInfo.value: Pomberos take delight from creeping into places where they don't belong and stealing interesting objects. A pombero's lair is littered with trinkets, both commonplace and valuable. The blame for all manner of misfortune is often laid at a pombero's hairy feet.

fluffInfo.name: Hatred of Hunters
fluffInfo.value: In contrast to their larcenous ways, pomberos take great umbrage over the killing of animals and the destruction of trees in their forests. Birds are particularly beloved pets, and they enjoy mimicking bird songs and calls most of all. Villagers in areas near pombero territory are careful to treat the animals and trees with respect, and they have a strong taboo against killing birds.

traits.name: Contortionist
traits.value: The pombero can contort its body into unnatural positions, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The pombero's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.value: The pombero has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.value: The pombero can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The pombero makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Charming Touch, if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Charming Touch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: One creature the pombero can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 10 minutes. If the target suffers any harm, the effect ends. Otherwise, the target can repeat the saving throw at the end of every minute, ending the effect on itself on a success. The pombero can have only one creature charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous creature ends.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The pombero magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Charming Touch, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the pombero wears or carries is invisible with it.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, paralysed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Arcane Power Source
traits.value: An arcane power source—a crystal on the mining suit's rear—can be targeted separately from the mining suit (AC 19, 64 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all damage except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the mining suit fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw. If the power source is destroyed, the tar elemental possessing the mining suit moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the mining suit becomes an inanimate object.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the mining suit takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks deal an additional 10 (**3d6**) fire damage. If the mining suit is subject to heavy rain or takes 10 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mining suit makes three attacks: one with its Claw, one with its Demolition Drill, and one with its Pseudopod.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the mining suit has advantage on attack rolls using its Claw against the target and the mining suit can't use its Claw on another target.

actions.name: Demolition Drill
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This ancient animal-headed pillar is engraved with weathered symbols from ancient empires.*

fluffInfo.name: Animal Headed
fluffInfo.value: Possessed pillars are carved from enormous blocks of stone to look like animal-headed gods of ancient pantheons or sometimes demonic figures of zealous cults. The most common are the jackal-faced and the ibis-headed variants, but pillars with baboon, crocodile, elephant, or hawk heads also exist.

fluffInfo.name: Hijacked by Cults
fluffInfo.value: Some such pillars are claimed by various cults and carved anew with blasphemous symbols or smeared with blood, oils, and unguents as sacrificial offerings.

fluffInfo.name: Weapon Donations
fluffInfo.value: Priests claim the weapons stolen by the pillars and distribute them to temple guards or sell them to fund temple activities.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The possessed pillar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep

traits.name: Divine Fists
traits.value: The possessed pillar's weapon attacks are magical. When the pillar hits with a Slam attack, the Slam deals an extra **2d8** necrotic damage or **2d8** radiant damage (included in the attack), the pillar's choice.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the pillar remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a statue or a carved column.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The pillar is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The pillar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magnetic Body
traits.value: The eldritch magic powering the possessed pillar causes the pillar's body to produce a minor magnetic field. When a creature hits the pillar with a weapon made of metal, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or the weapon sticks to the pillar. If the creature can't or won't let go of the weapon, it is also stuck to the pillar and restrained. A stuck weapon can't be used. A creature can take its action to remove one metal object from the pillar by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check. The pillar can release one creature or metal object stuck to it as a bonus action. If the pillar dies, all creatures and metal objects stuck to it are released.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The possessed pillar makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage or (**2d8**) radiant damage (the pillar's choice).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Postal Knight makes two melee attacks or three attacks with its Sling.

actions.name: Frying Pan
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Defensive Cooking
bonusActions.value: When wielding a frying pan, the Postal Knight can gain a +1 bonus to AC until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: If the spirit is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spirit move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the spirit isn't an object.

traits.name: New Form (2/Day)
traits.value: When the spirit is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it can choose a different object it can see within 10 feet of it and send its consciousness into that object. After it does so, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Reach
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Mage Hand__ cantrip. When it does so, the spectral hand created by the spell is invisible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes two attacks.

actions.name: Bite, Pinch, or Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bubble Lift (1/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Bubble Lift__ spell, using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes three attacks: two with its chomp and one with its scratch.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.value: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes two smack attacks.

actions.name: Smack
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) damage of the type associated with the spirit.

actions.name: Duplicate (2/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Duplicate__ spell (spell save DC 11), using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

entries: **Skills**: animal handling +5, medicine +5, nature +3, perception +5, stealth +5

traits.name: Body Bite (1/Day)
traits.value: While the spirit has at least 10 hit points, a friendly creature can use a bonus action to take a bite out of the spirit. The spirit takes **3d4** piercing damage, and the creature regains a number of hit points equal to the damage taken.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The spirit regains 4 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Push
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: A Tinge Lucky (3/Day)
traits.value: The spirit can choose to grant itself advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes two scratch attacks.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.value: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spiritual Sight
traits.value: The spirit can see 60 feet into the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) when it is on the Physical Realm, and vice versa.

actions.name: Spectral Pass
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d12 + 2**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.value: The spirit enters the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) from the Physical Realm, or vice versa. It is visible on the Physical Realm while it is in the Spirit Realm, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Incorporeal Transfer
actions.value: While holding an item, the spirit can cause it to become incorporeal, allowing it to pass through other objects and creatures. If the spirit lets go of the item while inside of an object or creature, the item is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space outside of the object or creature.

actions.name: Invisibility (1/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Invisibility__ spell on itself, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

actions.name: Sleep (1/Day)
actions.value: The spirit casts the __Sleep__ spell, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

entries: **Skills**: animal handling +5, arcana +9, history +9, investigation +9, medicine +5, nature +9

traits.name: Academic Specialty
traits.value: The Preceptor has Advantage on all ability checks using their chosen specialty and gains Resistance to a type of damage.

entries: Biothurge, Master of Warbreed: Medicine, Poison
Blastwright, Master of Machines: Arcana, Fire
Decosopher, Master of Alchemy: Nature, Acid

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Preceptor makes three Scalpel attacks. It can replace one Scalpel attack with an Acid Flask, Incendiary Bomb, or Neurotoxic Cloud.

actions.name: Scalpel
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) Slashing damage, plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Acid Flask (Decosopher)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Acid damage and 7 (**2d6**) Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Incendiary Bomb (Blastwright)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., *Hit:* 18 (**4d8**) Fire damage and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Neurotoxic Cloud (Biothurge)
actions.value: Targets in a 20-ft. Cone take 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. If the target succeeds on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, it takes half damage and is not Poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Impromptu Golem (Biothurge, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The biothurge turns a twisted mass spare bodies parts into a **__Zombie__**. The zombie lasts until the end of the biothurge's next turn or until it is destroyed. The biothurge can use a Bonus Action to extend the duration for 1 round.

bonusActions.name: Latent Decoction (Decosopher, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The decosopher activates a potion stored in its blood stream. The decosopher is affected by its choice of: *Haste, Healing (Superior), Speed, or Water Breathing*.

bonusActions.name: Magitek Interference (Blastwright, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The blastwright enjoins a magical item or golem to cease functioning until the beginning of the blastwright's next turn. If the item is held or is a creature, a successful DC 17 Intelligence saving throw resists the interference.

entries: **HP**: 6 plus six times your Barbarian level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to your Barbarian level)

traits.name: Protective Instinct
traits.value: When the guardian becomes Bloodied, it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half of its maximum Hit Points and is enraged for 10 minutes. While enraged, Hostile creatures within 5 feet have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the guardian.

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.value: The guardian can't be *surprised*.

traits.name: Wild Bond
traits.value: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw the beast makes.

actions.name: Natural Weapon
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your attack modifier using Strength, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **1d4 + 2** plus your Rage Damage bonus Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast).

entries: **HP**: 5 plus four times your Barbarian level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Barbarian level)

traits.name: Aquatic Assault (Sea Only)
traits.value: While the beast is submerged in water, it has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures without a Swim Speed submerged in water.

traits.name: Enraged Strikes
traits.value: While your Rage is active, the beast's attack rolls have Advantage.

traits.name: Flyby (Sky Only)
traits.value: The beast doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Wild Bond
traits.value: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw the beast makes.

actions.name: Natural Weapon
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your attack modifier using Strength, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **1d8 + 2** plus your Rage Damage bonus Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast).

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.value: When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Resolute Aura
traits.value: While he is conscious, Ellan and any allies within 20 feet of him who can see him can't be charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ellan makes two Bladed Scepter attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Scepter
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Command (2nd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him.

Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn't understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can't follow Ellan's command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:

entries: **Approach**: The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.
**Drop**: The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.
**Flee**: The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.
**Grovel**: The target falls prone and then ends their turn.
**Halt**: The target doesn't move and takes no actions.

actions.name: Unholy Flame (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Ellan conjures unholy fire around one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (**6d8**) fire damage and is enveloped (save ends at end of turn). While enveloped, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't enveloped.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The principle regains 20 hit points at the start of their turn if they aren't incapacitated. If they take fire damage, they only regain 10 hit points at the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The principle makes two Hampering Roots attacks or two Vernal Lash attacks.

actions.name: Hampering Roots
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Vernal Lash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) slashing damage, and the principle moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Burst from the Earth (1/Day)
actions.value: The principle causes three Large trees with whipping branches to sprout from the ground in unoccupied spaces the principle can see within 60 feet of them. Each tree has AC 15, 40 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

An enemy who starts their turn within 15 feet of one of these trees must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Verdure (2/Day)
bonusActions.value: The principle imbues the power of verdancy in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Roots of the Mind.** For 1 minute, the Elemental can link with each Large or larger plant object they can see within 90 feet of them (no action required). For the duration, the Elemental can perceive, make attacks, and use actions as if they were in the space of a linked plant.

**Thunder Burst.** Thorny vines burst from the Elemental. Each enemy the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 (**6d8**) piercing damage and is restrained until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't restrained.

fluffInfo.value: Occasionally, a creature's rapid mutations become too much for its body to withstand. In a horrific shower of gore, such wretches explode into a quivering mass of cancerous tumors, babbling mouths, shifting eyes, and grasping limbs that twist, expand, and retract in grotesque and bizarre ways.

traits.name: Absorption
traits.value: When the protean abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 hit points.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The protean abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The protean abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The protean abomination makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the protean abomination uses Engulf on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The protean abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature grappled by it. Until the grapple ends the target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the abomination's turns or take 19 (**3d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Protean Abomination, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Corpse Eater
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Absorption trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Enveloping Mass
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Protean Abomination's Engulf feature.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Weak Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the abomination's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Protean Abomination is a hungry creature that hides in dark ruins, old basements, or in piles of rubble, squeezing out to devour anything that comes by. No longer capable of strategic or nuanced thought, the Protean Abomination simply wishes to feed, grow, and survive. It is very territorial and once it has chosen a place to nest, it will stay there for months or years, only moving if it has gone weeks without absorbing a creature.
When prey does wander by, Protean Abominations will attempt to move up to the creature and Engulf it. It wants only to absorb the creature into its mass and grow stronger.
If brought below half Hit Points, the abomination might try to squeeze into a location where it cannot be followed to escape, waiting patiently for less problematic prey.

fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Absorption
traits.value: When the abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 Hit Points.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The abomination makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) and the abomination uses Engulf on the Grappled creature.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it. Until the grapple ends the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the abomination. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. The engulfed creature repeats the save at the start of each of the abomination's turns Success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

fluffInfo.value: *An immense creature sniffs at the air, its singular eye glowing with malice.*

fluffInfo.name: Paid in Souls and Memories
fluffInfo.value: These demonic creations are bred for protection, which they provide for a select few. The price for their guardianship is always high and never in coin. They demand everything from memories to souls in exchange for their services.

fluffInfo.name: Fond of Trophies
fluffInfo.value: Psoglav demons carry recent kills along with them as grisly toys, and they often wear strings of scalps or ears as trophies. They do not mind the stench, and enjoy gnawing bones as a pastime, the larger and more durable the better.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Stealers
fluffInfo.value: The psoglav has a single, menacing eye that is capable of commanding a creature's shadow to separate from its owner and follow the psoglav. The psoglav's command of the shadow is tenuous, however, and the shadow returns to its owner within a few days. Psoglav demons sometimes use this to sow further fear, allowing the shadow to return and letting the victim believe the psoglav has moved on, only for the psoglav to show up days later to finish the kill.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The psoglav has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The psoglav's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The psoglav makes three Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The psoglav magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Shadow-Stealing Ray, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment the psoglav wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Shadow-Stealing Ray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The psoglav emits a beam from its single eye at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the psoglav, and its shadow becomes a creature under the psoglav's control for 24 hours or until the shadow is reduced to 0 hp. On a success, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the psoglav and its shadow isn't stolen. Each controlled shadow uses the statistics of a shadow, except it can't create shadows from killing Humanoids. The psoglav can have no more than five shadows under its control at a time. The shadow becomes permanently under the psoglav's control if the shadow's original owner dies.

If a shadow's original owner died within the past minute, the psoglav can command (no action required) the shadow to inhabit and control the body, using the owner's statistics, proficiencies, and class features. A shadow inhabiting a body in this way can't cast spells or activate magic items the owner possessed, and it loses its Amorphous, Shadow *Stealth*, and Sunlight Weakness traits while inhabiting the body. The shadow can inhabit or exit the body as a bonus action. The shadow can inhabit the body for up to 24 hours after the creature died, after which time it is ejected and can't inhabit the body again.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or its shadow is returned to it, the creature is immune to the Shadow-Stealing Ray of all psoglav demons for the next 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Jump (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the psoglav disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.value: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The psybird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The psybird doesn't understand any languages, but can communicate telepathically with other creatures it chooses within its telepathy range. This telepathy can convey emotions or fleeting sensory memories, such as faint echoes of sounds it has heard, or flashes of images it has seen.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hypnotizing Plumage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The psybird attempts to vex nearby creatures with its psionic calls and dazzling plumage. Each creature within 30 feet of the psybird that can see or hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the psybird for 10 minutes.
When a creature becomes charmed by this effect, apply one of the effects below at random for as long as the creature remains charmed.

actions.name: 1 Hazy Sight
actions.value: The creature is unable to see with any definition further than 10 feet from itself. The affected creature is considered to be blinded to any creature or object further than 10 feet from itself, as they appear to it only as blurry, amorphous blobs of color.

actions.name: 2 Confusion
actions.value: The creature suffers the effects of the __confusion__ spell, though the psybird doesn't need to maintain *concentration* on it. The affected creature can repeat its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on itself on a success.

actions.name: 3 Stupefaction
actions.value: The creature suffers disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks it makes that use either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The creature also temporarily forgets any languages it knows except for the one it has known the longest.

actions.name: 4 Dizziness
actions.value: Any turn in combat during which the creature uses more than half of its movement speed, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone. Each time this happens, the creature can repeat its save, ending the effect on a success.

**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The psychic fragment can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The psychic fragment can mimic a single word or phrase it spoke in life. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 11 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The swarm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Maddening Voices
traits.value: The swarm constantly emits a babble of words and phrases spoken in life by its many undead spirits. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. of the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on a saving throw becomes immune to maddening voices for 24 hours.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**6d6**) necrotic damage, or 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* or *Investigation* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to study a Psychophant, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Feeding on Despair
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Life Siphon ability.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistant Form
fluffInfo.value: You know its Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Escape with Prey
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Teleport Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Psychophant feeds on the weak and will avoid a fight with competent adventurers unless the right opportunity presents itself, or its true nature is discovered. In combat it will attempt to subdue aggressors with its Final Scream, then target the bloodiest opponent with its Psychic Grasp. Victim in hand, it will attempt to flee using Teleportation, repeatedly feeding on the target with its Life Siphon until the creature falls unconscious.

entries: **Languages**: Common (only repeats phrases it has heard)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The psychophant makes two Psychic Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage and the target has the Immobilized condition (Wisdom saving throw DC 14 save ends).

actions.name: Final Scream (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage, and the target is immune to this psychophant's Final Scream for 24 hours.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.value: The psychophant shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen or reverts to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

bonusActions.name: Life Siphon
bonusActions.value: The psychophant deals 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage to a creature it damaged this turn with Psychic Grasp, then regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The psychophant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. It can bring one creature Immobilized by its Psychic Grasp, which teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the psychophant's destination space.

fluffInfo.value: The first pudding gremlin was the result of a misguided mage attempting to bring drama to their dinner table. The gremlin leapt from the plate and was soon causing havoc in the kitchen, where it created a small army of currant-filled compatriots. This ability to transform regular puddings into duplicates has resulted in pudding gremlins being a widespread pest during the festive season.

The pudding gremlin's sharp green horns and claws pose an immediate threat to those trying to quash these creatures. However, it is the tiny brandy scented inferno that resides within each pudding gremlin that provides the drama the mage had wished for. Even when defeated, these not-so-sweet treats create an unwelcome surprise, exploding and spraying clumps of sticky, scalding-hot cake over their foes.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: The pudding gremlin explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the pudding gremlin. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: If the pudding gremlin doesn't move on its turn, it has Advantage when taking the Hide action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft, *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 15 ft Cone. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Create Gremlin (1/Day)
actions.value: If the pudding gremlin is within 10 ft of an ordinary pudding, it can turn the ordinary pudding into another pudding gremlin. This new pudding gremlin appears in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of the original pudding gremlin and acts as its ally.

fluffInfo.value: *Fiendish Effigy of the Fields*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Pumpkin heads hold a shred of memory from the people they replaced. The sight of a keepsake or memento from a pumpkin head's victim confuses the creature.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common plus one other language but only speaks using Mimicry

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The pumpkin head can mimic the voice of the person it replaced or someone it used Personality Consumption on. A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation only with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Sorrowful Memento
traits.value: If the pumpkin head can see a creature holding a possession of the person the pumpkin head replaced, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The pumpkin head makes one Claw attack and one Pitchfork attack, and it can use Personality Consumption if available.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pitchfork
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the pumpkin head can push or pull it 5 feet.

actions.name: Personality Consumption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The pumpkin head consumes a victim's memories. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the pumpkin head can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn, and its Intelligence score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way is replaced by a __Pumpkin Head__ 1d8 hours later unless its body is burned.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The jam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance

fluffInfo.name: Swamp Undead
fluffInfo.value: Putrid haunts are walking corpses infused with moss, mud, and the detritus of the deep swamp. They are the shambling remains of individuals who, either through mishap or misdeed, died while lost in a vast swampland. Their desperate need to escape the marshland in life transforms into a hatred of all living beings in death. They often gather in places tainted by evil deeds.

fluffInfo.name: Mossy Islands
fluffInfo.value: When no potential victims are nearby, putrid haunts sink into the water and muck, where moss and water plants grow over them and vermin inhabit their rotting flesh. When living creatures draw near, the dormant putrid haunt bursts from its watery hiding spot and attacks its prey, stomping foes deep into the muck. There's no planning and little cunning in their assault, but they move through the marshes more freely than most intruders, and they attack with a single-mindedness that's easily mistaken for purpose.

fluffInfo.name: Harbor Vermin
fluffInfo.value: Putrid haunt corpses create favorable conditions for leeches, insects, and other swamp vermin. They are often hosts or hiding places for large gatherings of such creatures.

entries: **Languages**: understands the language it knew in life but can't speak

fluffInfo.value: *A fey lady of stunning beauty with hair the color of midnight stands before a shining field of stars. A gown seemingly woven from the night sky drapes her flawless ivory skin. Bright lights glitter like diamonds in her crown and raiment, and some drift about her body and dance near her hand*.

Her Celestial and Royal Majesty, Sarastra Aestruum, Queen of Night and Magic, is also Duchess of the Heavens, Mistress of Air and Darkness, Lady of the Summer Palace, and Bride of Shadows. The Queen rules the court of the shadow fey with grace and majesty—most of the time. Queen Sarastra is the head of the Summer Court, which rules the shadow fey in its season. On the rare occasion when the courtly season turns, Sarastra steps aside in favor of her husband and rival, the Moonlit King, who is head of the Winter Court.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Sorceress
fluffInfo.value: The Queen of Night and Magic does not bear her moniker lightly. She is a devastatingly potent sorceress, augmented with command over the stuff of shadows. Though her nature is undeniably dark, Queen Sarastra is hardly unreasonable. She is quick to recognize the value in any supplicant, mortal or fey, who catches her royal eye. She is never one to ignore an opportunity to further her agenda or to gain further power over the Moonlit King.

On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained. A restrained creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *Who I am is not as important as what I am. I am quicker than thought, more silent than contemplation, more slippery than a fading memory, and more unshakable than a guilty conscience. I deal in secrets and mendacity as lesser thieves deal in coins and larceny. I can fulfil your wildest dreams, or I can be your worst nightmare.* - The Queen of Thieves.

The Queen of Thieves is a scheming mastermind who controls the Drakkenheim underworld. She has transformed a hundred squabbling bands of brigands and outlaws into a burgeoning criminal empire. However, none know her true identity or origin, for she wears many faces. Though she is most infamously encountered as a lithe masked woman garbed in swashbuckling attire with a wide-brimmed hat and jewelled rapier, the Queen of Thieves adopts a variety of costumes, facial features, skin and hair colours, body shapes, ages, and genders depending on her mood and circumstances. As such, she typically confirms her identity by revealing some secret about whoever she is speaking with or demonstrating her uncanny ability to change appearance seemingly at-will.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I am never caught unprepared, and have contingencies for my contingencies. I speak with rakish confidence while casually exposing everything I know about others, and flaunt my ability to be anybody or anywhere.

**Ideal**: I indulge in playing mind games and manipulating people with the promise of profit. Instead of spilling blood, I spill secrets. My enemies are worthless as corpses. When I have to steal lives, I spend them dearly first.
**Bond**: Law is powerless in the chaos of the ruins. As long as anarchy reigns, so shall I.
**Flaw**: Anyone who trusts me is a terrible fool. Double-crossing is my nature. I expect everyone to betray me, and I'll relish the opportunity to defeat them when they try.

fluffInfo.value: Few amongst the Queen's Men have met the Queen of Thieves in person, and even fewer have attended the Court of Thieves. Most only know if they get a note attached to a Queen of Diamonds playing card, you better do what it says.

Each creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent Charmed by her. These memories can be restored with a __Heal__ spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Vexing Aura
traits.value: The Queen of Thieves projects a 30-foot Emanation of bewitching magic. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

entries: **Enchanting Presence**: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Charmed condition until it ends its turn outside the Emanation. If she deals damage to the creature, the condition ends, and that creature is immune to her Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.
**Mocking Laughter**: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: The Queen of Thieves always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, she takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: +3 Rapier

actions.name: Cutting Words

actions.value: The Queen of Thieves moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Misdirection (1/Round)
actions.value: The Queen of Thieves becomes Invisible and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet. At the same time, an illusory double of her appears where she was standing. The illusory double, as well as the Invisible condition, end if the Queen of Thieves attacks or casts a spell, or after 1 minute.

actions.name: Resistance Resistance
actions.value: The Queen of Thieves chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. She can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *This statuesque woman towers over any tall man and most ogres. Her hair falls in a cascade of curls and looks as if it is spun from copper. Her eyes are the color of moss beds, with no iris or pupil. A billowy robe of forest green enshrouds her body, and she grasps a great ring of etched silver in one massive fist*.

Nicnevin, the Queen of Witches, is the Mountain Ogress, Lady of Copper and Crystal, and the Moon Weaver. She is not what one usually imagines in a fey lady, but she has an imposing figure of mass and power. Her stature speaks to great physical strength and the stalwart defiance of the mountain itself, but her true power is in her command of magic.

fluffInfo.name: Pact Patron
fluffInfo.value: The Queen of Witches is one of the foremost patrons of those who seek power through a pact. Many hag covens offer her loyalty and tribute. She rules from beneath her mountain, attended by a court of fey witches, hags, and mortal supplicants. Her favor is highly sought after, and it is said that a single hair from her coppery head contains all the power a mortal might ever desire.
