actions.name: Drill
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 7**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition (save ends) and the Prone condition.

actions.name: Destructive Rampage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The reautomata moves up to its Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonusActions.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; *Bloodied* Only)
bonusActions.value: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains Immunity to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has Advantage on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore Resistances and Immunities, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact.

At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the reautomata when it dies. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage plus 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Ascendant Transformation
traits.value: When Vladimir von Drakken drops to 0 Hit Points, his body explodes in a shower of gore and he reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet as Ascendant Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the *Bloodied* or Bleeding condition.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4). In addition, Vladimir von Drakken can apply one of the following martial maneuvers to the target:
**Advance**: Vladimir von Drakken pushes the target 15 feet, then moves up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
**Hamstring**: The target has the Immobilized condition until the end of its next turn.
**Overpower**: The target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn.
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 49 (**14d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 20 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Dominate (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys Vladimir von Drakken's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition lasts 24 hours or until Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Success* The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against Vladimir von Drakken.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success*: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Shadow Step (2/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Shape-Shift (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him.

While in bat or mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and Speed, are unchanged, but he can't use Epic Actions other than Shape-Shift and Epic Resistance. While in mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak or manipulate objects, and loses his Aura of Dread. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. He has Resistance to all damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *The red-skinned woman steps forward, sunlight glinting in her raven hair as red magic swirls around her.*
An elder race—older than the elves, and as old as the dragons, they claim—red hags are the most cunning and longest-lived of the hags, with a lifespan of more than a thousand years.

*Red hags are more sociable among their own kind than other hags are, and they sometimes live in small communities in remote areas. In ancient times, they settled together in larger clusters and ruled small cities of mixed populations—especially in Old Verrayne. Their current leader is Blood Mother Margase, an ancient druid.*
*Their greatest city, Talitheos, an island metropolis of vast wealth and magical knowledge, sunk during the cataclysm, and the hags have been seeking its ruins ever since.*

fluffInfo.name: Beautiful and Strong
fluffInfo.value: Unlike many of their hag kin, red hags are not horrid to look upon, and most are considered comely in their own right. Few know anything about them, and the red hags do little to enlighten scholars, preferring seclusion.

fluffInfo.name: Tied to Nature
fluffInfo.value: Red hags have a deep connection with all elements of nature, and they often make their homes in deep forests, in caves, or alongside coastlines.

fluffInfo.name: Blood Magic
fluffInfo.value: Because of their connection to nature, red hags often serve as druids. Within their druidic circles they practice blood sacrifices and perform ritualistic blood magic—both to slake their craving for humanoid blood, but also as a means to venerate goddesses of dark magic. The ancient hags all answer to a hierarchy with the most powerful spellcasters at the top.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The red hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.value: The red hag can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of her and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of her.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The red hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.value: The red hag can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Claw attacks or three Blood Bolt attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Siphon Blood (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The red hag drains blood from nearby creatures. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 20 feet of the red hag must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (**10d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one creature fails the saving throw, the next spell the red hag casts is cast as if the spell used a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's lowest level.

fluffInfo.value: *Bands of red swirl along the abdomen of this small, black spider.*

Red-banded line spiders are named for both the deep red swirls on their abdomens, unique to each spider, and for their peculiar hunting technique. The largest ones hunt in the dark canopy of temperate and subtropical forests.

fluffInfo.name: Hand-Sized Hunters
fluffInfo.value: These furry, brown spiders are not enormous monsters, but they are big enough to be alarming. A typical one is as big as a human hand with fingers spread wide, but some grow as large as small dogs.

fluffInfo.name: Webbed Line
fluffInfo.value: Line spiders don't spin webs but instead perch and watch for prey. When prey wanders near, the spider launches a line of webbing to snare it, then pounces unerringly along that line to deliver a deep bite. Their potent venom can incapacitate creatures much larger than themselves, and they quickly devour flesh with their powerful jaws.

fluffInfo.name: City Dwellers
fluffInfo.value: Line spiders are often found in cities, and their size makes them a good replacement for a garroter crab in certain forms of divination. They're favorites among exotic pet dealers—usually with their venom sacs removed, sometimes not. Goblins, kobolds, and some humans use them rather than cats to control a mouse or rat infestation, and they make reasonably good pets if they're kept well-fed. If they get hungry, line spiders may devour other small pets or even their owners.

traits.name: Reactive Venom
traits.value: If the spider deals poison damage to a creature that is poisoned, the target takes an extra 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down and on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.value: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Swingline
bonusActions.value: The spider throws a length of webbing at a point on a surface, such as the ground or wall, it can see within 30 feet of it, attaching one end of the webbing to that point. It then reels in the webbing, pulling itself to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that point. When the spider moves in this way, opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage. If the spider pulled itself at least 15 feet straight toward a creature, it has advantage on the next Bite attack it makes against that creature before the start of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *This grizzled, weather-beaten creature looks like a sour old man, complete with scraggly beard. It carries a great pike and wears a blood-soaked hat and heavy boots shod with iron. It grins with massive yellow teeth*.

fluffInfo.name: Blood-Soaked Caps
fluffInfo.value: Redcaps are exceedingly dangerous creatures who wear the mark of their cruelty and evil quite literally. The caps from which they take their name define their very existence—these caps must constantly be revived with fresh blood.

fluffInfo.name: Compelled to Kill
fluffInfo.value: Redcaps aren't cruel and murderous by choice, but by necessity. A redcap must frequently bathe its cap in fresh, humanoid blood to sustain itself. If it fails to do so every three days, the creature withers and dies quickly. A redcap whose hat is nearly dry is a desperate, violent force of nature that prefers to die in battle rather than waste away to nothing.

fluffInfo.name: Bandits and Mercenaries
fluffInfo.value: Most long-lived redcaps are drawn to serve in marauding armies or make a living through constant banditry.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Red Cap
traits.value: The redcap must soak its cap in the blood of a Humanoid that has been dead for no more than 1 hour at least once every 3 days. Every 24 hours past the third day that it goes without soaking its cap in blood in this way, it suffers one level of exhaustion. This exhaustion can be reduced only when the redcap finishes a long rest after soaking its cap in fresh Humanoid blood, which reduces its exhaustion level to 0. If the redcap dies as a result of this exhaustion, it crumbles to dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The redcap makes one Bleeding Bite attack and two Pike attacks.

actions.name: Bleeding Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose 7 2d6 hp at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Pike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Solid Kick
bonusActions.value: The redcap kicks a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of garbage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Stench
traits.value: Any creature other than a refuse golem that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem, must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all refuse golems for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) bludgeoning damage, plus 9 (**2d8**) piercing or slashing damage (golem's choice).

actions.name: Hurl Junk
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d10 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Agile
traits.value: The reindeer doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Snowstrider
traits.value: Snow and ice are not Difficult Terrain for the reindeer.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Burst of Speed (3/day)
bonusActions.value: The reindeer's Speed doubles until the start of its next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Remnant Chosen
fluffInfo.value: All devotees of __The Whispered One__ are zealous followers, spending hours in silent meditation hoping to hear their long-dead master whisper a commandment from beyond. However, only a rare few hear the spectral voice of __The Whispered One__ as it worms its way into their minds, emptying out other thought and filling their heads with clarity and direction. Much of this direction involves the Remnants' plans to leverage secrets stolen from the Plane of Shadow to increase the cult's power in Tal'Dorei.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The chosen has Advantage and Disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Withering Spells
traits.value: When the chosen casts a spell of 1st level or higher, the next Withered Hand attack it makes before the end of its next turn deals extra damage equal to 1d6 per level of the spell cast.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**5d6**) force damage plus extra damage from the Withering Touch trait. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a __true resurrection__ or a __wish__ spell.

bonusActions.name: Inescapable Sight
bonusActions.value: The Chosen selects a creature or object under the effect of an illusion spell of 4th level or lower. One illusion of the Chosen's choice affecting the target is dispelled.

fluffInfo.name: Remnant Cultist
fluffInfo.value: All cultists of __The Whispered One__ endure horrific rites of initiation that force them to remove one of their own eyes and forever shackle themselves to the will of the cult's leaders. Every cultist can feel the presence of their foul god just beyond the fabric of the physical world, and many claim to hear him speaking to them when all else is silent.

The cultists of __The Whispered One__ still venerate their wrathful master with offerings of secrets and unwilling souls to gain his favor, learning what they can and keeping hidden that which they know. Cultists believe in cultivating evil in themselves and recognizing it in others, encouraging them to express it. They hope to seed the ruin of all who worship other deities until only those who kneel before __The Whispered One__ remain.

traits.name: Unknowable Secrets
traits.value: Any attempt to form a mental link with the cultist, cast __scrying__ on the cultist, or cast __speak with dead__ on the cultist automatically fails, and the creature that initiated the attempt takes 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage.

traits.name: One-Eyed
traits.value: The cultist has Advantage and Disadvantage on any attack roll made against a target more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Spellsteal
traits.value: If the cultist successfully uses __counterspell__ to negate another creature's spell, it can cast the countered spell once before the end of its next turn using one of its spell slots of the same level or higher, and requiring no material components.

actions.name: Dagger of Wounding
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage. Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a resting, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means.

Once per turn when the cultist hits a creature with an attack using this weapon, it can wound its target. At the start of each of the wounded creature's turns, it takes 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage for each time it's been wounded by this weapon. It can then make a DC 15 Constitution saving throws, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *Fiend of Music and Dance*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Revelers of song can't accept that any creature is more skilled at an instrument than they are and so can't refuse a musical challenge.

traits.name: Compelled Contest
traits.value: The reveler can't refuse a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an Influence action, a creature can make a Charisma (*Performance*) check using a Musical Instrument. The reveler must succeed on a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the check's total or take 20 Psychic damage and have the Stunned condition until the end of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Dancing Step
traits.value: The reveler doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Ensemble Form
traits.value: The reveler takes on a specific form: Drone, Drum, or Bell. The form determines certain traits and actions, as well as the instrument the reveler plays (hurdy gurdy, frame drum, or handbells, respectively).

traits.name: Droning Swarm (Drone Only)
traits.value: A droning swarm of bees surrounds the reveler. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature that ends its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the reveler. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The reveler makes two Instrumental Blast attacks.

actions.name: Instrumental Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Infectious Rhythm (Drum Only)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, up to two creatures the reveler can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the target is affected by the __Otto's Irresistible Dance__ spell (no *Concentration* required to maintain the spell). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Stunning Clangor (Bell Only)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the reveler can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the reveler's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *Fiend of Legend and Folklore*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Revelers of stories exist because of fables, legends, and other tales, and reciting the moral of a story related to the reveler's theme robs the reveler of its potency.

traits.name: Moral Quandary
traits.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story using the same theme as the reveler's Storied Form to weaken it for 1 hour. While weakened, the reveler can't take Reactions, and its AC is reduced by 4.

traits.name: Storied Form
traits.value: The reveler takes on a specific form: Great Beast, Hero, or Witch. The form determines certain traits and the theme of stories the reveler embodies (powerful monsters, brave heroes, or wicked magicians, respectively).

traits.name: Terror Feeding (Witch Only)
traits.value: If there is at least one creature with the Frightened condition within 30 feet of the reveler at the end of its turn, the reveler gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The reveler makes three Thrash attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Fabled Assault if available.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Force damage.

actions.name: Fabled Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The reveler uses the option determined by its Storied Form:

actions.name: Consuming Bite (Great Beast Only)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet (with Disadvantage if the reveler is grappling the target). *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: The reveler gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

actions.name: Heroic Charge (Hero Only)
actions.value: The reveler moves up to its Speed in a straight line without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it can move through other creatures without expending extra movement to do so. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature whose space the reveler enters. *Failure:* 26 (**4d12**) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wicked Storm (Witch Only)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Frightened condition. While Frightened in this way, the target's Speed is 0. A Frightened target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: Warlord of Droaam
fluffInfo.value: During the Last War, Rhesh Turakbar personally led countless raids against Orcbone and Brelish settlements along the Border Road. Any adventurer with roots in the frontier may have lost friends or family to Turakbar's reavers—or narrowly escaped death at his hands. With the end of open hostilities, Turakbar has pulled his forces back to the Fist and plays the role of warlord rather than reaver. As warlord, Turakbar is responsible for maintaining order in the region around Turakbar's Fist. His reavers patrol the land, but Turakbar wishes to be feared even by his subjects. He maintains order, indeed—by making a brutal example of anyone who challenges the Daughters or Turakbar himself. Some of the villages under his watch are minotaur communities; others are primarily goblins or kobolds with a few minotaur overseers. Either way, each village has a chib that answers to Turakbar—and he will often challenge chibs to test their might, killing and replacing any who prove to be too weak by his standards. There is no question that Rhesh Turakbar is maintaining order, as is the duty of a warlord. But where elsewhere in Droaam the Daughters are working to unite the different species and cultures of the region and to give their people hope, Rhesh Turakbar still rules through fear.

fluffInfo.name: Fist of the Horned King
fluffInfo.value: Turakbar's Fist is an artifact of the Horned King, charged with the power of Tol Kharash. The Daughters of Sora Kell gave Turakbar the title of warlord, but he earned Rhesh on his own by slaying the previous ruler of the Fist and claiming its power. Turakbar's horns are engraved with sigils that bind him to the Horned King, so that the power of the Fist flows through his blood. Turakbar can sense the fears of creatures around him, a gift he uses to intimidate his enemies and undermine his rivals. Adventurers facing Rhesh Turakbar can feel the fiendish power flowing through him—feel that he is a vessel for something ancient and terrifying. Because of his size and physical might, it is easy for people to underestimate Turakbar's intelligence. But the warlord is no fool. He may choose to be reckless in battle, but he is a cunning strategist with keen instincts. However, as a vessel for the Horned King there are limits on his behavior, much as a paladin follows an oath. Turakbar cannot willingly show fear or weakness, and he must always look for weakness in others and spread fear where he can.

Rhesh Turakbar is not immortal. He's not one of the Lords of Dust; he's a minotaur champion who's laid claim to a terrifying power, and who now has to be a brutal tyrant to hold onto that power. A DM could choose to play up Turakbar's role as a willing vessel of the overlord's spirit. In this case, his power could grow even as his personality melts away, leaving a sliver of Tol Kharash cloaked in what's left of Turakbar's flesh. On the other hand, a DM who wants more complexity could say that Rhesh Turakbar knows this is happening and is afraid of it—he doesn't want to be a puppet of Tol Kharash, but he is in too deep and sees no way to escape that fate.

traits.name: Horned King's Curse
traits.value: Creatures that are cursed by Turakbar (see Pact Gauntlet) have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws, and Turakbar deals an extra 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage whenever he hits a cursed target with a melee attack.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.value: Turakbar can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of his turn, Turakbar can gain Advantage on all melee attack rolls he makes during that turn, but attack rolls against him have Advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Turakbar makes one Greataxe attack or one Gore attack, and one Pact Gauntlet attack.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Pact Gauntlet
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target is cursed by Turakbar for 1 minute (see Horned King's Curse).

actions.name: Blood for the Overlord
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, creatures within 40 feet of Turakbar. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Necrotic damage for each creature currently affected by Turakbar's curse and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of their next turn. *Success* Half damage and the target does not have the Frightened condition. Creatures that are cursed by Turakbar's Pact Gauntlet are no longer cursed.

bonusActions.name: Ferocious Charge
bonusActions.value: *Trigger*: Turakbar moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn. *Response:* Turakbar can make a Pact Gauntlet attack.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Hunter's Training
traits.value: Rhys has proficiency with the longbow, shortbow, and spear. Additionally, her familiarity with the longbow means that it is not considered a heavy weapon for her.

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Rhys has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Aerial Defense
traits.value: Creatures who attack Rhys while she ranger is falling, gliding, or jumping have disadvantage on their attack roll.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) slashing damage.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, can also understand Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Riffin can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Riffin rolls advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Maneuver (2/Day)
traits.value: When Riffin hits with an attack, he can choose to maneuver the enemy out of position, granting an ally within 5 feet of the target the opportunity to use their reaction to move away from this enemy at half their movement speed without provoking an attack of opportunity.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Riffin makes two short sword attacks.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage. The knight can choose to grapple a target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Wing Crest Shield (1/Day)
actions.value: Riffin casts the __gust of wind__ spell (save DC 15).

fluffInfo.value: *This enormous pig is as large as an ox, and its mouth bristles with mismatched tusks. Its body is a lopsided mass of tumorous flesh that gives way to eyes and vestigial mouths, while long tentacles trail from its sides.*

From time to time, a breach forms in the fabric of the multiverse, and the Material Plane is bathed in the energy of alien dimensions. Living creatures exposed to this incursion can undergo horrible mutations, turning into monstrous mockeries of their former shapes. One example of this phenomenon is the rift swine: once-ordinary pigs transformed into slavering horrors after being bathed in eldritch light.

fluffInfo.name: Destructive Herds
fluffInfo.value: Rift swine travel in small herds. Their effect on an area can be catastrophic—they eat nearly anything, possess a fiendish cunning, and delight in the destruction they cause. A rift swine has difficulty perceiving anything smaller than itself as a threat, leading it to attack most other creatures on sight and fighting until it is destroyed.

fluffInfo.name: Abyssal Meat
fluffInfo.value: Rumors of vast herds of hundreds of rift swine on strongly chaos-aligned planes, cultivated by the lords of those places as a food source, are thankfully unconfirmed.

traits.name: Chaos Mutations
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the rift swine's body experiences a mutation. Choose an option or roll a d6 to determine the type of mutation. The mutation lasts until the start of the rift swine's next turn.

traits.name: 1 Acid Boils
traits.value: The next creature that hits the rift swine with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the rift swine takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

traits.name: 2 Acid Saliva
traits.value: The next melee attack the rift swine makes that hits a creature deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) acid damage to the creature.

traits.name: 3 Extra Eyes
traits.value: The rift swine has advantage on the next attack roll it makes.

traits.name: 4 Extra Hooves
traits.value: The rift swine's speed increases by 10 feet, and the rift swine doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: 5 Second Heart
traits.value: The rift swine gains 10 3d6 temporary hp.

traits.name: 6 Toughened Hide
traits.value: The rift swine has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (the rift swine's choice).

traits.name: Dozens of Eyes
traits.value: The rift swine has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being blinded. In addition, if the rift swine isn't blinded, creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the rift swine, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The rift swine makes one Tusk attack and two Tentacle attacks, or it makes three Warping Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The rift swine has two tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Warping Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**3d6 + 1**) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls as reality-warping energies temporarily distort its body.

fluffInfo.value: *The long, crusty slug sparkles like ice, and long tendrils dangle from its gaping mouth.*

fluffInfo.name: Ice Burrowers
fluffInfo.value: The rime worm's tendrils help it burrow through ice and snow as well as absorb sustenance from prey. Their pale, almost translucent, skin is coated with ice crystals, making them difficult to spot in their snowy habitat.

fluffInfo.name: Spray Black Ice
fluffInfo.value: The worms are fierce hunters, and their abilities to spray skewers of ice and freeze their prey make them extremely dangerous.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The rime worm can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Icy Body
traits.value: A creature that touches the rime worm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (**1d8**) cold damage.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.value: The rime worm has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

traits.name: Snow Stride
traits.value: The rime worm can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The rime worm makes two Rime Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Freeze Prey.

actions.name: Rime Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the rime worm doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Freeze Prey
actions.value: One creature grappled by the rime worm must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be petrified in ice for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A petrified creature that takes fire damage has advantage on the saving throw.

actions.name: Black Ice Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The rime worm sprays slivers of ice in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (**8d8**) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area then becomes icy, difficult terrain for 1 minute.

fluffInfo.value: *The long, crusty slug sparkles like ice, and long tendrils dangle from its gaping mouth.*

fluffInfo.name: Ice Burrowers
fluffInfo.value: The rime worm's tendrils help it burrow through ice and snow as well as absorb sustenance from prey. Their pale, almost translucent, skin is coated with ice crystals, making them difficult to spot in their snowy habitat.

fluffInfo.name: Spray Black Ice
fluffInfo.value: The worms are fierce hunters, and their abilities to spray skewers of ice and freeze their prey make them extremely dangerous.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The rime worm grub can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Ravenous Larva
traits.value: The rime worm grub can make an opportunity attack against any creature that leaves its reach, even if the creature takes the Disengage action. In addition, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.value: The rime worm grub has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

traits.name: Snow Stride
traits.value: The rime worm grub can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Rime Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (**1d8**) cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: A Ripper is a creation of a truly mad apothecary, though one ostensibly created as a "surgical assistant" for dissection and autopsy. In truth, a Ripper's only purpose is as a butcher, carrying out the grim task of dismembering corpses and collecting severed parts to supply fresh materials to create more abominations. Transforming morgues into abattoirs and surgery rooms into charnel houses, having a Ripper amongst their servants enables an Apothecary to work with startling efficiency.
Due to their horrific appearance and grim purpose, Rippers are seldom encountered outside an Apothecary's laboratory. Given their size and brutal skill, Rippers make ideal guardians.

fluffInfo.name: Parts Collectors
fluffInfo.value: Apothecaries stitch all manner of extra arms, hands, and limbs to their Rippers, which the creature uses to gather severed body parts and hold down subjects.

fluffInfo.name: Fear Engine
fluffInfo.value: The Ripper's tortured mind sympathetically responds when it senses a victim's fear and terror, but its twisted brain responds with adrenaline and bloodlust.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Ripper, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Occult Science Construct
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Insensitive to Pain trait, as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Razor-Sharp Weapons
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Ripper's Whirling Bonesaw attack, and it's Feed on Fear and Dismemberment traits.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Formidable but Dim-Witted
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Ripper's Constitution, Dexterity, and Intelligence saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Ripper is an unsubtle and unsophisticated combatant, but it can follow its creators' orders intelligently. Unless directed otherwise, a Ripper usually begins battle by using its Gory Display to terrify its victims. It then ponderously moves towards its chosen target before lowering its Saw Blade down, preferring Frightened targets to benefit from its Feed on Fear trait. During its turn, a Ripper continues attacking with its Saw Blade until it misses. If it reduces a target to 0 Hit Points, it does not stop making attacks until its target dies.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Chemical Solution.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Blades, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Plates.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Dismemberment
traits.value: Creatures killed by attacks made by the ripper can't be restored to life except by a __Resurrection__ spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Feed on Fear
traits.value: Frightened creatures have the Helpless and Defenseless conditions against attacks made by the ripper.

traits.name: Insensitive to Pain
traits.value: Critical Hits against the ripper become normal hits.

actions.name: Whirling Bonesaw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Slashing damage, and the ripper can immediately make another Whirling Bonesaw attack against the same target. This attack ignores __Resistance__ and Immunity to Slashing damage.

actions.name: Gory Display (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature that can see the ripper. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). While Frightened, the target's Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.

fluffInfo.value: *A body that might once have been human now has four legs and nightmarishly long, thick arms. What's worse, its skin has been flayed off, revealing the dead muscle and sinew beneath.*

fluffInfo.name: Spirit of War
fluffInfo.value: The risen reaver is an undead creature born from a warrior fallen on the battlefield. Its body becomes an avatar of combat, with four legs and a pair of long, heavy arms. In the process, it sheds its skin, becoming entirely undead muscle, bone, and sinew.

fluffInfo.name: Absorb Weapons
fluffInfo.value: When risen reavers take form, they absorb all weapons around them. Some of these weapons pierce their bodies, while others become part of the risen reaver's armament. Their four legs are tipped with blades on which they walk like metallic spiders. Their arms are covered in weaponry infused into their flesh, which they use to crush and flay any living creatures they encounter

fluffInfo.name: Battle Mad
fluffInfo.value: Risen reavers are battle-maddened spirits of vengeance and slaughter, obsessed with the chaos of combat that led to their own death. They hunt the living with the sole purpose of killing, and they thrive on violence and murder. As they died, so should others die.

entries: **Languages**: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.value: The risen reaver can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The risen reaver doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The risen reaver makes three Bladed Fist attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Skitter
bonusActions.value: The risen reaver takes the Dash action.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common plus one other language it knew but can't speak

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The sporehusk regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the sporehusk takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Grab
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

bonusActions.name: Bite
bonusActions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. (must target a creature Grappled by the sporehusk). *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *A tall, slender giant wades knee-deep through the river, holding a glowing fishing net in his hand.*
Shorter and slimmer than most other giants, river giants are found living along riverbanks throughout the Shadow Realm and in the mortal world where waterways cross or run alongside the shadow roads.

fluffInfo.name: River Travelers
fluffInfo.value: Capable boat pilots, these introspective giants sometimes transport travelers up and down the rivers of the Shadow Realm in their wooden skiffs, but they are most often found wading through the water with their glistening mooncatcher's nets. The giants use the nets to pull bits of souls and memories from the river. These fragments are bottled and traded to wizards and alchemists who use them to make memory philters and other potions.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The giant can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mindful Wader
traits.value: The giant is immune to the effects of dark water (see Chapter 5 of Book of Ebon Tides for more on dark water).

traits.name: Netted Strike
traits.value: Once per turn, the giant can deal an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage to a restrained creature the giant hits with a weapon attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes a Mooncatcher's Net attack and then two Staff attacks.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mooncatcher's Net
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, ranged 20/60 ft., one Small, Medium, or Large creature. *Hit:* The target is restrained until it escapes the net. A creature can use its action to make a DC 16 Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 14) frees the target.

fluffInfo.value: *This powerfully muscled elf lord wears a cloak of foam-trimmed dark blue and a vest of woven green reeds and willow branches. His crown shines like the sun on a lake, and his flowing hair curls and moves even when there is no wind. An orb of blue light that ripples like water circles his hand*.

His Rippling Majesty, Ulorian the River King, also bears the titles Defender of the Pearl Tower and Master of the Deep Forest. A lean elf noble with whipcord muscles and flowing grace, the River King rules over the Rippling Court and ultimately all the river elves of the forest. His court resides just beyond the river's reflection, in a realm of fey glamour and silty water.

fluffInfo.name: A Fickle Friend
fluffInfo.value: The River King is a stern ruler with a great love for his people and a quick temper for those who threaten his domain. As much a force of nature as he is a monarch, the River King is known to sometimes forget promises that were made in sincerity, and dealing with him can be perilous at the best of times. "The river may change its course when it wills" is the usual expression among his court when His Rippling Majesty has had a sudden change of heart.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, cold, fire, lightning, thunder from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The River King can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the River King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Riparian Weapons
traits.value: The River King's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) poison damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The River King makes two Longsword or Flood Blast attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) slashing damage, or 10 (**1d10 + 5**) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Flood Blast
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away from the River King and knocked prone.

actions.name: Grasping Whirlpool (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The River King magically creates a swirling vortex of water centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The vortex appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 15 feet tall with a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (**8d8**) bludgeoning damage and is restrained. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't restrained, and can choose to be pushed out of the whirlpool's space. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. While restrained, a creature is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, and it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 18 (**4d8**) bludgeoning damage. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take an action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. A creature with a swimming speed has advantage on the saving throw and on the Strength check to escape.

fluffInfo.value: *A charming grey cobblestone bridge arches over a stream of black brackish water. Crawling up and over the sides of the bridge, tendrils of thick black water coalesce into a helmed warrior bearing a sword—which it points toward you, as if daring you to use the bridge.*
River spirits are fey guardians that defend bridges and other crossing points over bodies of water.

fluffInfo.name: Stubborn Guardians
fluffInfo.value: River spirits are called into existence by the magic between water and shore, and they often appear quite suddenly, claiming a crossing point without any warning. Some river spirits allow travelers to pass over their bridges freely, but possessive or ornery spirits might bring all crossing to a complete standstill with challenges or demands. Since river spirits cannot truly die once they have bound themselves to a bridge, getting them to leave inevitably requires negotiation or powerful banishing magic.

fluffInfo.name: Unwavering Loyalty
fluffInfo.value: While river spirits are difficult to reason with, particularly patient or persuasive creatures can forge a friendly bond with them. River spirits may adjust their demands or even agree to guard different crossing points at the request of such a friend. Those who forge such a relationship gain their unwavering loyalty, and such a stout guardian may defend a location often long after the instigating creature has died. Fey bard often name and know of particular river spirits.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Bridge Defender
traits.value: When the river spirit hits a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed becomes 0 until the beginning of the target's next turn. In addition, a river spirit can make an opportunity attack against a creature even if they take the Disengage action before leaving their reach.

traits.name: Duty Bound
traits.value: The river spirit cannot willingly travel more than 300 feet away from the bridge or other location to which they are bound. If the river spirit if forcibly taken beyond this range, they burst into a spray of mist and instantly reappear, standing atop their bridge. If a river spirit is slain, they disappear for 24 hours and then reappear atop their bridge with full hit points.

Stepping-stones. Wherever the river spirit steps, a solid stepping-stone made of water appears. A river spirit can move in this manner in any direction as if they were flying. The stepping-stones created by the river spirit cannot support the weight of any other creatures, just the river spirit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The river spirit makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Liquid Lash
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 25 feet closer to the river spirit.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.value: River can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

actions.name: Force Missile
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) Force damage.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: River casts __Misty Step__ using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

fluffInfo.name: Rivermaw Brawler
fluffInfo.value: Many children in the Rivermaw herd get into friendly brawls, but only the truly dedicated learn the art of fist fighting. Rivermaw brawlers usually lead the charge on the battlefield, using their exceptional strength, speed, and cunning to throw an enemy vanguard into chaos.

Beyond the Dividing Plains, brawlers trained by the Rivermaw can be found in noble adventuring parties, working for the Clasp as muscle, in underground fighting rings, and as personal bodyguards. In Emon, the most famous fist fighters make a name for themselves within the Brawler's League or the Godsbrawl, representing the __The Stormlord__ in that annual holy tournament.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the brawler is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brawler makes three unarmed strikes.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the brawler can choose one of the following additional effects:

entries: **Bruise**: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throws. On a failure, its speed is reduced by 5 feet until it receives at least 1 point of magical healing. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check to heal an affected creature within 5 feet of it (including itself), restoring any lost speed on a success.
**Disarm**: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throws or drop one item it is holding. The brawler can choose which item is dropped, and can pick it up.
**Suplex**: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throws or be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.name: Rivermaw Stormborn
fluffInfo.value: Countless goliath legends tell of heroes born beneath a raging storm: Kaldon Thunderhead, who slew the __ember roc__ of the south; Marydra Skysplitter, who defeated a champion of the __The Ruiner__ in single combat; and Yodrell Rumblechest, who halted a flash flood with only his voice, to name just a few.

Though the stormborn of legend were all half-giants, more and more Rivermaw have begun to feel the __The Stormlord__ power reverberate within them. These peerless warriors are blessed with preternatural skill with a blade and the uncanny ability to command lightning. Often destined to become mythic heroes, stormborn fight with reckless abandon—but many can be distressingly prideful and might need reminding that the songs of defeated or tyrannical stormborn are rarely sung by the bards.

The tyrant Kevdak's fearsome Herd of Storms was so named because of the many stormborn in its ranks, but that herd was broken at Westruun some two decades ago. Now the Rivermaw herd is bolstered by those who were freed from Kevdak's rule. The few stormborn remaining from that broken herd are part of the Rivermaw, and more storm-blessed warriors have been born into the Rivermaw since, ready to forge new legends.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the stormborn can gain Advantage and Disadvantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage and Disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The stormborn makes two greataxe attacks. If it is concentrating on __call lightning__, it can also call down a lightning bolt.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) lightning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The creature is humanoid but disturbingly roachlike. Its legs are too short, its arms too long, and its back is covered by a carapace. Atop those features is an incongruously humanlike face*.

Combining the worst of human and cockroach qualities, these nimble creatures have a talent for stealth and for fighting dirty. Due to their natural resilience against disease, roachlings are comfortable with filth. "Good hygiene" is a foreign concept. This leaves most humanoids repulsed by the roachlings' smell.

fluffInfo.name: Clever Combatants
fluffInfo.value: Though skittish and easily frightened, roachlings are practical, not cowards. They understand survival often depends on remaining unseen and out of reach, and they are adept at hit-and-run tactics.

fluffInfo.name: Cautious and Family-Oriented
fluffInfo.value: Because most humanoids shun roachlings, they are naturally cautious around others, and they extend their trust to non-roachlings slowly. They live and associate with a tight-knit, extended family, which is led by a male or female roachling lord, and they put the needs of their community above all. A roachling away from or without a family often bonds with those it trusts most.

fluffInfo.name: Fused Carapace
fluffInfo.value: Roachlings have prominent, whip-like antennae, a carapace covering much of their backs, and small spines on their legs and arms. They have short, noticeably bowed legs, and their hair is dark. Their thick, hardened skin appears shiny and slightly oily, although it is dr. Roachlings have an internal skeleton, however, not the exoskeleton of a true insect.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.value: The roachling lord is immune to diseases and has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Unpleasant Scent
traits.value: The roachling lord has disadvantage on Wisdom (*Animal Handling*) checks when interacting with Beasts and on Charisma checks when interacting with Humanoids. If the roachling lord bathes meticulously, it loses this trait for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The roachling lord makes two Begrimed Shortsword or Begrimed Dart attacks.

actions.name: Begrimed Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Begrimed Dart
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage.
