traits.name: Born for the Saddle
traits.value: The ooze grips firmly onto any object that is inserted into its body to be used as a saddle. A creature riding the ooze on one such saddle has advantage on saving throws made to avoid being dismounted.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Corrode Object (3/Day)
actions.value: The ooze touches a Medium or smaller nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried, causing it to corrode and dissolve over the course of 1 minute.

fluffInfo.value: In ancient times, the Mirescar was called the Heartwood. It was the domain of a wise and kindly __guardian naga__ named __Sagacitous Erusaire__, who welcomed all with good hearts to share their bounty or receive alms. However, this __naga__ has been corrupted into a cruel shadow of his former self. He and his __diseased grick__ minions have been twisted into hideous, pus-oozing spreaders of disease—and spreading it is now the only thought in their minds. The __naga__ can cast __contagion__ at will, and his __diseased grick__ minions can do so once per day. Is it possible to save the mind of this corrupted guardian?
(See A Sickness Spreads for more information on this NPC.)

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a __wish__ spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: Sage is a one-legged gallus with fluffy, white-grey feathers that resemble fur. She looks and acts like a walking storm cloud but has a soft voice and a kind heart. Sage wears soft linen rags most likely made from discarded pieces of clothing that once belonged to wealthy birdfolk. Each piece looks carefully selected, as if it has a story to tell. A black luma feather on a chain can be spotted around her neck with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (*Perception*) check.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Druidic, Jerbeen, Mapach understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Sage can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

traits.name: Seedspeech
traits.value: Sage can communicate simple ideas to living plants and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, Sage can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Sage can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

actions.name: Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit (+4 to hit with __shillelagh__), reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage, or 11 (**2d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage with __shillelagh__.

fluffInfo.value: The aboleths created the lobster-like chuuls as living weapons and unleashed them against the sahuagin. The high priests of the Eternal Dominion responded by consuming the chuuls and taking their power. A Claw of Sha'argon is a mighty sahuagin champion—an armored powerhouse possessing deep faith and wielding divine power. While barons lead sahuagin into battle, the Claws of Sha'argon are the spiritual leaders of the Eternal Dominion who lead its inquisitions and crush its enemies with claw and spell.

fluffInfo.name: Claw and Tentacle
fluffInfo.value: The powerful claws of a sahuagin priest are deadly weapons. It manipulates objects and casts spells using its facial tentacles. These tentacles are fully prehensile limbs capable of delicate work, but a Claw of Sha'argon has Disadvantage on Strength checks made using its tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Devoted Priests
fluffInfo.value: Only the greatest spiritual leaders of the sahuagin are nominated for the ritual that produces a Claw of Sha'argon, and only those possessing the most unshakable faith survive this agonizing process. The Claws of Sha'argon see themselves as chosen vessels of the Devourer, channeling the fury of the wild. A Claw of Sha'argon casts spells as an 11th-level spellcaster, and those spells listed are typical for a Claw of Sha'argon, but can be replaced with any spell available to a Tempest Cleric (from the Player's Handbook ).

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.value: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.value: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

traits.name: Toughened Carapace
traits.value: Any Critical Hit against the sahuagin becomes a normal hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sahuagin makes three attacks, using Crushing Claw or Cutter Claw in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Crushing Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from the Crushing Claw.

actions.name: Cutter Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**3d12 + 5**) Slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: Gresha was called back in spirit by Lucretia Mathias to tend her namesake chapel. If Saint Gresha is destroyed, Lucretia Mathias calls her spirit back again as soon as possible.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: Saint Gresha can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, Saint Gresha has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.value: Saint Gresha targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under Saint Gresha's control. Saint Gresha can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: Sair doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
actions.value: *Ranged Power Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from Sair.

actions.name: *Mind Scream (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 (**5d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.

fluffInfo.value: *Elemental Font of Wisdom (Crushed opal)*

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 5 Ft., *fly* 30 Ft. (hover; Orb Of Water Only), *swim* 30 Ft., *canHover* (hover)
**Languages**: understands all but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Orb of Water
traits.value: The salmon is surrounded by a sphere of flowing water that moves with it. While inside of the sphere, the salmon has Resistance to Fire damage. A creature that grapples the salmon can choose to pull it out of the orb of water. The orb of water moves up to 20 feet toward the salmon at the start of each of the salmon's turns. If it enters the salmon's space, the Grappled condition ends on the salmon.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.value: The salmon can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The salmon makes two Water Spray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Prophetic Guidance.

actions.name: Water Spray
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Prophetic Guidance (2/Day)
actions.value: A creature the salmon can see within 30 feet gains a flash of foresight. Once in the next minute, when the creature fails a D20 Test, it can roll 1d4 and add it to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success.

fluffInfo.value: *The creature's skin sparkles with fine salt crystals as it brandishes a scimitar and jagged claws.*

fluffInfo.name: Sparkly Crystals
fluffInfo.value: Salt devils have sharp, crystalline teeth, sparkling skin studded with fine salt crystals, and long claws that leave jagged, burning wounds. They can also fight with salt‑encrusted blades seemingly forged from thin air.

fluffInfo.name: Servants of Mammon
fluffInfo.value: Salt devils claim to serve the devil-god Mammon. They often ally with gnolls and slavers with whom they seek out oases to use as ambush sites or just to poison the water.

fluffInfo.name: Slavers and Corruptors
fluffInfo.value: Salt devils create slave markets and salt mines, where they thrive on the misery of those indentured into their service. They often forge alliances with mortals when partners are needed for an endeavor, and they are less grasping and greedy than one might expect of Mammon's servants, preferring to encourage corruption in others.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the salt devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The salt devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Salt-Encrusted Hide
traits.value: A creature that touches the salt devil or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (**1d6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The salt devil makes two Scimitar attacks and one Water-Draining Claw attack.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Water-Draining Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Plants, Oozes, and creatures with the Amphibious, Water Breathing, or Water Form traits have disadvantage on this saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target also suffers one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Teleport (3/Day)
actions.value: The salt devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fluffInfo.value: *A crudely sculpted, roughly humanoid crystalline form shuffles about on wide, stump-like feet. Tiny salt crystals fall from its body in a glittering cloud with every step.*

fluffInfo.name: Coastal Druids
fluffInfo.value: These unnatural creatures are created by druids and others living in coastal or desert regions, or by those who seek to wage war with creatures susceptible to the warding powers of salt. Stories tell of a druid who built a squad of nine salt golems to combat a rampaging zmey. The salt warriors waged a long hunt and eventually killed the powerful dragon in its lair while the creator druid and her wizard companion reaped the spoils of its hoard.

fluffInfo.name: Crystalline and Silent
fluffInfo.value: A salt golem has a crudely formed humanoid body made of crystalline salts. It wears no clothing or armor and carries no weapons or other possessions. It cannot speak—the only sound it makes is the susurrus of sliding sand as it moves. A salt golem is incapable of strategy or tactics. It mindlessly fights until it destroys its opponents or until ordered to stop by its creator.

fluffInfo.name: Valuable Remains
fluffInfo.value: A salt golem stands about eight feet tall and weighs around 1,000 pounds. A salt golem's body is formed from a composite of 1,000 pounds of rare salts and minerals worth at least 2,500 gp.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Blinding Salt Spray
traits.value: When the salt golem takes damage, thousands of tiny salt crystals erupt from the golem's body, and each creature within 5 feet of the golem must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Dehydrating Fists
traits.value: The salt golem's Slam attacks are magical. When the golem hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra **4d8** necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The salt golem makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.value: [he/him]

A venerable and notorious dusk corvum pirate with dark plumage flecked with mottled grey specks, and a fierce, three-pronged silver hook in place of his right claw. Saltfeather has a deep hatred for __Petra Cloudburst__, owing to their last encounter in which she sliced off his claw.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Jerbeen, Tilia, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Saltfeather can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Saltfeather cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Hook and Talon
traits.value: Saltfeather has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks to climb any surface his talons and silvered hook-hand could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: Saltfeather deals an extra 17 **5d6** damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Saltfeather that isn't incapacitated and Saltfeather doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.value: Saltfeather has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in dim light or darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Saltfeather makes three melee attacks: two with his cutlass and one with his hook.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hook
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) piercing damage. On a successful hit, Saltfeather may spend a bonus action to grapple the target (escape DC 11). A target who escapes from this grapple must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**2d4**) piercing damage from the hook. This is a silvered weapon.

actions.name: Talon
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bomb (3/Day)
actions.value: After sparking his hook to light the fuse, Saltfeather lobs an iron shell filled with alchemical explosives. Choose a point within 60 feet of Saltfeather that he can see. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must attempt a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage and 14 (**4d6**) piercing damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When the knight dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The knight is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Slashing damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 (**2d8**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Lay on Hands (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: The knight touches another creature. The target regains 11 (2d8 + 2) Hit Points and is cured of one disease or the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When the monk dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Sanctified Monk is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While the monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The monk makes three Unarmed Strike attacks or five Dart attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Flame Step
bonusActions.value: The monk teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that is in Bright Light. It gains Advantage on its next melee attack.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When the sanctified soul dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The sanctified soul is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 (**1d8 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Guiding Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This withered crone glares malevolently, her face framed by lank, gray hair. Her malicious grin is filled with shark teeth and drool trickles from her lips.*

fluffInfo.name: Hatred of Beauty
fluffInfo.value: Dressed in tattered robes and skeletally thin, sand hags are terrifying crones that haunt desert ruins and forgotten oases. Their hatred for things of beauty and peace is terrible to behold. A sand hag uses her illusions and mimicry to lure travelers into an ambush.

fluffInfo.name: False Oasis
fluffInfo.value: These hags delight in tricking a caravan into an illusory oasis, killing all the riding animals and pack animals so the travelers can't flee, and then terrifying and slaughtering them one by one.

fluffInfo.name: Drain Bodies
fluffInfo.value: For the slaughter of animals or humanoids, a sand hag prefers to rely on her claws, which drain the moisture from her victims. They leave the mummified remnants in postures of life—tied to a saddle or atop a guard tower—to terrify others.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The sand hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The sand hag can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Scorpion Walk
traits.value: Difficult terrain composed of sand or gravel doesn't cost the hag extra movement. In addition, while in sandy terrain, she doesn't leave tracks and has tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes three Claw attacks. If two Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. A creature can't suffer more than two levels of exhaustion from this effect.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.value: The sand hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

actions.name: Scouring Sirocco (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sand hag generates a blast of hot wind and sand in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) slashing damage and 9 (**2d8**) fire damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The area is heavily obscured by airborne sand until the start of the sand hag's next turn.

traits.name: Desert Camouflage
traits.value: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d8 + 2**) piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. While poisoned in this way, the target takes another 4 (**1d8**) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the lizard hits the poisoned target with this attack, the damage dealt at the start of each of its turns increases by 4 (1d8). If the poisoned target receives magical healing or a creature uses a healer's kit on the target, the target can repeat the Constitution saving throw, ending the poisoned condition on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Venom
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. *Hit:* The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) acid damage and 18 (**4d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.value: *A person made of sand emerges from the dune, a sandstorm of wailing souls swirling around it.*
Sand silhouettes are spirits of those who died in desperation in sandy ground, buried during sandstorms, thrown into dry wells, or the victims of a dune collapse.

fluffInfo.name: Sand Bodies
fluffInfo.value: If disturbed or agitated, these restless souls cause the sand around them to swirl and form into a loose vortex that vaguely resembles their physical body in life. They can control these shapes as they controlled their physical bodies.

fluffInfo.name: Traceless Movement
fluffInfo.value: Sand silhouettes glide through the sand without leaving a trace or creating any telltale sign of their approach, which makes it easy for them to surprise even cautious travelers with sudden attacks from below.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Sand Camouflage
traits.value: The sand silhouette has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in desert terrain.

traits.name: Sand Form
traits.value: The sand silhouette can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sand Glide
traits.value: The sand silhouette can burrow through nonmagical, loose sand without disturbing the material it is moving through.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The sand silhouette doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Water Hypersusceptibility
traits.value: For every 5 feet the sand silhouette moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 (**1d4**) cold damage. In addition, the silhouette takes 10 cold damage when it starts its turn at least partially submerged in water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sand silhouette makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the silhouette uses its Engulf on the target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The sand silhouette engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded and restrained, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the sand silhouette's turns or take 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the sand silhouette moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The sand silhouette can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

actions.name: Haunted Haboob (3/Day)
actions.value: The sand silhouette creates a storm of whirling sand and wailing souls around itself. The storm is a 10-foot radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder centered on the silhouette and moves with the silhouette for 1 minute, until it ends the storm as a bonus action, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). The sandstorm's area is lightly obscured, and a creature that starts its turn in the sandstorm's area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage and be frightened for 1 minute. An engulfed creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: **Senses**: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.value: The spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has *surprised*.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.value: The spider can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Seize
traits.value: If the spider has advantage on an attack roll and hits a creature that is Large or smaller, the creature is also grappled (escape DC 14).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

fluffInfo.value: *Two speckled, tan legs erupt from the sand, plunging forward with murderous speed. The legs are quickly followed by the body of a large, orange and tan furred spider.*

fluffInfo.name: Drag Prey into Tunnels
fluffInfo.value: Sand spiders lurk beneath the arid plains and dry grasslands. These carnivores hunt desert dwellers and plains travelers by burrowing into loose sand so they are completely hidden from view. When prey walks over their trap, the spider lunges up from hiding, snares the prey, and drags it down beneath the sand, where it can wrap the prey in webbing before quickly stabbing it to death.

fluffInfo.name: Spider Packs
fluffInfo.value: More terrifying than a lone sand spider is a group of sand spiders hunting together. They build connected lair networks called clusters, containing one female and two or three males. They work together with one sand spider attacking to draw attention, and the others attacking from trapdoors in the opposite direction, behind the skirmish line.

traits.name: Sand Camouflage
traits.value: The sand spider has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sand spider makes one Bite attack and two Impaling Leg attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Impaling Leg
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the sand spider can't use the same Impaling Leg on another target. The sand spider has four Impaling Legs.

fluffInfo.value: *Stick-thin and moon-faced with a raptor's eyes and a mane of hawk feathers, this grinning humanoid pirouettes as nimbly as a dancer. Between its long, taloned fingers trickles sand that gleams with the cold light of stars.*

fluffInfo.name: Bringers of Nightmares
fluffInfo.value: Sandmen are sinister-looking bringers of sleep and dreams. Visiting the mortal world each night, sandmen ensure that their targets slumber deeply and experience vivid dreams that swell the dream realm's power. Some sandmen develop a talent for a specific flavor of dream; fantasies of lost love or childhood, prophecies and religious visions, or terrible nightmares.

fluffInfo.name: Abduct Dreamers
fluffInfo.value: Powerful dreamers attract both the attention and the protection of sandmen: children, madmen, would-be tyrants, and heroes. They protect such charges fiercely but have also been known to abduct them, taking them on wild adventures to inspire yet greater dreams. To them, all dreams are vital and good, be they uplifting or terrifying. Although they bring horrific nightmares as well as idyllic dreams, sandmen are not specifically baneful. Their actions are motivated by their connection to the dream realm, not by concerns over good and evil.

fluffInfo.name: Ethereal Dreamscapes
fluffInfo.value: When not on the Material Plane, sandmen ride bubble-like dreamscapes through the Ethereal Plane, breaching the Sea of Possibilities, nurturing and harvesting its contents. Sandmen are a common and welcome sight in markets across the Fey Realms, elemental planes, and even in Hell—anywhere that dreams or nightmares are a valuable commodity. They are merciless to any who threaten the sanctity of dreams, but especially dream eaters.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The sandman has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stuff of Dreams
traits.value: Made partially from dreams and imagination, the sandman isn't fully real. Any critical hit against the sandman is a normal hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sandman makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Dreamer's Sand, if available.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage. Damage from this attack doesn't wake an unconscious creature, unless the unconscious creature is below half its hp maximum. If the sandman scores a critical hit, the target is cursed with the eye-closer's curse. While cursed, the creature is blinded until it finishes a long rest or until the curse is lifted by remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Encourage Dreams (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sandman encourages powerful dreams in the minds of up to three unconscious creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, nightmares fill the target's mind, and the target takes 35 (**10d6**) psychic damage, wakes from its sleep, and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, pleasant dreams fill the target's mind, and the target regains 10 3d6 hp and can choose to remain unconscious or awaken. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Dreamer's Sand (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sandman throws magical sand in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

fluffInfo.value: *The large, bleached bones protruding from the desert sand suddenly shift and reveal themselves to be the boney spikes of a great reptile.*

fluffInfo.name: Hidden by Sand
fluffInfo.value: These lethargic, horned, yellow-scaled lizards spend most of their lives underground, lying in wait under the desert sand with their long-necked, spine-tailed bulk hidden below the surface. Only the long, jagged bones lining their backs are exposed. These bones resemble a sun-bleached ribcage so perfectly that it attracts carrion birds—and curious travelers. When prey passes between the "ribs," the sandwyrm snaps the rows of bone tightly over its prey. Once its victim is restrained, the sandwyrm paralyzes its meal with repeated stings before carrying it away.

fluffInfo.name: Torpid and Slow
fluffInfo.value: Sandwyrms sometimes wait for weeks in torpid hibernation before footsteps on the sand alert it to a fresh meal approaching. To guard against lean weeks, sandwyrms store excess prey in subterranean lairs. They're not above eating carrion if fresh meat isn't available. When outmatched in a fight, sandwyrms retreat to their lairs with their paralyzed prey.

fluffInfo.name: Peculiar Drakes
fluffInfo.value: Sandwyrms evolved as an offshoot to drakes or wyverns rather than from true dragons; their anatomy suggests they were originally four-limbed creatures and that their forearms are recent additions to the animal's body. The bones on their backs may have once been wings, suggesting that sandwyrms are the remnants of some primordial, winged reptiles that migrated to the deep deserts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sandwyrm makes one Bite attack, one Gore attack, and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d12 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 9 (**1d4 + 5**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

fluffInfo.value: *The Amethyst Academy produces talented warlocks and wizards. Vampires do something similar.*

fluffInfo.name: Twisted Mages
fluffInfo.value: When a mageborn is bitten by a vampire, the magical energies flowing in their now-tainted blood create a Sanguine Witch. A creature of both vampiric bloodlust and arcane might. These witches serve as right hands to vampire nobility and as generals and lieutenants in vampire armies.They are cunning and manipulative creatures who lure victims with deception and wit.

fluffInfo.name: Arcane Blood
fluffInfo.value: Sanguine Witches are mageborn but their magic energies are stunted and twisted; they can use magic to absorb life essence from their victims and live unnatural lives.
The more a Sanguine Witch feeds, the more the vampiric essence mutates with their arcane blood. Sanguine Witches often take on grotesque mutations from this otherworldly mixing.
Notably, many Sanguine Witches have acquired blood red glowing eyes and animalistic snouts and fangs.

fluffInfo.name: Mages of the Court
fluffInfo.value: Sanguine Witches stand as the chosen court mages to vampire masters. They perform all the duties a court mage would usually do, but their loyalty to the Court of the Night is unbreaking. Their mastery over undeath, and their ability to warp victims into vampiric thralls makes them a terrifying creature to behold

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Sanguine Witch, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unnatural Resistances
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Siphon Vitality
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Feast action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Caster
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature possesses formidable spellcasting abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Sanguine Witch uses __Darkness__ to hide themselves and attempt to enthrall subjects with __Hold Person__ before using Feast to feed on them. The witch's goal is to create thralls of their opponents.
If the Sanguine Witch is in direct sunlight, or at less than half their Hit Points, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes two attacks and uses Feast, if available. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**5d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. The target has the Weakened condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

actions.name: Feast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the vampire. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: The vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Aura of Punishment
traits.value: Whenever a hostile creature within 10 feet of the sanguinor takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 (**1d10**) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The sanguinor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The sanguinor's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the sanguinor can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sanguinor makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with its trident. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one trident attack.

actions.name: Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (3d4 + 8) piercing plus 13 (**3d8**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Trident
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d6 + 8**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Boil Blood (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sanguinor attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (**6d12**) fire damage and 39 (**6d12**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is poisoned by a sanguinor's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks; frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Aura of Valor
traits.value: Friendly creatures wielding weapons within 30 feet of the valkyrie have advantage on weapon attack rolls and ability checks. At the start of each of its turns, the valkyrie can choose to exclude any number of friendly creatures from this aura (no action required).

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.value: The valkyrie doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The valkyrie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Radiant Weapons
traits.value: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 16 (**3d10**) radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The valkyrie can use its Gaze of Doom. It then makes two Longsword attacks and one Spear attack, or it makes three Radiant Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 16 (**3d10**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage, or 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 16 (**3d10**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**4d10 + 4**) radiant damage.

actions.name: Gaze of Doom
actions.value: The valkyrie's gaze foretells a doomed fate for one creature the valkyrie can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
actions.value: The valkyrie touches another creature. The target magically regains 21 6d6 hp and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

fluffInfo.value: *The axe mark in the tree oozes with viscous sap that forms into a small, vaguely humanoid shape at the tree's roots. It half walks and half flows forward.*

fluffInfo.name: Tree Oozes
fluffInfo.value: Despite the name, sap demons aren't true demons. They are sentient oozes that form when an enchanted tree is cut or injured. A few hours after the injury, they pool into a shape that vaguely resembles their tree's attacker; if the tree cutter had a beard, the sap demon's human-like head drips in the vague shape of a beard. After dispatching the tree's attacker, most sap demons return to the tree, though some remain curious or malevolent enough to continue exploring the world.

fluffInfo.name: Reckless Possessors
fluffInfo.value: A sap demon earns its name from its ability to possess another creature by oozing down its throat. Once inside, the sap demon makes the host bleed as the tree bled and is reckless with the body. However, no matter how the body is bandaged or cured, the host perpetually bleeds.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The sap demon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.value: The sap demon doesn't require sleep.

traits.name: Season's Change
traits.value: If the sap demon takes fire damage, its speed is increased by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. If it takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sap demon makes two Slam or Lob Sap attacks. If both Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the creature is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Lob Sap
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Soul Sap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: One humanoid the sap demon is grappling or that is incapacitated within 5 feet of the sap demon must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be possessed by the sap demon. The sap demon then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The sap demon now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ooze can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that restore a creature's hp maximum. The ooze retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma and condition immunities. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

While possessed, the target's body seeps blood out of its ears, nose, and eyes, and the target takes 2 (**1d4**) acid damage at the end of each hour. Its hp maximum is also reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the possession ends. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hp, the ooze ends it as a bonus action, or the ooze is forced out by an effect like the __greater restoration__ spell. When the possession ends, the ooze reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this sap demon's Soul Sap for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

fluffInfo.value: *The sarcophagus opens to reveal an eerie, scintillating light. Wisps of gelid amber ectoplasm undulate outward from a quivering mass with a blackened skull at its center.*

fluffInfo.name: Vigilant Slime
fluffInfo.value: Sarcophagus slimes are amorphous undead guardians placed in the tombs of the powerful to guard them and to wreak terrible vengeance on would-be defilers of the ancient crypts. The slimes seethe with baleful energy, and their blackened skulls retain a simple watchfulness.

fluffInfo.name: Muddled Origins
fluffInfo.value: Many sages speculate that the first sarcophagus slime was spawned accidentally, in a mummy creation ritual that gave life to the congealed contents of canopic jars rather than the intended, mummified body. Others maintain sarcophagus slime was created by a powerful necromancer-pharaoh bent on formulating the perfect alchemical sentry to guard his crypt.

fluffInfo.name: Death to Tomb Robbers
fluffInfo.value: These ectoplasmic slimes are the bane of burglars and a constant danger for excavators and antiquarians exploring ruins or tombs. The rituals for their creation have not been entirely lost; modern necromancers still create these undead abominations for their own fell purposes, and tomb robbers are turned into slimes if they lack proper caution.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The sarcophagus slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The sarcophagus slime doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sarcophagus slime can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one Slam attack with a use of Corrupting Gaze.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) acid damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Gaze
actions.value: One creature the sarcophagus slime can see within 30 feet of it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain by this effect rises 24 hours later as a sarcophagus slime, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.value: Each creature of the sarcophagus slime's choice that is within 60 feet of the sarcophagus slime and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the sarcophagus slime's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *This titanic worm's rocky hide is rough and hard as stone. Its yawning gullet writhes with miniature worms like itself.*

fluffInfo.name: Elemental Predators
fluffInfo.value: Sathaq worms are nightmarish predators from the Plane of Elemental Earth with rugged brown hide embedded with stones. They devour stone and flesh with equal ease.

fluffInfo.name: Guts Filled with Larvae
fluffInfo.value: Sathaq worms are solitary; they approach each other only to mate. Their young incubate inside the worms' gullets. Creatures they swallow are simultaneously digested by the parent worm and devoured by the larvae.

fluffInfo.name: Painful Presence
fluffInfo.value: Ultrasonic noise and magical ripples that tear at flesh and bone make the very presence of a sathaq worm extremely uncomfortable for creatures of the Material Plane.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: acid, poison; exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands Deep Speech and Terran but can't speak

traits.name: Agonizing Aura
traits.value: The sathaq worm emits ultrasonic noise and minor vibrations that cause pain and subtly disrupt the functions of most creatures. A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the sathaq worm must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. Creatures with resistance or immunity to thunder damage automatically succeed on the saving throw.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.value: The sathaq worm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the worm doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Earthen Camouflage
traits.value: The sathaq worm has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in sandy, muddy, or rocky terrain.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The sathaq worm deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sathaq worm makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**4d8 + 6**) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the sathaq worm can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: The sathaq worm makes one Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm (including the worm's Agonizing Aura), and takes 10 (**3d6**) piercing damage and 10 (**3d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the sathaq worm's turns. The sathaq worm can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the sathaq worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the sathaq worm must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the sathaq worm. If the sathaq worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

fluffInfo.value: *A porcupine-quilled creature built like a grizzly bear with claws and fangs like scimitars rises on its hind legs. Its forelegs are mangled and scabbed, and its eyes shine with hatred and anticipation.*

fluffInfo.name: Driven by Dark Spirits
fluffInfo.value: While many druids claim these bear-like animals are not cursed or enchanted, the savager's habit of killing any living creature on sight is not natural behavior. Hunger doesn't explain their attacks, since savagers eat only part of their kills before abandoning the meal and looking for other animals to attack. Some dark forest spirit drives them.

fluffInfo.name: Gnaws Itself
fluffInfo.value: When there are no other creatures nearby to attack, a savager gnaws on its own forelimbs, resulting in scabs, scars, and calluses so thick and numb that they protect the savager from even the sharpest of swords.

fluffInfo.name: Rare Meetings
fluffInfo.value: The only creature a savager won't attack on sight is another savager, giving each other a wide berth or meeting briefly to produce young. A savager litter contains anywhere from ten to twenty-five cubs, all of them born able to walk and fend for themselves.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Mighty Swing
traits.value: If the savager doesn't move during its turn, it has advantage on the next Claw attack it makes before the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Spines
traits.value: A creature that touches the savager or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**2d4**) piercing damage. In addition, a creature grappled by or grappling the savager takes 5 (**2d4**) piercing damage at the start of the savager's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The savager makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) slashing damage as the savager rips into the target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d12 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Scanlan Shorthalt
fluffInfo.value: Bard extraordinaire, champion of the __The Knowing Mentor__, and braggadocious hero of all Exandria, Scanlan Shorthalt is the kind of adventurer who will never let you forget his name. He's personally ensured that the bards spreading his legend across the world will sing his praises for decades to come.

fluffInfo.name: After the Epilogue
fluffInfo.value: Scanlan has always been a self-centered, showboating braggart, but it doesn't mean he doesn't have a heart. These days, friendship and family mean more to him than anything, even if he's still not very good at showing it.

Following the defeat of __The Whispered One__, Scanlan eventually proposed to his long-pursued sweetheart, __Pike Trickfoot__, and they were married in a grand ceremony. The duo had a pair of children, one named Juniper (Juni) and the other named Wilhand'ildan (Wax). When the children were grown and in school, __Pike__ and Scanlan amicably divorced and went their separate ways, remaining good friends—and occasional lovers—but content to follow their own paths.

Scanlan is approaching a century of life, but as a long-lived gnome, his looks are much as they were in his adventuring days except for his slowly receding hairline and the slight belly he's developed. Vanity dies slowly, though, and he hides even this modest amount of aging with a comb-over, frequent use of his trademark beret, and well-placed illusion magic when he needs to look portrait perfect.

Scanlan likes to sing songs of the Vox Machina days to crowded houses in cities across Tal'Dorei. He spends his winters in Ank'Harel, where he and his daughter Kaylie operate their high-end trading business, Meatman Imports & Sexports. It's a good job that keeps him constantly traveling around Exandria, suiting his interest in seeking out new people and places around the world—and for new performance venues and places to get into trouble.
Also, he has a mustache now. He thinks it makes him look distinguished.

entries: **AC**: 16 (+2 Studded Leather Armor Of Acid Resistance And +2 Ring Of Protection)
**Skills**: acrobatics +5, arcana +8, athletics +6, deception +16, intimidation +11, investigation +13, performance +16, persuasion +16

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.value: Scanlan has Advantage and Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Focused
traits.value: Scanlan has Advantage and Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain *concentration* on spells.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: Scanlan wields Mythcarver, wears +2 Studded Leather Armor of Acid Resistance and a ring of protection with a +2 bonus, and carries a hat of disguise and a wand of magic missiles.

traits.name: Toughness
traits.value: Scanlan has an additional 40 hit points.

actions.name: Mythcarver
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage and 3 (**1d6**) force damage.

bonusActions.name: Arcane Fist (8th Level)
bonusActions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 45 (**10d8**) force damage. Scanlan can use this bonus action only while concentrating on the __Bigby's Hand__ spell.

bonusActions.name: Bardic Inspiration (6/resting)
bonusActions.value: Scanlan grants a Bardic Inspiration die to one creature other than himself within 60 feet of him who can hear him. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll a d12 and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throws it makes. When Scanlan uses this ability, he gains Advantage and Disadvantage on attack rolls with Mythcarver until the end of his turn.

bonusActions.name: __Healing Word__ (5th Level)
bonusActions.value: Scanlan casts __healing word__, restoring 18 (5d4 + 6) hit points to himself or another creature he can see within 60 feet of him.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.value: In the first round of a combat, the scarapit has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprise.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The scarapit has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Noxious Resilience
traits.value: The scarapit can breathe normally in any environment, and it has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as __cloudkill__ and __stinking cloud__ effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The scarapit can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Subterranean Explorer
traits.value: While the scarapit is underground, it always knows how far it is from the surface, it can't be Surprise while it isn't incapacitated, and it has advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks made to track creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage, or 21 (**4d8 + 3**) piercing damage if the target is Surprise, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +10, perception +8, sleight of hand +10, stealth +13

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.value: During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn't taken a turn.
The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: Scarlet deals an extra 14 (**4d6**) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Scarlet who isn't incapacitated and Scarlet doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Scarlet makes three Shadow Blade or three Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Shadow Blade
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) necrotic damage. If a target is hit by two or more Shadow Blade attacks on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Razor Garrote
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, they take 22 (**5d8**) slashing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Scarlet can't attack another target.

actions.name: Umbral Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Scarlet exhales dark flame in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (**8d6**) necrotic damage and is frightened of Scarlet for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: Scarlet takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: deception +3 plus PB, insight +1 plus PB, persuasion +3 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **2d4 plus PB** damage. Beginning at 7th level, the schemer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Promises and Lies (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the schemer turns enemies into allies. Each creature within 30 feet of the schemer who can hear them and who understand Common or Infernal must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the schemer for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, a creature can't willingly harm any of the schemer's allies. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on themself on a success.

actions.name: 7th Level: Turncoat (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the schemer chooses up to PB creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Charisma saving throw or make an attack against their nearest ally (no action required). A creature charmed by the schemer automatically fails this saving throw.

fluffInfo.value: *The small, dwarf-like creature is bootless with broken, dirty toenails and wearing rough burlap and a leather tam hat. It brandishes a pick as it grins maliciously.*
*When a scheznyki dies or 24 hours after its hat is stolen, its hat is imbued with the scheznyki's magic and becomes a vanisher hat.*

fluffInfo.name: Corrupted Dwarves
fluffInfo.value: These small, vicious, dwarf-like fey haunt abandoned quarries and ancient ruins, killing and robbing unsuspecting visitors. Legend says the scheznykis are lazy dwarves corrupted by the fey, though others claim that these are dwarves who swore allegiance to fey lords and ladies long ago.

fluffInfo.name: Magical Hats
fluffInfo.value: Scheznykis prize their tam hats and viciously hunt down any who steal their hats. When a scheznyki dies or if its hat is separated from it for more than 24 hours, some of the scheznyki's magic imbues the hat (see Scheznyki's Hat sidebar).

fluffInfo.name: Arcane Beards
fluffInfo.value: The majority of a scheznyki's magic is tied to its beard, and its beard hair is a valuable component for creating exotic inks. If the majority of its beard is cut off, the scheznyki can't cast spells until its beard regrows. If the scheznyki loses its hat and beard within the same 24-hour period, it falls into a deep, wasting coma and dies in 24 hours, crumbling to dust. If its beard is magically mended or regrown, or its hat restored to its head before this happens, the scheznyki recovers immediately.

traits.name: Beard Weakness
traits.value: A creature grappling the scheznyki can take its action to cut off the scheznyki's beard by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check while holding an edged weapon. If its beard is cut off, the scheznyki can't use Spellcasting until its beard regrows.

traits.name: Brute
traits.value: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the scheznyki hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The scheznyki has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The scheznyki makes three War Pick or Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**3d6 + 3**) force damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The scheznyki magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its *concentration* ends (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Any equipment it wears or carries is invisible with it.

fluffInfo.value: Trained as part guardian and part assassin, the cultists of Selket are organized into cells that strike in the name of the Scorpion Goddess. The scorpion cultists watch for those who blaspheme the name of their goddess or defile her sacred places. Their enemies find themselves the target of poisoned blades or an apparent accident, while those who praise Selket or care for the desert nomads are quietly helped. On special missions, scorpion cultists might doff their traditional garb and infiltrate towns or cities.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.value: The scorpion cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.value: The scorpion cultist has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks.

traits.name: Scorpion's Blessing
traits.value: The scorpion cultist has advantage on saving throws against poison. In addition, when the scorpion cultist hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **1d4** poison damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

fluffInfo.value: *When you've been around the beat as long as me, you learn to pick up a trick or two. Take anything you can get, it might mean you win the next big score, or just live another day.* - Blackjack Mel

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +5, deception +6, sleight of hand +5, stealth +7
**Languages**: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.value: On each of its turns, the scoundrel can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.value: The scoundrel deals an extra 14 **4d6** damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the scoundrel that isn't incapacitated and the scoundrel doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The sporehusk regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Grab
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Reautomata Each successful check reveals one of the following pieces of information:

fluffInfo.name: (16+) Dispassionate Metal and Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: (19+) Limb Weapons.

fluffInfo.name: (21+) Focused Killer.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Reautomata fight with outward ferocity and aggressive attacks which belie the cold, unfeeling calculation at the core of each solider. In battle, Reautomata launch themselves towards their foes in great leaps, impaling their targets upon their rending arm blades. The rending blades flense into flesh and latch on like hooks, allowing the Reautomata to restrain their targets. They then use their great strength to rend apart their restrained victims.

Reautomata unquestionably obey the orders of their creator and will fight until destroyed without regard for their own bodies. However, even with only general instructions, Reautomata fight intelligently and know how to utilize the environment to their advantage, making use of their climb speeds and jumping ability to prioritize dangerous targets.

fluffInfo.value: *This aquamarine dragon has a shark's head that tapers off into a sleek eel-like body. Its large fins double as wings.*

*Every sea dragon is devoted to the dragon god of the sea. As a result, many sea dragons use the innate spellcasting variant. Sea dragons favor spells that manipulate water or the weather, emulate storms, deal lightning or cold damage, divine the future, or conjure sea creatures to fight alongside the dragon.*

*Sea dragons are the offspring of Seggotan, the dragon god of time and the sea. A sea dragon shares its god's idea that everything in the sea is the property of Seggotan, and they expect lesser beings to respect that truth. The sea dragons are among the most powerful allies of the Mharoti Empire, securing seaways and acting as a communion point for the tidal priests. Thankfully for the Empire's enemies, the most ancient sea dragons are too consumed with contemplation of time and their inscrutable duties in the depths of the ocean to make war.*

fluffInfo.name: Divine Dragons
fluffInfo.value: Sea dragons are the children of the ocean and believe they are semi-divine beings, worthy of worship. Given their size and power, they might be right; certainly, they are often companions or steeds to gods of the sea. Despite the solemn duties the sea dragons invoke thanks to their lineage, they are extremely whimsical. While these immense creatures are playful, their games can shatter hulls and drown sailors. The sea dragons course through the waves with tangible joy as they hunt whales and entire schools of tuna.

fluffInfo.name: Shipwreck Art
fluffInfo.value: Sea dragons love collecting treasure. They especially prize the sunken, treasure-filled hulls of ships lost to storm, battle, or their own handiwork. While they appreciate all wealth, they prefer hardy items that stand up to long exposure to sea water. Precious metals and gemstones add a dramatic luster to the dragon's lair when they catch stray beams of light. Sea dragons take more perishable treasures and place them on a reef-altar, to dissolve in the sea as a tithe to the sea gods.

fluffInfo.name: Sunken Memorials
fluffInfo.value: A sea dragon's lair is littered with meticulously arranged ships consigned to the deeps. These wrecks are often artfully smashed to allow the treasures in the hold to spill out onto the sea floor. It may seem haphazard, but it displays a complex aesthetic that only other sea dragons can truly appreciate. Because they arrange these wrecks so carefully, a dragon notices immediately if its hoard is disturbed.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Wash Away (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the apprentice rides a crashing wave. They make a signature attack against an enemy within 5 feet of them and move up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the attack hits, it deals an extra **PB** bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Ride the Lightning (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the apprentice supercharges their foe's nervous system. The apprentice makes a signature attack, and if it deals damage to a creature, the target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is incapacitated and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: 7th Level: Drown (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the apprentice chooses three creatures the apprentice can see within 60 feet of them. Each target feels as though their lungs are filling with water and must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. A creature who can breathe water or who doesn't need air automatically succeeds on this saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **PBd8** force damage, and for 1 minute, they can't speak, their speed is halved, and they are dazed (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect. Another creature within 5 feet of a target can use their action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength (*Athletics*) or Intelligence (*Medicine*) check, ending the effect on a success.

traits.value: A creature that touches the Seaweed Elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become Restrained by the elemental. The Restrained creature can spend its action to attempt the saving throw again, ending the effect on a success. If the elemental moves more than 10 feet away from the Restrained creature, the effect ends.

traits.name: False Appearance
