traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: The seed coin is indistinguishable from a normal copper piece. However, a creature that has truesight sees a deep red aura radiating from the seed coin, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a __detect poison and disease__ spell senses the insidious nature of the seed coin and knows it is a plant creature.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.value: The seed coin doesn't require sleep. If the seed coin spends 1 minute in direct sunlight or a creature spends 1 hour in direct sunlight while the seed coin is on the creature's person, the seed coin receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the seed coin dies, it becomes an ordinary copper piece.

actions.name: Infestation
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +0 to hit, reach 0 ft., one humanoid that has the seed coin on its person. *Hit:* The creature must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or its mind becomes imperceptibly infected with a disease until the seed coin is no longer on the creature's person or the creature dies. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this disease, and a creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this disease for the next 30 days. The seed coin's influence invades a diseased creature's mind, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to 1d12 + the creature's Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes charmed for the rest of the duration and refuses to part with the seed coin.

If a diseased creature dies while the seed coin is on its person, it immediately regains all its hit points and becomes a __seed coin pollinator__, as the seed coin takes over its body. The seed coin doesn't gain access to the creature's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies while controlling a creature in this way. This infestation lasts until the __seed coin pollinator__ dies, killing the seed coin.

traits.name: False Appearance

traits.name: Unusual Nature

actions.name: Coin Spray (Recharge 5-6)

The target must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**4d4**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, one of the seed coins gets lodged on the target's body (for example, in a pocket or a fold in its clothing).

fluffInfo.value: *This grinning humanoid looks like a handsome man, if not for his glowing red eyes, insectoid legs, and antennae.*

fluffInfo.name: Dark Satyrs
fluffInfo.value: The selang or dark satyrs are twisted and vicious fauns who have abandoned nature worship and instead venerate ancient gods of deep and malign intelligence. Selangs seek to help those evil gods enter the mortal world by opening dark portals and bridging a path to realms beyond mortal understanding.

fluffInfo.name: Battle Song and Laughter
fluffInfo.value: Selangs relish battle, pain, and torture. They find violence thrilling and bloodshed exciting, and they often laugh, sing, and boast shamelessly during combat. Although they are the diplomats and spokesmen of the old gods, their manic speech and alien logic can sometimes be hard to follow. They are most comfortable with the slithering tones of Void Speech.

fluffInfo.name: Blasphemous Music
fluffInfo.value: Selang cults and settlements are often found at the sites sacred to the dark gods, making hypnotic and alien harmonies with swarms of dorreqi. They are rarely the strongest soldiers, instead encouraging evil humanoids or other creatures of martial mien to fill the ranks, while the dark satyrs use their magic and poison against their foes.

traits.name: Poisoned Weapons

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Dagger

actions.name: Alien Piping

entries: **Capering**: On the target's next turn, it must use all of its movement dancing without leaving its space, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.
**Captivating**: The target is charmed until the end of its next turn, humming along to the selang's pleasant melody.
**Disorienting**: The target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn, and when it moves, it moves in a random direction.

**Drowsy**: The target falls unconscious and dreams of evil entities and sinister portals for 10 minutes. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
**Haunting**: The target is frightened until the end of its next turn, and it must take the Dash action and move away from the selang by the safest available route, unless there is nowhere to move.
**AC**: 12 In Fey Form or 14 In Seal Form
**Speed**: *walk* 30 Ft., *swim* 30 Ft., *walk* 20 Ft. (in Seal Form), *swim* 50 Ft. (in Seal Form)

Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies. If the selkie is in its true form, it can't use this Bonus Action unless it is wearing or carrying its bound sealskin.

bonusActions.name: Charming Escape

actions.name: Black Feather Storm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Senmo flaps its twisted wings, unleashing a flurry of sharp, magical feathers. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) slashing damage and being knocked Prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and not being knocked Prone on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Sentient Planetoid, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mental Fortress
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Panoptic Arcanist
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's All-Knowing Magic action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Unfathomable Strength
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Sentient Planetoids are not all hostile creatures. Some of them, who have knowledge of mortals deem them a pest or a problem, especially if traversing the Space Between Worlds. Like a mortal who finds a rat in their home, a sentient planetoid will attempt to remove the creature or kill it.

Some planetoids might wish to converse with mortals, wanting to learn information from them about simple concepts of mundane life, or ask questions they think a mortal would know, only to confuse them with esoteric concepts and broad ideas of the universe. This can sometimes frustrate a planetoid who may react by simply wanting to eradicate the creature who bothered it.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder
**Immunities**: psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The sentient planetoid may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the sentient planetoid can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the sentient planetoid has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Beyond Space and Time
traits.value: The sentient planetoid always acts on Initiative count 20. Additionally, it can't be moved, teleported, or sent to another plane of existence against its will.

traits.name: Gravitational Pull
traits.value: The sentient planetoid exerts its own force of gravity in a 100-foot Emanation. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation falls towards the sentient planetoid, taking falling damage as appropriate if it collides with the planetoid. A creature can make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The sentient planetoid has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sentient planetoid makes four attacks, only one of which can be an Unfathomable Knowledge attack.

actions.name: Unfathomable Knowledge
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, reach 5 ft. or range 250 ft. *Hit:* 39 (**6d12**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Addled and Weakened conditions until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crashing Comet
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 150 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**6d8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d8 Fire).

actions.name: All-Knowing Magic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sentient planetoid casts any spell of level 5 or lower, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22, +14 to spell attacks).

traits.name: Inexorable
traits.value: The sentinel marshal has Advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause it to have the Paralyzed, Restrained, Stunned, or Prone conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sentinel marshal makes two Longsword attacks and one Shield Bash attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.value: The dwarven ringmage has advantage on saving throws against poison.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dwarven ringmage can use its Ring Magic. It then makes three Ring Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Ring Staff
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

actions.name: Ring Magic
actions.value: The dwarven ringmage draws circles of magic in the air and sends them toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, causing one of the following effects:

entries: **Rings of Binding**: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained by magical rings until the end of its next turn.
**Rings of Bravery**: The target can't be frightened and has advantage on melee weapon attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
**Rings of Protection**: The target has a +2 bonus to its Armor Class until the end of its next turn.

**Rings of Retribution**: When any creature hits the target before the start of the ringmage's next turn, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

fluffInfo.value: *The hooded cultist utters a sibilant phrase. Then, like a fading mask of fog, his face suddenly vanishes and in its stead leers a monstrous serpent's head. His terrible, slit eyes blaze unblinkingly as his scaly hands twist and contort in arcane gestures*.

fluffInfo.name: Priests of the Serpent God
fluffInfo.value: Grim tales are told of a prehistoric race of evil snake-people who, wearing the guise of a human cult, have surreptitiously built a monstrous religion around the worship of—the serpent god Yig. As an actor dons a mask, these fiendish humanoids use illusory magic to imitate anyone they wish. This disguise is often betrayed, however, by the presence of the serpentfolk's frightful, fetid scent.

fluffInfo.name: Under Cloak of Blasphemy
fluffInfo.value: Serpentfolk of Yig rely on natural cunning and the sorcery of their cold, reptilian bloodline to survive. These snake-people live in secret amongst the cities of civilized nations and plot to overthrow the warm-blooded inheritors of the world "when the stars are right." Known as "they that walk the night," the serpentfolk of Yig live to serve their dark god's hideous, evil agenda. Many seek to become powerful spellcasters and master assassins to better serve their cruel life's purpose. The Queen of Serpents (see *Creature Codex*) considers the serpentfolk abominations, corrupted versions of true serpents, and there is great enmity between her followers and the followers of Yig.

fluffInfo.name: The Snake That Speaks
fluffInfo.value: In defiance of the creation myths surrounding the World Serpent Veles, the serpentfolk worship their Great Old One progenitor as the true Father of Serpents, knowing him by many names—Set, Quetzelcoatl, and Ningishzida among them. As their insidious cults grow in size—swollen with allied horrors like the Servants of Yig, the scitalis (see *Creature Codex*), and other reptilian monstrosities—the serpentfolk move further and further from their shadowed jungle enclaves to corrupt the credulous kingdoms of man.

entries: **Languages**: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Void Speech

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The serpentfolk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The serpentfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its scimitar.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The spotted and scaly quadruped runs on hairless leonine paws, while its draconic head perches atop a sinuous, serpentine neck.*

fluffInfo.name: Swaying, Snakelike Cats
fluffInfo.value: Serpopards are 13 feet long and weigh 600 pounds, with little gender dimorphism. They have feline bodies but long, serpentine necks topped by vaguely draconic heads. Their hairless paws have wickedly curved, retractable talons. A serpopard's neck is in constant motion, swaying like a cobra, allowing it to track foes on all sides and to strike in unexpected directions.

fluffInfo.name: Easily Distracted
fluffInfo.value: Serpopards are foul-tempered predators and scavengers, and they are known to occasionally cannibalize their weakest pack mate. They actively hunt humanoids when possible and also attack other predators to steal their kills—or to kill and eat the predators, then take their kills. Serpopards are not tenacious hunters, however. They can be distracted from a pursuit by the appearance of an easier meal.

fluffInfo.name: Musk Glands
fluffInfo.value: In some culture, serpopard pelts and musk glands are prized for use in fashion and perfumes. Images of these odd animals appear regularly in ancient tomb iconography and temple decoration.

traits.name: Coastal Camouflage
traits.value: The serpopard has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in sandy, muddy, or swampy terrain.

traits.name: Sinuous Strikeback
traits.value: The serpopard gets two extra reactions that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The serpopard makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Musk (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The serpopard releases foul-smelling musk in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour or until it spends 10 minutes washing off the musk. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. While a creature is poisoned in this way, any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the poisoned creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Cursed Giant Enhanced by Alchemy*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Serum brutes are dependent upon their curse, and magic that breaks curses can leave the giants debilitated and bereft.

entries: **Senses**: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless Unleashed Eyes is active)

traits.name: Curse Dependent
traits.value: If the brute is targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic, until it finishes a Long Rest, the brute loses its Blindsight, its Withering Eye trait, and its Cursed Gaze action.

traits.name: Stimulant Rush
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the brute must choose one of the following options (it can't use that option twice in a row):

traits.name: Catalyst Infusion
traits.value: Until the start of its next turn, the brute's Speed increases to 50 feet, it doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it leaves an enemy's reach, and its Long Jump is up to 30 feet and its High Jump is up to 15 feet with or without a running start.

traits.name: Caustic Secretion
traits.value: Until the start of its next turn, its Fist attack deals an extra 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage (included in the Fist attack below).

traits.name: Stim Boost
traits.value: Gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
traits.value: When the brute is *Bloodied*, its sealed eyes rip open and unleash its curse. It is no longer blind beyond 60 feet, and it can use its Withering Eye trait and Cursed Gaze action until it finishes a Long Rest, whereupon its eyes seal shut again.

traits.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
traits.value: When the brute moves to within 5 feet of a creature, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brute makes two Fist attacks and can use Cursed Gaze if available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If Caustic Secretion is active, the target takes an extra 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the brute's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The builder is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The builder deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The builder has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The builder makes two attacks using Wrecking Ball, Stone, or both, and can use Lay the Foundation, if available.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**3d12 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (**2d12**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stone
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**3d10 + 7**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are knocked prone.

actions.name: Lay the Foundation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The builder pours wet concrete on the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within 5 feet of the builder. Until the foundation dries in 1 hour, that area is difficult terrain, and when a creature with a Strength score of 20 or less starts their turn in that area, they must succeed on a DC 19 Strength (*Athletics*) check or be restrained until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The miner is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The miner has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The miner can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The miner makes two attacks using Drill Press, Pneumatic Pick, or both.

actions.name: Drill Press
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is touching the ground, they are knocked prone and restrained by the miner's drill. While restrained in this way, the target takes 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and the miner can't make Drill Press attacks. The restrained condition ends if the miner moves, makes a Drill Press attack, or is destroyed. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action to pull the target away from the drill, ending the restrained condition and dealing 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage to the target in the process.

actions.name: Pneumatic Pick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is wearing mundane armor, their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.
Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Unload Rocks (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The miner hurls rocks and dirt in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (**8d10**) bludgeoning damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not blinded.

bonusActions.name: Break Ground (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The miner strikes the ground and creates a fissure extending from them in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-deep line. Each Medium or smaller creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing prone. On a successful save, a creature is shunted 5 feet into an unoccupied space and does not fall into the fissure. If a creature doesn't have an unoccupied space within 5 feet of them, they fall into the fissure.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The engine is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The engine deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The engine has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The engine makes two attacks using Blade Rake, Force Cannon, or both.

actions.name: Blade Rake
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pulled up to 15 feet toward the engine.

actions.name: Force Cannon
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**6d10**) force damage, and the target is dazed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Burning Oil (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The engine shoots burning oil in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 (**15d6**) fire damage and is covered in scalding oil. A creature covered in scalding oil takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove the oil from themself or a creature they can reach, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not covered in scalding oil.

bonusActions.name: Destructive Rollout
bonusActions.value: The engine moves up to their speed in a straight line, destroying mundane walls in their path that are less than 10 feet thick. Medium or smaller mundane objects in the engine's path are destroyed if the objects aren't being worn or carried by a creature. The engine can move through the spaces of other creatures during this movement as if they were difficult terrain, and if the engine does so, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (**2d10**) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gains Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Sewer Thing, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resilient Plant
fluffInfo.value: You know it's creature type, Resistances, and Immunities

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Poisonous Engulfer
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Poison Absorption and Engulf features.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Sense of Self
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's Wisdom and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Sewer Thing waits for the opportune moment to strike.

It lets creatures approach, appearing as plant matter over some sewer debris. Once its prey is close, it springs to life, lashing out with its tendrils at any it has surprised, attempting to Engulf them. This tactic works well if it is in water or sewage, where it can pull victims beneath the surface.

The Sewer Thing starts combat attempting to Engulf surprised targets. Once a creature is Engulfed, the Sewer Thing retreats into the sewer water and flees. It is a hunter, consuming its prey by dissolving them inside of it. Once it has its food, it has no reason to stay and fight.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Plant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Venom, Sap.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Flowers, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Plant Dust.

traits.name: Instinctive Ambusher
traits.value: At the start of the sewer thing's first turn of each combat, if the sewer thing attacks a creature, it can make one additional Tendril Lash attack as part of its Multiattack action.

traits.name: Poison Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the sewer thing takes Poison damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Poison damage dealt.

traits.name: Toxic Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sewer thing is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* 5 (**1d10**) Poison damage.

traits.name: Unexpected Appearance
traits.value: If the sewer thing is motionless at the start of combat, it has Advantage on its Initiative roll. Additionally, if a creature hasn't observed the sewer thing move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the sewer thing is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sewer thing makes two attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Tendril Lash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Reel
actions.value: The sewer thing pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 20 feet straight toward it.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The sewer thing engulfs a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it that is Grappled by it. The grapple ends. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and is subjected to the following effect at the start of each of the sewer thing's turns. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Poison damage plus 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage.

If the sewer thing moves, the target moves with it. The sewer thing can have up to four creatures engulfed at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 16 Strength (*Athletics*) check, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the sewer thing.

fluffInfo.value: *The gray unicorn appears desiccated with its skeleton clearly visible beneath its taut flesh. A haunting melody surrounds it.*

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Horses
fluffInfo.value: Shadhavar are natives of the Plane of Shadow. Although they resemble undead unicorns, they are living creatures imbued with shadow essences.

fluffInfo.name: Fey and Undead Riders
fluffInfo.value: While the shadhavar are intelligent creatures, they sometimes serve as mounts for the shadow fey, noctiny, hobgoblins, wights, or other creatures. They expect to be treated well during such an arrangement; more than one unkind rider has ridden off on a shadhavar and never returned.

fluffInfo.name: Deceptive Hunters
fluffInfo.value: Shadhavar use their hollow horn to play captivating sounds for defense or to draw in prey. They hunt when they must and are not discriminating about their quarry, but shadhavar primarily eat carrion. Despite their horrific appearance, they are not naturally evil.

entries: **Languages**: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Horn
traits.value: The shadhavar's Gore attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shadesight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadhavar's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shadhavar makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
actions.value: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the shadhavar, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the shadhavar maintains *concentration*, up to 10 minutes (as if *concentrating* on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

bonusActions.name: Plaintive Melody (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: The shadhavar plays a captivating melody through its hollow horn. Each creature within 60 feet of the shadhavar that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the shadhavar's next turn. While charmed, a creature is incapacitated, its speed is reduced to 0, and the shadhavar has advantage on attack rolls against it.

traits.name: Chilling Phasing

fluffInfo.value: *A mass of shadows and cloudstuff, never touching the ground, extends clawed hands as it reveals a glint of jagged teeth.*

fluffInfo.name: Called from the Void
fluffInfo.value: Shadow beasts are thought to be the result of shadow fey dabbling in the magic of the Void, transforming the shadow fey into something wholly different. Almost shapeless and largely incorporeal, through an act of will they can form rough semblances of their old bodies when needed.

fluffInfo.name: Hate the Past
fluffInfo.value: The motivations of these creatures are inscrutable. They despise light and anything that reminds them of light or of their former existence. Beyond that, little is understood about them.

fluffInfo.name: Cryptic Messages
fluffInfo.value: Shadow beasts are seldom found in groups, but when they are, they seem to have no difficulty or reluctance about operating and fighting together. They have been known to deliver cryptic and threatening messages, but speaking is difficult for them. At times, they perform arcane rituals with the aid of evil humanoids and the use of dark materials. In these rituals, they sacrifice magical energies and life blood as well as the tears of innocents and the souls of the damned.

actions.value: The shadow beast releases a wave of shadows filled with frightening images of eyes, fangs, and other barely seen and terrifying beasts in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 42 (**12d6**) necrotic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature must take the Dash action and move away from the shadow beast by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fluffInfo.value: *The stump of a blackened, frostbitten conifer stands upright on six leg-like roots and scuttles sideways like an arboreal hermit crab. Inky shadows fill a hollow near the base of the stump.*

fluffInfo.name: Born of Vampires
fluffInfo.value: When a vampire becomes a crimson mist (see *Creature Codex*), the terrified, bestial essence of the vampire initially flees and hides as it attempts to regain its senses. The mist lurks in the shadow of a tall tree in the icy northern lowlands and devours tree-dwelling insects and small animals until it is strong enough to once again hunt. The tree, weakened by the necrotic energy coming off the strengthening crimson mist, often succumbs to frostbite, animating the next sunset as a shadow blight.

fluffInfo.name: Spreading Parasite
fluffInfo.value: The shadow blight longs to spread the shadow that animates it to other dead trees. It also tries to find a door to the Plane of Shadows, allowing it to exist in secluded darkness forever. It is willing to slaughter anyone who prevents it from satisfying its desires.

fluffInfo.name: Red Flowering
fluffInfo.value: Shadow blights are sometimes cultivated by vampires, liches, or necromancers as particularly loathsome guardians. When they kill a living creature, they briefly flower. These blossoms resemble a pinkish dogwood or, in some climates, a flowering plum tree.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the shadow blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from the stump of a dead tree.

actions.name: Frozen Shadow Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) cold damage plus 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Animate Plants (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The shadow blight magically animates 1d4 plants within 60 feet of it, turning them into __awakened shrubs__ under its control. These plants' attacks deal an additional 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage. If the shrubs are not destroyed before 1 hour passes, they become new shadow blights.

fluffInfo.value: *A gray-skinned elf steps out of the darkness itself. Its pair of onyx horns seems to absorb the light around it. It gives a friendly smile, revealing small fangs*.

To most, the shadow fey are little more than a dancing shadow among the leaves. To savants, they are the creatures that taught the shadow dancers all they know—and kept many secrets to themselves. They were once elves like all others, dwelling in mortal lands beneath the sun. An ancient catastrophe drove them to darkness, and now they are creatures of the shadow. Though they can be found on the Material Plane, they are inextricably tied to the Plane of Shadow, and that is the seat of their power and culture. Their bond with darkness allows the shadow fey to slip through distant spaces, traversing darkness itself from one place to another.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Elves
fluffInfo.value: Shadow fey superficially resemble other elves, but they're rarely mistaken for their light-bound cousins. Skin tones among the shadow fey range from alabaster white to ebony black, with shades of gray in between, but they otherwise lack color. A few have a scintillating shimmer to their skin. Many shadow fey grow horns that sweep out from their hair, varying in size from subtle nubs to obvious spikes. Others have shocking sets of teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Dual Natured
fluffInfo.value: The shadow fey are contradictory beings. They boast some of the best features of elves, tempered by aspects of a fouler nature. They can be deliberate and purposeful, but they're also given to perplexing whimsy. Mortal creatures trying to fathom shadow fey motivations are in for a maddening experience; they are often illogical, capricious, and seemingly thrive on annoying others.

fluffInfo.name: Split Rulership
fluffInfo.value: The Summer Court and Winter Court each rule the shadow fey in the appropriate season. The turning of these seasons follows no clear calendar or schedule, though it is skewed toward summer. The Queen of Night and Magic and the Moonlit King each claim dominion in turn, ruling over the Summer and Winter courts respectively.

Shadow fey who live outside the courts find their skills are suited to waylaying travelers on the shadow roads.

*While shadow fey bandits are ruthless, they are often quite polite and dashing—the better to get their victims to comply with a robbery. They pretend to have confederates in the trees or claim their weapons are dosed with poison. Sometimes this is true, but more often, it is meant to provide a way for a victim to save face later.*
*Shadow fey bandit nicknames tend toward the lurid and lordly: "The Duke of Daggers," "The Laughing Princess," and "Quickpenny Jack" are fairly well-known figures. Occasionally, a new bandit will take up the name of an older bandit who has retired.*

fluffInfo.name: Criminal Outcasts
fluffInfo.value: Shadow fey who dwell at court obsessively pursue both leisure and politics, so they find the idea of professional crime boorish at best. Shadow fey finding themselves relying on banditry are often forced to make difficult decisions due to banishment or desperation.

fluffInfo.name: Strength In Numbers
fluffInfo.value: The Shadow Realm is a dangerous place to wander alone, so shadow fey bandits often keep company with a wide array of creatures. It is not uncommon to find shadow fey bandits working with darakhul, monstrous fey, or in the service of hags.

Shadow fey duelists are elite warriors, often of noble lineage. Swift and sure beyond compare, duelists are often taller and more wiry than others of their kind. Their armor, clothing, and weapons are of exquisite make, fashioned from only the finest materials, as befits their station.

fluffInfo.name: Deadly Nobles
fluffInfo.value: A nobleman or woman of the shadow fey is not to be taken lightly—many courtiers or politicians are deadly with their slim blades, and they are known to distill virulent poisons. Often a skilled duelist serves as a champion for her liege, standing in the noble's stead in challenges or serving as an elite bodyguard.

Beyond even great physical beauty, the sheer presence of a shadow fey enchantress can lay the most stalwart foes low. Almost universally female, Enchantresses are beautiful beyond compare.

fluffInfo.name: Enchanting Shadows
fluffInfo.value: Enchantresses are also powerful spellcasters who infuse their words and manner with the beguiling power of shadow to turn enemies against one another with a few words and a deadly smile. They augment the force of their minds with fey-wrought blades, infusing their weapons with power that shreds their victims' psyche as well as their flesh.

The creature can add a d4 to its roll, provided it can hear and understand the enchantress. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the enchantress is incapacitated.

Dressed in exquisitely wrought mail and leather jerkins, forest hunters are even more lithe and graceful than most shadow fey.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Stalkers
fluffInfo.value: Forest hunters roam the deep woods connected to the Plane of Shadow, as well as the forests' dark reflections within the Plane of Shadow. They are skilled trackers and stalkers, hunting animals and more dangerous game. Many forest hunters serve in the Wild Hunt. A hunter that has at one time ridden at the Lord of the Hunt 's side is afforded great respect, even fear, because of the common belief that such a hunter can implore the Lord of the Hunt to notice an enemy.

traits.value: If the forest hunter is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the hunter instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half the damage if it fails.

Shadow fey guardians are massive creatures trained and bred for battle. They appear as massive versions of shadow fey, but the stuff of shadow corrupts them even more than their brethren, expanding their size and power to an ogreish strength. Patches of shadow swallow parts of their body and crawl about, revealing and obscuring more by inches at a time. They stand nearly 10 feet tall and weigh over 700 pounds.

fluffInfo.name: Loyal Protectors
fluffInfo.value: Guardians are fanatically loyal to their superiors. Employed as house guards or even personal bodyguards for important shadow fey, guardians are unshakable in their duty. The shadow reaches into their minds and souls, so that not even powerful magic can bend their hearts or break their resolve. Guardians are independent thinkers, but they discharge their duty with single-minded dedication.

fluffInfo.value: *A large, purple-skinned goblin lumbers toward you. He is easily twice the width, height, and weight of any typical goblin, and he clutches a heavy, bejeweled axe in his ham‑sized fists.*
Shadow goblin chieftains rule goblin groups with a hearty mix of intimidation and natural charisma.

*Shadow goblin clans are very tight-knit and loyal to their members. Even an evil shadow goblin chieftain will hesitate to betray or slight their direct kinfolk and families. Instead, their rage, trickery, and betrayals are directed at everyone not a member of the clan. The only exception is when a shadow goblin has sworn to accomplish some task (or just as often, not to undertake some foolish venture) and then breaks their word. "Broken words, broken fingers" refers to the chieftain's custom of smashing the hands or toes of those who cross the clan's interests.*

fluffInfo.name: Court Players
fluffInfo.value: Shadow goblins thrive in the courts of the shadow fey and in their own courts and have built a complicated social network that mirrors fey politics. Shadow goblin chieftains are drawn from the ranks of the largest, eldest, and most cunning goblins.

fluffInfo.name: Shadow Hierarchy
fluffInfo.value: In shadow goblin clans or families, shadow goblin chieftains are second in power only to the moonshadow catchers, who wield strange and potent magic. Frequently a chieftain and a moonshadow catcher will work together to claim leadership of wealth or resources. This common arrangement is called a moon-chief clan. Others are either chieftain clans or moon-led clans.

Shadow goblin scribes are the notaries and executors of deals brokered between shadow fey and mortals.

*Shadow goblin clans are very tight-knit and loyal to their members. Even an evil shadow goblin chieftain will hesitate to betray or slight their direct kinfolk and families. Instead, their rage, trickery, and betrayals are directed at everyone not a member of the clan. The only exception is when a shadow goblin has sworn to accomplish some task (or just as often, not to undertake some foolish venture) and then breaks their word. "Broken words, broken fingers" refers to the chieftain's custom of smashing the hands or toes of those who cross the clan's interests.*

fluffInfo.name: Contracts, Oaths & Consequences
fluffInfo.value: Shadow fey nobility possess notoriously short attention spans and have come to rely on shadow goblin scribes to record and enforce the day-to-day drudgeries associated with complex contracts. After a fey accepts a bargain, they call upon the scribe to work out the exact terms, catalog them, and occasionally deal with those desperate enough to attempt to break a contract.

fluffInfo.name: Limited Spellcasting
fluffInfo.value: Shadow fey are careful not to teach their goblin servitors too much magic, but scribes learn a small selection of practical spells that allow them to deal with testy mortals. Scribes are often the messengers of bad news, and their magic allows them to subdue aggressive individuals long enough to accomplish their business.

traits.name: Blinding Beauty
traits.value: When a creature that can see the nymph starts its turn within 30 feet of the nymph, the nymph can force it to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw if the nymph isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is permanently blinded. Otherwise, a creature that fails its save is blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nymph until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the nymph in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Shadow Dweller
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadow nymph's darkvision.

traits.name: Water Spirit
traits.value: While the shadow nymph is in contact with or submerged in a body of water, she ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. She can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shadow nymph uses Shadow Nymph's Gaze. She then makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Nymph's Gaze
actions.value: The shadow nymph directs her gaze at one creature she can see within 30 feet of her, targeting the creature with one of the following effects:

entries: **Icy Glance**: The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) cold damage and is restrained until the end of its next turn as ice forms around its limbs. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.
**Shadow Glare**: The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Stunning Stare**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or become stunned until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the shadow nymph's Stunning Stare for the next 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Blend
bonusActions.value: The shadow nymph magically turns invisible until she attacks or uses Shadow Nymph's Gaze, until she enters an area of bright light, or until she ends it as a bonus action. She can use this bonus action only while in dim light or darkness.

entries: **HP**: 50 (Assassin only) or 40 (Infiltrator only) + 10 for each spell level above 5

traits.name: Incorporeal Passage
traits.value: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes **1d10** Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.value: The spirit may take the Hide action as a Bonus Action when in Dim Light or Darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Chill Touch (Infiltrator Only)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, Reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel** Cold damage.

actions.name: Deathly Bolt (Assassin Only)
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. *Hit:* **2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel** Cold damage. If the spirit was hidden when it made the attack, the attack deals an additional **2d4** Cold damage.

fluffInfo.value: This nightmare is conjured from Arrevis' fear of the common folk's reprisal for his ill deeds. It appears as a large, shadowy, mapach-headed creature with disproportionately large forearms and a bristling hide made of fur as sharp as needles.
It moves hunched over, walking on its enormous forearms. Its face is a mask of rage, and it indiscriminately attacks anything not from the dreamscape.

entries: **Resistances**: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
**Languages**: can understand all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Death in Shadow
traits.value: When the shadowbeast dies, its body and its equipment dissolve into shadows and disappear, leaving nothing behind.

traits.name: Bristling Hide
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the shadowbeast deals 5 (**1d10**) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Shadow Sight
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadowbeast's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The shadowbeast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shadowbeast makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its slam. Alternatively, it can use Spit Flame twice.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spit Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

fluffInfo.value: *This mass of fist-sized black spiders flows like a creeping mist. While they move like a shadow across the ground, they do not cast one themselves.*

fluffInfo.name: Born of Darkness
fluffInfo.value: Shadowspiders are not alive in the traditional sense. A shadowspider swarm is a creeping mass of spiders formed out of the primordial darkness of the Shadow Realm itself. They are born in the oldest and darkest regions of the Shadow Realm, often in areas where the planar barriers have grown thin. Unable to survive outside of its swarm, a shadowspider separated from its swarm evaporates in a greasy swirl of black smoke.

fluffInfo.name: Affinity with Undeath
fluffInfo.value: While shadowspider swarms form in places where two planes are close, they are particularly common in regions where the Shadow Realm is coterminous with the Plane of Undeath. Because of this, shadowspider swarms are often found alongside the undead that sometimes spill forth in these regions.

fluffInfo.name: Insatiable Hunger for Warmth
fluffInfo.value: Shadowspider swarms are always hungry, especially for the warmth of mortals. When a shadowspider swarm senses the warmth of a living creature, it immediately moves to consume the creature.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, necrotic; charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Darkwalkers
traits.value: While in darkness, the shadowspider swarm is invisible.

traits.name: Sense Life
traits.value: The shadowspider swarm can pinpoint the location of a warm, living creature within 30 feet.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The shadowspider swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny shadowspider. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Wasting Wave
traits.value: A creature that enters the swarm's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of shadow corruption (see Chapter 5 of Book of Ebon Tides).

actions.name: Shadow Bites
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) piercing damage, or 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage and 9 (**2d8**) cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shadowsteel Coat
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghast is coated in metal armor made of Shadowsteel.

traits.name: Shadowsteel Miasma
traits.value: Creatures of the Shadowsteel ghast's choice that start their turn within 30 feet of the ghast must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from any attack roll or saving throw they make until the start of their next turn. Only one miasma can affect a given creature at a time. A creature that rolls a natural 20 on any attack roll or saving throw while in a Shadowsteel miasma is immune to the miasma of any Shadowsteel ghast for 1 hour.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghast and any Shadowsteel ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Shadowsteel ghast makes two claw attacks or casts one at-will spell and makes one claw attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage and 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage. A cursed target must make an escalation check. If a target drops to 0 hit points due to this damage and isn't already cursed, they are randomly afflicted with one from among any of the curses in the Grim Hollow Campaign Guide (GM's choice).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghoul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shadowsteel Coat
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghoul is coated in metal armor made of Shadowsteel.

traits.name: Shadowsteel Hunger
traits.value: The Shadowsteel ghoul has advantage on attack rolls against creatures carrying or wearing Shadowsteel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Shadowsteel ghoul makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage and 5 (**2d4**) necrotic damage. A cursed target must make an escalation check. If a target drops to 0 hit points due to this damage and isn't already cursed, roll 1d4, and the target is afflicted with a curse based on the result: 1-2 Curse of Damned Aging, 3-4 Curse of Foul Blight. (See Grim Hollow Campaign Guide for information on curses and escalation.)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shaman makes three attacks, using Ritual Staff or Cursed Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Ritual Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Cursed Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Inspire Ferocity (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: The shaman inspires ferocity in up to three creatures it can see. Those targets have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the shaman's next turn and gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, flanked, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Engulfing Sack
traits.value: The mound has a vegetative sack on their body where they carry engulfed creatures. The sack can be attacked (AC 15; 50 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), which deals no damage to the mound. Destroying the sack frees creatures trapped by the mound's Engulf action. The mound regrows the sack at the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mound makes two Vine Lash attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Engulf, if available.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the mound can pull the target up to 30 feet toward them.

actions.name: Engulf (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mound reaches out with writhing vines and attempts to pull in up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mound's engulfing sack. An engulfed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes 7 (**2d6**) poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. If the mound dies or their engulfing sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, perception +0 plus PB

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation. If the mound's caregiver is Large or smaller, they can use the Hide action to attempt to hide in the same space as their motionless mound.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Vine Lash)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Long-Range Lash (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound makes a signature attack with a reach of 30 feet instead of 5 feet.
If this attack hits a Medium or smaller creature, the mound can pull the target up to 10 feet toward the mound.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Verdant Roundup (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound targets up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them who are Large or smaller. Each target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the mound and take **PBd4** poison damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Engulf (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound attempts to pull a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of them into their body. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pulled into the mound's space, takes **PBd8** poison damage, and is engulfed. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, doesn't move, and isn't engulfed.

An engulfed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes **PBd8** poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength check. On a success, that creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.
The mound can have one Large or up to four Medium or smaller creatures engulfed at a time.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, flanked, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the pile remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

traits.name: Hungry Grab
traits.value: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more piles, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be grappled. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, and at the start of each of the target's turns, they take poison damage equal to the number of piles within 5 feet of them. The saving throw and escape DC equal 10 plus the number of piles within 5 feet of the creature. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles are within 5 feet of the creature.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the pile takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pile takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Vine Lash (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study za Shardmaul Manticore, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutated Manticore
fluffInfo.value: You're aware the creature has no special Resistances or Immunities but is a capable flier.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Death From Above
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the manticore's Stinger and Wing Shards attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Strong, Fast, and Tough
fluffInfo.value: You learn the manticore's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Shardmaul Manticore attacks from above, choosing whichever target looks weakest and the least armored. It descends from above suddenly, making Bite and Claw attacks against the weakest prey it detects. After its first descent, it lifts off again, using Wing Shards to cover its ascent. It then repeats its attack pattern.
A Shardmaul Manticore is bold enough to attack when outnumbered but typically flees if it faces stiff opposition that reduces it to half its Hit Points or fewer.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws, Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Webbed Membrane.

fluffInfo.name: Delerium:
fluffInfo.value: The quills on its body are made of delerium and may be harvestable: 1d6 - 2 delerium fragments can be collected from its quills (minimum 0).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The manticore makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage. If the manticore flies 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition and the manticore can make a Bite attack against it as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 24 (**7d6**) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target also gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wing Shards (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the manticore (flying creatures have Disadvantage). *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Piercing damage, and if the target is flying, it has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *A skeletal humanoid made entirely of shark's jaws steps out from the water, dripping strands of seaweed.*

Made from numerous, interlocking shark's jaws, these horrors are animated through foul magic into a large, vaguely humanoid shape. Sahuagin priests animate them to guard sepulchers of bones. These sharkjaw skeletons lie among great piles of bones, waiting to rise up and attack any uninvited souls who invade the sanctity of sahuagin holy sites. Others guard pirate treasures or ancient shipwrecks.

fluffInfo.name: Undead Automaton
fluffInfo.value: Sharkjaw skeletons do nothing without orders from their creator, and they follow those instructions explicitly. A sharkjaw skeleton's creator can give it new commands while near the skeleton. Otherwise, a sharkjaw skeleton follows its last instructions to the best of its ability and to the exclusion of all else, though it fights back if attacked.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The sharkjaw skeleton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). The skeleton can grapple up to two targets at a time.

actions.name: Devouring Embrace
actions.value: The sharkjaw skeleton devours a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The grapple ends, the devoured target is restrained in the skeleton's many jaws, and the target takes 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage at the start of each of the skeleton's turns. If the skeleton moves, the devoured target moves with it. The skeleton can devour only one target at a time. A creature, including the devoured target, can take its action to pry the devoured target out of the skeleton's many jaws by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Glass Spikes
traits.value: Each time a creature makes a melee attack against a shatter corpse, it takes 3 piercing damage. A creature can choose to make an attack with disadvantage to avoid this damage.

traits.name: Loud
traits.value: Creatures have advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made to hear the approach of a shatter corpse.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The shatter corpse has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.value: If damage reduces the shatter corpse to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the shatter corpse drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage and 2 (**1d4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley of Glass (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The shatter corpse flicks a volley of glass shards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Rush
traits.value: If the sheep dragon moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, during which it moves within 5 feet of a creature and flies past it, that creature must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pulled 10 feet in the direction the sheep dragon is moving and knocked prone, and the sheep dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack from it. On a successful save, the creature isn't pulled or knocked prone, and if it makes an opportunity attack against the sheep dragon, it does so with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sheep dragon makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Headbutt. Alternatively, it makes three Wind Pistol attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Headbutt
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wind Pistol
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Despite being short and squat, this creature's relationship with a troll is undeniable. The kinship is most notable in the long arms and thick, pebbly hide.*

fluffInfo.name: Long Handed and Toad-like
fluffInfo.value: The shellycoat is a warped and spiteful creature also called the Iamh fada, or "long hands." They are frequently referred to as bridge trolls. Despite being fey, they are distantly related to true trolls. Unlike those tall, lanky creatures, a shellycoat is dwarfish and toad-like, with short, bent, legs and especially long arms with swollen, distended joints. It can further dislocate and stretch these joints to alarming lengths.

fluffInfo.name: Bridges and Pools
fluffInfo.value: The shellycoat can be found in abandoned wells or behind waterfalls, in deep tide pools, or beneath the ice of frozen ponds, but their preferred haunt has always been under bridges. They are most active during nighttime and on heavily overcast days, because of their mortal dread of sunlight. A shellycoat's favored tactic is to lie in wait under the water, ice, or bridge and surprise its prey. It strikes outward or upward from its hiding place to snatch passersby, livestock, and lone travelers or fishermen. Prey is dragged down to the shadows and water to be robbed and devoured.

fluffInfo.name: Shining Garments
fluffInfo.value: Shellycoats always fashioned themselves coats, cloaks, or shirts of colored pebbles, glass, and polished river shells. These adornments are crude but beautiful and sometimes magical.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The shellycoat can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.value: The shellycoat has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Hazesight
traits.value: The shellycoat can see through areas obscured by fog, smoke, and steam without penalty.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The shellycoat regains 3 hp at the start of its turn. If the shellycoat takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the shellycoat's next turn. The shellycoat dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Water Camouflage
traits.value: The shellycoat has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide while at least partially submerged in water.

traits.name: Sunlight Petrification
traits.value: If the shellycoat remains in nonmagical sunlight for 1 minute, it becomes petrified at the end of that minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shellycoat makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained. The shellycoat has two claws, each of which can grapple only one creature.

actions.name: Shellycoat's Fog (1/Day)
actions.value: While in contact with water, the shellycoat can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point it can see within 60 feet of it for 1 minute. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and unable to breathe, unless it can breathe water, for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
**Languages**: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.value: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.value: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shield-maiden makes three attacks, using Longsword or Javelin in any combination. The shield maiden can replace one attack with Shield Bash.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12 One creature within 5 feet that the shield-maiden can see. *Failure:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Call to Arms (Recharge 6)
bonusActions.value: Up to three creatures of the shield-maiden's choice that are within 30 feet of her and can hear her gain Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the shield-maiden's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: A shieldhead has a broad bone faceplate to protect itself and to ram foes. An expert rider can also use the bone like a shield. People have domesticated shieldheads for riding.

traits.name: Charge
traits.value: If the shieldhead moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through it normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

actions.name: Fiery Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Erupt (1/Day)
actions.value: If the drangolin is burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, they can erupt from the ground (without spending movement) into a space that contains one or more creatures. When they do, each creature within 10 feet of the drangolin must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. A creature directly above the drangolin when they emerge has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of their choice instead of being knocked prone.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball (1/Day)
actions.value: The drangolin moves up to twice their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. While doing so, they can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. If the drangolin enters another creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If the drangolin enters the space of a structure or object that isn't being worn or carried, it takes twice as much damage.

entries: **Immunities**: Special; see Adaptive ability; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The Caustic Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Caustic Slime can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Psuedopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) acid damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the shifting slime can't make a pseudopod attack against another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: The shifting slime makes one pseudopod attack against a target it is grappling that is at least one size smaller than itself. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the shifting slime, and it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns taking 3 (**1d6**) acid damage on a failure. If the shifting slime used its adaptive ability to become immune to a damage type, the damage dealt to the target on a failed save becomes that type instead. The shifting slime can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the shifting slime dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it, and may move freely as the body of the slime quivers and neutralizes into an inert puddle of goo.
