traits.value: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The shoggoth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The shoggoth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shoggoth makes four attacks, using Horrid Tendril or Hurled Mucous in any combination. It can't attack the same target more than once.

actions.name: Horrid Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. It can Grapple up to four Large or smaller creatures at a time.

actions.name: Hurled Mucous
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +15, range 200 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Slime Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Acid damage. *Success* Half damage. For 1 minute, the area within the Cone is drenched with slimy acid. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 22 (**4d10**) Acid damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

bonusActions.name: Horrid Digestion
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature Grappled by the shoggoth. *Failure:* The target takes 32 (**4d10 + 10**) Acid damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The giant, gelatinous blob of flesh releases whistles, trills, and chirps as it rolls forward, forming and reabsorbing mouths, eyes, and ears across its body.*

A shoggoth is an intelligent, gelatinous blob capable of manipulating and reshaping its body. Created by an elder race as servants, the shoggoths rebelled long ago and slew their masters without pity. Since that time, they've lived in isolated or desolate regions, devouring whatever they encounter and absorbing its flesh into their own amorphous, shifting forms.

fluffInfo.name: Constant Growth
fluffInfo.value: Shoggoths continue growing throughout their lives, though the eldest among them grow very slowly indeed. Some shoggoths may shrink from starvation if they deplete a territory of resources.

fluffInfo.name: Mutable Form
fluffInfo.value: A shoggoth can form any number of eyes, mouths, tentacles, or other appendages as needed, though it lacks the control to take and maintain the shape of another creature.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, slashing, thunder; blinded, deafened, prone, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Anaerobic Nature
traits.value: The shoggoth doesn't require air.

traits.name: Absorb Flesh
traits.value: When the shoggoth kills a creature while within 15 feet of it, the creature's body is absorbed into the shoggoth's. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Hideous Cacophony
traits.value: The shoggoth's many mouths constantly emit whistles, fluting, and other high-pitched noises. It has disadvantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to be unheard. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the shoggoth and that can hear it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the start of its next turn. A disoriented creature is incapacitated, and when it moves, it moves in a random direction.

Unless surprised, a creature can cover its ears to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't hear until the start of its next turn, when it can cover its ears again. If the creature uncovers its ears in the meantime while within 60 feet of the shoggoth, it must immediately make the save. A creature that is covering its ears and that has access to cloth, wax, or similar material can stuff its ears with the material as a bonus action to free up its hands, deafening itself while the material remains stuffed in its ears.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The shoggoth has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Limited Mutability
traits.value: Any spell or effect that would alter the shoggoth's form alters it for only 1 round. Afterward, the shoggoth returns to its amorphous blob form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shoggoth makes four Slam attacks. It can replace two Slam attacks with a use of Crush.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 30 (**4d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

actions.name: Crush
actions.value: The shoggoth crushes up to two creatures it is grappling by rolling them beneath its bulk. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 30 (**4d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage, be unable to breathe, and be restrained until the grapple ends. If the shoggoth moves, a creature beneath it is no longer restrained and is able to breathe, but it remains grappled.

fluffInfo.value: *The translucent person calls out a name in a barely audible whisper.*

fluffInfo.name: Bitter Spirits
fluffInfo.value: Shrouds are transitional creatures: remnants of wicked people who died but refuse to rest in peace, yet have not grown strong enough to become shadows. They are aggressive enemies of all living creatures and the light that nurtures life. Shrouds blend naturally into darkness, but they stand out starkly in bright light.

fluffInfo.name: Thin Outlines
fluffInfo.value: Shrouds look like flickering shadowy outlines of the people they were before they died, retaining the same height and body type.

fluffInfo.name: Repetitive Speech
fluffInfo.value: Shrouds cannot converse, but they occasionally can be heard cruelly whispering a name, term, or phrase over and over again: something that must have had meaning to them in life.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The shroud can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Evolution
traits.value: If the shroud deals at least 12 necrotic damage to a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead in 1 minute or less, the shroud transforms into a shadow at the start of the turn after it last dealt damage. It uses the statistics of the shadow, except it reduces the shadow's hp by an amount equal to the damage the shroud took before it transformed.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the shroud has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.value: The shroud doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on weapon attacks that use Strength until the end of its next turn. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shroud rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: While in dim light or darkness, the shroud takes the Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *Soul Corrupted by the Shroud*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Shrouded are bound by barriers and lines of iron, which is why cemeteries with iron fences keep them contained.

**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained

traits.name: Mist Form
traits.value: The shrouded can enter another creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Corrupting Mist
traits.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, a creature that starts its turn in the shrouded's space. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: The soul of a Humanoid that dies from this damage becomes a new shrouded at the start of the shrouded's next turn and takes its turn on that Initiative.
The Humanoid can't be returned to life until the new shrouded is destroyed.

traits.name: Graveyard Warding
traits.value: The shrouded can't move through a space with a barrier or line of iron, such as a wrought iron fence or a line of iron filings. This impassible barrier rises to a height of 1 mile above the iron.

traits.name: Variation
traits.value: The shrouded has one of three variants, which determines a unique action option: Devourer, Reaper, or Whisperer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The shrouded makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Consuming Bite (Devourer Only)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). At the start of a Grappled target's turn, it takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the shrouded regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Scythe (Reaper Only)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain Hit Points until the start of the shrouded's next turn.

actions.name: Toxic Thoughts (Whisperer Only)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the shrouded. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the shrouded's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Feline Resilience (3/Day)
traits.value: When Shtriga Nonna fails a saving throw, she can immediately turn into a cat of her size (Medium in her normal form, Large while under the effect of Grow) and succeed instead. While in cat form, Shtriga Nonna retains her game statistics and ability to speak, except she can't cast spells or use Soul Steal. She reverts to her previous form at the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Shtriga Nonna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Shtriga Nonna makes two Corrosive Claw attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Soul Steal, if available.

actions.name: Corrosive Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with Grow), one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage, or 14 (**3d6 + 4**) slashing damage while under the effect of Grow. If the target is wearing mundane metal armor, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity throw or their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. If the armor is reduced to an AC of 10, it is destroyed.

actions.name: Soul Steal (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Shtriga Nonna inhales deeply in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Shtriga Nonna regains 10 hit points for each creature who fails this saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Grow (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: For 1 minute, Shtriga Nonna magically increases in size, along with anything she is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, she is Large, her reach becomes 10 feet, she deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and she makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Shtriga Nonna lacks the room to become Large, she attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

bonusActions.name: Gobble You Up
bonusActions.value: Shtriga Nonna feeds on the body of an unconscious creature within 5 feet of her. The target takes 10 (**3d6**) piercing damage, and Shtriga Nonna recharges her Soul Steal action.

traits.name: Boundless Horror
traits.value: When Shub-Niggurath drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a swarm of insects that fill its space. At the start of each of Shub-Niggurath's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum Hit Points return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost Hit Points. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.
If Shub-Niggurath's space is filled with magical fire it is banished from the world and prevented from returning for 4d10 years.

traits.name: Horrid Garden
traits.value: Horrid vines, slick acidic dew and covering in flesh, gnawing mouths erupt from the ground in a 120-foot Emanation originating from Shub-Niggurath. The effect of this trait depends on its level. When Shub-Niggurath rolls initiative, set this trait's level to 0. The trait's level increase by 1 after each of Shub-Niggurath's turns to a maximum of 3. Use the highest AC bonus granted by this trait. Shub-Niggurath gains the benefits of this trait's current level and all lower ones. These benefits end when Shub-Niggurath is no longer threatened by hostile creatures.

traits.name: Level 0
traits.value: No effect.

traits.name: Level 1
traits.value: The ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for non-Plants. At the end of Shub-Niggurath's turns, including the turn in which this trait reached level 1, two awakened trees appear in open spots in the Emanation of Shub-Niggurath's choice. They immediately roll initiative and aid their Dark Mother.

traits.name: Level 2
traits.value: A non-plant takes 15 Acid damage, or 30 Acid damage if it has the Prone condition, when it ends its turn in the Emanation.

traits.name: Level 3
traits.value: Plants have Advantage on all attack rolls made against non-Plants in the Emanation. A creature hit by a Plant's melee attack gains the Prone condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.value: If Shub-Niggurath fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Shub-Niggurath makes four total Grasping Tendril and Stomping Hoff attacks.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, Reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage and the target is moved to the open space closest to Shub-Niggurath.

actions.name: Stomping Hoof
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, Reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 32 (**4d10 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage and the target gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: The Earth Hungers (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 25, creatures of Shub-Niggurath's choice within 200 ft. of Shub-Niggurath and the ground. *Failure:* The target takes 110 (**20d10**) Bludgeoning damage, is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying, and gains the Prone and Restrained conditions as fibrous plant tendrils erupt from the ground. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage, and the target is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying.

bonusActions.name: Tree Walk
bonusActions.value: Shub-Niggurath may teleport to any open space, provided she ends that teleportation within 10 feet of a friendly Plant creature she can see.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The wolf has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Evasive
traits.value: Shyla includes her Intelligence modifier as a bonus on all Dexterity saving throws.

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.value: As a bonus action, Shyla can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (**3d6**) poison damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Shyla expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 1st.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Languages**: all languages known before the curse

traits.name: Shared Agony
traits.value: When a Sightless Agony takes damage, it emits a wave of energy, causing each creature within 5 feet of it to take an amount of Psychic damage equal to half the triggering damage (rounding down).

traits.name: Stunted Flight
traits.value: When a Sightless Agony chooses to fly, it must land by the end of its turn or have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Sightless Agony makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Claw

If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Checks made to escape the grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Psychic damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast __Fog Cloud__.

actions.name: Thunderous Mace
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**3d8 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Thundercloud
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 240 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d6 + 8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d10 + 1**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Holy Weapons

traits.name: Skilled Rider
traits.value: While mounted, the cavalier can force an attack that targets its mount to target the cavalier instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cavalier makes two attacks.

actions.name: Lance
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 (with Disadvantage against a target within 5 feet), reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Force damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Force damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Summon Steed (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The cavalier magically summons a Griffon, which appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the cavalier and obeys its commands. The steed takes its turn immediately before or after the cavalier. It remains until it or the cavalier dies, or the cavalier dismisses it as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage, or 5 (**1d8 + 1**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Brave
traits.value: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. fluffInfo.value: Disease is no stranger to the people of Etharis. The virulent Weeping Pox has devastated towns and families, and the Tears of the Hungerer is rumored to be a poison designed by necromancers. Other afflictions, such as the Seven Shades of Sitri and the Faith Cough, are not deadly but can impede even the strongest body. These diseases can be carried by animals, breaking their normal method of transmission. A twist of nature or foul magic has created carriers, some intentionally and some aggressively, that spread sickness quickly.

traits.name: Seven Shades of Sitri
traits.value: A humanoid who touches a Sitri cat must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the Seven Shades of Sitri. If a humanoid succeeds on the saving throw, they're immune to the disease for 24 hours. Carnal urges overwhelm an infected humanoid. When the infected interacts with another non-hostile humanoid, the infected becomes charmed by that humanoid until the subject of the infatuation or their friends harm the infected. The infected can repeat the saving throw once every 24 hours. Current infatuations end when one of these saves succeeds. The disease ends for the infected when they have succeeded on five saving throws.

fluffInfo.value: *The androgynous humanoid appears mummified in writhing, diamond thread. Its skin is translucent, and dozens of quivering hourglasses sit suspended inside its body in place of organs.*

fluffInfo.name: Shepherd Destiny
fluffInfo.value: Skein witches are curators of destiny and enforcers of what must be. They voyage across the planes, weaving the strands of fate at the behest of their goddess-creator. Although they carry out their charge without regard to petty mortal concerns, they can be persuaded to bend fate for powerful petitioners whose interests align with those of their goddess.

fluffInfo.name: Surrounded by Guardians
fluffInfo.value: Despite their supernatural abilities, a skein witch's physical body is frail. Because of that, they tend to surround themselves with undead, constructs, or other brutish, soulless guardians cut free from the thread of fate.

fluffInfo.name: Fear of Cards
fluffInfo.value: If a deck of many things is brought close to a skein witch, the witch emits a psychic wail and disintegrates.

fluffInfo.value: *A repulsive, batlike creature darts from the darkness. Its body consists entirely of rotting sheets of stolen skin. Though its large eyes are glassy and lifeless, an unmistakably evil intent glimmers within them as a toothless mouth spreads wide in hunger*.

Skin bats are undead creatures created from skin flayed from the victims of sacrificial rites. They are given a measure of unlife by a vile ritual involving immersion in Abyssal flesh vats and invocations to Camazotz and similar demon lords. They feed on the skin of living beings to replenish their own constantly rotting skin. Their acidic saliva acts as a paralytic poison and leaves ugly scars on those who survive an attack. The typical skin bat has an 8-foot wingspan. The color of their skin matches that of their prey, so a skin bat's coloration can change over time. A skin bat weighs about 15 pounds.

fluffInfo.name: Cliff and Dungeon Dwellers
fluffInfo.value: Skin bats prey on the unwary but do not develop sinister plots of their own. Their flocks can be encountered in isolated areas accessible only by flight or by climbing treacherous cliffs. Skin bats can exist in any climate. In cool climes, they feed only infrequently, because the cold preserves their forms and reduces the need to replenish decaying flesh. This also explains why they are attracted to the dark depths of ageless dungeons. In wet, tropical climes where their skin decomposes rapidly, skin bats are voracious feeders by necessity.

fluffInfo.name: Accidental Treasures
fluffInfo.value: Skin bats have no use for magic items or wealth, but occasionally a ring or necklace from a past victim gets embedded in their fleshy folds, where it becomes an unintended trophy.

traits.name: Echolocation

On a success, the target can't be paralyzed in this way by the skin bat again for 24 hours.

In addition, the skin bat attaches to the target. While attached, the skin bat can't attack, and at the start of each of the bat's turns, the target takes 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage. The attached bat moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the bat's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the skin bat by succeeding on a DC 11 Strength check.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Skin Crawler is a mindless creature. It is nothing but animated flesh seeking to consume. If it senses a living creature nearby, it crawls towards it with total disregard for its own life.
It only wants to bind the living and squeeze them to death while slowly devouring their flesh, consuming it into itself.
A Skin Crawler is too focused to flee and continues to attempt to devour a target until either it or their target is dead.

fluffInfo.value: *This large beetle moves erratically, leaking noxious fluid from its cracked exoskeleton.*

fluffInfo.name: Ooze Vermin
fluffInfo.value: This parasitic ooze lives in the shells of monstrous vermin, such as beetles, scorpions, and spiders, which it has infested and killed. A skitterhaunt creature might be mistaken for its original, living version at a glance, but the sluggish, erratic movements and oozing carapace of skitterhaunts quickly reveal their true nature.

fluffInfo.name: Wide Range of Prey
fluffInfo.value: A skitterhaunt infection can decimate whole nests of vermin. When those are in short supply, these oozes move on to prey on other species, such as ants, crabs, and other creatures with exoskeletons or similar hard outer shells.

fluffInfo.name: Hosts Required
fluffInfo.value: Skitterhaunts can't survive long outside their host creatures; they quickly liquefy and lose their cohesion. A body abandoned by a skitterhaunt is an eerie, hollowed-out husk with a strong, acidic odor.

traits.name: Vermin Encasement
traits.value: The creature within the vermin's shell is a shapeless ooze protected by the vermin's exoskeleton. When the skitterhaunt is reduced to 0 hp, the exoskeleton breaks, and the skitterhaunt ooze exits it. Once out of its exoskeleton, the ooze is Small, has an AC of 10, 10 hp, and a speed of 15 feet, and it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, its only attack is a Slam that uses the same statistics as its Sting, except it deals bludgeoning damage instead of piercing damage. The skitterhaunt dies if it remains outside of a host for more than 24 hours. It can exit or enter a dead host's exoskeleton as a bonus action.

Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the skitterhaunt can't use its Mandibles on another target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) acid damage.

actions.value: The skitterhaunt infests a Large or smaller Beast with an exoskeleton within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the skitterhaunt no longer infests it. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) acid damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the skitterhaunt no longer infests it. The target dies if this reduces its hp maximum to 0. The skitterhaunt then takes control of the body, dissolving the flesh and hiding within the exoskeleton. A target that succeeds on two consecutive saving throws forces the skitterhaunt out of its body and is immune to the skitterhaunt's Infest Vermin for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The skitterhaunt spits acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The skitterling doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn. Creatures who are immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition succeed on this saving throw automatically.

entries: **HP**: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: perception +2 plus PB, sleight of hand +3 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** slashing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Destabilizing Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The skitterling makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on the next attack roll they make before the start of the skitterling's next turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Ankle Biter (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The skitterling moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes a signature attack. On a hit, if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are also knocked prone and grappled by the skitterling (escape DC 10 plus PB).

actions.name: 5th Level: In All Your Faces! (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The skitterling chaotically bounces around, smearing toxin on each enemy within 5 feet of them.

Each target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw or take **1d6 plus PB** poison damage and be blinded until the end of the skitterling's next turn. A creature within 5 feet of a target blinded in this way can use their action to wipe the toxin off them, ending the condition for that target.

bonusActions.name: Crafty Distraction (Recharges after a Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The skitterling flutters and screeches distractingly, allowing their caregiver an opportunity to reposition. The caregiver can use a reaction to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffInfo.value: *Fetid Fey Centipedes*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Skitterswarms can't resist dead bodies and are drawn to the corpses of Humanoids.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Body Burrowing
traits.value: If the swarm can see the corpse of a Humanoid at the start of its turn, it must move up to its Speed toward the corpse. Once it enters the corpse's space, it must remain there for 1 hour, after which time the corpse's flesh putrefies.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny centipede. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Vile Vermin
traits.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, any creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space. *Failure:* The target contracts a magical contagion. While afflicted, the target can't regain Hit Points, and it repeats the save when it finishes a Long Rest or when targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition, recovering from the contagion on a success. *Success* The target is immune to the Vile Vermin trait of all skitterswarms for 24 hours.

actions.name: Infesting Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) Piercing damage, or 3 (**1d6**) Piercing damage if the swarm is *Bloodied*. If the target is a creature, a centipede infests its body. While infested, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The infestation ends when the target regains Hit Points or is targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The skogsra makes three Claw attacks. In place of one Claw attack, it can use Grasping Vines or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Grasping Vines
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15 One Medium or smaller creature the skogsra can see within 15 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the skogsra and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

bonusActions.name: Hollow Trap
bonusActions.value: The skogsra pulls a creature with the Grappled condition into its hollow body. While held in this way, the target isn't Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 7 (**2d6**) Slashing damage and 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage reduces a Humanoid creature to 0 Hit Points, that creature is considered Stable and has the Paralyzed condition. This condition lasts for 12 hours or until the Paralyzed creature regains Hit Points.
The held creature has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the skogsra. While holding a creature within its body, the skogsra can't pull another creature into its hollow.

If the skogsra takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate that creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the skogsra and has the Prone condition.
If the skogsra dies, a held creature no longer has the Restrained or Paralyzed condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: Skopps is a grizzled but imposing strig with an uncanny power over creatures. He has used this power to capture and exploit wild beasts and monsters for profit. He and his band of poachers live outside the law, selling their services to others who operate in the shadows.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but doesn't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Skopps can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Skopps lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Skopps cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Skopps has advantage on ability checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Skopps makes two attacks. He can then use his Beast Command action.

actions.name: Barbed Whip
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**3d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage. After a hit, Skopps may spend a bonus action to grapple the target (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Beast Command
actions.value: Skopps commands a beast or monstrosity within 80 feet of him that can hear him. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Skopps until the end of his next turn. While the target is frightened and Skopps is conscious, Skopps has a telepathic link with it, and can use this link to mentally control the creature. At the start of the controlled creature's turn, Skopps can decide what actions and movement the creature takes on its turn. The target takes only the actions Skopps commands, and doesn't do anything that Skopps doesn't allow it to do. Skopps can cause the creature to use a reaction at any time, but this requires Skopps to use his reaction as well. Each time the controlled creature takes damage, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against being frightened. If the saving throw succeeds, this effect ends. Beast Command is a magical effect.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Skretch, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Flying Scavenger
fluffInfo.value: You recognize it may be possible to distract it with meat, offal, or strong-smelling food.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Acidic Vomit
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Skretch's Expel Waste and Spittle actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dextrous and Sturdy
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Skretches keep to high perches and observe potential prey before attacking. A Skretch prefers to attack targets that are visibly injured, weakened, or otherwise vulnerable.

Once it finds a suitable quarry, a Skretch circles their prey overhead pelting them with Spittle while waiting for their Expel Waste to recharge. Since its attacks require the Skretch to be directly overhead its target, they prefer to keep well above their targets to avoid any projectiles or ranged attacks.

A Skretch never enters close combat willingly. If it is engaged up close, it uses the Disengage action to flee. As lazy scavengers, a Skretch doesn't pursue its prey very far or into buildings and flees if reduced to half its Hit Points or fewer.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Feathers.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The skretch makes two attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spittle
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 120/300 ft., one target directly underneath the skretch. *Hit:* 15 (**6d4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Expel Waste (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere directly beneath the skretch. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d4 Acid). Each time the target takes damage from this condition, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Massive Frame
traits.value: The great ogre has Advantage on Strength saving throws and Strength (*Athletics*) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The great ogre makes two greatclub attacks or throws two javelins.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/200 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hideous Belch (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13 All creatures in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Poison damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. *Success* Half damage only. A creature with the Poisoned condition can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect upon itself.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the trollkin has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The trollkin regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The trollkin berserker makes four attacks, using Freezing Bryntroll or Freezing Handaxe in any combination.

actions.name: Freezing Bryntroll
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage. Once per round, if the berserker hits with its bryntroll, it can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first, and that is within reach. On a hit, the second creature takes 13 (**2d12**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Freezing Handaxe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Cold damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The sky drake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The sky drake has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sky drake makes one bite attack and one attack with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) piercing damage and 5 (**2d4**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, poisoned, stunned
**Languages**: understands Common and Torum but can't speak

traits.name: Cloud Trail
traits.value: Wherever the Sky King flies, it creates a trail of giant fluffy white clouds in its wake.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.value: If the Sky King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.value: Unless it wishes to be affected, the Sky King is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The Sky King's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: New Life
traits.value: When the Sky King dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

traits.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
traits.value: If the Sky King drops below 150 hit points, a giant storm begins to brew above and the oceans begin to become uneasy. For the next minute, creatures that touch the Sky King or hit it with a melee attack take 9 (**2d10**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Sky King makes three attacks: two with its Chomp and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**3d6 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Inspiring Presence
actions.value: Each creature of the Sky King's choice that is within 300 feet of the Sky King and aware of it gains inspiration and a flying speed of 30 feet for the next minute. Once a creature benefits from the Sky King's Inspiring Presence, it can't do so again until 7 days have passed.

traits.name: Divine Vitality
traits.value: Skymir's ability scores and HP maximum can't be reduced except by means of a __Wish__ spell.

traits.name: Icy Weapons
traits.value: Skymir's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Skymir has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Skymir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Skymir makes two attacks using Runesword or Arcane Sphere in any combination. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Runesword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage; the target is Marked with a glowing spectral rune until the end of Skymir's next turn.

actions.name: Arcane Sphere
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 6**) Force damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of Skymir's next turn.

actions.name: Icy Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16 Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on Skymir. *Failure:* 13 (**3d8**) Slashing damage, 13 (**3d8**) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from Skymir and gains the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage and not pushed or knocked Prone.

bonusActions.name: Translocative Word
bonusActions.value: Skymir speaks a word of power, and up to two creatures Marked by Skymir's Runesword are teleported to unoccupied spaces on the ground within 60 feet that he can see. The Mark on those targets then fades.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the whale. A swallowed creature has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 3 (**1d6**) lightning damage at the start of each of the whale's turns.

If the whale takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage.

traits.name: Heat Wave
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Slagger takes 2 (**1d4**) fire damage. If the creature is wearing metal armor or wielding metal weapons, the damage is doubled.

traits.name: Scorch
traits.value: Flammable objects ignite if they come within 15 feet of the Slagger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Slagger uses its Cough. It then makes one Slam attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**6d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spew Magma (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., three targets. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) fire damage. Regardless of whether the attacks hit or miss, the area within 5 feet of each target is covered in lava. The lava is considered difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the lava takes 6 (**1d12**) fire damage. The lava cools and hardens after 1 minute, at which point it becomes harmless and is no longer difficult terrain.

actions.name: Cough
actions.value: The Slagger coughs a sulfurous cloud in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (**2d12**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Heated Weapons
traits.value: When the slaghund hits with a weapon attack, it deals an extra 2 (**1d4**) fire damage (included in attacks).

traits.name: Heatable Body
traits.value: As a bonus action, the slaghund can cause its body to heat up, or return to a normal warm temperature. While its body is heated in this way, a creature that touches the slaghund or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

traits.name: Reactionary Flame
traits.value: When the slaghund is surprised, it ignites everything flammable within 1 foot of it that isn't being carried or worn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The demon makes four attacks using Pincer, Sword, Javelin, or a combination of them. They can replace one of these attacks with a Tail Spike attack. The demon can burn 1 soul to make a fifth attack using Pincer, Sword, or Javelin.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled, the target is restrained. The demon has six pincers, each of which can grapple a target or wield a weapon.

actions.name: Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
