traits.name: Puppet
traits.value: While in a dreamholder's lair, the sleepwalker sees what the dreamholder wants it to. A creature can use its action to make a Charisma (*Persuasion*) check contested by the dreamholder's Charisma (*Persuasion*) to help the sleepwalker see through the illusion. On a success, the sleepwalker sees through the dreamholder's illusions and can't be beguiled by the dreamholder for the next 24 hours. On a failure, the sleepwalker believes the creature to be a trick, and any further attempts made to persuade it by that creature automatically fail for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sleepwalker makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Phantom Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) psychic damage.

traits.name: Preternatural Balance
traits.value: Sleipnirspringr automatically succeed on saving throws against the Prone condition, and they cannot be Pushed or Pulled through nonmagical means.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The horse makes 3 Hoof attacks.

actions.name: Hoof
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Trickster Spawn
bonusActions.value: The horse can use a Bonus Action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action.

fluffInfo.value: These large monitor lizards are native to the jungles of the Tanglewilds and have an upright stance with long limbs suited for running down prey. Their bite is powerful and venomous.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The slicar has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage plus 5 (**2d4**) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour.

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Slime Familiar
fluffInfo.value: A benign slime altered by magic and made into a familiar. These slimes come in a variety of colors and are intensely curious.

entries: **Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Adorable Monstrosity
traits.value: The slime has advantage on Charisma (*Performance*) and Charisma (*Persuasion*) checks.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Mucus
traits.value: When the slime is hit by a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or their weapon becomes stuck in the slime. The weapon can be wrenched out by using an action to make a DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing the weapon on a success. All weapons stuck in the slime can be retrieved once the slime is slain.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Slime King
fluffInfo.value: Lendarick's current form is a half-slime, half-luma monstrosity. A birdfolk skull adorns each of the Slime King's shoulders, making him look like a three-headed horror. The back of the partially decomposed body is decorated with cervan horns, swords, and other monstrous protrusions. The Slime King carries a greatsword hewn from the bone of some massive creature and infused with the powers of cursed slimes.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The Slime King has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: While the Slime King sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

traits.name: Wallow in Waste
traits.value: The Slime King is immune to the effects of noxious gasses, such as those caused by the __stinking cloud__ and __cloudkill__ spells.

traits.name: Watchful Skulls
traits.value: The Slime King has two extra reactions that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Slime King makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one of its Bite attacks with a Slimeforged Blade attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slimeforged Blade
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) slashing damage. If the Slime King attacks a creature and rolls a 20 on its attack roll, the target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: Slimes are magical oozes with strange properties. Slimes provide an important role in many ecosystems across Humblewood, as their bodies can digest just about anything. The bodies of slimes are also sought after for use in potion making.

fluffInfo.name: Slimesworn Cultist
fluffInfo.value: The cultists are folk from the roots who passed and were reanimated with slime magic woven into cloth. They can be of any race. In an attempt to make them look less frightening, Lendarick fashioned the magic cloth into robes, leaving only their heads and claws exposed. The robes are painted with dark slime in swirling patterns. The cultists are controlled by the robes, and if the robes are engulfed in fire, the corpse crumples to the floor.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.value: The slimesworn cultist is incapacitated while in the area of an __antimagic field__. If targeted by __dispel magic__, the slimesworn cultist must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Dead Accurate
traits.value: If the slimesworn cultist is motionless, it looks merely like a dead mage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The slimesworn cultist makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Fabric Tendrils
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. *Hit:* The creature is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is also restrained and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the start of each its turns or take 10 (**3d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, Slip can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Slip can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Drop Attack
traits.value: Slip can make an attack during his glide. If he does so, he deals an extra 1d8 points of damage.

traits.name: Patient
traits.value: When Slip takes a readied action, he has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check he makes as a part of that action.

traits.name: Talons
traits.value: Slip has advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fear of Canines
traits.value: If the familiar can see a dog, wolf, or other canine at the start of its turn, it has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, it has Disadvantage on saving throws.

traits.name: Spider Climb (Centipede Only)
traits.value: The familiar can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vermin Telepathy
traits.value: The familiar can magically control Beasts and swarms that match its incarnation (centipedes, pigeons, weasels, giant versions of each, as well as __Boogleswarms__, __Skitterswarms__, and __Squabswarms__) within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The familiar makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Incarnated Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The familiar uses the option that matches its incarnation.

actions.name: Infectious Sting (Centipede Only)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the familiar can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the familiar's next turn. While Poisoned in this way, the target has the Paralyzed condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: A sloth galloper is a hybrid sloth-ape that is an agile climber and fast sprinter. The beast's four apelike hands are sensitive, so it hesitates to move rapidly over rough terrain.

traits.name: Speed Burst
traits.value: Provided it isn't moving over difficult terrain, the sloth galloper can use a bonus action to take the Dash action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sloth galloper makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Wisps of humid wind revolve around this spiny ball. Two massive black eyes and a dark mouth are the only features visible through its static-straight quills.*

Despite its perhaps comical appearance, a slow storm is a creature of wind, lightning, and chaos, able to send minute electrical shocks into creatures that cause pain every time the creature moves. It turns the bodies of physically able creatures against them, forcing them to choose between relative inactivity or ever-increasing pain.

fluffInfo.name: Small Central Core
fluffInfo.value: The nucleus of a slow storm is a sphere of ice and stone, and it is surrounded by protective, high-speed winds.

fluffInfo.name: Static Generator
fluffInfo.value: A slow storm has no internal organs other than its brain, and it lives on the energy and moisture it drains from opponents. Its quills not only deflect debris but also generate static electricity that it uses when attacking.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: lightning; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.value: The slow storm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Eye of the Storm
traits.value: The slow storm is surrounded by a 15-foot-radius wind storm. The storm imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls and Wisdom (*Perception*) checks based on sight or hearing within the area. The winds extinguish open flames and disperse fog. A flying creature in the storm must land at the end of its turn or fall. Each creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage. The storm's area is difficult terrain for any creature other than the slow storm.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The slow storm makes three Slam attacks or four Lightning Bolt attacks. If two Slam attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be wracked with pain for 1 minute. While the target is wracked with pain, minute bits of electricity dance within its body, and the target takes 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage for every 5 feet it moves. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**3d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Static Shock (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The slow storm releases built-up electricity in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 54 (**12d8**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also stunned for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Enervating Aura
traits.value: Any creature other than an undead that starts its turn within 30 feet of the phantom must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute. Whenever an unconscious target takes damage or another creature uses an action to try to shake it awake, the target can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Ethereal Form
traits.value: While on the Material Plane, attack rolls against the phantom are made with disadvantage unless the phantom is incapacitated. In addition, the phantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the phantom fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The phantom has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spectral Enthrallment
traits.value: Whenever the phantom reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the target dies and a specter rises from its corpse. The specter acts immediately after the phantom's initiative count and is under the phantom's control for 1 hour, after which time it vanishes.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.value: The phantom is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The phantom makes two Life Drain attacks. It can use its Dream Eater in place of one attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 36 (**8d8**) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and on a successful save, its hit point maximum is reduced by half that amount. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Dream Eater
actions.value: The phantom taps into the nightmares of one creature it touches. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to the effects of the __phantasmal killer__ spell for 1 minute (this effect doesn't require the phantom's *concentration*). The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. An unconscious creature makes its saving throws against this effect with disadvantage, and whenever it takes damage from this effect, the phantom regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the phantom can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

fluffInfo.value: *This large statue of emerald-green crystal has a humanoid body with the head of an ibis. Tiny symbols and runes are etched into it, and portions of it are inlaid with bits of gold.*

fluffInfo.name: Occult Initiates
fluffInfo.value: Smaragdine golems are crafted by disciples of occult esoterica to guard their secret meeting halls, sacred texts, and the arcane books of power.

fluffInfo.name: Emerald Body
fluffInfo.value: Though they seem to be made entirely of emeralds (and some are used in their construction), a smaragdine golem's body is closer to enchanted glass than to gemstones, a sad truth that has disappointed many plunderers.

fluffInfo.name: A Maker's Privilege
fluffInfo.value: Though smaragdine golems are sometimes given to powerful mages, scholars, theurgists, and hierophants as a token of esteem, they are always subject first to the magic and orders of their creators.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.value: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Enchanted Weapons
traits.value: The golem's weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **5d8** force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Vessel
traits.value: When the smaragdine golem counters or ends a spell with Absorb Spell, it holds the spell's magical energy within its body and becomes Charged for 1 minute. While Charged, the golem sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The smaragdine golem makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Release Spell.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (**5d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Release Spell (Recharge Special)
actions.value: The smaragdine golem releases an absorbed spell's energy in a green burst centered on a point the golem can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature, other than the smaragdine golem, within 5 feet of that point per level of the absorbed spell must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (**3d6**) force damage per level of the absorbed spell and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. The golem can use this action only if it is Charged (see the Magic Vessel trait).

fluffInfo.value: Smoke elementals are native to the Para-elemental Plane of Ash, where the Plane of Air and Plane of Fire collide. The ash that makes up a smoke elemental ranges from faint motes to fiery zephyrs. Its component mixture can cause breathing problems when inhaled, and it causes burning in the eyes when it attacks. Ironically, a strong wind can damage a smoke elemental, diluting its ashy substance.

Smoke elementals rarely travel to other planes, unless they are summoned by magic or travel through a portal. They might appear, however, in places where someone from a mortal world opens a portal to the Elemental Plane of Fire to immolate, to power a forge, or to drive arcane machinery. Those fighting large conflagrations all too often find themselves contending with confused and hostile smoke elementals that get pulled into their world.

rows: Swirling patches of white and black smoke.
Wispy spirits of those it's killed.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Aversion to Wind
traits.value: If the elemental starts its turn within a strong wind (such as one created by the __Gust of Wind__ spell), it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the elemental has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Smoke Form
traits.value: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Smoky Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Smoky Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Asphyxiate (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature in the elemental's space. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. All Exhaustion levels gained from this Bonus Action are removed after 1 minute.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the mephit dies, it leaves behind a cloud of smoke that fills a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on its space. The sphere is Vision and Light. Wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cinder Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of smoldering ash. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.

traits.name: Evasive
traits.value: Snap adds her Intelligence modifier as a bonus to his Dexterity saving throws (already included in stat block).

traits.name: Hunter's Eye (3/Day)
traits.value: As a bonus action, Snap can add 1d8 to her next attack or damage roll made with a ranged weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Snap makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: Snapjaw can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Snapjaw makes three attacks: two with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**3d10 + 15**) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Snapjaw can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by Snapjaw. *Hit:* 24 (**2d8 + 15**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.value: The young jerbeen Jerrin Hollowhome has gained an infamous reputation as the phantom thief, Snapshadow, who appears without warning before melting into the night. Snapshadow has worked for various criminal factions in the past, though she only steals from the wealthy, and often distributes the spoils of her crime among Alderheart's most needy. As a result she has become a folk hero in some circles, though this hasn't made her any less of a thief in the eyes of the Perch Guard.

Snapshadow dresses in loose clothing which hides many weapons. She usually keeps two daggers in spring loaded wrist sheaths, as well as a hidden hand crossbow mounted on a bracer. She is also known to carry a rapier hidden inside a plain looking walking stick.

A young female jerbeen agitator with a history of moving between criminal factions within Alderheart. She is linked to many of the most infamous crimes in Alderheart. Jerrin has blue eyes and reddish-orange fur dotted with white speckles, though she usually keeps her face concealed under a cloak. She often carries concealed weapons.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +6, insight +5, perception +5, sleight of hand +6, stealth +6

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.value: Snapshadow can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Lone Duelist
traits.value: When fighting a single creature, so long as there are no creatures within 5 feet of her or her opponent, Snapshadow has advantage on her attack rolls.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.value: Once per turn, Snapshadow deals an extra 10 **3d6** damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Snapshadow that isn't incapacitated and Snapshadow doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Snapshadow's long jump is 40 feet, and her base high jump is 20 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Snapshadow makes three attacks: two with her cane rapier and one with her dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The wolf has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: *This severe elf has pale, almost white skin and tightly braided blond hair. Her gown is exquisite, fashioned of luminous blue fabric that catches light and shines from within. Lacy ice crystals accent the gown, and a snow-white mantle cascades from her shoulders. Icicles radiate in a crown-like halo behind her head, drifting gracefully through the air*.

Her Crystalline Majesty, Morrinn, is the cold-hearted Snow Queen, Daughter of Boreas. The Snow Queen rules a northern kingdom in the remote, frozen reaches of the world. Perpetually shrouded in snow and ice, her domain is inhospitable to outsiders. She rules from a castle of delicate spires carved entirely out of ice. The dwelling catches and reflects even the faintest glimmer of light, shining like a beacon and enticing travelers to risk the dangerous winter realm.

fluffInfo.name: Queen of Giants
fluffInfo.value: The Snow Queen is proud and cruel to any who cross her. Her daughters, the ice maidens, roam her kingdom with ease. Travelers who can't give a good reason to be moving through the Queen's territory meet a quick end in the maidens' chilly embrace. The Snow Queen commands the loyalty of winter-born tribes of fraughashar, ogres, frost giants, thursir giants, and trollkin. She is said to have mocked both Thor and Loki and often leads their priests astray into winter storms.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Ice Climb
traits.value: When climbing on ice, the Snow Queen has a climbing speed of 20 feet, and she can climb difficult surfaces made of ice and snow, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Icy Weapons
traits.value: The Snow Queen's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **2d6** cold damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Snow Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Snowsight
traits.value: The Snow Queen can see through areas obscured by snowfall, sleet, rain, and other wintry precipitation without penalty.

traits.name: Snow Walk
traits.value: The Snow Queen can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Snow Queen makes two Claw or Ice Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) cold damage. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Cold Snap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Snow Queen causes the temperature around her to drop dramatically. Each creature without 30 feet of the Snow Queen must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 42 (**12d6**) cold damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer exhaustion. A creature that is immune to cold damage doesn't suffer exhaustion, even if it fails the saving throw. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is petrified in ice for 1 minute. A petrified creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A petrified creature that takes fire damage has advantage on the saving throw to end the effect.

fluffInfo.value: Camouflaged against the ice, a solitary snow sphinx is on the prowl. A shock of dark humanoid hair whips around a feline face, revealing piercing blue eyes that can freeze foes with a single glance. Compared to its desert-dwelling cousins, this sphinx is far less likely to be defeated with reason or logic. Although a snow sphinx can speak, it generally greets its prey with claws and teeth rather than riddles or philosophical conversation.

Physically, this fearsome creature is well adapted to harsh habitats, such as ice-covered mountains or arctic plains. It has wide paws to stop it sinking into soft snow and thick fur to ward out the cold. The sphinx's muscular wings carry the same spotted markings as its fur; they are strong enough to withstand the bitter winds that whistle across the tundra.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft, *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Cold damage.

bonusActions.name: Freezing Glare (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *First Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition, and is turned into an ice statue.

entries: **Immunities**: cold; grappled, paralyzed, prone, restrained, unconscious

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The snowball spirits make two pelt attacks.

actions.name: Pelt
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**4d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is at least one size smaller than the snowball spirits, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be whelmed by the snowball spirits. A whelmed creature is considered grappled (escape DC 14) and is carried with the snowball spirits when they move. A creature within 5 feet of the spirits can pull a whelmed creature out of them by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check, freeing the creature on a success.
The snowball spirit can have no more than one creature whelmed at a time, unless it reaches the Huge size, at which point it can whelm up to three creatures at a time.

actions.name: Snowball
actions.value: Whenever the snowball spirits take the Dash action, they can make a slam attack as part of that action. Alternatively, if they are in snowy terrain, they can choose to absorb the snow during the movement, growing by one size and regaining 10 hit points.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.value: The snowfox has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in snowy terrain or cloudy skies.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.value: The snowfox doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they leave an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 piercing damage, and the snowfox attaches to the target. While attached, the snowfox's Claw attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the snowfox can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can detach the snowfox as an action with a successful DC 13 Strength (*Athletics*) check. The snowfox can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Burrow
bonusActions.value: The snowfox burrows up to 5 feet in snow.

bonusActions.name: Listen
bonusActions.value: The snowfox makes a Wisdom (*Perception*) check.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: If the soda slime is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the soda slime move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the soda slime isn't an ordinary soda can.

traits.name: Soda Pop
traits.value: When a soda slime is reduced to 0 hit points, each creature within 10 feet of the soda slime must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (**1d10 + 1**) force damage as it explodes in a fizzy pop.

traits.name: Sticky Nature
traits.value: The soda slime can occupy the same space as another creature. While in the same space as the soda slime, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity checks. When a creature leaves the soda slime's space, it must first make a DC 10 Strength (*Athletics*) check, carrying the slime with it on a failure.

actions.name: Smack
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) poison damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *The massive wolf lumbers forward, malice gleaming in its black eyes. Two snake-like tongues slither in its jaws, and green scales peek from beneath its black fur.*

fluffInfo.name: Demonic Wolves
fluffInfo.value: Demonic black eyes, two snakelike tongues, and green-black scales beneath their black fur betray the sons of Fenris's unnatural origins.

fluffInfo.name: Hibernate Until Ravenous
fluffInfo.value: Sons of Fenris slumber beneath the snow for months, waking when they grow ravenous or when prey approaches. When hunting, they revel in wanton savagery and destruction, killing entire herds to delight in blood.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Worshipers
fluffInfo.value: Despite their fierce nature, all the sons of Fenris are divine offspring and wise in divine lore, attracting desperate souls who offer them worship and sacrifice in exchange for aid. The sons of Fenris enjoy this adulation, and they provide protection and wisdom to their followers. Sometimes, they gather enormous war bands and go reaving.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: cold, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.value: The son of Fenris has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Divine Weapons
traits.value: The son of Fenris's weapon attacks are magical. When the son hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **3d6** necrotic damage or **3d6** radiant damage (included in the attack), the son's choice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The son of Fenris makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes four Divine Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage or (**3d6**) radiant damage (the son's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the son of Fenris. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the son, and it takes 21 (**6d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the son's turns. The son can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the son takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the son must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the son. If the son dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**1d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage or (**3d6**) radiant damage (the son's choice).

actions.name: Divine Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) necrotic damage or (**4d6 + 4**) radiant damage (the son's choice).

actions.name: Snake Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The two snake tongues of the son of Fenris each exhale poison in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide, resulting in two lines. Each creature in a line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (**10d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the lines overlap, each creature in the overlapping lines must make one saving throw with disadvantage against only one of the lines rather than one saving throw for each line.

traits.name: Metamagic
traits.value: The sorcerer has 7 sorcery points and regains all expended sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend these points in the following ways:

entries: **Quickened Spell**: When the sorcerer casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

**Twinned Spell**: When the sorcerer casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magnetobolt
actions.value: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) force damage and the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp
actions.value: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage and the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The sorcerer has advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armour made of metal.

fluffInfo.value: *The creature walks on crab-like legs, carrying a fleshy, ectoplasm-filled mass on its back.*

fluffInfo.name: Merchants from the Lower Planes
fluffInfo.value: Soul eaters are soul-collecting fiends from the Lower Planes where they freely barter for prey. When a soul eater dies, the souls it carried are released and returned to their bodies or to their appropriate final destinations. Regardless, a dead soul eater has no souls for the demons and devils who value souls as currency. This gives soul eaters a measure of safety and power in the Lower Planes, and many of them operate as neutral merchants among other fiends.

fluffInfo.name: Hatred of the Sun God
fluffInfo.value: Soul eaters bear a particular antipathy for followers of the deities of the sun. They go to great lengths to kill any such deity's clergy, even defying the wishes of their fiendish superiors on occasion.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
**Immunities**: poison; paralyzed, poisoned, prone, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The soul eater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Sense
traits.value: The soul eater can pinpoint the location of creatures that have souls within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The soul eater makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Hasten Consumption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The soul eater emits a wave of psychic energy to hasten the demise of nearby creatures, bringing them one step closer to having their souls consumed. Each creature within 20 feet of the soul eater must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw, taking 31 (**9d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to below half its hp maximum by this effect has disadvantage on the saving throw against the soul eater's Soul Drain for 1 minute.

traits.name: Fiendish Adacity
traits.value: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Fiendish Fury
traits.value: The handler deals an extra 5 (**1d10**) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Fiendish Vigour
traits.value: The handler gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The handler makes two attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., ., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) piercing damage. Reload (3).

fluffInfo.value: *Engine-Born Spirit of Flame and Death*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Soulfire stokers are compelled to burn corpses they can see, so dead things can bait the spirits.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Corpse Fuel
traits.value: If the stoker can see a corpse at the start of its turn, it must move as far as possible to enter the corpse's space and use its action to incinerate the corpse. Medium or smaller corpses are reduced to ash, and larger corpses are partially incinerated and decrease one size.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.value: The stoker can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 4 (**1d8**) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.value: The stoker sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

traits.name: Soul Burn
traits.value: At the end of each of the stoker's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the stoker takes 4 (**1d8**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The stoker makes two Sear attacks.

actions.name: Sear
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Fire damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the elemental's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Spectral Steam (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The stoker unleashes a blast of glowing spectral steam. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* For 1 minute, the target sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

fluffInfo.value: A Southerner Champion may be a chieftain from Dunland, a bandit lord capable of uniting a number of fractious warriors into a small army, or just a particularly vicious brigand.

traits.name: Reckless Hate
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the Southerner Champion can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Southerner Champion makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

actions.name: Battle Axe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) slashing damage, or 8 (**1d10 + 3**) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) piercing damage, or 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

fluffInfo.value: When a particularly harsh winter has passed, Men from the South may assemble war parties and look for some isolated homestead to plunder, before retreating just as quickly back into the mists where they came from.

traits.name: Reckless Hate
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the Southerner Raider can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Axe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage, or 6 (**1d8 + 2**) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage, or 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

fluffInfo.value: When sovereign ooze vassals are near each other, they are compelled to join together. The process of merging two Sovereign Ooze Vassals takes one hour, resulting in a single Sovereign Ooze Lord.

The resulting sovereign ooze lord has a more evolved intelligence than its component creatures. They can think and plan, as well as communicate telepathically with other creatures on a more complex level. They can make bargains and—more importantly—break them if it furthers their goals.

In addition to the urge for self-preservation, the sovereign ooze lord has the drive to find others like itself, commanding its ooze vassals to seek them out. Ultimately, it searches for other ooze lords to merge with to form a Sovereign Ooze Monarch.
At its core, however, the sovereign ooze lord is driven to bring chaos and formlessness to everything around it.

fluffInfo.name: Sovereign Oozes
fluffInfo.value: Careless wizards, artificers, alchemists, and other creators of magical substances sometimes dispose of failed experiments haphazardly. They think city sewers or workshop basement grates are safe places to dump their magical waste. These remnants, often liquid in form and brimming with magical potential, interact with organic matter—blood, bodily waste, or dead flesh—to gain sentience and form. These newly formed creatures are sovereign oozes.

Sages who've studied the lore of these creatures believe that another factor may also contribute to a sovereign ooze's creation and its drive to transform the world into the same substance from which it is formed. These experts have proposed several possible catalysts: intervention by a great demonic power, such as Juiblex; influence from one of the planes of chaos, such as Limbo or Pandemonium; or manipulation by a god associated with chaos or entropy (perhaps with a tinge of evil), such as Ralishaz or Tharizdun.

Unlike many other oozes, sovereign oozes possess advanced sentience, and in the case of the more evolved sovereign oozes, sapience. This cognitive functionality allows the lord and monarch versions of the sovereign ooze to communicate and develop intricate plans that involve manipulating other creatures.

Sovereign oozes can assume rough shapes of other creatures they have encountered (or eaten). These forms cannot replicate fine details, but are refined enough to sometimes fool inattentive observers or those whose sight is obscured by darkness.

Sovereign oozes consume organic matter to gain energy, and they grow in power by combining with other sovereign oozes. Two Sovereign Ooze Vassals can join to become a Sovereign Ooze Lord, and two Sovereign Ooze Lords can join to become a Sovereign Ooze Monarch. Experts are unsure whether two or more monarchs can join, and they hope they never find out.

entries: **Languages**: telepathy 120 ft., understands Common but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ooze has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Merge
traits.value: The ooze and one other Sovereign Ooze Lord within 5 feet of it merge over the course of a Short Rest. When both oozes finish the Short Rest, they merge into a Sovereign Ooze Monarch.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Glob (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the ooze can see within 90 feet. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Force damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.value: The ooze shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Humanoid or Beast while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

bonusActions.name: Transformation (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the ooze can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. *Failure:* The target dies. After one minute, the target transforms into a Sovereign Ooze Vassal, unless it is restored to life or the ooze is destroyed before a minute passes. Only a __Wish__ spell can reverse this transformation.

fluffInfo.value: When two Sovereign Ooze Lords merge, the resulting creature is a Sovereign Ooze Monarch.

Sovereign ooze monarchs have an even greater capacity to think, communicate, reason, and plot. They also begin receiving messages from whatever greater power is linked to their existence (if any). In that case, they focus on carrying out the wishes of those greater powers. The Greater Power table below lists entities that may control the sovereign ooze monarch.
In the absence of a greater power's influence, the sovereign ooze monarch simply wants to consume organic matter and turn other creatures into sovereign oozes to serve it.

Ooze monarchs have antithetical feelings toward each other. If one sovereign ooze monarch ventures within 50 miles of another, they immediately attempt to destroy each other—or they convince other creatures to do so on their behalf.

rows: A deity of chaos and entropy
A demon lord looking to cause trouble
A lich in the area hoping for a distraction
An archmage building an ooze army

fluffInfo.value: Sovereign ooze vassals form when discarded magical experiments, especially alchemical concoctions and potions, mix with organic matter from sentient creatures. A magical spark animates the mixture, granting it life. These oozes are most likely to originate in sewers near alchemists' shops, in vast caverns beneath arcane schools, in the sub-basements of wizards' towers, or in places where magic-wielding folks congregate and work.

Sovereign ooze vassals cannot speak, but they possess a form of telepathy that allows them to communicate with other creatures on a rudimentary level. They can, however, convey complex thoughts to other sovereign oozes.

With no external stimuli, the sovereign ooze vassal is driven to consume organic matter to survive: flesh, plants, offal, etc. However, if they come into contact with another of their kind, they feel a strong compulsion to merge with it. They also readily obey commands from sovereign ooze lords or monarchs.
