traits.name: Electronic Data Network
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 (**6d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Predictive Analytics
traits.value: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls 1d20 for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any D20 Test made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

actions.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Algorithm takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Wire**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

**Algorithmic Manipulation**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 26, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the Restrained condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this Epic Action again, or has the Incapacitated condition.

**Deatomization**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. *Failure:* 65 (**10d12**) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. *Failure:* Half damage.

actions.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature Grappled by the algorithm. *Failure:* 55 (**10d10**) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

actions.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
actions.value: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its Epic Actions as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's Hit Points. When the Construct is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Undying Monarch of the Damned*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Barrow King's only true weakness is his name, written in the runic form of his lost native language. A weapon inscribed with his runic name becomes his bane.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the king fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The king has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Marshall Undead
traits.value: Undead creatures of the king's choice (excluding himself) in a 60-foot Emanation originating from him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. He can't use this trait if he has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Name of Rest
traits.value: The king has AC 10 against attack rolls made with a weapon inscribed with the runic form of his original name, and the king has Disadvantage on attack rolls made against a creature holding such a weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The king makes three Soul Blade attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, reach 5 ft. or range 40/80 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d6 + 7**) Slashing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) Necrotic damage. *Hit or Miss:* The blade magically returns to the king's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 16 (**2d8 + 7**) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a __Wight__ under the king's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

actions.name: Blade Storm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The king's blade flies in a deadly arc around him. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature of the king's choice in a 20-foot Emanation originating from him. *Failure:* A creature takes 35 (**10d6**) Force damage and has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *Manifestation of Rot and Decay*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Buried deep within the Beast of Blight, a tiny fragment of Farryn still exists. If shown an image of her lost love, the ignited memory will burn away the rot.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Blighted Overgrowth
traits.value: While the beast is *Bloodied*, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, its Spew Blight action recharges at the start of its turn, and if it has at least 1 Hit Point at the start of its turn, it regains 20 Hit Points.
If it takes Fire damage, it doesn't regain Hit Points at the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.value: The beast ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unraveled Longing
traits.value: If the beast can see the likeness of its long-lost love at the start of its turn, the beast takes 10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The beast makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17) from one of two claws. If the beast moved at least 20 feet immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Spew Blight (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it automatically succeeds. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Rot Stride
bonusActions.value: The beast teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. Either its starting or destination space must contain fungus or rotting organic matter.

fluffInfo.value: *Apocalyptic Colossus of Hellfire*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: If a soul willingly perishes in flame or lava to ensure the behemoth's demise, the Fiend will find its flame quenched.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Burning Sacrifice
traits.value: If a creature willingly sacrifices its life in fire or lava for the purpose of defeating the behemoth, the creature can't be returned to life by any means. For the next 24 hours, the behemoth has Disadvantage on D20 Tests, its Speed is halved, it has Vulnerability to Radiant damage, and it loses its Legendary Resistance trait.

traits.name: Consuming Flame
traits.value: When the behemoth deals Fire damage, it can choose to deal Necrotic damage instead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The behemoth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The behemoth deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The behemoth can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 20-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The behemoth makes one Bite attack, and it makes two Claw or Blazing Boulder attacks in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**3d10 + 10**) Slashing damage plus 11 (**2d10**) Fire damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**3d8 + 10**) Slashing damage plus 5 (**1d10**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Boulder
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +18, range 150 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**1d10 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.value: *Burdened Harbinger of Death*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Chained Reaper carries a memorial stone upon its back. If one can read aloud the names inscribed there, their purity will burn away the reaper's fury.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ancestral Shame
traits.value: If a creature that can speak Orc within 30 feet of the reaper takes an action to read aloud the names carved in the stone on the reaper's back, the reaper takes 20 Radiant damage.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The reaper can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The reaper can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the reaper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The reaper makes one Balefire Scythe attack and one Chain attack, and it uses either Chain Slam or Fling.

actions.name: Balefire Scythe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the target begins burning. It takes Necrotic damage instead of Fire damage while burning in this way.

actions.name: Chain
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of four chains.

actions.name: Chain Slam
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature Grappled by the reaper. *Failure:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the reaper's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Fling
actions.value: The reaper throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *Unholy Crusader of Blood*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Crimson Abbot's pride is nearly unshakable, but seeing a true reminder of the righteous man he once was can crack his façade.

traits.name: Honor Lost
traits.value: If a creature takes a Bonus Action to present a memento or recite a reminder of the abbot's past and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check, the abbot has Disadvantage on the next D20 Test he makes before the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the abbot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The abbot can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.value: The abbot takes 20 Radiant damage if he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The abbot makes two Sanguine Blade attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Blood Call.

actions.name: Sanguine Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Blood Call
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature other than a Construct or Undead within 30 feet. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by the damage taken. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: The abbot regains Hit Points equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a __Crimson Clergy__ under the abbot's control.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.value: A haint that enters the space of an upright, empty bottle must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the bottle, and a cork or stopper appears to close the bottle. The trapped haint can see and hear through the bottle out to 10 feet, and any creature in that range can hear the haint. The haint is released if the bottle breaks or another creature opens it.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. This can't raise the target's Exhaustion level above 5, and all Exhaustion levels gained from this action end when the target finishes a Short or Long Rest, or if it receives a __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Duchess. They learn the following information based on their check result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Eldritch Abomination
fluffInfo.value: You understand her Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Thought Control
fluffInfo.value: You recognize her Deep Domination ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Water Affinity
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Duchess's Moisture Regeneration ability.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Duchess never confronts her enemies on their terms, preferring to stay in her lair where it is safe. She ventures as far as the edges of contaminated water, knowing full well that the water sustains her. When confronting foes in combat, she uses her Deep Domination on her enemies while calling in reinforcements with Call of the Deep. She grabs foes and flings them away to keep her enemies focused on her dominated minions.

Unless in her lair, she flees the moment she doesn't like the odds of a fight. If she is in her lair, she flees only if she is reduced below 100 Hit Points to attempt to find a new location in contaminated water to build a new lair.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Scales.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The Duchess can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Aura of the Deep
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Duchess takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, a creature can touch one of the Duchess's Delerium shards to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a Delerium shard restores Hit Points in this way, it can't do so again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The Dutchess is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Dutchess may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Duchess has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Moisture Regeneration
traits.value: The Duchess regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at 0 Hit Points and does not regenerate.

actions.name: The Duchess always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, the Duchess can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Duchess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Duchess can have up to four creatures Grappled at a time.
At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Fling
actions.value: One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and has the Prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Deep Domination (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature The Duchess can see. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition. The target is under the Duchess's control and can't take Reactions. The Duchess and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance.

Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failure, it gains one Contamination level. Once every 24 hours, if the creature is at least 1 mile away from the Duchess, it can repeat the saving throw.
If the target undergoes a Monstrous Transformation, it becomes a __Deep Dreg Warrior__, a __Deep Knight__, or a __Deep Siren__, and is forever in thrall to the Duchess.

actions.name: Call of the Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: The Duchess calls forth up to five __Deep Dregs__ or one __Deep Knight__. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. The creatures act after the Duchess on the same Initiative count and are under her control.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Duchess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. The Duchess can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Shade of Motherly Anguish*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Dusk Mother's only true weakness or fear is the remnants of her children—some trinket or toy they played with in life or, more chillingly, their spirits, which also wander the world, but never in the same place as their mother's shade.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Death's Shroud
traits.value: The mother always has the Invisible condition. Blindsight, Truesight, and other effects that allow a creature to see Invisible creatures don't reveal the mother. A creature that has been reduced to 0 Hit Points at least once in its life can see her normally.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The mother can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. She takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the mother fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The mother has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Steadfast Matron
traits.value: Undead creatures of the mother's choice in a 60-foot Emanation originating from her (excluding herself) have Advantage on saving throws. She can't use this trait if she has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Undeniable Guilt
traits.value: At the start of her turn, if the mother can see a possession once owned by her living children, or if she can see or hear the spirits of her children, she has the Incapacitated condition until the start of her next turn, and she must move as far from the object or spirits as possible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mother makes three Shears attacks.

actions.name: Shears
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Force damage. If the target is a creature and is hit with two or more Shears attacks in the same turn, it gains 1 Exhaustion level.

actions.name: Mournful Tolling (1/Day)
actions.value: The mother focuses her wail into her bell. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the mother (Constructs, Undead, and creatures that have ever been raised from the dead succeed automatically). *Failure:* 77 (**14d10**) Psychic damage that ignores the target's __Resistance__, if any, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the mother's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Soul Doll
bonusActions.value: The mother targets the corpse of a creature she killed within the last minute. The target's soul is drawn out and transforms into a ceramic doll of the creature. The doll is a Tiny object with AC 15, HP equal to half the creature's maximum Hit Points, Vulnerability to Thunder damage, and Immunity to Poison damage.
The soul can dimly see and hear its surroundings, and creatures with telepathy can communicate with the soul.

If the doll is destroyed, the soul arises from the doll as a Shadow under the mother's control. The creature can't be returned to life unless its soul is freed from the doll by a __Wish__ spell, or by destroying the shadow it spawned.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: The Dusk Queen has spell scrolls of: dominate person, globe of invulnerability, protection from energy (×2), see invisibility, slow, and true seeing. She also wears a handy haversack, a ring of feather falling, and winged boots.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.value: The Dusk Queen has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Shadow Dweller
traits.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the Dusk Queen's darkvision.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the Dusk Queen has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Traveler in Darkness
traits.value: The Dusk Queen has advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Dusk Queen makes three Shadow Bolt attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage plus 7 (**2d6**) cold damage.

actions.name: Call the Shadows (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Dusk Queen magically causes shadows to pour out of a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. A creature dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and its hit point maximum isn't reduced. A humanoid slain by this action rises at the start of the Dusk Queen's next turn as a shadow under her control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The Dusk Queen can have no more than ten shadows under her control at one time.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the Dusk Queen disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when she uses this bonus action.

fluffInfo.name: The Queen of Weald and Wood
fluffInfo.value: The Forest Queen rules the Endless Weald within Thelanis, an arboreal realm inhabited by dire beasts and wild fey. The Weald often leaks into the world through manifest zones found in deep forests; in such places, dryads lurk in the trees and beasts may possess unusual cunning. Under the right circumstances, travelers passing through a zone might even slip into the Weald. Such forests typically have well-worn paths that avoid these pitfalls, thus strengthening the story of stay on the path. The Greensinger druids know rituals to connect a forest to the Endless Weald, establishing a temporary manifest zone in any deep wood. The Queen's influence can also be felt in any forest in times when Eberron and Thelanis are coterminous. Just like the stories, the Queen's personality often reflects the forest where she's currently manifesting; the Forest Queen is more likely to be benevolent in the Twilight Demesne and cruel in the Nightwood.

fluffInfo.name: The Queen as Ally or Patron
fluffInfo.value: The Forest Queen has close ties to the Greensingers, and any Greensinger Druid or Ranger could have the Forest Queen as a patron. She's an option for a Warlock with an Archfey Patron, but the magic she teaches is primal in nature, not arcane. This doesn't change the spells available to the Warlock; their spells simply draw on elemental forces and the power of the fey rather than arcane formulas. As a more exotic option, a character with the Guide background could have slipped into the Endless Weald as a child and been raised in the court of the Forest Queen.
Regardless of origin, any character allied with the Forest Queen is expected to follow her rules.

entries: Don't use weapons or armor of metal.
Don't kill a natural beast with magic or for sport.
Protect those who travel on a marked path, unless they harm the forest with their actions.
Help any fey of the forest who comes to you in need.

fluffInfo.value: Beyond these basic principles, the Forest Queen's quests typically relate to the woods in some way. An agent of the Forest Queen could be tasked to reconsecrate a grove, to destroy an infestation of aberrations or other unnatural predators, or to prevent an ambitious dragonmarked house from expanding into woodlands. Beyond the forest, an agent could be tasked to recover a relic stolen from the Endless Weald (and once reclaimed, perhaps entrusted to carry this artifact on their adventures). Agents of the Forest Queen might be charged to act as envoys, negotiating with agents of other archfey or dealing with the Feyspires. Or perhaps there's a darkness in the Endless Weald, a canker that appeared when the forests of Cyre were consumed by the Mourning. The Forest Queen could task mortals to explore this region within the Weald, or charge them to explore the Mournland and to seek a cure for the wounded land.

fluffInfo.name: The Queen as an Enemy
fluffInfo.value: One could make an enemy of the Queen by breaking one of her rules while in her woods, or perhaps by killing one of her favored beasts or devoted agents. Such a personal enmity could lead to a character being targeted by natural threats—singled out by aggressive beasts, led astray on journeys through wild regions, or targeted by malicious sprites. A character could also earn her ire by taking one of her relics from a forest, perhaps not knowing that the magic item is tied to the wood. On a larger scale, the Forest Queen could grow tired of civilization itself. The forests containing her manifest zones could expand, with fey and feral beasts attacking villages and towns as they're overgrown. Could adventurers find a way to placate the bitter Queen, or must they defeat her to end this advance?

entries: **Skills**: animal handling +13, deception +22, insight +13, nature +19, perception +13, stealth +12
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Grace of the Forest Queen
traits.value: As long as the Forest Queen is within the Endless Weald, her AC is 25.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: No magic can observe the Forest Queen remotely or detect her thoughts without her permission. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the Forest Queen's intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in the Endless Weald)
traits.value: If the Forest Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Forest Queen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.value: The Forest Queen can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Thelanian Protagonist
traits.value: If destroyed, the Forest Queen reforms in 1d4 days, reviving with all her Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the Endless Weald.

traits.name: Woodland Camouflage
traits.value: The Forest Queen has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in wooded terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Forest Queen makes two attacks, using Grasping Vine and Verdant Staff in any combination.

actions.name: Grasping Vine
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 40 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23) from a vine that sprouts from the ground.

actions.name: Verdant Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Force damage.

bonusActions.name: Tree Stride
bonusActions.value: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the Forest Queen teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

fluffInfo.name: The Prince of All Things Forgotten and Unloved
fluffInfo.value: The Forgotten Prince dwells in the Castle of Lost Things in Thelanis. His attendants are sly and cunning fey, along with mortals who were unappreciated in their mundane lives. Some say that the __Kenku__ are servants of the Forgotten Prince who fled from his service—that he stole their voices as punishment for their betrayal, but that a __Kenku__ can earn it back with clever deeds. True or not, the Prince has followers scattered across Khorvaire—thieves who sacrifice unloved objects and undervalued secrets to the Prince in exchange for his guidance and gifts. Followers of the Forgotten Prince rarely work together, but they can be found in many positions of influence. There are elves in the Shadow Houses who receive visions from the Prince when they trance, and changelings among the Tyrants of Sharn who engage in more subtle thefts on behalf of the Prince, stealing hearts or faces. While his thefts often go unnoticed by the greater world, the Forgotten Prince also takes pleasure in seeing celebrated people whose reputations are undeserved brought low, and his agents may act to expose such poseurs. Adventurers could also be forced to deal with the Prince if he has something they need—perhaps an artifact or secret long forgotten, now sealed away in the vaults of his dark castle.

fluffInfo.name: The Prince as Ally or Patron
fluffInfo.value: The Forgotten Prince may reach out to people who have themselves been forgotten or unappreciated, provided he sees potential in them. Sometimes he brings them to the Castle of Lost Things; in other cases, he offers these agents purpose, rewarding them for their service with gifts or secrets. The [Wayfarer](https://5e.tools/backgrounds.html#wayfarer_phb) background is an excellent option for someone forgotten by the world but chosen by the Prince, while the [Hermit](https://5e.tools/backgrounds.html#hermit_phb) background could reflect someone who spent much of their life in the Castle of Lost Things. The Forgotten Prince could be an __Archfey__ for a Warlock, or a __Hexblade__ (Xanathar's Guide to Everything) could also receive their weapon as a gift from the Prince; what is the forgotten history and destiny of this weapon? The Forgotten Prince can also be an interesting patron for a Bard of the __Lore__; the Prince values secrets no one else considers valuable, and the __Cutting Words__ feature can be depicted as stealing opportunity from a foe—a trick taught by the Forgotten Prince. The Forgotten Prince could teach a Rogue the talents of an __Arcane Trickster__ or the skills of a __Thief__, provided they are willing to use those skills on his behalf.

Missions issued by the Prince typically involve the theft of an object or a secret. These things may not be seen as valuable by the people that possess them, and such a task could easily be added on top of the mission for an existing adventure—"While you're in Dreadhold, steal the ring under the warden's bed." The Prince could teach his agents a ten-minute ritual which allows him to pull the requested item into Thelanis (this only works with objects the Prince wants, so it's not a way to dispose of just any item). The Prince may also task agents with actions to expose or bring down people whose reputations are undeserved, or to assist those who are unappreciated. Note that good and evil don't enter into these judgments; the Prince could call on agents to bring down someone who's using their undeserved reputation for a good cause, or to help an unappreciated serial killer!

fluffInfo.name: The Prince as an Enemy
fluffInfo.value: The simplest way for the Prince to enter a story is for one of his agents to steal something that the adventurers need, or to take actions that cripple an organization or patron that the characters work for. This ties to the idea that the Prince may target someone with an undeserved reputation even if they are using it to do good; the adventurers themselves could be targeted if they acquire fame that the Prince considers unearned. Or the characters might discover they need something stolen long ago by the Prince—or an object they've recently acquired and desperately need has gone missing, and no one else seems to remember it. Characters could also be set against the Prince by another immortal patron; perhaps the Prince has stolen one of the memories of the __Forest Queen__, and she wants it back.

fluffInfo.name: The Power of Secrets
fluffInfo.value: A defining part of the Forgotten Prince's story is that he himself has been forgotten. Should a character somehow learn the true name of the Forgotten Prince during their adventures, they have Advantage on saving throws against spells that he casts.

fluffInfo.name: The Forgotten Prince's Lair
fluffInfo.value: The Prince dwells in the Castle of Forgotten Things in Thelanis. The castle seems to be its own distinct layer of Thelanis; if it exists in some other realm, its location has been forgotten. There are no doors that allow exit from the castle, and all the windows are sealed and show scenes of places that have been forgotten. The only way to enter or leave the castle is through magic, whether by spell, through a manifest zone, or through a portal. Such portals can take many forms, such as the sack described in the legend above; normal people forget the location of a portal within an hour of discovering it, though player characters and other remarkable people could be immune to this effect. It's possible characters could discover that what they assumed to be a normal Bag of Holding can serve as a portal to the Castle of Lost Things.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +15, deception +22, intimidation +15, perception +13, sleight of hand +15, stealth +15, survival +13

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the Forgotten Prince fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Forgotten Prince has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stolen Gifts
traits.value: At the start of each of his turns, the Forgotten Prince causes one creature he can see within 60 feet to make a DC 25 Wisdom (*Perception*) check. On a failed check, the Forgotten Prince steals one of the following from the target until the start of the his next turn:

entries: **Weapon Skill**: For the duration, the target has Disadvantage on weapon attacks, and the Prince has Advantage on Dark Scythe attacks.

**Spellcasting Ability**: For the duration, the target has Disadvantage on spell attacks, and all creatures have Advantage on saving throws made to resist the target's spells. Additionally, all creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws to resist the Prince's spells.
**Speed**: The target's Speed is reduced by 20 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet). Additionally, the Prince's Speed is increased by 20 feet, and he can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Thelanian Protagonist
traits.value: If destroyed, the Forgotten Prince reforms in 1d4 days, reviving with all his Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the Castle of Forgotten Things.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Forgotten Prince makes two Dark Scythe attacks.

actions.name: Dark Scythe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 29 (**6d6 + 8**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Threads of Memory (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 23, up to three creatures the Forgotten Prince can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Psychic damage, and the target's memories are stolen. Until the memories return, the target subtracts 2 (1d4) from all D20 Tests. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonusActions.name: Fey Step
bonusActions.value: The Forgotten Prince can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: The Forgotten Prince can take the Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *Headless Executioner of Vengeance*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Galloping Headsman's original skull is its greatest weakness, and anyone holding the skull becomes the apparition's bane.

entries: **Immunities**: fire, poison; charmed, frightened, exhaustion, poisoned

traits.name: Binding Skull
traits.value: The headsman has Vulnerability to any damage dealt by a creature holding the headsman's original skull, and it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls made against that creature.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the headsman fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The headsman has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The headsman makes two Headsman's Axe attacks and one Hooves attack.

actions.name: Headsman's Axe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**2d12 + 6**) Slashing damage plus 16 (**3d10**) Fire damage. If the target is a creature with at least one head and the headsman rolled a 20 on the attack roll, the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or it is decapitated and dies if it can't survive without a head. A target is immune to this effect if it takes none of the damage, has Legendary Actions, or is Huge or larger. Such a creature takes an extra 28 (**8d6**) Force damage from the hit.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**4d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the headsman moved at least 20 feet immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Flaming Skull (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The headsman hurls its skull, after which it reappears in the headsman's hand. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 63 (**14d8**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: The target starts burning.

fluffInfo.value: *Corrupted Ghost Train*

traits.name: Crooked Switch (1/Day)
traits.value: When the locomotive is *Bloodied*, it regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance and enters a malevolent form for 12 hours. In this form, it is Chaotic Evil and can use its Multiattack action.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the locomotive fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack (Crooked Switch Only)
actions.value: The locomotive makes two Rail Slam attacks.

actions.name: Rail Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away.

actions.name: Spirit Exhaust (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: The elusive crime boss of the criminal syndicate called the Killer Flock. The Godfeather lived in hiding among Alderheart's high society as the well-to-do Cluvus Lightbreeze, before his eventual unmasking led to public disgrace for him and his house.

Though his identity was revealed, Cluvus is still at large, and still wields his power over the Killer Flock as their leader, ruling from the shadows. It is his goal to wipe out all other major criminal factions within the city, including the Bandit Coalition, to strengthen his hold on Alderheart's lucrative black market.

This grave male sable luma is the leader of a notorious crime family known as the Killer Flock. He managed to conceal his identity for years but has recently gone into hiding since being uncovered. He has bluish-gray plumage, dark blue eyes, and a distinctive scar on his beak.

entries: **Languages**: Birdfolk, Hedge, Thieves' cant, Vulpin, understands Auran but can't speak it

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.value: The Godfeather wears a hat of disguise and a ring of mind shielding to keep himself hidden from the watchful eyes of the Perch Guard.

traits.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
traits.value: The Godfeather can choose to reroll any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Glide
traits.value: When falling at least 10 feet, the Godfeather can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. The Godfeather can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

traits.name: Resilience
traits.value: The Godfeather has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.value: As a bonus action, the Godfeather can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself 15 feet upward. The Godfeather can't use this ability while gliding.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) slashing damage or 5 (**1d10**) slashing damage if used with both hands.

fluffInfo.value: *Dealer of Jinxes*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Grinning Sinner holds his prowess and reputation as a fearsome and successful pirate captain above all; causing him to doubt his renown can turn his hexed magic against him.

traits.name: Coffin Rider
traits.value: The sinner has a magic coffin that has Immunity to all damage. While standing on the coffin, the sinner rides it on a ghostly wave of swamp water with a Speed of 60 feet and can move over liquids as if they were solid.

traits.name: Curse Bottle
traits.value: The sinner has a bottle that holds cursed magic. The bottle has AC 15, HP 25, and Immunity to all damage except Force. If the bottle is destroyed, the sinner can magically create a new one when he finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the sinner fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Overweening Pride
traits.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature can insult the sinner's skill and renown as a pirate captain. The sinner must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sinner makes two attacks, using Hex Grasp or Blunderbuss in any combination. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast __Bane__.

actions.name: Hex Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed until the start of the sinner's next turn, or until the sinner curses it in this way again. While cursed, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and on ability checks that rely on an ability of the sinner's choice.

actions.name: Blunderbuss
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away.

actions.name: Curse Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sinner unleashes one of the following curses from his blunderbuss:

entries:
**Jack's Anguish**: A magenta wave fires out with a deep, wailing moan. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
After 1 minute, it automatically succeeds. *Success* Half damage only.

**Shadowy Friends**: A wave of shadow coughs forth and wraps around foes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the sinner's next turn. If a Paralyzed target takes damage, the condition ends early.
**Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.value: A haint that enters the space of an upright, empty bottle must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the bottle, and a cork or stopper appears to close the bottle. The trapped haint can see and hear through the bottle out to 10 feet, and any creature in that range can hear the haint. The haint is released if the bottle breaks or another creature opens it.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. This can't raise the target's Exhaustion level above 5, and all Exhaustion levels gained from this action end when the target finishes a Short or Long Rest, or if it receives a __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic.

fluffInfo.value: *Demon of Secrets and Despair*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The soul of Ol' Jericho Sticks still exists in the dark recesses of the Harvest Terror's mind. Singing or playing Jericho's favorite song tips the balance of control over Jericho's stolen body.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned (except for its Unraveling Song trait)

traits.name: Demonic Mimicry
traits.value: The terror can mimic voices and sounds it has heard. A listener can discern the mimicry for what it is with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the terror fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The terror has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unraveling Song
traits.value: As an Influence action, a creature can play or sing Jericho Sticks' favorite song, "Coal-Eyed Birds," to give the terror the Charmed condition until the end of the creature's next turn. The condition ends early if the creature damages the terror or forces it to make a saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The terror makes one Claw attack and one Scythe attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Dirge of Secrets (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the terror. *Failure:* The creature takes 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *Sin Made Manifest*

traits.name: Enduring Restoration
traits.value: If the Horned King dies, its body disappears in a cloud of ash. It becomes an intangible, Invisible spirit in its home forest, and it can't reform a new physical body for 10d10 years.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.value: If the Horned King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Horned King has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Horned King makes three Cursed Strike attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Terrorizing Breath.

actions.name: Cursed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12 (against a cursed target, scores a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20 on the d20), reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (Horned King's choice) plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed until the end of the Horned King's next turn. While cursed, it must subtract 1d4 from D20 Tests.

actions.name: Breath of Corruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level that ends at the end of the target's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrorizing Breath
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonusActions.name: Sense Desire
bonusActions.value: The Horned King casts __Detect Thoughts__, requiring no spell components and using Charisma for the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20).

traits.name: Dying Gasp
traits.value: When the Horror dies, they begin to rupture in a vile explosion of viscera and necrotic energy. The creature who reduced the Horror to 0 hit points can make a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check to appeal to Elyas's departing soul (no action required). On a successful check, his soul transforms the explosion and each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 feet of the Horror gains 7 (2d6) temporary hit points. On a failed check (or if no check is made), each creature within 15 feet of the Horror must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (**1d8**) acid damage plus 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spine Cleaver
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage against a grappled target.

actions.name: Bone Hook
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14) and the Horror can pull the target up to 15 feet toward them.
Until this grapple ends, the Horror can't make a Bone Hook attack against another target.

bonusActions.name: Valor's Death
bonusActions.value: Each enemy within 10 feet of the Horror who can hear the Horror must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the Horror for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the Horror's Valor's Death for 24 hours.

entries: **Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, stunned
**Languages**: understands Common and Torum but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.value: If the Hunter fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.value: Unless it wishes to be affected, the Hunter is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.value: The Hunter's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: New Life
traits.value: When the Hunter dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

traits.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
traits.value: If the Hunter drops below 250 hit points, it automatically regains 100 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Hunter makes three attacks: two with its Claw and one with Peck.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**4d6 + 10**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Peck
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Inspiring Presence
actions.value: Each creature of the Hunter's choice that is within 1,000 feet of the Hunter and aware of it gains inspiration and 19 (3d12) temporary hit points.
Once a creature benefits from the Hunter's Inspiring Presence, it can't do so again until 7 days have passed.

fluffInfo.value: *Curse-Wrought Swamp Monster*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: An idol of the fabled deal maker Snake Eye Jack that has been blessed by one of Jack's followers can turn the Jinxed Leviathan's own cursed power against it.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The leviathan can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.value: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Returned Curse
traits.value: If the leviathan curses a creature holding an idol of Snake Eye Jack blessed by one of his devoted followers, the creature is unaffected by the curse. The leviathan then takes 20 Radiant damage and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The leviathan makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**2d12 + 10**) Piercing damage plus 13 (**3d8**) Force damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20), and until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**3d8 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition and is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the leviathan.

actions.name: Accursed Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 78 (**12d12**) Necrotic damage, and the target is cursed. The cursed target has Disadvantage on D20 Tests and can't regain Hit Points. The target can end the curse early if it voluntarily fails a saving throw forced by one of its enemies. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the leviathan (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the leviathan, and takes 24 (**7d6**) Force damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the leviathan takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the leviathan must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the leviathan and has the Prone condition. If the leviathan dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

fluffInfo.value: *Fiendish Master of Revels*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The Lord of Fools thrives on laughter and amusement, so when someone doesn't react accordingly to one of his japes, he becomes enraged at that creature to the exclusion of others.

traits.name: Bitter Medicine
traits.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature can dismiss or belittle the lord's attempts at humor. If the creature succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (*Deception*) check, the lord has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than that creature until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Infinite Jest
traits.value: The lord creates an illusion of a Small Humanoid jester in his space. While he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, the lord can move the image up to 60 feet during his turn (no action required). The lord can perceive and speak through this image as if he were in the image's space. The image is insubstantial, but it can manipulate objects as if it has a Strength of 10.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the lord fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.value: The lord can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lord makes two attacks, using Ribbon or Joy Buzzer in any combination. If the lord has cast __Project Image__, he can make melee Joy Buzzer attacks from the image's space.

actions.name: Ribbon
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of six ribbons. It has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Joy Buzzer
actions.value: The lord's Infinite Jest illusion moves to a target within range. Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**3d12 + 5**) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the end of the lord's next turn. *Hit or Miss:* The jester vanishes and reappears in the lord's space.

actions.name: Exploding Pie (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The lord throws a massive pie that explodes in corrosive custard. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the lord can see within 100 feet. *Failure:* 16 (**3d10**) Acid damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the lord's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Ribbon Step
bonusActions.value: The lord vanishes in a burst of confetti and ribbons and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

traits.value: The painted king focuses its attacks on any creature carrying one of the painted stones from the Paletree Rise. The king's goal is to collect the stones, and should they be turned over to it, it gathers them and flees.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The painted king can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.value: The painted king can speak telepathically with any creature within 60 feet of it that carries a painted stone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The painted king makes three Claw attacks or Paint Splash attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Paint Splash
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Painted Step (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The painted king disappears and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it. A brief splash of colorful paint appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Draining Swipe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.value: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.value: A haint that enters the space of an upright, empty bottle must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the bottle, and a cork or stopper appears to close the bottle. The trapped haint can see and hear through the bottle out to 10 feet, and any creature in that range can hear the haint. The haint is released if the bottle breaks or another creature opens it.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. This can't raise the target's Exhaustion level above 5, and all Exhaustion levels gained from this action end when the target finishes a Short or Long Rest, or if it receives a __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic.

**Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
